name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauOne_of_mem_not_mem
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauOne_of_mem_not_mem
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.MuValid j) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∉ J) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.mu hf j valid)
        (.niveauOne (symmDiff J {j + 1})) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauOne J)
proof:
:= by
  have hDisjoint : Disjoint J ({j + 1} : Set (ZMod f)) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro i hiJ hiSingleton
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hiSingleton
    subst i
    exact hj1 hiJ
  have hToggle := Pinning.niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_of_disjoint hf
    (sigma.mu hf j valid) J {j + 1} hDisjoint
  have hMu := Pinning.niveauOneProfileSum_mu_of_mem_not_mem hp hf sigma j
    valid J hj hj1
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hSingleton :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) {j + 1} =
        inversePower p f hf j := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne ({j + 1} : Set (ZMod f))).indicator i : Int) *
            ((sigma.mu hf j valid).u i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j + 1 then (p : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp [PhantomWeight.mu, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hsucc, valid.2]
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
    rw [hfun, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_natCast]
    exact inversePower_succ p f hp hf j
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
  change sigma.t +
      niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) (symmDiff J {j + 1}) =
    sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J
  rw [hToggle, hMu, hSingleton]
  ring

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauTwo_of_mem_not_mem
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauTwo_of_mem_not_mem
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (valid : sigma.MuValid (periodicIndex hf a))
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (ha : a ∈ J) (ha1 : a + 1 ∉ J) :
    profileLeftExponent hf
        (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid)
        ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).periodicSymmDiff hf
          {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ)
proof:
:= by
  have hperiodicSucc :
      periodicIndex hf (a + 1) = periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_one]
  have hsucc : periodicIndex hf a + 1 ≠ periodicIndex hf a := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (periodicIndex hf a + 1) - periodicIndex hf a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have ha1Half : a + 1 + f ∈ J := by
    by_contra h
    exact ha1 ((hJ (a + 1)).mpr h)
  have hToggle :=
    Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSingletonToggle_of_mem hf
      (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J hJ (a + 1 + f) ha1Half
  have hPeriodicHalf :
      periodicIndex hf (a + 1 + f) = periodicIndex hf (a + 1) :=
    periodicIndex_add_half hf (a + 1)
  have hTwiceHalf : a + 1 + f + f = a + 1 := by
    calc
      a + 1 + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + f = a + 1 + (2 * f : Nat) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      _ = a + 1 := by simp
  have hTargetSucc :
      (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid).periodicU hf (a + 1 + f) = p := by
    rw [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodicHalf, hperiodicSucc]
    simp [PhantomWeight.mu, hsucc, valid.2]
  rw [hPeriodicHalf, hTwiceHalf, hTargetSucc] at hToggle
  have hMu := Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_mu_of_mem_not_mem
    (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) hf sigma a valid J hJ ha ha1
  have hRecurrence :
      (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1) =
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a := by
    simpa only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent] using
      inversePower_succ p (2 * f) (by omega : 1 ≤ p) (by omega) a
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, Profile.periodicSymmDiff,
    CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
  change liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid)
        (symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)})) =
    liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J
  rw [hToggle, hMu, hRecurrence]
  ring

name: KLSposet.mu_leftExponentSet_subset
statement:
theorem mu_leftExponentSet_subset
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.MuValid j) :
    leftExponentSet hf sigma ⊆ leftExponentSet hf (sigma.mu hf j valid)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hDet : determinantExponent hf sigma =
      determinantExponent hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) :=
    (determinantExponent_mu (by omega) hf sigma j valid).symm
  apply (leftExponentSet_subset_iff_complementary_choice_of_determinant_eq
    hp hf sigma (sigma.mu hf j valid) hDet).2
  intro profile
  cases profile with
  | niveauOne J =>
      by_cases hj : j ∈ J
      · by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J
        · left
          exact ⟨.niveauOne J,
            profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauOne (by omega) hf sigma j valid J
              hj hj1⟩
        · left
          exact ⟨.niveauOne (symmDiff J {j + 1}),
            profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauOne_of_mem_not_mem (by omega) hf
              sigma j valid J hj hj1⟩
      · by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J
        · right
          have hjCompl : j ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          have hj1Compl : j + 1 ∉ Jᶜ := by simpa
          exact ⟨.niveauOne (symmDiff Jᶜ {j + 1}), by
            simpa only [Profile.compl] using
              profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauOne_of_mem_not_mem (by omega) hf
                sigma j valid Jᶜ hjCompl hj1Compl⟩
        · right
          have hjCompl : j ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          have hj1Compl : j + 1 ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          exact ⟨.niveauOne Jᶜ, by
            simpa only [Profile.compl] using
              profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauOne (by omega) hf sigma j valid Jᶜ
                hjCompl hj1Compl⟩
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      let a0 : ZMod (2 * f) := shiftedFirstLift hf 0 j
      have ha0Index : periodicIndex hf a0 = j :=
        periodicIndex_shiftedFirstLift hf 0 j
      let a : ZMod (2 * f) := if a0 ∈ J then a0 else a0 + f
      have haIndex : periodicIndex hf a = j := by
        dsimp only [a]
        split_ifs with ha0
        · exact ha0Index
        · rw [periodicIndex_add_half, ha0Index]
      have ha : a ∈ J := by
        dsimp only [a]
        split_ifs with ha0
        · exact ha0
        · by_contra ha0f
          exact ha0 ((hJ a0).mpr ha0f)
      by_cases ha1 : a + 1 ∈ J
      · left
        have hEq := profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauTwo (by omega) hf sigma a
          (by simpa only [haIndex] using valid) J hJ ha ha1
        exact ⟨.niveauTwo J hJ, by simpa only [haIndex] using hEq⟩
      · left
        have hEq := profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauTwo_of_mem_not_mem hp hf
          sigma a (by simpa only [haIndex] using valid) J hJ ha ha1
        exact ⟨(Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).periodicSymmDiff hf
          {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}, by
            simpa only [haIndex] using hEq⟩

name: KLSposet.mu_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset
statement:
theorem mu_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.MuValid j) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars (sigma.mu hf j valid)
proof:
:= by
  apply semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_determinant_eq_of_left_subset hp hf
    chars sigma (sigma.mu hf j valid)
  · exact (determinantExponent_mu (by omega) hf sigma j valid).symm
  · exact mu_leftExponentSet_subset hp hf sigma j valid

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauOne_toggle_of_mem_mem
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauOne_toggle_of_mem_mem
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf j valid)
        (.niveauOne (symmDiff J {j + 1})) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauOne J)
proof:
:= by
  have hSubset : ({j + 1} : Set (ZMod f)) ⊆ J := by
    intro i hi
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hi
    subst i
    exact hj1
  have hToggle := Pinning.niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_of_subset hf
    (sigma.theta hf j valid) J {j + 1} hSubset
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hSingleton :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) {j + 1} =
        inversePower p f hf j := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne ({j + 1} : Set (ZMod f))).indicator i : Int) *
            ((sigma.theta hf j valid).u i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j + 1 then (p : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp [PhantomWeight.theta, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hsucc, valid.2]
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
    rw [hfun, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_natCast]
    exact inversePower_succ p f (by omega) hf j
  have hTheta := profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauOne_of_mem_mem (by omega) hf
    sigma j valid J hj hj1
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq] at hTheta ⊢
  rw [hToggle, hSingleton]
  linear_combination hTheta

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauTwo_toggle_of_mem_mem
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauTwo_toggle_of_mem_mem
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid (periodicIndex hf a))
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)

    profileLeftExponent hf
        (sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid)
        ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).periodicSymmDiff hf
          {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ)
proof:
:= by
  have hperiodicSucc :
      periodicIndex hf (a + 1) = periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_one]
  have hsucc : periodicIndex hf a + 1 ≠ periodicIndex hf a := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (periodicIndex hf a + 1) - periodicIndex hf a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hToggle :=
    Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSingletonToggle_of_mem hf
      (sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J hJ (a + 1) ha1
  have hTargetSucc :
      (sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid).periodicU hf (a + 1) = p := by
    rw [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hperiodicSucc]
    simp [PhantomWeight.theta, hsucc, valid.2]
  rw [hTargetSucc] at hToggle
  have hTheta := profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauTwo_of_mem_mem hp hf sigma a
    valid J hJ ha ha1
  have hRecurrence :
      (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1) =
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a := by
    simpa only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent] using
      inversePower_succ p (2 * f) (by omega : 1 ≤ p) (by omega) a
  have hRecurrenceHalf :
      (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1 + f) =
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + f) := by
    have hrec := inversePower_succ p (2 * f) (by omega : 1 ≤ p)
      (by omega) (a + f)
    rw [show a + f + 1 = a + 1 + f by ring] at hrec
    simpa only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent] using hrec
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, Profile.periodicSymmDiff,
    CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq] at hTheta ⊢
  rw [hToggle, hRecurrence, hRecurrenceHalf]

name: KLSposet.theta_leftExponentSet_subset
statement:

    (determinantExponent_theta (by omega) hf sigma j valid).symm

    hp hf sigma (sigma.theta hf j valid) hDet).2
  intro profile

      by_cases hj : j ∈ J
      · by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J
        · left

      · by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J
        · right
          have hjCompl : j ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          have hj1Compl : j + 1 ∉ Jᶜ := by simpa
          exact ⟨.niveauOne Jᶜ, by
            simpa only [Profile.compl] using
              profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauOne hf sigma j valid Jᶜ
                hjCompl hj1Compl⟩
        · right
          have hjCompl : j ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          have hj1Compl : j + 1 ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          exact ⟨.niveauOne (symmDiff Jᶜ {j + 1}), by
            simpa only [Profile.compl] using
              profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauOne_toggle_of_mem_mem hp hf sigma
                j valid Jᶜ hjCompl hj1Compl⟩
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      let a0 : ZMod (2 * f) := shiftedFirstLift hf 0 j
      have ha0Index : periodicIndex hf a0 = j :=

      have haIndex : periodicIndex hf a = j := by
        dsimp only [a]
        split_ifs with ha0
        · exact ha0Index
        · rw [periodicIndex_add_half, ha0Index]
      have ha : a ∈ J := by
        dsimp only [a]
        split_ifs with ha0
        · exact ha0
        · by_contra ha0f
          exact ha0 ((hJ a0).mpr ha0f)
      by_cases ha1 : a + 1 ∈ J
      · left
        have hEq := profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauTwo_toggle_of_mem_mem hp hf
          sigma a (by simpa only [haIndex] using valid) J hJ ha ha1
        exact ⟨(Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).periodicSymmDiff hf
          {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}, by simpa only [haIndex] using hEq⟩
      · left
        have hEq := profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauTwo hp hf sigma a
          (by simpa only [haIndex] using valid) J hJ ha ha1
        exact ⟨.niveauTwo J hJ, by simpa only [haIndex] using hEq⟩

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileSum_singleton
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_singleton
    {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (i : ZMod f) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {i} =
      (sigma.u i : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
  have hfun :
      (fun k : ZMod f ↦
        ((Profile.niveauOne ({i} : Set (ZMod f))).indicator k : Int) *
          (sigma.u k : Int)) =
      (fun k : ZMod f ↦ if k = i then (sigma.u i : Int) else 0) := by
    funext k
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst k
      simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set]
    · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hki]
  rw [hfun, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
  norm_num only [Int.cast_natCast]

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne_toggle_both_of_mem_not_mem
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne_toggle_both_of_mem_not_mem
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid j) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∉ J) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid)
        (.niveauOne (symmDiff (symmDiff J {j}) {j + 1})) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauOne J)
proof:
:= by
  let tau := sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid
  let K0 : Set (ZMod f) := symmDiff J {j}
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hjSubset : ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) ⊆ J := by
    intro i hi
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hi
    simpa only [hi] using hj
  have hRemove := Pinning.niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_of_subset hf tau J {j}
    hjSubset
  have hj1K0 : j + 1 ∉ K0 := by
    simp [K0, Set.mem_symmDiff, hj1, hsucc]
  have hSuccDisjoint : Disjoint K0 ({j + 1} : Set (ZMod f)) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro i hiK0 hiSingleton
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hiSingleton
    subst i
    exact hj1K0 hiK0
  have hAdd := Pinning.niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_of_disjoint hf tau K0
    {j + 1} hSuccDisjoint
  have hSourceDisjoint : Disjoint J ({j + 1} : Set (ZMod f)) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro i hiJ hiSingleton
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hiSingleton
    subst i
    exact hj1 hiJ
  have hSourceAdd := Pinning.niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_of_disjoint hf sigma
    J {j + 1} hSourceDisjoint
  have hTable := profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne (by omega) hf sigma j valid
    J hj hj1
  have hTauJ : tau.u j = 1 := by
    change sigma.u j = 0 at valid
    simp [tau, PhantomWeight.nu, valid]
  have hTauSucc : tau.u (j + 1) = p - sigma.u (j + 1) := by
    simp [tau, PhantomWeight.nu, hsucc]
  have hRecurrence :
      (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf (j + 1) =
        inversePower p f hf j :=
    inversePower_succ p f (by omega) hf j
  have huSuccLe : sigma.u (j + 1) ≤ p := sigma.u_le (j + 1)
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, Profile.periodicSymmDiff,
    CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq] at hTable ⊢
  change tau.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf tau
      (symmDiff (symmDiff J {j}) {j + 1}) =
    sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J
  change niveauOneProfileSum hf tau K0 = _ at hRemove
  change niveauOneProfileSum hf tau (symmDiff K0 {j + 1}) = _ at hAdd
  rw [hAdd, hRemove, niveauOneProfileSum_singleton,
    niveauOneProfileSum_singleton, hTauJ, hTauSucc, Nat.cast_sub huSuccLe]
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
  rw [sub_mul, hRecurrence]
  rw [hSourceAdd, niveauOneProfileSum_singleton] at hTable
  linear_combination hTable

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauTwo_toggle_both_of_mem_not_mem
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauTwo_toggle_both_of_mem_not_mem
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)

    (valid : sigma.NuValid (periodicIndex hf a))

        (((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).periodicSymmDiff hf
          {periodicIndex hf a}).periodicSymmDiff hf
            {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ)
proof:
:= by
  let tau := sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid
  let T0 : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a}
  let K0 : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := symmDiff J T0
  have hperiodicSucc :
      periodicIndex hf (a + 1) = periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_one]
  have hsucc : periodicIndex hf a + 1 ≠ periodicIndex hf a := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (periodicIndex hf a + 1) - periodicIndex hf a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hT0Periodic (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i ∈ T0 ↔ i + f ∈ T0 := by
    simp [T0, periodicIndexSet, periodicIndex_add_half]
  have hK0 : ∀ i, i ∈ K0 ↔ i + f ∉ K0 := by
    intro i
    simp only [K0, Set.mem_symmDiff]
    have hJi := hJ i
    have hTi := hT0Periodic i
    tauto
  have hbJ : a + 1 + f ∈ J := by
    by_contra h
    exact ha1 ((hJ (a + 1)).mpr h)
  have hPeriodicB :
      periodicIndex hf (a + 1 + f) = periodicIndex hf (a + 1) :=
    periodicIndex_add_half hf (a + 1)
  have hbNotT0 : a + 1 + f ∉ T0 := by
    simp [T0, periodicIndexSet, hPeriodicB, hperiodicSucc, hsucc]
  have hbK0 : a + 1 + f ∈ K0 := by
    simp [K0, Set.mem_symmDiff, hbJ, hbNotT0]
  have hWrap : a + 1 + f + f = a + 1 := by
    calc
      a + 1 + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + f = a + 1 + (2 * f : Nat) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      _ = a + 1 := by simp
  have hBaseToggle :=
    Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSingletonToggle_of_mem hf tau J hJ a ha
  have hSuccToggle :=
    Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSingletonToggle_of_mem hf tau K0 hK0
      (a + 1 + f) hbK0
  have hSourceToggle :=
    Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSingletonToggle_of_mem hf sigma J hJ
      (a + 1 + f) hbJ
  rw [hPeriodicB, hWrap] at hSuccToggle hSourceToggle
  have hTable := profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauTwo hp hf sigma a valid J hJ ha
    ha1
  have hTauA : tau.periodicU hf a = 1 := by
    change sigma.u (periodicIndex hf a) = 0 at valid
    simp [tau, PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.nu, valid]
  have hTauB :
      tau.periodicU hf (a + 1 + f) =
        p - sigma.u (periodicIndex hf (a + 1)) := by
    simp [tau, PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.nu, hPeriodicB,
      hperiodicSucc, hsucc]
  have hSigmaB :
      sigma.periodicU hf (a + 1 + f) =
        sigma.u (periodicIndex hf (a + 1)) := by
    simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodicB]
  have huSuccLe : sigma.u (periodicIndex hf (a + 1)) ≤ p :=
    sigma.u_le _
  have hRecurrence :
      (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1) =
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a := by
    simpa only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent] using
      inversePower_succ p (2 * f) (by omega : 1 ≤ p) (by omega) a
  have hRecurrenceHalf :
      (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1 + f) =
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + f) := by
    have hrec := inversePower_succ p (2 * f) (by omega : 1 ≤ p)
      (by omega) (a + f)
    rw [show a + f + 1 = a + 1 + f by ring] at hrec
    simpa only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent] using hrec
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, Profile.periodicSymmDiff,
    CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq] at hTable ⊢
  change liftQPlusOne p f tau.t +
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf tau
        (symmDiff K0 (periodicIndexSet hf
          {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)})) =
    liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J
  change niveauTwoProfileSum hf tau K0 = _ at hBaseToggle
  change niveauTwoProfileSum hf tau
      (symmDiff K0 (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)})) = _
    at hSuccToggle
  rw [hSuccToggle, hBaseToggle, hTauA, hTauB, Nat.cast_sub huSuccLe]
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
  rw [sub_mul, sub_mul, hRecurrence, hRecurrenceHalf]
  rw [hSigmaB] at hSourceToggle
  rw [hSourceToggle] at hTable
  linear_combination hTable

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne_toggle_of_mem_mem
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne_toggle_of_mem_mem
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid j) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid)
        (.niveauOne (symmDiff J {j + 1})) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauOne J)
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  let K : Set (ZMod f) := symmDiff J {j + 1}
  have hjK : j ∈ K := by
    simp [K, Set.mem_symmDiff, hj, Ne.symm hsucc]
  have hj1K : j + 1 ∉ K := by
    simp [K, Set.mem_symmDiff, hj1]
  have hEq := profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne (by omega) hf sigma j valid K
    hjK hj1K
  have hKK : symmDiff K {j + 1} = J := by
    ext i
    simp only [K, Set.mem_symmDiff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    tauto
  simpa only [K, Profile.periodicSymmDiff, hKK] using hEq

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauTwo_toggle_of_mem_mem
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauTwo_toggle_of_mem_mem
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (valid : sigma.NuValid (periodicIndex hf a))
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (ha : a ∈ J) (ha1 : a + 1 ∈ J) :
    profileLeftExponent hf
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid)
        ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).periodicSymmDiff hf
          {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ)
proof:
:= by
  have hperiodicSucc :
      periodicIndex hf (a + 1) = periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_one]
  have hsucc : periodicIndex hf a + 1 ≠ periodicIndex hf a := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (periodicIndex hf a + 1) - periodicIndex hf a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}
  let K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := symmDiff J T
  have hTPeriodic (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i ∈ T ↔ i + f ∈ T := by
    simp [T, periodicIndexSet, periodicIndex_add_half]
  have hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K := by
    intro i
    simp only [K, Set.mem_symmDiff]
    have hJi := hJ i
    have hTi := hTPeriodic i
    tauto
  have haT : a ∉ T := by
    simp [T, periodicIndexSet, hperiodicSucc, Ne.symm hsucc]
  have haK : a ∈ K := by
    simp [K, Set.mem_symmDiff, ha, haT]
  have ha1T : a + 1 ∈ T := by
    simp [T, periodicIndexSet]
  have ha1K : a + 1 ∉ K := by
    simp [K, Set.mem_symmDiff, ha1, ha1T]
  have hEq := profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauTwo hp hf sigma a valid K hK
    haK ha1K
  have hKK : symmDiff K T = J := by
    ext i
    simp only [K, Set.mem_symmDiff]
    tauto
  simpa only [Profile.periodicSymmDiff, K, T, hKK] using hEq

name: KLSposet.nu_leftExponentSet_subset
statement:
theorem nu_leftExponentSet_subset
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid j) :
    leftExponentSet hf sigma ⊆
      leftExponentSet hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hDet : determinantExponent hf sigma =
      determinantExponent hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid) :=
    (determinantExponent_nu (by omega) hf sigma j valid).symm
  apply (leftExponentSet_subset_iff_complementary_choice_of_determinant_eq
    hp hf sigma (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid) hDet).2
  intro profile
  cases profile with
  | niveauOne J =>
      by_cases hj : j ∈ J
      · by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J
        · left
          exact ⟨.niveauOne (symmDiff J {j + 1}),
            profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne_toggle_of_mem_mem hp hf sigma j
              valid J hj hj1⟩
        · left
          exact ⟨.niveauOne (symmDiff (symmDiff J {j}) {j + 1}),
            profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne_toggle_both_of_mem_not_mem hp hf
              sigma j valid J hj hj1⟩
      · by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J
        · right
          have hjCompl : j ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          have hj1Compl : j + 1 ∉ Jᶜ := by simpa
          exact ⟨.niveauOne (symmDiff (symmDiff Jᶜ {j}) {j + 1}), by
            simpa only [Profile.compl] using
              profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne_toggle_both_of_mem_not_mem hp hf
                sigma j valid Jᶜ hjCompl hj1Compl⟩
        · right
          have hjCompl : j ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          have hj1Compl : j + 1 ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          exact ⟨.niveauOne (symmDiff Jᶜ {j + 1}), by
            simpa only [Profile.compl] using
              profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne_toggle_of_mem_mem hp hf sigma j
                valid Jᶜ hjCompl hj1Compl⟩
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      let a0 : ZMod (2 * f) := shiftedFirstLift hf 0 j
      have ha0Index : periodicIndex hf a0 = j :=
        periodicIndex_shiftedFirstLift hf 0 j
      let a : ZMod (2 * f) := if a0 ∈ J then a0 else a0 + f
      have haIndex : periodicIndex hf a = j := by
        dsimp only [a]
        split_ifs with ha0
        · exact ha0Index
        · rw [periodicIndex_add_half, ha0Index]
      have ha : a ∈ J := by
        dsimp only [a]
        split_ifs with ha0
        · exact ha0
        · by_contra ha0f
          exact ha0 ((hJ a0).mpr ha0f)
      by_cases ha1 : a + 1 ∈ J
      · left
        have hEq := profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauTwo_toggle_of_mem_mem hp hf
          sigma a (by simpa only [haIndex] using valid) J hJ ha ha1
        exact ⟨(Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).periodicSymmDiff hf
          {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}, by simpa only [haIndex] using hEq⟩
      · left
        have hEq :=
          profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauTwo_toggle_both_of_mem_not_mem hp hf
            sigma a (by simpa only [haIndex] using valid) J hJ ha ha1
        exact ⟨((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).periodicSymmDiff hf
          {periodicIndex hf a}).periodicSymmDiff hf
            {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}, by simpa only [haIndex] using hEq⟩

name: KLSposet.nu_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset
statement:
theorem nu_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid j) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid)
proof:
:= by
  apply semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_determinant_eq_of_left_subset hp hf
    chars sigma (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid)
  · exact (determinantExponent_nu (by omega) hf sigma j valid).symm
  · exact nu_leftExponentSet_subset hp hf sigma j valid

name: KLSposet.muStrictWitness_translationExponent_ne_zero
statement:
theorem muStrictWitness_translationExponent_ne_zero
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (I : Set (ZMod f)) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.MuValid j) (hNoninvertible : sigma.u j ≠ 1) :
    translationExponent p f hf
        (fun i ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne I).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.u i : Int) - if i = j then 1 else 0) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  let y : ZMod f → Int := fun i ↦
    ((Profile.niveauOne I).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) -
      if i = j then 1 else 0
  have hy : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ (p : Int) := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [y]
    by_cases hi : i ∈ I
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp only [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi,
          if_pos, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
        rw [abs_le]
        have hpInt : (3 : Int) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp
        have huPositive : (0 : Int) < sigma.u j := by
          exact_mod_cast valid.1
        have huUpper : (sigma.u j : Int) ≤ p := by
          exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le j
        omega
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hij]
        exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le i
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
        omega
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hij]
  have hyzero : translationExponent p f hf y = 0 := by
    exact hzero
  rcases boundedCyclicCarry_existsUnique_of_translationExponent_eq_zero
      hp hf hyzero hy with ⟨z, ⟨hz, hzBound⟩, _⟩
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hEqSucc := hz (j + 1)
  have hEqSucc' :
      (0 : Int) = (p : Int) * z j - z (j + 1) := by
    simpa [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, valid.2,
      hsucc, show j + 1 - 1 = j by ring] using hEqSucc
  have hzjCases : z j = -1 ∨ z j = 0 ∨ z j = 1 := by
    have := abs_le.mp (hzBound j)
    omega
  have hzj : z j = 0 := by
    rcases hzjCases with hzj | hzj | hzj
    · rw [hzj] at hEqSucc'
      norm_num at hEqSucc'
      have hzsBound := abs_le.mp (hzBound (j + 1))
      omega
    · exact hzj
    · rw [hzj] at hEqSucc'
      norm_num at hEqSucc'
      have hzsBound := abs_le.mp (hzBound (j + 1))
      omega
  have hEqJ := hz j
  rw [hzj] at hEqJ
  have hzprevCases : z (j - 1) = -1 ∨ z (j - 1) = 0 ∨ z (j - 1) = 1 := by
    have := abs_le.mp (hzBound (j - 1))
    omega
  by_cases hjI : j ∈ I
  · have huPositive := valid.1
    have huLower : 2 ≤ sigma.u j := by omega
    simp [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hjI] at hEqJ
    rcases hzprevCases with hzprev | hzprev | hzprev <;>
      rw [hzprev] at hEqJ <;> norm_num at hEqJ <;>
      have huUpper := sigma.u_le j <;> omega
  · simp [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hjI] at hEqJ
    rcases hzprevCases with hzprev | hzprev | hzprev <;>
      rw [hzprev] at hEqJ <;> norm_num at hEqJ <;> omega

name: KLSposet.muStrictWitness_not_mem_leftExponentSet
statement:
theorem muStrictWitness_not_mem_leftExponentSet
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.MuValid j) (hNoninvertible : sigma.u j ≠ 1) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.mu hf j valid)
        (.niveauOne ({j + 1} : Set (ZMod f))) ∉ leftExponentSet hf sigma
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hTargetSum :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) {j + 1} =
        inversePower p f hf j := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne ({j + 1} : Set (ZMod f))).indicator i : Int) *
            ((sigma.mu hf j valid).u i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j + 1 then (p : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp [PhantomWeight.mu, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hsucc, valid.2]
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
    rw [hfun, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_natCast]
    exact inversePower_succ p f (by omega) hf j
  rintro ⟨J, hJ⟩
  cases J with
  | niveauOne I =>
      simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq] at hJ
      change sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma I =
        sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) {j + 1} at hJ
      rw [hTargetSum] at hJ
      have hSum : niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma I = inversePower p f hf j := by
        exact add_left_cancel hJ
      apply muStrictWitness_translationExponent_ne_zero hp hf sigma I j valid
        hNoninvertible
      rw [translationExponent_sub,
        translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
        PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
      norm_num only [Int.cast_one, one_mul]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hSum
  | niveauTwo J hComplementary =>
      simp [profileLeftExponent] at hJ

name: KLSposet.thetaStrictWitness_translationExponent_ne_zero
statement:
theorem thetaStrictWitness_translationExponent_ne_zero
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (I : Set (ZMod f)) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j) :
    translationExponent p f hf
        (fun i ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne I).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.u i : Int) + if i = j then 1 else 0) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  let y : ZMod f → Int := fun i ↦
    ((Profile.niveauOne I).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
      if i = j then 1 else 0
  have hyNonnegative : ∀ i, (0 : Int) ≤ y i := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [y]
    by_cases hi : i ∈ I
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp only [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi,
          if_pos, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
        have huNonnegative : (0 : Int) ≤ (sigma.u j : Int) := by
          exact Int.natCast_nonneg (sigma.u j)
        omega
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hij]
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hij]
  have hyUpper : ∀ i, y i ≤ (p : Int) := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [y]
    by_cases hi : i ∈ I
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
        exact_mod_cast valid.1
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hij]
        exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le i
    · by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
        omega
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hij]
  have hy : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ (p : Int) := by
    intro i
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (hyNonnegative i)]
    exact hyUpper i
  have hyzero : translationExponent p f hf y = 0 := hzero
  rcases boundedCyclicCarry_existsUnique_of_translationExponent_eq_zero
      hp hf hyzero hy with ⟨z, ⟨hz, hzBound⟩, _⟩
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hEqSucc := hz (j + 1)
  have hEqSucc' :
      (0 : Int) = (p : Int) * z j - z (j + 1) := by
    simpa [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, valid.2,
      hsucc, show j + 1 - 1 = j by ring] using hEqSucc
  have hzjCases : z j = -1 ∨ z j = 0 ∨ z j = 1 := by
    have := abs_le.mp (hzBound j)
    omega
  have hzj : z j = 0 := by
    rcases hzjCases with hzj | hzj | hzj
    · rw [hzj] at hEqSucc'
      norm_num at hEqSucc'
      have hzsBound := abs_le.mp (hzBound (j + 1))
      omega
    · exact hzj
    · rw [hzj] at hEqSucc'
      norm_num at hEqSucc'
      have hzsBound := abs_le.mp (hzBound (j + 1))
      omega
  have hzsucc : z (j + 1) = 0 := by
    rw [hzj] at hEqSucc'
    omega
  have hEqJ := hz j
  rw [hzj] at hEqJ
  have hyjPositive : (0 : Int) < y j := by
    by_cases hjI : j ∈ I <;>
      simp [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hjI]
  have hzprevCases : z (j - 1) = -1 ∨ z (j - 1) = 0 ∨ z (j - 1) = 1 := by
    have := abs_le.mp (hzBound (j - 1))
    omega
  have hzprev : z (j - 1) = 1 := by
    rcases hzprevCases with hzprev | hzprev | hzprev
    · rw [hzprev] at hEqJ
      norm_num at hEqJ
      omega
    · rw [hzprev] at hEqJ
      norm_num at hEqJ
      omega
    · exact hzprev
  have hPropagate : ∀ i : ZMod f, z i = 1 → z (i - 1) = 1 := by
    intro i hi
    have hEq := hz i
    rw [hi] at hEq
    have hprevCases :
        z (i - 1) = -1 ∨ z (i - 1) = 0 ∨ z (i - 1) = 1 := by
      have := abs_le.mp (hzBound (i - 1))
      omega
    rcases hprevCases with hprev | hprev | hprev
    · rw [hprev] at hEq
      norm_num at hEq
      have := hyNonnegative i
      omega
    · rw [hprev] at hEq
      norm_num at hEq
      have := hyNonnegative i
      omega
    · exact hprev
  have hIterate : ∀ k : Nat, z (j - 1 - (k : ZMod f)) = 1 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simpa using hzprev
    | succ k ih =>
        have hstep := hPropagate (j - 1 - (k : ZMod f)) ih
        convert hstep using 1
        push_cast
        ring_nf
  have hWrap : j - 1 - ((f - 2 : Nat) : ZMod f) = j + 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hf]
    norm_num
    ring
  have := hIterate (f - 2)
  rw [hWrap, hzsucc] at this
  norm_num at this

name: KLSposet.thetaStrictWitness_not_mem_leftExponentSet
statement:
theorem thetaStrictWitness_not_mem_leftExponentSet
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf j valid)
        (.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f))) ∉ leftExponentSet hf sigma
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨J, hJ⟩
  cases J with
  | niveauOne I =>
      simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq] at hJ
      change sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma I =
        sigma.t - inversePower p f hf j +
          niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) ∅ at hJ
      have hEmpty : niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) ∅ = 0 := by
        rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
          translationExponent]
      rw [hEmpty, add_zero] at hJ
      have hSum :
          niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma I = -inversePower p f hf j := by
        linear_combination hJ
      apply thetaStrictWitness_translationExponent_ne_zero hp hf sigma I j valid
      change translationExponent p f hf
          ((fun i : ZMod f ↦
            ((Profile.niveauOne I).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int)) +
          (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then 1 else 0)) = 0
      rw [translationExponent_add,
        translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
        PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
      norm_num only [Int.cast_one, one_mul]
      rw [hSum]
      exact neg_add_cancel _
  | niveauTwo J hComplementary =>
      simp [profileLeftExponent] at hJ

name: KLSposet.nuStrictWitness_translationExponent_ne_zero
statement:
theorem nuStrictWitness_translationExponent_ne_zero
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (I : Set (ZMod f)) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid j) (hNoninvertible : sigma.u (j + 1) ≠ p) :
    translationExponent p f hf
        (fun i ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne I).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.u i : Int) + (if i = j then 1 else 0) -
            if i = j + 1 then (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) else 0) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  let y : ZMod f → Int := fun i ↦
    ((Profile.niveauOne I).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
      (if i = j then 1 else 0) -
        if i = j + 1 then (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) else 0
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hu1Upper : sigma.u (j + 1) ≤ p - 1 := by
    have := sigma.u_le (j + 1)
    omega
  have hu0 : sigma.u j = 0 := valid
  have hjSucc : j ≠ j + 1 := Ne.symm hsucc
  have hy : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ (p : Int) := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [y]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hu0, hjSucc]
      omega
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        by_cases hi : j + 1 ∈ I
        · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hsucc]
        · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hsucc]
          exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le (j + 1)
      · by_cases hi : i ∈ I
        · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hij, hij1]
          exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le i
        · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hij, hij1]
  have hyNonnegativeAway : ∀ i : ZMod f, i ≠ j + 1 → (0 : Int) ≤ y i := by
    intro i hij1
    dsimp only [y]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hu0, hjSucc]
    · by_cases hi : i ∈ I
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hij, hij1]
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hij, hij1]
  have hyzero : translationExponent p f hf y = 0 := hzero
  rcases boundedCyclicCarry_existsUnique_of_translationExponent_eq_zero
      hp hf hyzero hy with ⟨z, ⟨hz, hzBound⟩, _⟩
  have hEqJ := hz j
  have hyj : y j = 1 := by
    simp [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hu0, hjSucc]
  rw [hyj] at hEqJ
  have hzprevCases : z (j - 1) = -1 ∨ z (j - 1) = 0 ∨ z (j - 1) = 1 := by
    have := abs_le.mp (hzBound (j - 1))
    omega
  have hzprev : z (j - 1) = 0 := by
    rcases hzprevCases with hprev | hprev | hprev
    · rw [hprev] at hEqJ
      norm_num at hEqJ
      have hzjBounds := abs_le.mp (hzBound j)
      omega
    · exact hprev
    · rw [hprev] at hEqJ
      norm_num at hEqJ
      have hzjBounds := abs_le.mp (hzBound j)
      omega
  have hzj : z j = -1 := by
    rw [hzprev] at hEqJ
    norm_num at hEqJ
    omega
  have hEqSucc := hz (j + 1)
  rw [show j + 1 - 1 = j by ring, hzj] at hEqSucc
  have hySuccLower : -((p : Int) - 1) ≤ y (j + 1) := by
    dsimp only [y]
    by_cases hi : j + 1 ∈ I
    · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hsucc]
      omega
    · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hsucc]
      have huCast : (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) ≤ (p : Int) - 1 := by
        have huLt : sigma.u (j + 1) < p := by omega
        have huLtCast : (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) < (p : Int) := by
          exact_mod_cast huLt
        omega
      omega
  have hzsuccCases : z (j + 1) = -1 ∨ z (j + 1) = 0 ∨ z (j + 1) = 1 := by
    have := abs_le.mp (hzBound (j + 1))
    omega
  have hzsucc : z (j + 1) = -1 := by
    rcases hzsuccCases with hsuccCarry | hsuccCarry | hsuccCarry
    · exact hsuccCarry
    · rw [hsuccCarry] at hEqSucc
      norm_num at hEqSucc
      omega
    · rw [hsuccCarry] at hEqSucc
      norm_num at hEqSucc
      omega
  have hnextNe : j + 2 ≠ j + 1 := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 2) - (j + 1) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hEqNext := hz (j + 2)
  rw [show j + 2 - 1 = j + 1 by ring, hzsucc] at hEqNext
  norm_num at hEqNext
  have hyNextNonnegative := hyNonnegativeAway (j + 2) hnextNe
  have hzNextLower := (abs_le.mp (hzBound (j + 2))).1
  omega

name: KLSposet.nuStrictWitness_not_mem_leftExponentSet
statement:
theorem nuStrictWitness_not_mem_leftExponentSet
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid j) (hNoninvertible : sigma.u (j + 1) ≠ p) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid)
        (.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f))) ∉ leftExponentSet hf sigma
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨J, hJ⟩
  cases J with
  | niveauOne I =>
      simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq] at hJ
      change sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma I =
        sigma.t - inversePower p f hf j +
          (sigma.u (j + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
            inversePower p f hf (j + 1) +
          niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid) ∅ at hJ
      have hEmpty :
          niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid) ∅ = 0 := by
        rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
          translationExponent]
      rw [hEmpty, add_zero] at hJ
      have hSum :
          niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma I =
            -inversePower p f hf j +
              (sigma.u (j + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
                inversePower p f hf (j + 1) := by
        linear_combination hJ
      apply nuStrictWitness_translationExponent_ne_zero hp hf sigma I j valid
        hNoninvertible
      have hAdd :
          translationExponent p f hf
              (fun i : ZMod f ↦
                ((Profile.niveauOne I).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
                  if i = j then 1 else 0) =
            translationExponent p f hf
                (fun i : ZMod f ↦
                  ((Profile.niveauOne I).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int)) +
              translationExponent p f hf
                (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then 1 else 0) := by
        change translationExponent p f hf
            ((fun i : ZMod f ↦
              ((Profile.niveauOne I).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int)) +
            (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then 1 else 0)) = _
        exact translationExponent_add p f hf _ _
      rw [translationExponent_sub, hAdd,
        translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
        PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single,
        PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
      norm_num only [Int.cast_one, one_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
      rw [hSum]
      ring
  | niveauTwo J hComplementary =>
      simp [profileLeftExponent] at hJ

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileCharacterPair_not_mem_of_leftExponent_not_mem
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileCharacterPair_not_mem_of_leftExponent_not_mem
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hWitness : profileLeftExponent hf tau (.niveauOne J) ∉
      leftExponentSet hf sigma) :
    profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars tau (.niveauOne J) ∉
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨profile, hPair⟩
  apply hWitness
  cases profile with
  | niveauOne K =>
      refine ⟨.niveauOne K, ?_⟩
      have hExp := niveauOneProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq
        (by omega) hf chars sigma tau K J hPair
      have hBoth :
          sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma K =
              tau.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf tau J ∧
            sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Kᶜ =
              tau.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf tau Jᶜ := by
        simpa only [profileCharacterExponents,
          OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne.injEq] using hExp
      simpa only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
        using hBoth.1
  | niveauTwo K hK =>
      have hScalar :
          (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma
            (.niveauTwo K hK)).IsScalar :=
        (crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_eq_implies_scalar (by omega) hf chars
          tau sigma J K hK hPair.symm).2
      rcases scalar_niveauOneProfileCharacterPair_eq_niveauTwo hp hf chars
          sigma K hK hScalar with ⟨L, hL⟩
      refine ⟨.niveauOne L, ?_⟩
      have hExp := niveauOneProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq
        (by omega) hf chars sigma tau L J (hL.trans hPair)
      have hBoth :
          sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma L =
              tau.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf tau J ∧
            sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Lᶜ =
              tau.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf tau Jᶜ := by
        simpa only [profileCharacterExponents,
          OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne.injEq] using hExp
      simpa only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
        using hBoth.1

statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f))
    (h : profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauOne J')) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J =
      (sigma'.t - sigma.t) + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' J'
proof:
:= by
  change OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
      (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J)
      (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) =
    OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
      (sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' J')
      (sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' J'ᶜ) at h
  injection h with hleft _
  calc
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J =
        -sigma.t + (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) := by ring
    _ = -sigma.t + (sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' J') := by rw [hleft]
    _ = (sigma'.t - sigma.t) + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' J' := by ring

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoCarryInput_antiPeriodic
statement:
theorem niveauTwoCarryInput_antiPeriodic {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J J' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) (hJ' : ∀ i, i ∈ J' ↔ i + f ∉ J') :
    ∀ i, niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' (i + f) =
      -niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have hperiodic (tau : PhantomWeight p f) :
      tau.periodicU hf (i + f) = tau.periodicU hf i := by
    simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU]
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
    simp
  have hsign (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
      (hK : ∀ k, k ∈ K ↔ k + f ∉ K) :
      (Profile.niveauTwo (f := f) K hK).sign (i + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) =
        -(Profile.niveauTwo (f := f) K hK).sign i := by
    classical
    by_cases hi : i ∈ K
    · have hif : i + f ∉ K := (hK i).mp hi
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hif]
    · have hif : i + f ∈ K := by
        by_contra hnot
        exact hi ((hK i).mpr hnot)
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hif]
  simp only [niveauTwoCarryInput, hperiodic]
  rw [hsign J' hJ', hsign J hJ]
  ring

name: KLSposet.translationExponent_sub
statement:
theorem translationExponent_sub {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (a b : ZMod f → Int) :

      translationExponent p f hf a - translationExponent p f hf b
proof:
:= by
  simp [translationExponent, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: KLSposet.translationExponent_niveauOne_signed
statement:
theorem translationExponent_niveauOne_signed {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f)) :
    translationExponent p f hf
        (fun i ↦ (Profile.niveauOne J).sign i * (sigma.u i : Int)) =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ - niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  simp only [translationExponent, niveauOneProfileSum,
    niveauOneFundamentalExponent, Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : i ∈ J
  · simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
  · simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]

statement:

proof:
:= by
  have hleft := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left hf sigma sigma' J J' h
  have hright := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_right hf sigma sigma' J J' h
  change translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦
    (Profile.niveauOne J').sign i * (sigma'.u i : Int) -
      (Profile.niveauOne J).sign i * (sigma.u i : Int)) = 0
  rw [translationExponent_sub, translationExponent_niveauOne_signed,
    translationExponent_niveauOne_signed]
  rw [hleft, hright]
  ring

name: KLSposet.niveauOneCarryInput_sub_eq_two_mul_halfDifference
statement:
theorem niveauOneCarryInput_sub_eq_two_mul_halfDifference {p f : Nat}
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J J' K K' : Set (ZMod f)) :
    ∀ i, niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J' i -
        niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' K K' i =
      2 * niveauOneCarryHalfDifference sigma sigma' J J' K K' i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  classical
  by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J <;> by_cases hiJ' : i ∈ J' <;>
    by_cases hiK : i ∈ K <;> by_cases hiK' : i ∈ K' <;>
    simp [niveauOneCarryInput, niveauOneCarryHalfDifference, Profile.sign,
      Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hiJ', hiK, hiK'] <;> ring

name: KLSposet.translationExponent_niveauOneCarryHalfDifference_eq_zero
statement:
theorem translationExponent_niveauOneCarryHalfDifference_eq_zero {p f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J J' K K' : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauOne J'))
    (hK : profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne K) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauOne K')) :
    translationExponent p f hf
      (niveauOneCarryHalfDifference sigma sigma' J J' K K') = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hleftJ := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ
  have hleftK := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left hf sigma sigma' K K' hK
  have hfun : niveauOneCarryHalfDifference sigma sigma' J J' K K' =
      fun i ↦
        (((Profile.niveauOne K').indicator i : Int) * (sigma'.u i : Int) -
          ((Profile.niveauOne J').indicator i : Int) * (sigma'.u i : Int)) -
        (((Profile.niveauOne K).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) -
          ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int)) := by
    funext i
    simp only [niveauOneCarryHalfDifference]
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  calc
    translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦
        (((Profile.niveauOne K').indicator i : Int) * (sigma'.u i : Int) -
          ((Profile.niveauOne J').indicator i : Int) * (sigma'.u i : Int)) -
        (((Profile.niveauOne K).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) -
          ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int))) =
      (translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne K').indicator i : Int) * (sigma'.u i : Int)) -
        translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne J').indicator i : Int) * (sigma'.u i : Int))) -
      (translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne K).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int)) -
        translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int))) := by
        simp only [translationExponent, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, sub_mul,
          Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ = (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' K' - niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' J') -
        (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma K - niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) := by
      rw [translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
        translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
        translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
        translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [hleftJ, hleftK]
      ring

name: KLSposet.translationExponent_niveauTwoCarryHalfDifference_eq_zero
statement:
theorem translationExponent_niveauTwoCarryHalfDifference_eq_zero {p f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J J' K K' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) (hJ' : ∀ i, i ∈ J' ↔ i + f ∉ J')
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) (hK' : ∀ i, i ∈ K' ↔ i + f ∉ K')
    (hExpJ : profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauTwo J' hJ'))
    (hExpK : profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauTwo K hK) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauTwo K' hK')) :
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega)
      (niveauTwoCarryHalfDifference hf sigma sigma' J J' K K' hJ hJ' hK hK') = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hleftJ := niveauTwoProfileSum_congr_left hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' hExpJ
  have hleftK := niveauTwoProfileSum_congr_left hf sigma sigma' K K' hK hK' hExpK
  have hfun : niveauTwoCarryHalfDifference hf sigma sigma' J J' K K' hJ hJ' hK hK' =
      fun i ↦
        (((Profile.niveauTwo K' hK').indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int) -
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J' hJ').indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)) -
        (((Profile.niveauTwo K hK).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) -
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) := by
    funext i
    simp only [niveauTwoCarryHalfDifference]
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  calc
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
        (((Profile.niveauTwo K' hK').indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int) -
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J' hJ').indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)) -
        (((Profile.niveauTwo K hK).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) -
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int))) =
      (translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo K' hK').indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)) -
        translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J' hJ').indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int))) -
      (translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo K hK).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) -
        translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int))) := by
        simp only [translationExponent, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, sub_mul,
          Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ = (niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K' - niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' J') -
        (niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma K - niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J) := by
      rw [translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator,
        translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator,
        translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator,
        translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator]
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [hleftJ, hleftK]
      ring

name: KLSposet.niveauOneCarryInput_abs_le
proof:
:= by
  have hu : |(sigma.u i : Int)| ≤ (p : Int) := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg _)]
    exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le i
  have hu' : |(sigma'.u i : Int)| ≤ (p : Int) := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg _)]
    exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le i
  calc
    |niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J' i| ≤
        |(Profile.niveauOne J').sign i * (sigma'.u i : Int)| +
          |(Profile.niveauOne J).sign i * (sigma.u i : Int)| := by
      simpa [niveauOneCarryInput, sub_eq_add_neg] using
        abs_add_le
          ((Profile.niveauOne J').sign i * (sigma'.u i : Int))
          (-((Profile.niveauOne J).sign i * (sigma.u i : Int)))
    _ = |(sigma'.u i : Int)| + |(sigma.u i : Int)| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, Profile.abs_sign, Profile.abs_sign]
      simp
    _ ≤ 2 * (p : Int) := by linarith

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoCarryInput_abs_le
statement:
theorem niveauTwoCarryInput_abs_le {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J J' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) (hJ' : ∀ i, i ∈ J' ↔ i + f ∉ J')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    |niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' i| ≤ 2 * (p : Int)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : |(sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)| ≤ (p : Int) := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg _)]
    exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le (periodicIndex hf i)
  have hu' : |(sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)| ≤ (p : Int) := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg _)]
    exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le (periodicIndex hf i)
  calc
    |niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' i| ≤
        |(Profile.niveauTwo J' hJ').sign i *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)| +
          |(Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).sign i *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)| := by
      simpa [niveauTwoCarryInput, sub_eq_add_neg] using
        abs_add_le
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J' hJ').sign i *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int))
          (-((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).sign i *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)))
    _ = |(sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)| + |(sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, Profile.abs_sign, Profile.abs_sign]
      simp
    _ ≤ 2 * (p : Int) := by linarith

name: KLSposet.niveauOneCarryInput_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem niveauOneCarryInput_eq_zero_iff {p f : Nat}
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f)) (i : ZMod f) :
    niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J' i = 0 ↔
      sigma.u i = sigma'.u i ∧
        (sigma.u i ≠ 0 → (i ∈ J ↔ i ∈ J'))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hi : i ∈ J <;> by_cases hi' : i ∈ J' <;>
    simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hi'] <;> omega

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoCarryInput_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem niveauTwoCarryInput_eq_zero_iff {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J J' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) (hJ' : ∀ i, i ∈ J' ↔ i + f ∉ J')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' i = 0 ↔
      sigma.periodicU hf i = sigma'.periodicU hf i ∧
        (sigma.periodicU hf i ≠ 0 → (i ∈ J ↔ i ∈ J'))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hi : i ∈ J <;> by_cases hi' : i ∈ J' <;>
    simp [niveauTwoCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hi'] <;> omega

name: KLSposet.niveauOneCarryInput_eq_six_iff
statement:
theorem niveauOneCarryInput_eq_six_iff {f : Nat}
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f)) (i : ZMod f) :
    niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J' i = 6 ↔
      sigma.u i = 3 ∧ sigma'.u i = 3 ∧ i ∈ J ∧ i ∉ J'
proof:
:= by
  have hu := sigma.u_le i
  have hu' := sigma'.u_le i
  classical
  by_cases hi : i ∈ J <;> by_cases hi' : i ∈ J' <;>
    simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hi'] <;> omega

name: KLSposet.niveauOneCarryInput_eq_neg_six_iff
statement:
theorem niveauOneCarryInput_eq_neg_six_iff {f : Nat}
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f)) (i : ZMod f) :
    niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J' i = -6 ↔
      sigma.u i = 3 ∧ sigma'.u i = 3 ∧ i ∉ J ∧ i ∈ J'
proof:
:= by
  have hu := sigma.u_le i
  have hu' := sigma'.u_le i
  classical
  by_cases hi : i ∈ J <;> by_cases hi' : i ∈ J' <;>
    simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hi'] <;> omega

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoCarryInput_eq_six_iff
statement:
theorem niveauTwoCarryInput_eq_six_iff {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f) (J J' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) (hJ' : ∀ i, i ∈ J' ↔ i + f ∉ J')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' i = 6 ↔
      sigma.periodicU hf i = 3 ∧ sigma'.periodicU hf i = 3 ∧
        i ∈ J ∧ i ∉ J'
proof:
:= by
  have hu : sigma.periodicU hf i ≤ 3 := sigma.u_le (periodicIndex hf i)
  have hu' : sigma'.periodicU hf i ≤ 3 := sigma'.u_le (periodicIndex hf i)
  classical
  by_cases hi : i ∈ J <;> by_cases hi' : i ∈ J' <;>
    simp [niveauTwoCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hi'] <;> omega

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoCarryInput_eq_neg_six_iff
statement:
theorem niveauTwoCarryInput_eq_neg_six_iff {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f) (J J' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) (hJ' : ∀ i, i ∈ J' ↔ i + f ∉ J')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' i = -6 ↔
      sigma.periodicU hf i = 3 ∧ sigma'.periodicU hf i = 3 ∧
        i ∉ J ∧ i ∈ J'
proof:

  have hu : sigma.periodicU hf i ≤ 3 := sigma.u_le (periodicIndex hf i)
  have hu' : sigma'.periodicU hf i ≤ 3 := sigma'.u_le (periodicIndex hf i)
