name: KLSposet.carryEquation_periodicExtend
statement:
theorem carryEquation_periodicExtend {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    {y x : ZMod f → Int} (hx : CarryEquation p y x) :
    CarryEquation p (periodicExtend hf y) (periodicExtend hf x)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  change y (periodicIndex hf i) =
    (p : Int) * x (periodicIndex hf (i - 1)) - x (periodicIndex hf i)
  rw [periodicIndex_sub_one]
  exact hx (periodicIndex hf i)

name: KLSposet.niveauOneZeroCarry_identifies_coordinates
statement:
theorem niveauOneZeroCarry_identifies_coordinates {p f : Nat}
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f))
    (hx : CarryEquation p (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J') (fun _ ↦ 0)) :
    (∀ i, sigma.u i = sigma'.u i) ∧
      ∀ i, sigma.u i ≠ 0 → (i ∈ J ↔ i ∈ J')
proof:
:= by
  have hzero (i : ZMod f) : niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J' i = 0 := by
    simpa using hx i
  constructor
  · intro i
    exact (niveauOneCarryInput_eq_zero_iff sigma sigma' J J' i).mp (hzero i) |>.1
  · intro i hi
    exact (niveauOneCarryInput_eq_zero_iff sigma sigma' J J' i).mp (hzero i) |>.2 hi

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileSum_eq_of_coordinates_and_support
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_eq_of_coordinates_and_support {p f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J J' : Set (ZMod f)) (hu : ∀ i, sigma.u i = sigma'.u i)
    (hmem : ∀ i, sigma.u i ≠ 0 → (i ∈ J ↔ i ∈ J')) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J = niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' J'
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  simp only [niveauOneProfileSum]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hz : sigma.u i = 0
  · have hz' : sigma'.u i = 0 := by rw [← hu i, hz]
    simp [hz, hz']
  · have hi := hmem i hz
    by_cases hJ : i ∈ J
    · have hJ' := hi.mp hJ
      simp [hJ, hJ', hu i]
    · have hJ' : i ∉ J' := by simpa [hJ] using hi
      simp [hJ, hJ']

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoZeroCarry_identifies_coordinates
statement:
theorem niveauTwoZeroCarry_identifies_coordinates {p f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J J' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) (hJ' : ∀ i, i ∈ J' ↔ i + f ∉ J')
    (hx : CarryEquation p (niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ')
      (fun _ => 0)) :
    (∀ i, sigma.u i = sigma'.u i) ∧
      ∀ i, sigma.periodicU hf i ≠ 0 → (i ∈ J ↔ i ∈ J')
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hzero (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
      niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' i = 0 := by
    simpa using hx i
  have hperiodic (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
      sigma.periodicU hf i = sigma'.periodicU hf i :=
    (niveauTwoCarryInput_eq_zero_iff hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' i).mp
      (hzero i) |>.1
  constructor
  · intro i
    have hi := hperiodic (i.val : ZMod (2 * f))
    simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] at hi
    rw [periodicIndex_natCast hf i.val i.val_lt] at hi
    simpa only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using hi
  · intro i hi
    exact (niveauTwoCarryInput_eq_zero_iff hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' i).mp
      (hzero i) |>.2 hi

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoProfileSum_eq_of_coordinates_and_support
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_eq_of_coordinates_and_support {p f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J J' : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hu : ∀ i, sigma.u i = sigma'.u i)
    (hmem : ∀ i, sigma.periodicU hf i ≠ 0 → (i ∈ J ↔ i ∈ J')) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J = niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' J'
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  simp only [niveauTwoProfileSum]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hui : sigma.periodicU hf i = sigma'.periodicU hf i := by
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hu (periodicIndex hf i)
  by_cases hz : sigma.periodicU hf i = 0
  · have hz' : sigma'.periodicU hf i = 0 := by rw [← hui, hz]
    simp [hz, hz']
  · have hi := hmem i hz
    by_cases hJ : i ∈ J
    · have hJ' := hi.mp hJ
      simp [hJ, hJ', hui]
    · have hJ' : i ∉ J' := by simpa [hJ] using hi
      simp [hJ, hJ']

name: KLSposet.phantomWeight_eq_of_niveauOne_zero_carry
statement:
theorem phantomWeight_eq_of_niveauOne_zero_carry {p f : Nat}
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f))
    (hx : CarryEquation p (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J') (fun _ ↦ 0))
    (ht : sigma.t = sigma'.t) : sigma = sigma'
proof:
:= by
  apply PhantomWeight.ext
  · funext i
    exact (niveauOneZeroCarry_identifies_coordinates sigma sigma' J J' hx).1 i
  · exact ht

name: KLSposet.niveauOneZeroCarry_determinantExponent_eq_of_pair_eq
statement:
theorem niveauOneZeroCarry_determinantExponent_eq_of_pair_eq
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f))
    (hpair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne J'))
    (hx : CarryEquation p (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J') (fun _ => 0)) :
    sigma.t = sigma'.t
proof:
:= by
  rcases niveauOneZeroCarry_identifies_coordinates sigma sigma' J J' hx with
    ⟨hu, hmem⟩
  have hsum := niveauOneProfileSum_eq_of_coordinates_and_support
    hf sigma sigma' J J' hu hmem
  have hcongr := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' J J' hpair
  rw [hsum] at hcongr
  have hdiff : sigma'.t - sigma.t = 0 := by
    apply add_right_cancel (b := niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' J')
    simpa using hcongr.symm
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hdiff).symm

name: KLSposet.phantomWeight_eq_of_niveauOne_zero_carry_of_pair_eq
statement:
theorem phantomWeight_eq_of_niveauOne_zero_carry_of_pair_eq
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f))
    (hpair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne J'))
    (hx : CarryEquation p (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J') (fun _ => 0)) :
    sigma = sigma'
proof:
:= by
  exact phantomWeight_eq_of_niveauOne_zero_carry sigma sigma' J J' hx
    (niveauOneZeroCarry_determinantExponent_eq_of_pair_eq
      hp hf chars sigma sigma' J J' hpair hx)

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoZeroCarry_determinantExponent_eq_of_pair_eq
statement:
theorem niveauTwoZeroCarry_determinantExponent_eq_of_pair_eq
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J J' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) (hJ' : ∀ i, i ∈ J' ↔ i + f ∉ J')
    (hpair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo J' hJ'))
    (hx : CarryEquation p (niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ')
      (fun _ => 0)) :
    sigma.t = sigma'.t
proof:
:= by
  rcases niveauTwoZeroCarry_identifies_coordinates hf sigma sigma' J J'
    hJ hJ' hx with ⟨hu, hmem⟩
  have hsum := niveauTwoProfileSum_eq_of_coordinates_and_support
    hf sigma sigma' J J' hu hmem
  have hcongr := niveauTwoProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' hpair
  rw [hsum] at hcongr
  have hdiff : liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t - liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t = 0 := by
    apply add_right_cancel (b := niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' J')
    simpa using hcongr.symm
  have hlift : liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t = liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t :=
    (sub_eq_zero.mp hdiff).symm
  apply chars.niveauOneExactOrder
  have hchar := congrArg (niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars) hlift
  have hchar' : niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars sigma.t =
      niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars sigma'.t := by
    simpa only [← niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne] using hchar
  exact hchar'

name: KLSposet.phantomWeight_eq_of_niveauTwo_zero_carry_of_pair_eq
statement:
theorem phantomWeight_eq_of_niveauTwo_zero_carry_of_pair_eq
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J J' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) (hJ' : ∀ i, i ∈ J' ↔ i + f ∉ J')
    (hpair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo J' hJ'))
    (hx : CarryEquation p (niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ')
      (fun _ => 0)) :
    sigma = sigma'
proof:
:= by
  apply PhantomWeight.ext
  · funext i
    exact (niveauTwoZeroCarry_identifies_coordinates hf sigma sigma' J J'
      hJ hJ' hx).1 i
  · exact niveauTwoZeroCarry_determinantExponent_eq_of_pair_eq
      hp hf chars sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' hpair hx

name: KLSposet.cyclicWeightedSumAux_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem cyclicWeightedSumAux_eq_sum_range (p n : Nat) (y : ZMod n → Int)
    (k : Nat) :
    cyclicWeightedSumAux p n y k =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, (p : Int) ^ (k - 1 - j) * y j
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [cyclicWeightedSumAux]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [cyclicWeightedSumAux, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        have hjlt := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
        rw [show k + 1 - 1 - j = (k - 1 - j) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
        ring
      · simp

name: KLSposet.manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_eq_sum_range {p n : Nat}
    (y : ZMod n → Int) :
    manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p n y =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (p : Int) ^ (n - j) * y j
proof:
:= by
  rw [manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum, cyclicWeightedSum,
    cyclicWeightedSumAux_eq_sum_range, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have hjlt := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
  rw [show n - j = (n - 1 - j) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
  ring

name: KLSposet.manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_periodicExtend
statement:
theorem manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_periodicExtend {p f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (y : ZMod f → Int) :
    manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p (2 * f) (periodicExtend hf y) =
      ((p : Int) ^ f + 1) * manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p f y
proof:
:= by
  rw [manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_eq_sum_range,
    manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_eq_sum_range]
  have hrange : Finset.range (2 * f) = Finset.range (f + f) := by
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [hrange, Finset.sum_range_add]
  simp only [periodicExtend]
  have hfirst :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range f,
          (p : Int) ^ (2 * f - j) *
            y (periodicIndex hf (j : ZMod (2 * f)))) =
        (p : Int) ^ f *
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range f, (p : Int) ^ (f - j) * y (j : ZMod f) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hjlt := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
    rw [periodicIndex_natCast hf j hjlt]
    rw [show 2 * f - j = f + (f - j) by omega, pow_add]
    ring
  have hsecond :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range f,
          (p : Int) ^ (2 * f - (f + j)) *
            y (periodicIndex hf ((f + j : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range f, (p : Int) ^ (f - j) * y (j : ZMod f) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hjlt := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
    rw [periodicIndex_add_natCast hf j]
    congr 2
    omega
  rw [hfirst, hsecond]
  ring

name: KLSposet.manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_cast
statement:
theorem manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_cast {p n : Nat} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (y : ZMod n → Int) :
    (manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p n y : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) =
      translationExponent p n hn y
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  rw [manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_eq_sum_range]
  simp only [Int.cast_sum, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_natCast,
    Finset.sum_range]
  rw [translationExponent]
  let e : Fin n ≃ ZMod n :=
    { toFun := fun i ↦ (i.val : ZMod n)
      invFun := fun i ↦ ⟨i.val, i.val_lt⟩
      left_inv := by
        intro i
        apply Fin.ext
        change (i.val : ZMod n).val = i.val
        exact ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt i.isLt
      right_inv := by
        intro i
        exact ZMod.natCast_zmod_val i }
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv e
  intro i
  have hei : e i = (i.val : ZMod n) := by rfl
  rw [hei]
  dsimp only [inversePower]
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt i.isLt]
  ring

name: KLSposet.cyclicWeightedSumAux_const_three
statement:
theorem cyclicWeightedSumAux_const_three (f k : Nat) :
    2 * cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f (fun _ : ZMod f => 3) k =
      3 * ((3 : Int) ^ k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [cyclicWeightedSumAux]
  | succ k ih =>
      simp only [cyclicWeightedSumAux]
      rw [pow_succ]
      calc
        2 * ((3 : Int) * cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f (fun _ => 3) k + 3) =
            3 * (2 * cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f (fun _ => 3) k) + 6 := by ring
        _ = 3 * (3 * ((3 : Int) ^ k - 1)) + 6 := by rw [ih]
        _ = 3 * ((3 : Int) ^ k * 3 - 1) := by ring

name: KLSposet.threePowerHalf_double
statement:
theorem threePowerHalf_double (f : Nat) :
    2 * ((3 ^ f - 1) / 2) = 3 ^ f - 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.two_mul_div_two_of_even
  have hoddpow : Odd (3 ^ f : Nat) := Odd.pow (by norm_num : Odd (3 : Nat))
  exact Nat.Odd.sub_odd hoddpow (by norm_num : Odd (1 : Nat))

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileSum_all_three_univ
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_all_three_univ (f : Nat) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight 3 f) (hu : ∀ i, sigma.u i = 3) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ =
      (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1))
proof:
:= by
  let half : Nat := (3 ^ f - 1) / 2
  have hhalfNat : 2 * half = 3 ^ f - 1 := threePowerHalf_double f
  have hhalfInt : 2 * (half : Int) = (3 : Int) ^ f - 1 := by
    have hone : 1 ≤ 3 ^ f := one_le_pow₀ (by omega)
    calc
      2 * (half : Int) = ((2 * half : Nat) : Int) := by norm_num
      _ = ((3 ^ f - 1 : Nat) : Int) := by rw [hhalfNat]
      _ = (3 : Int) ^ f - 1 := by
        rw [Int.natCast_sub hone, Int.natCast_pow]
        norm_num
  have haux := cyclicWeightedSumAux_const_three f f
  have hweighted :
      manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 f (fun _ : ZMod f => 3) =
        9 * (half : Int) := by
    simp only [manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum, cyclicWeightedSum]
    apply (mul_left_cancel₀ (by norm_num : (2 : Int) ≠ 0))
    calc
      2 * (3 * cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f (fun _ => 3) f) =
          3 * (2 * cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f (fun _ => 3) f) := by ring
      _ = 3 * (3 * ((3 : Int) ^ f - 1)) := by rw [haux]
      _ = 2 * (9 * (half : Int)) := by nlinarith [hhalfInt]
  have hconstant :
      (fun i : ZMod f =>
        ((Profile.niveauOne (Set.univ : Set (ZMod f))).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.u i : Int)) = fun _ => 3 := by
    funext i
    simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hu i]
  rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator hf sigma Set.univ]
  rw [hconstant]
  rw [← manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_cast hf]
  rw [hweighted]
  change ((9 * (half : Int) : Int) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) =
    ((half : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1))
  have hmultiple : ((3 ^ f - 1 : Nat) : Int) ∣
      9 * (half : Int) - (half : Int) := by
    have hone : 1 ≤ 3 ^ f := one_le_pow₀ (by omega)
    use 4
    rw [Int.natCast_sub hone, Int.natCast_pow]
    norm_num
    rw [← hhalfInt]
    ring
  have hhalfCast :
      ((half : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) =
        ((half : Int) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) := by norm_cast
  rw [hhalfCast]
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [← Int.cast_sub]
  exact (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd _ _).mpr hmultiple

name: KLSposet.threePowerHalf_neg
statement:
theorem threePowerHalf_neg (f : Nat) :
    -(((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) =
      (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1))
proof:
:= by
  let half : Nat := (3 ^ f - 1) / 2
  have hhalfNat : 2 * half = 3 ^ f - 1 := threePowerHalf_double f
  have hcast := congrArg (fun n : Nat => (n : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1))) hhalfNat
  have hsum :
      ((half : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) + (half : Nat) = 0 := by
    calc
      ((half : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) + (half : Nat) =
          ((2 * half : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) := by push_cast; ring
      _ = ((3 ^ f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) := hcast
      _ = 0 := ZMod.natCast_self (3 ^ f - 1)
  exact neg_eq_of_add_eq_zero_left hsum

name: KLSposet.niveauOneExceptionalDeterminantTwist
statement:
theorem niveauOneExceptionalDeterminantTwist {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f))
    (hu : ∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) (hu' : ∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3)
    (hprofiles : ((∀ k, k ∈ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∉ J') ∨
      ((∀ k, k ∉ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∈ J'))
    (hExp : profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauOne J')) :
    sigma'.t - sigma.t =
      (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hcongr := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left hf sigma sigma' J J' hExp
  rcases hprofiles with hprofiles | hprofiles
  · have hJ : J = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall hprofiles.1
    have hJ' : J' = ∅ := by
      ext k
      simp [hprofiles.2 k]
    rw [hJ, hJ', niveauOneProfileSum_all_three_univ f hf sigma hu] at hcongr
    simpa [niveauOneProfileSum] using hcongr.symm
  · have hJ : J = ∅ := by
      ext k
      simp [hprofiles.1 k]
    have hJ' : J' = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall hprofiles.2
    rw [hJ, hJ', niveauOneProfileSum_all_three_univ f hf sigma' hu'] at hcongr
    have hcongr' :
        0 = (sigma'.t - sigma.t) +
          (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) := by
      simpa [niveauOneProfileSum] using hcongr
    have hdiff : sigma'.t - sigma.t =
        -(((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) :=
      eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hcongr'.symm
    rw [hdiff, threePowerHalf_neg]

name: KLSposet.niveauOneExceptionalDeterminantTwist_of_pair_eq
statement:
theorem niveauOneExceptionalDeterminantTwist_of_pair_eq {f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem 3 f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f))
    (hu : ∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) (hu' : ∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3)
    (hprofiles : ((∀ k, k ∈ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∉ J') ∨
      ((∀ k, k ∉ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∈ J'))
    (h : profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne J')) :
    sigma'.t - sigma.t =
      (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply niveauOneExceptionalDeterminantTwist hf sigma sigma' J J' hu hu' hprofiles
  exact niveauOneProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq (by omega) hf chars
    sigma sigma' J J' h

name: KLSposet.translationExponent_periodicExtend
statement:
theorem translationExponent_periodicExtend {p f : Nat}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (y : ZMod f → Int) :
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (periodicExtend hf y) =
      liftQPlusOne p f (translationExponent p f hf y)
proof:
:= by
  let m := manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p f y
  let r := translationExponent p f hf y
  have hcast : (m : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) = r := by
    exact manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_cast hf y
  have hvalcast : ((r.val : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) = r := by
    letI : NeZero (p ^ f - 1) := ⟨by
      have := one_lt_pow₀ (by omega : 1 < p) (by omega : f ≠ 0)
      omega⟩
    exact ZMod.natCast_zmod_val r
  have hsmallCast : ((m - (r.val : Int) : Int) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) = 0 := by
    push_cast
    rw [hcast, hvalcast]
    simp
  have hsmallNat :=
    (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (m - (r.val : Int)) (p ^ f - 1)).mp hsmallCast
  have hsmall : ((p : Int) ^ f - 1) ∣ m - (r.val : Int) := by
    have hmodcast : ((p ^ f - 1 : Nat) : Int) = (p : Int) ^ f - 1 := by
      rw [Int.natCast_sub (one_le_pow₀ (by omega : 1 ≤ p)),
        Int.natCast_pow, Int.natCast_one]
    rw [← hmodcast]
    exact hsmallNat
  rcases hsmall with ⟨c, hc⟩
  rw [← manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_cast (by omega) (periodicExtend hf y)]
  rw [manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_periodicExtend]
  change (((p : Int) ^ f + 1) * m : Int) =
    (((p ^ f + 1) * r.val : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1))
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  have hncast :
      (((p ^ f + 1) * r.val : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) =
        ((((p ^ f + 1) * r.val : Nat) : Int) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) := by
    norm_cast
  rw [hncast]
  rw [← Int.cast_sub]
  apply (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd
    (((p : Int) ^ f + 1) * m -
      (((p ^ f + 1) * r.val : Nat) : Int)) (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)).mpr
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  simp only [Int.natCast_mul, Int.natCast_add, Int.natCast_pow,
    Int.natCast_one]
  have hmodcast2 : ((p ^ (2 * f) - 1 : Nat) : Int) =
      (p : Int) ^ (2 * f) - 1 := by
    rw [Int.natCast_sub (one_le_pow₀ (by omega : 1 ≤ p)),
      Int.natCast_pow, Int.natCast_one]
  rw [hmodcast2]
  calc
    ((p : Int) ^ f + 1) * m - ((p : Int) ^ f + 1) * (r.val : Int) =
        ((p : Int) ^ f + 1) * (m - (r.val : Int)) := by ring
    _ = ((p : Int) ^ f + 1) * (((p : Int) ^ f - 1) * c) := by rw [hc]
    _ = ((p : Int) ^ (2 * f) - 1) * c := by
      rw [show 2 * f = f + f by omega, pow_add]
      ring

name: KLSposet.translationExponent_residueRepresentative
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero (p ^ f - 1) := ⟨by
    have := one_lt_pow₀ (by omega : 1 < p) (by omega : f ≠ 0)
    omega⟩
  classical
  rw [translationExponent]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp [residueRepresentative, inversePower_zero p f (by omega) hf]
  · intro i _ hi
    simp [residueRepresentative, hi]
  · simp

name: KLSposet.liftQPlusOne_add
statement:
theorem liftQPlusOne_add {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (a b : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
    liftQPlusOne p f (a + b) = liftQPlusOne p f a + liftQPlusOne p f b
proof:
:= by
  let y := residueRepresentative a
  let z := residueRepresentative b
  calc
    liftQPlusOne p f (a + b) =
        liftQPlusOne p f (translationExponent p f hf (y + z)) := by
          rw [translationExponent_add,
            translationExponent_residueRepresentative hp hf a,
            translationExponent_residueRepresentative hp hf b]
    _ = translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega)
          (periodicExtend hf (y + z)) := by
            rw [translationExponent_periodicExtend hp hf]
    _ = translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega)
          (periodicExtend hf y + periodicExtend hf z) := by rfl
    _ = translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (periodicExtend hf y) +
          translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (periodicExtend hf z) := by
            rw [translationExponent_add]
    _ = liftQPlusOne p f a + liftQPlusOne p f b := by
      rw [translationExponent_periodicExtend hp hf,
        translationExponent_periodicExtend hp hf,
        translationExponent_residueRepresentative hp hf a,
        translationExponent_residueRepresentative hp hf b]

name: KLSposet.liftQPlusOne_neg
statement:
theorem liftQPlusOne_neg {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (a : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
    liftQPlusOne p f (-a) = -liftQPlusOne p f a
proof:
:= by
  have hadd := liftQPlusOne_add hp hf a (-a)
  rw [add_neg_cancel, show liftQPlusOne p f 0 = 0 by simp [liftQPlusOne]] at hadd
  apply eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left
  rw [add_comm]
  exact hadd.symm

name: KLSposet.liftQPlusOne_sub
statement:
theorem liftQPlusOne_sub {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (a b : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
    liftQPlusOne p f (a - b) = liftQPlusOne p f a - liftQPlusOne p f b
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, liftQPlusOne_add hp hf,
    liftQPlusOne_neg hp hf, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: KLSposet.translationExponent_crossNiveauCarryHalfDifference_eq_zero
statement:
theorem translationExponent_crossNiveauCarryHalfDifference_eq_zero
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J J' : Set (ZMod f)) (K K' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) (hK' : ∀ i, i ∈ K' ↔ i + f ∉ K')
    (hExpJ : profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauOne J'))
    (hExpK : profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauTwo K hK) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauTwo K' hK')) :
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega)
      (crossNiveauCarryHalfDifference hf sigma sigma' J J' K K' hK hK') = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hleftJ := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left hf sigma sigma' J J' hExpJ
  have hleftK := niveauTwoProfileSum_congr_left hf sigma sigma' K K' hK hK' hExpK
  have hfun :
      crossNiveauCarryHalfDifference hf sigma sigma' J J' K K' hK hK' =
        fun i ↦
          (((Profile.niveauTwo K' hK').indicator i : Int) *
              (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int) -
            periodicExtend hf (fun j ↦
              ((Profile.niveauOne J').indicator j : Int) * (sigma'.u j : Int)) i) -
          (((Profile.niveauTwo K hK).indicator i : Int) *
              (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) -
            periodicExtend hf (fun j ↦
              ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator j : Int) * (sigma.u j : Int)) i) := by
    funext i
    simp only [crossNiveauCarryHalfDifference, periodicExtend,
      PhantomWeight.periodicU]
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  calc
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
          (((Profile.niveauTwo K' hK').indicator i : Int) *
              (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int) -
            periodicExtend hf (fun j ↦
              ((Profile.niveauOne J').indicator j : Int) * (sigma'.u j : Int)) i) -
          (((Profile.niveauTwo K hK).indicator i : Int) *
              (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) -
            periodicExtend hf (fun j ↦
              ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator j : Int) * (sigma.u j : Int)) i)) =
        (translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
            ((Profile.niveauTwo K' hK').indicator i : Int) *
              (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)) -
          translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega)
            (periodicExtend hf (fun j ↦
              ((Profile.niveauOne J').indicator j : Int) * (sigma'.u j : Int)))) -
        (translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
            ((Profile.niveauTwo K hK).indicator i : Int) *
              (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) -
          translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega)
            (periodicExtend hf (fun j ↦
              ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator j : Int) * (sigma.u j : Int)))) := by
      simp only [translationExponent, Int.cast_sub, sub_mul,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ = (niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K' -
          liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' J')) -
        (niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma K -
          liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J)) := by
      rw [translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator,
        translationExponent_periodicExtend hp hf,
        translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
        translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator,
        translationExponent_periodicExtend hp hf,
        translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [hleftJ, hleftK, liftQPlusOne_add hp hf,
        liftQPlusOne_sub hp hf]
      ring

name: KLSposet.manuscriptWeightedSum_dvd_iff_translationExponent
statement:
theorem manuscriptWeightedSum_dvd_iff_translationExponent {p n : Nat}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (y : ZMod n → Int) :
    ((p : Int) ^ n - 1) ∣ manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p n y ↔
      translationExponent p n hn y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_cast hn]
  have hchar :=
    (CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff (ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) (p ^ n - 1)
      (manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p n y)).symm
  simpa [Int.natCast_sub (one_le_pow₀ hp), Int.natCast_pow] using hchar

name: KLSposet.manuscriptWeightedSum_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem manuscriptWeightedSum_dvd_iff {p n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (y : ZMod n → Int) :
    ((p : Int) ^ n - 1) ∣ manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p n y ↔
      ((p : Int) ^ n - 1) ∣ cyclicWeightedSum p n y
proof:
:= by
  have hcoprime : IsCoprime ((p : Int) ^ n - 1) (p : Int) := by
    refine ⟨(-1 : Int), (p : Int) ^ (n - 1), ?_⟩
    rw [show n = (n - 1) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
    rw [show n - 1 + 1 - 1 = n - 1 by omega]
    ring
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact hcoprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨(p : Int) * c, ?_⟩
    simp only [manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum, hc]
    ring

name: KLSposet.carrySolutionAux_add_weightedSumAux
statement:
theorem carrySolutionAux_add_weightedSumAux (p n : Nat) (y : ZMod n → Int)
    (c : Int) (k : Nat) :
    carrySolutionAux p n y c k + cyclicWeightedSumAux p n y k =
      (p : Int) ^ k * c
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [carrySolutionAux, cyclicWeightedSumAux]
  | succ k ih =>
      simp only [carrySolutionAux, cyclicWeightedSumAux]
      calc
        (p : Int) * carrySolutionAux p n y c k - y k +
              ((p : Int) * cyclicWeightedSumAux p n y k + y k) =
            (p : Int) *
              (carrySolutionAux p n y c k + cyclicWeightedSumAux p n y k) := by ring
        _ = (p : Int) * ((p : Int) ^ k * c) := by rw [ih]
        _ = (p : Int) ^ (k + 1) * c := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

name: KLSposet.carryEquation_exists_of_weightedSum_dvd
statement:
theorem carryEquation_exists_of_weightedSum_dvd {p n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {y : ZMod n → Int}
    (hdiv : ((p : Int) ^ n - 1) ∣ cyclicWeightedSum p n y) :
    ∃ x : ZMod n → Int, CarryEquation p y x
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  rcases hdiv with ⟨c, hc⟩
  let a : Nat → Int := carrySolutionAux p n y c
  have hclosed : a n = c := by
    have htel := carrySolutionAux_add_weightedSumAux p n y c n
    change a n + cyclicWeightedSum p n y = (p : Int) ^ n * c at htel
    rw [hc] at htel
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨fun i => a (i.val + 1), ?_⟩
  intro i
  have hpred : a ((i - 1).val + 1) = a i.val := by
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      have hindex : (((0 : ZMod n) - 1).val + 1) = n := by
        rw [zero_sub]
        obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero (by omega : n ≠ 0)
        simp [ZMod.val_neg_one]
      rw [hindex, hclosed]
      simp [a, carrySolutionAux]
    · have hival : 0 < i.val := ZMod.val_pos.mpr hi
      have hnlarge : 1 < n := by
        have := i.val_lt
        omega
      letI : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨hnlarge⟩
      have hone : (1 : ZMod n).val = 1 := ZMod.val_one n
      have hindex : (i - 1).val + 1 = i.val := by
        rw [ZMod.val_sub (by rw [hone]; omega), hone]
        omega
      rw [hindex]
  have hrec : a (i.val + 1) = (p : Int) * a i.val - y i := by
    change carrySolutionAux p n y c (i.val + 1) =
      (p : Int) * carrySolutionAux p n y c i.val - y i
    rw [carrySolutionAux, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
  change y i = (p : Int) * a ((i - 1).val + 1) - a (i.val + 1)
  rw [hpred, hrec]
  ring

name: KLSposet.carryEquation_exists_of_manuscriptWeightedSum_dvd
statement:
theorem carryEquation_exists_of_manuscriptWeightedSum_dvd {p n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {y : ZMod n → Int}
    (hdiv : ((p : Int) ^ n - 1) ∣ manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p n y) :
    ∃ x : ZMod n → Int, CarryEquation p y x
proof:
:=
  carryEquation_exists_of_weightedSum_dvd hn
    ((manuscriptWeightedSum_dvd_iff hn y).mp hdiv)

name: KLSposet.carryEquation_unique
statement:
theorem carryEquation_unique {p n : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {y x x' : ZMod n → Int} (hx : CarryEquation p y x)
    (hx' : CarryEquation p y x') : x = x'
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  have hstep (j : ZMod n) :
      x j - x' j = (p : Int) * (x (j - 1) - x' (j - 1)) := by
    have hj := hx j
    have hj' := hx' j
    calc
      x j - x' j =
          ((p : Int) * x (j - 1) - y j) -
            ((p : Int) * x' (j - 1) - y j) := by
              congr 1 <;> linarith
      _ = (p : Int) * (x (j - 1) - x' (j - 1)) := by ring
  have hiterate : ∀ k : Nat,
      x i - x' i = (p : Int) ^ k *
        (x (i - (k : ZMod n)) - x' (i - (k : ZMod n))) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
        calc
          x i - x' i = (p : Int) ^ k *
              (x (i - (k : ZMod n)) - x' (i - (k : ZMod n))) := ih
          _ = (p : Int) ^ k * ((p : Int) *
              (x (i - (k : ZMod n) - 1) -
                x' (i - (k : ZMod n) - 1))) := by
                  rw [hstep (i - (k : ZMod n))]
          _ = (p : Int) ^ (k + 1) *
              (x (i - ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod n)) -
                x' (i - ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod n))) := by
                  have hindex :
                      i - (k : ZMod n) - 1 =
                        i - ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod n) := by
                    push_cast
                    ring
                  rw [hindex, pow_succ]
                  ring
  have hcycle := hiterate n
  have hcycle' :
      x i - x' i = (p : Int) ^ n * (x i - x' i) := by
    simpa using hcycle
  have hpow : (1 : Int) < (p : Int) ^ n := by
    exact_mod_cast one_lt_pow₀ (by omega : 1 < p) (by omega : n ≠ 0)
  have hcoefficient : (p : Int) ^ n - 1 ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hzero : ((p : Int) ^ n - 1) * (x i - x' i) = 0 := by
    nlinarith [hcycle']
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left hcoefficient)

name: KLSposet.carryEquation_existsUnique
statement:
theorem carryEquation_existsUnique {p n : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {y : ZMod n → Int}
    (hdiv : ((p : Int) ^ n - 1) ∣ manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p n y) :
    ∃! x : ZMod n → Int, CarryEquation p y x
proof:
:= by
  rcases carryEquation_exists_of_manuscriptWeightedSum_dvd hn hdiv with ⟨x, hx⟩
  refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
  intro x' hx'
  exact carryEquation_unique hp hn hx' hx

  carryEquation_existsUnique hp (by omega)
    ((manuscriptWeightedSum_dvd_iff_translationExponent (by omega) hn y).mpr hzero)

name: KLSposet.carryEquation_difference_even
statement:
theorem carryEquation_difference_even {p n : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {y y' x x' z : ZMod n → Int} (hx : CarryEquation p y x)
    (hx' : CarryEquation p y' x') (hy : ∀ i, y i - y' i = 2 * z i)
    (hz : ((p : Int) ^ n - 1) ∣ manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p n z) :
    ∀ i, Even (x i - x' i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases carryEquation_exists_of_manuscriptWeightedSum_dvd hn hz with ⟨w, hw⟩
  have hdiff : CarryEquation p (fun i => y i - y' i) (fun i => x i - x' i) := by
    intro i
    calc
      y i - y' i =
          ((p : Int) * x (i - 1) - x i) -
            ((p : Int) * x' (i - 1) - x' i) := by rw [hx i, hx' i]
      _ = (p : Int) * (x (i - 1) - x' (i - 1)) - (x i - x' i) := by ring
  have hdouble : CarryEquation p (fun i => y i - y' i) (fun i => 2 * w i) := by
    intro i
    change y i - y' i = (p : Int) * (2 * w (i - 1)) - 2 * w i
    rw [hy i, hw i]
    ring
  have heq : (fun i => x i - x' i) = (fun i => 2 * w i) :=
    carryEquation_unique hp hn hdiff hdouble
  intro i
  change ∃ k : Int, x i - x' i = k + k
  refine ⟨w i, ?_⟩
  have hi := congrFun heq i
  linarith

name: KLSposet.niveauOneCarryEquation_sameParity
statement:
theorem niveauOneCarryEquation_sameParity {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J J' K K' : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauOne J'))
    (hK : profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne K) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauOne K'))
    {x x' : ZMod f → Int}
    (hx : CarryEquation p (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J') x)
    (hx' : CarryEquation p (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' K K') x') :
    ∀ i, Even (x i - x' i)
proof:
:= by
  apply carryEquation_difference_even hp (by omega) hx hx'
    (niveauOneCarryInput_sub_eq_two_mul_halfDifference sigma sigma' J J' K K')
  apply (manuscriptWeightedSum_dvd_iff_translationExponent (by omega) hf
    (niveauOneCarryHalfDifference sigma sigma' J J' K K')).mpr
  exact translationExponent_niveauOneCarryHalfDifference_eq_zero hf
    sigma sigma' J J' K K' hJ hK

name: KLSposet.carryEquation_antiPeriodic
statement:
theorem carryEquation_antiPeriodic {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 1 ≤ f)
    {y x : ZMod (2 * f) → Int} (hy : ∀ i, y (i + f) = -y i)
    (hx : CarryEquation p y x) : ∀ i, x (i + f) = -x i
proof:
:= by
  let x' : ZMod (2 * f) → Int := fun i => -x (i + f)
  have hx' : CarryEquation p y x' := by
    intro i
    change y i = (p : Int) * (-x (i - 1 + f)) - (-x (i + f))
    have hindex : i - 1 + f = i + f - 1 := by ring
    calc
      y i = -y (i + f) := by linarith [hy i]
      _ = -((p : Int) * x (i + f - 1) - x (i + f)) := by rw [hx]
      _ = (p : Int) * (-x (i - 1 + f)) - (-x (i + f)) := by
        rw [hindex]
        ring
  have heq : x = x' :=
    carryEquation_unique hp (by omega) hx hx'
  intro i
  have hi := congrFun heq i
  change x i = -x (i + f) at hi
  linarith

    (hx : CarryEquation p (niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ') x) :
    ∀ i, x (i + f) = -x i
proof:

  carryEquation_antiPeriodic hp (by omega)
    (niveauTwoCarryInput_antiPeriodic hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ') hx

name: KLSposet.carryEquation_abs_at_max_le_two
statement:
theorem carryEquation_abs_at_max_le_two {p n : Nat} (hp : 4 ≤ p)
    {y x : ZMod n → Int} (hy : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ 2 * (p : Int))
    (hx : CarryEquation p y x) (i : ZMod n)
    (hmax : ∀ j, |x j| ≤ |x i|) : |x i| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := hx (i + 1)
  have hindex : i + 1 - 1 = i := by ring
  rw [hindex] at hrec
  have hpnonneg : (0 : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := Int.natCast_nonneg p
  have hbound : (p : Int) * |x i| ≤ 2 * (p : Int) + |x i| := by
    calc
      (p : Int) * |x i| = |(p : Int)| * |x i| := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hpnonneg]
      _ = |(p : Int) * x i| := (abs_mul _ _).symm
      _ = |y (i + 1) + x (i + 1)| := by
        congr 1
        linarith
      _ ≤ |y (i + 1)| + |x (i + 1)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ 2 * (p : Int) + |x i| :=
        add_le_add (hy (i + 1)) (hmax (i + 1))
  by_contra hnot
  have hlarge : (3 : Int) ≤ |x i| := by omega
  have hpcast : (4 : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg (x i)]

name: KLSposet.carryEquation_abs_le_two
statement:
theorem carryEquation_abs_le_two {p n : Nat} (hp : 4 ≤ p) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {y x : ZMod n → Int} (hy : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ 2 * (p : Int))
    (hx : CarryEquation p y x) : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  let values : Finset Int := Finset.univ.image fun i : ZMod n ↦ |x i|
  have hvalues : values.Nonempty := by
    exact Finset.image_nonempty.mpr Finset.univ_nonempty
  let maximum : Int := values.max' hvalues
  have hmaximum_mem : maximum ∈ values := Finset.max'_mem values hvalues
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hmaximum_mem with ⟨imax, _, himax⟩
  have hmax : ∀ j, |x j| ≤ |x imax| := by
    intro j
    have hjmem : |x j| ∈ values := by
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, rfl⟩
    have hjle : |x j| ≤ maximum := Finset.le_max' values _ hjmem
    simpa [himax] using hjle
  have himax_le : |x imax| ≤ 2 :=
    carryEquation_abs_at_max_le_two hp hy hx imax hmax
  intro i
  exact le_trans (hmax i) himax_le

      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, rfl⟩
    have hjle : |x j| ≤ maximum := Finset.le_max' values _ hjmem
    simpa [himax] using hjle
  have himax_le : |x imax| ≤ 3 :=
    carryEquation_abs_at_max_le_three hp hy hx imax hmax
  intro i
  exact le_trans (hmax i) himax_le

name: KLSposet.carryEquation_abs_eq_three_rigid
statement:
theorem carryEquation_abs_eq_three_rigid {n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {y x : ZMod n → Int} (hy : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ 6)
    (hx : CarryEquation 3 y x) (i : ZMod n) (hi : |x i| = 3) :
    ((∀ j, x j = 3) ∧ ∀ j, y j = 6) ∨
      ((∀ j, x j = -3) ∧ ∀ j, y j = -6)
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hbound : ∀ j, |x j| ≤ 3 :=
    carryEquation_abs_le_three (p := 3) (by omega) hn (by simpa using hy) hx
  have hstep (k : ZMod n) (hk : |x k| = 3) : x (k + 1) = x k := by
    have hrec := hx (k + 1)
    have hindex : k + 1 - 1 = k := by ring
    rw [hindex] at hrec
    have hybounds := abs_le.mp (hy (k + 1))
    have hxbounds := abs_le.mp (hbound (k + 1))
    by_cases hkpos : 0 ≤ x k
    · have hkval : x k = 3 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hkpos] at hk
        omega
      omega
    · have hkneg : x k ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hkpos
      have hkval : x k = -3 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonpos hkneg] at hk
        omega
      omega
  have hiter : ∀ m : Nat, x (i + (m : ZMod n)) = x i := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
        have hmag : |x (i + (m : ZMod n))| = 3 := by rw [ih, hi]
        calc
          x (i + ((m + 1 : Nat) : ZMod n)) =
              x ((i + (m : ZMod n)) + 1) := by
                congr 1
                push_cast
                ring
          _ = x (i + (m : ZMod n)) := hstep _ hmag
          _ = x i := ih
  have hallx (j : ZMod n) : x j = x i := by
    have hval : (((j - i).val : Nat) : ZMod n) = j - i :=
      ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (j - i)
    calc
      x j = x (i + (((j - i).val : Nat) : ZMod n)) := by rw [hval]; congr 1; ring
      _ = x i := hiter (j - i).val
  have hally (j : ZMod n) : y j = 2 * x i := by
    calc
      y j = (3 : Int) * x (j - 1) - x j := hx j
      _ = (3 : Int) * x i - x i := by rw [hallx (j - 1), hallx j]
      _ = 2 * x i := by ring
  by_cases hipos : 0 ≤ x i
  · have hival : x i = 3 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hipos] at hi
      exact hi
    left
    constructor
    · intro j
      rw [hallx j, hival]
    · intro j
      rw [hally j, hival]
      norm_num
  · have hineg : x i ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hipos
    have hival : x i = -3 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonpos hineg] at hi
      omega
    right
    constructor
    · intro j
      rw [hallx j, hival]
    · intro j
      rw [hally j, hival]
      norm_num

name: KLSposet.niveauOneCarryEquation_boundary_classification
statement:
theorem niveauOneCarryEquation_boundary_classification {f : Nat} (hf : 1 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f))
    {x : ZMod f → Int}
    (hx : CarryEquation 3 (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J') x)
    (i : ZMod f) (hi : |x i| = 3) :
    ((∀ k, x k = 3) ∧ (∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) ∧ (∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3) ∧
        (∀ k, k ∈ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∉ J') ∨
      ((∀ k, x k = -3) ∧ (∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) ∧ (∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3) ∧
        (∀ k, k ∉ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∈ J')
proof:
:= by
  have hy : ∀ k, |niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J' k| ≤ 6 := by
    intro k
    simpa using niveauOneCarryInput_abs_le sigma sigma' J J' k
  rcases carryEquation_abs_eq_three_rigid hf hy hx i hi with hpos | hneg
  · left
    refine ⟨hpos.1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k
      exact (niveauOneCarryInput_eq_six_iff sigma sigma' J J' k).mp (hpos.2 k) |>.1
    · intro k
      exact (niveauOneCarryInput_eq_six_iff sigma sigma' J J' k).mp (hpos.2 k) |>.2.1
    · intro k
      exact (niveauOneCarryInput_eq_six_iff sigma sigma' J J' k).mp (hpos.2 k) |>.2.2.1
    · intro k
      exact (niveauOneCarryInput_eq_six_iff sigma sigma' J J' k).mp (hpos.2 k) |>.2.2.2
  · right
    refine ⟨hneg.1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k
      exact (niveauOneCarryInput_eq_neg_six_iff sigma sigma' J J' k).mp (hneg.2 k) |>.1
    · intro k
      exact (niveauOneCarryInput_eq_neg_six_iff sigma sigma' J J' k).mp (hneg.2 k) |>.2.1
    · intro k
      exact (niveauOneCarryInput_eq_neg_six_iff sigma sigma' J J' k).mp (hneg.2 k) |>.2.2.1
    · intro k
      exact (niveauOneCarryInput_eq_neg_six_iff sigma sigma' J J' k).mp (hneg.2 k) |>.2.2.2

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoCarryEquation_abs_ne_three
statement:
theorem niveauTwoCarryEquation_abs_ne_three {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f) (J J' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) (hJ' : ∀ i, i ∈ J' ↔ i + f ∉ J')
    {x : ZMod (2 * f) → Int}
    (hx : CarryEquation 3 (niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ') x) :
    ∀ i, |x i| ≠ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hy : ∀ k, |niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' k| ≤ 6 := by
    intro k
    simpa using niveauTwoCarryInput_abs_le hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' k
  intro i hi
  rcases carryEquation_abs_eq_three_rigid (by omega) hy hx i hi with hpos | hneg
  · have hallJ (k : ZMod (2 * f)) : k ∈ J :=
      (niveauTwoCarryInput_eq_six_iff hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' k).mp
        (hpos.2 k) |>.2.2.1
    have hnot : (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) + f ∉ J := (hJ 0).mp (hallJ 0)
    exact hnot (hallJ ((0 : ZMod (2 * f)) + f))
  · have hallJ' (k : ZMod (2 * f)) : k ∈ J' :=
      (niveauTwoCarryInput_eq_neg_six_iff hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' k).mp
        (hneg.2 k) |>.2.2.2
    have hnot : (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) + f ∉ J' := (hJ' 0).mp (hallJ' 0)
    exact hnot (hallJ' ((0 : ZMod (2 * f)) + f))

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoCarryEquation_abs_le_two
statement:
theorem niveauTwoCarryEquation_abs_le_two {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f) (J J' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) (hJ' : ∀ i, i ∈ J' ↔ i + f ∉ J')
    {x : ZMod (2 * f) → Int}
    (hx : CarryEquation 3 (niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ') x) :
    ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hy : ∀ k, |niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' k| ≤ 6 := by
    intro k
    simpa using niveauTwoCarryInput_abs_le hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' k
  have hle : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 3 :=
    carryEquation_abs_le_three (p := 3) (by omega) (by omega) hy hx
  have hne : ∀ i, |x i| ≠ 3 :=
    niveauTwoCarryEquation_abs_ne_three hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' hx
  intro i
  have hlei := hle i
  have hnei := hne i
  omega

name: KLSposet.niveauOneCarryEquation_bound_or_exception
statement:
theorem niveauOneCarryEquation_bound_or_exception {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J J' : Set (ZMod f)) {x : ZMod f → Int}
    (hx : CarryEquation p (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J') x) :
    (∀ i, |x i| ≤ 2) ∨
      (p = 3 ∧ (∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) ∧ (∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3) ∧
        (((∀ k, k ∈ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∉ J') ∨
          ((∀ k, k ∉ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∈ J')))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp4 : 4 ≤ p
  · left
    exact carryEquation_abs_le_two hp4 (by omega)
      (niveauOneCarryInput_abs_le sigma sigma' J J') hx
  have hp3 : p = 3 := by omega
  subst p
  by_cases hall : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 2
  · exact Or.inl hall
  · rcases not_forall.mp hall with ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hle3 : |x i| ≤ 3 := carryEquation_abs_le_three (p := 3) (by omega)
      (by omega) (by
        intro k
        simpa using niveauOneCarryInput_abs_le sigma sigma' J J' k) hx i
    have hi3 : |x i| = 3 := by omega
    rcases niveauOneCarryEquation_boundary_classification (by omega)
      sigma sigma' J J' hx i hi3 with hpos | hneg
    · right
      exact ⟨rfl, hpos.2.1, hpos.2.2.1,
        Or.inl ⟨hpos.2.2.2.1, hpos.2.2.2.2⟩⟩
    · right
      exact ⟨rfl, hneg.2.1, hneg.2.2.1,
        Or.inr ⟨hneg.2.2.2.1, hneg.2.2.2.2⟩⟩

name: KLSposet.niveauOneCarryEquation_bound_or_exception_with_twist
statement:
theorem niveauOneCarryEquation_bound_or_exception_with_twist {p f : Nat}
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f))
    {x : ZMod f → Int}
    (hExp : profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauOne J'))
    (hx : CarryEquation p (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J') x) :
    (∀ i, |x i| ≤ 2) ∨
      (p = 3 ∧ (∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) ∧ (∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3) ∧
        (((∀ k, k ∈ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∉ J') ∨
          ((∀ k, k ∉ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∈ J')) ∧
        sigma'.t - sigma.t =
          (((p ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rcases niveauOneCarryEquation_bound_or_exception hp hf sigma sigma' J J' hx with
    hbound | hexception
  · exact Or.inl hbound
  · rcases hexception with ⟨hp3, hu, hu', hprofiles⟩
    subst p
    exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, hu, hu', hprofiles,
      niveauOneExceptionalDeterminantTwist hf sigma sigma' J J' hu hu'
        hprofiles hExp⟩

name: KLSposet.niveauOneCarryEquation_bound_or_exception_with_twist_of_pair_eq
statement:
theorem niveauOneCarryEquation_bound_or_exception_with_twist_of_pair_eq
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f))
    {x : ZMod f → Int}
    (h : profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne J'))
    (hx : CarryEquation p (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J') x) :
    (∀ i, |x i| ≤ 2) ∨
      (p = 3 ∧ (∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) ∧ (∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3) ∧
        (((∀ k, k ∈ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∉ J') ∨
          ((∀ k, k ∉ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∈ J')) ∧
        sigma'.t - sigma.t =
          (((p ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  apply niveauOneCarryEquation_bound_or_exception_with_twist hp hf sigma sigma' J J'
  · exact niveauOneProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq (by omega) hf chars
      sigma sigma' J J' h
  · exact hx

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoCarryEquation_abs_le_two_of_three_le
statement:
theorem niveauTwoCarryEquation_abs_le_two_of_three_le {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J J' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) (hJ' : ∀ i, i ∈ J' ↔ i + f ∉ J')
    {x : ZMod (2 * f) → Int}
    (hx : CarryEquation p (niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ') x) :
    ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp4 : 4 ≤ p
  · exact carryEquation_abs_le_two hp4 (by omega)
      (niveauTwoCarryInput_abs_le hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ') hx
  have hp3 : p = 3 := by omega
  subst p
  exact niveauTwoCarryEquation_abs_le_two hf sigma sigma' J J' hJ hJ' hx

name: KLSposet.powerPlusOne_dvd_powerDouble_sub_one
statement:
theorem powerPlusOne_dvd_powerDouble_sub_one {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    p ^ f + 1 ∣ p ^ (2 * f) - 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨p ^ f - 1, ?_⟩
  rw [show 2 * f = f + f by omega, pow_add]
  have hq : 1 ≤ p ^ f := one_le_pow₀ hp
  calc
    p ^ f * p ^ f - 1 = (p ^ f * p ^ f + p ^ f) - (p ^ f + 1) := by omega
    _ = (p ^ f + 1) * p ^ f - (p ^ f + 1) := by ring_nf
    _ = (p ^ f + 1) * (p ^ f - 1) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib]
      simp

name: KLSposet.reduceNiveauTwoExponentToPowerPlusOne_liftQPlusOne
statement:
theorem reduceNiveauTwoExponentToPowerPlusOne_liftQPlusOne
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (a : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
    reduceNiveauTwoExponentToPowerPlusOne p f hp (liftQPlusOne p f a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change reduceNiveauTwoExponentToPowerPlusOne p f hp
    (((p ^ f + 1) * a.val : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) = 0
  rw [map_natCast, Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]

name: KLSposet.threePowerPlusOne_dvd_threePowerDouble_sub_one
statement:
theorem threePowerPlusOne_dvd_threePowerDouble_sub_one (f : Nat) :
    3 ^ f + 1 ∣ 3 ^ (2 * f) - 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨3 ^ f - 1, ?_⟩
  rw [show 2 * f = f + f by omega, pow_add]
  have hq : 1 ≤ 3 ^ f := one_le_pow₀ (by omega)
  calc
    3 ^ f * 3 ^ f - 1 = (3 ^ f * 3 ^ f + 3 ^ f) - (3 ^ f + 1) := by omega
    _ = (3 ^ f + 1) * 3 ^ f - (3 ^ f + 1) := by ring_nf
    _ = (3 ^ f + 1) * (3 ^ f - 1) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib]
      simp

name: KLSposet.reduceNiveauTwoExponentToQPlusOne_liftQPlusOne
statement:
theorem reduceNiveauTwoExponentToQPlusOne_liftQPlusOne (f : Nat)
    (a : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) :
    reduceNiveauTwoExponentToQPlusOne f (liftQPlusOne 3 f a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change reduceNiveauTwoExponentToQPlusOne f
    (((3 ^ f + 1) * a.val : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ (2 * f) - 1)) = 0
  rw [map_natCast, Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]

name: KLSposet.manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_complementary_decomposition
statement:
theorem manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_complementary_decomposition
    {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (y : ZMod (2 * f) → Int) (c : Int)
    (hy : ∀ i, y (i + f) = c - y i) :
    manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p (2 * f) y =
      ((p : Int) ^ f + 1) *
          manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p f (firstHalfCoordinates hf y) +
        manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p f
          (fun i => c - 2 * firstHalfCoordinates hf y i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_eq_sum_range,
    manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_eq_sum_range,
    manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_eq_sum_range]
  have hrange : Finset.range (2 * f) = Finset.range (f + f) := by
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [hrange, Finset.sum_range_add]
  have hfirst :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range f,
          (p : Int) ^ (2 * f - j) * y (j : ZMod (2 * f))) =
        (p : Int) ^ f *
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range f,
            (p : Int) ^ (f - j) * firstHalfCoordinates hf y (j : ZMod f) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hjlt := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
    simp only [firstHalfCoordinates, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hjlt]
    rw [show 2 * f - j = f + (f - j) by omega, pow_add]
    ring
  have hsecond :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range f,
          (p : Int) ^ (2 * f - (f + j)) *
            y ((f + j : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range f,
          (p : Int) ^ (f - j) *
            (c - firstHalfCoordinates hf y (j : ZMod f)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hjlt := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
    have hindex : ((f + j : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) =
        (j : ZMod (2 * f)) + f := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hindex, hy]
    simp only [firstHalfCoordinates, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hjlt]
    rw [show 2 * f - (f + j) = f - j by omega]
  rw [hfirst, hsecond]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: KLSposet.cyclicWeightedSumAux_signedUnit_ne_zero
statement:
theorem cyclicWeightedSumAux_signedUnit_ne_zero {p f : Nat}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (z : ZMod f → Int)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i = 1 ∨ z i = -1) :
    cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hfsucc : f = (f - 1) + 1 := by omega
  have hrec : cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z f =
      (p : Int) * cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z (f - 1) +
        z ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
    calc
      cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z f =
          cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z ((f - 1) + 1) := by
            exact congrArg (fun k => cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z k) hfsucc
      _ = (p : Int) * cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z (f - 1) +
          z ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by rw [cyclicWeightedSumAux]
  rcases hz ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) with hlast | hlast
  · rw [hrec, hlast] at hzero
    have hdiv : (p : Int) ∣ 1 := ⟨-cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z (f - 1), by
      ring_nf at hzero ⊢
      linarith⟩
    have hpOne : p ∣ 1 := Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp (by simpa using hdiv)
    have hpEq : p = 1 := Nat.dvd_one.mp hpOne
    omega
  · rw [hrec, hlast] at hzero
    have hdiv : (p : Int) ∣ 1 := ⟨cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z (f - 1), by
      ring_nf at hzero ⊢
      linarith⟩
    have hpOne : p ∣ 1 := Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp (by simpa using hdiv)
    have hpEq : p = 1 := Nat.dvd_one.mp hpOne
    omega

name: KLSposet.cyclicWeightedSumAux_signedUnit_bound
statement:
theorem cyclicWeightedSumAux_signedUnit_bound {p f : Nat}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (z : ZMod f → Int) (hz : ∀ i, z i = 1 ∨ z i = -1)
    (k : Nat) :
    ((p : Int) - 1) * |cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z k| ≤
      (p : Int) ^ k - 1
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [cyclicWeightedSumAux]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [cyclicWeightedSumAux]
      have hzabs : |z ((k : Nat) : ZMod f)| = 1 := by
        rcases hz ((k : Nat) : ZMod f) with hk | hk <;> simp [hk]
      have hpInt : (2 : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast hp
      calc
        ((p : Int) - 1) *
            |(p : Int) * cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z k + z (k : ZMod f)| ≤
          ((p : Int) - 1) *
            (|(p : Int) * cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z k| + |z (k : ZMod f)|) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_add_le _ _) (by omega)
        _ = ((p : Int) - 1) *
            ((p : Int) * |cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z k| + 1) := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by omega), hzabs]
        _ ≤ (p : Int) * ((p : Int) ^ k - 1) + ((p : Int) - 1) := by
              nlinarith
        _ = (p : Int) ^ (k + 1) - 1 := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

name: KLSposet.powerPlusOne_not_dvd_subOne_mul_signedUnitWeightedSum
statement:
theorem powerPlusOne_not_dvd_subOne_mul_signedUnitWeightedSum
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (z : ZMod f → Int)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i = 1 ∨ z i = -1) :
    ¬ ((p : Int) ^ f + 1) ∣
      ((p : Int) - 1) * manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p f z
proof:
:= by
  intro hdvd
  let a := cyclicWeightedSumAux p f z f
  have hweighted : manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p f z = (p : Int) * a := by rfl
  rw [hweighted] at hdvd
  have hdvd' : ((p : Int) ^ f + 1) ∣
      (p : Int) * (((p : Int) - 1) * a) := by
    rcases hdvd with ⟨d, hd⟩
    refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
    rw [← hd]
    ring
  have hpow : p ^ f = p * p ^ (f - 1) := by
    calc
      p ^ f = p ^ ((f - 1) + 1) := by
        congr 1
        omega
      _ = p ^ (f - 1) * p := by rw [pow_succ]
      _ = p * p ^ (f - 1) := by ring
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime (p ^ f + 1) p := by
    rw [hpow]
    rw [Nat.coprime_comm]
    exact (Nat.coprime_mul_left_add_right p 1 (p ^ (f - 1))).2
      (Nat.coprime_one_right p)
  have hdvdNat : p ^ f + 1 ∣
      p * (((p : Int) - 1) * a).natAbs := by
    have := Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr hdvd'
    simpa [Int.natAbs_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm,
      Nat.mul_assoc] using this
  have hcancelNat : p ^ f + 1 ∣ (((p : Int) - 1) * a).natAbs :=
    hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdvdNat
  have hcancel : ((p : Int) ^ f + 1) ∣ ((p : Int) - 1) * a := by
    apply Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mp
    change p ^ f + 1 ∣ (((p : Int) - 1) * a).natAbs
    exact hcancelNat
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := cyclicWeightedSumAux_signedUnit_ne_zero
    (by omega) (by omega) z hz
  have hprod : ((p : Int) - 1) * a ≠ 0 := by
    apply mul_ne_zero
    · have hpInt : (3 : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast hp
      omega
    · exact ha
  have hlow : (p : Int) ^ f + 1 ≤ |((p : Int) - 1) * a| :=
    Int.le_of_dvd (abs_pos.mpr hprod) ((dvd_abs _ _).2 hcancel)
  have hupper := cyclicWeightedSumAux_signedUnit_bound
    (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) z hz f
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by omega : (0 : Int) ≤ (p : Int) - 1)] at hlow
  nlinarith

name: KLSposet.criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates_complementary
statement:
theorem criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates_complementary {p f : Nat}
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    ∀ i, criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates (p := p) K hK (i + f) =
      (p : Int) - 1 - criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates (p := p) K hK i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i ∈ K
  · have hif : i + f ∉ K := (hK i).mp hi
    simp [criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hif]
  · have hif : i + f ∈ K := by
      by_contra hnot
      exact hi ((hK i).mpr hnot)
    simp [criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hif]

name: KLSposet.criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement:
theorem criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign_eq_one_or_neg_one {f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    ∀ i, criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign hf K hK i = 1 ∨
      criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign hf K hK i = -1
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  classical
  by_cases hi : (i.val : ZMod (2 * f)) ∈ K
  · right
    simp [criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
  · left
    simp [criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]

name: KLSposet.criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates_signed
statement:
theorem criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates_signed {p f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    ∀ i, (p : Int) - 1 -
        2 * firstHalfCoordinates hf
          (criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates (p := p) K hK) i =
      ((p : Int) - 1) * criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign hf K hK i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  classical
  by_cases hi : (i.val : ZMod (2 * f)) ∈ K
  · simp [firstHalfCoordinates, criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates,
      criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
    ring
  · simp [firstHalfCoordinates, criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates,
      criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]

name: KLSposet.criticalNiveauTwoSelectedWeightedSum_decomposition
statement:
theorem criticalNiveauTwoSelectedWeightedSum_decomposition {p f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p (2 * f)
        (criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates (p := p) K hK) =
      ((p : Int) ^ f + 1) * manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p f
          (firstHalfCoordinates hf
            (criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates (p := p) K hK)) +
        ((p : Int) - 1) * manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p f
          (criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign hf K hK)
proof:
:= by
  rw [manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_complementary_decomposition hf
    (criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates (p := p) K hK) ((p : Int) - 1)
    (criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates_complementary K hK)]
  congr 1
  rw [manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_eq_sum_range,
    manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_eq_sum_range, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates_signed hf K hK]
  ring

name: KLSposet.manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_antiPeriodic
statement:
theorem manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_antiPeriodic {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (y : ZMod (2 * f) → Int) (hy : ∀ i, y (i + f) = -y i) :
    manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p (2 * f) y =
      ((p : Int) ^ f - 1) *
        manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p f (firstHalfCoordinates hf y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_eq_sum_range,
    manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_eq_sum_range]
  have hrange : Finset.range (2 * f) = Finset.range (f + f) := by
    congr 1
    omega
  rw [hrange, Finset.sum_range_add]
  have hfirst :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range f,
          (p : Int) ^ (2 * f - j) * y (j : ZMod (2 * f))) =
        (p : Int) ^ f *
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range f,
            (p : Int) ^ (f - j) * firstHalfCoordinates hf y (j : ZMod f) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hjlt := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
    simp only [firstHalfCoordinates, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hjlt]
    rw [show 2 * f - j = f + (f - j) by omega, pow_add]
    ring
  have hsecond :
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range f,
          (p : Int) ^ (2 * f - (f + j)) *
            y ((f + j : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) =
        -∑ j ∈ Finset.range f,
            (p : Int) ^ (f - j) * firstHalfCoordinates hf y (j : ZMod f) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hjlt := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
    have hindex : ((f + j : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) =
        (j : ZMod (2 * f)) + f := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hindex, hy]
    simp only [firstHalfCoordinates, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hjlt]
    rw [show 2 * f - (f + j) = f - j by omega]
    ring
  rw [hfirst, hsecond]
  ring

name: KLSposet.cyclicWeightedSumAux_abs_le_const_three
statement:
theorem cyclicWeightedSumAux_abs_le_const_three (f : Nat) (z : ZMod f → Int)
    (hz : ∀ i, |z i| ≤ 3) (k : Nat) :
    |cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f z k| ≤
      cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f (fun _ => 3) k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [cyclicWeightedSumAux]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [cyclicWeightedSumAux, cyclicWeightedSumAux]
      calc
        |3 * cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f z k + z (k : ZMod f)| ≤
            |3 * cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f z k| + |z (k : ZMod f)| :=
          abs_add_le _ _
        _ = 3 * |cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f z k| + |z (k : ZMod f)| := by
          rw [abs_mul]
          norm_num
        _ ≤ 3 * cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f (fun _ => 3) k + 3 := by
          exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by norm_num)) (hz _)

name: KLSposet.three_dvd_cyclicWeightedSumAux_of_eq_three_or_neg_three
statement:
theorem three_dvd_cyclicWeightedSumAux_of_eq_three_or_neg_three
    (f : Nat) (z : ZMod f → Int) (hz : ∀ i, z i = 3 ∨ z i = -3) (k : Nat) :
    (3 : Int) ∣ cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f z k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [cyclicWeightedSumAux]
  | succ k ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨c, hc⟩
      rcases hz (k : ZMod f) with hk | hk
      · refine ⟨3 * c + 1, ?_⟩
        simp [cyclicWeightedSumAux, hc, hk]
        ring
      · refine ⟨3 * c - 1, ?_⟩
        simp [cyclicWeightedSumAux, hc, hk]
        ring

name: KLSposet.signedThreeManuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_properties
statement:
theorem signedThreeManuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_properties {f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (z : ZMod f → Int) (hz : ∀ i, z i = 3 ∨ z i = -3) :
    (9 : Int) ∣ manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 f z ∧
      manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 f z ≠ 0 ∧
      2 * |manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 f z| ≤
        9 * ((3 : Int) ^ f - 1)
proof:
:= by
  let a := cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f z f
  let b := cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f (fun _ => 3) f
  have habs : |a| ≤ b := cyclicWeightedSumAux_abs_le_const_three f z (fun i => by
    rcases hz i with hi | hi <;> simp [hi]) f
  have hadiv : (3 : Int) ∣ a :=
    three_dvd_cyclicWeightedSumAux_of_eq_three_or_neg_three f z hz f
  have hb := cyclicWeightedSumAux_const_three f f
  have hman : manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 f z = 3 * a := by
    rfl
  constructor
  · rcases hadiv with ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    rw [hman, hc]
    ring
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    have haZero : a = 0 := by omega
    have hfpos : 1 ≤ f := by omega
    have hfsucc : f = (f - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hprevDiv :=
      three_dvd_cyclicWeightedSumAux_of_eq_three_or_neg_three f z hz (f - 1)
    rcases hprevDiv with ⟨c, hc⟩
    have haRec : cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f z f =
        3 * cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f z (f - 1) + z ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
      calc
        cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f z f =
            cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f z ((f - 1) + 1) := by
              exact congrArg (fun k => cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f z k) hfsucc
        _ = 3 * cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f z (f - 1) +
            z ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
              rw [cyclicWeightedSumAux]
              norm_num
    change cyclicWeightedSumAux 3 f z f = 0 at haZero
    rcases hz ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) with hlast | hlast
    · rw [haRec, hc, hlast] at haZero
      omega
    · rw [haRec, hc, hlast] at haZero
      omega
  · rw [hman, abs_mul]
    norm_num
    nlinarith

name: KLSposet.threePowerPlusOne_not_dvd_two_signedThreeWeightedSum
proof:
:= by
  intro hdvd
  rcases signedThreeManuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_properties hf z hz with
    ⟨hnine, hne, hbound⟩
  rcases hdvd with ⟨c, hc⟩
  rcases hnine with ⟨d, hd⟩
  have hpow : (3 : Int) ^ f = 9 * (3 : Int) ^ (f - 2) := by
    rw [show f = 2 + (f - 2) by omega, pow_add]
    norm_num
  have hcNine : (9 : Int) ∣ c := by
    refine ⟨2 * d - (3 : Int) ^ (f - 2) * c, ?_⟩
    rw [hd, hpow] at hc
    nlinarith
  have hcAbs : |c| < 9 := by
    have hqpos : 0 < (3 : Int) ^ f + 1 := by positivity
    have habsEq : |2 * manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 f z| =
        ((3 : Int) ^ f + 1) * |c| := by
      rw [hc, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hqpos]
    have hstrict : 9 * ((3 : Int) ^ f - 1) <
        9 * ((3 : Int) ^ f + 1) := by nlinarith
    have htwo : |2 * manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 f z| =
        2 * |manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 f z| := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      norm_num
    rw [← htwo, habsEq] at hbound
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg c]
  rcases hcNine with ⟨e, rfl⟩
  have : e = 0 := by
    rw [abs_mul] at hcAbs
    norm_num at hcAbs
    have := abs_nonneg e
    omega
  subst e
  simp at hc
  exact hne (by omega)

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoSignedCoordinates_antiPeriodic
statement:
theorem niveauTwoSignedCoordinates_antiPeriodic {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    ∀ i, niveauTwoSignedCoordinates hf sigma K hK (i + f) =
      -niveauTwoSignedCoordinates hf sigma K hK i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have hperiodic : sigma.periodicU hf (i + f) = sigma.periodicU hf i := by
    simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU]
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
    simp
  have hsign :
      (Profile.niveauTwo (f := f) K hK).sign (i + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) =
        -(Profile.niveauTwo (f := f) K hK).sign i := by
    classical
    by_cases hi : i ∈ K
    · have hif : i + f ∉ K := (hK i).mp hi
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hif]
    · have hif : i + f ∈ K := by
        by_contra hnot
        exact hi ((hK i).mpr hnot)
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hif]
  simp only [niveauTwoSignedCoordinates, hperiodic]
  rw [hsign]
  ring

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoSignedCoordinates_firstHalf_eq_three_or_neg_three
statement:
theorem niveauTwoSignedCoordinates_firstHalf_eq_three_or_neg_three {f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight 3 f) (hu : ∀ i, sigma.u i = 3)
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    ∀ i, firstHalfCoordinates hf (niveauTwoSignedCoordinates hf sigma K hK) i = 3 ∨
      firstHalfCoordinates hf (niveauTwoSignedCoordinates hf sigma K hK) i = -3
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  intro i
  classical
  by_cases hi : (i.val : ZMod (2 * f)) ∈ K
  · right
    simp only [firstHalfCoordinates, niveauTwoSignedCoordinates, Profile.sign,
      Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set]
    rw [if_pos hi]
    simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hu]
  · left
    simp only [firstHalfCoordinates, niveauTwoSignedCoordinates, Profile.sign,
      Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set]
    rw [if_neg hi]
    simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hu]

name: KLSposet.crossNiveauExceptionalProfiles_ne_of_pair_eq
statement:
theorem crossNiveauExceptionalProfiles_ne_of_pair_eq {f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem 3 f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f) (hu' : ∀ i, sigma'.u i = 3)
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) ≠
      profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)
proof:
:= by
  intro hpair
  have hcross := crossNiveauProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq
    (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma' J K hK hpair
  have hKzero : reduceNiveauTwoExponentToQPlusOne f
      (niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (reduceNiveauTwoExponentToQPlusOne f) hcross.1
    simp only [map_add, reduceNiveauTwoExponentToQPlusOne_liftQPlusOne,
      zero_add] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hKcZero : reduceNiveauTwoExponentToQPlusOne f
      (niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (reduceNiveauTwoExponentToQPlusOne f) hcross.2
    simp only [map_add, reduceNiveauTwoExponentToQPlusOne_liftQPlusOne,
      zero_add] at h
    exact h.symm
  let y := niveauTwoSignedCoordinates hf sigma' K hK
  have hred : reduceNiveauTwoExponentToQPlusOne f
      (translationExponent 3 (2 * f) (by omega) y) = 0 := by
    have hsigned := translationExponent_niveauTwo_signed hf sigma' K hK
    change translationExponent 3 (2 * f) (by omega) y =
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ - niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K at hsigned
    rw [hsigned, map_sub, hKcZero, hKzero, sub_zero]
  have hmod :
      ((manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 (2 * f) y : Int) : ZMod (3 ^ f + 1)) = 0 := by
    calc
      ((manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 (2 * f) y : Int) : ZMod (3 ^ f + 1)) =
          reduceNiveauTwoExponentToQPlusOne f
            ((manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 (2 * f) y : Int) :
              ZMod (3 ^ (2 * f) - 1)) := by rw [map_intCast]
      _ = reduceNiveauTwoExponentToQPlusOne f
          (translationExponent 3 (2 * f) (by omega) y) := by
        rw [manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_cast (by omega) y]
      _ = 0 := hred
  have hdiv : ((3 : Int) ^ f + 1) ∣ manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 (2 * f) y := by
    have hnat := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd
      (manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 (2 * f) y) (3 ^ f + 1)).mp hmod
    norm_num at hnat ⊢
    exact hnat
  let z := firstHalfCoordinates hf y
  have hanti : manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 (2 * f) y =
      ((3 : Int) ^ f - 1) * manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 f z :=
    manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_antiPeriodic hf y
      (niveauTwoSignedCoordinates_antiPeriodic hf sigma' K hK)
  have htwo : ((3 : Int) ^ f + 1) ∣
      2 * manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 f z := by
    rcases hdiv with ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum 3 f z - c, ?_⟩
    rw [hanti] at hc
    nlinarith
  exact threePowerPlusOne_not_dvd_two_signedThreeWeightedSum hf z
    (niveauTwoSignedCoordinates_firstHalf_eq_three_or_neg_three
      hf sigma' hu' K hK) htwo

name: KLSposet.niveauOneExceptionalCanonicalExponents
statement:
theorem niveauOneExceptionalCanonicalExponents {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f)
    (hu : ∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) (hu' : ∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3)
    (ht : sigma'.t - sigma.t =
      (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1))) :
    profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne Set.univ) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauOne ∅)
proof:
:= by
  have hfull := niveauOneProfileSum_all_three_univ f hf sigma hu
  have hfull' := niveauOneProfileSum_all_three_univ f hf sigma' hu'
  have hneg := threePowerHalf_neg f
  have hempty (tau : PhantomWeight 3 f) :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf tau ∅ = 0 := by
    simp [niveauOneProfileSum]
  change OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
      (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ)
      (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma (Set.univ : Set (ZMod f))ᶜ) =
    OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
      (sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' ∅)
      (sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' (∅ : Set (ZMod f))ᶜ)
  simp only [Set.compl_univ, Set.compl_empty]
  rw [hfull, hfull', hempty sigma, hempty sigma']
  simp only [add_zero]
  congr 1
  · rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at ht
    simpa [add_comm] using ht.symm
  · rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at ht
    have hdouble :
        (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) +
            (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) = 0 := by
      rw [← neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, hneg]
    rw [ht]
    calc
      sigma.t = sigma.t + 0 := by simp
      _ = sigma.t +
          ((((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) +
            (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1))) := by rw [hdouble]
      _ = (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) + sigma.t +
          (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) := by ring

name: KLSposet.niveauOneExceptionalCanonicalCarry
statement:
theorem niveauOneExceptionalCanonicalCarry {f : Nat}
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f)
    (hu : ∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) (hu' : ∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3) :
    CarryEquation 3 (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' Set.univ ∅)
      (fun _ : ZMod f => 3)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
    Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hu i, hu' i]

name: KLSposet.niveauOneExceptionalProfiles
statement:
theorem niveauOneExceptionalProfiles {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f)
    (hu : ∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) (hu' : ∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3)
    (ht : sigma'.t - sigma.t =
      (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)))
    (J J' : Set (ZMod f))
    (hExp : profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauOne J')) :
    ((∀ k, k ∈ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∉ J') ∨
      ((∀ k, k ∉ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∈ J')
proof:
:= by
  have hcanonical :=
    niveauOneExceptionalCanonicalExponents hf sigma sigma' hu hu' ht
  have hxcanonical := niveauOneExceptionalCanonicalCarry sigma sigma' hu hu'
  rcases niveauOneCarryEquation_existsUnique (by omega) hf sigma sigma' J J' hExp with
    ⟨x, hx, _⟩
  have hparity : ∀ i, Even ((3 : Int) - x i) := by
    exact niveauOneCarryEquation_sameParity (by omega) hf sigma sigma'
      Set.univ ∅ J J' hcanonical hExp hxcanonical hx
  have hbound : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 3 := by
    exact carryEquation_abs_le_three (by omega) (by omega)
      (niveauOneCarryInput_abs_le sigma sigma' J J') hx
  have hboundary : ∃ i, |x i| = 3 := by
    by_contra hnone
    push_neg at hnone
    have hone (i : ZMod f) : x i = -1 ∨ x i = 1 := by
      rcases hparity i with ⟨c, hc⟩
      rcases abs_le.mp (hbound i) with ⟨hlower, hupper⟩
      have hnepos : x i ≠ 3 := by
        intro hi
        apply hnone i
        simp [hi]
      have hneneg : x i ≠ -3 := by
        intro hi
        apply hnone i
        simp [hi]
      omega
    have hy (i : ZMod f) :
        niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J' i = -6 ∨
          niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J' i = 0 ∨
          niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J J' i = 6 := by
      classical
      by_cases hi : i ∈ J <;> by_cases hi' : i ∈ J' <;>
        simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
          Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hi', hu i, hu' i]
    have hrec := hx 0
    rcases hone ((0 : ZMod f) - 1) with hprev | hprev <;>
      rcases hone 0 with hzero | hzero <;>
      rcases hy 0 with hinput | hinput | hinput <;> omega
  rcases hboundary with ⟨i, hi⟩
  rcases niveauOneCarryEquation_boundary_classification (by omega)
      sigma sigma' J J' hx i hi with hpos | hneg
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hpos.2.2.2.1, hpos.2.2.2.2⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨hneg.2.2.2.1, hneg.2.2.2.2⟩

name: KLSposet.niveauOneExceptionalProfiles_of_pair_eq
statement:
theorem niveauOneExceptionalProfiles_of_pair_eq {f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem 3 f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f)
    (hu : ∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) (hu' : ∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3)
    (ht : sigma'.t - sigma.t =
      (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)))
    (J J' : Set (ZMod f))
    (h : profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne J')) :
    ((∀ k, k ∈ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∉ J') ∨
      ((∀ k, k ∉ J) ∧ ∀ k, k ∈ J')
proof:
:= by
  apply niveauOneExceptionalProfiles hf sigma sigma' hu hu' ht J J'
  exact niveauOneProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq (by omega) hf chars
    sigma sigma' J J' h

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoExceptionalProfiles_ne
statement:
theorem niveauTwoExceptionalProfiles_ne {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f)
    (hu : ∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) (hu' : ∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3)
    (ht : sigma'.t - sigma.t =
      (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)))
    (K K' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) (hK' : ∀ i, i ∈ K' ↔ i + f ∉ K') :
    profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauTwo K hK) ≠
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauTwo K' hK')
proof:
:= by
  intro hExp
  have hcanonical :=
    niveauOneExceptionalCanonicalExponents hf sigma sigma' hu hu' ht
  have hxcanonical := niveauOneExceptionalCanonicalCarry sigma sigma' hu hu'
  rcases niveauTwoCarryEquation_existsUnique (by omega) hf sigma sigma' K K' hK hK'
      hExp with ⟨x, hx, _⟩
  have hparity : ∀ i, Even ((3 : Int) - x i) := by
    exact crossNiveauCarryEquation_sameParity (by omega) hf sigma sigma'
      Set.univ ∅ K K' hK hK' hcanonical hExp hxcanonical hx
  have hbound : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 2 :=
    niveauTwoCarryEquation_abs_le_two hf sigma sigma' K K' hK hK' hx
  have hone (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : x i = -1 ∨ x i = 1 := by
    rcases hparity i with ⟨c, hc⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp (hbound i) with ⟨hlower, hupper⟩
    omega
  have hy (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
      niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' K K' hK hK' i = -6 ∨
        niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' K K' hK hK' i = 0 ∨
        niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' K K' hK hK' i = 6 := by
    classical
    by_cases hi : i ∈ K <;> by_cases hi' : i ∈ K' <;>
      simp [niveauTwoCarryInput, PhantomWeight.periodicU, Profile.sign,
        Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hi',
        hu (periodicIndex hf i), hu' (periodicIndex hf i)]
  have hrec := hx 0
