  rcases hone ((0 : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1) with hprev | hprev <;>
    rcases hone 0 with hzero | hzero <;>
    rcases hy 0 with hinput | hinput | hinput <;> omega

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoExceptionalProfiles_ne_of_pair_eq
statement:
theorem niveauTwoExceptionalProfiles_ne_of_pair_eq {f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem 3 f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f)
    (hu : ∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) (hu' : ∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3)
    (ht : sigma'.t - sigma.t =
      (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)))
    (K K' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) (hK' : ∀ i, i ∈ K' ↔ i + f ∉ K') :
    profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo K hK) ≠
      profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo K' hK')
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply niveauTwoExceptionalProfiles_ne hf sigma sigma' hu hu' ht K K' hK hK'
  exact niveauTwoProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq (by omega) hf chars
    sigma sigma' K K' hK hK' h

name: KLSposet.exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable
statement:
theorem exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable {f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem 3 f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight 3 f)
    (hu : ∀ k, sigma.u k = 3) (hu' : ∀ k, sigma'.u k = 3)
    (ht : sigma'.t - sigma.t =
      (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1))) :
    ¬ semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma' ∧
      ¬ semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma' ⊆
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Nontrivial (ZMod f) := ZMod.nontrivial_iff.mpr (by omega)
  let J : Set (ZMod f) := {0}
  have hJnotAll : ¬ ∀ k, k ∈ J := by
    intro h
    have hone := h 1
    simp [J] at hone
  have hJnotNone : ¬ ∀ k, k ∉ J := by
    intro h
    exact h 0 (by simp [J])
  have htrev : sigma.t - sigma'.t =
      (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) := by
    calc
      sigma.t - sigma'.t = -(sigma'.t - sigma.t) := by ring
      _ = -(((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) := by rw [ht]
      _ = (((3 ^ f - 1) / 2 : Nat) : ZMod (3 ^ f - 1)) := threePowerHalf_neg f
  constructor
  · intro hsubset
    let rho := profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J)
    have hrho : rho ∈ semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma :=
      (mem_semisimpleCharacterSet_iff (by omega) hf chars sigma rho).mpr
        ⟨.niveauOne J, rfl⟩
    rcases (mem_semisimpleCharacterSet_iff (by omega) hf chars sigma' rho).mp
      (hsubset hrho) with ⟨P, hP⟩
    cases P with
    | niveauOne J' =>
        have hclass := niveauOneExceptionalProfiles_of_pair_eq hf chars
          sigma sigma' hu hu' ht J J' hP.symm
        rcases hclass with hclass | hclass
        · exact hJnotAll hclass.1
        · exact hJnotNone hclass.1
    | niveauTwo K hK =>
        exact crossNiveauExceptionalProfiles_ne_of_pair_eq hf chars
          sigma sigma' hu' J K hK hP.symm
  · intro hsubset
    let rho := profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne J)
    have hrho : rho ∈ semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma' :=
      (mem_semisimpleCharacterSet_iff (by omega) hf chars sigma' rho).mpr
        ⟨.niveauOne J, rfl⟩
    rcases (mem_semisimpleCharacterSet_iff (by omega) hf chars sigma rho).mp
      (hsubset hrho) with ⟨P, hP⟩
    cases P with
    | niveauOne J' =>
        have hclass := niveauOneExceptionalProfiles_of_pair_eq hf chars
          sigma' sigma hu' hu htrev J J' hP.symm
        rcases hclass with hclass | hclass
        · exact hJnotAll hclass.1
        · exact hJnotNone hclass.1
    | niveauTwo K hK =>
        exact crossNiveauExceptionalProfiles_ne_of_pair_eq hf chars
          sigma' sigma hu J K hK hP.symm

name: KLSposet.carryEquation_abs_at_max_le_one
statement:
theorem carryEquation_abs_at_max_le_one {p n : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p)
    {y x : ZMod n → Int} (hy : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ (p : Int))
    (hx : CarryEquation p y x) (i : ZMod n)
    (hmax : ∀ j, |x j| ≤ |x i|) : |x i| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := hx (i + 1)
  have hindex : i + 1 - 1 = i := by ring
  rw [hindex] at hrec
  have hpnonneg : (0 : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := Int.natCast_nonneg p
  have hbound : (p : Int) * |x i| ≤ (p : Int) + |x i| := by
    calc
      (p : Int) * |x i| = |(p : Int)| * |x i| := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hpnonneg]
      _ = |(p : Int) * x i| := (abs_mul _ _).symm
      _ = |y (i + 1) + x (i + 1)| := by
        congr 1
        linarith
      _ ≤ |y (i + 1)| + |x (i + 1)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (p : Int) + |x i| :=
        add_le_add (hy (i + 1)) (hmax (i + 1))
  by_contra hnot
  have hlarge : (2 : Int) ≤ |x i| := by omega
  have hpcast : (3 : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  nlinarith [abs_nonneg (x i)]

name: KLSposet.carryEquation_abs_le_one
statement:
theorem carryEquation_abs_le_one {p n : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {y x : ZMod n → Int} (hy : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ (p : Int))
    (hx : CarryEquation p y x) : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  let values : Finset Int := Finset.univ.image fun i : ZMod n ↦ |x i|
  have hvalues : values.Nonempty := by
    exact Finset.image_nonempty.mpr Finset.univ_nonempty
  let maximum : Int := values.max' hvalues
  have hmaximum_mem : maximum ∈ values := Finset.max'_mem values hvalues
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hmaximum_mem with ⟨imax, _, himax⟩
  have hmax : ∀ j, |x j| ≤ |x imax| := by
    intro j
    have hjmem : |x j| ∈ values := by
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, rfl⟩
    have hjle : |x j| ≤ maximum := Finset.le_max' values _ hjmem
    simpa [himax] using hjle
  have himax_le : |x imax| ≤ 1 :=
    carryEquation_abs_at_max_le_one hp hy hx imax hmax
  intro i
  exact le_trans (hmax i) himax_le

name: KLSposet.boundedCyclicCarry_existsUnique_of_translationExponent_eq_zero
statement:
theorem boundedCyclicCarry_existsUnique_of_translationExponent_eq_zero
    {p n : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hn : 2 ≤ n) {y : ZMod n → Int}
    (hzero : translationExponent p n hn y = 0)
    (hy : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ (p : Int)) :
    ∃! x : ZMod n → Int,
      CarryEquation p y x ∧ ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases carryEquation_existsUnique_of_translationExponent_eq_zero
      (by omega : 2 ≤ p) hn hzero with ⟨x, hx, hUnique⟩
  refine ⟨x, ⟨hx, carryEquation_abs_le_one hp (by omega) hy hx⟩, ?_⟩
  intro x' hx'
  exact hUnique x' hx'.1

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileSum_eq_compl_of_scalar
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_eq_compl_of_scalar {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hscalar : (profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J)).IsScalar) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J = niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ
proof:
:= by
  have hchar := hscalar
  rw [profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents] at hchar
  change niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
      (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) =
    niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
      (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) at hchar
  have hexp : sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J =
      sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ := by
    apply chars.niveauOneExactOrder
    simpa [niveauOneExponentCharacter] using hchar
  exact add_left_cancel hexp

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoProfileSum_eq_compl_of_scalar
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_eq_compl_of_scalar {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hscalar : (profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ)).IsScalar) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J = niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ
proof:
:= by
  have hchar := hscalar
  rw [profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents] at hchar
  change niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars
      (liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J) =
    niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars
      (liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) at hchar
  have hexp : liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J =
      liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ := by
    apply chars.niveauTwo_exactOrder
    simpa [niveauTwoExponentCharacter] using hchar
  exact add_left_cancel hexp

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoScalarCarryInput_congr
statement:
theorem niveauTwoScalarCarryInput_congr {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) (h : J = K) :
    niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma J hJ =
      niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma K hK
proof:
:= by
  subst K
  rfl

name: KLSposet.translationExponent_niveauOneScalarCarryInput_eq_zero
statement:
theorem translationExponent_niveauOneScalarCarryInput_eq_zero {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hscalar : (profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J)).IsScalar) :
    translationExponent p f hf (niveauOneScalarCarryInput sigma J) = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    translationExponent p f hf (niveauOneScalarCarryInput sigma J) =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ - niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J := by
      simpa [niveauOneScalarCarryInput] using
        translationExponent_niveauOne_signed hf sigma J
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [niveauOneProfileSum_eq_compl_of_scalar hp hf chars sigma J hscalar]
      exact sub_self _

name: KLSposet.translationExponent_niveauTwoScalarCarryInput_eq_zero
statement:
theorem translationExponent_niveauTwoScalarCarryInput_eq_zero {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hscalar : (profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ)).IsScalar) :
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega)
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma J hJ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega)
        (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma J hJ) =
        niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ - niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J := by
      simpa [niveauTwoScalarCarryInput] using
        translationExponent_niveauTwo_signed hf sigma J hJ
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [niveauTwoProfileSum_eq_compl_of_scalar hp hf chars sigma J hJ hscalar]
      exact sub_self _

name: KLSposet.niveauOneScalarCarryInput_abs_le
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  simp only [niveauOneScalarCarryInput, abs_mul, Profile.abs_sign, one_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg (sigma.u i))]
  exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le i

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoScalarCarryInput_abs_le
statement:
theorem niveauTwoScalarCarryInput_abs_le {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) :
    ∀ i, |niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma J hJ i| ≤ (p : Int)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  simp only [niveauTwoScalarCarryInput, abs_mul, Profile.abs_sign, one_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg (sigma.periodicU hf i))]
  exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le (periodicIndex hf i)

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoScalarCarryInput_antiPeriodic
statement:
theorem niveauTwoScalarCarryInput_antiPeriodic {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) :
    ∀ i, niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma J hJ (i + f) =
      -niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma J hJ i
proof:
:= by
  have h := niveauTwoCarryInput_antiPeriodic hf
    (PhantomWeight.unramified p f 0) sigma J J hJ hJ
  simpa [niveauTwoCarryInput, niveauTwoScalarCarryInput,
    PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.unramified, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] using h

name: KLSposet.niveauOneScalarCarry
statement:
theorem niveauOneScalarCarry {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hscalar : (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J)).IsScalar) :
    ∃! y : ZMod f → Int,
      CarryEquation p (niveauOneScalarCarryInput sigma J) y ∧
        ∀ i, |y i| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases carryEquation_existsUnique_of_translationExponent_eq_zero
      (by omega) hf
      (translationExponent_niveauOneScalarCarryInput_eq_zero
        (by omega) hf chars sigma J hscalar) with ⟨y, hy, hyuniq⟩
  refine ⟨y, ⟨hy, carryEquation_abs_le_one hp (by omega)
    (niveauOneScalarCarryInput_abs_le sigma J) hy⟩, ?_⟩
  intro y' hy'
  exact hyuniq y' hy'.1

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoScalarCarry
statement:
theorem niveauTwoScalarCarry {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hscalar : (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ)).IsScalar) :
    ∃! y : ZMod (2 * f) → Int,
      CarryEquation p (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma J hJ) y ∧
        (∀ i, y (i + f) = -y i) ∧ ∀ i, |y i| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases carryEquation_existsUnique_of_translationExponent_eq_zero
      (by omega) (by omega)
      (translationExponent_niveauTwoScalarCarryInput_eq_zero
        (by omega) hf chars sigma J hJ hscalar) with ⟨y, hy, hyuniq⟩
  refine ⟨y, ⟨hy, carryEquation_antiPeriodic (by omega) (by omega)
    (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput_antiPeriodic hf sigma J hJ) hy,
    carryEquation_abs_le_one hp (by omega)
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput_abs_le hf sigma J hJ) hy⟩, ?_⟩
  intro y' hy'
  exact hyuniq y' hy'.1

name: KLSposet.cyclicFunction_eq_const_of_pred_eq
statement:
theorem cyclicFunction_eq_const_of_pred_eq {n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {y : ZMod n → Int} (h : ∀ i, y (i - 1) = y i) : ∀ i, y i = y 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  intro i
  rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_val i]
  induction i.val with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [← h ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod n)]
      convert ih using 1
      push_cast
      ring_nf

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoScalarCarry_has_zero
statement:
theorem niveauTwoScalarCarry_has_zero {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) {y : ZMod (2 * f) → Int}
    (hy : CarryEquation p (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma J hJ) y)
    (hyAnti : ∀ i, y (i + f) = -y i)
    (hyBound : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ 1) :
    ∃ i, y i = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hzero
  push_neg at hzero
  have hpred : ∀ i, y (i - 1) = y i := by
    intro i
    have heq := hy i
    have hinput := niveauTwoScalarCarryInput_abs_le hf sigma J hJ i
    have hiRange := abs_le.mp (hyBound i)
    have hprevRange := abs_le.mp (hyBound (i - 1))
    have hiNonzero := hzero i
    have hprevNonzero := hzero (i - 1)
    have hiCases : y i = -1 ∨ y i = 1 := by omega
    have hprevCases : y (i - 1) = -1 ∨ y (i - 1) = 1 := by omega
    rcases hprevCases with hprev | hprev <;>
        rcases hiCases with hcurrent | hcurrent
    · rw [hprev, hcurrent]
    · rw [hprev, hcurrent] at heq ⊢
      rw [heq] at hinput
      have hcalc : (p : Int) * -1 - 1 = -(p : Int) - 1 := by ring
      rw [hcalc] at hinput
      have : |-(p : Int) - 1| = (p : Int) + 1 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonpos] <;> omega
      rw [this] at hinput
      omega
    · rw [hprev, hcurrent] at heq ⊢
      rw [heq] at hinput
      have hcalc : (p : Int) * 1 - -1 = (p : Int) + 1 := by ring
      rw [hcalc] at hinput
      have : |(p : Int) + 1| = (p : Int) + 1 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (by omega)]
      rw [this] at hinput
      omega
    · rw [hprev, hcurrent]
  have hconstant := cyclicFunction_eq_const_of_pred_eq (by omega) hpred
  have hanti := hyAnti 0
  rw [hconstant (0 + f), hconstant 0] at hanti
  exact hzero 0 (by omega)

name: KLSposet.niveauOneScalarCarry_has_zero_of_ne_critical
statement:
theorem niveauOneScalarCarry_has_zero_of_ne_critical {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f)) {y : ZMod f → Int}
    (hy : CarryEquation p (niveauOneScalarCarryInput sigma J) y)
    (hyBound : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ 1)
    (hcritical : sigma ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma.t) :
    ∃ i, y i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hzero
  push_neg at hzero
  have hcoordinates : ∀ i, sigma.u i = p - 1 ∧ y (i - 1) = y i := by
    intro i
    have heq := hy i
    have hiBound := hyBound i
    have hprevBound := hyBound (i - 1)
    have hiNonzero := hzero i
    have hprevNonzero := hzero (i - 1)
    have hui := sigma.u_le i
    have hiRange := abs_le.mp hiBound
    have hprevRange := abs_le.mp hprevBound
    have hiCases : y i = -1 ∨ y i = 1 := by omega
    have hprevCases : y (i - 1) = -1 ∨ y (i - 1) = 1 := by omega
    by_cases hi : i ∈ J
    · simp [niveauOneScalarCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
        Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi] at heq
      rcases hprevCases with hprev | hprev <;>
          rcases hiCases with hcurrent | hcurrent <;>
          rw [hprev, hcurrent] at heq <;>
          constructor <;> omega
    · simp [niveauOneScalarCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
        Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi] at heq
      rcases hprevCases with hprev | hprev <;>
          rcases hiCases with hcurrent | hcurrent <;>
          rw [hprev, hcurrent] at heq <;>
          constructor <;> omega
  apply hcritical
  apply PhantomWeight.ext
  · funext i
    simpa [PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] using (hcoordinates i).1
  · rfl

name: KLSposet.doubledAddHalf_val
statement:
theorem doubledAddHalf_val {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    (i + f).val = if i.val < f then i.val + f else i.val - f
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hilt : i.val < 2 * f := ZMod.val_lt i
  simpa only [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] using
    (show (((i.val : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) + f).val =
      if i.val < f then i.val + f else i.val - f from by
        simp only [ZMod.val_add,
          ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (ZMod.val_lt i),
          ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (by omega : f < 2 * f)]
        split_ifs with hhalf
        · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
          omega
        · rw [Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod (by omega : 2 * f ≤ i.val + f)]
          have heq : i.val + f - 2 * f = i.val - f := by omega
          rw [heq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
          omega)

name: KLSposet.doubledSheetSign_sub_one_eq_of_periodicIndex_ne_zero
statement:
theorem doubledSheetSign_sub_one_eq_of_periodicIndex_ne_zero {f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (i : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hperiodic : periodicIndex hf i ≠ 0) :
    doubledSheetSign (i - 1) = doubledSheetSign i
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hilt : i.val < 2 * f := ZMod.val_lt i
  have hine : i.val ≠ 0 := by
    intro hi
    apply hperiodic
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_val i]
    simp [hi, periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
  have hsub :
      ((i.val : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 =
        ((i.val - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ i.val)]
    norm_num
  rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_val i]
  rw [hsub]
  simp only [doubledSheetSign,
    ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hilt,
    ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (by omega : i.val - 1 < 2 * f)]
  by_cases hhalf : i.val < f
  · rw [if_pos hhalf, if_pos (by omega : i.val - 1 < f)]
  · by_cases hseam : i.val = f
    · exfalso
      apply hperiodic
      rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_val i]
      simp [hseam, periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
    · rw [if_neg hhalf, if_neg (by omega : ¬i.val - 1 < f)]

name: KLSposet.shiftedFirstLift_sub_val
statement:
theorem shiftedFirstLift_sub_val {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (j : ZMod f) :
    (shiftedFirstLift hf a j - a).val =
      (j - periodicIndex hf a).val
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hlt : (j - periodicIndex hf a).val < 2 * f := by
    have := ZMod.val_lt (j - periodicIndex hf a)
    omega
  rw [shiftedFirstLift]
  have hsub :
      a + (((j - periodicIndex hf a).val : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - a =
        ((j - periodicIndex hf a).val : Nat) := by ring
  rw [hsub, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hlt]

name: KLSposet.periodicIndex_shiftedFirstLift
statement:
theorem periodicIndex_shiftedFirstLift {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (j : ZMod f) :
    periodicIndex hf (shiftedFirstLift hf a j) = j
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, shiftedFirstLift, map_add, map_natCast,
    ← periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf a]
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
  ring

name: KLSposet.shiftedFirstLift_periodicIndex_eq
statement:
theorem shiftedFirstLift_periodicIndex_eq {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (a i : ZMod (2 * f)) (hi : (i - a).val < f) :
    shiftedFirstLift hf a (periodicIndex hf i) = i
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hperiodic :
      periodicIndex hf i - periodicIndex hf a = periodicIndex hf (i - a) := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom,
      periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
    simp
  have hval :
      (periodicIndex hf i - periodicIndex hf a).val = (i - a).val := by
    rw [hperiodic]
    change (((i - a).val : Nat) : ZMod f).val = (i - a).val
    exact ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hi
  rw [shiftedFirstLift, hval]
  rw [show (((i - a).val : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) = i - a by
    exact ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (i - a)]
  ring

name: KLSposet.mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) (a i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    i ∈ shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a ↔
      if (i - a).val < f then periodicIndex hf i ∈ J
      else periodicIndex hf i ∉ J
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: KLSposet.shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary
statement:
theorem shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) (a : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    ∀ i, i ∈ shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a ↔
      i + f ∉ shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  intro i
  have hperiodic : periodicIndex hf (i + f) = periodicIndex hf i := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
    simp
  have hindex : i + f - a = (i - a) + f := by ring
  have hval := doubledAddHalf_val hf (i - a)
  by_cases hhalf : (i - a).val < f
  · have hshift : ¬(i + f - a).val < f := by
      rw [hindex, hval, if_pos hhalf]
      omega
    simp [shiftedNiveauTwoSet, hhalf, hshift, hperiodic]
  · have hshift : (i + f - a).val < f := by
      rw [hindex, hval, if_neg hhalf]
      have hlt := ZMod.val_lt (i - a)
      omega
    simp [shiftedNiveauTwoSet, hhalf, hshift, hperiodic]

name: KLSposet.shiftedNiveauTwoSet_niveauOneSetAtShift
statement:
theorem shiftedNiveauTwoSet_niveauOneSetAtShift {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K)
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf (niveauOneSetAtShift hf K a) a = K
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  ext i
  by_cases hhalf : (i - a).val < f
  · simp only [mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet, hhalf, if_true,
      niveauOneSetAtShift, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [shiftedFirstLift_periodicIndex_eq hf a i hhalf]
  · have hindex : i + f - a = (i - a) + f := by ring
    have hshift : (i + f - a).val < f := by
      rw [hindex, doubledAddHalf_val hf, if_neg hhalf]
      have hlt := ZMod.val_lt (i - a)
      omega
    have hlift := shiftedFirstLift_periodicIndex_eq hf a (i + f) hshift
    rw [periodicIndex_add_half hf] at hlift
    simp only [mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet, hhalf, if_false,
      niveauOneSetAtShift, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    rw [hlift]
    exact (hK i).symm

name: KLSposet.shiftedNiveauTwoSet_sign
statement:
theorem shiftedNiveauTwoSet_sign {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) (a i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    (Profile.niveauTwo (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a)
      (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf J a)).sign i =
      shiftedDoubledSheetSign a i *
        (Profile.niveauOne J).sign (periodicIndex hf i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hhalf : (i - a).val < f
  · by_cases hmem : periodicIndex hf i ∈ J
    · have hiK : i ∈ shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a :=
        (mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a i).2 (if_pos hhalf ▸ hmem)
      simp [shiftedDoubledSheetSign, doubledSheetSign,
        Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        hiK, hhalf, hmem]
    · have hiK : i ∉ shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a := by
        rw [mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet, if_pos hhalf]
        exact hmem
      simp [shiftedDoubledSheetSign, doubledSheetSign,
        Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        hiK, hhalf, hmem]
  · by_cases hmem : periodicIndex hf i ∈ J
    · have hiK : i ∉ shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a := by
        rw [mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet, if_neg hhalf]
        simp [hmem]
      simp [shiftedDoubledSheetSign, doubledSheetSign,
        Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        hiK, hhalf, hmem]
    · have hiK : i ∈ shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a := by
        rw [mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet, if_neg hhalf]
        exact hmem
      simp [shiftedDoubledSheetSign, doubledSheetSign,
        Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        hiK, hhalf, hmem]

name: KLSposet.shiftedNiveauTwoScalarCarryInput
statement:
theorem shiftedNiveauTwoScalarCarryInput {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (a i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a)
        (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf J a) i =
      shiftedDoubledSheetSign a i *
        niveauOneScalarCarryInput sigma J (periodicIndex hf i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauTwoScalarCarryInput, shiftedNiveauTwoSet_sign]
  simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, niveauOneScalarCarryInput]
  ring

name: KLSposet.shiftedDoubledSheetSign_sub_one_eq_of_periodicIndex_ne
statement:
theorem shiftedDoubledSheetSign_sub_one_eq_of_periodicIndex_ne {f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (a i : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hperiodic : periodicIndex hf i ≠ periodicIndex hf a) :
    shiftedDoubledSheetSign a (i - 1) =
      shiftedDoubledSheetSign a i
proof:
:= by
  have hindex : i - 1 - a = (i - a) - 1 := by ring
  simp only [shiftedDoubledSheetSign, hindex]
  apply doubledSheetSign_sub_one_eq_of_periodicIndex_ne_zero hf
  have hreduce : periodicIndex hf (i - a) =
      periodicIndex hf i - periodicIndex hf a := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom,
      periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
    simp
  rw [hreduce]
  exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hperiodic

name: KLSposet.shiftedDoubledCarry_carryEquation
statement:
theorem shiftedDoubledCarry_carryEquation {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (y : ZMod f → Int)
    (hy : CarryEquation p (niveauOneScalarCarryInput sigma J) y)
    (hyzero : y (periodicIndex hf a - 1) = 0) :
    CarryEquation p
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a)
        (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf J a))
      (shiftedDoubledCarry hf a y)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  rw [shiftedNiveauTwoScalarCarryInput]
  rw [hy (periodicIndex hf i)]
  simp only [shiftedDoubledCarry, periodicIndex_sub_one]
  have hpred :
      shiftedDoubledSheetSign a (i - 1) *
          y (periodicIndex hf i - 1) =
        shiftedDoubledSheetSign a i * y (periodicIndex hf i - 1) := by
    by_cases hperiodic : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf a
    · rw [hperiodic, hyzero]
      ring
    · rw [shiftedDoubledSheetSign_sub_one_eq_of_periodicIndex_ne
        hf a i hperiodic]
  rw [hpred]
  ring

name: KLSposet.periodicIndex_lift_succ_sub_one
statement:
theorem periodicIndex_lift_succ_sub_one {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (z : ZMod f) :
    periodicIndex hf (((z.val + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) - 1 = z
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
  simp only [map_natCast]
  change ((z.val + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) - 1 = z
  simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_sub_cancel_right] using
    ZMod.natCast_zmod_val z

name: KLSposet.niveauOneScalarCarry_zero_splice
statement:
theorem niveauOneScalarCarry_zero_splice {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (y : ZMod f → Int)
    (hy : CarryEquation p (niveauOneScalarCarryInput sigma J) y)
    (z : ZMod f) (hyzero : y z = 0) :
    CarryEquation p
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma
        (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J
          ((z.val + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))
        (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf J
          ((z.val + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))))
      (shiftedDoubledCarry hf
        ((z.val + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) y)
proof:
:= by
  apply shiftedDoubledCarry_carryEquation hf sigma J
    ((z.val + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) y hy
  rw [periodicIndex_lift_succ_sub_one hf z]
  exact hyzero

name: KLSposet.translationExponent_eq_zero_of_carryEquation
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  rw [translationExponent]
  calc
    (∑ i, (y i : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) * inversePower p n hn i) =
        ∑ i, (((p : Int) * x (i - 1) - x i : Int) :
          ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) * inversePower p n hn i := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i _
            rw [hx i]
    _ = ∑ i, ((x (i - 1) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
          inversePower p n hn (i - 1) -
        (x i : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) * inversePower p n hn i) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          rw [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
          have hsucc := inversePower_succ p n (by omega) hn (i - 1)
          have hindex : i - 1 + 1 = i := by ring
          rw [hindex] at hsucc
          rw [← hsucc]
          ring
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      have hreindex :
          (∑ i, (x (i - 1) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
            inversePower p n hn (i - 1)) =
          ∑ i, (x i : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) * inversePower p n hn i := by
        simpa using (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.subRight (1 : ZMod n))
          (fun i : ZMod n => (x i : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
            inversePower p n hn i))
      rw [hreindex, sub_self]

name: KLSposet.shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference_apply
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hhalf : (i - a).val < f
  · by_cases hmem : periodicIndex hf i ∈ J
    · have hiK : i ∈ shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a :=
        (mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a i).2 (if_pos hhalf ▸ hmem)
      simp [shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference, hhalf, hmem, hiK,
        Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set]
    · have hiK : i ∉ shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a := by
        rw [mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet, if_pos hhalf]
        exact hmem
      simp [shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference, hhalf, hmem, hiK,
        Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set]
  · by_cases hmem : periodicIndex hf i ∈ J
    · have hiK : i ∉ shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a := by
        rw [mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet, if_neg hhalf]
        simp [hmem]
      simp [shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference, hhalf, hmem, hiK,
        Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        niveauOneScalarCarryInput, Profile.sign, PhantomWeight.periodicU]
    · have hiK : i ∈ shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a := by
        rw [mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet, if_neg hhalf]
        exact hmem
      simp [shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference, hhalf, hmem, hiK,
        Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        niveauOneScalarCarryInput, Profile.sign, PhantomWeight.periodicU]

name: KLSposet.reverseShiftedDoubledHalfCarry_carryEquation
statement:
theorem reverseShiftedDoubledHalfCarry_carryEquation {p f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (y : ZMod (2 * f) → Int)
    (hy : CarryEquation p
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a)
        (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf J a)) y)
    (hyAnti : ∀ i, y (i + f) = -y i)
    (hyzero : y (a - 1) = 0) :
    CarryEquation p (shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference hf sigma J a)
      (reverseShiftedDoubledHalfCarry a y)
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  intro i
  rw [shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference_apply]
  have heq := hy i
  rw [shiftedNiveauTwoScalarCarryInput] at heq
  by_cases hhalf : (i - a).val < f
  · rw [if_pos hhalf]
    by_cases hpred : (i - 1 - a).val < f
    · simp [reverseShiftedDoubledHalfCarry, hhalf, hpred]
    · have hperiodic : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf a := by
        by_contra hne
        have hsign := shiftedDoubledSheetSign_sub_one_eq_of_periodicIndex_ne
          hf a i hne
        simp [shiftedDoubledSheetSign, doubledSheetSign, hhalf, hpred] at hsign
      have hiLift := shiftedFirstLift_periodicIndex_eq hf a i hhalf
      have haHalf : (a - a).val < f := by simp; omega
      have haLift := shiftedFirstLift_periodicIndex_eq hf a a haHalf
      have hia : i = a := by
        calc
          i = shiftedFirstLift hf a (periodicIndex hf i) := hiLift.symm
          _ = shiftedFirstLift hf a (periodicIndex hf a) := by rw [hperiodic]
          _ = a := haLift
      subst i
      simp only [reverseShiftedDoubledHalfCarry]
      rw [if_neg hpred, if_pos haHalf, hyzero]
      ring
  · rw [if_neg hhalf]
    by_cases hpred : (i - 1 - a).val < f
    · have hperiodic : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf a := by
        by_contra hne
        have hsign := shiftedDoubledSheetSign_sub_one_eq_of_periodicIndex_ne
          hf a i hne
        simp [shiftedDoubledSheetSign, doubledSheetSign, hhalf, hpred] at hsign
      have hindex : i + f - a = (i - a) + f := by ring
      have hshift : (i + f - a).val < f := by
        rw [hindex, doubledAddHalf_val hf, if_neg hhalf]
        have hlt := ZMod.val_lt (i - a)
        omega
      have hiLift := shiftedFirstLift_periodicIndex_eq hf a (i + f) hshift
      rw [periodicIndex_add_half hf, hperiodic] at hiLift
      have haHalf : (a - a).val < f := by simp; omega
      have haLift := shiftedFirstLift_periodicIndex_eq hf a a haHalf
      have hia : i + f = a := by
        calc
          i + f = shiftedFirstLift hf a (periodicIndex hf a) := hiLift.symm
          _ = a := haLift
      have hpredzero : y (i - 1) = 0 := by
        have hanti := hyAnti (i - 1)
        have hindexPred : i - 1 + f = a - 1 := by rw [← hia]; ring
        rw [hindexPred, hyzero] at hanti
        omega
      simp [shiftedDoubledSheetSign, doubledSheetSign, hhalf] at heq
      rw [hpredzero] at heq
      simp [reverseShiftedDoubledHalfCarry, hhalf, hpred]
      ring_nf at heq
      linarith
    · simp [shiftedDoubledSheetSign, doubledSheetSign, hhalf] at heq
      simp [reverseShiftedDoubledHalfCarry, hhalf, hpred]
      linarith

name: KLSposet.shiftedDoubledHalfCarry_carryEquation
statement:
theorem shiftedDoubledHalfCarry_carryEquation {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (y : ZMod f → Int)
    (hy : CarryEquation p (niveauOneScalarCarryInput sigma J) y)
    (hyzero : y (periodicIndex hf a - 1) = 0) :
    CarryEquation p (shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference hf sigma J a)
      (shiftedDoubledHalfCarry hf a y)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  rw [shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference_apply]
  rw [hy (periodicIndex hf i)]
  simp only [shiftedDoubledHalfCarry, periodicIndex_sub_one]
  have hpred :
      (if (i - 1 - a).val < f then 0 else y (periodicIndex hf i - 1)) =
      (if (i - a).val < f then 0 else y (periodicIndex hf i - 1)) := by
    by_cases hperiodic : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf a
    · rw [hperiodic, hyzero]
      simp
    · have hsign := shiftedDoubledSheetSign_sub_one_eq_of_periodicIndex_ne
          hf a i hperiodic
      simp only [shiftedDoubledSheetSign, doubledSheetSign] at hsign
      split_ifs at hsign ⊢ <;> norm_num at hsign ⊢
  rw [hpred]
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: KLSposet.shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference_translationExponent
statement:
theorem shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference_translationExponent
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega)
        (shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference hf sigma J a) =
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a) -
        liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J)
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference hf sigma J a = fun i =>
      (((Profile.niveauTwo (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a)
        (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf J a)).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) -
      periodicExtend hf (fun j =>
        ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator j : Int) * (sigma.u j : Int)) i := by
    funext i
    simp only [shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference, periodicExtend,
      PhantomWeight.periodicU]
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  calc
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i =>
        (((Profile.niveauTwo (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a)
          (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf J a)).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) -
        periodicExtend hf (fun j =>
          ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator j : Int) * (sigma.u j : Int)) i) =
      translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i =>
        ((Profile.niveauTwo (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a)
          (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf J a)).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) -
      translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega)
        (periodicExtend hf (fun j =>
          ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator j : Int) * (sigma.u j : Int))) := by
          simp only [translationExponent, Int.cast_sub, sub_mul,
            Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ = niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a) -
        liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) := by
      rw [translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator,
        translationExponent_periodicExtend hp hf,
        translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]

name: KLSposet.shiftedNiveauTwoProfileSum_eq_lift
statement:
theorem shiftedNiveauTwoProfileSum_eq_lift {p f : Nat}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (y : ZMod f → Int)
    (hy : CarryEquation p (niveauOneScalarCarryInput sigma J) y)
    (hyzero : y (periodicIndex hf a - 1) = 0) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a) =
      liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J)
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [← shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference_translationExponent hp hf]
  exact translationExponent_eq_zero_of_carryEquation hp (by omega)
    (shiftedDoubledHalfCarry_carryEquation hf sigma J a y hy hyzero)

name: KLSposet.shiftedNiveauTwoProfileSum_eq_lift_of_reverseCarry
statement:
theorem shiftedNiveauTwoProfileSum_eq_lift_of_reverseCarry {p f : Nat}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (y : ZMod (2 * f) → Int)
    (hy : CarryEquation p
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a)
        (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf J a)) y)
    (hyAnti : ∀ i, y (i + f) = -y i)
    (hyzero : y (a - 1) = 0) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a) =
      liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J)
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [← shiftedNiveauTwoProfileHalfDifference_translationExponent hp hf]
  exact translationExponent_eq_zero_of_carryEquation hp (by omega)
    (reverseShiftedDoubledHalfCarry_carryEquation hf sigma J a y hy
      hyAnti hyzero)

name: KLSposet.shiftedNiveauTwoSet_compl
statement:
theorem shiftedNiveauTwoSet_compl {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) (a : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a)ᶜ = shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf Jᶜ a
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [Set.mem_compl_iff]
  simp only [mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet, Set.mem_compl_iff]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: KLSposet.niveauOneScalarCarryInput_compl
statement:
theorem niveauOneScalarCarryInput_compl {p f : Nat}
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f)) :
    niveauOneScalarCarryInput sigma Jᶜ =
      -niveauOneScalarCarryInput sigma J
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  classical
  by_cases hmem : i ∈ J <;>
    simp [niveauOneScalarCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hmem]

name: KLSposet.carryEquation_neg
statement:
theorem carryEquation_neg {p n : Nat} {y x : ZMod n → Int}
    (h : CarryEquation p y x) : CarryEquation p (-y) (-x)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  simp only [Pi.neg_apply]
  rw [h i]
  ring

name: KLSposet.noncritical_niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_eq_niveauOne
statement:
theorem noncritical_niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_eq_niveauOne
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hscalar :
      (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J)).IsScalar)
    (hcritical : sigma ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma.t) :
    ∃ (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
        (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K),
      profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo K hK) =
        profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J)
proof:
:= by
  rcases niveauOneScalarCarry hp hf chars sigma J hscalar with
    ⟨y, ⟨hy, hyBound⟩, _⟩
  rcases niveauOneScalarCarry_has_zero_of_ne_critical hp sigma J hy hyBound
      hcritical with ⟨z, hyzero⟩
  let a : ZMod (2 * f) := (z.val + 1 : Nat)
  let K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a
  let hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K :=
    shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf J a
  refine ⟨K, hK, ?_⟩
  have hseam : y (periodicIndex hf a - 1) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [a]
    rw [periodicIndex_lift_succ_sub_one hf z]
    exact hyzero
  have hsum : niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma K =
      liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) := by
    exact shiftedNiveauTwoProfileSum_eq_lift (by omega) hf sigma J a y hy hseam
  have hyCompl : CarryEquation p (niveauOneScalarCarryInput sigma Jᶜ) (-y) := by
    rw [niveauOneScalarCarryInput_compl]
    exact carryEquation_neg hy
  have hseamCompl : (-y) (periodicIndex hf a - 1) = 0 := by
    simp [hseam]
  have hsumCompl : niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Kᶜ =
      liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) := by
    rw [show Kᶜ = shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf Jᶜ a by
      dsimp only [K]
      exact shiftedNiveauTwoSet_compl hf J a]
    exact shiftedNiveauTwoProfileSum_eq_lift (by omega) hf sigma Jᶜ a (-y)
      hyCompl hseamCompl
  rw [profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents,
    profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents]
  simp only [profileCharacterExponents, realizeOrderedCharacterExponents,
    OrderedCharacterPair.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · change niveauTwoExponentCharacter (by omega) hf chars
        (liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma K) =
      niveauOneExponentCharacter (by omega) hf chars
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J)
    rw [niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne, hsum,
      liftQPlusOne_add (by omega) hf]
  · change niveauTwoExponentCharacter (by omega) hf chars
        (liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Kᶜ) =
      niveauOneExponentCharacter (by omega) hf chars
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ)
    rw [niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne, hsumCompl,
      liftQPlusOne_add (by omega) hf]

name: KLSposet.scalar_niveauOneProfileCharacterPair_eq_niveauTwo
statement:
theorem scalar_niveauOneProfileCharacterPair_eq_niveauTwo
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K)
    (hscalar :
      (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo K hK)).IsScalar) :
    ∃ J : Set (ZMod f),
      profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
        profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo K hK)
proof:
:= by
  rcases niveauTwoScalarCarry hp hf chars sigma K hK hscalar with
    ⟨y, ⟨hy, hyAnti, hyBound⟩, _⟩
  rcases niveauTwoScalarCarry_has_zero (by omega) hf sigma K hK hy hyAnti
      hyBound with ⟨z, hyzero⟩
  let a : ZMod (2 * f) := z + 1
  let J : Set (ZMod f) := niveauOneSetAtShift hf K a
  have hset : shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a = K := by
    dsimp only [J]
    exact shiftedNiveauTwoSet_niveauOneSetAtShift hf K hK a
  have hseam : y (a - 1) = 0 := by
    simpa [a] using hyzero
  have hyShift : CarryEquation p
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a)
        (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf J a)) y := by
    rw [niveauTwoScalarCarryInput_congr hf sigma
      (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a) K
      (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf J a) hK hset]
    exact hy
  have hsumShift :
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a) =
        liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) :=
    shiftedNiveauTwoProfileSum_eq_lift_of_reverseCarry (by omega) hf sigma
      J a y hyShift hyAnti hseam
  have hsum : niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma K =
      liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) := by
    simpa only [hset] using hsumShift
  have hinputCompl :
      niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf Jᶜ a)
          (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf Jᶜ a) =
        -niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a)
          (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf J a) := by
    funext i
    rw [shiftedNiveauTwoScalarCarryInput]
    simp only [Pi.neg_apply]
    rw [shiftedNiveauTwoScalarCarryInput, niveauOneScalarCarryInput_compl]
    simp
  have hyCompl : CarryEquation p
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf Jᶜ a)
        (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf Jᶜ a)) (-y) := by
    rw [hinputCompl]
    exact carryEquation_neg hyShift
  have hyAntiCompl : ∀ i, (-y) (i + f) = -(-y) i := by
    intro i
    simp only [Pi.neg_apply]
    rw [hyAnti]
  have hseamCompl : (-y) (a - 1) = 0 := by simp [hseam]
  have hsumComplShift :
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf Jᶜ a) =
        liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) :=
    shiftedNiveauTwoProfileSum_eq_lift_of_reverseCarry (by omega) hf sigma
      Jᶜ a (-y) hyCompl hyAntiCompl hseamCompl
  have hsetCompl : shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf Jᶜ a = Kᶜ := by
    calc
      shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf Jᶜ a =
          (shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf J a)ᶜ :=
        (shiftedNiveauTwoSet_compl hf J a).symm
      _ = Kᶜ := congrArg (fun S : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) => Sᶜ) hset
  have hsumCompl : niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Kᶜ =
      liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) := by
    simpa only [hsetCompl] using hsumComplShift
  refine ⟨J, ?_⟩
  rw [profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents,
    profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents]
  simp only [profileCharacterExponents, realizeOrderedCharacterExponents,
    OrderedCharacterPair.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · change niveauOneExponentCharacter (by omega) hf chars
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) =
      niveauTwoExponentCharacter (by omega) hf chars
        (liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma K)
    rw [niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne, hsum,
      liftQPlusOne_add (by omega) hf]
  · change niveauOneExponentCharacter (by omega) hf chars
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) =
      niveauTwoExponentCharacter (by omega) hf chars
        (liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Kᶜ)
    rw [niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne, hsumCompl,
      liftQPlusOne_add (by omega) hf]

name: KLSposet.critical_niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_not_scalar
statement:
theorem critical_niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_not_scalar {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    ¬ (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars
      (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) (.niveauTwo K hK)).IsScalar
proof:
:= by
  intro hscalarK
  rcases niveauTwoScalarCarry hp hf chars (PhantomWeight.critical p f t)
      K hK hscalarK with ⟨y, hy, _⟩
  have hpInt : (3 : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hpoint : ∀ i, y (i - 1) = y i ∧ |y i| = 1 := by
    intro i
    have heq := hy.1 i
    have hiBound := hy.2.2 i
    have hprevBound := hy.2.2 (i - 1)
    have hiRange := abs_le.mp hiBound
    have hprevRange := abs_le.mp hprevBound
    have hiCases : y i = -1 ∨ y i = 0 ∨ y i = 1 := by omega
    have hprevCases : y (i - 1) = -1 ∨ y (i - 1) = 0 ∨ y (i - 1) = 1 := by omega
    simp only [niveauTwoScalarCarryInput, PhantomWeight.periodicU,
      PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] at heq
    have hpSub : ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 := by omega
    rw [hpSub] at heq
    by_cases hi : i ∈ K
    · simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi] at heq
      rcases hprevCases with hprev | hprev | hprev <;>
          rcases hiCases with hcurrent | hcurrent | hcurrent
      all_goals
        rw [hprev, hcurrent] at heq
        ring_nf at heq
        constructor
        · omega
        · simp [hcurrent] <;> omega
    · simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi] at heq
      rcases hprevCases with hprev | hprev | hprev <;>
          rcases hiCases with hcurrent | hcurrent | hcurrent
      all_goals
        rw [hprev, hcurrent] at heq
        ring_nf at heq
        constructor
        · omega
        · simp [hcurrent] <;> omega
  have hconstant : ∀ i, y i = y 0 :=
    cyclicFunction_eq_const_of_pred_eq (by omega) fun i => (hpoint i).1
  have hshift := hconstant ((f : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))
  have hanti := hy.2.1 (0 : ZMod (2 * f))
  simp only [zero_add] at hanti
  have hyzero : y 0 = 0 := by omega
  have hone := (hpoint 0).2
  rw [hyzero] at hone
  norm_num at hone

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoProfileSum_reducesToPowerPlusOne_of_cross_pair_eq
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_reducesToPowerPlusOne_of_cross_pair_eq
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K)
    (hpair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)) :
    reduceNiveauTwoExponentToPowerPlusOne p f (by omega)
      (niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcross := crossNiveauProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq
    hp hf chars sigma sigma' J K hK hpair
  have h := congrArg (reduceNiveauTwoExponentToPowerPlusOne p f (by omega))
    hcross.1
  simp only [map_add,
    reduceNiveauTwoExponentToPowerPlusOne_liftQPlusOne, zero_add] at h
  exact h.symm

name: KLSposet.critical_niveauTwoProfileSum_eq_translationExponent
statement:
theorem critical_niveauTwoProfileSum_eq_translationExponent {p f : Nat}
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) K =
      translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega)
        (criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates (p := p) K hK)
proof:
:= by
  have hy : criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates (p := p) K hK =
      fun i ↦ ((Profile.niveauTwo K hK).indicator i : Int) *
        ((PhantomWeight.critical p f t).periodicU hf i : Int) := by
    funext i
    simp only [criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates, PhantomWeight.periodicU,
      PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p), Nat.cast_one]
  rw [hy]
  exact (translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf
    (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) K hK).symm

name: KLSposet.reduce_critical_niveauTwoProfileSum_eq_signedWeightedSum
statement:
theorem reduce_critical_niveauTwoProfileSum_eq_signedWeightedSum
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    reduceNiveauTwoExponentToPowerPlusOne p f (by omega)
        (niveauTwoProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) K) =
      (((p : Int) - 1) * manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p f
        (criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign hf K hK) : Int)
proof:
:= by
  let y := criticalNiveauTwoSelectedCoordinates (p := p) K hK
  have hprofile := critical_niveauTwoProfileSum_eq_translationExponent hp hf t K hK
  have hcast := manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum_cast (p := p) (by omega) y
  have hdecomp := criticalNiveauTwoSelectedWeightedSum_decomposition
    (p := p) hf K hK
  calc
    reduceNiveauTwoExponentToPowerPlusOne p f (by omega)
        (niveauTwoProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) K) =
      reduceNiveauTwoExponentToPowerPlusOne p f (by omega)
        ((manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p (2 * f) y : Int) :
          ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) := by rw [hprofile, hcast]
    _ = ((manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p (2 * f) y : Int) :
          ZMod (p ^ f + 1)) := by rw [map_intCast]
    _ = (((p : Int) - 1) * manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p f
          (criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign hf K hK) : Int) := by
      rw [hdecomp]
      push_cast
      have hmod : (p : ZMod (p ^ f + 1)) ^ f + 1 = 0 := by
        rw [← Nat.cast_pow]
        calc
          ((p ^ f : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f + 1)) + 1 =
              ((p ^ f : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f + 1)) +
                ((1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f + 1)) := by norm_num
          _ = ((p ^ f + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f + 1)) :=
            (Nat.cast_add (R := ZMod (p ^ f + 1)) (p ^ f) 1).symm
          _ = 0 := ZMod.natCast_self (p ^ f + 1)
      rw [hmod, zero_mul, zero_add]

name: KLSposet.reduce_critical_niveauTwoProfileSum_ne_zero
statement:
theorem reduce_critical_niveauTwoProfileSum_ne_zero
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    reduceNiveauTwoExponentToPowerPlusOne p f (by omega)
        (niveauTwoProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) K) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [reduce_critical_niveauTwoProfileSum_eq_signedWeightedSum hp hf t K hK]
  intro hzero
  have hnat := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd
    (((p : Int) - 1) * manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p f
      (criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign hf K hK)) (p ^ f + 1)).mp hzero
  have hint : ((p : Int) ^ f + 1) ∣
      ((p : Int) - 1) * manuscriptCyclicWeightedSum p f
        (criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign hf K hK) := by
    norm_num at hnat ⊢
    exact hnat
  exact powerPlusOne_not_dvd_subOne_mul_signedUnitWeightedSum hp hf
    (criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign hf K hK)
    (criticalNiveauTwoFirstHalfSign_eq_one_or_neg_one hf K hK) hint

name: KLSposet.criticalTarget_crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_ne
statement:
theorem criticalTarget_crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_ne
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) ≠
      profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) (.niveauTwo K hK)
proof:
:= by
  intro hpair
  exact reduce_critical_niveauTwoProfileSum_ne_zero hp hf t K hK
    (niveauTwoProfileSum_reducesToPowerPlusOne_of_cross_pair_eq
      (by omega) hf chars sigma (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) J K hK hpair)

name: KLSposet.criticalTarget_niveauOneProfileWitness_of_subset
statement:
theorem criticalTarget_niveauOneProfileWitness_of_subset
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.critical p f t))
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) :
    ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
      profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
        profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars
          (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) (.niveauOne K)
proof:
:= by
  have hsource : profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) ∈
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma := ⟨.niveauOne J, rfl⟩
  rcases hsubset hsource with ⟨P, hP⟩
  cases P with
  | niveauOne K => exact ⟨K, hP.symm⟩
  | niveauTwo K hK =>
      exact False.elim
        (criticalTarget_crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_ne hp hf chars sigma t
          J K hK hP.symm)

name: KLSposet.criticalTarget_niveauOneExponentWitnesses_of_subset
statement:
theorem criticalTarget_niveauOneExponentWitnesses_of_subset
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0)) :
    (∃ K : Set (ZMod f), sigma.t =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K) ∧
      ∀ j : ZMod f, ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
        sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j} =
          niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rcases criticalTarget_niveauOneProfileWitness_of_subset hp hf chars
        sigma 0 hsubset ∅ with ⟨K, hpair⟩
    refine ⟨K, ?_⟩
    have hexp := niveauOneProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq
      (by omega) hf chars sigma (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) ∅ K hpair
    change OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma ∅)
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma ∅ᶜ) =
      OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
        (0 + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K)
        (0 + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) Kᶜ) at hexp
    injection hexp with hleft _
    simpa [niveauOneProfileSum] using hleft
  · intro j
    rcases criticalTarget_niveauOneProfileWitness_of_subset hp hf chars
        sigma 0 hsubset {j} with ⟨K, hpair⟩
    refine ⟨K, ?_⟩
    have hexp := niveauOneProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq
      (by omega) hf chars sigma (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) {j} K hpair
    change OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j})
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j}ᶜ) =
      OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
        (0 + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K)
        (0 + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) Kᶜ) at hexp
    injection hexp with hleft _
    simpa using hleft

name: KLSposet.critical_niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_ne_niveauOne
statement:
theorem critical_niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_ne_niveauOne {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hscalar :
      (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars (PhantomWeight.critical p f t)
        (.niveauOne J)).IsScalar)
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars (PhantomWeight.critical p f t)
        (.niveauTwo K hK) ≠
      profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars (PhantomWeight.critical p f t)
        (.niveauOne J)
proof:
:= by
  intro hpair
  have hscalarK :
      (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars (PhantomWeight.critical p f t)
        (.niveauTwo K hK)).IsScalar := by
    rw [hpair]
    exact hscalar
  rcases niveauTwoScalarCarry hp hf chars (PhantomWeight.critical p f t)
      K hK hscalarK with ⟨y, hy, _⟩
  have hpInt : (3 : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hpoint : ∀ i, y (i - 1) = y i ∧ |y i| = 1 := by
    intro i
    have heq := hy.1 i
    have hiBound := hy.2.2 i
    have hprevBound := hy.2.2 (i - 1)
    have hiRange := abs_le.mp hiBound
    have hprevRange := abs_le.mp hprevBound
    have hiCases : y i = -1 ∨ y i = 0 ∨ y i = 1 := by omega
    have hprevCases : y (i - 1) = -1 ∨ y (i - 1) = 0 ∨ y (i - 1) = 1 := by omega
    simp only [niveauTwoScalarCarryInput, PhantomWeight.periodicU,
      PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] at heq
    have hpSub : ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 := by omega
    rw [hpSub] at heq
    by_cases hi : i ∈ K
    · simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi] at heq
      rcases hprevCases with hprev | hprev | hprev <;>
          rcases hiCases with hcurrent | hcurrent | hcurrent
      all_goals
        rw [hprev, hcurrent] at heq
        ring_nf at heq
        constructor
        · omega
        · simp [hcurrent] <;> omega
    · simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi] at heq
      rcases hprevCases with hprev | hprev | hprev <;>
          rcases hiCases with hcurrent | hcurrent | hcurrent
      all_goals
        rw [hprev, hcurrent] at heq
        ring_nf at heq
        constructor
        · omega
        · simp [hcurrent] <;> omega
  have hconstant : ∀ i, y i = y 0 :=
    cyclicFunction_eq_const_of_pred_eq (by omega) fun i => (hpoint i).1
  have hshift := hconstant ((f : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))
  have hanti := hy.2.1 (0 : ZMod (2 * f))
  simp only [zero_add] at hanti
  have hyzero : y 0 = 0 := by omega
  have hone := (hpoint 0).2
  rw [hyzero] at hone
  norm_num at hone

name: KLSposet.basePDigitValue_succ
statement:
theorem basePDigitValue_succ (p n : Nat) (a : Fin (n + 1) → Nat) :
    basePDigitValue p (n + 1) a =
      a 0 + p * basePDigitValue p n (fun i ↦ a i.succ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [basePDigitValue, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, Nat.mul_one, Fin.val_succ,
    basePDigitValue, pow_succ]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply congrArg (a 0 + ·)
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

name: KLSposet.basePDigitValue_injective
statement:
theorem basePDigitValue_injective {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (a b : Fin f → Nat) (ha : ∀ i, a i < p) (hb : ∀ i, b i < p)
    (hvalue : basePDigitValue p f a = basePDigitValue p f b) :
    a = b
proof:
:= by
  induction f with
  | zero =>
      funext i
      exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [basePDigitValue_succ, basePDigitValue_succ] at hvalue
      have hmod := congrArg (fun m : Nat ↦ m % p) hvalue
      have hzero : a 0 = b 0 := by
        simpa [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (ha 0),
          Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (hb 0)] using hmod
      have hmul :
          p * basePDigitValue p n (fun i ↦ a i.succ) =
            p * basePDigitValue p n (fun i ↦ b i.succ) := by
        rw [hzero] at hvalue
        exact Nat.add_left_cancel hvalue
      have htail :
          basePDigitValue p n (fun i ↦ a i.succ) =
            basePDigitValue p n (fun i ↦ b i.succ) :=
        Nat.mul_left_cancel (by omega) hmul
      have hfun : (fun i : Fin n ↦ a i.succ) = (fun i : Fin n ↦ b i.succ) :=
        ih (fun i : Fin n ↦ a i.succ) (fun i : Fin n ↦ b i.succ)
          (fun i : Fin n ↦ ha i.succ) (fun i : Fin n ↦ hb i.succ) htail
      funext i
      refine Fin.cases hzero ?_ i
      intro j
      exact congrFun hfun j

name: KLSposet.basePDigitDifference_constant
statement:
theorem basePDigitDifference_constant {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 1 ≤ f)
    (a b : Fin f → Nat) (ha : ∀ i, a i ≤ 2) (hb : ∀ i, b i ≤ 1)
    (hcong : Nat.ModEq (basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 1))
      (basePDigitValue p f a) (basePDigitValue p f b)) :
    ∃ c : Int, ∀ i, (a i : Int) - (b i : Int) = c
proof:
:= by
  let M := basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 1)
  let A := basePDigitValue p f a
  let B := basePDigitValue p f b
  have hMpos : 0 < M := by
    let i0 : Fin f := ⟨0, by omega⟩
    have hle : 1 * p ^ i0.val ≤ ∑ i : Fin f, 1 * p ^ i.val :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ ↦ Nat.zero_le (1 * p ^ i.val))
        (Finset.mem_univ i0)
    simpa [M, basePDigitValue, i0] using hle
  have hA_le : A ≤ 2 * M := by
    calc
      A ≤ basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 2) := by
        dsimp only [A]
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right (p ^ i.val) (ha i)
      _ = 2 * M := by
        simp [M, basePDigitValue, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hB_le : B ≤ M := by
    dsimp only [B, M]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right (p ^ i.val) (hb i)
  have hdiv : (M : Int) ∣ (B : Int) - (A : Int) := by
    exact hcong.dvd
  rcases hdiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
  have hMposInt : (0 : Int) < (M : Int) := by exact_mod_cast hMpos
  have hA_nonneg : (0 : Int) ≤ (A : Int) := by positivity
  have hB_nonneg : (0 : Int) ≤ (B : Int) := by positivity
  have hA_le_int : (A : Int) ≤ 2 * (M : Int) := by exact_mod_cast hA_le
  have hB_le_int : (B : Int) ≤ (M : Int) := by exact_mod_cast hB_le
  have hkBounds : (-2 : Int) ≤ k ∧ k ≤ 1 := by
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hkCases : k = -2 ∨ k = -1 ∨ k = 0 ∨ k = 1 := by omega
  rcases hkCases with hkNegTwo | hkNegOne | hkZero | hkOne
  · rw [hkNegTwo] at hk
    norm_num at hk
    have hA : A = 2 * M := by omega
    have hB : B = 0 := by omega
    have haTwo : a = fun _ ↦ 2 := by
      apply basePDigitValue_injective (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) a (fun _ ↦ 2)
      · intro i
        have := ha i
        omega
      · intro i
        omega
      · simpa [A, M, basePDigitValue, Finset.mul_sum] using hA
    have hbZero : b = fun _ ↦ 0 := by
      apply basePDigitValue_injective (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) b (fun _ ↦ 0)
      · intro i
        have := hb i
        omega
      · intro i
        omega
      · simpa [B, basePDigitValue] using hB
    refine ⟨2, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [congrFun haTwo i, congrFun hbZero i]
    norm_num
  · rw [hkNegOne] at hk
    norm_num at hk
    have hA : A = B + M := by omega
    have hplusOne : basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦ b i + 1) = B + M := by
      simp only [basePDigitValue, Nat.add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        Nat.one_mul]
      change (∑ x, b x * p ^ x.val) + (∑ x : Fin f, p ^ x.val) =
        basePDigitValue p f b + basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 1)
      simp [basePDigitValue]
    have haSucc : a = fun i ↦ b i + 1 := by
      apply basePDigitValue_injective (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) a
        (fun i ↦ b i + 1)
      · intro i
        have := ha i
        omega
      · intro i
        have := hb i
        omega
      · rw [hplusOne]
        change A = B + M
        exact hA
    refine ⟨1, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [congrFun haSucc i]
    push_cast
    omega
  · rw [hkZero] at hk
    norm_num at hk
    have hAB : A = B := by omega
    have hab : a = b := by
      apply basePDigitValue_injective (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) a b
      · intro i
        have := ha i
        omega
      · intro i
        have := hb i
        omega
      · change A = B
        exact hAB
    refine ⟨0, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [congrFun hab i]
    omega
  · rw [hkOne] at hk
    norm_num at hk
    have hA : A = 0 := by omega
    have hB : B = M := by omega
    have haZero : a = fun _ ↦ 0 := by
      apply basePDigitValue_injective (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) a (fun _ ↦ 0)
      · intro i
        have := ha i
        omega
      · intro i
        omega
      · simpa [A, basePDigitValue] using hA
    have hbOne : b = fun _ ↦ 1 := by
      apply basePDigitValue_injective (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) b (fun _ ↦ 1)
      · intro i
        have := hb i
        omega
      · intro i
        omega
      · simpa [B, M]
    refine ⟨-1, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [congrFun haZero i, congrFun hbOne i]
    norm_num

name: KLSposet.bounded_eq_zero_or_p_sub_one_of_modEq_zero
statement:
theorem bounded_eq_zero_or_p_sub_one_of_modEq_zero
    {p u : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hu : u ≤ p)
    (hmod : (u : ZMod (p - 1)) = 0) : u = 0 ∨ u = p - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcastInt : ((u : Int) : ZMod (p - 1)) = 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hmod
  have hdivInt : ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) ∣ (u : Int) :=
    (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (u : Int) (p - 1)).mp hcastInt
  have hdiv : p - 1 ∣ u := by exact_mod_cast hdivInt
  rcases hdiv with ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have hk : k ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra hk
    have hk' : 2 ≤ k := by omega
    have hmul : (p - 1) * 2 ≤ (p - 1) * k :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left (p - 1) hk'
    omega
  interval_cases k <;> simp

name: KLSposet.basePDigitSingleton_congruence_not_mem
statement:
theorem basePDigitSingleton_congruence_not_mem
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (K : Finset (Fin f))
    (hK : K ≠ Finset.univ) (j : Fin f) (b : Fin f → Nat)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ≤ 1)
    (hcong : Nat.ModEq (basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 1))
      (basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦
        (if i ∈ K then 1 else 0) + if i = j then 1 else 0))
      (basePDigitValue p f b)) :
    j ∉ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have ha : ∀ i : Fin f,
      (if i ∈ K then 1 else 0) + (if i = j then 1 else 0) ≤ 2 := by
    intro i
    split_ifs <;> omega
  rcases basePDigitDifference_constant hp hf
      (fun i ↦ (if i ∈ K then 1 else 0) + if i = j then 1 else 0)
      b ha hb hcong with ⟨c, hc⟩
  intro hj
  have hex : ∃ i, i ∉ K := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    apply hK
    ext i
    simp [h i]
  rcases hex with ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hij : i ≠ j := by
    intro hij
    apply hi
    simpa [hij] using hj
  have hcj := hc j
  have hci := hc i
  have hbj := hb j
  simp [hj] at hcj
  simp [hi, hij] at hci
  omega

name: KLSposet.basePDigitSingleton_congruences_disjoint
statement:
theorem basePDigitSingleton_congruences_disjoint
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (K S : Finset (Fin f))
    (hK : K ≠ Finset.univ)
    (hwitness : ∀ j, j ∈ S → ∃ b : Fin f → Nat, (∀ i, b i ≤ 1) ∧
      Nat.ModEq (basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 1))
        (basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦
          (if i ∈ K then 1 else 0) + if i = j then 1 else 0))
        (basePDigitValue p f b)) :
    Disjoint K S
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro j hjK hjS
  rcases hwitness j hjS with ⟨b, hb, hcong⟩
  exact basePDigitSingleton_congruence_not_mem hp hf K hK j b hb hcong hjK

name: KLSposet.basePDigitDisjoint_congruence_classification
statement:
theorem basePDigitDisjoint_congruence_classification
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 1 ≤ f) (K S : Finset (Fin f))
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint K S) (hK : K ≠ Finset.univ)
    (hcong : Nat.ModEq (basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 1))
      (basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦
        2 * (if i ∈ K then 1 else 0) + if i ∈ S then 1 else 0))
      (basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 0))) :
    K = ∅ ∧ (S = ∅ ∨ S = Finset.univ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have ha : ∀ i : Fin f,
      2 * (if i ∈ K then 1 else 0) + (if i ∈ S then 1 else 0) ≤ 2 := by
    intro i
    by_cases hiK : i ∈ K
    · have hiS : i ∉ S := by
        exact fun hiS ↦ Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hiK hiS
      simp [hiK, hiS]
    · by_cases hiS : i ∈ S <;> simp [hiK, hiS]
  have hb : ∀ _ : Fin f, 0 ≤ 1 := by omega
  rcases basePDigitDifference_constant hp hf
      (fun i ↦ 2 * (if i ∈ K then 1 else 0) + if i ∈ S then 1 else 0)
      (fun _ ↦ 0) ha hb hcong with ⟨c, hc⟩
  have hex : ∃ i, i ∉ K := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    apply hK
    ext i
    simp [h i]
  rcases hex with ⟨i, hiK⟩
  have hci := hc i
  by_cases hiS : i ∈ S
  · simp [hiK, hiS] at hci
    have hKempty : K = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro k hkK
      have hkS : k ∉ S := fun hkS ↦
        Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hkK hkS
      have hck := hc k
      simp [hkK, hkS] at hck
      omega
    have hSuniv : S = Finset.univ := by
      ext s
      simp only [Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
      by_contra hsS
      have hsK : s ∉ K := by simp [hKempty]
      have hcs := hc s
      simp [hsK, hsS] at hcs
      omega
    exact ⟨hKempty, Or.inr hSuniv⟩
  · simp [hiK, hiS] at hci
    have hKempty : K = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro k hkK
      have hkS : k ∉ S := fun hkS ↦
        Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hkK hkS
      have hck := hc k
      simp [hkK, hkS] at hck
      omega
    have hSempty : S = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro s hsS
      have hsK : s ∉ K := by simp [hKempty]
      have hcs := hc s
      simp [hsK, hsS] at hcs
      omega
    exact ⟨hKempty, Or.inl hSempty⟩

name: KLSposet.critical_niveauOneProfileSum_mod_p_sub_one
statement:
theorem critical_niveauOneProfileSum_mod_p_sub_one
    {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) :
    ZMod.castHom (by
      simpa using Nat.sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow p 1 f) (ZMod (p - 1))
        (niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) J) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  simp only [niveauOneProfileSum, PhantomWeight.critical,
    PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i hi
  rw [map_mul]
  simp

name: KLSposet.criticalTarget_emptyExponent_forces_t_mod_p_sub_one
statement:
theorem criticalTarget_emptyExponent_forces_t_mod_p_sub_one
    {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (K : Set (ZMod f))
    (hExponent : sigma.t = niveauOneProfileSum hf
      (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K) :
    ZMod.castHom (by
      simpa using Nat.sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow p 1 f) (ZMod (p - 1)) sigma.t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hExponent]
  exact critical_niveauOneProfileSum_mod_p_sub_one hf 0 K

name: KLSposet.criticalTarget_singletonExponent_forces_u_mod_p_sub_one
statement:
theorem criticalTarget_singletonExponent_forces_u_mod_p_sub_one
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (K : Set (ZMod f))
    (ht : ZMod.castHom (by
      simpa using Nat.sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow p 1 f) (ZMod (p - 1)) sigma.t = 0)
    (hExponent : sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j} =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K) :
    (sigma.u j : ZMod (p - 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  let phi : ZMod (p ^ f - 1) →+* ZMod (p - 1) :=
    ZMod.castHom (by simpa using Nat.sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow p 1 f) (ZMod (p - 1))
  have hmap := congrArg phi hExponent
  have hcritical := critical_niveauOneProfileSum_mod_p_sub_one hf
    (0 : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) K
  change phi sigma.t = 0 at ht
  change phi (niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K) = 0 at hcritical
  rw [map_add, ht, zero_add, hcritical] at hmap
  have hpCast : (p : ZMod (p - 1)) = 1 := by
    rw [show p = (p - 1) + 1 by omega, Nat.cast_add, ZMod.natCast_self,
      zero_add]
    norm_num
  have hsum : niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j} =
      (sigma.u j : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
        niveauOneFundamentalExponent p f hf j := by
    simp only [niveauOneProfileSum, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    rw [show Finset.univ.filter (fun i : ZMod f ↦ i = j) = {j} by
      ext i
      simp]
    simp
  rw [hsum, map_mul] at hmap
  have hinverse : phi (niveauOneFundamentalExponent p f hf j) = 1 := by
    rw [niveauOneFundamentalExponent, inversePower, map_pow, map_natCast,
      hpCast, one_pow]
  rw [hinverse, mul_one] at hmap
  simpa [phi] using hmap

name: KLSposet.criticalTarget_niveauOneExponentWitnesses_force_coordinates
statement:
theorem criticalTarget_niveauOneExponentWitnesses_force_coordinates
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hempty : ∃ K : Set (ZMod f), sigma.t = niveauOneProfileSum hf
      (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K)
    (hsingleton : ∀ j : ZMod f, ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
      sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j} =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K) :
    ZMod.castHom (by
      simpa using Nat.sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow p 1 f) (ZMod (p - 1)) sigma.t = 0 ∧
      ∀ j, sigma.u j = 0 ∨ sigma.u j = p - 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases hempty with ⟨K, hK⟩
  have ht := criticalTarget_emptyExponent_forces_t_mod_p_sub_one hf sigma K hK
  refine ⟨ht, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases hsingleton j with ⟨Kj, hKj⟩
  exact bounded_eq_zero_or_p_sub_one_of_modEq_zero hp (sigma.u_le j)
    (criticalTarget_singletonExponent_forces_u_mod_p_sub_one hp hf sigma j Kj ht hKj)

name: KLSposet.criticalTarget_subset_forces_coordinate_dichotomy
statement:
theorem criticalTarget_subset_forces_coordinate_dichotomy
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0)) :
    ZMod.castHom (by
      simpa using Nat.sub_dvd_pow_sub_pow p 1 f) (ZMod (p - 1)) sigma.t = 0 ∧
      ∀ j, sigma.u j = 0 ∨ sigma.u j = p - 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases criticalTarget_niveauOneExponentWitnesses_of_subset hp hf chars sigma
    hsubset with ⟨hempty, hsingleton⟩
  exact criticalTarget_niveauOneExponentWitnesses_force_coordinates hp hf sigma
    hempty hsingleton

name: KLSposet.reverseIndexEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem reverseIndexEquiv_apply {f : Nat} (hf : 1 ≤ f) (i : Fin f) :
    reverseIndexEquiv f hf i = reverseIndex i
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  change -((ZMod.finEquiv f) i) = -(i.val : ZMod f)
  congr 1
  cases f with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n =>
      apply ZMod.val_injective
      change i.val = ((i.val : Nat) : ZMod (n + 1)).val
      rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt i.isLt]

name: KLSposet.niveauOneFundamentalExponent_reverseIndex
statement:
theorem niveauOneFundamentalExponent_reverseIndex {p f : Nat}
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (i : Fin f) :
    niveauOneFundamentalExponent p f hf (reverseIndex i) =
      (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) ^ i.val
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · have hieq : i = 0 := Fin.ext hi
    subst i
    simp [reverseIndex, niveauOneFundamentalExponent, inversePower]
    rw [← Nat.cast_pow]
    have hq : 1 ≤ p ^ f := one_le_pow₀ (by omega)
    rw [show p ^ f = (p ^ f - 1) + 1 by omega, Nat.cast_add,
      ZMod.natCast_self, zero_add]
    norm_num
  · have hcast : (i.val : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      have hval := congrArg ZMod.val hzero
      rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt i.isLt] at hval
      simp only [ZMod.val_zero] at hval
      exact hi hval
    have hnegval : (-(i.val : ZMod f)).val = f - i.val := by
      rw [ZMod.neg_val, if_neg hcast, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt i.isLt]
    rw [niveauOneFundamentalExponent, inversePower, reverseIndex, hnegval]
    congr 1
    omega

name: KLSposet.critical_niveauOneProfileSum_eq_basePDigitValue
statement:
theorem critical_niveauOneProfileSum_eq_basePDigitValue
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) (K : Set (ZMod f)) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) K =
      (((p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f (reverseProfileDigits K) : Nat) :
        ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  have hreindex := Equiv.sum_comp (reverseIndexEquiv f (by omega))
    (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i ∈ K then
      ((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
        niveauOneFundamentalExponent p f hf i else 0)
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum]
  simp only [PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [← hreindex]
  simp only [reverseIndexEquiv_apply]
  rw [basePDigitValue, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [niveauOneFundamentalExponent_reverseIndex hp hf i]
