  by_cases hi : reverseIndex i ∈ K
  · simp [reverseProfileDigits, hi, Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)]
  · simp [reverseProfileDigits, hi]

name: KLSposet.basePDigitGeometricSum_int
statement:
theorem basePDigitGeometricSum_int (p f : Nat) :
    ((p : Int) - 1) *
        (basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 1) : Int) =
      (p : Int) ^ f - 1
proof:
:= by
  induction f with
  | zero => simp [basePDigitValue]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [basePDigitValue_succ]
      push_cast
      calc
        ((p : Int) - 1) *
            (1 + (p : Int) * (basePDigitValue p n (fun _ ↦ 1) : Int)) =
          (p : Int) * (((p : Int) - 1) *
            (basePDigitValue p n (fun _ ↦ 1) : Int)) + ((p : Int) - 1) := by ring
        _ = (p : Int) * ((p : Int) ^ n - 1) + ((p : Int) - 1) := by rw [ih]
        _ = (p : Int) ^ (n + 1) - 1 := by rw [pow_succ]; ring

name: KLSposet.basePDigitFactor_cancel
statement:
theorem basePDigitFactor_cancel {p f A B : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (_hf : 1 ≤ f)
    (h : (((p - 1) * A : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) =
      (((p - 1) * B : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))) :
    Nat.ModEq (basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 1)) A B
proof:
:= by
  let M := basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 1)
  have hInt : ((((p : Int) - 1) * (A : Int) : Int) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) =
      ((((p : Int) - 1) * (B : Int) : Int) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) := by
    push_cast
    norm_num [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)] at h ⊢
    exact h
  have hdvd : ((p ^ f - 1 : Nat) : Int) ∣
      ((p : Int) - 1) * ((B : Int) - (A : Int)) := by
    have hdiv := (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub
      (((p : Int) - 1) * (A : Int))
      (((p : Int) - 1) * (B : Int)) (p ^ f - 1)).mp hInt
    convert hdiv using 1
    ring
  have hpow : ((p ^ f - 1 : Nat) : Int) = ((p : Int) ^ f - 1) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by exact one_le_pow₀ (by omega : 1 ≤ p)), Nat.cast_pow,
      Nat.cast_one]
  rw [hpow, ← basePDigitGeometricSum_int p f] at hdvd
  rcases hdvd with ⟨c, hc⟩
  have hfactor : (B : Int) - (A : Int) = (M : Int) * c := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (show (p : Int) - 1 ≠ 0 by omega)
    calc
      ((p : Int) - 1) * ((B : Int) - (A : Int)) =
          (((p : Int) - 1) * (M : Int)) * c := hc
      _ = ((p : Int) - 1) * ((M : Int) * c) := by ring
  apply Nat.modEq_iff_dvd.mpr
  change (M : Int) ∣ (B : Int) - (A : Int)
  exact ⟨c, hfactor⟩

name: KLSposet.mem_reverseProfileSupport
statement:
theorem mem_reverseProfileSupport {f : Nat} (K : Set (ZMod f))
    (i : Fin f) :
    i ∈ reverseProfileSupport K ↔ reverseIndex i ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [reverseProfileSupport]

name: KLSposet.reverseProfileDigits_eq_indicator
statement:
theorem reverseProfileDigits_eq_indicator {f : Nat} (K : Set (ZMod f))
    (i : Fin f) :
    reverseProfileDigits K i =
      if i ∈ reverseProfileSupport K then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [reverseProfileDigits, reverseProfileSupport]

name: KLSposet.normalizedReverseProfileSupport_ne_univ
statement:
theorem normalizedReverseProfileSupport_ne_univ {f : Nat} (hf : 1 ≤ f)
    (K : Set (ZMod f)) :
    normalizedReverseProfileSupport K ≠ Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [normalizedReverseProfileSupport]
  split_ifs with h
  · intro hempty
    let i : Fin f := ⟨0, by omega⟩
    have hi : i ∈ (∅ : Finset (Fin f)) := by rw [hempty]; simp
    simp at hi
  · exact h

name: KLSposet.basePDigitGeometricSum
statement:
theorem basePDigitGeometricSum {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) :
    (p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 1) = p ^ f - 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.cast_injective (R := Int)
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p), Nat.cast_one,
    Nat.cast_sub (one_le_pow₀ (by omega : 1 ≤ p)), Nat.cast_pow,
    Nat.cast_one]
  exact basePDigitGeometricSum_int p f

name: KLSposet.normalizedReverseProfileSupport_cast
statement:
theorem normalizedReverseProfileSupport_cast {p f : Nat}
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (_hf : 1 ≤ f) (K : Set (ZMod f)) :
    (((p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f (reverseProfileDigits K) : Nat) :
        ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) =
      (((p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦
        if i ∈ normalizedReverseProfileSupport K then 1 else 0) : Nat) :
        ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hfull : reverseProfileSupport K = Finset.univ
  · have hdigits : reverseProfileDigits K = fun _ ↦ 1 := by
      funext i
      rw [reverseProfileDigits_eq_indicator]
      simp [hfull]
    rw [hdigits]
    simp [normalizedReverseProfileSupport, hfull]
    norm_num [← Nat.cast_mul, basePDigitGeometricSum hp]
    simp [basePDigitValue]
  · simp only [normalizedReverseProfileSupport, if_neg hfull]
    congr 2
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact reverseProfileDigits_eq_indicator K i

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileSum_singleton_reverseIndex
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_singleton_reverseIndex
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (i : Fin f)
    (hi : sigma.u (reverseIndex i) = p - 1) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {reverseIndex i} =
      (((p - 1) * p ^ i.val : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum]
  simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  rw [show Finset.univ.filter (fun x : ZMod f ↦ x = reverseIndex i) =
      {reverseIndex i} by ext; simp]
  rw [Finset.sum_singleton, hi,
    niveauOneFundamentalExponent_reverseIndex hp hf i,
    Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow]

name: KLSposet.mem_criticalCoordinateSupport
statement:
theorem mem_criticalCoordinateSupport {p f : Nat}
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (i : Fin f) :
    i ∈ criticalCoordinateSupport sigma ↔
      sigma.u (reverseIndex i) = p - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [criticalCoordinateSupport]

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_basePDigitValue_of_dichotomy
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_basePDigitValue_of_dichotomy
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hu : ∀ j, sigma.u j = 0 ∨ sigma.u j = p - 1) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ =
      (((p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦
        if i ∈ criticalCoordinateSupport sigma then 1 else 0) : Nat) :
        ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  have hreindex := Equiv.sum_comp (reverseIndexEquiv f (by omega))
    (fun i : ZMod f ↦ (sigma.u i : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
      niveauOneFundamentalExponent p f hf i)
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum]
  simp only [Set.mem_univ, Finset.filter_true]
  rw [← hreindex]
  simp only [reverseIndexEquiv_apply]
  rw [basePDigitValue, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [niveauOneFundamentalExponent_reverseIndex hp hf i]
  rcases hu (reverseIndex i) with hzero | hsub
  · have hnot : i ∉ criticalCoordinateSupport sigma := by
      rw [mem_criticalCoordinateSupport]
      omega
    simp [hzero, hnot]
  · have hmem : i ∈ criticalCoordinateSupport sigma :=
      (mem_criticalCoordinateSupport sigma i).mpr hsub
    simp [hsub, hmem, Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)]

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileSum_add_compl
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_add_compl {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (K : Set (ZMod f)) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma K + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Kᶜ =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  simp only [niveauOneProfileSum]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
  simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_univ, if_true]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : i ∈ K <;> simp [hi]

name: KLSposet.critical_niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [critical_niveauOneProfileSum_eq_basePDigitValue hp hf t Set.univ]
  have hdigits : reverseProfileDigits (Set.univ : Set (ZMod f)) = fun _ ↦ 1 := by
    funext i
    simp [reverseProfileDigits]
  rw [hdigits, basePDigitGeometricSum hp]
  exact ZMod.natCast_self (p ^ f - 1)

name: KLSposet.critical_niveauOneProfileSum_add_compl_eq_zero
statement:
theorem critical_niveauOneProfileSum_add_compl_eq_zero
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) (K : Set (ZMod f)) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) K +
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) Kᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum_add_compl hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) K,
    critical_niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_zero hp hf t]

name: KLSposet.basePDigitValue_add_singleton
statement:
theorem basePDigitValue_add_singleton {p f : Nat}
    (K : Finset (Fin f)) (j : Fin f) :
    basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦
        (if i ∈ K then 1 else 0) + if i = j then 1 else 0) =
      basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦ if i ∈ K then 1 else 0) + p ^ j.val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [basePDigitValue, Nat.add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: KLSposet.basePDigitValue_two_supports
statement:
theorem basePDigitValue_two_supports {p f : Nat}
    (K S : Finset (Fin f)) :
    basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦
        2 * (if i ∈ K then 1 else 0) + if i ∈ S then 1 else 0) =
      2 * basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦ if i ∈ K then 1 else 0) +
        basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦ if i ∈ S then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [basePDigitValue, Nat.add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.mul_sum]

name: KLSposet.criticalTarget_exponentWitnesses_classification
statement:
theorem criticalTarget_exponentWitnesses_classification
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hpair : ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
      sigma.t = niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K ∧
      sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) Kᶜ)
    (hsingleton : ∀ j : ZMod f, ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
      sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j} =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K)
    (hu : ∀ j, sigma.u j = 0 ∨ sigma.u j = p - 1) :
    sigma = PhantomWeight.unramified p f 0 ∨
      sigma = PhantomWeight.critical p f 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hpair with ⟨K, hleft, hright⟩
  let K0 := normalizedReverseProfileSupport K
  let S := criticalCoordinateSupport sigma
  have hK0 : K0 ≠ Finset.univ := by
    exact normalizedReverseProfileSupport_ne_univ (by omega) K
  have hdet : sigma.t =
      (((p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦
        if i ∈ K0 then 1 else 0) : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) := by
    calc
      sigma.t = niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K := hleft
      _ = (((p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f (reverseProfileDigits K) : Nat) :
          ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :=
        critical_niveauOneProfileSum_eq_basePDigitValue hp hf 0 K
      _ = (((p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦
          if i ∈ K0 then 1 else 0) : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :=
        normalizedReverseProfileSupport_cast hp (by omega) K
  have hwitness : ∀ j, j ∈ S → ∃ b : Fin f → Nat, (∀ i, b i ≤ 1) ∧
      Nat.ModEq (basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 1))
        (basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦
          (if i ∈ K0 then 1 else 0) + if i = j then 1 else 0))
        (basePDigitValue p f b) := by
    intro j hj
    have hcoord : sigma.u (reverseIndex j) = p - 1 := by
      exact (mem_criticalCoordinateSupport sigma j).mp hj
    rcases hsingleton (reverseIndex j) with ⟨Kj, hKj⟩
    refine ⟨reverseProfileDigits Kj, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      by_cases hi : reverseIndex i ∈ Kj <;> simp [reverseProfileDigits, hi]
    · have hcast :
          (((p - 1) *
              (basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦ if i ∈ K0 then 1 else 0) +
                p ^ j.val) : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) =
            (((p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f (reverseProfileDigits Kj) : Nat) :
              ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) := by
        calc
          (((p - 1) *
              (basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦ if i ∈ K0 then 1 else 0) +
                p ^ j.val) : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) =
              (((p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f
                    (fun i ↦ if i ∈ K0 then 1 else 0) : Nat) :
                  ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) +
                (((p - 1) * p ^ j.val : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) := by
                    push_cast
                    ring
          _ = sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {reverseIndex j} := by
            rw [hdet, niveauOneProfileSum_singleton_reverseIndex hp hf sigma j hcoord]
          _ = niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) Kj := hKj
          _ = (((p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f
                (reverseProfileDigits Kj) : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :=
            critical_niveauOneProfileSum_eq_basePDigitValue hp hf 0 Kj
      rw [basePDigitValue_add_singleton]
      exact basePDigitFactor_cancel hp (by omega) hcast
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint K0 S :=
    basePDigitSingleton_congruences_disjoint hp (by omega) K0 S hK0 hwitness
  have hfull : niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ =
      (((p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦
        if i ∈ S then 1 else 0) : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :=
    niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_basePDigitValue_of_dichotomy hp hf sigma hu
  have hsumzero : 2 * sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ = 0 := by
    calc
      2 * sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ =
          sigma.t + (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ) := by ring
      _ = niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K +
          niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) Kᶜ := by
        rw [hright, hleft]
      _ = 0 := critical_niveauOneProfileSum_add_compl_eq_zero hp hf 0 K
  have hcastFinal :
      (((p - 1) *
        (2 * basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦ if i ∈ K0 then 1 else 0) +
          basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦ if i ∈ S then 1 else 0)) : Nat) :
          ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) =
        (((p - 1) * 0 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) := by
    calc
      (((p - 1) *
        (2 * basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦ if i ∈ K0 then 1 else 0) +
          basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦ if i ∈ S then 1 else 0)) : Nat) :
          ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) =
        2 * (((p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f
          (fun i ↦ if i ∈ K0 then 1 else 0) : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) +
          (((p - 1) * basePDigitValue p f
            (fun i ↦ if i ∈ S then 1 else 0) : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) := by
          push_cast
          ring
      _ = 2 * sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ := by
        rw [hdet, hfull]
      _ = 0 := hsumzero
      _ = (((p - 1) * 0 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) := by simp
  have hcong : Nat.ModEq (basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 1))
      (basePDigitValue p f (fun i ↦
        2 * (if i ∈ K0 then 1 else 0) + if i ∈ S then 1 else 0))
      (basePDigitValue p f (fun _ ↦ 0)) := by
    rw [basePDigitValue_two_supports]
    simpa [basePDigitValue] using
      basePDigitFactor_cancel hp (by omega) hcastFinal
  rcases basePDigitDisjoint_congruence_classification hp (by omega) K0 S
      hdisjoint hK0 hcong with ⟨hKempty, hSempty | hSfull⟩
  · left
    apply PhantomWeight.ext
    · funext j
      rcases hu j with hj | hj
      · simpa [PhantomWeight.unramified, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] using hj
      · let i := (reverseIndexEquiv f (by omega)).symm j
        have hindex : reverseIndex i = j := by
          rw [← reverseIndexEquiv_apply (by omega)]
          exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply (reverseIndexEquiv f (by omega)) j
        have hi : i ∈ S := by
          rw [mem_criticalCoordinateSupport, hindex]
          exact hj
        rw [hSempty] at hi
        simp at hi
    · have ht : sigma.t = 0 := by
        simpa [hKempty, basePDigitValue] using hdet
      simpa [PhantomWeight.unramified, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] using ht
  · right
    apply PhantomWeight.ext
    · funext j
      let i := (reverseIndexEquiv f (by omega)).symm j
      have hindex : reverseIndex i = j := by
        rw [← reverseIndexEquiv_apply (by omega)]
        exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply (reverseIndexEquiv f (by omega)) j
      have hi : i ∈ S := by simp [hSfull]
      have hcoord := (mem_criticalCoordinateSupport sigma i).mp hi
      simpa [hindex, PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] using hcoord
    · have ht : sigma.t = 0 := by
        simpa [hKempty, basePDigitValue] using hdet
      simpa [PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] using ht

name: KLSposet.criticalTarget_relativeExponentWitnesses_of_subset
statement:
theorem criticalTarget_relativeExponentWitnesses_of_subset
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.critical p f t)) :
    (∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
      sigma.t - t = niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K ∧
      (sigma.t - t) + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) Kᶜ) ∧
    (∀ j : ZMod f, ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
      (sigma.t - t) + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j} =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rcases criticalTarget_niveauOneProfileWitness_of_subset hp hf chars
        sigma t hsubset ∅ with ⟨K, hpair⟩
    have hexp := niveauOneProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq
      (by omega) hf chars sigma (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) ∅ K hpair
    change OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma ∅)
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma ∅ᶜ) =
      OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
        (t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) K)
        (t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) Kᶜ) at hexp
    injection hexp with hleft hright
    refine ⟨K, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc
        sigma.t - t =
            (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma ∅) - t := by
              simp [niveauOneProfileSum]
        _ = (t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) K) - t := by
          rw [hleft]
        _ = niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K := by
          change (t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K) - t = _
          ring
    · calc
        (sigma.t - t) + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ =
            (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ) - t := by ring
        _ = (t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) Kᶜ) - t := by
          simpa using congrArg (fun x ↦ x - t) hright
        _ = niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) Kᶜ := by
          change (t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) Kᶜ) - t = _
          ring
  · intro j
    rcases criticalTarget_niveauOneProfileWitness_of_subset hp hf chars
        sigma t hsubset {j} with ⟨K, hpair⟩
    have hexp := niveauOneProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq
      (by omega) hf chars sigma (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) {j} K hpair
    change OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j})
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j}ᶜ) =
      OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
        (t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) K)
        (t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) Kᶜ) at hexp
    injection hexp with hleft _
    refine ⟨K, ?_⟩
    calc
      (sigma.t - t) + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j} =
          (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j}) - t := by ring
      _ = (t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) K) - t := by
        rw [hleft]
      _ = niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K := by
        change (t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K) - t = _
        ring

name: KLSposet.criticalTarget_subset_classification
statement:
theorem criticalTarget_subset_classification
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.critical p f t)) :
    sigma = PhantomWeight.unramified p f t ∨
      sigma = PhantomWeight.critical p f t
proof:
:= by
  let tau : PhantomWeight p f :=
    { u := sigma.u
      u_le := sigma.u_le
      t := sigma.t - t }
  rcases criticalTarget_relativeExponentWitnesses_of_subset hp hf chars sigma t
      hsubset with ⟨hpair, hsingleton⟩
  have hpairTau : ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
      tau.t = niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K ∧
      tau.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf tau Set.univ =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) Kᶜ := by
    simpa only [tau, niveauOneProfileSum] using hpair
  have hsingletonTau : ∀ j : ZMod f, ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
      tau.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf tau {j} =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.critical p f 0) K := by
    simpa only [tau, niveauOneProfileSum] using hsingleton
  have hu : ∀ j, tau.u j = 0 ∨ tau.u j = p - 1 :=
    (criticalTarget_niveauOneExponentWitnesses_force_coordinates hp hf tau
      ⟨hpairTau.choose, hpairTau.choose_spec.1⟩ hsingletonTau).2
  rcases criticalTarget_exponentWitnesses_classification hp hf tau hpairTau
      hsingletonTau hu with htau | htau
  · left
    apply PhantomWeight.ext
    · have h := congrArg PhantomWeight.u htau
      simpa [tau, PhantomWeight.unramified, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] using h
    · have h := congrArg PhantomWeight.t htau
      simp only [tau, PhantomWeight.unramified, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] at h
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
  · right
    apply PhantomWeight.ext
    · have h := congrArg PhantomWeight.u htau
      simpa [tau, PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] using h
    · have h := congrArg PhantomWeight.t htau
      simp only [tau, PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] at h
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h

name: KLSposet.unramified_profileCharacterPair_isScalar
statement:
theorem unramified_profileCharacterPair_isScalar
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) (P : Profile f) :
    (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars
      (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t) P).IsScalar
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | niveauOne J =>
      simp [OrderedCharacterPair.IsScalar, profileCharacterPair,
        niveauOneCharacterProduct, PhantomWeight.unramified,
        PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      simp [OrderedCharacterPair.IsScalar, profileCharacterPair,
        niveauTwoCharacterProduct, PhantomWeight.periodicU,
        PhantomWeight.unramified, PhantomWeight.constantWeight]

name: KLSposet.unramified_profileCharacterPair_eq_critical_empty
statement:
theorem unramified_profileCharacterPair_eq_critical_empty
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) (P : Profile f) :
    profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t) P =
      profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) (.niveauOne ∅)
proof:
:= by
  have hcriticalEmpty : niveauOneProfileSum hf
      (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) = 0 := by
    simp [niveauOneProfileSum]
  have hcriticalFull : niveauOneProfileSum hf
      (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) (Set.univ : Set (ZMod f)) = 0 :=
    critical_niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_zero hp hf t
  rw [profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents,
    profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents]
  cases P with
  | niveauOne J =>
      have hsource : niveauOneProfileSum hf
          (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t) J = 0 := by
        simp [niveauOneProfileSum, PhantomWeight.unramified,
          PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
      have hsourceCompl : niveauOneProfileSum hf
          (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t) Jᶜ = 0 := by
        simp [niveauOneProfileSum, PhantomWeight.unramified,
          PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
      simp only [profileCharacterExponents, realizeOrderedCharacterExponents,
        Set.compl_empty]
      rw [hsource, hsourceCompl, hcriticalEmpty, hcriticalFull]
      rfl
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      have hsource : niveauTwoProfileSum hf
          (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t) J = 0 := by
        simp [niveauTwoProfileSum, PhantomWeight.periodicU,
          PhantomWeight.unramified, PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
      have hsourceCompl : niveauTwoProfileSum hf
          (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t) Jᶜ = 0 := by
        simp [niveauTwoProfileSum, PhantomWeight.periodicU,
          PhantomWeight.unramified, PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
      simp only [profileCharacterExponents, realizeOrderedCharacterExponents,
        Set.compl_empty]
      rw [hsource, hsourceCompl, hcriticalEmpty]
      simp only [add_zero, OrderedCharacterPair.mk.injEq]
      constructor
      · exact (niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne
          (by omega) hf chars t).symm
      · rw [hcriticalFull, add_zero]
        exact (niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne
          (by omega) hf chars t).symm

name: KLSposet.unramified_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_critical
statement:
theorem unramified_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_critical
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t) ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.critical p f t)
proof:
:= by
  rintro rho ⟨P, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨.niveauOne ∅,
    (unramified_profileCharacterPair_eq_critical_empty hp hf chars t P).symm⟩

name: KLSposet.unramified_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset_critical
statement:
theorem unramified_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset_critical
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t) ⊂
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.critical p f t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne]
  refine ⟨unramified_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_critical hp hf chars t, ?_⟩
  let K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf ∅ 0
  let hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K :=
    shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf ∅ 0
  let rho := profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars
    (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) (.niveauTwo K hK)
  have hcritical : rho ∈ semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
      (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) := ⟨.niveauTwo K hK, rfl⟩
  have hunramified : rho ∉ semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
      (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t) := by
    rintro ⟨P, hP⟩
    have hscalar : rho.IsScalar := by
      rw [← hP]
      exact unramified_profileCharacterPair_isScalar hp hf chars t P
    exact critical_niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_not_scalar hp hf chars t K hK hscalar
  intro heq
  apply hunramified
  rw [heq]
  exact hcritical

name: KLSposet.unramified_critical_semisimpleCharacterSet_simple
statement:
theorem unramified_critical_semisimpleCharacterSet_simple
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
    SimpleInclusionIn
      (Set.range fun sigma : PhantomWeight p f ↦
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t))
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.critical p f t))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨unramified_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset_critical hp hf chars t, ?_⟩
  rintro Z ⟨sigma, rfl⟩ ⟨hlower, hupper⟩
  have hsubset := (Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp hupper).1
  rcases criticalTarget_subset_classification hp hf chars sigma t hsubset with
    hsigma | hsigma
  · subst sigma
    exact (Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp hlower).2 rfl
  · subst sigma
    exact (Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp hupper).2 rfl

name: KLSposet.exists_cyclic_predicate_boundary
statement:
theorem exists_cyclic_predicate_boundary {n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (P : ZMod n → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (hExists : ∃ i, P i) (hNotAll : ¬ ∀ i, P i) :
    ∃ j, ¬ P (j - 1) ∧ P j
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  by_contra hBoundary
  have hstep (j : ZMod n) (hj : P j) : P (j - 1) := by
    by_contra hprev
    exact hBoundary ⟨j, hprev, hj⟩
  rcases hExists with ⟨i, hi⟩
  apply hNotAll
  intro j
  have hiter : ∀ m : Nat, P (i - (m : ZMod n)) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simpa using hi
    | succ m ih =>
        have := hstep (i - (m : ZMod n)) ih
        convert this using 1
        push_cast
        ring
  have hcast : ((((i - j).val : Nat) : ZMod n)) = i - j :=
    ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (i - j)
  have hj := hiter (i - j).val
  rw [hcast] at hj
  convert hj using 1
  ring

name: KLSposet.existsUnique_carrySignCase
statement:
theorem existsUnique_carrySignCase {n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (x : ZMod n → Int) (hNotZero : ¬ ∀ i, x i = 0) :
    ∃! c : CarrySignCase, CarrySignCase.Holds c x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hSomePositive : ∃ i, 0 < x i
  · by_cases hAllPositive : ∀ i, 0 < x i
    · refine ⟨CarrySignCase.positive, hAllPositive, ?_⟩
      intro c hc
      cases c with
      | positive => rfl
      | positiveBoundary =>
          rcases hc with ⟨j, hprev, _⟩
          have := hAllPositive (j - 1)
          omega
      | negativeBoundary =>
          have := hc.1
          rcases hSomePositive with ⟨i, hi⟩
          have := this i
          omega
      | negative =>
          rcases hSomePositive with ⟨i, hi⟩
          have := hc i
          omega
    · have hBoundary := exists_cyclic_predicate_boundary hn
          (fun i => 0 < x i) hSomePositive hAllPositive
      rcases hBoundary with ⟨j, hprev, hj⟩
      have hprev' : x (j - 1) ≤ 0 := by omega
      refine ⟨CarrySignCase.positiveBoundary, ⟨j, hprev', hj⟩, ?_⟩
      intro c hc
      cases c with
      | positive =>
          have := hc (j - 1)
          omega
      | positiveBoundary => rfl
      | negativeBoundary =>
          have := hc.1 j
          omega
      | negative =>
          have := hc j
          omega
  · have hNonpositive : ∀ i, x i ≤ 0 := by
      intro i
      by_contra hi
      exact hSomePositive ⟨i, by omega⟩
    by_cases hAllNegative : ∀ i, x i < 0
    · refine ⟨CarrySignCase.negative, hAllNegative, ?_⟩
      intro c hc
      cases c with
      | positive =>
          have := hc 0
          have := hAllNegative 0
          omega
      | positiveBoundary =>
          rcases hc with ⟨j, _, hj⟩
          have := hAllNegative j
          omega
      | negativeBoundary =>
          rcases hc.2 with ⟨j, hprev, _⟩
          have := hAllNegative (j - 1)
          omega
      | negative => rfl
    · have hSomeZero : ∃ i, x i = 0 := by
        push_neg at hAllNegative
        rcases hAllNegative with ⟨i, hi⟩
        exact ⟨i, by have := hNonpositive i; omega⟩
      have hSomeNegative : ∃ i, x i < 0 := by
        push_neg at hNotZero
        rcases hNotZero with ⟨i, hi⟩
        exact ⟨i, by have := hNonpositive i; omega⟩
      have hNotAllNegative : ¬ ∀ i, x i < 0 := by
        intro h
        rcases hSomeZero with ⟨i, hi⟩
        have := h i
        omega
      have hBoundary := exists_cyclic_predicate_boundary hn
        (fun i => x i < 0) hSomeNegative hNotAllNegative
      rcases hBoundary with ⟨j, hprev, hj⟩
      have hprev' : x (j - 1) = 0 := by
        have := hNonpositive (j - 1)
        omega
      refine ⟨CarrySignCase.negativeBoundary, ⟨hNonpositive, j, hprev', hj⟩, ?_⟩
      intro c hc
      cases c with
      | positive =>
          have := hc j
          omega
      | positiveBoundary =>
          rcases hc with ⟨i, _, hi⟩
          have := hNonpositive i
          omega
      | negativeBoundary => rfl
      | negative =>
          have := hc (j - 1)
          omega

name: KLSposet.carrySixCase_of_not_all_zero
statement:
theorem carrySixCase_of_not_all_zero {n : Nat} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (x : ZMod n → Int) (u : ZMod n → Nat)
    (hNotZero : ¬ ∀ i, x i = 0) : CarrySixCase x u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases (existsUnique_carrySignCase hn x hNotZero).exists with ⟨c, hc⟩
  cases c with
  | positive => exact .positive hc
  | positiveBoundary =>
      rcases hc with ⟨j, hprev, hcurrent⟩
      by_cases hu : u j = 0
      · exact .positiveBoundaryZero j hprev hcurrent hu
      · exact .positiveBoundaryPositive j hprev hcurrent (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hu)
  | negativeBoundary =>
      rcases hc with ⟨hall, j, hprev, hcurrent⟩
      by_cases hstring : NegativeStringToPositive x u j
      · exact .negativeBoundaryReachesPositive hall j hprev hcurrent hstring
      · exact .negativeBoundaryNoPositive hall j hprev hcurrent hstring
  | negative => exact .negative hc

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pinnedEmptyCarry_not_all_zero
statement:
theorem pinnedEmptyCarry_not_all_zero {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hne : sigma ≠ sigma') :
    ¬ ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  apply hne
  have hcarry := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty
  have hfun : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty = (fun _ => 0) :=
    funext hzero
  rw [hfun] at hcarry
  have hpair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne ∅) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
          (.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)) := by
    rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec ∅ hEmpty]
    exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f))) hEmpty
  exact phantomWeight_eq_of_niveauOne_zero_carry_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' ∅ (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty) hpair hcarry

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pinnedEmptyCarry_sixCases
statement:
theorem pinnedEmptyCarry_sixCases {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hne : sigma ≠ sigma') :
    CarrySixCase (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty) sigma.u
proof:
:=
  carrySixCase_of_not_all_zero (by omega) _ _
    (pin.pinnedEmptyCarry_not_all_zero hEmpty hne)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.exists_isMinimal_after_equivalent
statement:
theorem exists_isMinimal_after_equivalent {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    ∃ (tau : PhantomWeight p f),
      PhantomWeight.Equivalent (by omega) hf tau sigma ∧
        ∃ (minimalPin : Pinning hp hf chars tau sigma')
          (hMinimalEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
            compatibleProfiles hp hf chars tau sigma'),
          minimalPin.IsMinimal hMinimalEmpty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P : Nat → Prop := fun cost =>
    ∃ (tau : PhantomWeight p f),
      PhantomWeight.Equivalent (by omega) hf tau sigma ∧
        ∃ (candidate : Pinning hp hf chars tau sigma')
          (hCandidateEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
            compatibleProfiles hp hf chars tau sigma'),
          candidate.emptyCarryCost hCandidateEmpty = cost
  have hExists : ∃ cost, P cost := by
    refine ⟨pin.emptyCarryCost hEmpty, sigma, ?_, pin, hEmpty, rfl⟩
    exact (PhantomWeight.equivalent_isEquivalence (by omega) hf).refl sigma
  rcases Nat.find_spec hExists with
    ⟨tau, hTau, minimalPin, hMinimalEmpty, hCost⟩
  refine ⟨tau, hTau, minimalPin, hMinimalEmpty, ?_⟩
  intro rho hRho other hOtherEmpty
  have hRhoSigma : PhantomWeight.Equivalent (by omega) hf rho sigma :=
    (PhantomWeight.equivalent_isEquivalence (by omega) hf).trans hRho hTau
  have hOther : P (other.emptyCarryCost hOtherEmpty) :=
    ⟨rho, hRhoSigma, other, hOtherEmpty, rfl⟩
  rw [hCost]
  exact Nat.find_min' hExists hOther

name: KLSposet.Pinning.fixedProfilePinning_target
statement:
theorem fixedProfilePinning_target {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (J₀ : Profile f)
    (hJ₀ : J₀ ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (K₀ : Profile f) (hNiveau : J₀.niveau = K₀.niveau)
    (hPair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma J₀ =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' K₀) :
    (fixedProfilePinning J₀ K₀ hNiveau hPair).target J₀ hJ₀ = K₀
proof:
:= by
  simp [fixedProfilePinning]

name: KLSposet.Pinning.mu_emptyProfileCharacterPair_eq
statement:
theorem mu_emptyProfileCharacterPair_eq {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.MuValid j)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 1) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0) :
    profileCharacterPair hp hf chars (sigma.mu hf j valid) (.niveauOne ∅) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne ∅)
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hFull :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) Set.univ =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator hf
        (sigma.mu hf j valid) Set.univ,
      ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator hf sigma Set.univ]
    simp only [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
      Set.mem_univ, if_true]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f => ((sigma.mu hf j valid).u i : Int)) =
          (fun i => (sigma.u i : Int)) +
            (fun i => if i = j then (-1 : Int)
              else if i = j + 1 then (p : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp [PhantomWeight.mu, huj]
      · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
        · subst i
          simp [PhantomWeight.mu, hsucc, huj1]
        · simp [PhantomWeight.mu, hij, hij1]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_adjacent]
    push_cast
    rw [inversePower_succ p f (by omega) hf j]
    ring
  have hExp :
      profileCharacterExponents hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) (.niveauOne ∅) =
        profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne ∅) := by
    change OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
      (sigma.t +
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) ∅)
      (sigma.t +
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) (∅ : Set (ZMod f))ᶜ) =
      OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
      (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma ∅)
      (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma (∅ : Set (ZMod f))ᶜ)
    rw [Set.compl_empty, hFull]
    simp [niveauOneProfileSum]
  calc
    profileCharacterPair hp hf chars (sigma.mu hf j valid) (.niveauOne ∅) =
        realizeOrderedCharacterExponents hp hf chars
          (profileCharacterExponents hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) (.niveauOne ∅)) :=
      profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents hp hf chars _ _
    _ = realizeOrderedCharacterExponents hp hf chars
          (profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne ∅)) := congrArg _ hExp
    _ = profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne ∅) :=
      (profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents hp hf chars _ _).symm

name: KLSposet.Pinning.emptyCarry_targetCoordinate_eq_abs
statement:
theorem emptyCarry_targetCoordinate_eq_abs {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') (j : ZMod f) :
    (sigma'.u (j + 1) : Int) =
      |(sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) + (p : Int) *
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j -
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1)|
proof:
:= by
  have hEquation := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty (j + 1)
  have hSigned :
      (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)).sign (j + 1) *
          (sigma'.u (j + 1) : Int) =
        (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) + (p : Int) *
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j -
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1) := by
    have hEquation' :
        (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)).sign (j + 1) *
              (sigma'.u (j + 1) : Int) - (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) =
            (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j -
              pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1) := by
      simpa [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
        Profile.Contains, Profile.set] using hEquation
    omega
  have hAbs := congrArg abs hSigned
  rw [abs_mul, Profile.abs_sign, one_mul,
    abs_of_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg _)] at hAbs
  exact hAbs

name: KLSposet.Pinning.emptyCarry_forbidden_patterns
statement:
theorem emptyCarry_forbidden_patterns {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    (∀ j, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j ≠ 2) ∧
      (∀ j, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = 1 →
        ¬ pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1) < 0) ∧
      (∀ j, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = -2 →
        ¬ 0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let x := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
  have hCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty
  have hInputBound : ∀ i,
      |niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' ∅ (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty) i| ≤
        2 * (p : Int) :=
    niveauOneCarryInput_abs_le sigma sigma' ∅ (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)
  have hBoundThree : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 3 :=
    carryEquation_abs_le_three hp3 (by omega) hInputBound hCarry
  have hSuccessor_le_two (j : ZMod f) (hj : x j = 2) : x (j + 1) ≤ 2 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hSuccessor : x (j + 1) = 3 := by
      have hbounds := abs_le.mp (hBoundThree (j + 1))
      omega
    by_cases hpEq : p = 3
    · subst p
      have hAbsSuccessor : |x (j + 1)| = 3 := by
        rw [hSuccessor]
        norm_num
      have hRigid := carryEquation_abs_eq_three_rigid (by omega)
        hInputBound hCarry (j + 1) hAbsSuccessor
      have hj' : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = 2 := by
        simpa only [x] using hj
      have hSuccessor' :
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1) = 3 := by
        simpa only [x] using hSuccessor
      rcases hRigid with hPositive | hNegative
      · have := hPositive.1 j
        omega
      · have := hNegative.1 (j + 1)
        omega
    · have hp4 : 4 ≤ p := by omega
      have hBoundTwo : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 2 :=
        carryEquation_abs_le_two hp4 (by omega) hInputBound hCarry
      have hbounds := abs_le.mp (hBoundTwo (j + 1))
      omega
  constructor
  · intro j hj
    have hAbs := pin.emptyCarry_targetCoordinate_eq_abs hEmpty j
    have hu := sigma.u_le (j + 1)
    have hu' := sigma'.u_le (j + 1)
    have huInt : (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
      exact_mod_cast hu
    have hu'Int : (sigma'.u (j + 1) : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
      exact_mod_cast hu'
    have hp3Int : (3 : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
      exact_mod_cast hp3
    have hxNext := hSuccessor_le_two j hj
    dsimp only [x] at hxNext
    rw [hj] at hAbs
    have hNonnegative :
        0 ≤ (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) + (p : Int) * 2 -
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1) := by
      omega
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hNonnegative] at hAbs
    omega
  constructor
  · intro j hj hNext
    have hAbs := pin.emptyCarry_targetCoordinate_eq_abs hEmpty j
    have hu' := sigma'.u_le (j + 1)
    have hu'Int : (sigma'.u (j + 1) : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
      exact_mod_cast hu'
    rw [hj] at hAbs
    simp only [mul_one] at hAbs
    have hNonnegative :
        0 ≤ (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) + (p : Int) -
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1) := by
      have huNonnegative : 0 ≤ (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) :=
        Int.natCast_nonneg _
      omega
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hNonnegative] at hAbs
    omega
  · intro j hj hNext
    have hAbs := pin.emptyCarry_targetCoordinate_eq_abs hEmpty j
    have hu := sigma.u_le (j + 1)
    have hu' := sigma'.u_le (j + 1)
    have huInt : (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
      exact_mod_cast hu
    have hu'Int : (sigma'.u (j + 1) : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
      exact_mod_cast hu'
    have hp3Int : (3 : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
      exact_mod_cast hp3
    rw [hj] at hAbs
    have hNonpositive :
        (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) + (p : Int) * (-2) -
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1) ≤ 0 := by
      omega
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hNonpositive] at hAbs
    omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.minimal_emptyCarry_excludes_invertible_mu
statement:
theorem minimal_emptyCarry_excludes_invertible_mu
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty) :
    ∀ j, sigma.u j = 1 → sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 →
      ¬ 0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  intro j huj huj1 hxPositive
  let hmu : sigma.MuValid j := ⟨by omega, huj1⟩
  let tau := sigma.mu hf j hmu
  have hMuPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars tau (.niveauOne ∅) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne ∅) := by
    exact mu_emptyProfileCharacterPair_eq sigma j hmu huj huj1
  have hTargetPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars tau (.niveauOne ∅) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (pin.target (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty) :=
    hMuPair.trans (pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty)
  have hTargetNiveau :
      (Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f))).niveau =
        (pin.target (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty).niveau :=
    pin.target_niveau (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty
  have hTauEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars tau sigma' := by
    exact ⟨pin.target (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty, hTargetNiveau, hTargetPair⟩
  let other : Pinning hp hf chars tau sigma' :=
    fixedProfilePinning (.niveauOne ∅) (pin.target (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty)
      hTargetNiveau hTargetPair
  have hOtherCarrier :
      other.niveauOneTarget ∅ hTauEmpty = pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty := by
    have hs := other.niveauOneTarget_spec ∅ hTauEmpty
    rw [fixedProfilePinning_target (.niveauOne ∅) hTauEmpty
      (pin.target (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty) hTargetNiveau hTargetPair,
      pin.niveauOneTarget_spec] at hs
    injection hs with h
    exact h.symm
  let x := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
  let y : ZMod f → Int := fun i => if i = j then x i - 1 else x i
  change 0 < x j at hxPositive
  have hOldCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty
  have hNewCarry : CarryEquation p
      (niveauOneCarryInput tau sigma' ∅ (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)) y := by
    intro i
    have hold := hOldCarry i
    have hSelfPred : j - 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
        omega
      apply hone
      calc
        (1 : ZMod f) = j - (j - 1) := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
        omega
      apply hone
      calc
        (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp [y, x, tau, niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign,
        Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, PhantomWeight.mu,
        hSelfPred, huj] at hold ⊢
      omega
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        have hpred : j + 1 - 1 = j := by ring
        simp [y, x, tau, niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign,
          Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, PhantomWeight.mu,
          hsucc, hpred, huj1] at hold ⊢
        ring_nf at hold ⊢
        omega
      · have hpred : i - 1 ≠ j := by
          intro h
          apply hij1
          calc
            i = (i - 1) + 1 := by ring
            _ = j + 1 := by rw [h]
        simp [y, x, tau, niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign,
          Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, PhantomWeight.mu,
          hij, hij1, hpred] at hold ⊢
        exact hold
  have hOtherCarry := other.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hTauEmpty
  rw [hOtherCarrier] at hOtherCarry
  have hyEq : y = other.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hTauEmpty :=
    carryEquation_unique hp (by omega) hNewCarry hOtherCarry
  have hStep : PhantomWeight.InvertibleStep (by omega) hf sigma tau :=
    Or.inl ⟨j, hmu, huj, rfl⟩
  have hForward : PhantomWeight.Equivalent (by omega) hf sigma tau :=
    Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ hStep
  have hEquivalent : PhantomWeight.Equivalent (by omega) hf tau sigma :=
    (PhantomWeight.equivalent_isEquivalence (by omega) hf).symm hForward
  have hPointLe : ∀ i : ZMod f, Int.natAbs (y i) ≤ Int.natAbs (x i) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = j
    · subst i
      have hxNonnegative : 0 ≤ x j := by omega
      have hxSubNonnegative : 0 ≤ x j - 1 := by omega
      simp only [y, if_pos]
      have hInt : (x j - 1) ≤ x j := by omega
      have hCast :
          (Int.natAbs (x j - 1) : Int) ≤ (Int.natAbs (x j) : Int) := by
        simpa only [Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hxSubNonnegative,
          Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hxNonnegative] using hInt
      exact_mod_cast hCast
    · simp [y, hi]
  have hPointLt : Int.natAbs (y j) < Int.natAbs (x j) := by
    have hxNonnegative : 0 ≤ x j := by omega
    have hxSubNonnegative : 0 ≤ x j - 1 := by omega
    simp only [y, if_pos]
    have hInt : (x j - 1) < x j := by omega
    have hCast :
        (Int.natAbs (x j - 1) : Int) < (Int.natAbs (x j) : Int) := by
      simpa only [Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hxSubNonnegative,
        Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hxNonnegative] using hInt
    exact_mod_cast hCast
  have hSumLt :
      (∑ i : ZMod f, Int.natAbs (y i)) <
        ∑ i : ZMod f, Int.natAbs (x i) :=
    Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun i _hi => hPointLe i)
      ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, hPointLt⟩
  have hMinimalCost := hMinimal tau hEquivalent other hTauEmpty
  unfold emptyCarryCost at hMinimalCost
  rw [← hyEq] at hMinimalCost
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hMinimalCost) hSumLt

name: KLSposet.Pinning.minimal_emptyCarry_excludes_invertible_nu
statement:
theorem minimal_emptyCarry_excludes_invertible_nu
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty) :
    ∀ j, sigma.u j = 0 → sigma.u (j + 1) = p →
      ¬ pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  intro j huj huj1 hxNegative
  rcases PhantomWeight.mu_nu_inverse (by omega) hf sigma j huj huj1 with
    ⟨hnu, hmu, hInverse⟩
  let tau := sigma.nu (by omega) hf j hnu
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hTauJ : tau.u j = 1 := by
    simp [tau, PhantomWeight.nu, huj]
  have hTauJ1 : tau.u (j + 1) = 0 := by
    simp [tau, PhantomWeight.nu, hsucc, huj1]
  have hMuPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars (tau.mu hf j hmu) (.niveauOne ∅) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars tau (.niveauOne ∅) :=
    mu_emptyProfileCharacterPair_eq tau j hmu hTauJ hTauJ1
  have hTauPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars tau (.niveauOne ∅) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne ∅) := by
    rw [hInverse] at hMuPair
    exact hMuPair.symm
  have hTargetPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars tau (.niveauOne ∅) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (pin.target (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty) :=
    hTauPair.trans (pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty)
  have hTargetNiveau :
      (Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f))).niveau =
        (pin.target (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty).niveau :=
    pin.target_niveau (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty
  have hTauEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars tau sigma' := by
    exact ⟨pin.target (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty, hTargetNiveau, hTargetPair⟩
  let other : Pinning hp hf chars tau sigma' :=
    fixedProfilePinning (.niveauOne ∅) (pin.target (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty)
      hTargetNiveau hTargetPair
  have hOtherCarrier :
      other.niveauOneTarget ∅ hTauEmpty = pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty := by
    have hs := other.niveauOneTarget_spec ∅ hTauEmpty
    rw [fixedProfilePinning_target (.niveauOne ∅) hTauEmpty
      (pin.target (.niveauOne ∅) hEmpty) hTargetNiveau hTargetPair,
      pin.niveauOneTarget_spec] at hs
    injection hs with h
    exact h.symm
  let x := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
  let y : ZMod f → Int := fun i => if i = j then x i + 1 else x i
  change x j < 0 at hxNegative
  have hOldCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty
  have hNewCarry : CarryEquation p
      (niveauOneCarryInput tau sigma' ∅ (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)) y := by
    intro i
    have hold := hOldCarry i
    have hSelfPred : j - 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
        omega
      apply hone
      calc
        (1 : ZMod f) = j - (j - 1) := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp [y, x, tau, niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign,
        Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, PhantomWeight.nu,
        hSelfPred, huj] at hold ⊢
      omega
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        have hpred : j + 1 - 1 = j := by ring
        simp [y, x, tau, niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign,
          Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, PhantomWeight.nu,
          hsucc, hpred, huj1] at hold ⊢
        ring_nf at hold ⊢
        omega
      · have hpred : i - 1 ≠ j := by
          intro h
          apply hij1
          calc
            i = (i - 1) + 1 := by ring
            _ = j + 1 := by rw [h]
        simp [y, x, tau, niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign,
          Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, PhantomWeight.nu,
          hij, hij1, hpred] at hold ⊢
        exact hold
  have hOtherCarry := other.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hTauEmpty
  rw [hOtherCarrier] at hOtherCarry
  have hyEq : y = other.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hTauEmpty :=
    carryEquation_unique hp (by omega) hNewCarry hOtherCarry
  have hStep : PhantomWeight.InvertibleStep (by omega) hf sigma tau :=
    Or.inr ⟨j, hnu, huj1, rfl⟩
  have hForward : PhantomWeight.Equivalent (by omega) hf sigma tau :=
    Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ hStep
  have hEquivalent : PhantomWeight.Equivalent (by omega) hf tau sigma :=
    (PhantomWeight.equivalent_isEquivalence (by omega) hf).symm hForward
  have hPointLe : ∀ i : ZMod f, Int.natAbs (y i) ≤ Int.natAbs (x i) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = j
    · subst i
      have hxNonpositive : x j ≤ 0 := by omega
      have hxAddNonpositive : x j + 1 ≤ 0 := by omega
      simp only [y, if_pos]
      have hInt : -(x j + 1) ≤ -x j := by omega
      have hCast :
          (Int.natAbs (x j + 1) : Int) ≤ (Int.natAbs (x j) : Int) := by
        simpa only [Int.ofNat_natAbs_of_nonpos hxAddNonpositive,
          Int.ofNat_natAbs_of_nonpos hxNonpositive] using hInt
      exact_mod_cast hCast
    · simp [y, hi]
  have hPointLt : Int.natAbs (y j) < Int.natAbs (x j) := by
    have hxNonpositive : x j ≤ 0 := by omega
    have hxAddNonpositive : x j + 1 ≤ 0 := by omega
    simp only [y, if_pos]
    have hInt : -(x j + 1) < -x j := by omega
    have hCast :
        (Int.natAbs (x j + 1) : Int) < (Int.natAbs (x j) : Int) := by
      simpa only [Int.ofNat_natAbs_of_nonpos hxAddNonpositive,
        Int.ofNat_natAbs_of_nonpos hxNonpositive] using hInt
    exact_mod_cast hCast
  have hSumLt :
      (∑ i : ZMod f, Int.natAbs (y i)) <
        ∑ i : ZMod f, Int.natAbs (x i) :=
    Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun i _hi => hPointLe i)
      ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, hPointLt⟩
  have hMinimalCost := hMinimal tau hEquivalent other hTauEmpty
  unfold emptyCarryCost at hMinimalCost
  rw [← hyEq] at hMinimalCost
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hMinimalCost) hSumLt

name: KLSposet.Pinning.emptyCarry_minimal_reductions
statement:
theorem emptyCarry_minimal_reductions
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty) :
    (∀ j, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j ≠ 2) ∧
      (∀ j, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = 1 →
        ¬ pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1) < 0) ∧
      (∀ j, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = -2 →
        ¬ 0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1)) ∧
      (∀ j, sigma.u j = 1 → sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 →
        ¬ 0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j) ∧
      (∀ j, sigma.u j = 0 → sigma.u (j + 1) = p →
        ¬ pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
proof:
:= by
  have _hContainment := hsubset
  rcases pin.emptyCarry_forbidden_patterns hp3 hEmpty with ⟨hTwo, hOne, hNegTwo⟩
  exact ⟨hTwo, hOne, hNegTwo,
    pin.minimal_emptyCarry_excludes_invertible_mu hEmpty hMinimal,
    pin.minimal_emptyCarry_excludes_invertible_nu hEmpty hMinimal⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.positiveCarry_classification
statement:
theorem positiveCarry_classification
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty)
    (hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i) :
    ∃ t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1),
      (sigma = PhantomWeight.unramified p f t ∧
          sigma' = PhantomWeight.critical p f t) ∨
        (sigma = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t ∧
          sigma' = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases pin.emptyCarry_minimal_reductions hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal with
    ⟨hNoTwo, _hNoPositiveToNegative, _hNoNegativeToPositive,
      hNoInvertibleMu, _hNoInvertibleNu⟩
  have hBound : ∀ i, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
      hBound | hExceptional
    · exact hBound
    · rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, hu, hu', ht⟩
      exact False.elim
        ((exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars
          sigma sigma' hu hu' ht).1 hsubset)
  have hCarryOne : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = 1 := by
    intro i
    have hiBound := abs_le.mp (hBound i)
    have hiPositive := hPositive i
    have hiNotTwo := hNoTwo i
    omega
  have hCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty
  have hTargetNotMem : ∀ i, i ∉ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty := by
    intro i hi
    have hiEquation := hCarry i
    rw [hCarryOne (i - 1), hCarryOne i] at hiEquation
    simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi] at hiEquation
    have hu := sigma.u_le i
    have hu' := sigma'.u_le i
    have huInt : (sigma.u i : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast hu
    have hu'Int : (sigma'.u i : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast hu'
    omega
  have hCoordinateEquation : ∀ i,
      (sigma'.u i : Int) - (sigma.u i : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 := by
    intro i
    have hiEquation := hCarry i
    rw [hCarryOne (i - 1), hCarryOne i] at hiEquation
    simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hTargetNotMem i] at hiEquation
    omega
  have hSourceCases : ∀ i, sigma.u i = 0 ∨ sigma.u i = 1 := by
    intro i
    have hiEquation := hCoordinateEquation i
    have hu' := sigma'.u_le i
    have hu'Int : (sigma'.u i : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast hu'
    omega
  have hNoOneToZero : ∀ j, ¬(sigma.u j = 1 ∧ sigma.u (j + 1) = 0) := by
    intro j hLocal
    exact hNoInvertibleMu j hLocal.1 hLocal.2 (hPositive j)
  have hTargetEmpty : pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty = ∅ := by
    ext i
    simp [hTargetNotMem i]
  have hPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne ∅) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne ∅) := by
    have hPair' := pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f))) hEmpty
    rw [pin.niveauOneTarget_spec ∅ hEmpty, hTargetEmpty] at hPair'
    exact hPair'
  have htDifference : sigma'.t - sigma.t = 0 := by
    have hCongruence := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
      sigma sigma' ∅ ∅ hPair
    simpa [niveauOneProfileSum] using hCongruence.symm
  have ht : sigma'.t = sigma.t := sub_eq_zero.mp htDifference
  by_cases hAllZero : ∀ i, sigma.u i = 0
  · refine ⟨sigma.t, Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · apply PhantomWeight.ext
      · funext i
        simp [PhantomWeight.unramified, PhantomWeight.constantWeight, hAllZero i]
      · rfl
    · apply PhantomWeight.ext
      · funext i
        have hiEquation := hCoordinateEquation i
        have hiZero := hAllZero i
        simp only [PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
        omega
      · exact ht
  · have hAllOne : ∀ i, sigma.u i = 1 := by
      by_contra hNotAllOne
      push_neg at hNotAllOne
      rcases hNotAllOne with ⟨i, hiNotOne⟩
      have hiZero : sigma.u i = 0 := (hSourceCases i).resolve_right hiNotOne
      have hSomeOne : ∃ k, sigma.u k = 1 := by
        push_neg at hAllZero
        rcases hAllZero with ⟨k, hkNotZero⟩
        exact ⟨k, (hSourceCases k).resolve_left hkNotZero⟩
      have hBoundary := exists_cyclic_predicate_boundary (by omega)
        (fun k : ZMod f => sigma.u k = 0) ⟨i, hiZero⟩ (by
          intro hall
          rcases hSomeOne with ⟨k, hk⟩
          rw [hall k] at hk
          omega)
      rcases hBoundary with ⟨j, hjPrev, hj⟩
      have hjPrevOne : sigma.u (j - 1) = 1 :=
        (hSourceCases (j - 1)).resolve_left hjPrev
      apply hNoOneToZero (j - 1)
      constructor
      · exact hjPrevOne
      · simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hj
    refine ⟨sigma.t, Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · apply PhantomWeight.ext
      · funext i
        simp [PhantomWeight.barsottiTate, PhantomWeight.constantWeight, hAllOne i]
      · rfl
    · apply PhantomWeight.ext
      · funext i
        have hiEquation := hCoordinateEquation i
        have hiOne := hAllOne i
        simp only [PhantomWeight.steinberg, PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
        omega
      · exact ht

name: KLSposet.Pinning.positiveBoundary_zeroString
statement:
theorem positiveBoundary_zeroString
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty) (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) ≤ 0)
    (hCurrent : 0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j) :
    ∃ length : Nat,
      (∀ k : Nat, k ≤ length →
        0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + (k : ZMod f))) ∧
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (j + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0 ∧
      ∀ k : Nat, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
        sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  let x := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
  change x (j - 1) ≤ 0 at hPrev
  change 0 < x j at hCurrent
  change ∃ length : Nat,
    (∀ k : Nat, k ≤ length → 0 < x (j + (k : ZMod f))) ∧
      x (j + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0 ∧
      ∀ k : Nat, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
        sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0
  have hLastCast : ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) = -1 := by
    have hfSplit : f = (f - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hCast := congrArg (fun n : Nat => (n : ZMod f)) hfSplit
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hCast
    calc
      ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) = (f : ZMod f) - 1 := by rw [hCast]; ring
      _ = 0 - 1 := by rw [ZMod.natCast_self]
      _ = -1 := by ring
  let Exit : Nat → Prop := fun m =>
    1 ≤ m ∧ x (j + (m : ZMod f)) ≤ 0
  have hExit : ∃ m : Nat, Exit m := by
    refine ⟨f - 1, by omega, ?_⟩
    simpa only [hLastCast, sub_eq_add_neg] using hPrev
  let length := Nat.find hExit - 1
  have hFind := Nat.find_spec hExit
  have hFindPositive : 1 ≤ Nat.find hExit := hFind.1
  have hLengthEnd : length + 1 = Nat.find hExit := by
    dsimp only [length]
    omega
  have hRunPositive : ∀ k : Nat, k ≤ length →
      0 < x (j + (k : ZMod f)) := by
    intro k hk
    by_contra hnot
    have hkNonpositive : x (j + (k : ZMod f)) ≤ 0 := by omega
    by_cases hkZero : k = 0
    · subst k
      exact hnot (by simpa using hCurrent)
    · have hkPositive : 1 ≤ k := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hkZero
      have hFindLe : Nat.find hExit ≤ k :=
        Nat.find_min' hExit ⟨hkPositive, hkNonpositive⟩
      dsimp only [length] at hk
      omega
  rcases pin.emptyCarry_minimal_reductions hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal with
    ⟨hNoTwo, hNoPositiveToNegative, _hNoNegativeToPositive,
      hNoInvertibleMu, _hNoInvertibleNu⟩
  have hBound : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
      hSharp | hExceptional
    · simpa only [x] using hSharp
    · rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, hu, hu', ht⟩
      exact False.elim
        ((exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars
          sigma sigma' hu hu' ht).1 hsubset)
  have hRunOne : ∀ k : Nat, k ≤ length →
      x (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 1 := by
    intro k hk
    have hbounds := abs_le.mp (hBound (j + (k : ZMod f)))
    have hpositive := hRunPositive k hk
    have hnotTwo := hNoTwo (j + (k : ZMod f))
    change x (j + (k : ZMod f)) ≠ 2 at hnotTwo
    omega
  have hEndNonpositive :
      x (j + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) ≤ 0 := by
    have hLengthEndCast :
        ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) = (Nat.find hExit : ZMod f) :=
      congrArg (fun n : Nat => (n : ZMod f)) hLengthEnd
    rw [hLengthEndCast]
    exact hFind.2
  have hSuccessorIndex :
      (j + (length : ZMod f)) + 1 =
        j + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
    push_cast
    ring
  have hEndZero : x (j + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0 := by
    have hNotNegative := hNoPositiveToNegative (j + (length : ZMod f))
      (hRunOne length le_rfl)
    change ¬x ((j + (length : ZMod f)) + 1) < 0 at hNotNegative
    rw [hSuccessorIndex] at hNotNegative
    omega
  have hEndSourceZero :
      sigma.u (j + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0 := by
    have hAbs := pin.emptyCarry_targetCoordinate_eq_abs hEmpty
      (j + (length : ZMod f))
    change (sigma'.u ((j + (length : ZMod f)) + 1) : Int) =
      |(sigma.u ((j + (length : ZMod f)) + 1) : Int) +
          (p : Int) * x (j + (length : ZMod f)) -
        x ((j + (length : ZMod f)) + 1)| at hAbs
    rw [hSuccessorIndex, hRunOne length le_rfl, hEndZero] at hAbs
    simp only [mul_one, sub_zero] at hAbs
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)] at hAbs
    have hu' := sigma'.u_le (j + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f))
    have hu'Int :
        (sigma'.u (j + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) : Int) ≤
          (p : Int) := by
      exact_mod_cast hu'
    omega
  have hSourceCases : ∀ k : Nat, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length →
      sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0 ∨
        sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 1 := by
    intro k hkPositive hkLength
    have hkSplit : k = (k - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hIndex :
        (j + ((k - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) + 1 = j + (k : ZMod f) := by
      rw [hkSplit]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hAbs := pin.emptyCarry_targetCoordinate_eq_abs hEmpty
      (j + ((k - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f))
    change (sigma'.u ((j + ((k - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) + 1) : Int) =
      |(sigma.u ((j + ((k - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) + 1) : Int) +
          (p : Int) * x (j + ((k - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) -
            x ((j + ((k - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) + 1)| at hAbs
    rw [hIndex, hRunOne (k - 1) (by omega), hRunOne k hkLength] at hAbs
    simp only [mul_one] at hAbs
    have hAbsNonnegative :
        0 ≤ (sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) : Int) + (p : Int) - 1 := by
      have hpInt : (1 : Int) ≤ p := by
        exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ p by omega)
      have huNonnegative :
          0 ≤ (sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) : Int) := Int.natCast_nonneg _
      omega
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hAbsNonnegative] at hAbs
    have hu' := sigma'.u_le (j + (k : ZMod f))
    have hu'Int : (sigma'.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
      exact_mod_cast hu'
    omega
  have hBackwardStep : ∀ k : Nat, 1 ≤ k → k < length + 1 →
      sigma.u (j + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0 →
        sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0 := by
    intro k hkPositive hkLength hSuccessorZero
    rcases hSourceCases k hkPositive (by omega) with hZero | hOne
    · exact hZero
    · exfalso
      have hIndex :
          (j + (k : ZMod f)) + 1 =
            j + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      have hNoLocal := hNoInvertibleMu (j + (k : ZMod f)) hOne
        (by simpa only [hIndex] using hSuccessorZero)
      apply hNoLocal
      exact hRunPositive k (by omega)
  refine ⟨length, hRunPositive, hEndZero, ?_⟩
  intro k hkPositive hkLength
  exact Nat.decreasingInduction' (m := k) (n := length + 1)
    (fun r hr hkr ih => hBackwardStep r (le_trans hkPositive hkr) hr ih)
    hkLength hEndSourceZero

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeBoundary_singleton_alternative
statement:
theorem negativeBoundary_singleton_alternative
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') (j : ZMod f)
    (hSingleton : Profile.niveauOne ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    ((p : Int) * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j - 1) =
        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j) ∨
      ((sigma.u j : Int) =
        (p : Int) *
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j - 1) -
          pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j)
proof:
:= by
  exact
    (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty {j} hSingleton j).1
      (Set.mem_singleton j)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeBoundary_emptyCarry_coordinate
statement:
theorem negativeBoundary_emptyCarry_coordinate
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0) :
    j ∉ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty ∧
      (sigma'.u j : Int) =
        (sigma.u j : Int) - pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j ∧
      (sigma.u j : Int) ≤
        (p : Int) + pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j
proof:
:= by
  have hEquation := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty j
  have hu' := sigma'.u_le j
  have hu'Int : (sigma'.u j : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
    exact_mod_cast hu'
  by_cases hjTarget : j ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty
  · simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hjTarget, hPrev] at hEquation
    have huNonnegative : (0 : Int) ≤ sigma.u j := by positivity
    have hu'Nonnegative : (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.u j := by positivity
    omega
  · refine ⟨hjTarget, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
        Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hjTarget, hPrev] at hEquation
      omega
    · simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
        Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hjTarget, hPrev] at hEquation
      omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeBoundary_singleton_local_consequences
statement:
theorem negativeBoundary_singleton_local_consequences
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') (j : ZMod f)
    (hSingleton : Profile.niveauOne ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
    (huPositive : 0 < sigma.u j) :
    pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j =
        -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j ∧
      pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j = 0
proof:
:= by
  let sPrev :=
    pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j - 1)
  let sAt := pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j
  let dPrev :=
    pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j - 1)
  let dAt := pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j
  let xAt := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j
  change xAt < 0 at hCurrent
  have hBounds :=
    (pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hsPrevBound : |sPrev| ≤ 2 := hBounds.1 (j - 1)
  have hsAtBound : |sAt| ≤ 2 := hBounds.1 j
  have hdPrevBound : |dPrev| ≤ 2 := hBounds.2 (j - 1)
  have hdAtBound : |dAt| ≤ 2 := hBounds.2 j
  have hSigns := pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception hp3
    hNotExceptional hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j (by
      simpa only [baseCarryAt] using hCurrent)
  have hsAtNonpositive : sAt ≤ 0 := by simpa only [sAt] using hSigns.1
  have hdAtNonnegative : 0 ≤ dAt := by simpa only [dAt] using hSigns.2
  have hDoubleSum := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
    (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j
  have hDoubleDifference := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
    (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt]
    at hDoubleSum hDoubleDifference
  have hRelation : sAt - dAt = xAt := by
    dsimp only [sAt, dAt, xAt]
    omega
  have huUpper :=
    (pin.negativeBoundary_emptyCarry_coordinate hEmpty j hPrev hCurrent).2.2
  change (sigma.u j : Int) ≤ (p : Int) + xAt at huUpper
  have hAlternative :=
    pin.negativeBoundary_singleton_alternative hEmpty j hSingleton
  change (p : Int) * sPrev = sAt ∨
    (sigma.u j : Int) = (p : Int) * dPrev - dAt at hAlternative
  rcases hAlternative with hSumRecurrence | hDifferenceEquation
  · have hZero :=
      boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3 hsPrevBound hsAtBound hSumRecurrence
    have hsAtZero : sAt = 0 := hZero.2
    have hdAtEq : dAt = -xAt := by omega
    exact ⟨by simpa only [dAt, xAt] using hdAtEq,
      by simpa only [sAt] using hsAtZero⟩
  · rcases abs_le.mp hdPrevBound with ⟨hdPrevLower, hdPrevUpper⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hdAtBound with ⟨hdAtLower, hdAtUpper⟩
    have huPositiveInt : (0 : Int) < sigma.u j := by exact_mod_cast huPositive
    have hdPrevEq : dPrev = 1 := by
      interval_cases dPrev <;> omega
    rw [hdPrevEq, mul_one] at hDifferenceEquation
    have hdLower : -xAt ≤ dAt := by omega
    have hdUpper : dAt ≤ -xAt := by omega
    have hdAtEq : dAt = -xAt := le_antisymm hdUpper hdLower
    have hsAtZero : sAt = 0 := by omega
    exact ⟨by simpa only [dAt, xAt] using hdAtEq,
      by simpa only [sAt] using hsAtZero⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeBoundary_singleton_successor_alternative
statement:
theorem negativeBoundary_singleton_successor_alternative
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') (j : ZMod f)
    (hSingleton : Profile.niveauOne ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hDifferenceAt :
      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j =
        -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j)
    (hSumAt : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j = 0) :
    ((sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) =
        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j + 1)) ∨
      (pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j + 1) =
        -(p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j)
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hNotMem : j + 1 ∉ ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hsucc
  rcases
      (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty {j} hSingleton
        (j + 1)).2 hNotMem with hSum | hDifference
  · left
    have hIndex : j + 1 - 1 = j := by ring
    rw [hIndex, hSumAt] at hSum
    omega
  · right
    have hIndex : j + 1 - 1 = j := by ring
    rw [hIndex, hDifferenceAt] at hDifference
    calc
      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j + 1) =
          (p : Int) * -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j :=
        hDifference.symm
      _ = -(p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j := by ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeBoundary_singleton_successor_positive
statement:
theorem negativeBoundary_singleton_successor_positive
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
