    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') (j : ZMod f)
    (hSingleton : Profile.niveauOne ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
    (hNextNonpositive : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1) ≤ 0)
    (hDifferenceAt :
      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j =
        -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j)
    (hSumAt : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j = 0)
    (huNextPositive : 0 < sigma.u (j + 1)) :
    pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1) = 0 ∧
      sigma.u (j + 1) = 1 ∧
      pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j + 1) = 1 ∧
      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j + 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let xAt := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j
  let xNext := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1)
  let sNext := pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j + 1)
  let dNext :=
    pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j + 1)
  change xAt < 0 at hCurrent
  change xNext ≤ 0 at hNextNonpositive
  have hBaseBound :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hProfileBound :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 {j} hSingleton).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hPairedBounds :=
    (pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hxAtBound : |xAt| ≤ 2 := hBaseBound j
  have hxNextBound : |xNext| ≤ 2 := hBaseBound (j + 1)
  have hsNextBound : |sNext| ≤ 2 := hPairedBounds.1 (j + 1)
  have hdNextBound : |dNext| ≤ 2 := hPairedBounds.2 (j + 1)
  have hAlternative := pin.negativeBoundary_singleton_successor_alternative
    hEmpty j hSingleton hDifferenceAt hSumAt
  change (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) = sNext ∨
    dNext = -(p : Int) * xAt at hAlternative
  have hSourceEq : (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) = sNext := by
    rcases hAlternative with hSum | hDifference
    · exact hSum
    · rcases abs_le.mp hxAtBound with ⟨hxAtLower, hxAtUpper⟩
      rcases abs_le.mp hdNextBound with ⟨hdNextLower, hdNextUpper⟩
      interval_cases xAt <;> omega
  have hsNextPositive : 0 < sNext := by
    have huNextPositiveInt : (0 : Int) < sigma.u (j + 1) := by
      exact_mod_cast huNextPositive
    omega
  have hxNextZero : xNext = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hxNextNegative : xNext < 0 := by omega
    have hSigns := pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception hp3
      hNotExceptional hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j + 1) (by
        simpa only [baseCarryAt] using hxNextNegative)
    have : sNext ≤ 0 := by simpa only [sNext] using hSigns.1
    omega
  have hDoubleSum := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
    (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j + 1)
  have hDoubleDifference := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
    (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton (j + 1)
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hDoubleSum hDoubleDifference
  change 2 * sNext =
    pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry {j} hSingleton (j + 1) + xNext at hDoubleSum
  have hCarryAtBound := abs_le.mp (hProfileBound (j + 1))
  have hsNextEq : sNext = 1 := by
    rcases abs_le.mp hsNextBound with ⟨hsNextLower, hsNextUpper⟩
    omega
  have hRelation : sNext - dNext = xNext := by
    dsimp only [sNext, dNext, xNext]
    omega
  have hdNextEq : dNext = 1 := by omega
  have huNextEq : sigma.u (j + 1) = 1 := by
    have hSourceEq' : (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) = 1 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast hSourceEq'
  exact ⟨by simpa only [xNext] using hxNextZero, huNextEq,
    by simpa only [sNext] using hsNextEq,
    by simpa only [dNext] using hdNextEq⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeBoundary_successor_zero_of_three_le
statement:
theorem negativeBoundary_successor_zero_of_three_le
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hf3 : 3 ≤ f)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') (j : ZMod f)
    (hSingleton : Profile.niveauOne ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hAllNonpositive : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i ≤ 0)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
    (hDifferenceAt :
      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j =
        -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j)
    (hSumAt : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton j = 0) :
    sigma.u (j + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra huNextNe
  have huNextPositive : 0 < sigma.u (j + 1) := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero huNextNe
  rcases pin.negativeBoundary_singleton_successor_positive hp3 hNotExceptional
      hEmpty j hSingleton hCurrent (hAllNonpositive (j + 1))
      hDifferenceAt hSumAt huNextPositive with
    ⟨_hxNextZero, _huNextEq, hsNextEq, hdNextEq⟩
  have hTwoNeZero : (2 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hval := congrArg ZMod.val h
    have hvalTwo : (2 : ZMod f).val = 2 :=
      ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (by omega : 2 < f)
    rw [hvalTwo] at hval
    simp at hval
  have hIndexNe : j + 2 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    apply hTwoNeZero
    calc
      (2 : ZMod f) = (j + 2) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hNotMem : j + 2 ∉ ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hIndexNe
  have hBounds :=
    (pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty (.niveauOne {j}) hSingleton).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hsAtBound := abs_le.mp (hBounds.1 (j + 2))
  have hdAtBound := abs_le.mp (hBounds.2 (j + 2))
  rcases
      (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty {j} hSingleton
        (j + 2)).2 hNotMem with hSum | hDifference
  · have hIndex : j + 2 - 1 = j + 1 := by ring
    rw [hIndex, hsNextEq] at hSum
    have huNonnegative : (0 : Int) ≤ sigma.u (j + 2) := by positivity
    omega
  · have hIndex : j + 2 - 1 = j + 1 := by ring
    rw [hIndex, hdNextEq] at hDifference
    omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeBoundary_two_cycle_configuration
statement:
theorem negativeBoundary_two_cycle_configuration
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hfEq : f = 2)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') (j : ZMod f)
    (hSingleton : Profile.niveauOne ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
    (hAllNonpositive : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i ≤ 0)
    (huPositive : 0 < sigma.u j) (huNextPositive : 0 < sigma.u (j + 1)) :
    pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = -1 ∧
      sigma.u j = p - 1 ∧ sigma.u (j + 1) = 1 ∧
      sigma'.u j = p ∧ sigma'.u (j + 1) = p - 1 ∧
      pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty = {j + 1}
proof:
:= by
  subst f
  have hIndex : j - 1 = j + 1 := by
    have hMinusOne : (-1 : ZMod 2) = 1 := by decide
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, hMinusOne]
  rcases pin.negativeBoundary_singleton_local_consequences hp3 hNotExceptional
      hEmpty j hSingleton hPrev hCurrent huPositive with
    ⟨hDifferenceAt, hSumAt⟩
  rcases pin.negativeBoundary_singleton_successor_positive hp3 hNotExceptional
      hEmpty j hSingleton hCurrent (hAllNonpositive (j + 1))
      hDifferenceAt hSumAt huNextPositive with
    ⟨hxNextZero, huNextEq, hsNextEq, hdNextEq⟩
  have hAlternative :=
    pin.negativeBoundary_singleton_alternative hEmpty j hSingleton
  have huFormula :
      (sigma.u j : Int) =
        (p : Int) + pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j := by
    rcases hAlternative with hSum | hDifference
    · rw [hIndex, hsNextEq, hSumAt] at hSum
      omega
    · rw [hIndex, hdNextEq, hDifferenceAt] at hDifference
      omega
  rcases pin.negativeBoundary_emptyCarry_coordinate hEmpty j hPrev hCurrent with
    ⟨hjNotTarget, huTargetAt, _huUpper⟩
  let xAt := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j
  change xAt < 0 at hCurrent
  change (sigma.u j : Int) = (p : Int) + xAt at huFormula
  have hxBound :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hxAtBound : |xAt| ≤ 2 := hxBound j
  have hTargetNextAbs := pin.emptyCarry_targetCoordinate_eq_abs hEmpty j
  change (sigma'.u (j + 1) : Int) =
    |(sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) + (p : Int) * xAt -
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1)| at hTargetNextAbs
  rw [huNextEq, hxNextZero, sub_zero] at hTargetNextAbs
  have huTargetNextLe := sigma'.u_le (j + 1)
  have huTargetNextLeInt : (sigma'.u (j + 1) : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
    exact_mod_cast huTargetNextLe
  have hxCases : xAt = -2 ∨ xAt = -1 := by
    rcases abs_le.mp hxAtBound with ⟨hxLower, hxUpper⟩
    omega
  have hxAtEq : xAt = -1 := by
    rcases hxCases with hxAtEq | hxAtEq
    · rw [hxAtEq] at hTargetNextAbs
      norm_num only [mul_neg, mul_one] at hTargetNextAbs
      rw [abs_of_nonpos (by omega)] at hTargetNextAbs
      omega
    · exact hxAtEq
  have huAtEq : sigma.u j = p - 1 := by
    have huAtEqInt : (sigma.u j : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 := by
      rw [hxAtEq] at huFormula
      omega
    omega
  have huTargetAtEq : sigma'.u j = p := by
    change (sigma'.u j : Int) = (sigma.u j : Int) - xAt at huTargetAt
    have huTargetAtEqInt : (sigma'.u j : Int) = (p : Int) := by
      rw [huAtEq, hxAtEq] at huTargetAt
      norm_num at huTargetAt ⊢
      omega
    exact_mod_cast huTargetAtEqInt
  have huTargetNextEq : sigma'.u (j + 1) = p - 1 := by
    have huTargetNextEqInt :
        (sigma'.u (j + 1) : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 := by
      rw [hxAtEq] at hTargetNextAbs
      norm_num only [mul_neg, mul_one] at hTargetNextAbs
      rw [abs_of_nonpos (by omega)] at hTargetNextAbs
      omega
    omega
  have hjNextTarget : j + 1 ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty := by
    by_contra hjNextNotTarget
    have hEquation := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty (j + 1)
    simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hjNextNotTarget] at hEquation
    change (sigma'.u (j + 1) : Int) - (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) =
      (p : Int) * xAt -
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1) at hEquation
    rw [huNextEq, huTargetNextEq, hxAtEq, hxNextZero] at hEquation
    norm_num at hEquation
    omega
  have hIndexCases (i : ZMod 2) : i = j ∨ i = j + 1 := by
    have hValLt : (i - j).val < 2 := ZMod.val_lt (i - j)
    have hCast : (((i - j).val : Nat) : ZMod 2) = i - j :=
      ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (i - j)
    have hResidue : i - j = 0 ∨ i - j = 1 := by
      interval_cases hVal : (i - j).val
      · left
        simpa using hCast.symm
      · right
        simpa using hCast.symm
    rcases hResidue with hZero | hOne
    · left
      calc
        i = (i - j) + j := by ring
        _ = j := by rw [hZero]; simp
    · right
      calc
        i = (i - j) + j := by ring
        _ = j + 1 := by rw [hOne]; ring
  have hTargetEq : pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty = {j + 1} := by
    ext i
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hi
      rcases hIndexCases i with hiEq | hiEq
      · subst i
        exact (hjNotTarget hi).elim
      · exact hiEq
    · intro hi
      rw [hi]
      exact hjNextTarget
  exact ⟨by simpa only [xAt] using hxAtEq, huAtEq, huNextEq,
    huTargetAtEq, huTargetNextEq, hTargetEq⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeBoundary_two_cycle_witness_incompatible
statement:
theorem negativeBoundary_two_cycle_witness_incompatible
    {p : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ 2} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p 2 I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p 2} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (j : ZMod 2)
    (huAt : sigma.u j = p - 1) (huNext : sigma.u (j + 1) = 1)
    (huTargetAt : sigma'.u j = p)
    (huTargetNext : sigma'.u (j + 1) = p - 1) :
    ∃ (J : Set (ZMod 4))
        (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + 2 ∉ J),
      Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∉
        compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma'
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases j
  · let J : Set (ZMod 4) := {0, 3}
    have hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + 2 ∉ J := by
      dsimp only [J]
      decide
    refine ⟨J, hComplementary, ?_⟩
    intro hJ
    let x := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
    let K := pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
    let hK := pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ
    let e0 := (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) K hK).sign (0 : ZMod 4)
    let e1 := (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) K hK).sign (1 : ZMod 4)
    let x0 := x (0 : ZMod 4)
    let x1 := x (1 : ZMod 4)
    have he0 : e0 = -1 ∨ e0 = 1 := by
      classical
      by_cases hMem : (0 : ZMod 4) ∈ K
      · left
        simp [e0, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
      · right
        simp [e0, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
    have he1 : e1 = -1 ∨ e1 = 1 := by
      classical
      by_cases hMem : (1 : ZMod 4) ∈ K
      · left
        simp [e1, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
      · right
        simp [e1, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
    have hBound := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ
    have hx0Bound : |x0| ≤ 2 := hBound 0
    have hx1Bound : |x1| ≤ 2 := hBound 1
    have hSpec := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ
    have hAnti := niveauTwoCarryEquation_antiPeriodic hp hf sigma sigma' J K
      hComplementary hK hSpec
    have hAntiOne := hAnti (1 : ZMod 4)
    have hEquationZero := hSpec (0 : ZMod 4)
    have hEquationOne := hSpec (1 : ZMod 4)
    have hSourceZero : sigma.periodicU hf (0 : ZMod 4) = p - 1 := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huAt
    have hSourceOne : sigma.periodicU hf (1 : ZMod 4) = 1 := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huNext
    have hTargetZero : sigma'.periodicU hf (0 : ZMod 4) = p := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huTargetAt
    have hTargetOne : sigma'.periodicU hf (1 : ZMod 4) = p - 1 := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huTargetNext
    have hSourceSignZero :
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (0 : ZMod 4) = -1 := by
      classical
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, J]
    have hSourceSignOne :
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (1 : ZMod 4) = 1 := by
      have hNotMem : (1 : ZMod 4) ∉ J := by decide
      classical
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hNotMem]
    change x (1 + 2) = -x 1 at hAntiOne
    norm_num at hAntiOne
    have hPrevious : x (-1 : ZMod 4) = -x 1 := by
      rw [show (-1 : ZMod 4) = 3 by decide]
      exact hAntiOne
    change e0 * (sigma'.periodicU hf 0 : Int) -
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (0 : ZMod 4) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf 0 : Int) =
      (p : Int) * x (0 - 1) - x 0 at hEquationZero
    change e1 * (sigma'.periodicU hf 1 : Int) -
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (1 : ZMod 4) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf 1 : Int) =
      (p : Int) * x (1 - 1) - x 1 at hEquationOne
    norm_num at hEquationZero hEquationOne
    rw [hSourceZero, hTargetZero, hSourceSignZero, hPrevious] at hEquationZero
    rw [hSourceOne, hTargetOne, hSourceSignOne] at hEquationOne
    have hCastSub : ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 := by omega
    have hEquationZero' :
        e0 * (p : Int) + ((p : Int) - 1) =
          -(p : Int) * x1 - x0 := by
      dsimp only [x0, x1]
      rw [hCastSub] at hEquationZero
      linear_combination hEquationZero
    have hEquationOne' :
        e1 * ((p : Int) - 1) - 1 =
          (p : Int) * x0 - x1 := by
      dsimp only [x0, x1]
      rw [hCastSub] at hEquationOne
      linear_combination hEquationOne
    rcases abs_le.mp hx0Bound with ⟨hx0Lower, hx0Upper⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hx1Bound with ⟨hx1Lower, hx1Upper⟩
    rcases he0 with he0 | he0 <;> rcases he1 with he1 | he1 <;>
      simp only [he0, he1] at hEquationZero' hEquationOne' <;>
      interval_cases x0 <;> interval_cases x1 <;> omega
  · let J : Set (ZMod 4) := {0, 1}
    have hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + 2 ∉ J := by
      dsimp only [J]
      decide
    refine ⟨J, hComplementary, ?_⟩
    intro hJ
    let x := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
    let K := pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
    let hK := pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ
    let e1 := (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) K hK).sign (1 : ZMod 4)
    let e2 := (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) K hK).sign (2 : ZMod 4)
    let x1 := x (1 : ZMod 4)
    let x2 := x (2 : ZMod 4)
    have he1 : e1 = -1 ∨ e1 = 1 := by
      classical
      by_cases hMem : (1 : ZMod 4) ∈ K
      · left
        simp [e1, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
      · right
        simp [e1, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
    have he2 : e2 = -1 ∨ e2 = 1 := by
      classical
      by_cases hMem : (2 : ZMod 4) ∈ K
      · left
        simp [e2, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
      · right
        simp [e2, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
    have hBound := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ
    have hx1Bound : |x1| ≤ 2 := hBound 1
    have hx2Bound : |x2| ≤ 2 := hBound 2
    have hSpec := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ
    have hAnti := niveauTwoCarryEquation_antiPeriodic hp hf sigma sigma' J K
      hComplementary hK hSpec
    have hAntiZero := hAnti (0 : ZMod 4)
    have hEquationOne := hSpec (1 : ZMod 4)
    have hEquationTwo := hSpec (2 : ZMod 4)
    have hSourceOne : sigma.periodicU hf (1 : ZMod 4) = p - 1 := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huAt
    have hSourceTwo : sigma.periodicU hf (2 : ZMod 4) = 1 := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huNext
    have hTargetOne : sigma'.periodicU hf (1 : ZMod 4) = p := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huTargetAt
    have hTargetTwo : sigma'.periodicU hf (2 : ZMod 4) = p - 1 := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huTargetNext
    have hSourceSignOne :
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (1 : ZMod 4) = -1 := by
      classical
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, J]
    have hSourceSignTwo :
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (2 : ZMod 4) = 1 := by
      have hNotMem : (2 : ZMod 4) ∉ J := by decide
      classical
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hNotMem]
    change x (0 + 2) = -x 0 at hAntiZero
    norm_num at hAntiZero
    have hPrevious : x 0 = -x 2 := by omega
    change e1 * (sigma'.periodicU hf 1 : Int) -
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (1 : ZMod 4) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf 1 : Int) =
      (p : Int) * x (1 - 1) - x 1 at hEquationOne
    change e2 * (sigma'.periodicU hf 2 : Int) -
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (2 : ZMod 4) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf 2 : Int) =
      (p : Int) * x (2 - 1) - x 2 at hEquationTwo
    norm_num at hEquationOne hEquationTwo
    rw [hSourceOne, hTargetOne, hSourceSignOne, hPrevious] at hEquationOne
    rw [hSourceTwo, hTargetTwo, hSourceSignTwo] at hEquationTwo
    have hCastSub : ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 := by omega
    have hEquationOne' :
        e1 * (p : Int) + ((p : Int) - 1) =
          -(p : Int) * x2 - x1 := by
      dsimp only [x1, x2]
      rw [hCastSub] at hEquationOne
      linear_combination hEquationOne
    have hEquationTwo' :
        e2 * ((p : Int) - 1) - 1 =
          (p : Int) * x1 - x2 := by
      dsimp only [x1, x2]
      rw [hCastSub] at hEquationTwo
      linear_combination hEquationTwo
    rcases abs_le.mp hx1Bound with ⟨hx1Lower, hx1Upper⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hx2Bound with ⟨hx2Lower, hx2Upper⟩
    rcases he1 with he1 | he1 <;> rcases he2 with he2 | he2 <;>
      simp only [he1, he2] at hEquationOne' hEquationTwo' <;>
      interval_cases x1 <;> interval_cases x2 <;> omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeBoundary_successor_zero
statement:
theorem negativeBoundary_successor_zero
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') (j : ZMod f)
    (hSingleton : Profile.niveauOne ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hAllNonpositive : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i ≤ 0)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
    (huPositive : 0 < sigma.u j) :
    sigma.u (j + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases pin.negativeBoundary_singleton_local_consequences hp3 hNotExceptional
      hEmpty j hSingleton hPrev hCurrent huPositive with
    ⟨hDifferenceAt, hSumAt⟩
  by_cases hfEq : f = 2
  · by_contra huNextNe
    have huNextPositive : 0 < sigma.u (j + 1) := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero huNextNe
    rcases pin.negativeBoundary_two_cycle_configuration hp3 hfEq hNotExceptional
        hEmpty j hSingleton hPrev hCurrent hAllNonpositive huPositive
        huNextPositive with
      ⟨_hxAt, huAt, huNext, huTargetAt, huTargetNext, _hTarget⟩
    have hTargetNoncritical :
        sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t := by
      intro hCritical
      have hCoordinate := congrArg (fun tau : PhantomWeight p f => tau.u j)
        hCritical
      simp only [PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] at hCoordinate
      omega
    subst f
    rcases pin.negativeBoundary_two_cycle_witness_incompatible hp3 j huAt
        huNext huTargetAt huTargetNext with ⟨J, hComplementary, hIncompatible⟩
    have hSource : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma
          (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) ∈
        semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma :=
      ⟨.niveauTwo J hComplementary, rfl⟩
    rcases hsubset hSource with ⟨K, hPair⟩
    have hCompatible : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
        compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' := by
      cases K with
      | niveauOne K =>
          have hScalars := crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_eq_implies_scalar
            hp hf chars sigma' sigma K J hComplementary hPair
          rcases noncritical_niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_eq_niveauOne hp3 hf
              chars sigma' K hScalars.1 hTargetNoncritical with
            ⟨L, hL, hConvert⟩
          rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
          refine ⟨.niveauTwo L hL, rfl, ?_⟩
          exact hPair.symm.trans hConvert.symm
      | niveauTwo K hK =>
          rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
          exact ⟨.niveauTwo K hK, rfl, hPair.symm⟩
    exact hIncompatible hCompatible
  · have hf3 : 3 ≤ f := by omega
    exact pin.negativeBoundary_successor_zero_of_three_le hp3 hf3
      hNotExceptional hEmpty j hSingleton hAllNonpositive hCurrent
      hDifferenceAt hSumAt

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeBoundary_current_zero_successor_zero
statement:
theorem negativeBoundary_current_zero_successor_zero
    {f : Nat} {x : ZMod f → Int} {u : ZMod f → Nat} (j : ZMod f)
    (hCurrent : x j < 0) (huZero : u j = 0)
    (hNoPositive : ¬ NegativeStringToPositive x u j) :
    u (j + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra huNextNe
  apply hNoPositive
  refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k hk
    have hkZero : k = 0 := by omega
    subst k
    simpa using And.intro hCurrent huZero
  · simpa using Nat.pos_of_ne_zero huNextNe

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeBoundary_noPositive_successor_zero
statement:
theorem negativeBoundary_noPositive_successor_zero
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') (j : ZMod f)
    (hSingleton : Profile.niveauOne ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hAllNonpositive : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i ≤ 0)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
    (hNoPositive : ¬ NegativeStringToPositive
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty) sigma.u j) :
    sigma.u (j + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases huZero : sigma.u j = 0
  · exact negativeBoundary_current_zero_successor_zero j hCurrent huZero
      hNoPositive
  · have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
      intro hExceptional
      rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, hu, hu', ht⟩
      exact (exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars sigma
        sigma' hu hu' ht).1 hsubset
    exact pin.negativeBoundary_successor_zero hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty j
      hSingleton hsubset hPrev hAllNonpositive hCurrent
      (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero huZero)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_coordinate_formula
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_all_source_positive_coordinate_formula
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < sigma.u i) :
    ∀ i, (sigma.u i : Int) = (p : Int) + 1 +
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro i
  let J : Set (ZMod f) := {i + 1}
  have hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset J
  have hPrevNot : (i + 1) - 1 ∉ J := by
    simp only [J, Set.mem_singleton_iff, add_sub_cancel_right]
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) = 0 := by
      have hSub := congrArg (fun z : ZMod f ↦ z - i) h
      simpa using hSub.symm
    rw [ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff] at hone
    omega
  have hMem : i + 1 ∈ J := by simp only [J, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  have hNextNot : (i + 1) + 1 ∉ J := by
    simp only [J, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) = 0 := by
      have hSub := congrArg (fun z : ZMod f ↦ z - (i + 1)) h
      simpa using hSub
    rw [ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff] at hone
    omega
  have hLocal := pin.niveauOne_negativeCarries_positiveCoordinates_local_consequences
    hp3 hEmpty J hJ (i + 1) hPrevNot hMem hNextNot
    (hNegative ((i + 1) - 1)) (hNegative (i + 1))
    (hNegative ((i + 1) + 1)) (hPositive ((i + 1) - 1))
    (hPositive (i + 1)) (hPositive ((i + 1) + 1))
  simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hLocal.1

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_carry_cases
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_all_source_positive_carry_cases
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < sigma.u i) :
    ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -1 ∨
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -2
proof:
:= by
  have hFormula := pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_coordinate_formula
    hp3 hsubset hEmpty hNegative hPositive
  have hBound : ∀ i, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
      hBound | hExceptional
    · exact hBound
    · rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, hu, hu', ht⟩
      exact False.elim
        ((exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars
          sigma sigma' hu hu' ht).1 hsubset)
  intro i
  have hiBound := abs_le.mp (hBound i)
  have hiNegative := hNegative i
  have huLe : (sigma.u i : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
    exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le i
  have hiFormula := hFormula i
  omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_neg_one_classification
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_all_source_positive_neg_one_classification
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < sigma.u i)
    (hAllNegOne : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -1) :
    sigma = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f sigma.t ∧
      sigma' = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) sigma.t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hFormula := pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_coordinate_formula
    hp3 hsubset hEmpty hNegative hPositive
  have hSourceCoordinates : ∀ i, sigma.u i = p := by
    intro i
    have hi := hFormula i
    rw [hAllNegOne i] at hi
    omega
  have hCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty
  have hTargetNotMem : ∀ i, i ∉ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty := by
    intro i hi
    have hEquation := hCarry i
    rw [hAllNegOne (i - 1), hAllNegOne i] at hEquation
    simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hSourceCoordinates i] at hEquation
    omega
  have hTargetCoordinates : ∀ i, sigma'.u i = 1 := by
    intro i
    have hEquation := hCarry i
    rw [hAllNegOne (i - 1), hAllNegOne i] at hEquation
    simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hTargetNotMem i, hSourceCoordinates i]
      at hEquation
    omega
  have hTargetEmpty : pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty = ∅ := by
    ext i
    simp [hTargetNotMem i]
  have hPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne ∅) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne ∅) := by
    have hPair' := pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f))) hEmpty
    rw [pin.niveauOneTarget_spec ∅ hEmpty, hTargetEmpty] at hPair'
    exact hPair'
  have hCongruence := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' ∅ ∅ hPair
  have htDifference : sigma'.t - sigma.t = 0 := by
    simpa [niveauOneProfileSum] using hCongruence.symm
  have ht : sigma'.t = sigma.t := sub_eq_zero.mp htDifference
  constructor
  · apply PhantomWeight.ext
    · funext i
      simp [PhantomWeight.steinberg, PhantomWeight.constantWeight,
        hSourceCoordinates i]
    · rfl
  · apply PhantomWeight.ext
    · funext i
      simp [PhantomWeight.barsottiTate, PhantomWeight.constantWeight,
        hTargetCoordinates i]
    · exact ht

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_neg_two_classification
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_all_source_positive_neg_two_classification
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < sigma.u i)
    (hAllNegTwo : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -2) :
    sigma = PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma.t ∧
      sigma' = PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma.t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hFormula := pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_coordinate_formula
    hp3 hsubset hEmpty hNegative hPositive
  have hSourceCoordinates : ∀ i, sigma.u i = p - 1 := by
    intro i
    have hi := hFormula i
    rw [hAllNegTwo i] at hi
    omega
  have hCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty
  have hTargetMem : ∀ i, i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty := by
    intro i
    by_contra hi
    have hEquation := hCarry i
    rw [hAllNegTwo (i - 1), hAllNegTwo i] at hEquation
    simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi, hSourceCoordinates i] at hEquation
    have huTarget := sigma'.u_le i
    omega
  have hTargetCoordinates : ∀ i, sigma'.u i = p - 1 := by
    intro i
    have hEquation := hCarry i
    rw [hAllNegTwo (i - 1), hAllNegTwo i] at hEquation
    simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hTargetMem i, hSourceCoordinates i]
      at hEquation
    omega
  have hTargetFull : pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty = Set.univ := by
    ext i
    simp [hTargetMem i]
  have hSource : sigma = PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma.t := by
    apply PhantomWeight.ext
    · funext i
      simp [PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight,
        hSourceCoordinates i]
    · rfl
  have hTarget : sigma' = PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t := by
    apply PhantomWeight.ext
    · funext i
      simp [PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight,
        hTargetCoordinates i]
    · rfl
  have hPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne ∅) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne Set.univ) := by
    have hPair' := pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f))) hEmpty
    rw [pin.niveauOneTarget_spec ∅ hEmpty, hTargetFull] at hPair'
    exact hPair'
  have hCongruence := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' ∅ Set.univ hPair
  have hTargetSum := critical_niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_zero hp3 hf sigma'.t
  rw [hTarget] at hCongruence
  rw [hTargetSum] at hCongruence
  have htDifference : sigma'.t - sigma.t = 0 := by
    simpa [niveauOneProfileSum] using hCongruence.symm
  have ht : sigma'.t = sigma.t := sub_eq_zero.mp htDifference
  exact ⟨hSource, hTarget.trans (by rw [ht])⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_mixed_transition
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_all_source_positive_mixed_transition
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < sigma.u i)
    (hNotAllNegOne : ¬ ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -1)
    (hNotAllNegTwo : ¬ ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -2) :
    ∃ j, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = -2 ∧
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hCases := pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_carry_cases hp3
    hsubset hEmpty hNegative hPositive
  push_neg at hNotAllNegOne hNotAllNegTwo
  rcases hNotAllNegOne with ⟨i, hiNotNegOne⟩
  rcases hNotAllNegTwo with ⟨k, hkNotNegTwo⟩
  have hiNegTwo : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -2 :=
    (hCases i).resolve_left hiNotNegOne
  have hkNegOne : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty k = -1 :=
    (hCases k).resolve_right hkNotNegTwo
  have hBoundary := exists_cyclic_predicate_boundary (by omega)
    (fun r : ZMod f ↦ pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty r = -1)
    ⟨k, hkNegOne⟩ (by
      intro hAll
      rw [hAll i] at hiNegTwo
      omega)
  rcases hBoundary with ⟨j, hPrevNot, hj⟩
  exact ⟨j, (hCases (j - 1)).resolve_left hPrevNot, hj⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_transition_forces_two
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_all_source_positive_transition_forces_two
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < sigma.u i) (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = -2)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = -1) :
    f = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let J : Set (ZMod f) := {j - 1}
  have hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset J
  have hOneNeZero : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
    omega
  have hPrevNot : (j - 1) - 1 ∉ J := by
    simp only [J, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    intro h
    apply hOneNeZero
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j - 1) - ((j - 1) - 1) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hMem : j - 1 ∈ J := by simp only [J, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  have hNextNot : (j - 1) + 1 ∉ J := by
    simp only [J, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    intro h
    apply hOneNeZero
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = ((j - 1) + 1) - (j - 1) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hLocal := pin.niveauOne_negativeCarries_positiveCoordinates_local_consequences
    hp3 hEmpty J hJ (j - 1) hPrevNot hMem hNextNot
    (hNegative ((j - 1) - 1)) (hNegative (j - 1))
    (hNegative ((j - 1) + 1)) (hPositive ((j - 1) - 1))
    (hPositive (j - 1)) (hPositive ((j - 1) + 1))
  have hSourceFormula := pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_coordinate_formula
    hp3 hsubset hEmpty hNegative hPositive
  have huPrev : (sigma.u (j - 1) : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 := by
    have h := hSourceFormula (j - 1)
    rw [hPrev] at h
    omega
  have hdPrev :
      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (j - 1) = 1 := by
    omega
  have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
    intro hExceptional
    rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, hu, hu', ht⟩
    exact (exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars
      sigma sigma' hu hu' ht).1 hsubset
  have hBounds :=
    (pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hsDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (j - 1)
  have hdDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (j - 1)
  have hsPrev : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (j - 1) = -1 := by
    simp only [baseCarryAt, hPrev] at hsDouble hdDouble
    omega
  have hjNot : j ∉ J := by
    simp only [J, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    intro h
    apply hOneNeZero
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = j - (j - 1) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [← h]; simp
  have huCurrent : (sigma.u j : Int) = p := by
    have h := hSourceFormula j
    rw [hCurrent] at h
    omega
  have hsCurrent : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ j = 0 := by
    rcases (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J hJ j).2
        hjNot with hSum | hDifference
    · rw [hsPrev] at hSum
      omega
    · rw [hdPrev] at hDifference
      have hdBound := abs_le.mp (hBounds.2 j)
      omega
  have hNextMem : j + 1 ∈ J :=
    pin.niveauOne_negativeCarries_positiveCoordinate_sumPrevZero_mem hp3
      hEmpty J hJ (j + 1) (by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hNegative j)
      (hNegative (j + 1)) (hPositive (j + 1))
      (by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hsCurrent)
  have hIndex : j + 1 = j - 1 := by
    simpa only [J, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hNextMem
  by_contra hfNe
  have hfGt : 2 < f := by omega
  have hTwoNeZero : (2 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hval := congrArg ZMod.val h
    have hvalTwo : (2 : ZMod f).val = 2 :=
      ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hfGt
    rw [hvalTwo] at hval
    simp at hval
  apply hTwoNeZero
  calc
    (2 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - (j - 1) := by ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [hIndex]; simp

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_mixed_configuration
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_all_source_positive_mixed_configuration
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < sigma.u i) (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = -2)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = -1) :
    f = 2 ∧ sigma.u j = p ∧ sigma.u (j + 1) = p - 1 ∧
      sigma'.u j = p - 1 ∧ sigma'.u (j + 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hfEq := pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_transition_forces_two
    hp3 hsubset hEmpty hNegative hPositive j hPrev hCurrent
  have hFormula := pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_coordinate_formula
    hp3 hsubset hEmpty hNegative hPositive
  have huAt : sigma.u j = p := by
    have h := hFormula j
    rw [hCurrent] at h
    omega
  have hIndex : j + 1 = j - 1 := by
    subst f
    fin_cases j <;> decide
  have hxNext : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1) = -2 := by
    rw [hIndex]
    exact hPrev
  have huNext : sigma.u (j + 1) = p - 1 := by
    have h := hFormula (j + 1)
    rw [hxNext] at h
    omega
  have hTargetAtRaw := pin.emptyCarry_targetCoordinate_eq_abs hEmpty (j - 1)
  have hTargetAt : (sigma'.u j : Int) =
      |(sigma.u j : Int) + (p : Int) *
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) -
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j| := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hTargetAtRaw
  have huTargetAt : sigma'.u j = p - 1 := by
    rw [huAt, hPrev, hCurrent] at hTargetAt
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by omega)] at hTargetAt
    omega
  have hTargetNext := pin.emptyCarry_targetCoordinate_eq_abs hEmpty j
  have huTargetNext : sigma'.u (j + 1) = 1 := by
    rw [huNext, hCurrent, hxNext] at hTargetNext
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by omega)] at hTargetNext
    omega
  exact ⟨hfEq, huAt, huNext, huTargetAt, huTargetNext⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_mixed_witness_incompatible
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_all_source_positive_mixed_witness_incompatible
    {p : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ 2} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p 2 I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p 2} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (j : ZMod 2)
    (huAt : sigma.u j = p) (huNext : sigma.u (j + 1) = p - 1)
    (huTargetAt : sigma'.u j = p - 1)
    (huTargetNext : sigma'.u (j + 1) = 1) :
    ∃ (J : Set (ZMod 4))
        (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + 2 ∉ J),
      Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∉
        compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma'
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases j
  · let J : Set (ZMod 4) := {0, 1}
    have hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + 2 ∉ J := by
      dsimp only [J]
      decide
    refine ⟨J, hComplementary, ?_⟩
    intro hJ
    let x := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
    let K := pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
    let hK := pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ
    let e0 := (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) K hK).sign (0 : ZMod 4)
    let e1 := (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) K hK).sign (1 : ZMod 4)
    let x0 := x (0 : ZMod 4)
    let x1 := x (1 : ZMod 4)
    have he0 : e0 = -1 ∨ e0 = 1 := by
      classical
      by_cases hMem : (0 : ZMod 4) ∈ K
      · left
        simp [e0, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
      · right
        simp [e0, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
    have he1 : e1 = -1 ∨ e1 = 1 := by
      classical
      by_cases hMem : (1 : ZMod 4) ∈ K
      · left
        simp [e1, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
      · right
        simp [e1, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
    have hBound := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ
    have hx0Bound : |x0| ≤ 2 := hBound 0
    have hx1Bound : |x1| ≤ 2 := hBound 1
    have hSpec := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ
    have hAnti := niveauTwoCarryEquation_antiPeriodic hp hf sigma sigma' J K
      hComplementary hK hSpec
    have hAntiOne := hAnti (1 : ZMod 4)
    have hEquationZero := hSpec (0 : ZMod 4)
    have hEquationOne := hSpec (1 : ZMod 4)
    have hSourceZero : sigma.periodicU hf (0 : ZMod 4) = p := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huAt
    have hSourceOne : sigma.periodicU hf (1 : ZMod 4) = p - 1 := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huNext
    have hTargetZero : sigma'.periodicU hf (0 : ZMod 4) = p - 1 := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huTargetAt
    have hTargetOne : sigma'.periodicU hf (1 : ZMod 4) = 1 := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huTargetNext
    have hSourceSignZero :
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (0 : ZMod 4) = -1 := by
      classical
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, J]
    have hSourceSignOne :
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (1 : ZMod 4) = -1 := by
      classical
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, J]
    change x (1 + 2) = -x 1 at hAntiOne
    norm_num at hAntiOne
    have hPrevious : x (-1 : ZMod 4) = -x 1 := by
      rw [show (-1 : ZMod 4) = 3 by decide]
      exact hAntiOne
    change e0 * (sigma'.periodicU hf 0 : Int) -
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (0 : ZMod 4) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf 0 : Int) =
      (p : Int) * x (0 - 1) - x 0 at hEquationZero
    change e1 * (sigma'.periodicU hf 1 : Int) -
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (1 : ZMod 4) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf 1 : Int) =
      (p : Int) * x (1 - 1) - x 1 at hEquationOne
    norm_num at hEquationZero hEquationOne
    rw [hSourceZero, hTargetZero, hSourceSignZero, hPrevious] at hEquationZero
    rw [hSourceOne, hTargetOne, hSourceSignOne] at hEquationOne
    have hCastSub : ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 := by omega
    have hEquationZero' :
        e0 * ((p : Int) - 1) + (p : Int) =
          -(p : Int) * x1 - x0 := by
      dsimp only [x0, x1]
      rw [hCastSub] at hEquationZero
      linear_combination hEquationZero
    have hEquationOne' :
        e1 + ((p : Int) - 1) = (p : Int) * x0 - x1 := by
      dsimp only [x0, x1]
      rw [hCastSub] at hEquationOne
      linear_combination hEquationOne
    rcases abs_le.mp hx0Bound with ⟨hx0Lower, hx0Upper⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hx1Bound with ⟨hx1Lower, hx1Upper⟩
    rcases he0 with he0 | he0 <;> rcases he1 with he1 | he1 <;>
      simp only [he0, he1] at hEquationZero' hEquationOne' <;>
      interval_cases x0 <;> interval_cases x1 <;> omega
  · let J : Set (ZMod 4) := {1, 2}
    have hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + 2 ∉ J := by
      dsimp only [J]
      decide
    refine ⟨J, hComplementary, ?_⟩
    intro hJ
    let x := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
    let K := pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
    let hK := pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ
    let e1 := (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) K hK).sign (1 : ZMod 4)
    let e2 := (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) K hK).sign (2 : ZMod 4)
    let x1 := x (1 : ZMod 4)
    let x2 := x (2 : ZMod 4)
    have he1 : e1 = -1 ∨ e1 = 1 := by
      classical
      by_cases hMem : (1 : ZMod 4) ∈ K
      · left
        simp [e1, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
      · right
        simp [e1, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
    have he2 : e2 = -1 ∨ e2 = 1 := by
      classical
      by_cases hMem : (2 : ZMod 4) ∈ K
      · left
        simp [e2, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
      · right
        simp [e2, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hMem]
    have hBound := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ
    have hx1Bound : |x1| ≤ 2 := hBound 1
    have hx2Bound : |x2| ≤ 2 := hBound 2
    have hSpec := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ
    have hAnti := niveauTwoCarryEquation_antiPeriodic hp hf sigma sigma' J K
      hComplementary hK hSpec
    have hAntiZero := hAnti (0 : ZMod 4)
    have hEquationOne := hSpec (1 : ZMod 4)
    have hEquationTwo := hSpec (2 : ZMod 4)
    have hSourceOne : sigma.periodicU hf (1 : ZMod 4) = p := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huAt
    have hSourceTwo : sigma.periodicU hf (2 : ZMod 4) = p - 1 := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huNext
    have hTargetOne : sigma'.periodicU hf (1 : ZMod 4) = p - 1 := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huTargetAt
    have hTargetTwo : sigma'.periodicU hf (2 : ZMod 4) = 1 := by
      simpa [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex] using huTargetNext
    have hSourceSignOne :
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (1 : ZMod 4) = -1 := by
      classical
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, J]
    have hSourceSignTwo :
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (2 : ZMod 4) = -1 := by
      classical
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, J]
    change x (0 + 2) = -x 0 at hAntiZero
    norm_num at hAntiZero
    have hPrevious : x 0 = -x 2 := by omega
    change e1 * (sigma'.periodicU hf 1 : Int) -
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (1 : ZMod 4) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf 1 : Int) =
      (p : Int) * x (1 - 1) - x 1 at hEquationOne
    change e2 * (sigma'.periodicU hf 2 : Int) -
        (Profile.niveauTwo (f := 2) J hComplementary).sign
          (2 : ZMod 4) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf 2 : Int) =
      (p : Int) * x (2 - 1) - x 2 at hEquationTwo
    norm_num at hEquationOne hEquationTwo
    rw [hSourceOne, hTargetOne, hSourceSignOne, hPrevious] at hEquationOne
    rw [hSourceTwo, hTargetTwo, hSourceSignTwo] at hEquationTwo
    have hCastSub : ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 := by omega
    have hEquationOne' :
        e1 * ((p : Int) - 1) + (p : Int) =
          -(p : Int) * x2 - x1 := by
      dsimp only [x1, x2]
      rw [hCastSub] at hEquationOne
      linear_combination hEquationOne
    have hEquationTwo' :
        e2 + ((p : Int) - 1) = (p : Int) * x1 - x2 := by
      dsimp only [x1, x2]
      rw [hCastSub] at hEquationTwo
      linear_combination hEquationTwo
    rcases abs_le.mp hx1Bound with ⟨hx1Lower, hx1Upper⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hx2Bound with ⟨hx2Lower, hx2Upper⟩
    rcases he1 with he1 | he1 <;> rcases he2 with he2 | he2 <;>
      simp only [he1, he2] at hEquationOne' hEquationTwo' <;>
      interval_cases x1 <;> interval_cases x2 <;> omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_mixed_impossible
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_all_source_positive_mixed_impossible
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < sigma.u i) (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = -2)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = -1) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  rcases pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_mixed_configuration hp3
      hsubset hEmpty hNegative hPositive j hPrev hCurrent with
    ⟨hfEq, huAt, huNext, huTargetAt, huTargetNext⟩
  have hTargetNoncritical :
      sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t := by
    intro hCritical
    have hCoordinate := congrArg (fun tau : PhantomWeight p f ↦ tau.u (j + 1))
      hCritical
    simp only [PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] at hCoordinate
    omega
  subst f
  rcases pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_mixed_witness_incompatible hp3
      j huAt huNext huTargetAt huTargetNext with
    ⟨J, hComplementary, hIncompatible⟩
  have hSource : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) ∈
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma :=
    ⟨.niveauTwo J hComplementary, rfl⟩
  rcases hsubset hSource with ⟨K, hPair⟩
  have hCompatible : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' := by
    cases K with
    | niveauOne K =>
        have hScalars := crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_eq_implies_scalar
          hp hf chars sigma' sigma K J hComplementary hPair
        rcases noncritical_niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_eq_niveauOne hp3 hf
            chars sigma' K hScalars.1 hTargetNoncritical with
          ⟨L, hL, hConvert⟩
        rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
        refine ⟨.niveauTwo L hL, rfl, ?_⟩
        exact hPair.symm.trans hConvert.symm
    | niveauTwo K hK =>
        rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
        exact ⟨.niveauTwo K hK, rfl, hPair.symm⟩
  exact hIncompatible hCompatible

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_classification
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_all_source_positive_classification
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < sigma.u i) (hNe : sigma ≠ sigma') :
    sigma = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f sigma.t ∧
      sigma' = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) sigma.t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hAllNegOne :
      ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -1
  · exact pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_neg_one_classification
      hp3 hsubset hEmpty hNegative hPositive hAllNegOne
  · by_cases hAllNegTwo :
        ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -2
    · rcases pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_neg_two_classification
          hp3 hsubset hEmpty hNegative hPositive hAllNegTwo with
        ⟨hSource, hTarget⟩
      exact (hNe (hSource.trans hTarget.symm)).elim
    · rcases pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_mixed_transition hp3
          hsubset hEmpty hNegative hPositive hAllNegOne hAllNegTwo with
        ⟨j, hPrev, hCurrent⟩
      exact (pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_mixed_impossible hp3
        hsubset hEmpty hNegative hPositive j hPrev hCurrent).elim

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_zero_at_zero_implies_all_source_zero
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_zero_at_zero_implies_all_source_zero
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty)
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hZero : sigma.u 0 = 0) :
    ∀ i, sigma.u i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases pin.emptyCarry_minimal_reductions hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal with
    ⟨_hNoTwo, _hNoPositiveToNegative, _hNoNegativeToPositive,
      _hNoInvertibleMu, hNoInvertibleNu⟩
  have hNoZeroP : ∀ i : ZMod f,
      (sigma.u (i - 1), sigma.u i) ≠ (0, p) := by
    intro i hPair
    have hPrevZero : sigma.u (i - 1) = 0 := congrArg Prod.fst hPair
    have hCurrentP : sigma.u ((i - 1) + 1) = p := by
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using congrArg Prod.snd hPair
    exact (hNoInvertibleNu (i - 1) hPrevZero hCurrentP) (hNegative (i - 1))
  let interior : Set (ZMod f) := {i | 0 < sigma.u i ∧ sigma.u i < p}
  have hInterior : Profile.niveauOne interior ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset interior
  have hNoOneP : ∀ i : ZMod f,
      (sigma.u i, sigma.u (i + 1)) ≠ (1, p) := by
    intro i
    exact pin.interiorProfile_negative_excludes_one_p hp3 hEmpty
      (by simpa only [interior] using hInterior) i (hNegative i)
  let endpoint : Set (ZMod f) := {i | sigma.u i = p}
  let P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf endpoint 0
  let hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P :=
    shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf endpoint 0
  have hPrescribed : ∀ k : Nat, k < f →
      ((k : ZMod (2 * f)) ∈ P ↔
        sigma.periodicU hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)) = p) := by
    intro k hk
    simp [P, shiftedNiveauTwoSet, endpoint,
      ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (show k < 2 * f by omega),
      periodicIndex_natCast hf k hk, PhantomWeight.periodicU, hk]
  have hNotCompatible : Profile.niveauTwo P hComplementary ∉
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    pin.prescribedNiveauTwo_not_compatible hp3 hEmpty P hComplementary
      hPrescribed hZero hNoZeroP hNegative
  have hScalar :=
    niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_isScalar_of_subset_of_not_compatible
      hp3 hf chars sigma sigma' hsubset P hComplementary hNotCompatible
  rcases niveauTwoScalarCarry hp3 hf chars sigma P hComplementary hScalar with
    ⟨y, ⟨hy, hyAnti, hyBound⟩, _hyUnique⟩
  have hBoundary := prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_zero_boundary sigma hp3 P
    hComplementary hy hyAnti hyBound hZero
  have hFirst := prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_firstHalf_zero sigma hp3 P
    hComplementary hPrescribed hy hyBound hZero hBoundary hNoOneP
  exact firstHalf_periodicU_zero_implies_all_source_zero sigma
    (fun k hk ↦ (hFirst k hk).1)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_zero_at_implies_all_source_zero
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_zero_at_implies_all_source_zero
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty)
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (j : ZMod f) (hZero : sigma.u j = 0) :
    ∀ i, sigma.u i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  rcases pin.emptyCarry_minimal_reductions hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal with
    ⟨_hNoTwo, _hNoPositiveToNegative, _hNoNegativeToPositive,
      _hNoInvertibleMu, hNoInvertibleNu⟩
  have hNoZeroP : ∀ i : ZMod f,
      (sigma.u (i - 1), sigma.u i) ≠ (0, p) := by
    intro i hPair
    have hPrevZero : sigma.u (i - 1) = 0 := congrArg Prod.fst hPair
    have hCurrentP : sigma.u ((i - 1) + 1) = p := by
      simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using congrArg Prod.snd hPair
    exact (hNoInvertibleNu (i - 1) hPrevZero hCurrentP) (hNegative (i - 1))
  let interior : Set (ZMod f) := {i | 0 < sigma.u i ∧ sigma.u i < p}
  have hInterior : Profile.niveauOne interior ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset interior
  have hNoOneP : ∀ i : ZMod f,
      (sigma.u i, sigma.u (i + 1)) ≠ (1, p) := by
    intro i
    exact pin.interiorProfile_negative_excludes_one_p hp3 hEmpty
      (by simpa only [interior] using hInterior) i (hNegative i)
  let endpoint : Set (ZMod f) := {i | sigma.u i = p}
  let a : ZMod (2 * f) := (j.val : Nat)
  have hPeriodicA : periodicIndex hf a = j := by
    dsimp only [a]
    rw [periodicIndex_natCast hf j.val j.val_lt]
    exact ZMod.natCast_zmod_val j
  let P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf endpoint a
  let hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P :=
    shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf endpoint a
  have hPrescribed : ∀ k : Nat, k < f →
      (a + (k : Nat) ∈ P ↔
        sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k : Nat)) = p) := by
    intro k hk
    have hDiff : a + ((k : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - a =
        (k : ZMod (2 * f)) := by ring
    have hVal : (a + ((k : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - a).val = k := by
      rw [hDiff, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (show k < 2 * f by omega)]
    have hHalf : (a + ((k : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - a).val < f := by
      rw [hVal]
      exact hk
    rw [show P = shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf endpoint a from rfl,
      mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet, if_pos hHalf]
    simp only [endpoint, Set.mem_setOf_eq, PhantomWeight.periodicU]
  have hZeroPeriodic : sigma.periodicU hf a = 0 := by
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodicA] using hZero
  have hNotCompatible : Profile.niveauTwo P hComplementary ∉
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    pin.prescribedNiveauTwo_not_compatible_at hp3 hEmpty P hComplementary
      a hPrescribed hZeroPeriodic hNoZeroP hNegative
  have hScalar :=
    niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_isScalar_of_subset_of_not_compatible
      hp3 hf chars sigma sigma' hsubset P hComplementary hNotCompatible
  rcases niveauTwoScalarCarry hp3 hf chars sigma P hComplementary hScalar with
    ⟨y, ⟨hy, hyAnti, hyBound⟩, _hyUnique⟩
  have hBoundary := prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_zero_boundary_at sigma hp3
    P hComplementary hy hyAnti hyBound a hZeroPeriodic
  have hFirst := prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_translatedFirstHalf_zero
    sigma hp3 P hComplementary a hPrescribed hy hyBound hZeroPeriodic
    hBoundary hNoOneP
  exact translatedFirstHalf_periodicU_zero_implies_all_source_zero sigma a
    (fun k hk ↦ (hFirst k hk).1)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_all_source_zero_coordinates
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_all_source_zero_coordinates
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hAllZero : ∀ i, sigma.u i = 0) :
    (∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -1) ∧
      (∀ i, sigma'.u i = p - 1) ∧
      pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
  have hBound : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
      hBound | hExceptional
    · exact hBound
    · rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, hu, hu', ht⟩
      exact False.elim
        ((exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars
          sigma sigma' hu hu' ht).1 hsubset)
  have hCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty
  have hNoNegTwo : ∀ i, x i ≠ -2 := by
    intro i hi
    have hEquation := hCarry (i + 1)
    have hNextBound := abs_le.mp (hBound (i + 1))
    change
      -2 ≤ pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i + 1) ∧
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i + 1) ≤ 2 at hNextBound
    have huTarget := sigma'.u_le (i + 1)
    have huTargetInt : (sigma'.u (i + 1) : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
      exact_mod_cast huTarget
    by_cases hMem : i + 1 ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty
    · simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
        Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hMem, hAllZero] at hEquation
      change pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -2 at hi
      rw [hi] at hEquation
      omega
    · simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
        Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hMem, hAllZero] at hEquation
      change pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -2 at hi
      rw [hi] at hEquation
      omega
  have hAllMinusOne : ∀ i, x i = -1 := by
    intro i
    have hiBound := abs_le.mp (hBound i)
    have hiNegative := hNegative i
    have hiNotNegTwo := hNoNegTwo i
    change x i < 0 at hiNegative
    omega
  have hTargetMem : ∀ i, i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty := by
    intro i
    have hEquation := hCarry i
    have hPrev := hAllMinusOne (i - 1)
    have hCurrent := hAllMinusOne i
    change pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) = -1 at hPrev
    change pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -1 at hCurrent
    rw [hPrev, hCurrent] at hEquation
    by_contra hNotMem
    simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hNotMem, hAllZero] at hEquation
    omega
  have hTargetCoordinates : ∀ i, sigma'.u i = p - 1 := by
    intro i
    have hEquation := hCarry i
    have hPrev := hAllMinusOne (i - 1)
    have hCurrent := hAllMinusOne i
    change pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) = -1 at hPrev
    change pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -1 at hCurrent
    rw [hPrev, hCurrent] at hEquation
    simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hTargetMem i, hAllZero] at hEquation
    omega
  refine ⟨hAllMinusOne, hTargetCoordinates, ?_⟩
  ext i
  simp [hTargetMem i]

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_all_source_zero_classification
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_all_source_zero_classification
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hAllZero : ∀ i, sigma.u i = 0) :
    sigma = PhantomWeight.unramified p f sigma.t ∧
      sigma' = PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma.t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases pin.negativeCarry_all_source_zero_coordinates hp3 hsubset hEmpty
      hNegative hAllZero with ⟨_hCarry, hTargetCoordinates, hTargetFull⟩
  have hSource : sigma = PhantomWeight.unramified p f sigma.t := by
    apply PhantomWeight.ext
    · funext i
      simp [PhantomWeight.unramified, PhantomWeight.constantWeight, hAllZero i]
    · rfl
  have hTarget : sigma' = PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t := by
    apply PhantomWeight.ext
    · funext i
      simp only [PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
      exact hTargetCoordinates i
    · rfl
  have hPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne ∅) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne Set.univ) := by
    have hPair' := pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f))) hEmpty
    rw [pin.niveauOneTarget_spec ∅ hEmpty, hTargetFull] at hPair'
    exact hPair'
  have hCongruence := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' ∅ Set.univ hPair
  have hTargetSum := critical_niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_zero hp3 hf sigma'.t
  rw [hTarget] at hCongruence
  rw [hTargetSum] at hCongruence
  have htDifference : sigma'.t - sigma.t = 0 := by
    simpa [niveauOneProfileSum] using hCongruence.symm
  have ht : sigma'.t = sigma.t := sub_eq_zero.mp htDifference
  exact ⟨hSource, hTarget.trans (by rw [ht])⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_zero_at_zero_classification
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_zero_at_zero_classification
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty)
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hZero : sigma.u 0 = 0) :
    sigma = PhantomWeight.unramified p f sigma.t ∧
      sigma' = PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma.t
proof:
:= by
  apply pin.negativeCarry_all_source_zero_classification hp3 hsubset hEmpty
    hNegative
  exact pin.negativeCarry_zero_at_zero_implies_all_source_zero hp3 hsubset
    hEmpty hMinimal hNegative hZero

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_zero_at_classification
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_zero_at_classification
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty)
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (j : ZMod f) (hZero : sigma.u j = 0) :
    sigma = PhantomWeight.unramified p f sigma.t ∧
      sigma' = PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma.t
proof:
:= by
  apply pin.negativeCarry_all_source_zero_classification hp3 hsubset hEmpty
    hNegative
  exact pin.negativeCarry_zero_at_implies_all_source_zero hp3 hsubset hEmpty
    hMinimal hNegative j hZero

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeCarry_classification
statement:
theorem negativeCarry_classification
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty)
    (hNegative : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hNe : sigma ≠ sigma') :
    (sigma = PhantomWeight.unramified p f sigma.t ∧
        sigma' = PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma.t) ∨
      (sigma = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f sigma.t ∧
        sigma' = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) sigma.t)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < sigma.u i
  · exact Or.inr (pin.negativeCarry_all_source_positive_classification
      hp3 hsubset hEmpty hNegative hPositive hNe)
  · push_neg at hPositive
    rcases hPositive with ⟨j, hj⟩
    have hZero : sigma.u j = 0 := by omega
    exact Or.inl (pin.negativeCarry_zero_at_classification hp3 hsubset hEmpty
      hMinimal hNegative j hZero)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.preliminaries
statement:
theorem preliminaries
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty) (hNe : sigma ≠ sigma') :
    ((∀ i, 0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i) →
      ∃ t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1),
        (sigma = PhantomWeight.unramified p f t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.critical p f t) ∨
          (sigma = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t)) ∧
    (∀ j : ZMod f,
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) ≤ 0 →
      0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j →
      ∃ length : Nat,
        (∀ k : Nat, k ≤ length →
          0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + (k : ZMod f))) ∧
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (j + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0 ∧
        ∀ k : Nat, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
          sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ j : ZMod f,
      (∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i ≤ 0) →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0 →
      ¬ NegativeStringToPositive
        (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty) sigma.u j →
      sigma.u (j + 1) = 0) ∧
    ((∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0) →
      ∃ t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1),
        (sigma = PhantomWeight.unramified p f t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.critical p f t) ∨
          (sigma = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨pin.positiveCarry_classification hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hPrev hCurrent
    exact pin.positiveBoundary_zeroString hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal j
      hPrev hCurrent
  · intro j hAllNonpositive hPrev hCurrent hNoPositive
    have hSingleton : Profile.niveauOne ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
        compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
      niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hsubset {j}
    exact pin.negativeBoundary_noPositive_successor_zero hp3 hsubset hEmpty j
      hSingleton hPrev hAllNonpositive hCurrent hNoPositive
  · intro hNegative
    exact ⟨sigma.t, pin.negativeCarry_classification hp3 hsubset hEmpty
      hMinimal hNegative hNe⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.eq_iff_pinnedEmptyCarry_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_iff_pinnedEmptyCarry_eq_zero
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty) :
    sigma = sigma' ↔
      ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  constructor
  · intro hEq
    subst sigma'
    have hSelfEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
        compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma := by
      rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
      exact ⟨.niveauOne ∅, rfl, rfl⟩
    let other : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma :=
      fixedProfilePinning (.niveauOne ∅) (.niveauOne ∅) rfl rfl
    have hOtherTarget : other.niveauOneTarget ∅ hSelfEmpty = ∅ := by
      have hs := other.niveauOneTarget_spec ∅ hSelfEmpty
      rw [fixedProfilePinning_target (.niveauOne ∅) hSelfEmpty
        (.niveauOne ∅) rfl rfl] at hs
      injection hs with h
      exact h.symm
    have hZeroEquation : CarryEquation p
        (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma ∅ ∅) (fun _ ↦ 0) := by
      intro i
      simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
        Profile.Contains, Profile.set]
    have hOtherEquation := other.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hSelfEmpty
    rw [hOtherTarget] at hOtherEquation
    have hOtherCarry : other.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hSelfEmpty = fun _ ↦ 0 :=
      (niveauOneCarryEquation_existsUnique_of_pair_eq hp hf chars sigma sigma
        ∅ ∅ rfl).unique hOtherEquation hZeroEquation
    have hOtherCost : other.emptyCarryCost hSelfEmpty = 0 := by
      simp [emptyCarryCost, hOtherCarry]
    have hCostLe := hMinimal sigma
      ((PhantomWeight.equivalent_isEquivalence (by omega) hf).refl sigma)
      other hSelfEmpty
    have hCostZero : pin.emptyCarryCost hEmpty = 0 := by
      omega
    have hSumZero :
        (∑ i : ZMod f,
          Int.natAbs (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i)) = 0 := by
      simpa [emptyCarryCost] using hCostZero
    intro i
    have hTermLe :
        Int.natAbs (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i) ≤
          ∑ k : ZMod f,
            Int.natAbs (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty k) := by
      exact Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun k : ZMod f ↦
          Int.natAbs (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty k))
        (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have hTermZero :
        Int.natAbs (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i) = 0 := by
      rw [hSumZero] at hTermLe
      omega
    exact Int.natAbs_eq_zero.mp hTermZero
  · intro hZero
    by_contra hNe
    exact pin.pinnedEmptyCarry_not_all_zero hEmpty hNe hZero

name: KLSposet.Pinning.criticalTarget_distinct_emptyCarry_constant
statement:
theorem criticalTarget_distinct_emptyCarry_constant
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
    (hCritical : sigma' = PhantomWeight.critical p f t)
    (hNe : sigma ≠ sigma') :
    (∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = 1) ∨
      (∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = -1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  subst sigma'
  have hScalar : sigma = PhantomWeight.unramified p f t := by
    rcases criticalTarget_subset_classification hp3 hf chars sigma t hsubset with
