      hScalar | hCriticalSource
    · exact hScalar
    · exact False.elim (hNe hCriticalSource)
  subst sigma
  let x : ZMod f → Int := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
  have hBound : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
      hBound | hExceptional
    · exact hBound
    · rcases hExceptional with ⟨_hpEq, hu, _hu', _ht⟩
      have h := hu 0
      simp [PhantomWeight.unramified, PhantomWeight.constantWeight] at h
  have hpSub : (((p - 1 : Nat) : Int)) = (p : Int) - 1 := by
    omega
  have hEquation (i : ZMod f) :
      ((if i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty then -1 else 1) : Int) *
          ((p : Int) - 1) =
        (p : Int) * x (i - 1) - x i := by
    have hi := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty i
    simpa [x, niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, PhantomWeight.unramified,
      PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight, hpSub] using hi
  have hNonzero (i : ZMod f) : x i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hiZero
    have hi := hEquation i
    have hPrevBound := abs_le.mp (hBound (i - 1))
    by_cases hiMem : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty
    · simp [hiMem, hiZero] at hi
      have hPrevLow : -2 ≤ x (i - 1) := hPrevBound.1
      have hPrevHigh : x (i - 1) ≤ 2 := hPrevBound.2
      interval_cases hPrev : x (i - 1) <;> nlinarith
    · simp [hiMem, hiZero] at hi
      have hPrevLow : -2 ≤ x (i - 1) := hPrevBound.1
      have hPrevHigh : x (i - 1) ≤ 2 := hPrevBound.2
      interval_cases hPrev : x (i - 1) <;> nlinarith
  have hNotTwo (i : ZMod f) : x i ≠ 2 := by
    intro hiTwo
    have hi := hEquation (i + 1)
    have hNextBound := abs_le.mp (hBound (i + 1))
    have hIndex : i + 1 - 1 = i := by ring
    rw [hIndex, hiTwo] at hi
    by_cases hiMem : i + 1 ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty
    · simp [hiMem] at hi
      nlinarith
    · simp [hiMem] at hi
      nlinarith
  have hNotNegTwo (i : ZMod f) : x i ≠ -2 := by
    intro hiNegTwo
    have hi := hEquation (i + 1)
    have hNextBound := abs_le.mp (hBound (i + 1))
    have hIndex : i + 1 - 1 = i := by ring
    rw [hIndex, hiNegTwo] at hi
    by_cases hiMem : i + 1 ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty
    · simp [hiMem] at hi
      nlinarith
    · simp [hiMem] at hi
      nlinarith
  have hUnit (i : ZMod f) : x i = 1 ∨ x i = -1 := by
    have hiBound := abs_le.mp (hBound i)
    have hiNonzero := hNonzero i
    have hiNotTwo := hNotTwo i
    have hiNotNegTwo := hNotNegTwo i
    omega
  have hPred (i : ZMod f) : x (i - 1) = x i := by
    have hi := hEquation i
    rcases hUnit (i - 1) with hPrev | hPrev <;>
      rcases hUnit i with hCurrent | hCurrent <;>
      rw [hPrev, hCurrent] at hi
    all_goals
      by_cases hiMem : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty
      · simp [hiMem] at hi
        nlinarith
      · simp [hiMem] at hi
        nlinarith
  have hConst : ∀ i, x i = x 0 :=
    cyclicFunction_eq_const_of_pred_eq (by omega) hPred
  rcases hUnit 0 with hOne | hMinusOne
  · left
    intro i
    change x i = 1
    rw [hConst i, hOne]
  · right
    intro i
    change x i = -1
    rw [hConst i, hMinusOne]

name: KLSposet.Pinning.zero_source_and_zero_emptyCarry_target_not_critical
statement:
theorem zero_source_and_zero_emptyCarry_target_not_critical
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j j' : ZMod f) (hu : sigma.u j = 0)
    (hx : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j' = 0) :
    ∀ t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1), sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f t
proof:
:= by
  intro t hCritical
  have hNe : sigma ≠ sigma' := by
    intro hEq
    have hCoordinate := congrArg (fun tau : PhantomWeight p f ↦ tau.u j)
      (hEq.trans hCritical)
    simp [PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight, hu] at hCoordinate
    omega
  rcases pin.criticalTarget_distinct_emptyCarry_constant hp3 hsubset hEmpty t
      hCritical hNe with hOne | hMinusOne
  · rw [hOne j'] at hx
    omega
  · rw [hMinusOne j'] at hx
    omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.positiveBoundaryPositive_mu_validNoninvertible
statement:
theorem positiveBoundaryPositive_mu_validNoninvertible

name: KLSposet.Pinning.negativeBoundary_theta_validNoninvertible
statement:
theorem negativeBoundary_theta_validNoninvertible
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}

name: KLSposet.localShift_eq_zero_of_boundedCarry
statement:
theorem localShift_eq_zero_of_boundedCarry
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    {y : ZMod f → Int} (j : ZMod f) (gamma : Int)
    (hzero : translationExponent p f hf y = 0)
    (hy : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ (p : Int))
    (hyj : y j = gamma)
    (hysucc : y (j + 1) = 0 ∨ y (j + 1) = 1)
    (hgamma : |gamma| ≤ 1) :
    gamma = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases boundedCyclicCarry_existsUnique_of_translationExponent_eq_zero
      hp hf hzero hy with ⟨z, ⟨hz, hzBound⟩, _⟩
  have hEqSucc := hz (j + 1)
  rw [show j + 1 - 1 = j by ring] at hEqSucc
  have hzjBounds := abs_le.mp (hzBound j)
  have hzsuccBounds := abs_le.mp (hzBound (j + 1))
  have hzj : z j = 0 := by
    have hzjCases : z j = -1 ∨ z j = 0 ∨ z j = 1 := by omega
    rcases hzjCases with hzj | hzj | hzj
    · rw [hzj] at hEqSucc
      rcases hysucc with hysucc | hysucc <;> rw [hysucc] at hEqSucc <;>
        norm_num at hEqSucc <;> omega
    · exact hzj
    · rw [hzj] at hEqSucc
      rcases hysucc with hysucc | hysucc <;> rw [hysucc] at hEqSucc <;>
        norm_num at hEqSucc <;> omega
  have hEqJ := hz j
  rw [hyj, hzj] at hEqJ
  have hzprevBounds := abs_le.mp (hzBound (j - 1))
  have hgammaBounds := abs_le.mp hgamma
  have hzprevCases : z (j - 1) = -1 ∨ z (j - 1) = 0 ∨ z (j - 1) = 1 := by
    omega
  rcases hzprevCases with hzprev | hzprev | hzprev <;>
    rw [hzprev] at hEqJ <;> norm_num at hEqJ <;> omega

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.niveauOneLeftExponent_mu_witness
statement:
theorem niveauOneLeftExponent_mu_witness
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (k : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.MuValid k) :
    niveauOneLeftExponent hf (sigma.mu hf k valid) {k + 1} =
      sigma.t + inversePower p f hf k
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauOneLeftExponent]
  have hsucc : k + 1 ≠ k := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (k + 1) - k := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hTargetSum :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf k valid) {k + 1} =
        inversePower p f hf k := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne ({k + 1} : Set (ZMod f))).indicator i : Int) *
            ((sigma.mu hf k valid).u i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = k + 1 then (p : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = k + 1
      · subst i
        simp [mu, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hsucc,
          valid.2]
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_single]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_natCast]
    exact inversePower_succ p f hp hf k
  rw [hTargetSum]
  rfl

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.niveauOneLeftExponent_theta_witness
statement:
theorem niveauOneLeftExponent_theta_witness
    {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (k : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid k) :
    niveauOneLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf k valid) ∅ =
      sigma.t - inversePower p f hf k
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauOneLeftExponent]
  have hEmpty : niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.theta hf k valid) ∅ = 0 := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
      translationExponent]
  rw [hEmpty, add_zero]
  rfl

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.niveauOneLeftExponent_nu_witness
statement:
theorem niveauOneLeftExponent_nu_witness
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (k : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.NuValid k) :
    niveauOneLeftExponent hf (sigma.nu hp hf k valid) ∅ =
      sigma.t - inversePower p f hf k +
        (sigma.u (k + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauOneLeftExponent]
  have hEmpty : niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.nu hp hf k valid) ∅ = 0 := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
      translationExponent]
  rw [hEmpty, add_zero]
  rfl

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.muLocalShift_eq_zero
statement:
theorem muLocalShift_eq_zero
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f)) (j k : ZMod f)
    (gamma : Int) (valid : sigma.MuValid k)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hgamma : |gamma| ≤ 1)
    (hzero : translationExponent p f hf
      (fun i ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
        (if i = j then gamma else 0) - if i = k then 1 else 0) = 0) :
    gamma = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hkj : k ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hpositive := valid.1
    rw [h, huj] at hpositive
    omega
  have hkj1 : k ≠ j + 1 := by
    intro h
    have hpositive := valid.1
    rw [h, huj1] at hpositive
    omega
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  let y : ZMod f → Int := fun i ↦
    ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
      (if i = j then gamma else 0) - if i = k then 1 else 0
  have hy : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ (p : Int) := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [y]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huj, hkj.symm]
      calc
        |gamma| ≤ 1 := hgamma
        _ ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ p by omega)
    · by_cases hik : i = k
      · subst i
        by_cases hiJ : k ∈ J
        · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hkj]
          have huPositive := valid.1
          have huUpper := sigma.u_le k
          have huPositiveInt : (1 : Int) ≤ (sigma.u k : Int) := by
            exact_mod_cast huPositive
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr huPositiveInt)]
          have huUpperInt : (sigma.u k : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
            exact_mod_cast huUpper
          omega
        · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hkj]
          omega
      · by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J
        · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hij, hik]
          exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le i
        · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hij, hik]
  apply localShift_eq_zero_of_boundedCarry hp hf (y := y) j gamma
  · exact hzero
  · exact hy
  · simp [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huj, hkj.symm]
  · left
    simp [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huj1, hsucc,
      hkj1.symm]
  · exact hgamma

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.thetaLocalShift_eq_zero
statement:
theorem thetaLocalShift_eq_zero
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f)) (j k : ZMod f)
    (gamma : Int) (valid : sigma.ThetaValid k)
    (hkj : k ≠ j)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hgamma : |gamma| ≤ 1)
    (hzero : translationExponent p f hf
      (fun i ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
        (if i = j then gamma else 0) + if i = k then 1 else 0) = 0) :
    gamma = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
    omega
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  let y : ZMod f → Int := fun i ↦
    ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
      (if i = j then gamma else 0) + if i = k then 1 else 0
  have hy : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ (p : Int) := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [y]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huj, hkj.symm]
      calc
        |gamma| ≤ 1 := hgamma
        _ ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ p by omega)
    · by_cases hik : i = k
      · subst i
        by_cases hiJ : k ∈ J
        · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hkj]
          have huStrict := valid.1
          have huStrictInt : (sigma.u k : Int) < (p : Int) := by
            exact_mod_cast huStrict
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
          omega
        · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hkj]
          omega
      · by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J
        · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hij, hik]
          exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le i
        · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hij, hik]
  apply localShift_eq_zero_of_boundedCarry hp hf (y := y) j gamma
  · exact hzero
  · exact hy
  · simp [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huj, hkj.symm]
  · by_cases hj1k : j + 1 = k
    · right
      have huk : sigma.u k = 0 := by simpa [← hj1k] using huj1
      simp [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huk, hkj,
        hj1k]
    · left
      simp [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huj1, hsucc,
        hj1k]
  · exact hgamma

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.nuLocalShift_eq_zero
statement:
theorem nuLocalShift_eq_zero
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f)) (j k : ZMod f)
    (gamma : Int) (valid : sigma.NuValid k)
    (hkj : k ≠ j)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hgamma : |gamma| ≤ 1)
    (hzero : translationExponent p f hf
      (fun i ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
        (if i = j then gamma else 0) + (if i = k then 1 else 0) -
          if i = k + 1 then (sigma.u (k + 1) : Int) else 0) = 0) :
    gamma = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
    omega
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hsuccK : k + 1 ≠ k := by
    intro h
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (k + 1) - k := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have huk : sigma.u k = 0 := valid
  let y : ZMod f → Int := fun i ↦
    ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
      (if i = j then gamma else 0) + (if i = k then 1 else 0) -
        if i = k + 1 then (sigma.u (k + 1) : Int) else 0
  have hy : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ (p : Int) := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [y]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      by_cases hjk1 : j = k + 1
      · have huk1 : sigma.u (k + 1) = 0 := by simpa [← hjk1] using huj
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hjk1, huk1,
          hsuccK]
        calc
          |gamma| ≤ 1 := hgamma
          _ ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ p by omega)
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huj, hkj.symm,
          hjk1]
        calc
          |gamma| ≤ 1 := hgamma
          _ ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ p by omega)
    · by_cases hik : i = k
      · subst i
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huk, hkj,
          hsuccK.symm]
        omega
      · by_cases hik1 : i = k + 1
        · subst i
          by_cases hk1j : k + 1 = j
          · have huk1 : sigma.u (k + 1) = 0 := by simpa [hk1j] using huj
            simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huj,
              hkj.symm, hk1j]
            calc
              |gamma| ≤ 1 := hgamma
              _ ≤ (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ p by omega)
          · by_cases hk1J : k + 1 ∈ J
            · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hk1J,
                hk1j, hsuccK]
            · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hk1J,
                hk1j, hsuccK]
              exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le (k + 1)
        · by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J
          · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hij,
              hik, hik1]
            exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le i
          · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hij,
              hik, hik1]
  apply localShift_eq_zero_of_boundedCarry hp hf (y := y) j gamma
  · exact hzero
  · exact hy
  · by_cases hjk1 : j = k + 1
    · have huk1 : sigma.u (k + 1) = 0 := by simpa [← hjk1] using huj
      simp [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hjk1, huk1,
        hsuccK]
    · simp [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huj, hkj.symm,
        hjk1]
  · by_cases hj1k : j + 1 = k
    · right
      have huk' : sigma.u k = 0 := valid
      simp [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hj1k, huk',
        hkj, hsuccK.symm]
    · by_cases hj1k1 : j + 1 = k + 1
      · have hjk : j = k := by
          calc
            j = (j + 1) - 1 := by ring
            _ = (k + 1) - 1 := by rw [hj1k1]
            _ = k := by ring
        exact (hkj hjk.symm).elim
      · left
        simp [y, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huj1, hsucc,
          hj1k, hj1k1]
  · exact hgamma

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.muLocalShift_eq_zero_of_niveauOneLeftExponent_eq
statement:
theorem muLocalShift_eq_zero_of_niveauOneLeftExponent_eq
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f)) (j k : ZMod f)
    (gamma : Int) (valid : sigma.MuValid k)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hgamma : |gamma| ≤ 1)
    (hEq : niveauOneLeftExponent hf (sigma.mu hf k valid) {k + 1} =
      niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma J +
        (gamma : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf j) :
    gamma = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply muLocalShift_eq_zero hp hf sigma J j k gamma valid huj huj1 hgamma
  have hResidue :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J +
          (gamma : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf j -
        inversePower p f hf k = 0 := by
    rw [niveauOneLeftExponent_mu_witness (by omega) hf,
      niveauOneLeftExponent] at hEq
    linear_combination -hEq
  change translationExponent p f hf
      (fun i : ZMod f ↦
        (((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
          if i = j then gamma else 0) - if i = k then 1 else 0) = 0
  rw [translationExponent_sub]
  rw [show translationExponent p f hf
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
            if i = j then gamma else 0) =
      translationExponent p f hf
          (fun i : ZMod f ↦
            ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int)) +
        translationExponent p f hf
          (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then gamma else 0) by
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply] using translationExponent_add p f hf
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int))
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then gamma else 0)]
  rw [translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
  rw [translationExponent_single]
  rw [translationExponent_single]
  norm_num only [Int.cast_one, one_mul]
  exact hResidue

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.thetaLocalShift_eq_zero_of_niveauOneLeftExponent_eq
statement:
theorem thetaLocalShift_eq_zero_of_niveauOneLeftExponent_eq
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f)) (j k : ZMod f)
    (gamma : Int) (valid : sigma.ThetaValid k) (hkj : k ≠ j)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hgamma : |gamma| ≤ 1)
    (hEq : niveauOneLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf k valid) ∅ =
      niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma J +
        (gamma : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf j) :
    gamma = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply thetaLocalShift_eq_zero hp hf sigma J j k gamma valid hkj huj huj1
    hgamma
  have hResidue :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J +
          (gamma : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf j +
        inversePower p f hf k = 0 := by
    rw [niveauOneLeftExponent_theta_witness hf,
      niveauOneLeftExponent] at hEq
    linear_combination -hEq
  change translationExponent p f hf
      ((fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then gamma else 0) +
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = k then 1 else 0)) = 0
  rw [translationExponent_add, translationExponent_add,
    translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator, translationExponent_single,
    translationExponent_single]
  norm_num only [Int.cast_one, one_mul]
  exact hResidue

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.nuLocalShift_eq_zero_of_niveauOneLeftExponent_eq
statement:
theorem nuLocalShift_eq_zero_of_niveauOneLeftExponent_eq
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f)) (j k : ZMod f)
    (gamma : Int) (valid : sigma.NuValid k) (hkj : k ≠ j)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hgamma : |gamma| ≤ 1)
    (hEq : niveauOneLeftExponent hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf k valid) ∅ =
      niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma J +
        (gamma : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf j) :
    gamma = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply nuLocalShift_eq_zero hp hf sigma J j k gamma valid hkj huj huj1
    hgamma
  have hResidue :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J +
          (gamma : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf j +
          inversePower p f hf k -
        (sigma.u (k + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (k + 1) = 0 := by
    rw [niveauOneLeftExponent_nu_witness (by omega) hf,
      niveauOneLeftExponent] at hEq
    linear_combination -hEq
  change translationExponent p f hf
      (fun i : ZMod f ↦
        (((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
          (if i = j then gamma else 0) + (if i = k then 1 else 0)) -
            if i = k + 1 then (sigma.u (k + 1) : Int) else 0) = 0
  rw [translationExponent_sub]
  rw [show translationExponent p f hf
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          (((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
            (if i = j then gamma else 0)) + if i = k then 1 else 0) =
      translationExponent p f hf
          (fun i : ZMod f ↦
            ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
              if i = j then gamma else 0) +
        translationExponent p f hf
          (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = k then 1 else 0) by
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply] using translationExponent_add p f hf
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
            if i = j then gamma else 0)
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = k then 1 else 0)]
  rw [show translationExponent p f hf
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) +
            if i = j then gamma else 0) =
      translationExponent p f hf
          (fun i : ZMod f ↦
            ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int)) +
        translationExponent p f hf
          (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then gamma else 0) by
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply] using translationExponent_add p f hf
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int))
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then gamma else 0)]
  rw [translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
  rw [translationExponent_single]
  rw [translationExponent_single]
  rw [translationExponent_single]
  norm_num only [Int.cast_one, one_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
  exact hResidue

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.muWitness_not_mem_thetaNiveauOneRange
statement:
theorem muWitness_not_mem_thetaNiveauOneRange
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j k : ZMod f)
    (validMu : sigma.MuValid k) (hNoninvertible : sigma.u k ≠ 1)
    (validTheta : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0) :
    niveauOneLeftExponent hf (sigma.mu hf k validMu) {k + 1} ∉
      Set.range (niveauOneLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf j validTheta))
proof:
:= by
  intro hMem
  rw [theta_niveauOneLeftExponent_range (by omega) hf sigma j validTheta huj
    huj1] at hMem
  rcases hMem with ⟨_, ⟨J, rfl⟩, shift, hShift, hEq⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hShift
  rcases hShift with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · have hEq' :
        niveauOneLeftExponent hf (sigma.mu hf k validMu) {k + 1} =
          niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma J +
            ((-1 : Int) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf j := by
      simpa using hEq.symm
    have hGamma := muLocalShift_eq_zero_of_niveauOneLeftExponent_eq hp hf
      sigma J j k (-1) validMu huj huj1 (by norm_num) hEq'
    norm_num at hGamma
  · have hEqZero :
        niveauOneLeftExponent hf (sigma.mu hf k validMu) {k + 1} =
          niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma J := by simpa using hEq.symm
    apply muStrictWitness_not_mem_leftExponentSet hp hf sigma k validMu
      hNoninvertible
    refine ⟨.niveauOne J, ?_⟩
    simpa [profileLeftExponent, niveauOneLeftExponent] using hEqZero.symm
  · have hEq' :
        niveauOneLeftExponent hf (sigma.mu hf k validMu) {k + 1} =
          niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma J +
            ((1 : Int) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf j := by
      simpa using hEq.symm
    have hGamma := muLocalShift_eq_zero_of_niveauOneLeftExponent_eq hp hf
      sigma J j k 1 validMu huj huj1 (by norm_num) hEq'
    norm_num at hGamma

statement:

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.niveauOneLeftExponent_mem_range_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset
statement:
theorem niveauOneLeftExponent_mem_range_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hsub : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars tau)
    (hnoncritical : tau ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f tau.t)
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) :
    niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma J ∈
      Set.range (niveauOneLeftExponent hf tau)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft :=
    leftExponentSet_subset_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_ne_critical
      hp hf chars sigma tau hsub hnoncritical
  have hmem : profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauOne J) ∈
      leftExponentSet hf sigma := ⟨.niveauOne J, rfl⟩
  rcases hleft hmem with ⟨K, hK⟩
  cases K with
  | niveauOne L =>
      exact ⟨L, by
        simpa [profileLeftExponent, niveauOneLeftExponent] using hK⟩
  | niveauTwo L hL =>
      simp [profileLeftExponent] at hK

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.theta_ne_critical
statement:
theorem theta_ne_critical
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j) :
    sigma.theta hf j valid ≠
      PhantomWeight.critical p f (sigma.theta hf j valid).t
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun tau : PhantomWeight p f ↦ tau.u (j + 1)) h
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro heq
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [heq]; simp
  simp [theta, critical, constantWeight, hsucc] at hcoord
  omega

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.equivalent_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_coordinate_zero
statement:
theorem equivalent_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_coordinate_zero
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    {sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f} (i : ZMod f)
    (hi : sigma.u i = 0)
    (hSupport : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma =
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars tau) :
    Equivalent (by omega) hf sigma tau
proof:
:= by
  rcases (semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_iff_equivalent_or_barsottiTate_steinberg
    hp3 hpOdd hf chars sigma tau).mp hSupport with hEquivalent | hSpecial
  · exact hEquivalent
  · rcases hSpecial with ⟨t, hForward | hReverse⟩
    · rw [hForward.1] at hi
      simp [barsottiTate, constantWeight] at hi
    · rw [hReverse.1] at hi
      simp [steinberg, constantWeight] at hi
      omega

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.thetaData_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq
statement:
theorem thetaData_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    {sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f} (j : ZMod f)
    (validSigma : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (hLocal : sigma.ThetaLocalConditions j)
    (hSupport : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma =
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars tau) :
    ∃ validTau : tau.ThetaValid j,
      tau.ThetaLocalConditions j ∧
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
            (tau.theta hf j validTau) =
          semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
            (sigma.theta hf j validSigma)
proof:
:= by
  have hEquivalent := equivalent_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_coordinate_zero
    hp3 hpOdd hf chars j hLocal.1 hSupport
  rcases theta_equivalent_of_equivalent_at_local_zero_pair
    (sigma := sigma) (tau := tau) (by omega) hf j hEquivalent hLocal with
    ⟨hLocalTau, hThetaEquivalent⟩
  have validTau : tau.ThetaValid j := ⟨by rw [hLocalTau.1]; omega,
    hLocalTau.2.1⟩
  refine ⟨validTau, hLocalTau, ?_⟩
  exact semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_equivalent (by omega) hf chars
    (hThetaEquivalent validSigma validTau)

name: KLSposet.exists_firstCovBy_of_transGen_covBy
statement:
theorem exists_firstCovBy_of_transGen_covBy
    {alpha : Type*} [Preorder alpha] {X W : alpha}
    (hChain : Relation.TransGen (· ⋖ ·) X W) :
    ∃ Y : alpha, X ⋖ Y ∧ Y ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  induction hChain with
  | single hCov => exact ⟨_, hCov, le_rfl⟩
  | tail hChain hCov ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨Y, hXY, hYB⟩
      exact ⟨Y, hXY, hYB.trans hCov.le⟩

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.theta_no_intermediate_of_localConditions
statement:
theorem theta_no_intermediate_of_localConditions
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (validJ : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (hLocal : sigma.ThetaLocalConditions j) :
    ¬ ∃ Z : Set (OrderedCharacterPair I A),
      Z ∈ semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars ∧
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊂ Z ∧
      Z ⊂ semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (sigma.theta hf j validJ)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨Z, hZ, hLeft, hRight⟩
  let X : SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars :=
    ⟨semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma, ⟨sigma, rfl⟩⟩
  let W : SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars := ⟨Z, hZ⟩
  let T : SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars :=
    ⟨semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
      (sigma.theta hf j validJ), ⟨sigma.theta hf j validJ, rfl⟩⟩
  have hXW : X < W := hLeft
  have hWT : W < T := hRight
  letI : Finite (SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars) :=
    semisimpleSupportSet_finite (by omega) hf chars
  letI : Fintype (SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI : DecidableLE (SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars) :=
    Classical.decRel _
  letI : DecidableLT (SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars) :=
    Classical.decRel _
  letI : LocallyFiniteOrder (SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars) :=
    Fintype.toLocallyFiniteOrder
  have hChain : Relation.TransGen (· ⋖ ·) X W :=
    lt_iff_transGen_covBy.mp hXW
  rcases exists_firstCovBy_of_transGen_covBy hChain with ⟨Y, hCov, hYW⟩
  have hYT : Y < T := lt_of_le_of_lt hYW hWT
  have hClassification := simpleSupportInclusion_classification hp3 hpOdd hf
    chars X.1 Y.1 X.2 Y.2 (simpleInclusionIn_of_covBy hCov)
  cases hClassification with
  | mu rho k valid hSource hTarget =>
      have hSupport : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma =
          semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars rho := by
        simpa only [X] using hSource
      rcases thetaData_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars j
        validJ hLocal hSupport with ⟨validTheta, hLocalRho, hThetaSupport⟩
      have hNoninvertible : rho.u k ≠ 1 := by
        intro hk
        have hEq := semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_invertibleStep (by omega) hf
          chars (Or.inl ⟨k, valid, hk, rfl⟩)
        apply hCov.lt.ne
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hSource.trans (hEq.trans hTarget.symm)
      have hSubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
            (rho.mu hf k valid) ⊆
          semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
            (rho.theta hf j validTheta) := by
        rw [← hTarget, hThetaSupport]
        simpa only [T] using hYT.le
      have hMem := niveauOneLeftExponent_mem_range_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset
        hp3 hf chars (rho.mu hf k valid) (rho.theta hf j validTheta) hSubset
        (theta_ne_critical hp3 hf rho j validTheta) ({k + 1} : Set (ZMod f))
      exact (muWitness_not_mem_thetaNiveauOneRange hp3 hf rho j k valid
        hNoninvertible validTheta hLocalRho.1 hLocalRho.2.1) hMem
  | theta rho k valid hSource hTarget =>
      have hSupport : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma =
          semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars rho := by
        simpa only [X] using hSource
      rcases thetaData_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars j
        validJ hLocal hSupport with ⟨validTheta, hLocalRho, hThetaSupport⟩
      by_cases hkj : k = j
      · subst k
        apply hYT.ne
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hTarget.trans hThetaSupport
      · have hSubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (rho.theta hf k valid) ⊆
            semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (rho.theta hf j validTheta) := by
          rw [← hTarget, hThetaSupport]
          simpa only [T] using hYT.le
        have hMem :=
          niveauOneLeftExponent_mem_range_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset
            hp3 hf chars (rho.theta hf k valid) (rho.theta hf j validTheta)
            hSubset (theta_ne_critical hp3 hf rho j validTheta) ∅
        exact (thetaWitness_not_mem_thetaNiveauOneRange hp3 hf rho j k valid
          hkj validTheta hLocalRho.1 hLocalRho.2.1) hMem
  | nu rho k valid hSource hTarget =>
      have hSupport : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma =
          semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars rho := by
        simpa only [X] using hSource
      rcases thetaData_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars j
        validJ hLocal hSupport with ⟨validTheta, hLocalRho, hThetaSupport⟩
      have hNoninvertible : rho.u (k + 1) ≠ p := by
        intro hk
        have hEq := semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_invertibleStep (by omega) hf
          chars (Or.inr ⟨k, valid, hk, rfl⟩)
        apply hCov.lt.ne
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hSource.trans (hEq.trans hTarget.symm)
      by_cases hkj : k = j
      · subst k
        have hThetaNu := rho.theta_eq_nu_of_successor_zero (by omega) hf j
          validTheta valid hLocalRho.2.1
        apply hYT.ne
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hTarget.trans ((congrArg
          (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars) hThetaNu).symm.trans
            hThetaSupport)
      · have hSubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (rho.nu (by omega) hf k valid) ⊆
            semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (rho.theta hf j validTheta) := by
          rw [← hTarget, hThetaSupport]
          simpa only [T] using hYT.le
        have hMem :=
          niveauOneLeftExponent_mem_range_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset
            hp3 hf chars (rho.nu (by omega) hf k valid)
            (rho.theta hf j validTheta) hSubset
            (theta_ne_critical hp3 hf rho j validTheta) ∅
        exact (nuWitness_not_mem_thetaNiveauOneRange hp3 hf rho j k valid
          hNoninvertible hkj validTheta hLocalRho.1 hLocalRho.2.1) hMem
  | unramifiedCritical t hSource hTarget =>
      have hCount := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_lt_of_properInclusion hp3
        hpOdd hf chars Y T hYT
      have hYCount := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars Y
        (critical p f t) hTarget
      rw [hYCount] at hCount
      have hpSubPositive : 0 < p - 1 := by omega
      simp [zeroCount, critical, constantWeight, Nat.ne_of_gt hpSubPositive] at hCount

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.mu_simpleInclusion
statement:
theorem mu_simpleInclusion
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.MuValid j) (hNoninvertible : sigma.u j ≠ 1) :
    SimpleInclusionIn (semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars (sigma.mu hf j valid))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mu_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars sigma j valid
    hNoninvertible, ?_⟩
  rintro Z hZ hBetween
  exact sigma.mu_no_intermediate hp3 hpOdd hf chars j valid
    ⟨Z, hZ, hBetween⟩

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.theta_simpleInclusion_of_not_exceptional
statement:
theorem theta_simpleInclusion_of_not_exceptional
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ sigma.ExceptionalForSimplicity j) :
    SimpleInclusionIn (semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (sigma.theta hf j valid))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨theta_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars sigma j valid, ?_⟩
  rintro Z hZ hBetween
  have hZero := sigma.theta_adjacent_zero_of_intermediate hp3 hpOdd hf chars
    j valid Z hZ hBetween.1 hBetween.2
  have hPrev : sigma.u (j - 1) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hNotExceptional ⟨hZero.1, hZero.2, Or.inl h⟩
  have hNext : sigma.u (j + 2) ≠ p := by
    intro h
    exact hNotExceptional ⟨hZero.1, hZero.2, Or.inr h⟩
  exact sigma.theta_no_intermediate_of_localConditions hp3 hpOdd hf chars j
    valid ⟨hZero.1, hZero.2, hPrev, hNext⟩ ⟨Z, hZ, hBetween⟩

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.nu_simpleInclusion_of_not_exceptional
statement:
theorem nu_simpleInclusion_of_not_exceptional
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid j) (hNoninvertible : sigma.u (j + 1) ≠ p)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ sigma.ExceptionalForSimplicity j) :
    SimpleInclusionIn (semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨nu_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars sigma j valid
    hNoninvertible, ?_⟩
  rintro Z hZ hBetween
  have hZero := sigma.nu_adjacent_zero_of_intermediate hp3 hpOdd hf chars
    j valid Z hZ hBetween.1 hBetween.2
  have hPrev : sigma.u (j - 1) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    exact hNotExceptional ⟨hZero.1, hZero.2, Or.inl h⟩
  have hNext : sigma.u (j + 2) ≠ p := by
    intro h
    exact hNotExceptional ⟨hZero.1, hZero.2, Or.inr h⟩
  have validTheta : sigma.ThetaValid j :=
    ⟨by rw [hZero.1]; omega, hZero.2⟩
  have hThetaNu := sigma.theta_eq_nu_of_successor_zero (by omega) hf j
    validTheta valid hZero.2
  apply sigma.theta_no_intermediate_of_localConditions hp3 hpOdd hf chars j
    validTheta ⟨hZero.1, hZero.2, hPrev, hNext⟩
  exact ⟨Z, hZ, hBetween.1, by rw [hThetaNu]; exact hBetween.2⟩

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.leftExceptional_theta_factorization
statement:
theorem leftExceptional_theta_factorization
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (validTheta : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hprev : sigma.u (j - 1) = 1) :
    ∃ (validMuPrev : sigma.MuValid (j - 1))
      (validMuJ : (sigma.mu hf (j - 1) validMuPrev).MuValid j)
      (validNuPrev : ((sigma.mu hf (j - 1) validMuPrev).mu hf j
        validMuJ).NuValid (j - 1)),
      sigma.theta hf j validTheta =
        ((sigma.mu hf (j - 1) validMuPrev).mu hf j validMuJ).nu
          (by omega) hf (j - 1) validNuPrev
proof:
:= by
  have hPredSucc : j - 1 + 1 = j := by ring
  have hSuccNe : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hPredNe : j - 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = j - (j - 1) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  by_cases hWrap : j + 1 = j - 1
  · have : False := by rw [← hWrap] at hprev; omega
    contradiction
  · have validMuPrev : sigma.MuValid (j - 1) :=
      ⟨by omega, by simpa only [hPredSucc] using huj⟩
    have hWrap' : j - 1 ≠ j + 1 := Ne.symm hWrap
    have validMuJ : (sigma.mu hf (j - 1) validMuPrev).MuValid j := by
      constructor
      · simp [mu, hPredNe.symm, hPredSucc, huj]
        omega
      · simp [mu, hWrap, hSuccNe, huj1]
    have validNuPrev : ((sigma.mu hf (j - 1) validMuPrev).mu hf j
        validMuJ).NuValid (j - 1) := by
      simp [NuValid, mu, hPredNe, hPredSucc, hWrap', hprev]
    refine ⟨validMuPrev, validMuJ, validNuPrev, ?_⟩
    apply ext
    · funext i
      by_cases hiPrev : i = j - 1
      · subst i
        simp [theta, nu, mu, hPredNe, hPredSucc, hWrap', hprev]
      · by_cases hiJ : i = j
        · subst i
          simp [theta, nu, mu, hPredNe.symm, hPredSucc, huj]
          omega
        · by_cases hiSucc : i = j + 1
          · subst i
            simp [theta, nu, mu, hPredSucc, hSuccNe, hWrap, huj1]
          · simp [theta, nu, mu, hiPrev, hiJ, hiSucc]
    · have hAtJ : ((sigma.mu hf (j - 1) validMuPrev).mu hf j
          validMuJ).u j = p - 1 := by
        simp [mu, hPredNe.symm, hPredSucc, huj]
      have hInv := inversePower_succ p f (by omega) hf (j - 1)
      rw [hPredSucc] at hInv
      change sigma.t - inversePower p f hf j =
        ((sigma.mu hf (j - 1) validMuPrev).mu hf j validMuJ).t -
          inversePower p f hf (j - 1) +
          (((sigma.mu hf (j - 1) validMuPrev).mu hf j validMuJ).u
            (j - 1 + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
            inversePower p f hf (j - 1 + 1)
      rw [hPredSucc, hAtJ]
      change sigma.t - inversePower p f hf j =
        sigma.t - inversePower p f hf (j - 1) +
          ((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf j
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)]
      push_cast
      rw [← hInv]
      ring

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.rightExceptional_theta_factorization
statement:
theorem rightExceptional_theta_factorization
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (validTheta : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hnext : sigma.u (j + 2) = p) :
    ∃ (validNuNext : sigma.NuValid (j + 1))
      (validNuJ : (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + 1) validNuNext).NuValid j)
      (validThetaNext : ((sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + 1) validNuNext).nu
        (by omega) hf j validNuJ).ThetaValid (j + 1)),
      sigma.theta hf j validTheta =
        ((sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + 1) validNuNext).nu (by omega) hf j
          validNuJ).theta hf (j + 1) validThetaNext
proof:
:= by
  have hSuccNext : j + 1 + 1 = j + 2 := by ring
  have hSuccNe : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hNextNeSucc : j + 2 ≠ j + 1 := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 2) - (j + 1) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  by_cases hWrap : j + 2 = j
  · have : False := by rw [hWrap] at hnext; omega
    contradiction
  · have validNuNext : sigma.NuValid (j + 1) := huj1
    have hWrap' : j ≠ j + 1 + 1 := by
      rw [hSuccNext]
      exact Ne.symm hWrap
    have validNuJ : (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + 1) validNuNext).NuValid j := by
      simp [NuValid, nu, hSuccNe.symm, hWrap', huj]
    have validThetaNext : ((sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + 1) validNuNext).nu
        (by omega) hf j validNuJ).ThetaValid (j + 1) := by
      constructor
      · simp [nu, hSuccNe, hSuccNext, huj1]
        omega
      · simp [nu, hSuccNext, hWrap, hNextNeSucc, hnext]
    refine ⟨validNuNext, validNuJ, validThetaNext, ?_⟩
    apply ext
    · funext i
      by_cases hiJ : i = j
      · subst i
        simp [theta, nu, hSuccNe.symm, hWrap', huj]
      · by_cases hiSucc : i = j + 1
        · subst i
          simp [theta, nu, hSuccNe, hSuccNext, huj1]
          omega
        · by_cases hiNext : i = j + 2
          · subst i
            simp [theta, nu, hSuccNext, hNextNeSucc, hWrap, hnext]
          · simp [theta, nu, hSuccNext, hiJ, hiSucc, hiNext]
    · have hAtSucc : (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + 1) validNuNext).u
          (j + 1) = 1 := by
        simp [nu, huj1]
      have hInv := inversePower_succ p f (by omega) hf (j + 1)
      rw [hSuccNext] at hInv
      change sigma.t - inversePower p f hf j =
        ((sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + 1) validNuNext).nu (by omega) hf j
            validNuJ).t - inversePower p f hf (j + 1)
      rw [show ((sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + 1) validNuNext).nu
          (by omega) hf j validNuJ).t =
          (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + 1) validNuNext).t -
            inversePower p f hf j +
            (((sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + 1) validNuNext).u (j + 1) :
              ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf (j + 1)) from rfl]
      rw [show (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + 1) validNuNext).t =
          sigma.t - inversePower p f hf (j + 1) +
            (sigma.u (j + 1 + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
              inversePower p f hf (j + 1 + 1) from rfl]
      rw [hSuccNext, hAtSucc, hnext]
      push_cast
      rw [← hInv]
      ring

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.leftExceptional_theta_has_intermediate
statement:
theorem leftExceptional_theta_has_intermediate
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (validTheta : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hprev : sigma.u (j - 1) = 1) :
    ∃ Z : Set (OrderedCharacterPair I A),
      Z ∈ semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars ∧
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊂ Z ∧
      Z ⊂ semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (sigma.theta hf j validTheta)
proof:
:= by
  rcases leftExceptional_theta_factorization hp3 hf sigma j validTheta
    huj huj1 hprev with ⟨validMuPrev, validMuJ, validNuPrev, hFactor⟩
  let H := sigma.mu hf (j - 1) validMuPrev
  let G := H.mu hf j validMuJ
  refine ⟨semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars G, ⟨G, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hSourceEq := semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_invertibleStep (by omega) hf
      chars (Or.inl ⟨j - 1, validMuPrev, hprev, rfl⟩)
    have hPredSucc : j - 1 + 1 = j := by ring
    have hPredNe : j - 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
        omega
      apply hone
      calc
        (1 : ZMod f) = j - (j - 1) := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    have hHAtJ : H.u j = p := by
      simp [H, mu, hPredNe.symm, hPredSucc, huj]
    have hStrict := mu_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars H j validMuJ
      (by rw [hHAtJ]; omega)
    rw [hSourceEq]
    exact hStrict
  · have hPredSucc : j - 1 + 1 = j := by ring
    have hGAtJ : G.u j = p - 1 := by
      have hPredNe : j - 1 ≠ j := by
        intro h
        have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
          omega
        apply hone
        calc
          (1 : ZMod f) = j - (j - 1) := by ring
          _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
      simp [G, H, mu, hPredNe.symm, hPredSucc, huj]
    have hStrict := nu_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars G (j - 1)
      validNuPrev (by rw [hPredSucc, hGAtJ]; omega)
    rw [hFactor]
    exact hStrict

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.rightExceptional_theta_has_intermediate
statement:
theorem rightExceptional_theta_has_intermediate
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (validTheta : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hnext : sigma.u (j + 2) = p) :
    ∃ Z : Set (OrderedCharacterPair I A),
      Z ∈ semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars ∧
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊂ Z ∧
      Z ⊂ semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (sigma.theta hf j validTheta)
proof:
:= by
  rcases rightExceptional_theta_factorization hp3 hf sigma j validTheta
    huj huj1 hnext with ⟨validNuNext, validNuJ, validThetaNext, hFactor⟩
  let H := sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + 1) validNuNext
  let G := H.nu (by omega) hf j validNuJ
  refine ⟨semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars G, ⟨G, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hSourceEq := semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_invertibleStep (by omega) hf
      chars (Or.inr ⟨j + 1, validNuNext,
        by simpa only [show j + 1 + 1 = j + 2 by ring] using hnext, rfl⟩)
    have hHAtSucc : H.u (j + 1) = 1 := by
      simp [H, nu, huj1]
    have hStrict := nu_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars H j validNuJ
      (by rw [hHAtSucc]; omega)
    rw [hSourceEq]
    exact hStrict
  ·
    have hStrict := theta_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars G (j + 1)
      validThetaNext
    rw [hFactor]
    exact hStrict

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.theta_not_simple_of_exceptional
statement:
theorem theta_not_simple_of_exceptional
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (hExceptional : sigma.ExceptionalForSimplicity j) :
    ¬ SimpleInclusionIn (semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (sigma.theta hf j valid))
proof:
:= by
  rintro hSimple
  rcases hExceptional with ⟨huj, huj1, hprev | hnext⟩
  · rcases leftExceptional_theta_has_intermediate hp3 hf chars sigma j
      valid huj huj1 hprev with ⟨Z, hZ, hLeft, hRight⟩
    exact hSimple.2 Z hZ ⟨hLeft, hRight⟩
  · rcases rightExceptional_theta_has_intermediate hp3 hf chars sigma j
      valid huj huj1 hnext with ⟨Z, hZ, hLeft, hRight⟩
    exact hSimple.2 Z hZ ⟨hLeft, hRight⟩

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.nu_not_simple_of_exceptional
statement:
theorem nu_not_simple_of_exceptional
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid j)
    (hExceptional : sigma.ExceptionalForSimplicity j) :
    ¬ SimpleInclusionIn (semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hExceptional with ⟨huj, huj1, hException⟩
  have validTheta : sigma.ThetaValid j := ⟨by rw [huj]; omega, huj1⟩
  have hThetaNu := sigma.theta_eq_nu_of_successor_zero (by omega) hf j
    validTheta valid huj1
  intro hSimple
  apply theta_not_simple_of_exceptional hp3 hf chars sigma j validTheta
    ⟨huj, huj1, hException⟩
  simpa only [hThetaNu] using hSimple

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.mu_simpleInclusion_iff
statement:
theorem mu_simpleInclusion_iff
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.MuValid j) :
    SimpleInclusionIn (semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars (sigma.mu hf j valid)) ↔
      sigma.u j ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hSimple hInvertible
    have hEq := semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_invertibleStep (by omega) hf chars
      (Or.inl ⟨j, valid, hInvertible, rfl⟩)
    exact hSimple.1.ne hEq
  · exact mu_simpleInclusion hp3 hpOdd hf chars sigma j valid

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.theta_simpleInclusion_iff
statement:
theorem theta_simpleInclusion_iff
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j) :
    SimpleInclusionIn (semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (sigma.theta hf j valid)) ↔
      ¬ sigma.ExceptionalForSimplicity j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hSimple hExceptional
    exact theta_not_simple_of_exceptional hp3 hf chars sigma j valid
      hExceptional hSimple
  · exact theta_simpleInclusion_of_not_exceptional hp3 hpOdd hf chars sigma j valid

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.nu_simpleInclusion_iff
statement:
theorem nu_simpleInclusion_iff
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid j) :
    SimpleInclusionIn (semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma)
      (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid)) ↔
      sigma.u (j + 1) ≠ p ∧ ¬ sigma.ExceptionalForSimplicity j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hSimple
    have hNoninvertible : sigma.u (j + 1) ≠ p := by
      intro hInvertible
      have hEq := semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_invertibleStep (by omega) hf chars
        (Or.inr ⟨j, valid, hInvertible, rfl⟩)
      exact hSimple.1.ne hEq
    refine ⟨hNoninvertible, ?_⟩
    intro hExceptional
    exact nu_not_simple_of_exceptional hp3 hf chars sigma j valid
      hExceptional hSimple
  · rintro ⟨hNoninvertible, hNotExceptional⟩
    exact nu_simpleInclusion_of_not_exceptional hp3 hpOdd hf chars sigma j valid
      hNoninvertible hNotExceptional

name: KLSposet.mem_compatibleProfiles_iff
statement:
theorem mem_compatibleProfiles_iff {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Profile f) :
    J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' ↔
      ∃ K : Profile f,
        J.niveau = K.niveau ∧
          profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma J =
            profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' K
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: KLSposet.profileCarryEquation_existsUnique_of_pair_eq
statement:
theorem profileCarryEquation_existsUnique_of_pair_eq {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J K : Profile f)
    (hNiveau : J.niveau = K.niveau)
    (hPair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma J =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' K) :
    ∃! x : J.Index → Int,
      ProfileCarryEquation hf sigma sigma' J K hNiveau x
proof:
:= by
  cases J with
  | niveauOne J =>
      cases K with
      | niveauOne K =>
          simpa only [ProfileCarryEquation, Profile.Index] using
            niveauOneCarryEquation_existsUnique_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
              sigma sigma' J K hPair
      | niveauTwo K hK =>
          simp [Profile.niveau] at hNiveau
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      cases K with
      | niveauOne K =>
          simp [Profile.niveau] at hNiveau
      | niveauTwo K hK =>
          simpa only [ProfileCarryEquation, Profile.Index] using
            niveauTwoCarryEquation_existsUnique_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
              sigma sigma' J K hJ hK hPair

name: KLSposet.mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset_of_ne_critical
statement:
theorem mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset_of_ne_critical
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma')
    (hnoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t)
    (J : Profile f) :
    J ∈ compatibleProfiles (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma'
proof:
:= by
  have hsource : profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma J ∈
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma := ⟨J, rfl⟩
  rcases hsubset hsource with ⟨K, hpair⟩
  cases J with
  | niveauOne J =>
      cases K with
      | niveauOne K =>
          rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
          exact ⟨.niveauOne K, rfl, hpair.symm⟩
      | niveauTwo K hK =>
          have hscalars := crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_eq_implies_scalar
            (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma' J K hK hpair.symm
          rcases scalar_niveauOneProfileCharacterPair_eq_niveauTwo hp hf chars
            sigma' K hK hscalars.2 with ⟨L, hconvert⟩
          rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
          refine ⟨.niveauOne L, rfl, ?_⟩
          exact hpair.symm.trans hconvert.symm
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      cases K with
      | niveauOne K =>
          have hscalars := crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_eq_implies_scalar
            (by omega) hf chars sigma' sigma K J hJ hpair
          rcases noncritical_niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_eq_niveauOne hp hf
            chars sigma' K hscalars.1 hnoncritical with ⟨L, hL, hconvert⟩
          rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
          refine ⟨.niveauTwo L hL, rfl, ?_⟩
          exact hpair.symm.trans hconvert.symm
      | niveauTwo K hK =>
          rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
          exact ⟨.niveauTwo K hK, rfl, hpair.symm⟩

name: KLSposet.compatibleProfiles_iff_of_subset_of_eq_critical
statement:
theorem compatibleProfiles_iff_of_subset_of_eq_critical
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma')
    (hcritical : sigma' = PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t)
    (J : Profile f) :
    J ∈ compatibleProfiles (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma' ↔
      ¬ (J.niveau = .two ∧
        (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma J).IsScalar)
proof:
:= by
  cases J with
  | niveauOne J =>
      constructor
      · intro _ hbad
        simp [Profile.niveau] at hbad
      · intro _
        have hsubsetCritical : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
            semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t) := by
          simpa only [← hcritical] using hsubset
        rcases criticalTarget_niveauOneProfileWitness_of_subset hp hf chars
          sigma sigma'.t hsubsetCritical J with ⟨K, hpair⟩
        rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
        refine ⟨.niveauOne K, rfl, ?_⟩
        rw [hcritical]
        exact hpair
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      constructor
      · intro hcompat hbad
        have hscalar :
            (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma
              (.niveauTwo J hJ)).IsScalar := hbad.2
        rcases (mem_compatibleProfiles_iff (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma'
          (.niveauTwo J hJ)).mp hcompat with ⟨K, hNiveau, hpair⟩
        cases K with
        | niveauOne K => simp [Profile.niveau] at hNiveau
        | niveauTwo K hK =>
            have htargetScalar :
                (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma'
                  (.niveauTwo K hK)).IsScalar := by
              simpa only [← hpair] using hscalar
            rw [hcritical] at htargetScalar
            exact critical_niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_not_scalar hp hf chars
              sigma'.t K hK htargetScalar
      · intro hnot
        have hnonscalar :
            ¬ (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma
              (.niveauTwo J hJ)).IsScalar := by
          intro hscalar
          exact hnot ⟨rfl, hscalar⟩
        have hsource :
            profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ) ∈
              semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma :=
          ⟨.niveauTwo J hJ, rfl⟩
        rcases hsubset hsource with ⟨K, hpair⟩
        cases K with
        | niveauOne K =>
            have hscalars := crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_eq_implies_scalar
              (by omega) hf chars sigma' sigma K J hJ hpair
            exact False.elim (hnonscalar hscalars.2)
        | niveauTwo K hK =>
            rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
            exact ⟨.niveauTwo K hK, rfl, hpair.symm⟩

name: KLSposet.niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset
statement:
theorem niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) :
    Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma'
proof:
:= by
  have hsource : profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma
        (.niveauOne J) ∈ semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma :=
    ⟨.niveauOne J, rfl⟩
  rcases hsubset hsource with ⟨K, hpair⟩
  cases K with
  | niveauOne K =>
      rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
      exact ⟨.niveauOne K, rfl, hpair.symm⟩
  | niveauTwo K hK =>
      have hscalars := crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_eq_implies_scalar
        (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma' J K hK hpair.symm
      rcases scalar_niveauOneProfileCharacterPair_eq_niveauTwo hp hf chars
          sigma' K hK hscalars.2 with ⟨L, hconvert⟩
      rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
      refine ⟨.niveauOne L, rfl, ?_⟩
      exact hpair.symm.trans hconvert.symm

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_isScalar_of_subset_of_not_compatible
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileCharacterPair_isScalar_of_subset_of_not_compatible
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma')
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    (hNotCompatible : Profile.niveauTwo P hComplementary ∉
      compatibleProfiles (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma') :
    (profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma
      (.niveauTwo P hComplementary)).IsScalar
proof:
:= by
  have hsource : profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma
        (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) ∈
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma :=
    ⟨.niveauTwo P hComplementary, rfl⟩
  rcases hsubset hsource with ⟨K, hpair⟩
  cases K with
  | niveauOne K =>
      exact (crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_eq_implies_scalar
        (by omega) hf chars sigma' sigma K P hComplementary hpair).2
  | niveauTwo K hK =>
      exfalso
      apply hNotCompatible
      rw [mem_compatibleProfiles_iff]
      exact ⟨.niveauTwo K hK, rfl, hpair.symm⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.carry_spec
statement:
theorem carry_spec {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Profile f) (hJ : J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    ProfileCarryEquation hf sigma sigma' J (pin.target J hJ)
      (pin.target_niveau J hJ) (pin.carry J hJ)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec
    (profileCarryEquation_existsUnique_of_pair_eq hp hf chars sigma sigma'
      J (pin.target J hJ) (pin.target_niveau J hJ) (pin.target_pair_eq J hJ))).1

name: KLSposet.Pinning.carry_unique
statement:
theorem carry_unique {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]

    (hx : ProfileCarryEquation hf sigma sigma' J (pin.target J hJ)
      (pin.target_niveau J hJ) x) :
    x = pin.carry J hJ
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec
    (profileCarryEquation_existsUnique_of_pair_eq hp hf chars sigma sigma'
      J (pin.target J hJ) (pin.target_niveau J hJ) (pin.target_pair_eq J hJ))).2 x hx

name: KLSposet.Pinning.target_eq_niveauOne
statement:
theorem target_eq_niveauOne {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    ∃ K : Set (ZMod f), pin.target (.niveauOne J) hJ = .niveauOne K
proof:
:= by
  have hNiveau := pin.target_niveau (.niveauOne J) hJ
  cases htarget : pin.target (.niveauOne J) hJ with
  | niveauOne K => exact ⟨K, rfl⟩
  | niveauTwo K hK => simp [Profile.niveau, htarget] at hNiveau

name: KLSposet.Pinning.target_eq_niveauTwo
statement:
theorem target_eq_niveauTwo {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}

    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    ∃ (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K),
      pin.target (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ = .niveauTwo K hK
proof:
:= by
  have hNiveau := pin.target_niveau (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
  cases htarget : pin.target (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ with
  | niveauOne K => simp [Profile.niveau, htarget] at hNiveau
  | niveauTwo K hK => exact ⟨K, hK, rfl⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOneTarget_spec
statement:
theorem niveauOneTarget_spec {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    pin.target (.niveauOne J) hJ = .niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (pin.target_eq_niveauOne J hJ)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwoTarget_complementary
statement:
theorem niveauTwoTarget_complementary {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    ∀ i, i ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ ↔
      i + f ∉ pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
    (pin.target_eq_niveauTwo J hComplementary hJ))

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwoTarget_spec
statement:
theorem niveauTwoTarget_spec {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    pin.target (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ =
      .niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)
