  exact Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
    (pin.target_eq_niveauTwo J hComplementary hJ))

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec
statement:
theorem pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    CarryEquation p
      (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ))
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pinnedNiveauOneCarry
  exact (Classical.choose_spec
    (niveauOneCarryEquation_existsUnique_of_pair_eq hp hf chars sigma sigma' J
      (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ) (by
        rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec J hJ]
        exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne J) hJ))).1

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec
statement:
theorem pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    CarryEquation p
      (niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ) hComplementary
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ))
      (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pinnedNiveauTwoCarry
  exact (Classical.choose_spec
    (niveauTwoCarryEquation_existsUnique_of_pair_eq hp hf chars sigma sigma' J
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ) hComplementary
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ) (by
        rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec J hComplementary hJ]
        exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ))).1

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pairedCarry_difference_even
statement:
theorem pairedCarry_difference_even {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Profile f) (hJ : J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    ∀ i, Even (pin.sameNiveauCarry J hJ i - pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty J i)
proof:
:= by
  have hpairEmpty :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne ∅) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
          (.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)) := by
    rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec ∅ hEmpty]
    exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f))) hEmpty
  have hcarryEmpty := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty
  cases J with
  | niveauOne J =>
      have hpair :
          profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
            profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
              (.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)) := by
        rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec J hJ]
        exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne J) hJ
      have hcarry := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec J hJ
      simpa only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] using
        niveauOneCarryEquation_sameParity_of_pair_eq hp hf chars sigma sigma'
          J (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ) ∅ (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)
          hpair hpairEmpty hcarry hcarryEmpty
  | niveauTwo J hComplementary =>
      have hpair :
          profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
            profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
              (.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
                (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)) := by
        rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec J hComplementary hJ]
        exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
      have hcarry := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ
      intro i
      have hparity := crossNiveauCarryEquation_sameParity_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
        sigma sigma' ∅ (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty) J
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ) hComplementary
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ) hpairEmpty hpair
        hcarryEmpty hcarry i
      rcases hparity with ⟨k, hk⟩
      refine ⟨-k, ?_⟩
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt]
      omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.two_mul_pairedCarrySum
statement:
theorem two_mul_pairedCarrySum {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Profile f) (hJ : J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : J.Index) :
    2 * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hJ i =
      pin.sameNiveauCarry J hJ i + pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty J i
proof:
:= by
  rcases pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty J hJ i with ⟨k, hk⟩
  simp only [pairedCarrySum]
  omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference
statement:
theorem two_mul_pairedCarryDifference {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Profile f) (hJ : J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : J.Index) :
    2 * pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty J hJ i =
      pin.sameNiveauCarry J hJ i - pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty J i
proof:
:= by
  rcases pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty J hJ i with ⟨k, hk⟩
  simp only [pairedCarryDifference]
  omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOnePairedCarrySumEquation
statement:
theorem niveauOnePairedCarrySumEquation {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    ∀ i : ZMod f,
      ((Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i +
          (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)).sign i) / 2 *
          (sigma'.u i : Int) -
        ((Profile.niveauOne Jᶜ).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) =
      (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) -
        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  classical
  have hCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec J hJ i
  have hBase := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty i
  have hSumPrev :=
    pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1)
  have hSum := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSumPrev hSum
  have hScaledSumPrev := congrArg (fun z : Int ↦ (p : Int) * z) hSumPrev
  have hRaw :
      (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ) i +
          niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' ∅ (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty) i) / 2 =
        (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) -
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i := by
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] at hCarry hBase hScaledSumPrev hSum ⊢
    ring_nf at hCarry hBase hScaledSumPrev hSum ⊢
    omega
  rw [← hRaw]
  by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J <;>
    by_cases hiTarget : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ <;>
      by_cases hiBase : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty <;>
        simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
          Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hiTarget, hiBase] <;>
        omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOnePairedCarryDifferenceEquation
statement:
theorem niveauOnePairedCarryDifferenceEquation {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    ∀ i : ZMod f,
      ((Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i -
          (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)).sign i) / 2 *
          (sigma'.u i : Int) +
        ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) =
      (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) -
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  classical
  have hCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec J hJ i
  have hBase := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty i
  have hDifferencePrev :=
    pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1)
  have hDifference :=
    pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hDifferencePrev hDifference
  have hScaledDifferencePrev :=
    congrArg (fun z : Int ↦ (p : Int) * z) hDifferencePrev
  have hRaw :
      (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' J (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ) i -
          niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' ∅ (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty) i) / 2 =
        (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) -
          pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i := by
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]
      at hCarry hBase hScaledDifferencePrev hDifference ⊢
    ring_nf at hCarry hBase hScaledDifferencePrev hDifference ⊢
    omega
  rw [← hRaw]
  by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J <;>
    by_cases hiTarget : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ <;>
      by_cases hiBase : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty <;>
        simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
          Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hiTarget, hiBase] <;>
        omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwoPairedCarrySumEquation
statement:
theorem niveauTwoPairedCarrySumEquation {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    ∀ i : ZMod (2 * f),
      ((Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
            (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign i +
          (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)).sign
            (periodicIndex hf i)) / 2 * (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int) -
        ((Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary).compl.indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) =
      (p : Int) *
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1) -
        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  classical
  have hCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ i
  have hBase :=
    carryEquation_periodicExtend hf
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty) i
  have hSumPrev :=
    pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1)
  have hSum :=
    pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSumPrev hSum
  have hScaledSumPrev := congrArg (fun z : Int ↦ (p : Int) * z) hSumPrev
  have hRaw :
      (niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J
            (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ) hComplementary
            (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ) i +
          periodicExtend hf
            (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' ∅
              (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)) i) / 2 =
        (p : Int) *
            pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1) -
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i := by
    simp only [periodicExtend] at hBase hScaledSumPrev hSum ⊢
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] at hCarry hBase hScaledSumPrev hSum ⊢
    ring_nf at hCarry hBase hScaledSumPrev hSum ⊢
    omega
  rw [← hRaw]
  by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J <;>
    by_cases hiTarget : i ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ <;>
      by_cases hiBase : periodicIndex hf i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty <;>
        simp [niveauTwoCarryInput, periodicExtend, niveauOneCarryInput,
          PhantomWeight.periodicU, Profile.compl, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
          Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hiTarget, hiBase] <;>
        omega

statement:
theorem niveauTwoPairedCarryDifferenceEquation {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')

    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    ∀ i : ZMod (2 * f),
      ((Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
            (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign i -
          (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)).sign
            (periodicIndex hf i)) / 2 * (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int) +
        ((Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) =
      (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
          (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1) -
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  classical
  have hCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ i

    carryEquation_periodicExtend hf
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty) i

    pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1)

    pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hDifferencePrev hDifference
  have hScaledDifferencePrev :=
    congrArg (fun z : Int ↦ (p : Int) * z) hDifferencePrev
  have hRaw :
      (niveauTwoCarryInput hf sigma sigma' J
            (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ) hComplementary

          periodicExtend hf
            (niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' ∅

        (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
            (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1) -
          pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i := by
    simp only [periodicExtend]
      at hBase hScaledDifferencePrev hDifference ⊢

      at hCarry hBase hScaledDifferencePrev hDifference ⊢
    ring_nf at hCarry hBase hScaledDifferencePrev hDifference ⊢
    omega
  rw [← hRaw]
  by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J <;>
    by_cases hiTarget : i ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ <;>
      by_cases hiBase : periodicIndex hf i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty <;>
        simp [niveauTwoCarryInput, periodicExtend, niveauOneCarryInput,

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative
statement:
theorem niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    ∀ i : ZMod f,
      (-(((Profile.niveauOne Jᶜ).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int)) =
          (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) -
            pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i) ∨
        (((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) * (sigma.u i : Int) =
          (p : Int) *
              pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) -
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  classical
  have hSum := pin.niveauOnePairedCarrySumEquation hEmpty J hJ i
  have hDifference :=
    pin.niveauOnePairedCarryDifferenceEquation hEmpty J hJ i
  by_cases hiTarget : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
  · have hTargetSign :
        (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i = -1 := by
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiTarget]
    by_cases hiBase : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty
    · have hBaseSign :
          (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)).sign i = -1 := by
        simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiBase]
      rw [hTargetSign, hBaseSign] at hDifference
      norm_num at hDifference
      exact Or.inr hDifference
    · have hBaseSign :
          (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)).sign i = 1 := by
        simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiBase]
      rw [hTargetSign, hBaseSign] at hSum
      norm_num at hSum
      exact Or.inl hSum
  · have hTargetSign :
        (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i = 1 := by
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiTarget]
    by_cases hiBase : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty
    · have hBaseSign :
          (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)).sign i = -1 := by
        simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiBase]
      rw [hTargetSign, hBaseSign] at hSum
      norm_num at hSum
      exact Or.inl hSum
    · have hBaseSign :
          (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty)).sign i = 1 := by
        simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiBase]
      rw [hTargetSign, hBaseSign] at hDifference
      norm_num at hDifference
      exact Or.inr hDifference

    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) :
    (i ∈ J →
      ((p : Int) * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) =
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i) ∨
        ((sigma.u i : Int) =
          (p : Int) *
              pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) -
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i)) ∧
    (i ∉ J →
      (-(sigma.u i : Int) =
          (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) -
            pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i) ∨
        ((p : Int) *
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) =

    · right
      simpa [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi] using hDifference

    rcases hAlternative with hSum | hDifference
    · left
      simpa [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi] using hSum

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception
statement:
theorem pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    (∀ i, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ i| ≤ 2) ∨
      ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma'
proof:
:= by
  have hPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
          (.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)) := by
    rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec J hJ]
    exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne J) hJ
  rcases niveauOneCarryEquation_bound_or_exception_with_twist_of_pair_eq
      hp3 hf chars sigma sigma' J (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ) hPair
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec J hJ) with hBound | hExceptional
  · exact Or.inl hBound
  · rcases hExceptional with ⟨hpEq, hu, hu', _hProfiles, ht⟩
    exact Or.inr ⟨hpEq, hu, hu', ht⟩

theorem baseCarryAt_abs_le_two {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}

      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hBound : ∀ i, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i| ≤ 2)
    (J : Profile f) : ∀ i, |pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty J i| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  cases J with
  | niveauOne J =>
      intro i
      simpa only [baseCarryAt] using hBound i
  | niveauTwo J hComplementary =>
      intro i
      simpa only [baseCarryAt] using hBound (periodicIndex hf i)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pairedCarrySum_abs_le_two
statement:
theorem pairedCarrySum_abs_le_two {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Profile f) (hJ : J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hCarry : ∀ i, |pin.sameNiveauCarry J hJ i| ≤ 2)
    (hBase : ∀ i, |pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty J i| ≤ 2) :
    ∀ i, |pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hJ i| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have hCarryBounds := abs_le.mp (hCarry i)
  have hBaseBounds := abs_le.mp (hBase i)
  have hDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hJ i
  apply abs_le.mpr
  omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pairedCarryDifference_abs_le_two
statement:
theorem pairedCarryDifference_abs_le_two {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}

    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}

proof:
