name: KLSposet.Pinning.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception
statement:
theorem pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Profile f) (hJ : J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    ((∀ i, |pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hJ i| ≤ 2) ∧
        ∀ i, |pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty J hJ i| ≤ 2) ∨
      ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma'
proof:
:= by
  rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
    hBase | hExceptional
  · have hBaseAt := pin.baseCarryAt_abs_le_two hEmpty hBase J
    cases J with
    | niveauOne J =>
        rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 J hJ with
          hCarry | hExceptional
        · exact Or.inl
            ⟨pin.pairedCarrySum_abs_le_two hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ hCarry hBaseAt,
              pin.pairedCarryDifference_abs_le_two hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
                hCarry hBaseAt⟩
        · exact Or.inr hExceptional
    | niveauTwo J hComplementary =>
        have hCarry :=
          pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ
        exact Or.inl
          ⟨pin.pairedCarrySum_abs_le_two hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
              hCarry hBaseAt,
            pin.pairedCarryDifference_abs_le_two hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ hCarry hBaseAt⟩
  · exact Or.inr hExceptional

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception
statement:
theorem pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Profile f) (hJ : J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : J.Index) (hNegative : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty J i < 0) :
    pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hJ i ≤ 0 ∧
      0 ≤ pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty J hJ i
proof:
:= by
  have hBaseCarry : ∀ k, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty k| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
      hBound | hExceptional
    · exact hBound
    · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)
  have hBaseAt := pin.baseCarryAt_abs_le_two hEmpty hBaseCarry J
  cases J with
  | niveauOne J =>
      rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 J hJ with
        hCarry | hExceptional
      · exact pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i
          (hCarry i) (hBaseAt i) hNegative
      · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)
  | niveauTwo J hComplementary =>
      have hCarry :=
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ
      exact pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i (hCarry i) (hBaseAt i) hNegative

name: KLSposet.Pinning.interiorProfile_negative_excludes_one_p
statement:
theorem interiorProfile_negative_excludes_one_p
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hInterior : Profile.niveauOne
      {k : ZMod f | 0 < sigma.u k ∧ sigma.u k < p} ∈
        compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hNegative : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0) :
    (sigma.u i, sigma.u (i + 1)) ≠ (1, p)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hExceptionalPair : ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma'
  · intro hPair
    have hui : sigma.u i = 1 := congrArg Prod.fst hPair
    have huiThree : sigma.u i = 3 := hExceptionalPair.2.1 i
    omega
  intro hPair
  have hui : sigma.u i = 1 := congrArg Prod.fst hPair
  have huiNext : sigma.u (i + 1) = p := congrArg Prod.snd hPair
  let J : Set (ZMod f) := {k | 0 < sigma.u k ∧ sigma.u k < p}
  change Profile.niveauOne J ∈
    compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' at hInterior
  have hiJ : i ∈ J := by
    simp only [J, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    omega
  have hiNextNotJ : i + 1 ∉ J := by
    simp only [J, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    omega
  have hBaseCarry : ∀ k, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty k| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
      hBound | hExceptional
    · exact hBound
    · exact False.elim (hExceptionalPair hExceptional)
  have hInteriorCarry :
      ∀ k, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hInterior k| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 J hInterior with
      hBound | hExceptional
    · exact hBound
    · exact False.elim (hExceptionalPair hExceptional)
  have hBaseAt :=
    pin.baseCarryAt_abs_le_two hEmpty hBaseCarry (.niveauOne J)
  have hSumBound := pin.pairedCarrySum_abs_le_two hEmpty (.niveauOne J)
    hInterior hInteriorCarry hBaseAt
  have hDifferenceBound :=
    pin.pairedCarryDifference_abs_le_two hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hInterior
      hInteriorCarry hBaseAt
  have hNegativeAt : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauOne J) i < 0 := by
    simpa only [baseCarryAt] using hNegative
  have hSigns := pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception hp3
    hExceptionalPair hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hInterior i hNegativeAt
  have hSumAtZero :
      pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hInterior i = 0 := by
    rcases (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J hInterior i).1
        hiJ with hSumRecurrence | hDifferenceEquation
    · exact (boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
        (hSumBound (i - 1)) (hSumBound i) hSumRecurrence).2
    · let dPrev :=
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hInterior (i - 1)
      let dAt := pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hInterior i
      have hEquation : (1 : Int) = (p : Int) * dPrev - dAt := by
        simpa only [hui, Nat.cast_one, dPrev, dAt] using hDifferenceEquation
      have hPrevBound : |dPrev| ≤ 2 := by
        simpa only [dPrev] using hDifferenceBound (i - 1)
      have hAtBound : |dAt| ≤ 2 := by
        simpa only [dAt] using hDifferenceBound i
      rcases abs_le.mp hPrevBound with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
      rcases abs_le.mp hAtBound with ⟨hAtLower, hAtUpper⟩
      have hAtNonnegative : 0 ≤ dAt := hSigns.2
      have hDifferenceAt : dAt = 2 := by
        interval_cases dPrev <;> omega
      have hSumDouble :=
        pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hInterior i
      have hDifferenceDouble :=
        pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hInterior i
      have hBaseLower := (abs_le.mp (hBaseAt i)).1
      dsimp only [dAt] at hDifferenceAt
      omega
  rcases
      (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J hInterior
        (i + 1)).2 hiNextNotJ with hSumEquation | hDifferenceRecurrence
  · have hSumNextBounds := abs_le.mp (hSumBound (i + 1))
    simp only [huiNext, add_sub_cancel_right, hSumAtZero] at hSumEquation
    omega
  · have hDifferenceRecurrence' :
        (p : Int) *
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hInterior i =
          pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hInterior (i + 1) := by
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hDifferenceRecurrence
    have hDifferenceZero := boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
      (hDifferenceBound i) (hDifferenceBound (i + 1))
      hDifferenceRecurrence'
    have hSumDouble :=
      pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hInterior i
    have hDifferenceDouble :=
      pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hInterior i
    omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_backward
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_backward
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    (hP : Profile.niveauTwo P hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hPrescribed : i ∈ P ↔ sigma.periodicU hf i = p)
    (hNegative : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) i < 0)
    (hSumZero :
      pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP i = 0) :
    pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP (i - 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP with hBounds | hExceptional
  · let sPrev :=
      pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP (i - 1)
    let dPrev :=
      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP (i - 1)
    let dAt := pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP i
    by_cases hiP : i ∈ P
    · rcases
          (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty P
            hComplementary hP i).1 hiP with hSumRecurrence | hDifferenceEquation
      · have hRecurrence : (p : Int) * sPrev = 0 := by
          simpa only [sPrev, hSumZero] using hSumRecurrence
        have hpNe : (p : Int) ≠ 0 := by omega
        have hSumPrev : sPrev = 0 :=
          (mul_eq_zero.mp hRecurrence).resolve_left hpNe
        simpa only [sPrev] using hSumPrev
      · have hui : sigma.periodicU hf i = p := hPrescribed.mp hiP
        have hEquation : (p : Int) = (p : Int) * dPrev - dAt := by
          simpa only [hui, Nat.cast_ofNat, dPrev, dAt] using hDifferenceEquation
        have hPrevBound : |dPrev| ≤ 2 := by
          simpa only [dPrev] using hBounds.2 (i - 1)
        have hAtBound : |dAt| ≤ 2 := by
          simpa only [dAt] using hBounds.2 i
        rcases abs_le.mp hPrevBound with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
        rcases abs_le.mp hAtBound with ⟨hAtLower, hAtUpper⟩
        have hDifferenceAt : dAt = 0 := by
          interval_cases dPrev <;> interval_cases dAt <;> omega
        have hSumDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
          (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP i
        have hDifferenceDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
          (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP i
        dsimp only [dAt] at hDifferenceAt
        omega
    · have huiNe : sigma.periodicU hf i ≠ p := by
        exact fun hui => hiP (hPrescribed.mpr hui)
      rcases
          (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty P
            hComplementary hP i).2 hiP with hSumEquation | hDifferenceRecurrence
      · have huBound : sigma.periodicU hf i ≤ p :=
          sigma.u_le (periodicIndex hf i)
        have hPrevBound : |sPrev| ≤ 2 := by
          simpa only [sPrev] using hBounds.1 (i - 1)
        rcases abs_le.mp hPrevBound with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
        have hSumEquation' :
            -(sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) = (p : Int) * sPrev := by
          simpa only [sPrev, hSumZero, sub_zero] using hSumEquation
        have hSumPrev : sPrev = 0 := by
          interval_cases sPrev <;> omega
        simpa only [sPrev] using hSumPrev
      · have hDifferenceZero := boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
          (hBounds.2 (i - 1)) (hBounds.2 i) hDifferenceRecurrence
        have hSumDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
          (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP i
        have hDifferenceDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
          (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP i
        omega
  · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_forward
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_forward
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    (hP : Profile.niveauTwo P hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hPrescribed : i ∈ P ↔ sigma.periodicU hf i = p)
    (huiNe : sigma.periodicU hf i ≠ p)
    (hNegative : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) i < 0)
    (hNegativePrev :
      pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) (i - 1) < 0)
    (hSumPrevZero :
      pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP (i - 1) = 0) :
    pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP i = 0 ∧
      sigma.periodicU hf i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hiP : i ∉ P := fun hi => huiNe (hPrescribed.mp hi)
  rcases pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP with hBounds | hExceptional
  · rcases
        (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty P
          hComplementary hP i).2 hiP with hSumEquation | hDifferenceRecurrence
    · have hSigns := pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception hp3
        hNotExceptional hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP i hNegative
      have hSumEquation' :
          -(sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) =
            -pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP i := by
        simpa only [hSumPrevZero, mul_zero, zero_sub] using hSumEquation
      constructor <;> omega
    · have hDifferenceZero := boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
        (hBounds.2 (i - 1)) (hBounds.2 i) hDifferenceRecurrence
      have hSumDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP (i - 1)
      have hDifferenceDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP (i - 1)
      omega
  · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_backward_to_zero
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_backward_to_zero
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    (hP : Profile.niveauTwo P hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hPrescribed : ∀ k : Nat, k < f →
      ((k : ZMod (2 * f)) ∈ P ↔
        sigma.periodicU hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)) = p))
    (hNegative : ∀ i : ZMod (2 * f),
      pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) i < 0)
    (n : Nat) (hn : n < f)
    (hSumZero : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP
      (n : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0) :
    pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP
      (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  revert hn hSumZero
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro _ hSumZero
      simpa only [Nat.cast_zero] using hSumZero
  | succ n ih =>
      intro hn hSumZero
      have hnlt : n < f := by omega
      let i : ZMod (2 * f) := (n + 1 : Nat)
      have hIndex :
          i - 1 = (n : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
        simp only [i, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_sub_cancel_right]
      have hStep :
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP
              (i - 1) = 0 :=
        pin.prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_backward hp3
          hNotExceptional hEmpty P hComplementary hP i
          (by simpa only [i] using hPrescribed (n + 1) hn)
          (hNegative i) (by simpa only [i] using hSumZero)
      rw [hIndex] at hStep
      exact ih hnlt hStep

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_forward_firstHalf
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_forward_firstHalf
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    (hP : Profile.niveauTwo P hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hPrescribed : ∀ k : Nat, k < f →
      ((k : ZMod (2 * f)) ∈ P ↔
        sigma.periodicU hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)) = p))
    (hNegative : ∀ i : ZMod (2 * f),
      pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) i < 0)
    (hNoZeroP : ∀ k : Nat, k + 1 < f →
      ¬ (sigma.periodicU hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0 ∧
        sigma.periodicU hf ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) = p))
    (hZero : sigma.u 0 = 0)
    (hSumZero : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP
      (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0)
    (n : Nat) (hn : n < f) :
    pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP
        (n : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0 ∧
      sigma.periodicU hf (n : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      constructor
      · simpa only [Nat.cast_zero] using hSumZero
      · simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex, hZero]
  | succ n ih =>
      have hnlt : n < f := by omega
      rcases ih hnlt with ⟨hSumPrevZero, huPrevZero⟩
      have huAtNe :
          sigma.periodicU hf ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) ≠ p := by
        intro huAt
        apply hNoZeroP n hn
        exact ⟨huPrevZero, huAt⟩
      let i : ZMod (2 * f) := (n + 1 : Nat)
      have hIndex :
          i - 1 = (n : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
        simp only [i, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_sub_cancel_right]
      have hStep := pin.prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_forward hp3
        hNotExceptional hEmpty P hComplementary hP i
        (by simpa only [i] using hPrescribed (n + 1) hn)
        (by simpa only [i] using huAtNe) (hNegative i) (hNegative (i - 1)) (by
          rw [hIndex]
          exact hSumPrevZero)
      simpa only [i] using hStep

name: KLSposet.Pinning.emptyCarry_predecessor_eq_neg_one_of_zero_coordinate_at
statement:
theorem emptyCarry_predecessor_eq_neg_one_of_zero_coordinate_at
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hZero : sigma.u i = 0)
    (hNegativeAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hNegativePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) < 0) :
    pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hCarryBound : ∀ j, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
      hBound | hExceptional
    · exact hBound
    · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)
  let xPrev := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1)
  let xAt := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i
  let y := niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' ∅
    (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty) i
  have hEquation : y = (p : Int) * xPrev - xAt := by
    simpa only [y, xPrev, xAt] using pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty i
  have hInputBound : |y| ≤ (p : Int) := by
    have hu' : (sigma'.u i : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
      exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le i
    have hu'Nonnegative : (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.u i := by omega
    dsimp only [y, niveauOneCarryInput]
    rw [hZero]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, abs_mul,
      Profile.abs_sign, one_mul, abs_of_nonneg hu'Nonnegative]
    exact hu'
  have hPrevBound : |xPrev| ≤ 2 := by
    simpa only [xPrev] using hCarryBound (i - 1)
  have hAtBound : |xAt| ≤ 2 := by
    simpa only [xAt] using hCarryBound i
  rcases abs_le.mp hPrevBound with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hAtBound with ⟨hAtLower, hAtUpper⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hInputBound with ⟨hInputLower, hInputUpper⟩
  have hPrevNegative : xPrev < 0 := by
    simpa only [xPrev] using hNegativePrev
  have hAtNegative : xAt < 0 := by
    simpa only [xAt] using hNegativeAt
  have hxPrev : xPrev = -1 := by
    interval_cases xPrev <;> interval_cases xAt <;> omega
  simpa only [xPrev] using hxPrev

name: KLSposet.Pinning.emptyCarry_predecessor_eq_neg_one_of_zero_coordinate
statement:
theorem emptyCarry_predecessor_eq_neg_one_of_zero_coordinate
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hZero : sigma.u 0 = 0)
    (hNegativeZero : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty 0 < 0)
    (hNegativePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (0 - 1) < 0) :
    pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (0 - 1) = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hCarryBound : ∀ i, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
      hBound | hExceptional
    · exact hBound
    · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)
  let xPrev := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (0 - 1)
  let xZero := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty 0
  let y := niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' ∅ (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty) 0
  have hEquation : y = (p : Int) * xPrev - xZero := by
    simpa only [y, xPrev, xZero] using pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty 0
  have hInputBound : |y| ≤ (p : Int) := by
    have hu' : (sigma'.u 0 : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
      exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le 0
    have hu'Nonnegative : (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.u 0 := by omega
    dsimp only [y, niveauOneCarryInput]
    rw [hZero]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, abs_mul,
      Profile.abs_sign, one_mul, abs_of_nonneg hu'Nonnegative]
    exact hu'
  have hPrevBound : |xPrev| ≤ 2 := by
    simpa only [xPrev] using hCarryBound (0 - 1)
  have hZeroBound : |xZero| ≤ 2 := by
    simpa only [xZero] using hCarryBound 0
  rcases abs_le.mp hPrevBound with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hZeroBound with ⟨hZeroLower, hZeroUpper⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hInputBound with ⟨hInputLower, hInputUpper⟩
  have hPrevNegative : xPrev < 0 := by simpa only [xPrev] using hNegativePrev
  have hZeroNegative : xZero < 0 := by simpa only [xZero] using hNegativeZero
  have hxPrev : xPrev = -1 := by
    interval_cases xPrev <;> interval_cases xZero <;> omega
  simpa only [xPrev] using hxPrev

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_zero_boundary_alternative_at
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_zero_boundary_alternative_at
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    (hP : Profile.niveauTwo P hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hPrescribedAt : a ∈ P ↔ sigma.periodicU hf a = p)
    (hZero : sigma.periodicU hf a = 0) :
    (pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP (a - 1) = 0 ∧
        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP a = 0) ∨
      (pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP
            (a - 1) = 0 ∧
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP a = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hAtNotP : a ∉ P := by
    exact fun hmem ↦ by have := hPrescribedAt.mp hmem; omega
  rcases pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP with hBounds | hExceptional
  · rcases (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty P
        hComplementary hP a).2 hAtNotP with
      hSumRecurrence | hDifferenceRecurrence
    · left
      have hRecurrence :
          (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP (a - 1) =
            pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP a := by
        have hZeroEquation : (0 : Int) =
            (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty
                (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP (a - 1) -
              pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP a := by
          simpa only [hZero, Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero] using hSumRecurrence
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp hZeroEquation.symm
      exact boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
        (hBounds.1 (a - 1)) (hBounds.1 a) hRecurrence
    · right
      exact boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
        (hBounds.2 (a - 1)) (hBounds.2 a) hDifferenceRecurrence
  · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_zero_boundary_alternative
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_zero_boundary_alternative
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    (hP : Profile.niveauTwo P hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hPrescribedZero :
      (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) ∈ P ↔ sigma.periodicU hf 0 = p)
    (hZero : sigma.u 0 = 0) :
    (pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP
          ((0 : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1) = 0 ∧
        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP
          (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0) ∨
      (pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP
          ((0 : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1) = 0 ∧
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP
          (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hPeriodicZero : sigma.periodicU hf (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0 := by
    simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex, hZero]
  have hZeroNotP : (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) ∉ P := by
    exact fun hmem => by
      have := hPrescribedZero.mp hmem
      omega
  rcases pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP with hBounds | hExceptional
  · rcases
        (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty P
          hComplementary hP (0 : ZMod (2 * f))).2 hZeroNotP with
      hSumRecurrence | hDifferenceRecurrence
    · left
      have hSumRecurrence' :
          (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP ((0 : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1) =
            pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP
              (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
        have hZero : (0 : Int) =
            (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty
                (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP ((0 : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1) -
              pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP
                (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
          simpa only [hPeriodicZero, Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero] using hSumRecurrence
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp hZero.symm
      exact boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
        (hBounds.1 ((0 : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1))
        (hBounds.1 (0 : ZMod (2 * f))) hSumRecurrence'
    · right
      exact boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
        (hBounds.2 ((0 : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1))
        (hBounds.2 (0 : ZMod (2 * f))) hDifferenceRecurrence
  · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_eq_neg_one_or_one_of_base_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_eq_neg_one_or_one_of_base_eq_neg_one
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    (hP : Profile.niveauTwo P hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hBase : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) i = -1) :
    pin.sameNiveauCarry (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP i = -1 ∨
      pin.sameNiveauCarry (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP i = 1
proof:
:= by
  let xP := pin.sameNiveauCarry (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP i
  have hBound : |xP| ≤ 2 := by
    simpa only [sameNiveauCarry, xP] using
      pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 P hComplementary hP i
  rcases abs_le.mp hBound with ⟨hLower, hUpper⟩
  rcases pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo P hComplementary) hP i with ⟨k, hk⟩
  have hParity : xP - (-1) = k + k := by
    simpa only [xP, hBase] using hk
  interval_cases xP <;> omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_not_compatible
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_not_compatible
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    (hPrescribed : ∀ k : Nat, k < f →
      ((k : ZMod (2 * f)) ∈ P ↔
        sigma.periodicU hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)) = p))
    (hZero : sigma.u 0 = 0)
    (hNoZeroP : ∀ i : ZMod f,
      (sigma.u (i - 1), sigma.u i) ≠ (0, p))
    (hNegative : ∀ i : ZMod f,
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0) :
    Profile.niveauTwo P hComplementary ∉
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma'
proof:
:= by
  intro hP
  have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
    intro hExceptional
    have huThree := hExceptional.2.1 0
    omega
  let J : Profile f := .niveauTwo P hComplementary
  let prev : ZMod (2 * f) := 0 - 1
  let last : ZMod (2 * f) := (f - 1 : Nat)
  have hNegativeDoubled : ∀ i : ZMod (2 * f),
      pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty J i < 0 := by
    intro i
    simpa only [J, baseCarryAt] using hNegative (periodicIndex hf i)
  have hBasePrevOriginal :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty ((0 : ZMod f) - 1) = -1 :=
    pin.emptyCarry_predecessor_eq_neg_one_of_zero_coordinate hp3
      hNotExceptional hEmpty hZero (hNegative 0) (hNegative (0 - 1))
  have hPeriodicPrev : periodicIndex hf prev = (0 : ZMod f) - 1 := by
    dsimp only [prev]
    rw [periodicIndex_sub_one]
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
    simp
  have hBasePrev : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty J prev = -1 := by
    simp only [J, baseCarryAt, hPeriodicPrev]
    exact hBasePrevOriginal
  have hLastCast :
      ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) = (f : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 := by
    have hfSplit : f = (f - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hCast := congrArg (fun n : Nat ↦ (n : ZMod (2 * f))) hfSplit
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hCast
    rw [hCast]
    ring
  have hLastAddHalf : last + f = prev := by
    dsimp only [last, prev]
    rw [hLastCast]
    calc
      (f : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 + f =
          ((2 * f : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 := by
            push_cast
            ring
      _ = 0 - 1 := by rw [ZMod.natCast_self]
  have hPeriodicLast : periodicIndex hf last = periodicIndex hf prev := by
    rw [← periodicIndex_add_half hf last, hLastAddHalf]
  have hBaseLast : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty J last = -1 := by
    simpa only [J, baseCarryAt, hPeriodicLast] using hBasePrev
  have hAntiPeriodic : ∀ i : ZMod (2 * f),
      pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP (i + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) =
        -pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP i := by
    intro i
    simpa only [J, sameNiveauCarry] using
      (niveauTwoCarryEquation_antiPeriodic hp hf sigma sigma' P
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget P hComplementary hP) hComplementary
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary P hComplementary hP)
        (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec P hComplementary hP) i)
  have hAntiLast :
      pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP prev =
        -pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP last := by
    simpa only [hLastAddHalf] using hAntiPeriodic last
  have hPinnedPrev : pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP prev = -1 ∨
      pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP prev = 1 := by
    simpa only [J, sameNiveauCarry] using
      (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_eq_neg_one_or_one_of_base_eq_neg_one hp3
        hEmpty P hComplementary hP prev (by simpa only [J] using hBasePrev))
  have hPinnedPrevNe : pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP prev ≠ 0 := by
    rcases hPinnedPrev with hPinnedPrev | hPinnedPrev <;> omega
  have hNoZeroPFirstHalf : ∀ k : Nat, k + 1 < f →
      ¬ (sigma.periodicU hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0 ∧
        sigma.periodicU hf ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) = p) := by
    intro k hk hPair
    have hklt : k < f := by omega
    have hPrevIndex :
        sigma.periodicU hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)) = sigma.u (k : ZMod f) := by
      rw [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_natCast hf k hklt]
    have hAtIndex :
        sigma.periodicU hf ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) =
          sigma.u ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
      rw [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_natCast hf (k + 1) hk]
    have hIndex :
        ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) - 1 = (k : ZMod f) := by
      simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_sub_cancel_right]
    apply hNoZeroP ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)
    rw [hIndex]
    exact Prod.ext (by simpa only [← hPrevIndex] using hPair.1)
      (by simpa only [← hAtIndex] using hPair.2)
  have hBoundary := pin.prescribedNiveauTwo_zero_boundary_alternative hp3
    hNotExceptional hEmpty P hComplementary hP
    (by simpa only [Nat.cast_zero] using hPrescribed 0 (by omega)) hZero
  rcases hBoundary with hSumBoundary | hDifferenceBoundary
  · have hForward :=
      pin.prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_forward_firstHalf hp3
        hNotExceptional hEmpty P hComplementary hP hPrescribed
        (by simpa only [J] using hNegativeDoubled) hNoZeroPFirstHalf hZero
        (by simpa only [J] using hSumBoundary.2) (f - 1) (by omega)
    have hSumLast : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP last = 0 := by
      simpa only [J, last] using hForward.1
    have hSumPrev : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP prev = 0 := by
      simpa only [J, prev] using hSumBoundary.1
    have hSumPrevDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP prev
    have hSumLastDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP last
    have hPinnedPrevEq : pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP prev = 1 := by
      omega
    have hPinnedLastEq : pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP last = 1 := by
      omega
    omega
  · have hDifferencePrevDouble :=
      pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty J hP prev
    have hDifferencePrev :
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty J hP prev = 0 := by
      simpa only [J, prev] using hDifferenceBoundary.1
    have hPinnedPrevEq : pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP prev = -1 := by
      omega
    have hPinnedLastEq : pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP last = 1 := by
      omega
    have hSumLastDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP last
    have hSumLast : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP last = 0 := by
      omega
    have hBackward :=
      pin.prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_backward_to_zero hp3
        hNotExceptional hEmpty P hComplementary hP hPrescribed
        (by simpa only [J] using hNegativeDoubled) (f - 1) (by omega)
        (by simpa only [J, last] using hSumLast)
    have hSumZero :
        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0 := by
      simpa only [J] using hBackward
    have hDifferenceZero :
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty J hP (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0 := by
      simpa only [J] using hDifferenceBoundary.2
    have hSumZeroDouble :=
      pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP (0 : ZMod (2 * f))
    have hDifferenceZeroDouble :=
      pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty J hP (0 : ZMod (2 * f))
    have hNegativeZero := hNegativeDoubled (0 : ZMod (2 * f))
    omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_not_compatible_at
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_not_compatible_at
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hPrescribed : ∀ k : Nat, k < f →
      (a + (k : Nat) ∈ P ↔ sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k : Nat)) = p))
    (hZero : sigma.periodicU hf a = 0)
    (hNoZeroP : ∀ i : ZMod f,
      (sigma.u (i - 1), sigma.u i) ≠ (0, p))
    (hNegative : ∀ i : ZMod f,
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0) :
    Profile.niveauTwo P hComplementary ∉
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma'
proof:
:= by
  intro hP
  have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
    intro hExceptional
    have huThree := hExceptional.2.1 (periodicIndex hf a)
    have hZeroOriginal : sigma.u (periodicIndex hf a) = 0 := by
      simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hZero
    omega
  let J : Profile f := .niveauTwo P hComplementary
  let prev : ZMod (2 * f) := a - 1
  let last : ZMod (2 * f) := a + (f - 1 : Nat)
  have hNegativeDoubled : ∀ i : ZMod (2 * f),
      pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty J i < 0 := by
    intro i
    simpa only [J, baseCarryAt] using hNegative (periodicIndex hf i)
  have hZeroOriginal : sigma.u (periodicIndex hf a) = 0 := by
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hZero
  have hBasePrevOriginal :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf a - 1) = -1 :=
    pin.emptyCarry_predecessor_eq_neg_one_of_zero_coordinate_at hp3
      hNotExceptional hEmpty (periodicIndex hf a) hZeroOriginal
      (hNegative (periodicIndex hf a)) (hNegative (periodicIndex hf a - 1))
  have hPeriodicPrev : periodicIndex hf prev = periodicIndex hf a - 1 := by
    dsimp only [prev]
    exact periodicIndex_sub_one hf a
  have hBasePrev : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty J prev = -1 := by
    simp only [J, baseCarryAt, hPeriodicPrev]
    exact hBasePrevOriginal
  have hLastAddHalf : last + f = prev := by
    dsimp only [last, prev]
    have hfSplit : f = (f - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hCast := congrArg (fun n : Nat ↦ (n : ZMod (2 * f))) hfSplit
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hCast
    calc
      a + ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) + f =
          a + ((2 * f : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 := by
            push_cast
            rw [hCast]
            ring
      _ = a - 1 := by rw [ZMod.natCast_self, add_zero]
  have hPeriodicLast : periodicIndex hf last = periodicIndex hf prev := by
    rw [← periodicIndex_add_half hf last, hLastAddHalf]
  have hBaseLast : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty J last = -1 := by
    simpa only [J, baseCarryAt, hPeriodicLast] using hBasePrev
  have hAntiPeriodic : ∀ i : ZMod (2 * f),
      pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP (i + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) =
        -pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP i := by
    intro i
    simpa only [J, sameNiveauCarry] using
      (niveauTwoCarryEquation_antiPeriodic hp hf sigma sigma' P
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget P hComplementary hP) hComplementary
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary P hComplementary hP)
        (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec P hComplementary hP) i)
  have hAntiLast :
      pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP prev =
        -pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP last := by
    simpa only [hLastAddHalf] using hAntiPeriodic last
  have hPinnedPrev : pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP prev = -1 ∨
      pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP prev = 1 := by
    simpa only [J, sameNiveauCarry] using
      (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_eq_neg_one_or_one_of_base_eq_neg_one hp3
        hEmpty P hComplementary hP prev (by simpa only [J] using hBasePrev))
  have hNoZeroPFirstHalf : ∀ k : Nat, k + 1 < f →
      ¬ (sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k : Nat)) = 0 ∧
        sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) = p) := by
    intro k hk hPair
    let i : ZMod (2 * f) := a + (k + 1 : Nat)
    have hPred : periodicIndex hf i - 1 =
        periodicIndex hf (a + (k : Nat)) := by
      dsimp only [i]
      rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
      simp only [map_add, map_natCast]
      push_cast
      ring
    apply hNoZeroP (periodicIndex hf i)
    rw [hPred]
    exact Prod.ext
      (by simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hPair.1)
      (by simpa only [i, PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hPair.2)
  have hBoundary := pin.prescribedNiveauTwo_zero_boundary_alternative_at hp3
    hNotExceptional hEmpty P hComplementary hP a
    (by simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using hPrescribed 0 (by omega))
    hZero
  rcases hBoundary with hSumBoundary | hDifferenceBoundary
  · have hForward : ∀ n : Nat, n < f →
        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP
            (a + ((n : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0 ∧
          sigma.periodicU hf (a + ((n : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0 := by
      intro n hn
      induction n with
      | zero =>
          simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, J] using
            And.intro hSumBoundary.2 hZero
      | succ n ih =>
          have hnlt : n < f := by omega
          rcases ih hnlt with ⟨hSumPrev, huPrev⟩
          let i : ZMod (2 * f) := a + (n + 1 : Nat)
          have hPred : i - 1 = a + (n : Nat) := by
            dsimp only [i]
            push_cast
            ring
          have huAtNe : sigma.periodicU hf i ≠ p := by
            intro huAt
            exact hNoZeroPFirstHalf n hn ⟨huPrev, by simpa only [i] using huAt⟩
          have hStep := pin.prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_forward hp3
            hNotExceptional hEmpty P hComplementary hP i
            (by simpa only [i] using hPrescribed (n + 1) hn) huAtNe
            (by simpa only [J] using hNegativeDoubled i)
            (by simpa only [J] using hNegativeDoubled (i - 1))
            (by rw [hPred]; simpa only [J] using hSumPrev)
          simpa only [i, J] using hStep
    have hForwardLast := hForward (f - 1) (by omega)
    have hSumLast : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP last = 0 := by
      simpa only [last] using hForwardLast.1
    have hSumPrev : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP prev = 0 := by
      simpa only [J, prev] using hSumBoundary.1
    have hSumPrevDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP prev
    have hSumLastDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP last
    have hPinnedPrevEq : pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP prev = 1 := by omega
    have hPinnedLastEq : pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP last = 1 := by omega
    omega
  · have hDifferencePrevDouble :=
      pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty J hP prev
    have hDifferencePrev :
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty J hP prev = 0 := by
      simpa only [J, prev] using hDifferenceBoundary.1
    have hPinnedPrevEq : pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP prev = -1 := by omega
    have hPinnedLastEq : pin.sameNiveauCarry J hP last = 1 := by omega
    have hSumLastDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP last
    have hSumLast : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP last = 0 := by omega
    have hBackward : ∀ n : Nat, n < f →
        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP
            (a + ((n : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0 →
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP a = 0 := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
          intro _ hSum
          simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using hSum
      | succ n ih =>
          intro hn hSum
          have hnlt : n < f := by omega
          let i : ZMod (2 * f) := a + (n + 1 : Nat)
          have hPred : i - 1 = a + (n : Nat) := by
            dsimp only [i]
            push_cast
            ring
          have hStep := pin.prescribedNiveauTwo_sum_zero_propagates_backward
            hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty P hComplementary hP i
            (by simpa only [i] using hPrescribed (n + 1) hn)
            (by simpa only [J] using hNegativeDoubled i)
            (by simpa only [i, J] using hSum)
          rw [hPred] at hStep
          exact ih hnlt hStep
    have hSumAt : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP a = 0 :=
      hBackward (f - 1) (by omega) (by simpa only [last] using hSumLast)
    have hDifferenceAt :
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty J hP a = 0 := by
      simpa only [J] using hDifferenceBoundary.2
    have hSumAtDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty J hP a
    have hDifferenceAtDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty J hP a
    have hNegativeAt := hNegativeDoubled a
    omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_table
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_table
    {p u : Nat} {yPrev y : Int} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (huLe : u ≤ p)
    (hEquation : (if u = p then (-1 : Int) else 1) * (u : Int) =
      (p : Int) * yPrev - y)
    (hPrevBound : |yPrev| ≤ 1) (hBound : |y| ≤ 1) :
    (u = 0 ∧ yPrev = 0 ∧ y = 0) ∨
      (u = 1 ∧ yPrev = 0 ∧ y = -1) ∨
      (u = p - 1 ∧ yPrev = 1 ∧ y = 1) ∨
      (u = p ∧ yPrev = -1 ∧ y = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases abs_le.mp hPrevBound with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hBound with ⟨hLower, hUpper⟩
  by_cases hup : u = p
  · simp only [if_pos hup] at hEquation
    interval_cases yPrev <;> interval_cases y <;> omega
  · simp only [if_neg hup, one_mul] at hEquation
    interval_cases yPrev <;> interval_cases y <;> omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_table_at
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_table_at
    {p f : Nat} {hf : 2 ≤ f}
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    (hPrescribed : ∀ k : Nat, k < f →
      ((k : ZMod (2 * f)) ∈ P ↔
        sigma.periodicU hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)) = p))
    {y : ZMod (2 * f) → Int}
    (hy : CarryEquation p
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma P hComplementary) y)
    (hyBound : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ 1) (k : Nat) (hk : k < f) :
    let i : ZMod (2 * f) := k
    let u := sigma.periodicU hf i
    (u = 0 ∧ y (i - 1) = 0 ∧ y i = 0) ∨
      (u = 1 ∧ y (i - 1) = 0 ∧ y i = -1) ∨
      (u = p - 1 ∧ y (i - 1) = 1 ∧ y i = 1) ∨
      (u = p ∧ y (i - 1) = -1 ∧ y i = 0)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have hEquation := hy (k : ZMod (2 * f))
  have hEquation' :
      (if sigma.periodicU hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)) = p then (-1 : Int) else 1) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)) : Int) =
        (p : Int) * y ((k : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1) -
          y (k : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
    simpa [niveauTwoScalarCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hPrescribed k hk] using hEquation
  exact prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_table hp3
    (sigma.u_le (periodicIndex hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)))) hEquation'
    (hyBound ((k : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1)) (hyBound (k : ZMod (2 * f)))

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_zero_boundary
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_zero_boundary
    {p f : Nat} {hf : 2 ≤ f} (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    {y : ZMod (2 * f) → Int}
    (hy : CarryEquation p
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma P hComplementary) y)
    (hyAnti : ∀ i, y (i + f) = -y i)
    (hyBound : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ 1) (hZero : sigma.u 0 = 0) :
    y 0 = 0 ∧ y (f - 1 : Nat) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let last : ZMod (2 * f) := (f - 1 : Nat)
  have hLastCast :
      ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) = (f : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 := by
    have hfSplit : f = (f - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hCast := congrArg (fun n : Nat ↦ (n : ZMod (2 * f))) hfSplit
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hCast
    rw [hCast]
    ring
  have hLastAddHalf : last + f = (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 := by
    dsimp only [last]
    rw [hLastCast]
    calc
      (f : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 + f =
          ((2 * f : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 := by
            push_cast
            ring
      _ = 0 - 1 := by rw [ZMod.natCast_self]
  have hAntiLast : y ((0 : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1) = -y last := by
    simpa only [hLastAddHalf] using hyAnti last
  have hEquation := hy (0 : ZMod (2 * f))
  have hPeriodicZero : sigma.periodicU hf (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0 := by
    rw [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
    simpa only [map_zero] using hZero
  have hEquationZero :
      (0 : Int) = (p : Int) * y ((0 : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1) - y 0 := by
    simpa [niveauTwoScalarCarryInput, hPeriodicZero] using hEquation
  have hZeroBound := hyBound (0 : ZMod (2 * f))
  have hLastBound := hyBound last
  rcases abs_le.mp hZeroBound with ⟨hZeroLower, hZeroUpper⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hLastBound with ⟨hLastLower, hLastUpper⟩
  rw [hAntiLast] at hEquationZero
  interval_cases y last <;> interval_cases y (0 : ZMod (2 * f)) <;>
    omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_zero_boundary_at
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_zero_boundary_at
    {p f : Nat} {hf : 2 ≤ f} (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    {y : ZMod (2 * f) → Int}
    (hy : CarryEquation p
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma P hComplementary) y)
    (hyAnti : ∀ i, y (i + f) = -y i)
    (hyBound : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ 1) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hZero : sigma.periodicU hf a = 0) :
    y a = 0 ∧ y (a + (f - 1 : Nat)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let last : ZMod (2 * f) := a + (f - 1 : Nat)
  have hLastAddHalf : last + f = a - 1 := by
    dsimp only [last]
    have hfSplit : f = (f - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hCast := congrArg (fun n : Nat ↦ (n : ZMod (2 * f))) hfSplit
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hCast
    calc
      a + ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) + f =
          a + ((2 * f : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 := by
            push_cast
            rw [hCast]
            ring
      _ = a - 1 := by rw [ZMod.natCast_self, add_zero]
  have hAntiLast : y (a - 1) = -y last := by
    simpa only [hLastAddHalf] using hyAnti last
  have hEquation := hy a
  have hEquationZero :
      (0 : Int) = (p : Int) * y (a - 1) - y a := by
    simpa [niveauTwoScalarCarryInput, hZero] using hEquation
  have hAtBound := hyBound a
  have hLastBound := hyBound last
  rcases abs_le.mp hAtBound with ⟨hAtLower, hAtUpper⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hLastBound with ⟨hLastLower, hLastUpper⟩
  rw [hAntiLast] at hEquationZero
  have hAt : y a = 0 := by
    interval_cases y last <;> interval_cases y a <;> omega
  have hLast : y last = 0 := by
    interval_cases y last <;> interval_cases y a <;> omega
  exact ⟨hAt, by simpa only [last] using hLast⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_table_at_index
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_table_at_index
    {p f : Nat} {hf : 2 ≤ f}
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    {y : ZMod (2 * f) → Int}
    (hy : CarryEquation p
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma P hComplementary) y)
    (hyBound : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ 1) (i : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hPrescribed : i ∈ P ↔ sigma.periodicU hf i = p) :
    let u := sigma.periodicU hf i
    (u = 0 ∧ y (i - 1) = 0 ∧ y i = 0) ∨
      (u = 1 ∧ y (i - 1) = 0 ∧ y i = -1) ∨
      (u = p - 1 ∧ y (i - 1) = 1 ∧ y i = 1) ∨
      (u = p ∧ y (i - 1) = -1 ∧ y i = 0)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have hEquation := hy i
  have hEquation' :
      (if sigma.periodicU hf i = p then (-1 : Int) else 1) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) =
        (p : Int) * y (i - 1) - y i := by
    simpa [niveauTwoScalarCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hPrescribed] using hEquation
  exact prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_table hp3
    (sigma.u_le (periodicIndex hf i)) hEquation'
    (hyBound (i - 1)) (hyBound i)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_translatedFirstHalf_zero
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_translatedFirstHalf_zero
    {p f : Nat} {hf : 2 ≤ f} (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hPrescribed : ∀ k : Nat, k < f →
      (a + (k : Nat) ∈ P ↔ sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k : Nat)) = p))
    {y : ZMod (2 * f) → Int}
    (hy : CarryEquation p
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma P hComplementary) y)
    (hyBound : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ 1)
    (hSourceZero : sigma.periodicU hf a = 0)
    (hBoundary : y a = 0 ∧ y (a + (f - 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hNoOneP : ∀ i : ZMod f, (sigma.u i, sigma.u (i + 1)) ≠ (1, p)) :
    ∀ k : Nat, k < f →
      sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k : Nat)) = 0 ∧
        y (a + (k : Nat)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using
        And.intro hSourceZero hBoundary.1
  | succ k ih =>
      have hklt : k < f := by omega
      have hPrev := ih hklt
      let i : ZMod (2 * f) := a + (k + 1 : Nat)
      have hPred : i - 1 = a + (k : Nat) := by
        dsimp only [i]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hTable := prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_table_at_index sigma hp3
        P hComplementary hy hyBound i
        (by simpa only [i] using hPrescribed (k + 1) hk)
      dsimp only at hTable
      rw [hPred] at hTable
      rcases hTable with hZero | hOne | hPmOne | hP
      · simpa only [i] using And.intro hZero.1 hZero.2.2
      · by_cases hNext : k + 2 < f
        · let next : ZMod (2 * f) := a + (k + 2 : Nat)
          have hNextPred : next - 1 = i := by
            dsimp only [next, i]
            push_cast
            ring
          have hNextTable := prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_table_at_index
            sigma hp3 P hComplementary hy hyBound next
            (by simpa only [next] using hPrescribed (k + 2) hNext)
          dsimp only at hNextTable
          rw [hNextPred] at hNextTable
          have hNextP : sigma.periodicU hf next = p := by
            rcases hNextTable with hNextZero | hNextOne | hNextPmOne | hNextP
            · omega
            · omega
            · omega
            · exact hNextP.1
          have hCurrentU : sigma.u (periodicIndex hf i) = 1 := by
            simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hOne.1
          have hNextU : sigma.u (periodicIndex hf i + 1) = p := by
            have hPeriodicNext : periodicIndex hf next = periodicIndex hf i + 1 := by
              dsimp only [next, i]
              rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
              simp only [map_add, map_natCast]
              push_cast
              ring
            rw [← hPeriodicNext]
            simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hNextP
          exact False.elim (hNoOneP (periodicIndex hf i)
            (Prod.ext hCurrentU hNextU))
        · have hkLast : k + 1 = f - 1 := by omega
          have hiLast : i = a + (f - 1 : Nat) := by
            dsimp only [i]
            rw [hkLast]
          rw [hiLast] at hOne
          exact False.elim (by omega)
      · exact False.elim (by omega)
      · exact False.elim (by omega)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.translatedFirstHalf_periodicU_zero_implies_all_source_zero
statement:
theorem translatedFirstHalf_periodicU_zero_implies_all_source_zero
    {p f : Nat} {hf : 2 ≤ f} (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hFirst : ∀ k : Nat, k < f →
      sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k : Nat)) = 0) :
    ∀ i, sigma.u i = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  intro i
  let k := (i - periodicIndex hf a).val
  have hk : k < f := ZMod.val_lt (i - periodicIndex hf a)
  have hAt := hFirst k hk
  have hLift : shiftedFirstLift hf a i = a + (k : Nat) := rfl
  rw [← hLift, PhantomWeight.periodicU,
    periodicIndex_shiftedFirstLift hf a i] at hAt
  exact hAt

name: KLSposet.Pinning.prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_firstHalf_zero
statement:
theorem prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_firstHalf_zero
    {p f : Nat} {hf : 2 ≤ f} (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (P : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ P ↔ i + f ∉ P)
    (hPrescribed : ∀ k : Nat, k < f →
      ((k : ZMod (2 * f)) ∈ P ↔
        sigma.periodicU hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)) = p))
    {y : ZMod (2 * f) → Int}
    (hy : CarryEquation p
      (niveauTwoScalarCarryInput hf sigma P hComplementary) y)
    (hyBound : ∀ i, |y i| ≤ 1) (hSourceZero : sigma.u 0 = 0)
    (hBoundary : y 0 = 0 ∧ y (f - 1 : Nat) = 0)
    (hNoOneP : ∀ i : ZMod f, (sigma.u i, sigma.u (i + 1)) ≠ (1, p)) :
    ∀ k : Nat, k < f →
      sigma.periodicU hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0 ∧
        y (k : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      constructor
      · rw [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_natCast hf 0 (by omega)]
        simpa only [Nat.cast_zero] using hSourceZero
      · simpa only [Nat.cast_zero] using hBoundary.1
  | succ k ih =>
      have hklt : k < f := by omega
      have hPrev := ih hklt
      have hTable := prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_table_at sigma hp3 P
        hComplementary hPrescribed hy hyBound (k + 1) hk
      dsimp only at hTable
      have hPredCast :
          ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 =
            (k : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hPredCast] at hTable
      rcases hTable with hZero | hOne | hPmOne | hP
      · exact ⟨hZero.1, hZero.2.2⟩
      · by_cases hNext : k + 2 < f
        · have hNextTable :=
            prescribedNiveauTwo_scalarCarry_table_at sigma hp3 P
              hComplementary hPrescribed hy hyBound (k + 2) hNext
          dsimp only at hNextTable
          have hPredCast :
              ((k + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 =
                ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
            push_cast
            ring
          rw [hPredCast] at hNextTable
          have hNextP :
              sigma.periodicU hf ((k + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) = p := by
            rcases hNextTable with hNextZero | hNextOne | hNextPmOne | hNextP
            · omega
            · omega
            · omega
            · exact hNextP.1
          have hCurrentU : sigma.u ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) = 1 := by
            have hPeriodicCurrent := periodicIndex_natCast hf (k + 1) hk
            rw [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodicCurrent] at hOne
            exact hOne.1
          have hNextU : sigma.u (((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) + 1) = p := by
            have hCast :
                (((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) + 1) =
                  ((k + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
              push_cast
              ring
            rw [hCast]
            have hPeriodicNext := periodicIndex_natCast hf (k + 2) hNext
            rw [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodicNext] at hNextP
            exact hNextP
          exact False.elim (hNoOneP ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)
            (Prod.ext hCurrentU hNextU))
        · have hkLast : k + 1 = f - 1 := by omega
          have hCast :
              ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) =
                ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
            exact congrArg (fun n : Nat ↦ (n : ZMod (2 * f))) hkLast
          rw [hCast] at hOne
          exact False.elim (by omega)
      · exact False.elim (by omega)
      · exact False.elim (by omega)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.firstHalf_periodicU_zero_implies_all_source_zero
statement:
theorem firstHalf_periodicU_zero_implies_all_source_zero
    {p f : Nat} {hf : 2 ≤ f} (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hFirst : ∀ k : Nat, k < f →
      sigma.periodicU hf (k : ZMod (2 * f)) = 0) :
    ∀ i, sigma.u i = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  intro i
  have hi := hFirst i.val i.val_lt
  have hPeriodic := periodicIndex_natCast hf i.val i.val_lt
  rw [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodic] at hi
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] at hi
  exact hi

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_negativeCarries_positiveCoordinate_sumPrevZero_mem
statement:
theorem niveauOne_negativeCarries_positiveCoordinate_sumPrevZero_mem
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f)
    (hNegativePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) < 0)
    (hNegative : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (huPositive : 0 < sigma.u i)
    (hSumPrev :
      pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) = 0) :
    i ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hi
  by_cases hExceptional : ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma'
  · have hpEq : p = 3 := hExceptional.1
    subst p
    have hPair :
        profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
          profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma'
            (.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)) := by
      rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec J hJ]
      exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne J) hJ
    rcases niveauOneExceptionalProfiles_of_pair_eq hf chars sigma sigma'
        hExceptional.2.1 hExceptional.2.2.1 hExceptional.2.2.2 J
        (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ) hPair with hFull | hEmptySource
    · exact hi (hFull.1 i)
    · have hJEq : J = ∅ := by
        ext k
        simp [hEmptySource.1 k]
      subst J
      have hProof : hJ = hEmpty := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst hJ
      have hDouble :=
        pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)))
          hEmpty (i - 1)
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hDouble
      omega
  · have hBounds :
        (∀ k, |pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ k| ≤ 2) ∧
          ∀ k, |pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ k| ≤ 2 := by
      rcases pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ with
        hBounds | hExceptional'
      · exact hBounds
      · exact False.elim (hExceptional hExceptional')
    have hNegativeAt : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauOne J) i < 0 := by
      simpa only [baseCarryAt] using hNegative
    have hSigns :=
      pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception hp3 hExceptional
        hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i hNegativeAt
    rcases (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J hJ i).2 hi with
      hSumEquation | hDifferenceRecurrence
    · have huPositiveInt : (0 : Int) < (sigma.u i : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast huPositive
      rw [hSumPrev] at hSumEquation
      simp only [mul_zero, zero_sub] at hSumEquation
      omega
    · have hDifferenceZero := boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
        (hBounds.2 (i - 1)) (hBounds.2 i) hDifferenceRecurrence
      have hSumDouble :=
        pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1)
      have hDifferenceDouble :=
        pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1)
      have hNegativePrevAt :
          pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauOne J) (i - 1) < 0 := by
        simpa only [baseCarryAt] using hNegativePrev
      omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_negativeCarries_positiveCoordinate_sumPrevZero_mem

theorem niveauTwo_negativeCarries_positiveCoordinate_sumPrevZero_mem
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ k, k ∈ J ↔ k + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hNegativePrev :
      pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) (i - 1) < 0)
    (hNegative : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) i < 0)
    (huPositive : 0 < sigma.periodicU hf i)
    (hSumPrev : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
      (i - 1) = 0) :
    i ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hi
  by_cases hExceptional : ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma'
  · have hpEq : p = 3 := hExceptional.1
    subst p
