        profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma
            (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
          profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma'
            (.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)) := by
      rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec J hComplementary hJ]
      exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
    exact (niveauTwoExceptionalProfiles_ne_of_pair_eq hf chars sigma sigma'
      hExceptional.2.1 hExceptional.2.2.1 hExceptional.2.2.2 J
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ) hComplementary
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)) hPair
  · have hBounds :
        (∀ k, |pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ k| ≤ 2) ∧
          ∀ k,
            |pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ k| ≤ 2 := by
      rcases pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty
          (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ with hBounds | hExceptional'
      · exact hBounds
      · exact False.elim (hExceptional hExceptional')
    have hSigns :=
      pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception hp3 hExceptional
        hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i hNegative
    rcases (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J
        hComplementary hJ i).2 hi with hSumEquation | hDifferenceRecurrence
    · have huPositiveInt :
          (0 : Int) < (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast huPositive
      rw [hSumPrev] at hSumEquation
      simp only [mul_zero, zero_sub] at hSumEquation
      omega
    · have hDifferenceZero := boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
        (hBounds.2 (i - 1)) (hBounds.2 i) hDifferenceRecurrence
      have hSumDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1)
      have hDifferenceDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1)
      omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_positiveCoordinate_local_alternative
statement:
theorem niveauOne_positiveCoordinate_local_alternative
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hPrevNot : i - 1 ∉ J) (hi : i ∈ J)
    (hNegative : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (huPositive : 0 < sigma.u i) :
    (pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) = 0 ∧
        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i = 0) ∨
      (pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) = 1 ∧
        (sigma.u i : Int) = (p : Int) -
          pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hExceptional : ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma'
  · have hpEq : p = 3 := hExceptional.1
    subst p
    have hPair :
        profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
          profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma'
            (.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)) := by
      rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec J hJ]
      exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne J) hJ
    rcases niveauOneExceptionalProfiles_of_pair_eq hf chars sigma sigma'
        hExceptional.2.1 hExceptional.2.2.1 hExceptional.2.2.2 J
        (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ) hPair with hFull | hEmptySource
    · exact False.elim (hPrevNot (hFull.1 (i - 1)))
    · exact False.elim (hEmptySource.1 i hi)
  · have hBounds :
        (∀ k, |pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ k| ≤ 2) ∧
          ∀ k, |pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ k| ≤ 2 := by
      rcases pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ with
        hBounds | hExceptional'
      · exact hBounds
      · exact False.elim (hExceptional hExceptional')
    have hNegativeAt : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauOne J) i < 0 := by
      simpa only [baseCarryAt] using hNegative
    have hSigns :=
      pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception hp3 hExceptional
        hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i hNegativeAt
    rcases (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J hJ i).1 hi with
      hSumRecurrence | hDifferenceEquation
    · exact Or.inl (boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
        (hBounds.1 (i - 1)) (hBounds.1 i) hSumRecurrence)
    · let dPrev := pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1)
      let dAt := pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i
      have hEquation : (sigma.u i : Int) = (p : Int) * dPrev - dAt := by
        simpa only [dPrev, dAt] using hDifferenceEquation
      have hPrevBound : |dPrev| ≤ 2 := by
        simpa only [dPrev] using hBounds.2 (i - 1)
      have hAtBound : |dAt| ≤ 2 := by
        simpa only [dAt] using hBounds.2 i
      rcases abs_le.mp hPrevBound with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
      rcases abs_le.mp hAtBound with ⟨hAtLower, hAtUpper⟩
      have hAtNonnegative : 0 ≤ dAt := by simpa only [dAt] using hSigns.2
      have huPositiveInt : (0 : Int) < (sigma.u i : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast huPositive
      have huLeInt : (sigma.u i : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le i
      have hPrev : dPrev = 1 := by
        interval_cases dPrev <;> omega
      exact Or.inr ⟨by simpa only [dPrev] using hPrev, by
        simpa only [dAt, hPrev, mul_one] using hEquation⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_positiveCoordinate_local_alternative
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_positiveCoordinate_local_alternative
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hComplementary : ∀ k, k ∈ J ↔ k + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) (hi : i ∈ J)
    (hNegative : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) i < 0)
    (huPositive : 0 < sigma.periodicU hf i) :
    (pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1) = 0 ∧
        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i = 0) ∨
      (pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
          (i - 1) = 1 ∧
        (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) = (p : Int) -
          pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hExceptional : ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma'
  · have hpEq : p = 3 := hExceptional.1
    subst p
    have hPair :
        profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma
            (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
          profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma'
            (.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)) := by
      rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec J hComplementary hJ]
      exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
    exact False.elim ((niveauTwoExceptionalProfiles_ne_of_pair_eq hf chars
      sigma sigma' hExceptional.2.1 hExceptional.2.2.1 hExceptional.2.2.2 J
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ) hComplementary
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)) hPair)
  · have hBounds :
        (∀ k,
            |pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ k| ≤ 2) ∧
          ∀ k,
            |pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ k| ≤ 2 := by
      rcases pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty
          (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ with hBounds | hExceptional'
      · exact hBounds
      · exact False.elim (hExceptional hExceptional')
    have hSigns :=
      pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception hp3 hExceptional
        hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i hNegative
    rcases (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J
        hComplementary hJ i).1 hi with hSumRecurrence | hDifferenceEquation
    · exact Or.inl (boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
        (hBounds.1 (i - 1)) (hBounds.1 i) hSumRecurrence)
    · let dPrev := pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1)
      let dAt := pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i
      have hEquation :
          (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) = (p : Int) * dPrev - dAt := by
        simpa only [dPrev, dAt] using hDifferenceEquation
      have hPrevBound : |dPrev| ≤ 2 := by
        simpa only [dPrev] using hBounds.2 (i - 1)
      have hAtBound : |dAt| ≤ 2 := by
        simpa only [dAt] using hBounds.2 i
      rcases abs_le.mp hPrevBound with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
      rcases abs_le.mp hAtBound with ⟨hAtLower, hAtUpper⟩
      have hAtNonnegative : 0 ≤ dAt := by simpa only [dAt] using hSigns.2
      have huPositiveInt : (0 : Int) < (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast huPositive
      have huLeInt : (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le (periodicIndex hf i)
      have hPrev : dPrev = 1 := by
        interval_cases dPrev <;> omega
      exact Or.inr ⟨by simpa only [dPrev] using hPrev, by
        simpa only [dAt, hPrev, mul_one] using hEquation⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_negativeCarries_positiveCoordinates_local_consequences
statement:
theorem niveauOne_negativeCarries_positiveCoordinates_local_consequences
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hPrevNot : i - 1 ∉ J) (hi : i ∈ J) (hNextNot : i + 1 ∉ J)
    (hNegativePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) < 0)
    (hNegative : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i < 0)
    (hNegativeNext : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i + 1) < 0)
    (huPositivePrev : 0 < sigma.u (i - 1))
    (huPositive : 0 < sigma.u i) (huPositiveNext : 0 < sigma.u (i + 1)) :
    (sigma.u (i - 1) : Int) = (p : Int) + 1 +
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) ∧
      (sigma.u i : Int) = (p : Int) -
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i
proof:
:= by
  have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
    intro hExceptional
    have hpEq : p = 3 := hExceptional.1
    subst p
    have hPair :
        profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
          profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma'
            (.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)) := by
      rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec J hJ]
      exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne J) hJ
    rcases niveauOneExceptionalProfiles_of_pair_eq hf chars sigma sigma'
        hExceptional.2.1 hExceptional.2.2.1 hExceptional.2.2.2 J
        (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ) hPair with hFull | hEmptySource
    · exact hPrevNot (hFull.1 (i - 1))
    · exact hEmptySource.1 i hi
  have hBounds :
      (∀ k, |pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ k| ≤ 2) ∧
        ∀ k, |pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ k| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ with
      hBounds | hExceptional
    · exact hBounds
    · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)
  have hNegativePrevAt : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauOne J) (i - 1) < 0 := by
    simpa only [baseCarryAt] using hNegativePrev
  have hNegativeAt : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauOne J) i < 0 := by
    simpa only [baseCarryAt] using hNegative
  have hNegativeNextAt : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauOne J) (i + 1) < 0 := by
    simpa only [baseCarryAt] using hNegativeNext
  have hSignsPrev := pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception hp3
    hNotExceptional hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) hNegativePrevAt
  have hSignsNext := pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception hp3
    hNotExceptional hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i + 1) hNegativeNextAt
  rcases pin.niveauOne_positiveCoordinate_local_alternative hp3 hEmpty J hJ i
      hPrevNot hi hNegative huPositive with hSumZero | hDifference
  · rcases (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J hJ
        (i + 1)).2 hNextNot with hSumEquation | hDifferenceRecurrence
    · have huPositiveNextInt : (0 : Int) < (sigma.u (i + 1) : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast huPositiveNext
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_right, hSumZero.2, mul_zero, zero_sub]
        at hSumEquation
      omega
    · have hDifferenceRecurrence' :
          (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i =
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i + 1) := by
        simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hDifferenceRecurrence
      have hDifferenceZero := boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
        (hBounds.2 i) (hBounds.2 (i + 1)) hDifferenceRecurrence'
      have hSumDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i
      have hDifferenceDouble :=
        pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i
      omega
  · rcases (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J hJ
        (i - 1)).2 hPrevNot with hSumEquation | hDifferenceRecurrence
    · let sPrevPrev := pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ ((i - 1) - 1)
      let sPrev := pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1)
      have hEquation :
          -(sigma.u (i - 1) : Int) = (p : Int) * sPrevPrev - sPrev := by
        simpa only [sPrevPrev, sPrev] using hSumEquation
      have hPrevPrevBound : |sPrevPrev| ≤ 2 := by
        simpa only [sPrevPrev] using hBounds.1 ((i - 1) - 1)
      have hPrevBound : |sPrev| ≤ 2 := by
        simpa only [sPrev] using hBounds.1 (i - 1)
      rcases abs_le.mp hPrevPrevBound with ⟨hPrevPrevLower, hPrevPrevUpper⟩
      rcases abs_le.mp hPrevBound with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
      have hPrevNonpositive : sPrev ≤ 0 := by simpa only [sPrev] using hSignsPrev.1
      have huPrevPositiveInt : (0 : Int) < (sigma.u (i - 1) : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast huPositivePrev
      have huPrevLeInt : (sigma.u (i - 1) : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le (i - 1)
      have hPrevPrev : sPrevPrev = -1 := by
        interval_cases sPrevPrev <;> omega
      have hEquationAfter :
          -(sigma.u (i - 1) : Int) = -(p : Int) - sPrev := by
        calc
          -(sigma.u (i - 1) : Int) = (p : Int) * sPrevPrev - sPrev := hEquation
          _ = -(p : Int) - sPrev := by rw [hPrevPrev]; ring
      have hSumDouble :=
        pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1)
      have hDifferenceDouble :=
        pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1)
      simp only [baseCarryAt] at hSumDouble hDifferenceDouble
      have hDifferencePrev := hDifference.1
      constructor
      · dsimp only [sPrev] at hPrevNonpositive hEquationAfter
        omega
      · exact hDifference.2
    · let dPrevPrev :=
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ ((i - 1) - 1)
      have hPrevPrevBound : |dPrevPrev| ≤ 2 := by
        simpa only [dPrevPrev] using hBounds.2 ((i - 1) - 1)
      rcases abs_le.mp hPrevPrevBound with ⟨hPrevPrevLower, hPrevPrevUpper⟩
      have hRecurrence : (p : Int) * dPrevPrev = 1 := by
        simpa only [dPrevPrev, hDifference.1] using hDifferenceRecurrence
      interval_cases dPrevPrev <;> omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_negativeCarries_positiveCoordinates_local_consequences
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_negativeCarries_positiveCoordinates_local_consequences
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')

    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hComplementary : ∀ k, k ∈ J ↔ k + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) (hPrevNot : i - 1 ∉ J) (hi : i ∈ J)
    (hNextNot : i + 1 ∉ J)
    (hNegativePrev :
      pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) (i - 1) < 0)
    (hNegative : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) i < 0)
    (hNegativeNext :
      pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) (i + 1) < 0)
    (huPositivePrev : 0 < sigma.periodicU hf (i - 1))
    (huPositive : 0 < sigma.periodicU hf i)
    (huPositiveNext : 0 < sigma.periodicU hf (i + 1)) :
    (sigma.periodicU hf (i - 1) : Int) = (p : Int) + 1 +
        pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) (i - 1) ∧
      (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) = (p : Int) -
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i
proof:
:= by
  have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
    intro hExceptional
    have hpEq : p = 3 := hExceptional.1
    subst p
    have hPair :
        profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma
            (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
          profileCharacterPair (by omega) hf chars sigma'
            (.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)) := by
      rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec J hComplementary hJ]
      exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
    exact (niveauTwoExceptionalProfiles_ne_of_pair_eq hf chars sigma sigma'
      hExceptional.2.1 hExceptional.2.2.1 hExceptional.2.2.2 J
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ) hComplementary
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)) hPair
  have hBounds :
      (∀ k, |pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ k| ≤ 2) ∧
        ∀ k,
          |pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ k| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ with hBounds | hExceptional
    · exact hBounds
    · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)
  have hSignsPrev := pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception hp3
    hNotExceptional hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1) hNegativePrev
  have hSignsNext := pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception hp3
    hNotExceptional hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i + 1) hNegativeNext
  rcases pin.niveauTwo_positiveCoordinate_local_alternative hp3 hEmpty J
      hComplementary hJ i hi hNegative huPositive with
    hSumZero | hDifference
  · rcases (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J
        hComplementary hJ (i + 1)).2 hNextNot with
      hSumEquation | hDifferenceRecurrence
    · have huPositiveNextInt :
          (0 : Int) < (sigma.periodicU hf (i + 1) : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast huPositiveNext
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_right, hSumZero.2, mul_zero, zero_sub]
        at hSumEquation
      omega
    · have hDifferenceRecurrence' :
          (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i =
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
              (i + 1) := by
        simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using hDifferenceRecurrence
      have hDifferenceZero := boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
        (hBounds.2 i) (hBounds.2 (i + 1)) hDifferenceRecurrence'
      have hSumDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i
      have hDifferenceDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i
      omega
  · rcases (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J
        hComplementary hJ (i - 1)).2 hPrevNot with
      hSumEquation | hDifferenceRecurrence
    · let sPrevPrev := pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ ((i - 1) - 1)
      let sPrev := pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1)
      have hEquation :
          -(sigma.periodicU hf (i - 1) : Int) =
            (p : Int) * sPrevPrev - sPrev := by
        simpa only [sPrevPrev, sPrev] using hSumEquation
      have hPrevPrevBound : |sPrevPrev| ≤ 2 := by
        simpa only [sPrevPrev] using hBounds.1 ((i - 1) - 1)
      have hPrevBound : |sPrev| ≤ 2 := by
        simpa only [sPrev] using hBounds.1 (i - 1)
      rcases abs_le.mp hPrevPrevBound with ⟨hPrevPrevLower, hPrevPrevUpper⟩
      rcases abs_le.mp hPrevBound with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
      have hPrevNonpositive : sPrev ≤ 0 := by simpa only [sPrev] using hSignsPrev.1
      have huPrevPositiveInt :
          (0 : Int) < (sigma.periodicU hf (i - 1) : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast huPositivePrev
      have huPrevLeInt : (sigma.periodicU hf (i - 1) : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le (periodicIndex hf (i - 1))
      have hPrevPrev : sPrevPrev = -1 := by
        interval_cases sPrevPrev <;> omega
      have hEquationAfter :
          -(sigma.periodicU hf (i - 1) : Int) = -(p : Int) - sPrev := by
        calc
          -(sigma.periodicU hf (i - 1) : Int) =
              (p : Int) * sPrevPrev - sPrev := hEquation
          _ = -(p : Int) - sPrev := by rw [hPrevPrev]; ring
      have hSumDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1)
      have hDifferenceDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1)
      have hDifferencePrev := hDifference.1
      constructor
      · dsimp only [sPrev] at hPrevNonpositive hEquationAfter
        omega
      · exact hDifference.2
    · let dPrevPrev := pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ ((i - 1) - 1)
      have hPrevPrevBound : |dPrevPrev| ≤ 2 := by
        simpa only [dPrevPrev] using hBounds.2 ((i - 1) - 1)
      rcases abs_le.mp hPrevPrevBound with ⟨hPrevPrevLower, hPrevPrevUpper⟩
      have hRecurrence : (p : Int) * dPrevPrev = 1 := by
        simpa only [dPrevPrev, hDifference.1] using hDifferenceRecurrence
      interval_cases dPrevPrev <;> omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.signedPinnedCarryAt_mod_relation
statement:
theorem signedPinnedCarryAt_mod_relation
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Profile f) (hJ : J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    (p : Int) ∣ pin.signedPinnedCarryAt J hJ i -
      ((sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) -
        pin.sourceTargetSignProductAt J hJ i * (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases J with
  | niveauOne S =>
      have hCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec S hJ (periodicIndex hf i)
      by_cases hiS : periodicIndex hf i ∈ S <;>
        by_cases hiT : periodicIndex hf i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget S hJ
      all_goals
        simp [signedPinnedCarryAt, sourceTargetSignProductAt,
          niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
          Profile.Contains, Profile.set, PhantomWeight.periodicU, hiS, hiT]
          at hCarry ⊢
      all_goals
        refine ⟨(Profile.niveauOne S).sign (periodicIndex hf i) *
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry S hJ (periodicIndex hf i - 1), ?_⟩
      all_goals
        simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiS]
        omega
  | niveauTwo S hS =>
      have hCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec S hS hJ i
      by_cases hiS : i ∈ S <;>
        by_cases hiT : i ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget S hS hJ
      all_goals
        simp [signedPinnedCarryAt, sourceTargetSignProductAt,
          niveauTwoCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
          Profile.Contains, Profile.set, PhantomWeight.periodicU, hiS, hiT]
          at hCarry ⊢
      all_goals
        refine ⟨(Profile.niveauTwo S hS).sign i *
          pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry S hS hJ (i - 1), ?_⟩
      all_goals
        simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiS]
        omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.signedPinnedCarryAt_sub_even
statement:
theorem signedPinnedCarryAt_sub_even
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J K : Profile f)
    (hJ : J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hK : K ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    Even (pin.signedPinnedCarryAt J hJ i - pin.signedPinnedCarryAt K hK i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have signChoice (M : Profile f) (k : M.Index) :
      M.sign k = 1 ∨ M.sign k = -1 := by
    by_cases hk : M.Contains k
    · right
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, hk]
    · left
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, hk]
  have signedParity (a b s t : Int) (hs : s = 1 ∨ s = -1)
      (ht : t = 1 ∨ t = -1) (hab : Even (a - b)) :
      Even (s * a - t * b) := by
    rcases hab with ⟨k, hk⟩
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> rcases ht with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨k, by omega⟩
    · exact ⟨k + b, by omega⟩
    · exact ⟨-k - b, by omega⟩
    · exact ⟨-k, by omega⟩
  cases J with
  | niveauOne S =>
      cases K with
      | niveauOne T =>
          have hPairS :
              profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne S) =
                profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
                  (.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget S hJ)) := by
            rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec S hJ]
            exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne S) hJ
          have hPairT :
              profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne T) =
                profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
                  (.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget T hK)) := by
            rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec T hK]
            exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne T) hK
          have hRaw := niveauOneCarryEquation_sameParity_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
            sigma sigma' S (pin.niveauOneTarget S hJ) T
              (pin.niveauOneTarget T hK) hPairS hPairT
              (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec S hJ)
              (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec T hK) (periodicIndex hf i)
          simpa [signedPinnedCarryAt] using signedParity
            (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry S hJ (periodicIndex hf i))
            (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry T hK (periodicIndex hf i))
            ((Profile.niveauOne S).sign (periodicIndex hf i))
            ((Profile.niveauOne T).sign (periodicIndex hf i))
            (signChoice (.niveauOne S) (periodicIndex hf i))
            (signChoice (.niveauOne T) (periodicIndex hf i)) hRaw
      | niveauTwo T hT =>
          have hPairS :
              profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne S) =
                profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
                  (.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget S hJ)) := by
            rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec S hJ]
            exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne S) hJ
          have hPairT :
              profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo T hT) =
                profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
                  (.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget T hT hK)
                    (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary T hT hK)) := by
            rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec T hT hK]
            exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo T hT) hK
          have hRaw := crossNiveauCarryEquation_sameParity_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
            sigma sigma' S (pin.niveauOneTarget S hJ) T
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget T hT hK) hT
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary T hT hK) hPairS hPairT
              (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec S hJ)
              (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec T hT hK) i
          simpa [signedPinnedCarryAt] using signedParity
            (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry S hJ (periodicIndex hf i))
            (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry T hT hK i)
            ((Profile.niveauOne S).sign (periodicIndex hf i))
            ((Profile.niveauTwo T hT).sign i)
            (signChoice (.niveauOne S) (periodicIndex hf i))
            (signChoice (.niveauTwo T hT) i) hRaw
  | niveauTwo S hS =>
      cases K with
      | niveauOne T =>
          have hPairS :
              profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo S hS) =
                profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
                  (.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget S hS hJ)
                    (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary S hS hJ)) := by
            rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec S hS hJ]
            exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo S hS) hJ
          have hPairT :
              profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne T) =
                profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
                  (.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget T hK)) := by
            rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec T hK]
            exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne T) hK
          have hRaw := crossNiveauCarryEquation_sameParity_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
            sigma sigma' T (pin.niveauOneTarget T hK) S
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget S hS hJ) hS
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary S hS hJ) hPairT hPairS
              (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec T hK)
              (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec S hS hJ) i
          rcases hRaw with ⟨k, hk⟩
          have hRaw' : Even (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry S hS hJ i -
              pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry T hK (periodicIndex hf i)) :=
            ⟨-k, by omega⟩
          simpa [signedPinnedCarryAt] using signedParity
            (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry S hS hJ i)
            (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry T hK (periodicIndex hf i))
            ((Profile.niveauTwo S hS).sign i)
            ((Profile.niveauOne T).sign (periodicIndex hf i))
            (signChoice (.niveauTwo S hS) i)
            (signChoice (.niveauOne T) (periodicIndex hf i)) hRaw'
      | niveauTwo T hT =>
          have hPairS :
              profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo S hS) =
                profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
                  (.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget S hS hJ)
                    (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary S hS hJ)) := by
            rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec S hS hJ]
            exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo S hS) hJ
          have hPairT :
              profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo T hT) =
                profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
                  (.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget T hT hK)
                    (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary T hT hK)) := by
            rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec T hT hK]
            exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo T hT) hK
          have hRaw := niveauTwoCarryEquation_sameParity_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
            sigma sigma' S (pin.niveauTwoTarget S hS hJ) T
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget T hT hK) hS
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary S hS hJ) hT
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary T hT hK) hPairS hPairT
              (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec S hS hJ)
              (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec T hT hK) i
          simpa [signedPinnedCarryAt] using signedParity
            (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry S hS hJ i)
            (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry T hT hK i)
            ((Profile.niveauTwo S hS).sign i) ((Profile.niveauTwo T hT).sign i)
            (signChoice (.niveauTwo S hS) i) (signChoice (.niveauTwo T hT) i) hRaw

name: KLSposet.Pinning.signedPinnedCarryAt_abs_le_two
statement:
theorem signedPinnedCarryAt_abs_le_two
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (J : Profile f) (hJ : J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : |pin.signedPinnedCarryAt J hJ i| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases J with
  | niveauOne S =>
      rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 S hJ with
        hBound | hExceptional
      · have h := hBound (periodicIndex hf i)
        simpa [signedPinnedCarryAt, abs_mul, Profile.abs_sign] using h
      · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)
  | niveauTwo S hS =>
      have h := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 S hS hJ i
      simpa [signedPinnedCarryAt, abs_mul, Profile.abs_sign] using h

name: KLSposet.Pinning.signedPinnedCarryAt_eq_of_signProduct_eq
statement:
theorem signedPinnedCarryAt_eq_of_signProduct_eq
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (J K : Profile f)
    (hJ : J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hK : K ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hSign : pin.sourceTargetSignProductAt J hJ i =
      pin.sourceTargetSignProductAt K hK i) :
    pin.signedPinnedCarryAt J hJ i = pin.signedPinnedCarryAt K hK i
proof:
:= by
  have hModJ := pin.signedPinnedCarryAt_mod_relation J hJ i
  have hModK := pin.signedPinnedCarryAt_mod_relation K hK i
  rw [hSign] at hModJ
  rcases hModJ with ⟨a, ha⟩
  rcases hModK with ⟨b, hb⟩
  have hDvd : (p : Int) ∣
      pin.signedPinnedCarryAt J hJ i - pin.signedPinnedCarryAt K hK i := by
    refine ⟨a - b, ?_⟩
    calc
      pin.signedPinnedCarryAt J hJ i - pin.signedPinnedCarryAt K hK i =
          (pin.signedPinnedCarryAt J hJ i -
            ((sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) -
              pin.sourceTargetSignProductAt K hK i *
                (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int))) -
          (pin.signedPinnedCarryAt K hK i -
            ((sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) -
              pin.sourceTargetSignProductAt K hK i *
                (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int))) := by ring
      _ = (p : Int) * a - (p : Int) * b := by rw [ha, hb]
      _ = (p : Int) * (a - b) := by ring
  have hEven := pin.signedPinnedCarryAt_sub_even J K hJ hK i
  rcases hEven with ⟨e, he⟩
  have hBoundJ := pin.signedPinnedCarryAt_abs_le_two hp3 hNotExceptional J hJ i
  have hBoundK := pin.signedPinnedCarryAt_abs_le_two hp3 hNotExceptional K hK i
  rcases abs_le.mp hBoundJ with ⟨hJLower, hJUpper⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hBoundK with ⟨hKLower, hKUpper⟩
  by_cases hpEq : p = 3
  · subst p
    interval_cases hJValue : pin.signedPinnedCarryAt J hJ i <;>
      interval_cases hKValue : pin.signedPinnedCarryAt K hK i
    all_goals norm_num [hJValue, hKValue] at hDvd
    all_goals omega
  · rcases hpOdd with ⟨n, hn⟩
    have hp5 : 5 ≤ p := by omega
    have hAbsDiff :
        |pin.signedPinnedCarryAt J hJ i - pin.signedPinnedCarryAt K hK i| <
          (p : Int) := by
      apply abs_lt.mpr
      constructor <;> omega
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (Int.eq_zero_of_abs_lt_dvd hDvd hAbsDiff)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.signedPinnedCarries_atMostTwo
statement:
theorem signedPinnedCarries_atMostTwo
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (J K L : Profile f)
    (hJ : J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hK : K ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hL : L ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    pin.signedPinnedCarryAt J hJ i = pin.signedPinnedCarryAt K hK i ∨
      pin.signedPinnedCarryAt J hJ i = pin.signedPinnedCarryAt L hL i ∨
      pin.signedPinnedCarryAt K hK i = pin.signedPinnedCarryAt L hL i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hExceptional : ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma'
  · have classify : ∀ (M : Profile f)
        (hM : M ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma'),
        M = .niveauOne Set.univ ∨ M = .niveauOne ∅ := by
      intro M hM
      cases M with
      | niveauOne S =>
          have hPair :
              profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne S) =
                profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
                  (.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget S hM)) := by
            rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec S hM]
            exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne S) hM
          rcases hExceptional with ⟨hpEq, hu, hu', ht⟩
          subst p
          rcases niveauOneExceptionalProfiles_of_pair_eq hf chars sigma sigma'
              hu hu' ht S (pin.niveauOneTarget S hM) hPair with hFull | hEmpty'
          · left
            congr
            ext x
            simp [hFull.1 x]
          · right
            congr
            ext x
            simp [hEmpty'.1 x]
      | niveauTwo S hS =>
          have hPair :
              profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo S hS) =
                profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
                  (.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget S hS hM)
                    (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary S hS hM)) := by
            rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec S hS hM]
            exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo S hS) hM
          rcases hExceptional with ⟨hpEq, hu, hu', ht⟩
          subst p
          exact False.elim ((niveauTwoExceptionalProfiles_ne_of_pair_eq hf chars
            sigma sigma' hu hu' ht S (pin.niveauTwoTarget S hS hM) hS
            (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary S hS hM)) hPair)
    rcases classify J hJ with hJFull | hJEmpty <;>
      rcases classify K hK with hKFull | hKEmpty <;>
      rcases classify L hL with hLFull | hLEmpty
    all_goals (subst_vars; simp)
  · let eJ := pin.sourceTargetSignProductAt J hJ i
    let eK := pin.sourceTargetSignProductAt K hK i
    let eL := pin.sourceTargetSignProductAt L hL i
    have hJChoice : eJ = 1 ∨ eJ = -1 := by
      cases J with
      | niveauOne S =>
          by_cases hiS : periodicIndex hf i ∈ S <;>
            by_cases hiT : periodicIndex hf i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget S hJ <;>
              simp [eJ, sourceTargetSignProductAt, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
                Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiS, hiT]
      | niveauTwo S hS =>
          by_cases hiS : i ∈ S <;>
            by_cases hiT : i ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget S hS hJ <;>
              simp [eJ, sourceTargetSignProductAt, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
                Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiS, hiT]
    have hKChoice : eK = 1 ∨ eK = -1 := by
      cases K with
      | niveauOne S =>
          by_cases hiS : periodicIndex hf i ∈ S <;>
            by_cases hiT : periodicIndex hf i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget S hK <;>
              simp [eK, sourceTargetSignProductAt, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
                Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiS, hiT]
      | niveauTwo S hS =>
          by_cases hiS : i ∈ S <;>
            by_cases hiT : i ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget S hS hK <;>
              simp [eK, sourceTargetSignProductAt, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
                Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiS, hiT]
    have hLChoice : eL = 1 ∨ eL = -1 := by
      cases L with
      | niveauOne S =>
          by_cases hiS : periodicIndex hf i ∈ S <;>
            by_cases hiT : periodicIndex hf i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget S hL <;>
              simp [eL, sourceTargetSignProductAt, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
                Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiS, hiT]
      | niveauTwo S hS =>
          by_cases hiS : i ∈ S <;>
            by_cases hiT : i ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget S hS hL <;>
              simp [eL, sourceTargetSignProductAt, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
                Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiS, hiT]
    rcases hJChoice with hJPos | hJNeg
    · rcases hKChoice with hKPos | hKNeg
      · exact Or.inl (pin.signedPinnedCarryAt_eq_of_signProduct_eq hp3 hpOdd
          hExceptional J K hJ hK i (by simp [eJ, eK, hJPos, hKPos]))
      · rcases hLChoice with hLPos | hLNeg
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (pin.signedPinnedCarryAt_eq_of_signProduct_eq hp3
            hpOdd hExceptional J L hJ hL i
              (by simp [eJ, eL, hJPos, hLPos])))
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (pin.signedPinnedCarryAt_eq_of_signProduct_eq hp3
            hpOdd hExceptional K L hK hL i
              (by simp [eK, eL, hKNeg, hLNeg])))
    · rcases hKChoice with hKPos | hKNeg
      · rcases hLChoice with hLPos | hLNeg
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (pin.signedPinnedCarryAt_eq_of_signProduct_eq hp3
            hpOdd hExceptional K L hK hL i
              (by simp [eK, eL, hKPos, hLPos])))
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (pin.signedPinnedCarryAt_eq_of_signProduct_eq hp3
            hpOdd hExceptional J L hJ hL i
              (by simp [eJ, eL, hJNeg, hLNeg])))
      · exact Or.inl (pin.signedPinnedCarryAt_eq_of_signProduct_eq hp3 hpOdd
          hExceptional J K hJ hK i (by simp [eJ, eK, hJNeg, hKNeg]))

name: KLSposet.Pinning.paPositiveString_length_lt_period
statement:
theorem paPositiveString_length_lt_period {f length : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (j : ZMod f) (x : ZMod f → Int)
    (hOne : ∀ k, k ≤ length → x (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 1)
    (hEnd : x (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0) :
    length + 1 < f
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hLength
  have hfLe : f ≤ length + 1 := Nat.le_of_not_gt hLength
  let k := length + 1 - f
  have hk : k ≤ length := by
    dsimp only [k]
    omega
  have hSplit : length + 1 = k + f := by
    dsimp only [k]
    omega
  have hIndex : j + (k : ZMod f) = j + (length + 1 : Nat) := by
    conv_rhs => rw [hSplit]
    push_cast
    simp
  have hOneAt := hOne k hk
  rw [hIndex, hEnd] at hOneAt
  omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.paCyclicInterval_index_injective
statement:
theorem paCyclicInterval_index_injective {f length : Nat}
    (j : ZMod f) (hLength : length + 1 < f) :
    ∀ ⦃a⦄, a ∈ Finset.range (length + 1) →
      ∀ ⦃b⦄, b ∈ Finset.range (length + 1) →
        j + (a + 1 : Nat) = j + (b + 1 : Nat) → a = b
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hIndex
  have haLt : a + 1 < f := by
    have := Finset.mem_range.mp ha
    omega
  have hbLt : b + 1 < f := by
    have := Finset.mem_range.mp hb
    omega
  have hCast : ((a + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) = (b + 1 : Nat) :=
    add_left_cancel hIndex
  have hVal := congrArg ZMod.val hCast
  simp only [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt haLt, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hbLt] at hVal
  omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.periodicIndexSet_paCyclicInterval
statement:
theorem periodicIndexSet_paCyclicInterval {f length : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    periodicIndexSet hf
        (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf a) length) : Set (ZMod f)) =
      (↑(paCyclicInterval a length) : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) ∪
        (↑(paCyclicInterval (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) length) :
          Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hPeriodicAdd (b : ZMod (2 * f)) (n : Nat) :
      periodicIndex hf (b + (n : ZMod (2 * f))) =
        periodicIndex hf b + (n : ZMod f) := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
    simp
  ext i
  constructor
  · intro hi
    change periodicIndex hf i ∈
      (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf a) length) : Set (ZMod f)) at hi
    have hi' : periodicIndex hf i ∈
        paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf a) length := hi
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi' with ⟨k, hk, hki⟩
    have hPeriodic : periodicIndex hf i =
        periodicIndex hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) := by
      rw [hPeriodicAdd]
      exact hki.symm
    rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i
      (a + (k + 1 : Nat))).mp hPeriodic with hEq | hEq
    · left
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, hk, hEq.symm⟩
    · right
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
      rw [hEq]
      ring
  · rintro (hi | hi)
    · change periodicIndex hf i ∈
        (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf a) length) : Set (ZMod f))
      have hi' : i ∈ paCyclicInterval a length := hi
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi' with ⟨k, hk, hki⟩
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
      rw [← hki, hPeriodicAdd]
    · change periodicIndex hf i ∈
        (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf a) length) : Set (ZMod f))
      have hi' : i ∈
          paCyclicInterval (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) length := hi
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi' with ⟨k, hk, hki⟩
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
      rw [← hki, hPeriodicAdd, periodicIndex_add_half]

name: KLSposet.Pinning.paCyclicInterval_disjoint_add_half
statement:
theorem paCyclicInterval_disjoint_add_half {f length : Nat}
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (hLength : length + 1 < f) :
    Disjoint (↑(paCyclicInterval a length) : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
      (↑(paCyclicInterval (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) length) :
        Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro i hi hiHalf
  have hi' : i ∈ paCyclicInterval a length := hi
  have hiHalf' : i ∈
      paCyclicInterval (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) length := hiHalf
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi' with ⟨k, hk, hki⟩
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hiHalf' with ⟨l, hl, hli⟩
  have hkLt : k + 1 < f := by
    have := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
    omega
  have hlLt : l + 1 < f := by
    have := Finset.mem_range.mp hl
    omega
  have hEq : a + (k + 1 : Nat) = a + (f + (l + 1) : Nat) := by
    calc
      a + (k + 1 : Nat) = i := hki
      _ = a + f + (l + 1 : Nat) := hli.symm
      _ = a + (f + (l + 1) : Nat) := by push_cast; ring
  have hCast : ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) =
      (f + (l + 1) : Nat) := add_left_cancel hEq
  have hVal := congrArg ZMod.val hCast
  simp only [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (by omega : k + 1 < 2 * f),
    ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (by omega : f + (l + 1) < 2 * f)] at hVal
  omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.mem_paCyclicInterval_add_half_iff
statement:
theorem mem_paCyclicInterval_add_half_iff {f length : Nat}
    (a i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    i ∈ (↑(paCyclicInterval (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) length) :
        Set (ZMod (2 * f))) ↔
      i + f ∈ (↑(paCyclicInterval a length) : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hi
    have hi' : i ∈
        paCyclicInterval (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) length := hi
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi' with ⟨k, hk, hki⟩
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
    calc
      a + (k + 1 : Nat) = a + (k + 1 : Nat) + (2 * f : Nat) := by simp
      _ = (a + f + (k + 1 : Nat)) + f := by push_cast; ring
      _ = i + f := by rw [hki]
  · intro hi
    have hi' : i + f ∈ paCyclicInterval a length := hi
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi' with ⟨k, hk, hki⟩
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
    apply add_right_cancel (b := (f : ZMod (2 * f)))
    calc
      (a + f + (k + 1 : Nat)) + f =
          a + (k + 1 : Nat) + (2 * f : Nat) := by push_cast; ring
      _ = a + (k + 1 : Nat) := by simp
      _ = i + f := hki

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOneProfileSum_paCyclicInterval
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_paCyclicInterval {p f length : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (hLength : length + 1 < f) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma
        (↑(paCyclicInterval j length) : Set (ZMod f)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
        (sigma.u (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (j + (k + 1 : Nat))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun k _ ↦ j + (k + 1 : Nat)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro k hk
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_coe]
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    exact paCyclicInterval_index_injective j hLength ha hb hab
  · intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_coe] at hi
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi with ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  · intro k hk
    rfl

name: KLSposet.Pinning.paInteriorCarryStep
statement:
theorem paInteriorCarryStep {p : Nat} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    {epsilon a b : Int} (hepsilon : epsilon = 1 ∨ epsilon = -1)
    (ha : |a| ≤ 2) (hb : |b| ≤ 2) (haOdd : Odd a) (hbOdd : Odd b)
    (hEquation : epsilon * ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) = (p : Int) * a - b) :
    (a = 1 ∧ b = 1 ∧ epsilon = 1) ∨
      (a = -1 ∧ b = -1 ∧ epsilon = -1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases abs_le.mp ha with ⟨haLower, haUpper⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hb with ⟨hbLower, hbUpper⟩
  rcases haOdd with ⟨ka, hka⟩
  rcases hbOdd with ⟨kb, hkb⟩
  have haCases : a = -1 ∨ a = 1 := by omega
  have hbCases : b = -1 ∨ b = 1 := by omega
  rcases hepsilon with hepsilon | hepsilon <;>
    rcases haCases with haValue | haValue <;>
    rcases hbCases with hbValue | hbValue
  all_goals simp [hepsilon, haValue, hbValue] at hEquation ⊢
  all_goals omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.paEndpointCarryStep
statement:
theorem paEndpointCarryStep {p : Nat} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    {epsilon a b : Int} (hepsilon : epsilon = 1 ∨ epsilon = -1)
    (ha : |a| ≤ 2) (hb : |b| ≤ 2) (haOdd : Odd a) (hbEven : Even b)
    (hEquation : epsilon * (p : Int) = (p : Int) * a - b) :
    (a = 1 ∧ b = 0 ∧ epsilon = 1) ∨
      (a = -1 ∧ b = 0 ∧ epsilon = -1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases abs_le.mp ha with ⟨haLower, haUpper⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hb with ⟨hbLower, hbUpper⟩
  rcases haOdd with ⟨ka, hka⟩
  rcases hbEven with ⟨kb, hkb⟩
  have haCases : a = -1 ∨ a = 1 := by omega
  rcases hepsilon with hepsilon | hepsilon <;>
    rcases haCases with haValue | haValue
  all_goals simp [hepsilon, haValue] at hEquation ⊢
  all_goals omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.paPositiveStringDichotomy
statement:
theorem paPositiveStringDichotomy {p length : Nat} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (x epsilon : Nat → Int)
    (hepsilon : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      epsilon k = 1 ∨ epsilon k = -1)
    (hxBound : ∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 → |x k| ≤ 2)
    (hxOdd : ∀ k, k ≤ length → Odd (x k))
    (hxEndEven : Even (x (length + 1)))
    (hInterior : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length →
      epsilon k * ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) =
        (p : Int) * x (k - 1) - x k)
    (hEndpoint : epsilon (length + 1) * (p : Int) =
      (p : Int) * x length - x (length + 1)) :
    ((∀ k, k ≤ length → x k = 1) ∧
        (∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 → epsilon k = 1) ∧
        x (length + 1) = 0) ∨
      ((∀ k, k ≤ length → x k = -1) ∧
        (∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 → epsilon k = -1) ∧
        x (length + 1) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hEnd := paEndpointCarryStep hp3
    (hepsilon (length + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
    (hxBound length (by omega)) (hxBound (length + 1) (by omega))
    (hxOdd length (by omega)) hxEndEven hEndpoint
  rcases hEnd with hEndPositive | hEndNegative
  · left
    have hxPositive : ∀ k, k ≤ length → x k = 1 := by
      intro k hk
      exact Nat.decreasingInduction (n := length)
        (motive := fun k _hk ↦ x k = 1) (fun k hk ih ↦ by
          have hStep := paInteriorCarryStep hp3
            (hepsilon (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
            (hxBound k (by omega)) (hxBound (k + 1) (by omega))
            (hxOdd k (by omega)) (hxOdd (k + 1) (by omega))
            (hInterior (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
          rcases hStep with hStepPositive | hStepNegative
          · exact hStepPositive.1
          · omega)
        hEndPositive.1 hk
    refine ⟨hxPositive, ?_, hEndPositive.2.1⟩
    intro k hkPositive hkEnd
    by_cases hkEndpoint : k = length + 1
    · simpa only [hkEndpoint] using hEndPositive.2.2
    · have hkInterior : k ≤ length := by omega
      have hkPred : k - 1 ≤ length := by omega
      have hStep := paInteriorCarryStep hp3
        (hepsilon k hkPositive hkEnd)
        (hxBound (k - 1) (by omega)) (hxBound k (by omega))
        (hxOdd (k - 1) hkPred) (hxOdd k hkInterior)
        (hInterior k hkPositive hkInterior)
      rcases hStep with hStepPositive | hStepNegative
      · exact hStepPositive.2.2
      · have := hxPositive k hkInterior
        omega
  · right
    have hxNegative : ∀ k, k ≤ length → x k = -1 := by
      intro k hk
      exact Nat.decreasingInduction (n := length)
        (motive := fun k _hk ↦ x k = -1) (fun k hk ih ↦ by
          have hStep := paInteriorCarryStep hp3
            (hepsilon (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
            (hxBound k (by omega)) (hxBound (k + 1) (by omega))
            (hxOdd k (by omega)) (hxOdd (k + 1) (by omega))
            (hInterior (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
          rcases hStep with hStepPositive | hStepNegative
          · omega
          · exact hStepNegative.1)
        hEndNegative.1 hk
    refine ⟨hxNegative, ?_, hEndNegative.2.1⟩
    intro k hkPositive hkEnd
    by_cases hkEndpoint : k = length + 1
    · simpa only [hkEndpoint] using hEndNegative.2.2
    · have hkInterior : k ≤ length := by omega
      have hkPred : k - 1 ≤ length := by omega
      have hStep := paInteriorCarryStep hp3
        (hepsilon k hkPositive hkEnd)
        (hxBound (k - 1) (by omega)) (hxBound k (by omega))
        (hxOdd (k - 1) hkPred) (hxOdd k hkInterior)
        (hInterior k hkPositive hkInterior)
      rcases hStep with hStepPositive | hStepNegative
      · have := hxNegative k hkInterior
        omega
      · exact hStepNegative.2.2

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pbCarryIntervalWeightedSum
statement:
theorem pbCarryIntervalWeightedSum {p n length : Nat}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (j : ZMod n) (x : Nat → Int) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
        (↑((p : Int) * x k - x (k + 1)) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
          inversePower p n hn (j + (k + 1 : Nat))) =
      (x 0 : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) * inversePower p n hn j -
        (x (length + 1) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
          inversePower p n hn (j + (length + 1 : Nat))
proof:
:= by
  induction length with
  | zero =>
      have hRecurrence := inversePower_succ p n hp hn j
      simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add,
        Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, Nat.cast_one]
      rw [← hRecurrence]
      ring
  | succ length ih =>
      have hRecurrence := inversePower_succ p n hp hn
        (j + (length + 1 : Nat))
      have hIndex : j + (length + 1 : Nat) + 1 =
          j + (length + 2 : Nat) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hIndex] at hRecurrence
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
      simp only [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
      rw [← hRecurrence]
      ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.translationExponent_paCyclicInterval
statement:
theorem translationExponent_paCyclicInterval {p n length : Nat}
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) (j : ZMod n) (hLength : length + 1 < n)
    (v : ZMod n → Int) :
    translationExponent p n hn (fun i ↦
        (↑(paCyclicInterval j length) : Set (ZMod n)).indicator
          (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i * v i) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
        (v (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
          inversePower p n hn (j + (k + 1 : Nat))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  rw [translationExponent]
  simp only [Set.indicator, Int.cast_ite, Int.cast_zero, ite_mul, one_mul,
    zero_mul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun k _ ↦ j + (k + 1 : Nat)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro k hk
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_coe]
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    exact paCyclicInterval_index_injective j hLength ha hb hab
  · intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      Finset.mem_coe] at hi
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi with ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  · intro k hk
    rfl

name: KLSposet.Pinning.paPositiveIntervalWeightedSum
statement:
theorem paPositiveIntervalWeightedSum {p n length : Nat}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (j : ZMod n) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range length,
        (((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
          inversePower p n hn (j + (k + 1 : Nat)))) +
        (p : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
          inversePower p n hn (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) =
      inversePower p n hn j
proof:
:= by
  induction length with
  | zero =>
      simpa using inversePower_succ p n hp hn j
  | succ length ih =>
      have hpCast : ((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) = p - 1 :=
        calc
          ((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) =
              (p : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) - (1 : Nat) := Nat.cast_sub hp
          _ = (p : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) - 1 := by norm_num
      simp_rw [hpCast] at ih ⊢
      have hIndex : j + (length + 1 : Nat) + 1 =
          j + (length + 2 : Nat) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      have hRecurrence := inversePower_succ p n hp hn
        (j + (length + 1 : Nat))
      rw [hIndex] at hRecurrence
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, hRecurrence]
      rw [← ih]
      ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_paTargetIntervalWeightedSum
statement:
theorem niveauOne_paTargetIntervalWeightedSum {p f length : Nat}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (hInterior : ∀ k, k < length →
      sigma'.u (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) = p - 1)
    (hEndpoint : sigma'.u (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = p) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range length,
        (sigma'.u (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (j + (k + 1 : Nat))) +
        (sigma'.u (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) =
      inversePower p f hf j
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range length,
          (((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
            inversePower p f hf (j + (k + 1 : Nat)))) +
          (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
            inversePower p f hf (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) := by
      congr 1
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k hk
        rw [hInterior k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)]
      · rw [hEndpoint]
    _ = inversePower p f hf j :=
      paPositiveIntervalWeightedSum hp hf j

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOneProfileSum_paCyclicInterval_eq_inversePower
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_paCyclicInterval_eq_inversePower
    {p f length : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hInterior : ∀ k, k < length →
      sigma'.u (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) = p - 1)
    (hEndpoint : sigma'.u (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = p) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma'
        (↑(paCyclicInterval j length) : Set (ZMod f)) =
      inversePower p f hf j
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum_paCyclicInterval hf sigma' j hLength,
    Finset.sum_range_succ]
  exact niveauOne_paTargetIntervalWeightedSum hp hf sigma' j hInterior hEndpoint

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_paTargetIntervalWeightedSum
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_paTargetIntervalWeightedSum {p f length : Nat}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hInterior : ∀ k, k < length →
      sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) = p - 1)
    (hEndpoint : sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) = p) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range length,
        (sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) :
            ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat))) +
        (sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) :
            ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) =
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range length,
          (((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)))) +
          (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf
              (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) := by
      congr 1
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k hk
        rw [hInterior k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)]
      · rw [hEndpoint]
    _ = niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a := by
      simpa only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent] using
        paPositiveIntervalWeightedSum hp (by omega : 2 ≤ 2 * f) a

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_paCyclicInterval
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_paCyclicInterval {p f length : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hLength : length + 1 < f) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma
        (↑(paCyclicInterval a length) : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
        (sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) :
            ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  rw [niveauTwoProfileSum]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun k _ ↦ a + (k + 1 : Nat)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro k hk
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_coe]
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  · intro k hk l hl hkl
    exact paCyclicInterval_index_injective a (by omega) hk hl hkl
  · intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_coe] at hi
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi with ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
  · intro k hk
    rfl

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_paCyclicInterval_eq_fundamentalExponent
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_paCyclicInterval_eq_fundamentalExponent
    {p f length : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hInterior : ∀ k, k < length →
      sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) = p - 1)
    (hEndpoint : sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) = p) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma'
        (↑(paCyclicInterval a length) : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) =
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauTwoProfileSum_paCyclicInterval hf sigma' a hLength,
    Finset.sum_range_succ]
  exact niveauTwo_paTargetIntervalWeightedSum hp hf sigma' a hInterior hEndpoint

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_of_subset
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_of_subset {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (K T : Set (ZMod f)) (hTK : T ⊆ K) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff K T) =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma K - niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma T
proof:
:= by
  rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
    ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
    ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator, ← translationExponent_sub]
  apply congrArg (translationExponent p f hf)
  funext i
  by_cases hiT : i ∈ T
  · have hiK : i ∈ K := hTK hiT
    simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
      Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT, hiK]
  · by_cases hiK : i ∈ K <;>
      simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT, hiK]

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_of_disjoint {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (K T : Set (ZMod f))
    (hDisjoint : Disjoint K T) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff K T) =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma K + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma T
proof:
:= by
  rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
    ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
    ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator, ← translationExponent_add]
  apply congrArg (translationExponent p f hf)
  funext i
  by_cases hiT : i ∈ T
  · have hiK : i ∉ K := fun h ↦ Set.disjoint_left.mp hDisjoint h hiT
    simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
      Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT, hiK]
  · by_cases hiK : i ∈ K <;>
      simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT, hiK]

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_eq_add_signed
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_eq_add_signed {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (K T : Set (ZMod f)) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff K T) =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma K +
        translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne T).indicator i : Int) *
            (Profile.niveauOne K).sign i * (sigma.u i : Int))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
    ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator, ← translationExponent_add]
  apply congrArg (translationExponent p f hf)
  funext i
  by_cases hiT : i ∈ T <;> by_cases hiK : i ∈ K <;>
    simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
      Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT, hiK]

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_pbSingletonToggle
statement:
theorem niveauOne_pbSingletonToggle {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (K : Set (ZMod f)) (j : ZMod f)
    (hj : j ∉ K) (hu : sigma'.u j = 1) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' (symmDiff K {j}) =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' K + inversePower p f hf j
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_eq_add_signed]
  have hfun :
      (fun i : ZMod f ↦
        ((Profile.niveauOne ({j} : Set (ZMod f))).indicator i : Int) *
          (Profile.niveauOne K).sign i * (sigma'.u i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then 1 else 0) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        hj, hu]
    · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hij]
  rw [hfun, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
  norm_num

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_symmDiff_of_subset
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_symmDiff_of_subset {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)

    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff K T) =
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma K - niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  rw [niveauTwoProfileSum, niveauTwoProfileSum, niveauTwoProfileSum]

  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _hi
  by_cases hiT : i ∈ T
  · have hiK : i ∈ K := hTK hiT
    simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT, hiK]
  · by_cases hiK : i ∈ K <;>

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_symmDiff_of_disjoint
statement:

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_symmDiff_eq_add_signed
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_symmDiff_eq_add_signed {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (K T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff K T) =
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma K +
        translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
          T.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
            (Profile.niveauTwo K hK).sign i *
              (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  rw [niveauTwoProfileSum, niveauTwoProfileSum, translationExponent]
  simp only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent, Finset.sum_filter,
    ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _hi
  by_cases hiT : i ∈ T <;> by_cases hiK : i ∈ K <;>
    simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
      Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT, hiK]

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSymmDiff_paCyclicInterval_of_subset
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSymmDiff_paCyclicInterval_of_subset
    {p f length : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K)
    (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hInterior : ∀ k, k < length →
      sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) = p - 1)
    (hEndpoint : sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) = p)
    (hSubset : (↑(paCyclicInterval a length) : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) ⊆ K) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma'
        (symmDiff K (periodicIndexSet hf
          (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf a) length) : Set (ZMod f)))) =
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K -
        (1 - (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a
proof:
:= by
  let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := ↑(paCyclicInterval a length)
  let Tf : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    ↑(paCyclicInterval (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) length)
  change T ⊆ K at hSubset
  have hPeriodic : periodicIndexSet hf
        (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf a) length) : Set (ZMod f)) =
      T ∪ Tf := by
    simpa only [T, Tf] using periodicIndexSet_paCyclicInterval hf a
  rw [hPeriodic]
  have hTTf : Disjoint T Tf := by
    simpa only [T, Tf] using paCyclicInterval_disjoint_add_half a hLength
  have hShift : ∀ i, i ∈ Tf ↔ i + f ∈ T := by
    intro i
    simpa only [T, Tf] using mem_paCyclicInterval_add_half_iff a i
  have hKDisjointTf : Disjoint K Tf := by
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro i hiK hiTf
    have hiKHalf : i + f ∈ K := hSubset ((hShift i).mp hiTf)
    exact (hComplementary i).mp hiK hiKHalf
  have hAfterDisjointTf : Disjoint (symmDiff K T) Tf := by
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro i hiSymm hiTf
    have hiNotK : i ∉ K := fun hiK ↦
      Set.disjoint_left.mp hKDisjointTf hiK hiTf
    have hiNotT : i ∉ T := fun hiT ↦
      Set.disjoint_left.mp hTTf hiT hiTf
    simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hiNotK, hiNotT] at hiSymm
  have hSymm : symmDiff K (T ∪ Tf) = symmDiff (symmDiff K T) Tf := by
    ext i
    by_cases hiT : i ∈ T
    · have hiTf : i ∉ Tf := fun h ↦ Set.disjoint_left.mp hTTf hiT h
      simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT, hiTf]
    · by_cases hiTf : i ∈ Tf <;>
        simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT, hiTf]
  rw [hSymm,
    niveauTwoProfileSum_symmDiff_of_disjoint hf sigma' (symmDiff K T) Tf
      hAfterDisjointTf,
    niveauTwoProfileSum_symmDiff_of_subset hf sigma' K T hSubset]
  have hHalfPeriodicU (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
      sigma'.periodicU hf (i + f) = sigma'.periodicU hf i := by
    simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU]
    rw [periodicIndex_add_half]
  have hInteriorHalf : ∀ k, k < length →
      sigma'.periodicU hf
          (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (k + 1 : Nat)) = p - 1 := by
    intro k hk
    have hIndex : a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (k + 1 : Nat) =
        a + (k + 1 : Nat) + f := by
      push_cast
      ring
    calc
      sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (k + 1 : Nat)) =
          sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat) + f) := by rw [hIndex]
      _ = sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) :=
        hHalfPeriodicU (a + (k + 1 : Nat))
      _ = p - 1 := hInterior k hk
  have hEndpointHalf : sigma'.periodicU hf
      (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (length + 1 : Nat)) = p := by
    have hIndex : a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (length + 1 : Nat) =
        a + (length + 1 : Nat) + f := by
      push_cast
      ring
    calc
      sigma'.periodicU hf
          (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (length + 1 : Nat)) =
          sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat) + f) := by
            rw [hIndex]
      _ = sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) :=
        hHalfPeriodicU (a + (length + 1 : Nat))
      _ = p := hEndpoint
  have hSumT : niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' T =
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a := by
    simpa only [T] using
      niveauTwoProfileSum_paCyclicInterval_eq_fundamentalExponent
        hp hf sigma' a hLength hInterior hEndpoint
  have hSumTf : niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' Tf =
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf
        (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
    simpa only [Tf] using
      niveauTwoProfileSum_paCyclicInterval_eq_fundamentalExponent hp hf sigma'
        (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) hLength hInteriorHalf hEndpointHalf
  have hTwiceHalf : a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (f : Nat) = a := by
    calc
      a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (f : Nat) = a + (2 * f : Nat) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      _ = a := by simp
  have hHalfExponent :
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) =
        (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a := by
    have hRecurrence := niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_nat p f hp hf
      (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) f
    rw [hTwiceHalf] at hRecurrence
    exact hRecurrence.symm
  rw [hSumT, hSumTf, hHalfExponent]
  ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSymmDiff_paCyclicInterval_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSymmDiff_paCyclicInterval_of_disjoint
    {p f length : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K)
    (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hInterior : ∀ k, k < length →
      sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) = p - 1)
    (hEndpoint : sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) = p)
    (hDisjoint : Disjoint K
      (↑(paCyclicInterval a length) : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma'
        (symmDiff K (periodicIndexSet hf
          (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf a) length) : Set (ZMod f)))) =
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K +
        (1 - (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a
proof:
:= by
  let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := ↑(paCyclicInterval a length)
  let Tf : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    ↑(paCyclicInterval (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) length)
  change Disjoint K T at hDisjoint
  have hPeriodic : periodicIndexSet hf
        (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf a) length) : Set (ZMod f)) =
      T ∪ Tf := by
    simpa only [T, Tf] using periodicIndexSet_paCyclicInterval hf a
  rw [hPeriodic]
  have hTTf : Disjoint T Tf := by
    simpa only [T, Tf] using paCyclicInterval_disjoint_add_half a hLength
  have hShift : ∀ i, i ∈ Tf ↔ i + f ∈ T := by
    intro i
    simpa only [T, Tf] using mem_paCyclicInterval_add_half_iff a i
  have hTfSubsetK : Tf ⊆ K := by
    intro i hiTf
    have hiTHalf : i + f ∈ T := (hShift i).mp hiTf
    have hiNotKHalf : i + f ∉ K := fun hiKHalf ↦
      Set.disjoint_left.mp hDisjoint hiKHalf hiTHalf
    exact (hComplementary i).mpr hiNotKHalf
  have hTfSubsetAfter : Tf ⊆ symmDiff K T := by
    intro i hiTf
    have hiK : i ∈ K := hTfSubsetK hiTf
    have hiNotT : i ∉ T := fun hiT ↦ Set.disjoint_left.mp hTTf hiT hiTf
    simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hiK, hiNotT]
  have hSymm : symmDiff K (T ∪ Tf) = symmDiff (symmDiff K T) Tf := by
    ext i
    by_cases hiT : i ∈ T
    · have hiTf : i ∉ Tf := fun h ↦ Set.disjoint_left.mp hTTf hiT h
      simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT, hiTf]
    · by_cases hiTf : i ∈ Tf <;>
        simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT, hiTf]
  rw [hSymm,
    niveauTwoProfileSum_symmDiff_of_subset hf sigma' (symmDiff K T) Tf
      hTfSubsetAfter,
    niveauTwoProfileSum_symmDiff_of_disjoint hf sigma' K T hDisjoint]
  have hHalfPeriodicU (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
      sigma'.periodicU hf (i + f) = sigma'.periodicU hf i := by
    simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU]
    rw [periodicIndex_add_half]
  have hInteriorHalf : ∀ k, k < length →
      sigma'.periodicU hf
          (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (k + 1 : Nat)) = p - 1 := by
    intro k hk
    have hIndex : a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (k + 1 : Nat) =
        a + (k + 1 : Nat) + f := by
      push_cast
      ring
    calc
      sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (k + 1 : Nat)) =
          sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat) + f) := by rw [hIndex]
      _ = sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) :=
        hHalfPeriodicU (a + (k + 1 : Nat))
      _ = p - 1 := hInterior k hk
  have hEndpointHalf : sigma'.periodicU hf
      (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (length + 1 : Nat)) = p := by
    have hIndex : a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (length + 1 : Nat) =
        a + (length + 1 : Nat) + f := by
      push_cast
      ring
    calc
      sigma'.periodicU hf
          (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (length + 1 : Nat)) =
          sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat) + f) := by rw [hIndex]
      _ = sigma'.periodicU hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) :=
        hHalfPeriodicU (a + (length + 1 : Nat))
      _ = p := hEndpoint
  have hSumT : niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' T =
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a := by
    simpa only [T] using
      niveauTwoProfileSum_paCyclicInterval_eq_fundamentalExponent
        hp hf sigma' a hLength hInterior hEndpoint
  have hSumTf : niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' Tf =
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf
        (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
    simpa only [Tf] using
      niveauTwoProfileSum_paCyclicInterval_eq_fundamentalExponent hp hf sigma'
        (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) hLength hInteriorHalf hEndpointHalf
  have hTwiceHalf : a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (f : Nat) = a := by
    calc
      a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (f : Nat) = a + (2 * f : Nat) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      _ = a := by simp
  have hHalfExponent :
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) =
        (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a := by
    have hRecurrence := niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_nat p f hp hf
      (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) f
    rw [hTwiceHalf] at hRecurrence
    exact hRecurrence.symm
  rw [hSumT, hSumTf, hHalfExponent]
  ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_paCyclicInterval_of_subset
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_paCyclicInterval_of_subset
    {p f length : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (K : Set (ZMod f))
    (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hInterior : ∀ k, k < length →
      sigma'.u (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) = p - 1)
    (hEndpoint : sigma'.u (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = p)
    (hSubset : (↑(paCyclicInterval j length) : Set (ZMod f)) ⊆ K) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma'
        (symmDiff K (↑(paCyclicInterval j length) : Set (ZMod f))) =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' K - inversePower p f hf j
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_of_subset hf sigma' K _ hSubset,
    niveauOneProfileSum_paCyclicInterval_eq_inversePower
      hp hf sigma' j hLength hInterior hEndpoint]

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_paAlternative
statement:
theorem niveauOne_paAlternative
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hi : i ∈ J) :
    (pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) = 0 ∧
        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i = 0) ∨
      (sigma.u i : Int) =
        (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) -
          pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i
proof:
:= by
  have hAlternative :=
    (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J hJ i).1 hi
  rcases pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ with
    hBounds | hExceptional
  · rcases hAlternative with hHomogeneous | hDifference
    · left
      exact boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
        (hBounds.1 (i - 1)) (hBounds.1 i) hHomogeneous
    · exact Or.inr hDifference
  · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)
