name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_paStartDifference
statement:
theorem niveauOne_paStartDifference
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hi : i ∈ J)
    (hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = 1)
    (hCarryAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ i = 1)
    (hu : 1 < sigma.u i) :
    sigma.u i = p ∧
      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hSumAt : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i = 1 := by
    simp [pairedCarrySum, sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBaseAt, hCarryAt]
  have hDifferenceAt :
      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i = 0 := by
    simp [pairedCarryDifference, sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBaseAt, hCarryAt]
  rcases pin.niveauOne_paAlternative hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty J hJ i hi with
    hHomogeneous | hDifference
  · rw [hSumAt] at hHomogeneous
    omega
  · rw [hDifferenceAt, sub_zero] at hDifference
    let d := pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1)
    have hpNonnegative : (0 : Int) ≤ p := by omega
    have huPositive : (0 : Int) < sigma.u i := by omega
    have huUpper : (sigma.u i : Int) ≤ p := by
      exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le i
    have hdPositive : (0 : Int) < d := by
      dsimp only [d]
      nlinarith
    have hdOne : d = 1 := by
      have hdAtLeast : (1 : Int) ≤ d := by omega
      have hdAtMost : d ≤ 1 := by
        by_contra hd
        have hdTwo : (2 : Int) ≤ d := by omega
        have hMul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdTwo hpNonnegative
        dsimp only [d] at hMul
        nlinarith
      omega
    have huEq : (sigma.u i : Int) = p := by
      simpa only [d, hdOne, mul_one] using hDifference
    exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast huEq, hdOne⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_paStartDifference
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_paStartDifference
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')

    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) (hi : i ∈ J)
    (hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf i) = 1)
    (hCarryAt : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ i = 1)
    (hu : 1 < sigma.periodicU hf i) :
    sigma.periodicU hf i = p ∧
      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
        (i - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hSumAt :
      pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i = 1 := by
    simp [pairedCarrySum, sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBaseAt, hCarryAt]

      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i = 0 := by
    simp [pairedCarryDifference, sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBaseAt, hCarryAt]
  rcases pin.niveauTwo_paAlternative hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty J hComplementary
      hJ i hi with hHomogeneous | hDifference

    omega
  · rw [hDifferenceAt, sub_zero] at hDifference
    let d := pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
      (i - 1)
    have hpNonnegative : (0 : Int) ≤ p := by omega

      exact_mod_cast sigma.u_le (periodicIndex hf i)
    have hdPositive : (0 : Int) < d := by
      dsimp only [d]
      nlinarith
    have hdOne : d = 1 := by
      have hdAtLeast : (1 : Int) ≤ d := by omega
      have hdAtMost : d ≤ 1 := by
        by_contra hd
        have hdTwo : (2 : Int) ≤ d := by omega
        have hMul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdTwo hpNonnegative
        dsimp only [d] at hMul
        nlinarith
      omega
    have huEq : (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) = p := by
      simpa only [d, hdOne, mul_one] using hDifference
    exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast huEq, hdOne⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_paStartNegativePredecessor
statement:
theorem niveauOne_paStartNegativePredecessor
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hi : i ∈ J)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) = -1)
    (hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = 1)
    (hCarryAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ i = 1)
    (hu : 1 < sigma.u i) :
    sigma.u i = p ∧ i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ ∧ sigma'.u i = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases pin.niveauOne_paStartDifference hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty J hJ i hi
      hBaseAt hCarryAt hu with ⟨huEq, hDifferencePrev⟩
  have hDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
    (i - 1)
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hDifferencePrev, hBasePrev] at hDouble
  have hCarryPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (i - 1) = 1 := by omega
  have hEquation := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec J hJ i
  by_cases hTarget : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
  · simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
      Profile.set, hi, hTarget, huEq, hCarryPrev, hCarryAt] at hEquation
    exact ⟨huEq, hTarget, by omega⟩
  · simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
      Profile.set, hi, hTarget, huEq, hCarryPrev, hCarryAt] at hEquation
    have hu' : (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.u i := by omega
    omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_paModifiedProfileTargetOmission
statement:
theorem niveauOne_paModifiedProfileTargetOmission
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hi : i ∈ J)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) = 0)
    (hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = 1)
    (hCarryAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ i = 1)
    (hu : 1 < sigma.u i)
    (hJMinus : Profile.niveauOne (symmDiff J {i}) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    i ∉ pin.niveauOneTarget (symmDiff J {i}) hJMinus
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : Fact (1 < f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hiMinus : i ∉ symmDiff J {i} := by
    simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hi]
  rcases pin.niveauOne_paStartZeroPredecessor hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty J hJ i
      hi hBasePrev hBaseAt hCarryAt hu with ⟨huEq, _hiTarget, huTarget⟩
  have hDifferencePrev :=
    (pin.niveauOne_paStartDifference hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty J hJ i hi
      hBaseAt hCarryAt hu).2
  have hDoubleJ := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
    (i - 1)
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hDifferencePrev, hBasePrev] at hDoubleJ
  have hCarryJPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (i - 1) = 2 := by omega
  by_contra hiTargetMinus
  have hEquation := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec (symmDiff J {i}) hJMinus i
  have hCarryBound : ∀ k,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry (symmDiff J {i}) hJMinus k| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 (symmDiff J {i})
        hJMinus with hBound | hExceptional
    · exact hBound
    · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)
  have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty
    (.niveauOne (symmDiff J {i})) hJMinus (i - 1)
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBasePrev, sub_zero] at hParity
  have hPrevRange := abs_le.mp (hCarryBound (i - 1))
  have hAtRange := abs_le.mp (hCarryBound i)
  simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
    Profile.set, hiMinus, hiTargetMinus, huEq, huTarget] at hEquation
  have hCarryMinusPrev :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry (symmDiff J {i}) hJMinus (i - 1) = -2 := by
    rcases hParity with ⟨k, hk⟩
    rcases hPrevRange with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
    rcases hAtRange with ⟨hAtLower, hAtUpper⟩
    interval_cases hPrev :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry (symmDiff J {i}) hJMinus (i - 1) <;>
      interval_cases hAt :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry (symmDiff J {i}) hJMinus i <;> omega
  let liftPrev : ZMod (2 * f) := ((i - 1).val : Nat)
  have hPeriodicLift : periodicIndex hf liftPrev = i - 1 := by
    dsimp only [liftPrev]
    rw [periodicIndex_natCast hf (i - 1).val (i - 1).val_lt]
    exact ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (i - 1)
  have hTwo := pin.signedPinnedCarries_atMostTwo hp3 hpOdd
    (.niveauOne ∅) (.niveauOne (symmDiff J {i})) (.niveauOne J)
    hEmpty hJMinus hJ liftPrev
  have hPredNe : i - 1 ≠ i := by
    intro hPredEq
    have hOneZero : (1 : ZMod f) = 0 := by
      calc
        1 = i - (i - 1) := by ring
        _ = i - i := by rw [hPredEq]
        _ = 0 := sub_self i
    have hVal := congrArg ZMod.val hOneZero
    simp at hVal
  by_cases hPrevJ : i - 1 ∈ J
  · have hPrevMinus : i - 1 ∈ symmDiff J {i} := by
      simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hPrevJ, hPredNe]
    simp [signedPinnedCarryAt, hPeriodicLift, hBasePrev, hCarryMinusPrev,
      hCarryJPrev, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
      Profile.set, hPrevJ, hPrevMinus] at hTwo
  · have hPrevMinus : i - 1 ∉ symmDiff J {i} := by
      simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hPrevJ, hPredNe]
    simp [signedPinnedCarryAt, hPeriodicLift, hBasePrev, hCarryMinusPrev,
      hCarryJPrev, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
      Profile.set, hPrevJ, hPrevMinus] at hTwo

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_paModifiedProfileTargetOmission
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_paModifiedProfileTargetOmission
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ k, k ∈ J ↔ k + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) (hi : i ∈ J)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (i - 1)) = 0)
    (hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf i) = 1)
    (hCarryAt : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ i = 1)
    (hu : 1 < sigma.periodicU hf i)
    (hMinusComplementary : ∀ k,
      k ∈ symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf i}) ↔
        k + f ∉ symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf i}))
    (hJMinus : Profile.niveauTwo
        (symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf i}))
        hMinusComplementary ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma') :
    i ∉ pin.niveauTwoTarget
      (symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf i}))
      hMinusComplementary hJMinus
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : Fact (1 < f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  let JMinus : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf i})
  have hiPeriodic : i ∈ periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf i} := by
    simp [periodicIndexSet]
  have hiMinus : i ∉ JMinus := by
    simp [JMinus, Set.mem_symmDiff, hi, hiPeriodic]
  rcases pin.niveauTwo_paStartZeroPredecessor hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty J
      hComplementary hJ i hi hBasePrev hBaseAt hCarryAt hu with
    ⟨huEq, _hiTarget, huTarget⟩
  have hDifferencePrev :=
    (pin.niveauTwo_paStartDifference hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty J hComplementary
      hJ i hi hBaseAt hCarryAt hu).2
  have hDoubleJ := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
    (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1)
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hDifferencePrev, hBasePrev] at hDoubleJ
  have hCarryJPrev :
      pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (i - 1) = 2 := by omega
  by_contra hiTargetMinus
  have hEquation := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec JMinus hMinusComplementary
    hJMinus i
  have hCarryBound : ∀ k,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus k| ≤ 2 :=
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
  have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty
    (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus (i - 1)
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBasePrev, sub_zero] at hParity
  have hPrevRange := abs_le.mp (hCarryBound (i - 1))
  have hAtRange := abs_le.mp (hCarryBound i)
  simp [niveauTwoCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
    Profile.set, JMinus, hiMinus, hiTargetMinus, huEq, huTarget] at hEquation
  have hCarryMinusPrev :
      pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus (i - 1) = -2 := by
    rcases hParity with ⟨k, hk⟩
    rcases hPrevRange with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
    rcases hAtRange with ⟨hAtLower, hAtUpper⟩
    interval_cases hPrev :
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus (i - 1) <;>
      interval_cases hAt :
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus i <;> omega
  have hTwo := pin.signedPinnedCarries_atMostTwo hp3 hpOdd
    (.niveauOne ∅) (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary)
    (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hEmpty hJMinus hJ (i - 1)
  have hPeriodicPred : periodicIndex hf (i - 1) = periodicIndex hf i - 1 :=
    periodicIndex_sub_one hf i
  have hBasePrev' : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf i - 1) = 0 := by
    rw [← hPeriodicPred]
    exact hBasePrev
  have hPredPeriodicNe : periodicIndex hf (i - 1) ≠ periodicIndex hf i := by
    rw [hPeriodicPred]
    intro hPredEq
    have hOneZero : (1 : ZMod f) = 0 := by
      calc
        1 = periodicIndex hf i - (periodicIndex hf i - 1) := by ring
        _ = periodicIndex hf i - periodicIndex hf i := by rw [hPredEq]
        _ = 0 := sub_self _
    have hVal := congrArg ZMod.val hOneZero
    simp at hVal
  have hPrevNotPeriodic :
      i - 1 ∉ periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf i} := by
    simp [periodicIndexSet, hPredPeriodicNe]
  by_cases hPrevJ : i - 1 ∈ J
  · have hPrevMinus : i - 1 ∈ JMinus := by
      simp [JMinus, Set.mem_symmDiff, hPrevJ, hPrevNotPeriodic]
    simp [signedPinnedCarryAt, hPeriodicPred, hBasePrev', hCarryMinusPrev,
      hCarryJPrev, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
      Profile.set, hPrevJ, hPrevMinus] at hTwo
  · have hPrevMinus : i - 1 ∉ JMinus := by
      simp [JMinus, Set.mem_symmDiff, hPrevJ, hPrevNotPeriodic]
    simp [signedPinnedCarryAt, hPeriodicPred, hBasePrev', hCarryMinusPrev,
      hCarryJPrev, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
      Profile.set, hPrevJ, hPrevMinus] at hTwo

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOneProfileSum_mu_of_mem_not_mem
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_mu_of_mem_not_mem
    {p f : Nat} (_hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.MuValid j)
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∉ J) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) J =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J - inversePower p f hf j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
    ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hpos : 1 ≤ sigma.u j := by
    have := valid.1
    omega
  have hfun :
      (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
        (((sigma.mu hf j valid).u i : Nat) : Int)) =
      (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
        (sigma.u i : Int)) +
      (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then -1 else 0) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp only [PhantomWeight.mu, if_pos, Pi.add_apply]
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hpos, Nat.cast_one]
      simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hj]
      ring
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp [PhantomWeight.mu, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hsucc, hj1, valid.2]
      · simp [PhantomWeight.mu, hij, hij1]
  rw [hfun, translationExponent_add,
    PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
  norm_num
  ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_paModifiedProfileExponentIdentity
statement:
theorem niveauOne_paModifiedProfileExponentIdentity
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.MuValid j) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∉ J)
    (hJMinus : Profile.niveauOne (symmDiff J {j}) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hTargetOmit : j ∉ pin.niveauOneTarget (symmDiff J {j}) hJMinus)
    (hu : sigma.u j = p) (huTarget : sigma'.u j = p - 1) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) (.niveauOne J) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma'
        (.niveauOne (symmDiff
          (pin.niveauOneTarget (symmDiff J {j}) hJMinus) {j}))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let JMinus : Set (ZMod f) := symmDiff J {j}
  let KMinus : Set (ZMod f) := pin.niveauOneTarget JMinus hJMinus
  have hPair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne JMinus) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne KMinus) := by
    rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec JMinus hJMinus]
    exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus
  have hCongr := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' JMinus KMinus hPair
  have hSourceSubset : ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) ⊆ J := by
    simpa using hj
  have hSourceToggle : niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma JMinus =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J - niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j} := by
    simpa only [JMinus] using
      niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_of_subset hf sigma J {j} hSourceSubset
  have hTargetDisjoint : Disjoint KMinus ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) := by
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro i hiK hij
    subst i
    apply hTargetOmit
    simpa only [KMinus, JMinus] using hiK
  have hTargetToggle :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' (symmDiff KMinus {j}) =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' KMinus +
          niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' {j} :=
    niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_of_disjoint hf sigma' KMinus {j}
      hTargetDisjoint
  have hSourceSingle : niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma {j} =
      (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf j := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne {j}).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.u i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then (p : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hu]
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hij]
    rw [hfun, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num
  have hTargetSingle : niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' {j} =
      ((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf j := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne {j}).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma'.u i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huTarget]
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hij]
    rw [hfun, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num
  have hpCast : ((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) =
      (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)]
    norm_num
  have hMu := niveauOneProfileSum_mu_of_mem_not_mem
    (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) hf sigma j valid J hj hj1
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
  change sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) J =
    sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' (symmDiff KMinus {j})
  rw [hSourceToggle, hSourceSingle] at hCongr
  rw [hMu, hTargetToggle, hTargetSingle, hpCast]
  linear_combination hCongr

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSingletonToggle_of_mem
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSingletonToggle_of_mem
    {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K)
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (ha : a ∈ K) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma
        (symmDiff K (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a})) =
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma K -
        (sigma.periodicU hf a : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a +
        (sigma.periodicU hf a : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a}
  have hTPeriodic (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i ∈ T ↔ i + f ∈ T := by
    simp [T, periodicIndexSet, periodicIndex_add_half]
  have hToggle : ∀ i, i ∈ symmDiff K T ↔ i + f ∉ symmDiff K T := by
    intro i
    simp only [Set.mem_symmDiff]
    have hKi := hK i
    have hTi := hTPeriodic i
    tauto
  have hhalf : (f : ZMod (2 * f)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hdiv : 2 * f ∣ f :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff f (2 * f)).mp hzero
    have hle : 2 * f ≤ f := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdiv
    omega
  have hhalfSelf (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i + f ≠ i := by
    intro h
    apply hhalf
    calc
      (f : ZMod (2 * f)) = (i + f) - i := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have haHalf : a + f ∉ K := (hK a).mp ha
  rw [← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf sigma
      (symmDiff K T) hToggle,
    ← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf sigma K hK]
  have hfun :
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        ((Profile.niveauTwo (symmDiff K T) hToggle).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) =
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        ((Profile.niveauTwo K hK).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) +
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        if i = a then -(sigma.periodicU hf a : Int) else 0) +
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        if i = a + f then (sigma.periodicU hf a : Int) else 0) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hia : i = a
    · subst i
      simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        Set.mem_symmDiff, T, periodicIndexSet_singleton, ha,
        Ne.symm (hhalfSelf a)]
    · by_cases hiaf : i = a + f
      · subst i
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
          Set.mem_symmDiff, T, periodicIndexSet_singleton, haHalf,
          PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_add_half, hia]
      · have hiT : i ∉ T := by
          dsimp only [T]
          rw [periodicIndexSet_singleton hf a]
          simp [hia, hiaf]
        have hiff : i ∈ symmDiff K T ↔ i ∈ K := by
          simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT]
        simp only [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set]
        by_cases hiK : i ∈ K
        · have hiToggle := hiff.mpr hiK
          simp [hiK, hiToggle, hia, hiaf]
        · have hiToggle : i ∉ symmDiff K T := fun h ↦ hiK (hiff.mp h)
          simp [hiK, hiToggle, hia, hiaf]
  rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, translationExponent_add,
    PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single,
    PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
  norm_num only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]
  simp only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent]
  ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_pbPeriodicSingletonToggle
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_pbPeriodicSingletonToggle
    {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K)
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (ha : a ∉ K) (hu : sigma'.periodicU hf a = 1) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma'
        (symmDiff K (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a})) =
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K +
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a -
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + f)
proof:
:= by
  have hDouble : a + f + f = a := by
    calc
      a + f + f = a + (2 * f : Nat) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      _ = a := by simp
  have haHalf : a + f ∈ K := by
    apply (hK (a + f)).2
    simpa only [hDouble] using ha
  have huHalf : sigma'.periodicU hf (a + f) = 1 := by
    rw [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_add_half]
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hu
  have hToggle := niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSingletonToggle_of_mem hf sigma'
    K hK (a + f) haHalf
  rw [periodicIndex_add_half, huHalf, hDouble] at hToggle
  norm_num at hToggle ⊢
  linear_combination hToggle

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwoProfileSum_mu_of_mem_not_mem
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_mu_of_mem_not_mem
    {p f : Nat} (_hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (valid : sigma.MuValid (periodicIndex hf a))
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (ha : a ∈ J) (ha1 : a + 1 ∉ J) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf
        (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J =
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J -
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a +
        (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1 + f)
proof:
:= by
  have hperiodicSucc :
      periodicIndex hf (a + 1) = periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_one]
  have hsucc : periodicIndex hf a + 1 ≠ periodicIndex hf a := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (periodicIndex hf a + 1) - periodicIndex hf a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have honeDouble : (1 : ZMod (2 * f)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
    omega
  have hsuccDouble : a + 1 ≠ a := by
    intro h
    apply honeDouble
    calc
      (1 : ZMod (2 * f)) = (a + 1) - a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have haHalf : a + f ∉ J := (hJ a).mp ha
  have ha1Half : a + 1 + f ∈ J := by
    by_contra h
    exact ha1 ((hJ (a + 1)).mpr h)
  have hhalf : (f : ZMod (2 * f)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hdiv : 2 * f ∣ f :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff f (2 * f)).mp hzero
    have hle : 2 * f ≤ f := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdiv
    omega
  have hhalfSelf (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i + f ≠ i := by
    intro h
    apply hhalf
    calc
      (f : ZMod (2 * f)) = (i + f) - i := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have haNeSuccHalf : a ≠ a + 1 + f := by
    intro h
    apply hsucc
    calc
      periodicIndex hf a + 1 = periodicIndex hf (a + 1) :=
        hperiodicSucc.symm
      _ = periodicIndex hf (a + 1 + f) :=
        (periodicIndex_add_half hf (a + 1)).symm
      _ = periodicIndex hf a := by rw [← h]
  rw [← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf
      (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J hJ,
    ← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf sigma J hJ]
  have hpos : 1 ≤ sigma.u (periodicIndex hf a) := by
    have := valid.1
    omega
  have hfun :
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
          (((sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid).periodicU hf i : Nat) : Int)) =
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) +
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦ if i = a then (-1 : Int) else 0) +
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        if i = a + 1 + f then (p : Int) else 0) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hi : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf a
    · rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i a).mp hi with rfl | rfl
      · simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.mu, if_pos,
          Pi.add_apply]
        rw [Nat.cast_sub hpos, Nat.cast_one]
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, ha,
          haNeSuccHalf]
        ring
      · have hne1 : a + f ≠ a + 1 + f := by
          intro h
          apply hsuccDouble
          calc
            a + 1 = (a + 1 + f) - f := by ring
            _ = (a + f) - f := by rw [h]
            _ = a := by ring
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, haHalf,
          hhalfSelf, hne1]
    · by_cases hi1 : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf (a + 1)
      · rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i (a + 1)).mp hi1 with
          rfl | rfl
        · simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.mu,
            hperiodicSucc, hsucc, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
            Profile.set, ha1, valid.2, hsuccDouble,
            Ne.symm (hhalfSelf (a + 1))]
        · have hne0 : a + 1 + f ≠ a := by
            intro h
            exact haNeSuccHalf h.symm
          simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.mu,
            hi1, hperiodicSucc, hsucc, Profile.indicator,
            Profile.Contains, Profile.set, ha1Half, valid.2, hne0]
      · have hia : i ≠ a := fun h ↦ hi (h ▸ rfl)
        have hia1f : i ≠ a + 1 + f := by
          intro h
          apply hi1
          rw [h, periodicIndex_add_half]
        have hi1' : periodicIndex hf i ≠ periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
          rw [← hperiodicSucc]
          exact hi1
        simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.mu, hi,
          hi1', hia, hia1f]
  rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, translationExponent_add,
    PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single,
    PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
  norm_num only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_natCast]
  simp only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent]
  ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_paModifiedProfileExponentIdentity
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_paModifiedProfileExponentIdentity
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (valid : sigma.MuValid (periodicIndex hf a))
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (ha : a ∈ J) (ha1 : a + 1 ∉ J)
    (hMinusComplementary : ∀ i,
      i ∈ symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a}) ↔
        i + f ∉ symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a}))
    (hJMinus : Profile.niveauTwo
        (symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a}))
        hMinusComplementary ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hTargetOmit : a ∉ pin.niveauTwoTarget
      (symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a}))
      hMinusComplementary hJMinus)
    (hu : sigma.periodicU hf a = p)
    (huTarget : sigma'.periodicU hf a = p - 1) :
    profileLeftExponent hf
        (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid)
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma'
        ((Profile.niveauTwo
          (pin.niveauTwoTarget
            (symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a}))
            hMinusComplementary hJMinus)
          (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary
            (symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a}))
            hMinusComplementary hJMinus)).periodicSymmDiff hf
              {periodicIndex hf a})
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let JMinus : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a})
  let KMinus : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    pin.niveauTwoTarget JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
  let hKMinus : ∀ i, i ∈ KMinus ↔ i + f ∉ KMinus :=
    pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
  have hPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma
          (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma'
          (.niveauTwo KMinus hKMinus) := by
    rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus]
    exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus
  have hCongr := niveauTwoProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' JMinus KMinus hMinusComplementary hKMinus hPair
  have haTargetHalf : a + f ∈ KMinus := by
    by_contra h
    apply hTargetOmit
    change a ∈ KMinus
    exact (hKMinus a).mpr h
  have hSourceToggle :=
    niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSingletonToggle_of_mem hf sigma J
      hComplementary a ha
  change niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma JMinus = _ at hSourceToggle
  have hTargetToggle :=
    niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSingletonToggle_of_mem hf sigma' KMinus
      hKMinus (a + f) haTargetHalf
  have hTwiceHalf : a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + f = a := by
    calc
      a + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + f = a + (2 * f : Nat) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      _ = a := by simp
  have hTargetPeriodic :
      periodicIndex hf (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) = periodicIndex hf a :=
    periodicIndex_add_half hf a
  rw [hTargetPeriodic, hTwiceHalf] at hTargetToggle
  simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hTargetPeriodic] at hTargetToggle
  rw [hu] at hSourceToggle
  have huTargetBase : sigma'.u (periodicIndex hf a) = p - 1 := by
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using huTarget
  rw [huTargetBase] at hTargetToggle
  have hpCast : ((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) =
      (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)]
    norm_num
  rw [hpCast] at hTargetToggle
  have hRecurrence :
      (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1 + f) =
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + f) := by
    have hrec := inversePower_succ p (2 * f) (by omega : 1 ≤ p)
      (by omega) (a + f)
    rw [show a + f + 1 = a + 1 + f by ring] at hrec
    simpa only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent] using hrec
  have hMu := niveauTwoProfileSum_mu_of_mem_not_mem
    (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) hf sigma a valid J hComplementary ha ha1
  rw [hRecurrence] at hMu
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, Profile.periodicSymmDiff,
    CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
  change liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf
        (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J =
    liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t +
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma'
        (symmDiff KMinus (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a}))
  rw [hMu, hTargetToggle]
  linear_combination hCongr - hSourceToggle

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_paCarryEquation
statement:
theorem niveauOne_paCarryEquation
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hu : sigma.u i = 0) :
    (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i *
        (sigma'.u i : Int) =
      (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (i - 1) -
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ i
proof:
:= by
  have hCarry := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec J hJ i
  simp only [niveauOneCarryInput, hu, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero] at hCarry
  exact hCarry

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_paCarryEquation
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_paCarryEquation
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_pbSignedIntervalWeightedSum
statement:
theorem niveauOne_pbSignedIntervalWeightedSum
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f) (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.u (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hStart : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ j = 1)
    (hEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
      (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0) :
    translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦
        (↑(paCyclicInterval j length) : Set (ZMod f)).indicator
          (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
            ((Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i *
              (sigma'.u i : Int))) =
      inversePower p f hf j
proof:
:= by
  rw [translationExponent_paCyclicInterval hf j hLength]
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
        (↑((Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign
            (j + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) *
              (sigma'.u (j + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) : Int)) :
            ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (j + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f))) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
        (↑((p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
              (j + ((k : Nat) : ZMod f)) -
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
              (j + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f))) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (j + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      have hEquation := pin.niveauOne_paCarryEquation J hJ
        (j + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f))
        (hSourceZero k (by
          have hk' := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
          omega))
      have hPred : j + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) - 1 =
          j + ((k : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hPred] at hEquation
      rw [hEquation]
    _ = (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ j : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf j -
        (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
            (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using
        pbCarryIntervalWeightedSum (by omega : 1 ≤ p) hf j
          (fun k ↦ pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + (k : Nat)))
    _ = inversePower p f hf j := by
      rw [hStart, hEnd]
      norm_num

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_pbSignedIntervalWeightedSum_eq_endpoints
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_pbSignedIntervalWeightedSum_eq_endpoints
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (hLength : length + 1 < 2 * f)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0) :
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
        (↑(paCyclicInterval a length) : Set (ZMod (2 * f))).indicator
          (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
            ((Profile.niveauTwo
                (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
                (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign i *
              (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int))) =
      (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a :
          ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a -
        (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
            (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf
            (a + (length + 1 : Nat))
proof:
:= by
  rw [translationExponent_paCyclicInterval (by omega : 2 ≤ 2 * f) a hLength]
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
        (↑((Profile.niveauTwo
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign
            (a + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) *
              (sigma'.periodicU hf
                (a + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) : Int)) :
            ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          inversePower p (2 * f) (by omega)
            (a + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
        (↑((p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
              (a + ((k : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) -
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
              (a + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))) :
            ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          inversePower p (2 * f) (by omega)
            (a + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      have hEquation := pin.niveauTwo_paCarryEquation J hComplementary hJ
        (a + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))
        (hSourceZero k (by
          have hk' := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
          omega))
      have hPred : a + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 =
          a + ((k : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hPred] at hEquation
      rw [hEquation]
    _ = (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a :
            ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          inversePower p (2 * f) (by omega) a -
        (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
            (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          inversePower p (2 * f) (by omega)
            (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using
        pbCarryIntervalWeightedSum (by omega : 1 ≤ p)
          (by omega : 2 ≤ 2 * f) a
          (fun k ↦ pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
            (a + (k : Nat)))
    _ = _ := by simp only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent]

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_pbSignedIntervalWeightedSum
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_pbSignedIntervalWeightedSum
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (hLength : length + 1 < 2 * f)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hStart : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a = 1)
    (hEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
      (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0) :
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
        (↑(paCyclicInterval a length) : Set (ZMod (2 * f))).indicator
          (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
            ((Profile.niveauTwo
                (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
                (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign i *
              (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int))) =
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a
proof:
:= by
  rw [pin.niveauTwo_pbSignedIntervalWeightedSum_eq_endpoints J
    hComplementary hJ a hLength hSourceZero, hStart, hEnd]
  norm_num

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_pbSignedPeriodicIntervalWeightedSum
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_pbSignedPeriodicIntervalWeightedSum
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hStart : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a = 1)
    (hEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
      (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0) :
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
        (periodicIndexSet hf
            (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf a) length) :
              Set (ZMod f))).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
          (Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign i *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)) =
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a -
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
  let hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K :=
    pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ
  let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := ↑(paCyclicInterval a length)
  let Tf : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    ↑(paCyclicInterval (a + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) length)
  have hPeriodic : periodicIndexSet hf
        (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf a) length) : Set (ZMod f)) =
      T ∪ Tf := by
    simpa only [T, Tf] using periodicIndexSet_paCyclicInterval hf a
  have hDisjoint : Disjoint T Tf := by
    simpa only [T, Tf] using paCyclicInterval_disjoint_add_half a hLength
  have hFirst := pin.niveauTwo_pbSignedIntervalWeightedSum J hComplementary
    hJ a (by omega : length + 1 < 2 * f) hSourceZero hStart hEnd
  have hAnti := niveauTwoCarryEquation_antiPeriodic hp hf sigma sigma' J K
    hComplementary hK (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ)
  have hStartHalf : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a + f) = -1 := by
    rw [hAnti a, hStart]
  have hEndHalf : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
      (a + f + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0 := by
    have hIndex : a + f + (length + 1 : Nat) =
        a + (length + 1 : Nat) + f := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hIndex, hAnti (a + (length + 1 : Nat)), hEnd]
    norm_num
  have hSourceZeroHalf : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf (a + f + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    have hIndex : a + f + (k + 1 : Nat) = a + (k + 1 : Nat) + f := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hIndex, PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_add_half]
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hSourceZero k hk
  have hHalf := pin.niveauTwo_pbSignedIntervalWeightedSum_eq_endpoints J
    hComplementary hJ (a + f) (by omega : length + 1 < 2 * f)
    hSourceZeroHalf
  rw [hStartHalf, hEndHalf] at hHalf
  norm_num at hHalf
  have hfun :
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        ((T ∪ Tf).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i) *
          (Profile.niveauTwo K hK).sign i *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          T.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
            ((Profile.niveauTwo K hK).sign i *
              (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int))) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          Tf.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
            ((Profile.niveauTwo K hK).sign i *
              (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int))) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hiT : i ∈ T
    · have hiTf : i ∉ Tf := fun hi ↦ Set.disjoint_left.mp hDisjoint hiT hi
      simp [Set.indicator, hiT, hiTf]
    · by_cases hiTf : i ∈ Tf <;> simp [Set.indicator, hiT, hiTf]
  rw [hPeriodic, hfun, translationExponent_add]
  change _ = _ at hFirst hHalf ⊢
  rw [hFirst, hHalf]
  ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_paInteriorTargetCoordinate
statement:
theorem niveauOne_paInteriorTargetCoordinate
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hu : sigma.u i = 0)
    (hxPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (i - 1) = 1)
    (hx : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ i = 1) :
    (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i = 1 ∧
      sigma'.u i = p - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hEquation := pin.niveauOne_paCarryEquation J hJ i hu
  rw [hxPrev, hx] at hEquation
  by_cases hi : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
  · simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
      at hEquation
    omega
  · simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
      at hEquation ⊢
    omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_paInteriorTargetCoordinate
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_paInteriorTargetCoordinate
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) (hu : sigma.periodicU hf i = 0)
    (hxPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (i - 1) = 1)
    (hx : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ i = 1) :
    (Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
          (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign i = 1 ∧
      sigma'.periodicU hf i = p - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hEquation := pin.niveauTwo_paCarryEquation J hComplementary hJ i hu
  rw [hxPrev, hx] at hEquation
  by_cases hi : i ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
  · simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
      at hEquation
    omega
  · simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
      at hEquation ⊢
    omega

statement:

    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_paPositiveStringDichotomy
statement:
theorem niveauOne_paPositiveStringDichotomy
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f) (length : Nat)
    (hBaseOne : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 1)
    (hBaseEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0) :
    ((∀ k, k ≤ length →
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 1) ∧
        (∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
          j + (k : ZMod f) ∉ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ) ∧
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
          (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0) ∨
      ((∀ k, k ≤ length →
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + (k : ZMod f)) = -1) ∧
        (∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
          j + (k : ZMod f) ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ) ∧
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
          (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let index : Nat → ZMod f := fun k ↦ j + (k : ZMod f)
  let x : Nat → Int := fun k ↦ pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (index k)
  let epsilon : Nat → Int := fun k ↦
    (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign (index k)
  have hPredIndex : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → index k - 1 = index (k - 1) := by
    intro k hk
    have hkSplit : k = (k - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hCast : (k : ZMod f) = ((k - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) + 1 := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hkSplit]
      rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    change j + (k : ZMod f) - 1 = j + ((k - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)
    rw [hCast]
    ring
  have hTargetInterior : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length →
      sigma'.u (index k) = p - 1 := by
    intro k hkPositive hkLength
    have hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (index k - 1) = 1 := by
      rw [hPredIndex k hkPositive]
      exact hBaseOne (k - 1) (by omega)
    exact (pin.niveauOne_paInteriorTargetCoordinate ∅ hEmpty (index k)
      (hSourceZero k hkPositive (by omega)) hPrev
      (hBaseOne k hkLength)).2
  have hTargetEndpoint : sigma'.u (index (length + 1)) = p := by
    have hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (index (length + 1) - 1) = 1 := by
      rw [hPredIndex (length + 1) (by omega)]
      simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using hBaseOne length (by omega)
    exact (pin.niveauOne_paEndpointTargetCoordinate ∅ hEmpty
      (index (length + 1)) (hSourceZero (length + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
      hPrev (by simpa only [index] using hBaseEnd)).2
  have hCarryBound : ∀ i, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ i| ≤ 2 :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 J hJ).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hEpsilon : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      epsilon k = 1 ∨ epsilon k = -1 := by
    intro k _hkPositive _hkEnd
    by_cases hk : index k ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
    · right
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hk]
    · left
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hk]
  have hXBound : ∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 → |x k| ≤ 2 := by
    intro k _hk
    exact hCarryBound (index k)
  have hXOdd : ∀ k, k ≤ length → Odd (x k) := by
    intro k hk
    have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
      (index k)
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hParity
    have hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (index k) = 1 := by
      simpa only [index] using hBaseOne k hk
    rw [hBaseAt] at hParity
    change Odd (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (index k))
    rcases hParity with ⟨r, hr⟩
    exact ⟨r, by omega⟩
  have hXEndEven : Even (x (length + 1)) := by
    have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
      (index (length + 1))
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hParity
    rw [show pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (index (length + 1)) = 0 by
      simpa only [index] using hBaseEnd] at hParity
    change Even (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (index (length + 1)))
    simpa only [sub_zero] using hParity
  have hInterior : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length →
      epsilon k * ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) =
        (p : Int) * x (k - 1) - x k := by
    intro k hkPositive hkLength
    have hEquation := pin.niveauOne_paCarryEquation J hJ (index k)
      (hSourceZero k hkPositive (by omega))
    rw [hTargetInterior k hkPositive hkLength, hPredIndex k hkPositive]
      at hEquation
    simpa only [epsilon, x] using hEquation
  have hEndpoint : epsilon (length + 1) * (p : Int) =
      (p : Int) * x length - x (length + 1) := by
    have hEquation := pin.niveauOne_paCarryEquation J hJ (index (length + 1))
      (hSourceZero (length + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
    rw [hTargetEndpoint, hPredIndex (length + 1) (by omega)] at hEquation
    simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, epsilon, x] using hEquation
  rcases paPositiveStringDichotomy hp3 x epsilon hEpsilon hXBound hXOdd
      hXEndEven hInterior hEndpoint with hPositive | hNegative
  · left
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k hk
      simpa only [x, index] using hPositive.1 k hk
    · intro k hkPositive hkEnd
      have hSign := hPositive.2.1 k hkPositive hkEnd
      by_contra hk
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set] at hSign
      exact hSign hk
    · simpa only [x, index] using hPositive.2.2
  · right
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k hk
      simpa only [x, index] using hNegative.1 k hk
    · intro k hkPositive hkEnd
      have hSign := hNegative.2.1 k hkPositive hkEnd
      by_contra hk
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set] at hSign
      exact hk hSign
    · simpa only [x, index] using hNegative.2.2

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_paPositiveStringDichotomy
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_paPositiveStringDichotomy
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod (2 * f)) (length : Nat)
    (hBaseOne : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (j + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))) = 1)
    (hBaseEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (j + (length + 1 : Nat))) = 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      sigma.periodicU hf (j + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0) :
    ((∀ k, k ≤ length →
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
          (j + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) = 1) ∧
        (∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
          j + (k : ZMod (2 * f)) ∉
            pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ) ∧
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
          (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0) ∨
      ((∀ k, k ≤ length →
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
          (j + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) = -1) ∧
        (∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
          j + (k : ZMod (2 * f)) ∈
            pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ) ∧
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
          (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let index : Nat → ZMod (2 * f) := fun k ↦ j + (k : ZMod (2 * f))
  let x : Nat → Int := fun k ↦
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (index k)
  let epsilon : Nat → Int := fun k ↦
    (Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign (index k)
  have hPredIndex : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → index k - 1 = index (k - 1) := by
    intro k hk
    have hkSplit : k = (k - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hCast : (k : ZMod (2 * f)) =
        ((k - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) + 1 := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hkSplit]
      rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    change j + (k : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 =
      j + ((k - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))
    rw [hCast]
    ring
  have hTargetInterior : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length →
      sigma'.periodicU hf (index k) = p - 1 := by
    intro k hkPositive hkLength
    have hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (index k) - 1) = 1 := by
      rw [← periodicIndex_sub_one hf, hPredIndex k hkPositive]
      exact hBaseOne (k - 1) (by omega)
    have hTarget := pin.niveauOne_paInteriorTargetCoordinate ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (index k))
      (by simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using
        hSourceZero k hkPositive (by omega))
      hPrev (hBaseOne k hkLength)
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hTarget.2
  have hTargetEndpoint : sigma'.periodicU hf (index (length + 1)) = p := by
    have hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (index (length + 1)) - 1) = 1 := by
      rw [← periodicIndex_sub_one hf, hPredIndex (length + 1) (by omega)]
      simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using hBaseOne length (by omega)
    have hTarget := pin.niveauOne_paEndpointTargetCoordinate ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (index (length + 1)))
      (by simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using
        hSourceZero (length + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
      hPrev (by simpa only [index] using hBaseEnd)
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hTarget.2
  have hCarryBound : ∀ i,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ i| ≤ 2 :=
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ
  have hEpsilon : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      epsilon k = 1 ∨ epsilon k = -1 := by
    intro k _hkPositive _hkEnd
    by_cases hk : index k ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
    · right
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hk]
    · left
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hk]
  have hXBound : ∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 → |x k| ≤ 2 := by
    intro k _hk
    exact hCarryBound (index k)
  have hXOdd : ∀ k, k ≤ length → Odd (x k) := by
    intro k hk
    have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (index k)
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hParity
    have hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (index k)) = 1 := hBaseOne k hk
    rw [hBaseAt] at hParity
    change Odd (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (index k))
    rcases hParity with ⟨r, hr⟩
    exact ⟨r, by omega⟩
  have hXEndEven : Even (x (length + 1)) := by
    have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (index (length + 1))
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hParity
    rw [show pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (index (length + 1))) = 0 by
      simpa only [index] using hBaseEnd] at hParity
    change Even (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
      (index (length + 1)))
    simpa only [sub_zero] using hParity
  have hInterior : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length →
      epsilon k * ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) =
        (p : Int) * x (k - 1) - x k := by
    intro k hkPositive hkLength
    have hEquation := pin.niveauTwo_paCarryEquation J hComplementary hJ
      (index k) (hSourceZero k hkPositive (by omega))
    rw [hTargetInterior k hkPositive hkLength, hPredIndex k hkPositive]
      at hEquation
    simpa only [epsilon, x] using hEquation
  have hEndpoint : epsilon (length + 1) * (p : Int) =
      (p : Int) * x length - x (length + 1) := by
    have hEquation := pin.niveauTwo_paCarryEquation J hComplementary hJ
      (index (length + 1))
      (hSourceZero (length + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
    rw [hTargetEndpoint, hPredIndex (length + 1) (by omega)] at hEquation
    simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, epsilon, x] using hEquation
  rcases paPositiveStringDichotomy hp3 x epsilon hEpsilon hXBound hXOdd
      hXEndEven hInterior hEndpoint with hPositive | hNegative
  · left
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k hk
      simpa only [x, index] using hPositive.1 k hk
    · intro k hkPositive hkEnd
      have hSign := hPositive.2.1 k hkPositive hkEnd
      by_contra hk
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set] at hSign
      exact hSign hk
    · simpa only [x, index] using hPositive.2.2
  · right
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k hk
      simpa only [x, index] using hNegative.1 k hk
    · intro k hkPositive hkEnd
      have hSign := hNegative.2.1 k hkPositive hkEnd
      by_contra hk
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set] at hSign
      exact hk hSign
    · simpa only [x, index] using hNegative.2.2

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_paHardProfileExponentWitness
statement:
theorem niveauOne_paHardProfileExponentWitness
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (j : ZMod f) (length : Nat)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
      (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hsubset ∅) (j - 1) ≤ 0)
    (hBaseOne : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
        (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
          hsubset ∅) (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 1)
    (hBaseEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
      (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hsubset ∅) (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0)
    (hu : 1 < sigma.u j)
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∉ J) :
    ∃ K : Profile f,
      profileLeftExponent hf
          (sigma.mu hf j ⟨by omega, by
            simpa using hSourceZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)⟩)
          (.niveauOne J) =
        profileLeftExponent hf sigma' K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset ∅
  let valid : sigma.MuValid j :=
    ⟨by omega, by simpa using hSourceZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)⟩
  have hZeroSucc : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 :=
    by simpa using hSourceZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)
  have hNoncritical :
      sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t :=
    pin.zero_source_and_zero_emptyCarry_target_not_critical hp3 hsubset hEmpty
      (j + 1) (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) hZeroSucc hBaseEnd sigma'.t
  have hCompatible (L : Profile f) :
      L ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset_of_ne_critical hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset hNoncritical L
  have hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' := hCompatible _
  have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
    intro hExceptional
    rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, huAll, huAll', ht⟩
    exact (exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars sigma
      sigma' huAll huAll' ht).1 hsubset
  have hLength : length + 1 < f :=
    paPositiveString_length_lt_period hf j
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty) hBaseOne hBaseEnd
  have hInterior : ∀ k, k < length →
      sigma'.u (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) = p - 1 := by
    intro k hk
    have hPredIndex : j + (k + 1 : Nat) - 1 = j + (k : ZMod f) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    exact (pin.niveauOne_paInteriorTargetCoordinate ∅ hEmpty
      (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) (hSourceZero (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
      (by rw [hPredIndex]; exact hBaseOne k (by omega))
      (hBaseOne (k + 1) (by omega))).2
  have hEndpoint : sigma'.u (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = p := by
    have hPredIndex : j + (length + 1 : Nat) - 1 =
        j + (length : ZMod f) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    exact (pin.niveauOne_paEndpointTargetCoordinate ∅ hEmpty
      (j + (length + 1 : Nat))
      (hSourceZero (length + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
      (by rw [hPredIndex]; exact hBaseOne length (by omega)) hBaseEnd).2
  rcases pin.niveauOne_paPositiveStringDichotomy hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty
      J hJ j length hBaseOne hBaseEnd hSourceZero with
    hPositive | hNegative
  · have hCarryAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ j = 1 :=
      by simpa using hPositive.1 0 (by omega)
    have hBaseBound :
        |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1)| ≤ 2 := by
      rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
        hBound | hExceptional
      · exact hBound (j - 1)
      · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)
    have hBaseNotNegTwo :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) ≠ -2 := by
      have hForbidden := (pin.emptyCarry_forbidden_patterns hp3 hEmpty).2.2
        (j - 1)
      intro hNegTwo
      have hNextPositive :
          0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty ((j - 1) + 1) := by
        have hAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = 1 := by
          simpa using hBaseOne 0 (by omega)
        simpa using (show 0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j by omega)
      exact hForbidden hNegTwo hNextPositive
    have hBaseCases :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = -1 ∨
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0 := by
      have hRange := abs_le.mp hBaseBound
      omega
    rcases hBaseCases with hBaseNegative | hBaseZero
    · rcases pin.niveauOne_paStartNegativePredecessor hp3 hNotExceptional
          hEmpty J hJ j hj hBaseNegative
          (by simpa using hBaseOne 0 (by omega)) hCarryAt hu with
        ⟨huEq, hjTarget, huTarget⟩
      let K : Set (ZMod f) := pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
      have hPair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
          profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne K) := by
        rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec J hJ]
        exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne J) hJ
      have hCongr := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
        sigma sigma' J K hPair
      have hSingleton : niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' {j} =
          inversePower p f hf j := by
        rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
        have hfun :
            (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne {j}).indicator i : Int) *
              (sigma'.u i : Int)) =
            (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then (1 : Int) else 0) := by
          funext i
          by_cases hij : i = j
          · subst i
            simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, huTarget]
          · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hij]
        rw [hfun, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
        norm_num
      have hSubset : ({j} : Set (ZMod f)) ⊆ K := by
        intro i hi
        simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hi ▸ hjTarget
      have hToggle := niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_of_subset hf sigma' K {j}
        hSubset
      have hMu := niveauOneProfileSum_mu_of_mem_not_mem
        (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) hf sigma j valid J hj hj1
      refine ⟨.niveauOne (symmDiff K {j}), ?_⟩
      simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
      change sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) J =
        sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' (symmDiff K {j})
      rw [hMu, hToggle, hSingleton]
      linear_combination hCongr
    · let JMinus : Set (ZMod f) := symmDiff J {j}
      have hJMinus : Profile.niveauOne JMinus ∈
          compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' := hCompatible _
      have hTargetOmit := pin.niveauOne_paModifiedProfileTargetOmission hp3
        hpOdd hNotExceptional hEmpty J hJ j hj hBaseZero
        (by simpa using hBaseOne 0 (by omega)) hCarryAt hu hJMinus
      rcases pin.niveauOne_paStartZeroPredecessor hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty
          J hJ j hj hBaseZero (by simpa using hBaseOne 0 (by omega))
          hCarryAt hu with
        ⟨huEq, _hjTarget, huTarget⟩
      refine ⟨.niveauOne (symmDiff (pin.niveauOneTarget JMinus hJMinus) {j}), ?_⟩
      exact pin.niveauOne_paModifiedProfileExponentIdentity j valid J hj hj1
        hJMinus hTargetOmit huEq huTarget
  · let K : Set (ZMod f) := pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
    let T : Set (ZMod f) :=
      ↑(paCyclicInterval j length)
    have hSubsetT : T ⊆ K := by
      intro i hi
      have hi' : i ∈ paCyclicInterval j length := hi
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi' with ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
      exact hNegative.2.1 (k + 1) (by omega)
        (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hk; omega)
    have hPair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne K) := by
      rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec J hJ]
      exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne J) hJ
    have hCongr := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
      sigma sigma' J K hPair
    have hToggle :=
      niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_paCyclicInterval_of_subset
        (p := p) (f := f) (length := length) (by omega) hf sigma' j K
        hLength hInterior hEndpoint hSubsetT
    have hMu := niveauOneProfileSum_mu_of_mem_not_mem
      (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) hf sigma j valid J hj hj1
    refine ⟨.niveauOne (symmDiff K T), ?_⟩
    simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
    change sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) J =
      sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' (symmDiff K T)
    rw [hMu, hToggle]
    linear_combination hCongr

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_paHardProfileExponentWitness
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_paHardProfileExponentWitness
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (j : ZMod (2 * f)) (length : Nat)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
      (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hsubset ∅) (periodicIndex hf (j - 1)) ≤ 0)
    (hBaseOne : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
        (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
          hsubset ∅)
        (periodicIndex hf (j + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))) = 1)
    (hBaseEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
      (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hsubset ∅)
      (periodicIndex hf (j + (length + 1 : Nat))) = 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      sigma.periodicU hf (j + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0)
    (hu : 1 < sigma.periodicU hf j)
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∉ J) :
    ∃ K : Profile f,
      profileLeftExponent hf
          (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf j) ⟨by
            have hu' : 1 < sigma.u (periodicIndex hf j) := by
              simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hu
            omega, by
            simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_eq_castHom,
              Nat.cast_one, map_add, map_one] using
                hSourceZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)⟩)
          (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
        profileLeftExponent hf sigma' K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset ∅
  let valid : sigma.MuValid (periodicIndex hf j) :=
    ⟨by
      have hu' : 1 < sigma.u (periodicIndex hf j) := by
        simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hu
      omega, by
      simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_eq_castHom,
        Nat.cast_one, map_add, map_one] using
          hSourceZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)⟩
  have hZeroSucc : sigma.u (periodicIndex hf (j + 1)) = 0 := by
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, Nat.cast_one] using
      hSourceZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)
  have hNoncritical :
      sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t :=
    pin.zero_source_and_zero_emptyCarry_target_not_critical hp3 hsubset hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (j + 1))
      (periodicIndex hf (j + (length + 1 : Nat))) hZeroSucc hBaseEnd sigma'.t
  have hCompatible (L : Profile f) :
      L ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset_of_ne_critical hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset hNoncritical L
  have hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' := hCompatible _
  have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
    intro hExceptional
    rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, huAll, huAll', ht⟩
    exact (exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars sigma
      sigma' huAll huAll' ht).1 hsubset
  have hLength : length + 1 < f := by
    apply paPositiveString_length_lt_period hf (periodicIndex hf j)
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty)
    · intro k hk
      simpa only [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_natCast] using
        hBaseOne k hk
    · simpa only [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_natCast] using hBaseEnd
  have hInterior : ∀ k, k < length →
      sigma'.periodicU hf (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) = p - 1 := by
    intro k hk
    have hPredIndex : periodicIndex hf (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) - 1 =
        periodicIndex hf (j + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
      rw [← periodicIndex_sub_one hf]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    have hTarget := pin.niveauOne_paInteriorTargetCoordinate ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (j + (k + 1 : Nat)))
      (by simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using
        hSourceZero (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
      (by rw [hPredIndex]; exact hBaseOne k (by omega))
      (hBaseOne (k + 1) (by omega))
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hTarget.2
  have hEndpoint :
      sigma'.periodicU hf (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = p := by
    have hPredIndex : periodicIndex hf (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) - 1 =
        periodicIndex hf (j + (length : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
      rw [← periodicIndex_sub_one hf]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    have hTarget := pin.niveauOne_paEndpointTargetCoordinate ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (j + (length + 1 : Nat)))
      (by simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using
        hSourceZero (length + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
      (by rw [hPredIndex]; exact hBaseOne length (by omega)) hBaseEnd
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hTarget.2
  rcases pin.niveauTwo_paPositiveStringDichotomy hp3 hEmpty J hComplementary
      hJ j length hBaseOne hBaseEnd hSourceZero with hPositive | hNegative
  · have hCarryAt :
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ j = 1 :=
      by simpa using hPositive.1 0 (by omega)
    have hBaseBound :
        |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf (j - 1))| ≤ 2 := by
      rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
        hBound | hExceptional
      · exact hBound (periodicIndex hf (j - 1))
      · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)
    have hBaseNotNegTwo :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
            (periodicIndex hf (j - 1)) ≠ -2 := by
      have hForbidden := (pin.emptyCarry_forbidden_patterns hp3 hEmpty).2.2
        (periodicIndex hf (j - 1))
      intro hNegTwo
      have hPeriodicPred : periodicIndex hf (j - 1) + 1 =
          periodicIndex hf j := by
        rw [periodicIndex_sub_one hf]
        ring
      have hNextPositive : 0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (periodicIndex hf (j - 1) + 1) := by
        rw [hPeriodicPred]
        have hAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
            (periodicIndex hf j) = 1 := by
          simpa using hBaseOne 0 (by omega)
        omega
      exact hForbidden hNegTwo hNextPositive
    have hBaseCases :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf (j - 1)) = -1 ∨
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf (j - 1)) = 0 := by
      have hRange := abs_le.mp hBaseBound
      omega
    rcases hBaseCases with hBaseNegative | hBaseZero
    · rcases pin.niveauTwo_paStartNegativePredecessor hp3 hNotExceptional
          hEmpty J hComplementary hJ j hj hBaseNegative
          (by simpa using hBaseOne 0 (by omega)) hCarryAt hu with
        ⟨huEq, hjTarget, huTarget⟩
      let K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
        pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
      let hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K :=
        pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ
      have hPair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma
            (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
          profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK) := by
        rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec J hComplementary hJ]
        exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
      have hCongr := niveauTwoProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
        sigma sigma' J K hComplementary hK hPair
      have hTargetToggle :=
        niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSingletonToggle_of_mem hf sigma' K hK j
          hjTarget
      rw [huTarget] at hTargetToggle
