      norm_num only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul] at hTargetToggle
      have hRecurrence :
          (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
              niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (j + 1 + f) =
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (j + f) := by
        have hrec := inversePower_succ p (2 * f) (by omega : 1 ≤ p)
          (by omega) (j + f)
        rw [show j + f + 1 = j + 1 + f by ring] at hrec
        simpa only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent] using hrec
      have hMu := niveauTwoProfileSum_mu_of_mem_not_mem
        (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) hf sigma j valid J hComplementary hj hj1
      refine ⟨Profile.periodicSymmDiff hf (Profile.niveauTwo K hK)
        {periodicIndex hf j}, ?_⟩
      simp only [profileLeftExponent, Profile.periodicSymmDiff,
        CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
      change liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
          niveauTwoProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf j) valid) J =
        liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma'
          (symmDiff K (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf j}))
      rw [hMu, hTargetToggle, hRecurrence]
      linear_combination hCongr
    · have hMinusComplementary : ∀ i,
          i ∈ symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf j}) ↔
            i + f ∉ symmDiff J
              (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf j}) := by
        intro i
        simp only [Set.mem_symmDiff, periodicIndexSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
          periodicIndex_add_half]
        have hi := hComplementary i
        tauto
      let JMinus : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
        symmDiff J (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf j})
      have hJMinus : Profile.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary ∈
          compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' := hCompatible _
      have hTargetOmit := pin.niveauTwo_paModifiedProfileTargetOmission hp3
        hpOdd hNotExceptional hEmpty J hComplementary hJ j hj hBaseZero
        (by simpa using hBaseOne 0 (by omega)) hCarryAt hu
        hMinusComplementary hJMinus
      rcases pin.niveauTwo_paStartZeroPredecessor hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty
          J hComplementary hJ j hj hBaseZero
          (by simpa using hBaseOne 0 (by omega)) hCarryAt hu with
        ⟨huEq, _hjTarget, huTarget⟩
      refine ⟨((Profile.niveauTwo
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus)
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary JMinus hMinusComplementary
          hJMinus)).periodicSymmDiff hf {periodicIndex hf j}), ?_⟩
      exact pin.niveauTwo_paModifiedProfileExponentIdentity j valid J
        hComplementary hj hj1 hMinusComplementary hJMinus hTargetOmit huEq
        huTarget
  · let K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
      pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
    let hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K :=
      pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ
    let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := ↑(paCyclicInterval j length)
    have hSubsetT : T ⊆ K := by
      intro i hi
      have hi' : i ∈ paCyclicInterval j length := hi
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hi' with ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
      exact hNegative.2.1 (k + 1) (by omega)
        (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hk; omega)
    have hPair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma
          (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK) := by
      rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec J hComplementary hJ]
      exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
    have hCongr := niveauTwoProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
      sigma sigma' J K hComplementary hK hPair
    have hToggle :=
      niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSymmDiff_paCyclicInterval_of_subset
        (p := p) (f := f) (length := length) (by omega) hf sigma' j K hK
        hLength hInterior hEndpoint hSubsetT
    have hRecurrence :
        (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (j + 1 + f) =
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (j + f) := by
      have hrec := inversePower_succ p (2 * f) (by omega : 1 ≤ p)
        (by omega) (j + f)
      rw [show j + f + 1 = j + 1 + f by ring] at hrec
      simpa only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent] using hrec
    have hTwiceHalf : j + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (f : Nat) = j := by
      calc
        j + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + (f : Nat) = j + (2 * f : Nat) := by
          push_cast
          ring
        _ = j := by simp
    have hHalfExponent :
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (j + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) =
          (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f *
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf j := by
      have hrec := niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_nat p f (by omega) hf
        (j + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) f
      rw [hTwiceHalf] at hrec
      exact hrec.symm
    have hMu := niveauTwoProfileSum_mu_of_mem_not_mem
      (p := p) (f := f) (by omega) hf sigma j valid J hComplementary hj hj1
    refine ⟨Profile.periodicSymmDiff hf (Profile.niveauTwo K hK)
      (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf j) length) : Set (ZMod f)), ?_⟩
    simp only [profileLeftExponent, Profile.periodicSymmDiff,
      CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
    change liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
        niveauTwoProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf j) valid) J =
      liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma'
        (symmDiff K (periodicIndexSet hf
          (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf j) length) : Set (ZMod f))))
    rw [hMu, hToggle, hRecurrence, hHalfExponent]
    linear_combination hCongr

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pa_mu_support_subset_of_unitCarryString
statement:
theorem pa_mu_support_subset_of_unitCarryString
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (j : ZMod f) (length : Nat)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
      (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hsubset ∅) (j - 1) ≤ 0)
    (hBaseOne : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
        (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
          hsubset ∅) (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 1)
    (hBaseEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
      (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hsubset ∅) (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0)
    (hu : 1 < sigma.u j) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
        (sigma.mu hf j ⟨by omega, by
          simpa using hSourceZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)⟩) ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset ∅
  let valid : sigma.MuValid j :=
    ⟨by omega, by simpa using hSourceZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)⟩
  have hZeroSucc : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 :=
    by simpa using hSourceZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)
  have hNoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t :=
    pin.zero_source_and_zero_emptyCarry_target_not_critical hp3 hsubset hEmpty
      (j + 1) (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) hZeroSucc hBaseEnd sigma'.t
  have hOriginalLeft : leftExponentSet hf sigma ⊆
      leftExponentSet hf sigma' :=
    leftExponentSet_subset_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_ne_critical
      hp3 hf chars sigma sigma' hsubset hNoncritical
  have hDetOriginal : determinantExponent hf sigma =
      determinantExponent hf sigma' :=
    determinantExponent_eq_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset hp hf chars
      sigma sigma' hsubset
  have hDetMu : determinantExponent hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) =
      determinantExponent hf sigma' :=
    (determinantExponent_mu (by omega) hf sigma j valid).trans hDetOriginal
  apply semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_determinant_eq_of_left_subset hp hf
    chars (sigma.mu hf j valid) sigma' hDetMu
  apply (leftExponentSet_subset_iff_complementary_choice_of_determinant_eq
    hp hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) sigma' hDetMu).2
  intro profile
  cases profile with
  | niveauOne J =>
      by_cases hj : j ∈ J
      · by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J
        · left
          rw [profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauOne (by omega) hf sigma j valid J
            hj hj1]
          exact hOriginalLeft ⟨.niveauOne J, rfl⟩
        · obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := pin.niveauOne_paHardProfileExponentWitness hp3
            hpOdd hsubset j length hBasePrev hBaseOne hBaseEnd hSourceZero hu
            J hj hj1
          exact Or.inl ⟨K, hK.symm⟩
      · by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J
        · have hjCompl : j ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          have hj1Compl : j + 1 ∉ Jᶜ := by simpa
          obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := pin.niveauOne_paHardProfileExponentWitness hp3
            hpOdd hsubset j length hBasePrev hBaseOne hBaseEnd hSourceZero hu
            Jᶜ hjCompl hj1Compl
          exact Or.inr ⟨K, by
            simpa only [Profile.compl] using hK.symm⟩
        · right
          have hjCompl : j ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          have hj1Compl : j + 1 ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          rw [show (Profile.niveauOne J).compl = .niveauOne Jᶜ by rfl,
            profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauOne (by omega) hf sigma j valid Jᶜ
              hjCompl hj1Compl]
          exact hOriginalLeft ⟨.niveauOne Jᶜ, rfl⟩
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      let a0 : ZMod (2 * f) := shiftedFirstLift hf 0 j
      have ha0Index : periodicIndex hf a0 = j :=
        periodicIndex_shiftedFirstLift hf 0 j
      let a : ZMod (2 * f) := if a0 ∈ J then a0 else a0 + f
      have haIndex : periodicIndex hf a = j := by
        dsimp only [a]
        split_ifs with ha0
        · exact ha0Index
        · rw [periodicIndex_add_half, ha0Index]
      have ha : a ∈ J := by
        dsimp only [a]
        split_ifs with ha0
        · exact ha0
        · by_contra ha0f
          exact ha0 ((hJ a0).mpr ha0f)
      have hBasePrevA : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (periodicIndex hf (a - 1)) ≤ 0 := by
        rw [periodicIndex_sub_one hf, haIndex]
        exact hBasePrev
      have hBaseOneA : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
            (periodicIndex hf (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))) = 1 := by
        intro k hk
        have hIndex : periodicIndex hf (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) =
            j + (k : ZMod f) := by
          rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_natCast,
            ← periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf a, haIndex]
        rw [hIndex]
        exact hBaseOne k hk
      have hBaseEndA : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (periodicIndex hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat))) = 0 := by
        have hIndex : periodicIndex hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) =
            j + (length + 1 : Nat) := by
          rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_natCast,
            ← periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf a, haIndex]
        rw [hIndex]
        exact hBaseEnd
      have hSourceZeroA : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
          sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0 := by
        intro k hkPositive hkEnd
        have hIndex : periodicIndex hf (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) =
            j + (k : ZMod f) := by
          rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_natCast,
            ← periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf a, haIndex]
        simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hIndex] using
          hSourceZero k hkPositive hkEnd
      have huA : 1 < sigma.periodicU hf a := by
        simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, haIndex] using hu
      by_cases ha1 : a + 1 ∈ J
      · left
        have hEq := profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauTwo (by omega) hf sigma a
          (by simpa only [haIndex] using valid) J hJ ha ha1
        have hEq' : profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.mu hf j valid)
              (.niveauTwo J hJ) =
            profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ) := by
          simpa only [haIndex] using hEq
        rw [hEq']
        exact hOriginalLeft ⟨.niveauTwo J hJ, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := pin.niveauTwo_paHardProfileExponentWitness hp3
          hpOdd hsubset a length hBasePrevA hBaseOneA hBaseEndA hSourceZeroA
          huA J hJ ha ha1
        left
        have hK' : profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.mu hf j valid)
              (.niveauTwo J hJ) = profileLeftExponent hf sigma' K := by
          simpa only [haIndex] using hK
        exact ⟨K, hK'.symm⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pa_mu_support_subset
statement:
theorem pa_mu_support_subset
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (j : ZMod f) (length : Nat)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
      (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hsubset ∅) (j - 1) ≤ 0)
    (hBasePositive : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
        (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
          hsubset ∅) (j + (k : ZMod f)))
    (hBaseEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
      (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hsubset ∅) (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0)
    (hu : 1 < sigma.u j) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
        (sigma.mu hf j ⟨by omega, by
          simpa using hSourceZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)⟩) ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
proof:
:= by
  let hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset ∅
  have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
    intro hExceptional
    rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, huAll, huAll', ht⟩
    exact (exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars sigma
      sigma' huAll huAll' ht).1 hsubset
  have hBound : ∀ i, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
      hBound | hExceptional
    · exact hBound
    · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)
  have hNoTwo : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i ≠ 2 :=
    (pin.emptyCarry_forbidden_patterns hp3 hEmpty).1
  have hBaseOne : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 1 := by
    intro k hk
    have hPositive := hBasePositive k hk
    have hRange := abs_le.mp (hBound (j + (k : ZMod f)))
    have hNeTwo := hNoTwo (j + (k : ZMod f))
    omega
  exact pin.pa_mu_support_subset_of_unitCarryString hp3 hpOdd hsubset j length
    hBasePrev hBaseOne hBaseEnd hSourceZero hu

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pa_mu_support_subset_of_minimalPositiveBoundary
statement:
theorem pa_mu_support_subset_of_minimalPositiveBoundary
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty) (hNe : sigma ≠ sigma')
    (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) ≤ 0)
    (hCurrent : 0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j)
    (huPositive : 0 < sigma.u j) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
        (sigma.mu hf j ⟨huPositive, by
          rcases (pin.preliminaries hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe).2.1 j
              hPrev hCurrent with ⟨length, _, _, hZero⟩
          simpa using hZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)⟩) ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
proof:
:= by
  rcases (pin.preliminaries hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe).2.1 j hPrev
      hCurrent with ⟨length, hPositive, hEnd, hZero⟩
  have hValidNoninvertible := pin.positiveBoundaryPositive_mu_validNoninvertible
    hEmpty hMinimal j huPositive
      (by simpa using hZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)) hCurrent
  have hu : 1 < sigma.u j := by
    have hNotOne : sigma.u j ≠ 1 := by
      intro hOne
      exact hValidNoninvertible.2 ⟨hOne,
        by simpa using hZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)⟩
    omega
  exact pin.pa_mu_support_subset hp3 hpOdd hsubset j length hPrev hPositive
    hEnd hZero hu

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_pbBaseStartTargetCoordinate
statement:
theorem niveauOne_pbBaseStartTargetCoordinate
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f) (hu : sigma.u j = 0)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) ≤ 0)
    (hAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = 1) :
    pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0 ∧
      j ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty ∧ sigma'.u j = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hEquation := pin.niveauOne_paCarryEquation ∅ hEmpty j hu
  rw [hAt] at hEquation
  have huUpper : (sigma'.u j : Int) ≤ p := by
    exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le j
  by_cases hj : j ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty
  · simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hj]
      at hEquation
    have hPrevNonnegative :
        0 ≤ pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) := by
      nlinarith
    have hPrevZero : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0 :=
      le_antisymm hPrev hPrevNonnegative
    rw [hPrevZero] at hEquation
    exact ⟨hPrevZero, hj, by omega⟩
  · simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hj]
      at hEquation
    have hProductNonpositive :
        (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by omega) hPrev
    omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_pbBaseEndpointTargetCoordinate
statement:
theorem niveauOne_pbBaseEndpointTargetCoordinate
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hu : sigma.u i = 0)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) = 1)
    (hAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = 0) :
    i ∉ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty ∧ sigma'.u i = p
proof:
:= by
  have hTarget := pin.niveauOne_paEndpointTargetCoordinate ∅ hEmpty i hu hPrev hAt
  by_cases hi : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty
  · exfalso
    have hSign := hTarget.1
    simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
      at hSign
  · exact ⟨hi, hTarget.2⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_pbStartCarryDichotomy
statement:
theorem niveauOne_pbStartCarryDichotomy
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f) (hj : j ∈ J) (hu : sigma.u j = 0)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = 1) :
    pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j - 1) = 0 ∧
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ j = -1 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ j = 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ with
    hBounds | hExceptional
  · rcases (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J hJ j).1 hj
        with hSum | hDifference
    · rcases boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
          (hBounds.1 (j - 1)) (hBounds.1 j) hSum with ⟨hSumPrev, hSumAt⟩
      have hPrevDouble :=
        pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (j - 1)
      have hAtDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ j
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hSumPrev, hSumAt,
        hBasePrev, hBaseAt] at hPrevDouble hAtDouble
      exact ⟨by omega, Or.inl (by omega)⟩
    · have hRecurrence :
          (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
              (j - 1) =
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ j := by
        rw [hu] at hDifference
        norm_num at hDifference
        omega
      rcases boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
          (hBounds.2 (j - 1)) (hBounds.2 j) hRecurrence with
        ⟨hDifferencePrev, hDifferenceAt⟩
      have hPrevDouble :=
        pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (j - 1)
      have hAtDouble :=
        pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ j
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hDifferencePrev, hDifferenceAt,
        hBasePrev, hBaseAt] at hPrevDouble hAtDouble
      exact ⟨by omega, Or.inr (by omega)⟩
  · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_pbStartCarryDichotomy
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_pbStartCarryDichotomy
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (ha : a ∈ J)
    (hu : sigma.periodicU hf a = 0)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (a - 1)) = 0)
    (hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf a) = 1) :
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a - 1) = 0 ∧
      (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a = -1 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a = 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ with hBounds | hExceptional
  · rcases (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized
        hEmpty J hComplementary hJ a).1 ha with hSum | hDifference
    · rcases boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
          (hBounds.1 (a - 1)) (hBounds.1 a) hSum with ⟨hSumPrev, hSumAt⟩
      have hPrevDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (a - 1)
      have hAtDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ a
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hSumPrev, hSumAt,
        hBasePrev, hBaseAt] at hPrevDouble hAtDouble
      exact ⟨by omega, Or.inl (by omega)⟩
    · have hRecurrence :
          (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (a - 1) =
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ a := by
        rw [hu] at hDifference
        norm_num at hDifference
        omega
      rcases boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
          (hBounds.2 (a - 1)) (hBounds.2 a) hRecurrence with
        ⟨hDifferencePrev, hDifferenceAt⟩
      have hPrevDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (a - 1)
      have hAtDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ a
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hDifferencePrev, hDifferenceAt,
        hBasePrev, hBaseAt] at hPrevDouble hAtDouble
      exact ⟨by omega, Or.inr (by omega)⟩
  · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_pbEndpointCarryZero
statement:
theorem niveauOne_pbEndpointCarryZero
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hu : sigma.u i = 0) (hu' : sigma'.u i = p)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) = 1)
    (hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = 0) :
    pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hBound : ∀ k, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ k| ≤ 2 :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 J hJ).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hEpsilon :
      (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i = 1 ∨
        (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i = -1 := by
    by_cases hi : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
    · right
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
    · left
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
  have hPrevOdd : Odd (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (i - 1)) := by
    have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
      (i - 1)
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBasePrev] at hParity
    rcases hParity with ⟨r, hr⟩
    exact ⟨r, by omega⟩
  have hAtEven : Even (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ i) := by
    have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBaseAt, sub_zero] at hParity
    exact hParity
  have hEquation := pin.niveauOne_paCarryEquation J hJ i hu
  rw [hu'] at hEquation
  rcases paEndpointCarryStep hp3 hEpsilon (hBound (i - 1)) (hBound i)
      hPrevOdd hAtEven hEquation with hPositive | hNegative
  · exact hPositive.2.1
  · exact hNegative.2.1

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_pbEndpointCarryZero
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_pbEndpointCarryZero
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ k, k ∈ J ↔ k + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hu : sigma.periodicU hf i = 0)
    (hu' : sigma'.periodicU hf i = p)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (i - 1)) = 1)
    (hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf i) = 0) :
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hBound : ∀ k, |pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ k| ≤ 2 :=
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ
  have hEpsilon :
      (Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign i = 1 ∨
      (Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign i = -1 := by
    by_cases hi : i ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
    · right
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
    · left
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
  have hPrevOdd :
      Odd (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (i - 1)) := by
    have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1)
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBasePrev] at hParity
    rcases hParity with ⟨r, hr⟩
    exact ⟨r, by omega⟩
  have hAtEven : Even (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ i) := by
    have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBaseAt, sub_zero] at hParity
    exact hParity
  have hEquation := pin.niveauTwo_paCarryEquation J hComplementary hJ i hu
  rw [hu'] at hEquation
  rcases paEndpointCarryStep hp3 hEpsilon (hBound (i - 1)) (hBound i)
      hPrevOdd hAtEven hEquation with hPositive | hNegative
  · exact hPositive.2.1
  · exact hNegative.2.1

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_pbProfileExponentWitness_of_carries
statement:
theorem niveauOne_pbProfileExponentWitness_of_carries
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J)
    (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.u (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (huStart : sigma.u j = 0) (huTargetStart : sigma'.u j = 1)
    (hStartPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j - 1) = 0)
    (hStart : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ j = -1 ∨
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ j = 1)
    (hEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
      (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0) :
    ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
      profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) (.niveauOne J) =
        profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauOne K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K : Set (ZMod f) := pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
  have hPair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne K) := by
    rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec J hJ]
    exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne J) hJ
  have hCongr := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' J K hPair
  have hTheta := profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauOne_of_mem_mem
    (by omega : 1 ≤ p) hf sigma j valid J hj hj1
  rcases hStart with hNegative | hPositive
  · have hEquation := pin.niveauOne_paCarryEquation J hJ j huStart
    have hjTarget : j ∉ K := by
      intro hjK
      have hSign : (Profile.niveauOne K).sign j = -1 := by
        simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
          hjK]
      rw [hSign, huTargetStart, hStartPrev, hNegative] at hEquation
      norm_num at hEquation
    have hToggle := niveauOne_pbSingletonToggle hf sigma' K j hjTarget
      huTargetStart
    refine ⟨symmDiff K {j}, ?_⟩
    rw [hTheta]
    simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
    rw [hToggle]
    linear_combination hCongr
  · let T : Set (ZMod f) := ↑(paCyclicInterval j length)
    have hSigned := pin.niveauOne_pbSignedIntervalWeightedSum J hJ j hLength
      hSourceZero hPositive hEnd
    have hToggle := niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_eq_add_signed hf sigma' K T
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne T).indicator i : Int) *
            (Profile.niveauOne K).sign i * (sigma'.u i : Int)) =
          (fun i : ZMod f ↦ T.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
            ((Profile.niveauOne K).sign i * (sigma'.u i : Int))) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i ∈ T <;>
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, Set.indicator,
          hi]
    rw [hfun, hSigned] at hToggle
    refine ⟨symmDiff K T, ?_⟩
    rw [hTheta]
    simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
    rw [hToggle]
    linear_combination hCongr

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_pbProfileExponentWitness_of_carries
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_pbProfileExponentWitness_of_carries
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid (periodicIndex hf a))
    (ha : a ∈ J) (ha1 : a + 1 ∈ J)
    (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (huStart : sigma.periodicU hf a = 0)
    (huTargetStart : sigma'.periodicU hf a = 1)
    (hStartPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a - 1) = 0)
    (hStart : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a = -1 ∨
      pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a = 1)
    (hEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
      (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0) :
    ∃ (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K),
      profileLeftExponent hf
          (sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid)
          (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
        profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
  let hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K :=
    pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ
  have hPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK) := by
    rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec J hComplementary hJ]
    exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
  have hCongr := niveauTwoProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' J K hComplementary hK hPair
  have hTheta := profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauTwo_of_mem_mem hp hf sigma a
    valid J hComplementary ha ha1
  rcases hStart with hNegative | hPositive
  · have hEquation := pin.niveauTwo_paCarryEquation J hComplementary hJ a
      huStart
    have haTarget : a ∉ K := by
      intro haK
      have hSign : (Profile.niveauTwo K hK).sign a = -1 := by
        simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
          haK]
      rw [hSign, huTargetStart, hStartPrev, hNegative] at hEquation
      norm_num at hEquation
    let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
      periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a}
    let L : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := symmDiff K T
    have hL : ∀ i, i ∈ L ↔ i + f ∉ L := by
      intro i
      simp only [L, T, Set.mem_symmDiff, periodicIndexSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
        Set.mem_singleton_iff, periodicIndex_add_half]
      have hKi := hK i
      tauto
    have hToggle := niveauTwo_pbPeriodicSingletonToggle hf sigma' K hK a
      haTarget huTargetStart
    change niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' L = _ at hToggle
    refine ⟨L, hL, ?_⟩
    rw [hTheta]
    simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
    rw [hToggle]
    linear_combination hCongr
  · let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := periodicIndexSet hf
        (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf a) length) : Set (ZMod f))
    let L : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := symmDiff K T
    have hL : ∀ i, i ∈ L ↔ i + f ∉ L := by
      intro i
      simp only [L, T, Set.mem_symmDiff, periodicIndexSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
        periodicIndex_add_half]
      have hKi := hK i
      tauto
    have hSigned := pin.niveauTwo_pbSignedPeriodicIntervalWeightedSum J
      hComplementary hJ a hLength hSourceZero hPositive hEnd
    have hToggle := niveauTwoProfileSum_symmDiff_eq_add_signed hf sigma' K T hK
    rw [hSigned] at hToggle
    change niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' L = _ at hToggle
    refine ⟨L, hL, ?_⟩
    rw [hTheta]
    simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
    rw [hToggle]
    linear_combination hCongr

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pb_theta_support_subset_of_profileExponentWitnesses
statement:
theorem pb_theta_support_subset_of_profileExponentWitnesses
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hNoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t)
    (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (hNiveauOne : ∀ (J : Set (ZMod f))
      (_hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
        compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma'),
      j ∈ J → j + 1 ∈ J →
        ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
          profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) (.niveauOne J) =
            profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauOne K))
    (hNiveauTwo : ∀ (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
      (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
      (_hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
        compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
      (a : ZMod (2 * f)), periodicIndex hf a = j →
      a ∈ J → a + 1 ∈ J →
        ∃ (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K),
          profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf j valid)
              (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
            profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars (sigma.theta hf j valid) ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hOriginalLeft : leftExponentSet hf sigma ⊆
      leftExponentSet hf sigma' :=
    leftExponentSet_subset_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_ne_critical
      hp3 hf chars sigma sigma' hsubset hNoncritical
  have hDetOriginal : determinantExponent hf sigma =
      determinantExponent hf sigma' :=
    determinantExponent_eq_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset hp hf chars
      sigma sigma' hsubset
  have hDetTheta : determinantExponent hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) =
      determinantExponent hf sigma' :=
    (determinantExponent_theta (by omega) hf sigma j valid).trans hDetOriginal
  apply semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_determinant_eq_of_left_subset hp hf
    chars (sigma.theta hf j valid) sigma' hDetTheta
  apply (leftExponentSet_subset_iff_complementary_choice_of_determinant_eq
    hp hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) sigma' hDetTheta).2
  intro profile
  cases profile with
  | niveauOne J =>
      by_cases hj : j ∈ J
      · by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J
        · let hJ := niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars
            sigma sigma' hsubset J
          obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hNiveauOne J hJ hj hj1
          exact Or.inl ⟨.niveauOne K, hK.symm⟩
        · left
          rw [profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauOne hf sigma j valid J hj hj1]
          exact hOriginalLeft ⟨.niveauOne J, rfl⟩
      · by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J
        · right
          have hjCompl : j ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          have hj1Compl : j + 1 ∉ Jᶜ := by simpa
          rw [show (Profile.niveauOne J).compl = .niveauOne Jᶜ by rfl,
            profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauOne hf sigma j valid Jᶜ
              hjCompl hj1Compl]
          exact hOriginalLeft ⟨.niveauOne Jᶜ, rfl⟩
        · right
          have hjCompl : j ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          have hj1Compl : j + 1 ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          let hJCompl := niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars
            sigma sigma' hsubset Jᶜ
          obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hNiveauOne Jᶜ hJCompl hjCompl hj1Compl
          exact ⟨.niveauOne K, by
            simpa only [Profile.compl] using hK.symm⟩
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      let a0 : ZMod (2 * f) := shiftedFirstLift hf 0 j
      have ha0Index : periodicIndex hf a0 = j :=
        periodicIndex_shiftedFirstLift hf 0 j
      let a : ZMod (2 * f) := if a0 ∈ J then a0 else a0 + f
      have haIndex : periodicIndex hf a = j := by
        dsimp only [a]
        split_ifs with ha0
        · exact ha0Index
        · rw [periodicIndex_add_half, ha0Index]
      have ha : a ∈ J := by
        dsimp only [a]
        split_ifs with ha0
        · exact ha0
        · by_contra ha0f
          exact ha0 ((hJ a0).mpr ha0f)
      have hCompatible : Profile.niveauTwo J hJ ∈
          compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
        mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset_of_ne_critical hp3 hf chars sigma
          sigma' hsubset hNoncritical (.niveauTwo J hJ)
      by_cases ha1 : a + 1 ∈ J
      · obtain ⟨K, hK, hEq⟩ := hNiveauTwo J hJ hCompatible a haIndex ha ha1
        exact Or.inl ⟨.niveauTwo K hK, hEq.symm⟩
      · left
        have hEq := profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauTwo hp hf sigma a
          (by simpa only [haIndex] using valid) J hJ ha ha1
        have hEq' : profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf j valid)
              (.niveauTwo J hJ) =
            profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ) := by
          simpa only [haIndex] using hEq
        rw [hEq']
        exact hOriginalLeft ⟨.niveauTwo J hJ, rfl⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pb_theta_support_subset
statement:
theorem pb_theta_support_subset
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (j : ZMod f) (length : Nat)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
      (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hsubset ∅) (j - 1) ≤ 0)
    (hBasePositive : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
        (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
          hsubset ∅) (j + (k : ZMod f)))
    (hBaseEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
      (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hsubset ∅) (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 →
      sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
        (sigma.theta hf j ⟨by
          have hu := hSourceZero 0 (by omega)
          simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] at hu
          omega, by
          simpa using hSourceZero 1 (by omega)⟩) ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset ∅
  have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
    intro hExceptional
    rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, huAll, huAll', ht⟩
    exact (exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars sigma
      sigma' huAll huAll' ht).1 hsubset
  have hBound : ∀ i, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i| ≤ 2 := by
    rcases pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty with
      hBound | hExceptional
    · exact hBound
    · exact False.elim (hNotExceptional hExceptional)
  have hNoTwo : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i ≠ 2 :=
    (pin.emptyCarry_forbidden_patterns hp3 hEmpty).1
  have hBaseOne : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 1 := by
    intro k hk
    have hPositive := hBasePositive k hk
    have hRange := abs_le.mp (hBound (j + (k : ZMod f)))
    have hNeTwo := hNoTwo (j + (k : ZMod f))
    omega
  have hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = 1 := by
    simpa using hBaseOne 0 (by omega)
  have huStart : sigma.u j = 0 := by
    simpa using hSourceZero 0 (by omega)
  let valid : sigma.ThetaValid j := ⟨by rw [huStart]; omega, by
    simpa using hSourceZero 1 (by omega)⟩
  have hBaseStart := pin.niveauOne_pbBaseStartTargetCoordinate hEmpty j huStart
    hBasePrev hBaseAt
  have hBasePrevZero : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0 :=
    hBaseStart.1
  have huTargetStart : sigma'.u j = 1 := hBaseStart.2.2
  have hLength : length + 1 < f :=
    paPositiveString_length_lt_period hf j
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty) hBaseOne hBaseEnd
  have hSourceZeroSucc : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.u (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    exact hSourceZero (k + 1) (by omega)
  have hEndPred : j + (length + 1 : Nat) - 1 =
      j + (length : ZMod f) := by
    push_cast
    ring
  have hBaseEndPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (j + (length + 1 : Nat) - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [hEndPred]
    exact hBaseOne length (by omega)
  have huEnd : sigma.u (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0 :=
    hSourceZero (length + 1) (by omega)
  have hBaseEndpoint := pin.niveauOne_pbBaseEndpointTargetCoordinate hEmpty
    (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) huEnd hBaseEndPrev hBaseEnd
  have huTargetEnd : sigma'.u (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = p :=
    hBaseEndpoint.2
  have hNoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t :=
    pin.zero_source_and_zero_emptyCarry_target_not_critical hp3 hsubset hEmpty
      (j + 1) (j + (length + 1 : Nat))
      (by simpa using hSourceZero 1 (by omega)) hBaseEnd sigma'.t
  apply pb_theta_support_subset_of_profileExponentWitnesses hp3 hsubset
    hNoncritical j valid
  · intro J hJ hj hj1
    have hStart := pin.niveauOne_pbStartCarryDichotomy hp3 hNotExceptional
      hEmpty J hJ j hj huStart hBasePrevZero hBaseAt
    have hEnd := pin.niveauOne_pbEndpointCarryZero hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty
      J hJ (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) huEnd huTargetEnd hBaseEndPrev hBaseEnd
    exact pin.niveauOne_pbProfileExponentWitness_of_carries J hJ j valid hj hj1
      hLength hSourceZeroSucc huStart huTargetStart hStart.1 hStart.2 hEnd
  · intro J hComplementary hJ a haIndex ha ha1
    have hPeriodicIndex (k : Nat) :
        periodicIndex hf (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) =
          j + (k : ZMod f) := by
      rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_natCast,
        ← periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf a, haIndex]
    have hBasePrevA : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (a - 1)) = 0 := by
      rw [periodicIndex_sub_one, haIndex]
      exact hBasePrevZero
    have hBaseAtA : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf a) = 1 := by
      rw [haIndex]
      exact hBaseAt
    have huStartA : sigma.periodicU hf a = 0 := by
      simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, haIndex] using huStart
    have huTargetStartA : sigma'.periodicU hf a = 1 := by
      simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, haIndex] using huTargetStart
    have hSourceZeroA : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
        sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0 := by
      intro k hk
      simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodicIndex]
      exact hSourceZero (k + 1) (by omega)
    have hStart := pin.niveauTwo_pbStartCarryDichotomy hp3 hNotExceptional
      hEmpty J hComplementary hJ a ha huStartA hBasePrevA hBaseAtA
    have hEndPredIndex :
        periodicIndex hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat) - 1) =
          j + (length : ZMod f) := by
      rw [periodicIndex_sub_one, hPeriodicIndex]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hBaseEndPrevA : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat) - 1)) = 1 := by
      rw [hEndPredIndex]
      exact hBaseOne length (by omega)
    have hBaseEndA : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat))) = 0 := by
      rw [hPeriodicIndex]
      exact hBaseEnd
    have huEndA : sigma.periodicU hf (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0 := by
      simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodicIndex] using huEnd
    have huTargetEndA : sigma'.periodicU hf
        (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) = p := by
      simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodicIndex] using huTargetEnd
    have hEnd := pin.niveauTwo_pbEndpointCarryZero hp3 hEmpty J
      hComplementary hJ (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) huEndA huTargetEndA
      hBaseEndPrevA hBaseEndA
    have hWitness := pin.niveauTwo_pbProfileExponentWitness_of_carries J
      hComplementary hJ a (by simpa only [haIndex] using valid) ha ha1
      hLength hSourceZeroA huStartA huTargetStartA hStart.1 hStart.2 hEnd
    simpa only [haIndex] using hWitness

name: KLSposet.Pinning.pb_theta_support_subset_of_minimalPositiveBoundary
statement:
theorem pb_theta_support_subset_of_minimalPositiveBoundary
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty) (hNe : sigma ≠ sigma')
    (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) ≤ 0)
    (hCurrent : 0 < pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j)
    (huZero : sigma.u j = 0) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
        (sigma.theta hf j ⟨by rw [huZero]; omega, by
          rcases (pin.preliminaries hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe).2.1 j
              hPrev hCurrent with ⟨length, _, _, hZero⟩
          simpa using hZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)⟩) ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
proof:
:= by
  rcases (pin.preliminaries hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe).2.1 j hPrev
      hCurrent with ⟨length, hPositive, hEnd, hZero⟩
  apply pin.pb_theta_support_subset hp3 hsubset j length hPrev hPositive hEnd
  intro k hk
  by_cases hkZero : k = 0
  · subst k
    simpa using huZero
  · exact hZero k (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hkZero) hk

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naNegativeCarryStep
statement:
theorem naNegativeCarryStep {p : Nat} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    {xPrev xNext epsilon target : Int}
    (hxPrevLower : -2 ≤ xPrev) (hxPrevNegative : xPrev < 0)
    (hxNextBound : |xNext| ≤ 2)
    (hTargetLower : 0 ≤ target) (hTargetUpper : target ≤ p)
    (hEpsilon : epsilon = 1 ∨ epsilon = -1)
    (hEquation : epsilon * target = (p : Int) * xPrev - xNext) :
    xPrev = -1
proof:
:= by
  rcases abs_le.mp hxNextBound with ⟨hxNextLower, hxNextUpper⟩
  have hxPrev : xPrev = -2 ∨ xPrev = -1 := by omega
  rcases hxPrev with rfl | rfl
  · rcases hEpsilon with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num at hEquation <;> omega
  · rfl

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naNegativeString_normalize
statement:
theorem naNegativeString_normalize {p length : Nat} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (x epsilon target : Nat → Int)
    (hNegative : ∀ i, i ≤ length → x i < 0)
    (hBound : ∀ i, i ≤ length → |x i| ≤ 2)
    (hTargetLower : ∀ i, i < length → 0 ≤ target i)
    (hTargetUpper : ∀ i, i < length → target i ≤ p)
    (hEpsilon : ∀ i, i < length → epsilon i = 1 ∨ epsilon i = -1)
    (hEquation : ∀ i, i < length →
      epsilon i * target i = (p : Int) * x i - x (i + 1)) :
    (∀ i, i < length → x i = -1) ∧
      (x length = -1 ∨ x length = -2)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i hi
    exact naNegativeCarryStep hp3
      (abs_le.mp (hBound i (by omega))).1 (hNegative i (by omega))
      (hBound (i + 1) (by omega)) (hTargetLower i hi) (hTargetUpper i hi)
      (hEpsilon i hi) (hEquation i hi)
  · have hxLower := (abs_le.mp (hBound length (by omega))).1
    have hxNegative := hNegative length (by omega)
    omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naNegativeString_length_lt_period
statement:
theorem naNegativeString_length_lt_period {f length : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (start : ZMod f) (x : ZMod f → Int) (hStart : x start = 0)
    (hNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      x (start + (k : ZMod f)) ≠ 0) :
    length + 1 < f
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hLength
  have hfUpper : f ≤ length + 1 := Nat.le_of_not_gt hLength
  have hfPositive : 1 ≤ f := by omega
  have hAtPeriod := hNonzero f hfPositive hfUpper
  have hIndex : start + (f : ZMod f) = start := by simp
  rw [hIndex, hStart] at hAtPeriod
  exact hAtPeriod rfl

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naPairedZeroAlternative_propagates
statement:
theorem naPairedZeroAlternative_propagates {length : Nat}
    (x s d : Nat → Int)
    (hNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 → x k ≠ 0)
    (hDecomp : ∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 → x k = s k - d k)
    (hAlternative : ∀ i, i ≤ length →
      (s i = 0 ∧ s (i + 1) = 0) ∨
        (d i = 0 ∧ d (i + 1) = 0)) :
    (∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 → s k = 0) ∨
      (∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 → d k = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hZeroSumEdges :
      (s 0 = 0 ∧ s 1 = 0) →
        ∀ i, i ≤ length → s i = 0 ∧ s (i + 1) = 0 := by
    intro hStart i hi
    induction i with
    | zero => simpa using hStart
    | succ i ih =>
        have hPrev := ih (by omega)
        rcases hAlternative (i + 1) hi with hSum | hDiff
        · exact hSum
        · exfalso
          exact hNonzero (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega) (by
            rw [hDecomp (i + 1) (by omega), hPrev.2, hDiff.1]
            norm_num)
  have hZeroDiffEdges :
      (d 0 = 0 ∧ d 1 = 0) →
        ∀ i, i ≤ length → d i = 0 ∧ d (i + 1) = 0 := by
    intro hStart i hi
    induction i with
    | zero => simpa using hStart
    | succ i ih =>
        have hPrev := ih (by omega)
        rcases hAlternative (i + 1) hi with hSum | hDiff
        · exfalso
          exact hNonzero (i + 1) (by omega) (by omega) (by
            rw [hDecomp (i + 1) (by omega), hSum.1, hPrev.2]
            norm_num)
        · exact hDiff
  rcases hAlternative 0 (by omega) with hStart | hStart
  · left
    have hEdges := hZeroSumEdges hStart
    intro k hk
    by_cases hkZero : k = 0
    · simpa [hkZero] using hStart.1
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hkZero
      exact (hEdges i (by omega)).2
  · right
    have hEdges := hZeroDiffEdges hStart
    intro k hk
    by_cases hkZero : k = 0
    · simpa [hkZero] using hStart.1
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hkZero
      exact (hEdges i (by omega)).2

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString
statement:
theorem naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString {length : Nat}
    (x xProfile s d : Nat → Int)
    (hNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 → x k ≠ 0)
    (hBaseDecomp : ∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 → x k = s k - d k)
    (hProfileDecomp : ∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 →
      xProfile k = s k + d k)
    (hAlternative : ∀ i, i ≤ length →
      (s i = 0 ∧ s (i + 1) = 0) ∨
        (d i = 0 ∧ d (i + 1) = 0)) :
    (∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 → xProfile k = x k) ∨
      (∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 → xProfile k = -x k)
proof:
:= by
  rcases naPairedZeroAlternative_propagates x s d hNonzero hBaseDecomp
      hAlternative with hSum | hDiff
  · right
    intro k hk
    rw [hProfileDecomp k hk, hBaseDecomp k hk, hSum k hk]
    ring
  · left
    intro k hk
    rw [hProfileDecomp k hk, hBaseDecomp k hk, hDiff k hk]
    ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f)
    (hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + (k : ZMod f)) ≠ 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ i, i ≤ length →
      sigma.u (j + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0) :
    (∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 →
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + (k : ZMod f)) =
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + (k : ZMod f))) ∨
      (∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 →
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + (k : ZMod f)) =
          -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + (k : ZMod f)))
proof:
:= by
  have hBounds :=
    (pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  apply naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString
    (fun k ↦ pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + (k : ZMod f)))
    (fun k ↦ pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + (k : ZMod f)))
    (fun k ↦ pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
      (j + (k : ZMod f)))
    (fun k ↦ pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
      (j + (k : ZMod f)))
  · exact hBaseNonzero
  · intro k hk
    have hSum := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
      (j + (k : ZMod f))
    have hDifference := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
      (.niveauOne J) hJ (j + (k : ZMod f))
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSum hDifference
    omega
  · intro k hk
    have hSum := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
      (j + (k : ZMod f))
    have hDifference := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
      (.niveauOne J) hJ (j + (k : ZMod f))
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSum hDifference
    omega
  · intro i hi
    have hPred :
        j + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) - 1 = j + (i : ZMod f) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    have hu : sigma.u (j + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0 :=
      hSourceZero i hi
    by_cases hmem : j + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) ∈ J
    · rcases (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J hJ
          (j + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f))).1 hmem with hSum | hDifference
      · left
        rw [hPred] at hSum
        exact boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
          (hBounds.1 (j + (i : ZMod f)))
          (hBounds.1 (j + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f))) hSum
      · right
        simp only [hu, Nat.cast_zero] at hDifference
        rw [hPred] at hDifference
        exact boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
          (hBounds.2 (j + (i : ZMod f)))
          (hBounds.2 (j + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)))
          (by omega)
    · rcases (pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J hJ
          (j + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f))).2 hmem with hSum | hDifference
      · left
        rw [hu, Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero] at hSum
        rw [hPred] at hSum
        exact boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
          (hBounds.1 (j + (i : ZMod f)))
          (hBounds.1 (j + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f))) (by omega)
      · right
        rw [hPred] at hDifference
        exact boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
          (hBounds.2 (j + (i : ZMod f)))
          (hBounds.2 (j + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f))) hDifference

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))) ≠ 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ i, i ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf (a + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0) :
    (∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 →
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
            (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) =
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
            (periodicIndex hf (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))))) ∨
      (∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 →
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
            (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) =
          -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
            (periodicIndex hf (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))))
proof:
:= by
  have hBounds :=
    (pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ).resolve_right hNotExceptional
  apply naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString
    (fun k ↦ pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))))
    (fun k ↦ pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
      (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))))
    (fun k ↦ pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
      (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))))
    (fun k ↦ pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))))
  · exact hBaseNonzero
  · intro k hk
    have hSum := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))
    have hDifference := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSum hDifference
    omega
  · intro k hk
    have hSum := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))
    have hDifference := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSum hDifference
    omega
  · intro i hi
    have hPred : a + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 =
        a + (i : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    have hu : sigma.periodicU hf
        (a + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0 := hSourceZero i hi
    by_cases hmem : a + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) ∈ J
    · rcases (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J
          hComplementary hJ (a + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))).1 hmem with
          hSum | hDifference
      · left
        rw [hPred] at hSum
        exact boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
          (hBounds.1 (a + (i : ZMod (2 * f))))
          (hBounds.1 (a + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))) hSum
      · right
        simp only [hu, Nat.cast_zero] at hDifference
        rw [hPred] at hDifference
        exact boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
          (hBounds.2 (a + (i : ZMod (2 * f))))
          (hBounds.2 (a + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))))
          (by omega)
    · rcases (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J
          hComplementary hJ (a + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))).2 hmem with
          hSum | hDifference
      · left
        rw [hu, Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero] at hSum
        rw [hPred] at hSum
        exact boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
          (hBounds.1 (a + (i : ZMod (2 * f))))
          (hBounds.1 (a + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))) (by omega)
      · right
        rw [hPred] at hDifference
        exact boundedHomogeneousPair_eq_zero hp3
          (hBounds.2 (a + (i : ZMod (2 * f))))
          (hBounds.2 (a + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))) hDifference

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naToggledProfileCarryDichotomy
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naToggledProfileCarryDichotomy
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hNoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJSuccessor : start + (length + 2 : Nat) ∈ J)
    (hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (start + (k : ZMod f)) ≠ 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ i, i ≤ length →
      sigma.u (start + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0)
    (hBaseTerminal :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = -1 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = -2) :
    ∃ hJMinus : Profile.niveauOne
          (symmDiff J {start + (length + 2 : Nat)}) ∈
        compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma',
      start + (length + 2 : Nat) ∉
          symmDiff J {start + (length + 2 : Nat)} ∧
        ((∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 →
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry
                (symmDiff J {start + (length + 2 : Nat)}) hJMinus
                (start + (k : ZMod f)) =
              pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
                (start + (k : ZMod f))) ∨
          (∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 →
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry
                (symmDiff J {start + (length + 2 : Nat)}) hJMinus
                (start + (k : ZMod f)) =
              -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
                (start + (k : ZMod f)))) ∧
        (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry
              (symmDiff J {start + (length + 2 : Nat)}) hJMinus
              (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) ≠ -1 →
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry
                (symmDiff J {start + (length + 2 : Nat)}) hJMinus
                (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 1 ∨
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry
                (symmDiff J {start + (length + 2 : Nat)}) hJMinus
                (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = -2 ∨
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry
                (symmDiff J {start + (length + 2 : Nat)}) hJMinus
                (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let JMinus : Set (ZMod f) :=
    symmDiff J {start + (length + 2 : Nat)}
  let hJMinus : Profile.niveauOne JMinus ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset_of_ne_critical hp3 hf chars sigma
      sigma' hsubset hNoncritical (.niveauOne JMinus)
  have hJSuccessor' : start + ((length : ZMod f) + 2) ∈ J := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hJSuccessor
  have hJMinusSuccessor : start + (length + 2 : Nat) ∉ JMinus := by
    dsimp only [JMinus]
    simp only [Set.mem_symmDiff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    tauto
  have hDichotomy :=
    pin.niveauOne_naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString hp3
      hNotExceptional hEmpty JMinus hJMinus start hBaseNonzero hSourceZero
  refine ⟨hJMinus, hJMinusSuccessor, hDichotomy, ?_⟩
  intro hNotNegOne
  rcases hDichotomy with hSame | hNegative
  · have hTerminal := hSame (length + 1) (by omega)
    rcases hBaseTerminal with hBaseTerminal | hBaseTerminal
    · exfalso
      apply hNotNegOne
      simpa only [JMinus] using hTerminal.trans hBaseTerminal
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by
        simpa only [JMinus] using hTerminal.trans hBaseTerminal))
  · have hTerminal := hNegative (length + 1) (by omega)
    rcases hBaseTerminal with hBaseTerminal | hBaseTerminal
    · exact Or.inl (by
        have hValue :
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus
                (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 1 := by
          calc
            _ = -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
                (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) := hTerminal
            _ = 1 := by rw [hBaseTerminal]; norm_num
        simpa only [JMinus] using hValue)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by
        have hValue :
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus
                (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 2 := by
          calc
            _ = -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
                (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) := hTerminal
            _ = 2 := by rw [hBaseTerminal]; norm_num
        simpa only [JMinus] using hValue))

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_naToggledProfileCarryDichotomy
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naToggledProfileCarryDichotomy
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hNoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod (2 * f)) (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJSuccessor : start + (length + 2 : Nat) ∈ J)
    (hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (start + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))) ≠ 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ i, i ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf
        (start + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0)
    (hBaseTerminal :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat))) = -1 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat))) = -2) :
    ∃ (hMinusComplementary : ∀ i,
          i ∈ symmDiff J
              (periodicIndexSet hf
                {periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat))}) ↔
            i + f ∉ symmDiff J
              (periodicIndexSet hf
                {periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat))}))
      (hJMinus : Profile.niveauTwo
          (symmDiff J
            (periodicIndexSet hf
              {periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat))}))
          hMinusComplementary ∈
        compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma'),
      start + (length + 2 : Nat) ∉
          symmDiff J
            (periodicIndexSet hf
              {periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat))}) ∧
        ((∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 →
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry
                (symmDiff J
                  (periodicIndexSet hf
                    {periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat))}))
                hMinusComplementary hJMinus
                (start + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) =
              pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
                (periodicIndex hf (start + (k : ZMod (2 * f))))) ∨
          (∀ k, k ≤ length + 1 →
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry
                (symmDiff J
                  (periodicIndexSet hf
                    {periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat))}))
                hMinusComplementary hJMinus
                (start + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) =
              -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
                (periodicIndex hf (start + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))))) ∧
        (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry
              (symmDiff J
                (periodicIndexSet hf
                  {periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat))}))
              hMinusComplementary hJMinus
              (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) ≠ -1 →
          pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry
                (symmDiff J
                  (periodicIndexSet hf
                    {periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat))}))
                hMinusComplementary hJMinus
                (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 1 ∨
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry
                (symmDiff J
                  (periodicIndexSet hf
                    {periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat))}))
                hMinusComplementary hJMinus
                (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = -2 ∨
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry
                (symmDiff J
                  (periodicIndexSet hf
                    {periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat))}))
                hMinusComplementary hJMinus
                (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := periodicIndexSet hf
    {periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat))}
  let JMinus : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := symmDiff J T
  have hTPeriodic (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i ∈ T ↔ i + f ∈ T := by
    simp [T, periodicIndexSet, periodicIndex_add_half]
  let hMinusComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ JMinus ↔ i + f ∉ JMinus := by
    intro i
    simp only [JMinus, Set.mem_symmDiff]
    have hJi := hComplementary i
    have hTi := hTPeriodic i
    tauto
  let hJMinus : Profile.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset_of_ne_critical hp3 hf chars sigma
      sigma' hsubset hNoncritical (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary)
  have hSuccessorT : start + (length + 2 : Nat) ∈ T := by
    simp [T, periodicIndexSet]
  have hJMinusSuccessor : start + (length + 2 : Nat) ∉ JMinus := by
    simp only [JMinus, Set.mem_symmDiff]
    tauto
  have hDichotomy :=
    pin.niveauTwo_naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString hp3
      hNotExceptional hEmpty JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus start
      hBaseNonzero hSourceZero
  refine ⟨hMinusComplementary, hJMinus, hJMinusSuccessor, hDichotomy, ?_⟩
  intro hNotNegOne
  rcases hDichotomy with hSame | hNegative
  · have hTerminal := hSame (length + 1) (by omega)
    rcases hBaseTerminal with hBaseTerminal | hBaseTerminal
    · exfalso
      apply hNotNegOne
      simpa only [JMinus, T] using hTerminal.trans hBaseTerminal
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by
        simpa only [JMinus, T] using hTerminal.trans hBaseTerminal))
  · have hTerminal := hNegative (length + 1) (by omega)
    rcases hBaseTerminal with hBaseTerminal | hBaseTerminal
    · exact Or.inl (by
        have hValue :
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
                (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 1 := by
          calc
            _ = -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
                (periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat))) := hTerminal
            _ = 1 := by rw [hBaseTerminal]; norm_num
        simpa only [JMinus, T] using hValue)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by
        have hValue :
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
                (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 2 := by
          calc
            _ = -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
                (periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat))) := hTerminal
            _ = 2 := by rw [hBaseTerminal]; norm_num
        simpa only [JMinus, T] using hValue))

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naCarryIntervalWeightedSum
statement:
theorem naCarryIntervalWeightedSum {p n length : Nat}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (j : ZMod n) (x : Nat → Int)
    (hStart : x 0 = 0) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
        (↑((p : Int) * x k - x (k + 1)) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
          inversePower p n hn (j + (k + 1 : Nat))) =
      -(x (length + 1) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
        inversePower p n hn (j + (length + 1 : Nat))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pbCarryIntervalWeightedSum hp hn j x, hStart]
  simp

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naCarryIntervalWeightedSum_withEndpoint
statement:
theorem naCarryIntervalWeightedSum_withEndpoint {p n length : Nat}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (j : ZMod n) (x : Nat → Int)
    (u : Int) (hStart : x 0 = 0) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
        (↑((p : Int) * x k - x (k + 1)) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
          inversePower p n hn (j + (k + 1 : Nat))) +
        (↑(u + (p : Int) * x (length + 1) - x (length + 2)) :
            ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
          inversePower p n hn (j + (length + 2 : Nat)) =
      (↑(u - x (length + 2)) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
        inversePower p n hn (j + (length + 2 : Nat))
proof:
:= by
  rw [naCarryIntervalWeightedSum hp hn j x hStart]
  have hRecurrence := inversePower_succ p n hp hn
    (j + (length + 1 : Nat))
  have hIndex : j + (length + 1 : Nat) + 1 =
      j + (length + 2 : Nat) := by
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hIndex] at hRecurrence
  simp only [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
  rw [← hRecurrence]
  ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naSignedIntervalWeightedSum_withEndpoint
statement:
theorem naSignedIntervalWeightedSum_withEndpoint {p n length : Nat}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (start : ZMod n) (x : Nat → Int)
    (v : ZMod n → Int) (u : Int) (hLength : length + 2 < n)
    (hInterior : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      v (start + (k + 1 : Nat)) = (p : Int) * x k - x (k + 1))
    (hEndpoint : v (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) =
      u + (p : Int) * x (length + 1) - x (length + 2))
    (hStart : x 0 = 0) :
    translationExponent p n hn (fun i ↦
        (↑(paCyclicInterval start (length + 1)) : Set (ZMod n)).indicator
          (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i * v i) =
      (↑(u - x (length + 2)) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
        inversePower p n hn (start + (length + 2 : Nat))
proof:
:= by
  rw [translationExponent_paCyclicInterval hn start hLength]
  rw [show length + 1 + 1 = length + 2 by omega, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
          (v (start + (k + 1 : Nat)) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
            inversePower p n hn (start + (k + 1 : Nat))) +
        (v (start + (length + 1 + 1 : Nat)) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
          inversePower p n hn (start + (length + 1 + 1 : Nat)) =
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
          (↑((p : Int) * x k - x (k + 1)) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
            inversePower p n hn (start + (k + 1 : Nat))) +
        (↑(u + (p : Int) * x (length + 1) - x (length + 2)) :
            ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
          inversePower p n hn (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) := by
      congr 1
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k hk
        rw [hInterior k (by
          have hk' := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
          omega)]
      · have hIndex : start + (length + 1 + 1 : Nat) =
            start + (length + 2 : Nat) := by
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [hIndex, hEndpoint]
    _ = (↑(u - x (length + 2)) : ZMod (p ^ n - 1)) *
          inversePower p n hn (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
        naCarryIntervalWeightedSum_withEndpoint hp hn start x u hStart

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naEndpointP_length_lt_period
statement:
theorem naEndpointP_length_lt_period {p f length : Nat}
    (start : ZMod f) (u : ZMod f → Nat) (x : ZMod f → Int)
    (hPrefix : length + 1 < f)
    (huStrict : u (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) < p)
    (hStart : x start = 0)
    (hEndpoint : (u (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) : Int) -
      x (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) = p) :
    length + 2 < f
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hNotLength
  have hLengthEq : length + 2 = f := by omega
  have hIndex : start + (length + 2 : Nat) = start := by
    rw [hLengthEq]
    simp
  have hEndpoint' := hEndpoint
  rw [hIndex, hStart] at hEndpoint'
  have huStrict' : (u (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) : Int) < p := by
    exact_mod_cast huStrict
  rw [hIndex] at huStrict'
  omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naTerminalNegOneSignedIntervalWeightedSum
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naTerminalNegOneSignedIntervalWeightedSum
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod f) (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.u (start + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hStart : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ start = 0)
    (hEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
      (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = -1) :
    translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦
        (↑(paCyclicInterval start length) : Set (ZMod f)).indicator
          (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
            ((Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i *
              (sigma'.u i : Int))) =
      inversePower p f hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat))
proof:
:= by
  rw [translationExponent_paCyclicInterval hf start hLength]
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
        (↑((Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign
            (start + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) *
              (sigma'.u (start + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) : Int)) :
            ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (start + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f))) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (length + 1),
        (↑((p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
              (start + ((k : Nat) : ZMod f)) -
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
