              (start + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f))) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf
            (start + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      have hEquation := pin.niveauOne_paCarryEquation J hJ
        (start + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f))
        (hSourceZero k (by
          have hk' := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
          omega))
      have hPred : start + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) - 1 =
          start + ((k : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hPred] at hEquation
      rw [hEquation]
    _ = (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ start : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf start -
        (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
            (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using
        pbCarryIntervalWeightedSum (by omega : 1 ≤ p) hf start
          (fun k ↦ pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (start + (k : Nat)))
    _ = inversePower p f hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) := by
      rw [hStart, hEnd]
      norm_num

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_naTerminalNegOneSignedPeriodicIntervalWeightedSum
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naTerminalNegOneSignedPeriodicIntervalWeightedSum
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod (2 * f)) (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf (start + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hStart : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ start = 0)
    (hEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
      (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = -1) :
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
        (periodicIndexSet hf
            (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf start) length) :
              Set (ZMod f))).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
          (Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign i *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)) =
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf
          (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) -
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf
          (start + (length + 1 : Nat) + f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
  let hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K :=
    pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ
  let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := ↑(paCyclicInterval start length)
  let Tf : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    ↑(paCyclicInterval (start + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) length)
  have hPeriodic : periodicIndexSet hf
        (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf start) length) : Set (ZMod f)) =
      T ∪ Tf := by
    simpa only [T, Tf] using periodicIndexSet_paCyclicInterval hf start
  have hDisjoint : Disjoint T Tf := by
    simpa only [T, Tf] using paCyclicInterval_disjoint_add_half start hLength
  have hFirst := pin.niveauTwo_pbSignedIntervalWeightedSum_eq_endpoints J
    hComplementary hJ start (by omega : length + 1 < 2 * f) hSourceZero
  rw [hStart, hEnd] at hFirst
  norm_num at hFirst
  have hAnti := niveauTwoCarryEquation_antiPeriodic hp hf sigma sigma' J K
    hComplementary hK (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ)
  have hStartHalf : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
      (start + f) = 0 := by
    rw [hAnti start, hStart]
    norm_num
  have hEndHalf : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
      (start + f + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 1 := by
    have hIndex : start + f + (length + 1 : Nat) =
        start + (length + 1 : Nat) + f := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hIndex, hAnti (start + (length + 1 : Nat)), hEnd]
    norm_num
  have hSourceZeroHalf : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf (start + f + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    have hIndex : start + f + (k + 1 : Nat) =
        start + (k + 1 : Nat) + f := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hIndex, PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_add_half]
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hSourceZero k hk
  have hHalf := pin.niveauTwo_pbSignedIntervalWeightedSum_eq_endpoints J
    hComplementary hJ (start + f) (by omega : length + 1 < 2 * f)
    hSourceZeroHalf
  rw [hStartHalf, hEndHalf] at hHalf
  norm_num at hHalf
  have hfun :
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        ((T ∪ Tf).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i) *
          (Profile.niveauTwo K hK).sign i *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          T.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
            ((Profile.niveauTwo K hK).sign i *
              (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int))) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          Tf.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
            ((Profile.niveauTwo K hK).sign i *
              (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int))) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hiT : i ∈ T
    · have hiTf : i ∉ Tf := fun hi ↦ Set.disjoint_left.mp hDisjoint hiT hi
      simp [Set.indicator, hiT, hiTf]
    · by_cases hiTf : i ∈ Tf <;> simp [Set.indicator, hiT, hiTf]
  rw [hPeriodic, hfun, translationExponent_add]
  change _ = _ at hFirst hHalf ⊢
  rw [hFirst, hHalf]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [show start + f + ((length : ZMod (2 * f)) + 1) =
    start + ((length : ZMod (2 * f)) + 1) + f by ring]

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naEndpointPSignedIntervalWeightedSum
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naEndpointPSignedIntervalWeightedSum
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod f) (hLength : length + 2 < f)
    (hEndpointNotMem : start + (length + 2 : Nat) ∉ J)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.u (start + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hStart : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ start = 0)
    (hEndpoint :
      (sigma.u (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) : Int) -
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
            (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) = p) :
    translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦
        (↑(paCyclicInterval start (length + 1)) : Set (ZMod f)).indicator
          (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
            ((Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i *
              (sigma'.u i : Int))) =
      inversePower p f hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat))
proof:
:= by
  let endpoint : ZMod f := start + (length + 2 : Nat)
  let x : Nat → Int := fun k ↦
    pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (start + (k : Nat))
  let v : ZMod f → Int := fun i ↦
    (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i *
      (sigma'.u i : Int)
  have hInterior : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      v (start + (k + 1 : Nat)) = (p : Int) * x k - x (k + 1) := by
    intro k hk
    have hEquation := pin.niveauOne_paCarryEquation J hJ
      (start + (k + 1 : Nat)) (hSourceZero k hk)
    have hPred : start + (k + 1 : Nat) - 1 = start + (k : Nat) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hPred] at hEquation
    simpa only [v, x] using hEquation
  have hEndpointEquation : v endpoint =
      (sigma.u endpoint : Int) + (p : Int) * x (length + 1) -
        x (length + 2) := by
    have hSourceSign : (Profile.niveauOne J).sign endpoint = 1 := by
      have hEndpointNotMem' : endpoint ∉ J := by
        simpa only [endpoint] using hEndpointNotMem
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        hEndpointNotMem']
    have hRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec J hJ endpoint
    have hPred : endpoint - 1 = start + (length + 1 : Nat) := by
      simp only [endpoint]
      push_cast
      ring
    simp only [niveauOneCarryInput] at hRaw
    rw [hSourceSign, hPred] at hRaw
    norm_num at hRaw
    have hRaw' :
        (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign endpoint *
              (sigma'.u endpoint : Int) - (sigma.u endpoint : Int) =
          (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
              (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) -
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ endpoint := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hRaw
    dsimp only [v, x]
    linear_combination hRaw'
  have hTel := naSignedIntervalWeightedSum_withEndpoint
    (by omega : 1 ≤ p) hf start x v (sigma.u endpoint : Int) hLength
    hInterior hEndpointEquation (by dsimp only [x]; simpa using hStart)
  have hEndpoint' : (sigma.u endpoint : Int) - x (length + 2) = p := by
    simpa only [endpoint, x] using hEndpoint
  rw [hEndpoint'] at hTel
  have hRecurrence := inversePower_succ p f (by omega : 1 ≤ p) hf
    (start + (length + 1 : Nat))
  have hIndex : start + (length + 1 : Nat) + 1 = endpoint := by
    simp only [endpoint]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hIndex] at hRecurrence
  change translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦
      (↑(paCyclicInterval start (length + 1)) : Set (ZMod f)).indicator
        (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i * v i) = _
  rw [hTel]
  simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using hRecurrence

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_naEndpointPSignedPeriodicIntervalWeightedSum
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naEndpointPSignedPeriodicIntervalWeightedSum
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod (2 * f)) (hLength : length + 2 < f)
    (hEndpointNotMem : start + (length + 2 : Nat) ∉ J)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf (start + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hStart : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ start = 0)
    (hEndpoint :
      (sigma.periodicU hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) : Int) -
          pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
            (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) = p) :
    translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
        (periodicIndexSet hf
            (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf start) (length + 1)) :
              Set (ZMod f))).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
          (Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign i *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)) =
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf
          (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) -
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf
          (start + (length + 1 : Nat) + f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
  let hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K :=
    pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ
  let prev : ZMod (2 * f) := start + (length + 1 : Nat)
  let endpoint : ZMod (2 * f) := start + (length + 2 : Nat)
  let v : ZMod (2 * f) → Int := fun i ↦
    (Profile.niveauTwo K hK).sign i * (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)
  let x : Nat → Int := fun k ↦
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (start + (k : Nat))
  have hInterior : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      v (start + (k + 1 : Nat)) = (p : Int) * x k - x (k + 1) := by
    intro k hk
    have hEquation := pin.niveauTwo_paCarryEquation J hComplementary hJ
      (start + (k + 1 : Nat)) (hSourceZero k hk)
    have hPred : start + (k + 1 : Nat) - 1 = start + (k : Nat) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hPred] at hEquation
    simpa only [v, K, hK, x] using hEquation
  have hEndpointEquation : v endpoint =
      (sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) +
          (p : Int) * x (length + 1) - x (length + 2) := by
    have hEndpointNotMem' : endpoint ∉ J := by
      simpa only [endpoint] using hEndpointNotMem
    have hSourceSign : (Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary).sign endpoint = 1 := by
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        hEndpointNotMem']
    have hRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ endpoint
    have hPred : endpoint - 1 = prev := by
      simp only [endpoint, prev]
      push_cast
      ring
    simp only [niveauTwoCarryInput] at hRaw
    rw [hSourceSign, hPred] at hRaw
    norm_num at hRaw
    have hRaw' :
        (Profile.niveauTwo K hK).sign endpoint *
              (sigma'.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) -
            (sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) =
          (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ prev -
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ endpoint := by
      simpa only [K, hK] using hRaw
    dsimp only [v, x]
    change (Profile.niveauTwo K hK).sign endpoint *
          (sigma'.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) =
        (sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) +
          (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ prev -
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ endpoint
    linear_combination hRaw'
  have hFirstTel := naSignedIntervalWeightedSum_withEndpoint
    (by omega : 1 ≤ p) (by omega : 2 ≤ 2 * f) start x v
      (sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) (by omega : length + 2 < 2 * f)
      hInterior hEndpointEquation (by dsimp only [x]; simpa using hStart)
  have hEndpoint' :
      (sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) - x (length + 2) = p := by
    simpa only [endpoint, x] using hEndpoint
  rw [hEndpoint'] at hFirstTel
  have hFirstRecurrence := niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_succ p f
    (by omega : 1 ≤ p) hf prev
  have hPrevSucc : prev + 1 = endpoint := by
    simp only [prev, endpoint]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hPrevSucc] at hFirstRecurrence
  have hFirst :
      translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
          (↑(paCyclicInterval start (length + 1)) :
            Set (ZMod (2 * f))).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i * v i) =
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf prev := by
    rw [hFirstTel]
    simpa only [Int.cast_natCast] using hFirstRecurrence
  have hAnti := niveauTwoCarryEquation_antiPeriodic hp hf sigma sigma' J K
    hComplementary hK (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ)
  let startHalf : ZMod (2 * f) := start + f
  let xHalf : Nat → Int := fun k ↦
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (startHalf + (k : Nat))
  have hStartHalf : xHalf 0 = 0 := by
    dsimp only [xHalf]
    rw [show startHalf + (0 : Nat) = start + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) by
      simp [startHalf]]
    rw [hAnti start, hStart]
    norm_num
  have hSourceZeroHalf : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf (startHalf + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    have hIndex : startHalf + (k + 1 : Nat) =
        start + (k + 1 : Nat) + f := by
      simp only [startHalf]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hIndex, PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_add_half]
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hSourceZero k hk
  have hInteriorHalf : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      v (startHalf + (k + 1 : Nat)) =
        (p : Int) * xHalf k - xHalf (k + 1) := by
    intro k hk
    have hEquation := pin.niveauTwo_paCarryEquation J hComplementary hJ
      (startHalf + (k + 1 : Nat)) (hSourceZeroHalf k hk)
    have hPred : startHalf + (k + 1 : Nat) - 1 =
        startHalf + (k : Nat) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hPred] at hEquation
    simpa only [v, K, hK, xHalf] using hEquation
  have hEndpointDouble : endpoint + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) + f = endpoint := by
    calc
      endpoint + f + f = endpoint + (2 * f : Nat) := by push_cast; ring
      _ = endpoint := by simp
  have hEndpointNotMem' : endpoint ∉ J := by
    simpa only [endpoint] using hEndpointNotMem
  have hEndpointHalfMem : endpoint + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) ∈ J := by
    apply (hComplementary (endpoint + (f : ZMod (2 * f)))).2
    rw [hEndpointDouble]
    exact hEndpointNotMem'
  have hEndpointHalfEquation : v (endpoint + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) =
      -(sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) +
          (p : Int) * xHalf (length + 1) - xHalf (length + 2) := by
    have hSourceSign :
        (Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary).sign
            (endpoint + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) = (-1 : Int) := by
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        hEndpointHalfMem]
    have hRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ
      (endpoint + (f : ZMod (2 * f)))
    have hPred : endpoint + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 =
        startHalf + (length + 1 : Nat) := by
      simp only [endpoint, startHalf]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hPeriodicSource : sigma.periodicU hf
        (endpoint + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) =
        sigma.periodicU hf endpoint := by
      simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_add_half]
    simp only [niveauTwoCarryInput] at hRaw
    rw [hSourceSign, hPeriodicSource, hPred] at hRaw
    norm_num at hRaw
    have hRaw' :
        v (endpoint + (f : ZMod (2 * f))) +
            (sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) =
          (p : Int) * xHalf (length + 1) - xHalf (length + 2) := by
      dsimp only [v, xHalf]
      rw [show startHalf + (length + 2 : Nat) =
        endpoint + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) by
          simp only [startHalf, endpoint]
          push_cast
          ring]
      convert hRaw using 1
      all_goals simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    linear_combination hRaw'
  have hStartHalfEndpoint : startHalf + (length + 2 : Nat) =
      endpoint + (f : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
    simp only [startHalf, endpoint]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hHalfTel := naSignedIntervalWeightedSum_withEndpoint
    (by omega : 1 ≤ p) (by omega : 2 ≤ 2 * f) startHalf xHalf v
      (-(sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int))
      (by omega : length + 2 < 2 * f) hInteriorHalf
      (by rw [hStartHalfEndpoint]; exact hEndpointHalfEquation) hStartHalf
  have hEndHalf : xHalf (length + 2) = -x (length + 2) := by
    dsimp only [xHalf, x]
    rw [hStartHalfEndpoint, hAnti endpoint]
  have hHalfCoefficient :
      -(sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) - xHalf (length + 2) =
        -(p : Int) := by
    rw [hEndHalf]
    linear_combination -hEndpoint'
  rw [hHalfCoefficient] at hHalfTel
  rw [hStartHalfEndpoint] at hHalfTel
  have hHalfRecurrence := niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_succ p f
    (by omega : 1 ≤ p) hf (prev + f)
  have hHalfSucc : prev + f + 1 = endpoint + f := by
    calc
      prev + f + 1 = prev + 1 + f := by ring
      _ = endpoint + f := by rw [hPrevSucc]
  rw [hHalfSucc] at hHalfRecurrence
  have hHalfRecurrence' :
      (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          inversePower p (2 * f) (by omega) (endpoint + f) =
        inversePower p (2 * f) (by omega) (prev + f) := by
    simpa only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent] using hHalfRecurrence
  have hHalf :
      translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega) (fun i ↦
          (↑(paCyclicInterval startHalf (length + 1)) :
            Set (ZMod (2 * f))).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i * v i) =
        -niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (prev + f) := by
    rw [hHalfTel]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]
    rw [neg_mul, hHalfRecurrence']
    simp only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent]
  let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := ↑(paCyclicInterval start (length + 1))
  let Tf : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := ↑(paCyclicInterval startHalf (length + 1))
  have hPeriodic : periodicIndexSet hf
        (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf start) (length + 1)) :
          Set (ZMod f)) = T ∪ Tf := by
    simpa only [T, Tf, startHalf] using
      periodicIndexSet_paCyclicInterval hf start
  have hDisjoint : Disjoint T Tf := by
    simpa only [T, Tf, startHalf] using
      paCyclicInterval_disjoint_add_half start hLength
  have hfun :
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        ((T ∪ Tf).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i) * v i) =
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        T.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i * v i) +
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        Tf.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i * v i) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hiT : i ∈ T
    · have hiTf : i ∉ Tf := fun hi ↦ Set.disjoint_left.mp hDisjoint hiT hi
      simp [Set.indicator, hiT, hiTf]
    · by_cases hiTf : i ∈ Tf <;> simp [Set.indicator, hiT, hiTf]
  have hGoalFun :
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        (periodicIndexSet hf
            (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf start) (length + 1)) :
              Set (ZMod f))).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
          (Profile.niveauTwo
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
              (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign i *
            (sigma'.periodicU hf i : Int)) =
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        (periodicIndexSet hf
            (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf start) (length + 1)) :
              Set (ZMod f))).indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i * v i) := by
    funext i
    simp only [v, K, mul_assoc]
  rw [hGoalFun]
  rw [hPeriodic, hfun, translationExponent_add]
  change _ = _ at hFirst hHalf ⊢
  rw [hFirst, hHalf]
  simp only [prev]
  ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_naEndpointP_length_lt_period
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naEndpointP_length_lt_period
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod (2 * f)) (hPrefix : length + 1 < f)
    (huStrict : sigma.periodicU hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) < p)
    (hStart : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ start = 0)
    (hEndpoint :
      (sigma.periodicU hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) : Int) -
          pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
            (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) = p) :
    length + 2 < f
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hNotLength
  have hLengthEq : length + 2 = f := by omega
  let K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
  let hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K :=
    pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ
  have hAnti := niveauTwoCarryEquation_antiPeriodic hp hf sigma sigma' J K
    hComplementary hK (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ)
  have hIndex : start + (length + 2 : Nat) = start + f := by
    rw [hLengthEq]
  have hEndpoint' := hEndpoint
  rw [hIndex, hAnti start, hStart] at hEndpoint'
  norm_num at hEndpoint'
  have huStrict' :
      (sigma.periodicU hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) : Int) < p := by
    exact_mod_cast huStrict
  rw [hIndex] at huStrict'
  omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naEndpointAlternative
statement:
theorem naEndpointAlternative {p : Nat} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    {u sPrev sNext dPrev dNext : Int}
    (hdPrev : |dPrev| ≤ 2) (hdNext : |dNext| ≤ 2)
    (hAlternative :
      -u = (p : Int) * sPrev - sNext ∨
        (p : Int) * dPrev = dNext) :
    (-u = (p : Int) * sPrev - sNext) ∨
      (dPrev = 0 ∧ dNext = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hAlternative with hSum | hDifference
  · exact Or.inl hSum
  · right
    rcases abs_le.mp hdPrev with ⟨hdPrevLower, hdPrevUpper⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hdNext with ⟨hdNextLower, hdNextUpper⟩
    interval_cases dPrev <;> norm_num at hDifference ⊢ <;> omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naEndpointAlternative_of_pinnedCarries
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naEndpointAlternative_of_pinnedCarries
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hi : i ∉ J) :
    (-(sigma.u i : Int) =
        (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) -
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i) ∨
      (pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ (i - 1) = 0 ∧
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hBounds :=
    (pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  exact naEndpointAlternative hp3 (hBounds.2 (i - 1)) (hBounds.2 i)
    ((pin.niveauOnePairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J hJ i).2 hi)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_naEndpointAlternative_of_pinnedCarries
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naEndpointAlternative_of_pinnedCarries
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) (hi : i ∉ J) :
    (-(sigma.periodicU hf i : Int) =
        (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty
            (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1) -
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i) ∨
      (pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
            (i - 1) = 0 ∧
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
            i = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hBounds :=
    (pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ).resolve_right hNotExceptional
  exact naEndpointAlternative hp3 (hBounds.2 (i - 1)) (hBounds.2 i)
    ((pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J hComplementary
      hJ i).2 hi)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naExponentBridge
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naExponentBridge {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.NuValid j)
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J) :
    (sigma.nu hp hf j valid).t +
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.nu hp hf j valid) J =
      sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff J {j + 1}) +
        inversePower p f hf j
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  let u1 := sigma.u (j + 1)
  have hsumNu :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.nu hp hf j valid) J =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J + 2 * inversePower p f hf j -
          2 * (u1 : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf (j + 1) := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
      ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
          (((sigma.nu hp hf j valid).u i : Nat) : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.u i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then 1 else 0) +
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          if i = j + 1 then (p : Int) - 2 * (u1 : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp [PhantomWeight.nu, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hj, Ne.symm hsucc]
      · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
        · subst i
          have hu1le : u1 ≤ p := sigma.u_le _
          simp only [PhantomWeight.nu, hsucc, if_false, if_pos, Pi.add_apply]
          rw [Nat.cast_sub hu1le]
          simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hj1, u1]
          ring
        · simp [PhantomWeight.nu, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
            Profile.set, hij, hij1]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, translationExponent_add,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_one, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
    rw [sub_mul, inversePower_succ p f hp hf j]
    ring
  have hsumToggle :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff J {j + 1}) =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J -
          (u1 : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf (j + 1) := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
      ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne (symmDiff J {j + 1})).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.u i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.u i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          if i = j + 1 then -(u1 : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
          Set.mem_symmDiff, hj1, u1]
      · have hiff : i ∈ symmDiff J {j + 1} ↔ i ∈ J := by
          simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hi]
        simp only [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set]
        by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J
        · have hiSymm := hiff.mpr hiJ
          simp [hiJ, hiSymm, hi]
        · have hiSymm : i ∉ symmDiff J {j + 1} := fun h ↦ hiJ (hiff.mp h)
          simp [hiJ, hiSymm, hi]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]
    ring
  rw [show (sigma.nu hp hf j valid).t =
      sigma.t - inversePower p f hf j +
        (u1 : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf (j + 1) by rfl,
    hsumNu, hsumToggle]
  ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_naExponentBridge
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naExponentBridge {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (valid : sigma.NuValid (periodicIndex hf a))
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (ha : a ∈ J) (ha1 : a + 1 ∈ J) :
    liftQPlusOne p f
          (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid).t +
        niveauTwoProfileSum hf
          (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J =
      liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
          niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff J {a + 1, a + 1 + f}) +
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a -
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + f)
proof:
:= by
  have hperiodicSucc :
      periodicIndex hf (a + 1) = periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_one]
  have hsucc : periodicIndex hf a + 1 ≠ periodicIndex hf a := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (periodicIndex hf a + 1) - periodicIndex hf a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hsuccDouble : a + 1 ≠ a := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod (2 * f)) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod (2 * f)) = (a + 1) - a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have haHalf : a + f ∉ J := (hJ a).mp ha
  have ha1Half : a + 1 + f ∉ J := (hJ (a + 1)).mp ha1
  have hhalf : (f : ZMod (2 * f)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hdiv : 2 * f ∣ f :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff f (2 * f)).mp hzero
    have hle : 2 * f ≤ f := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdiv
    omega
  have hhalfSelf (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i + f ≠ i := by
    intro h
    apply hhalf
    calc
      (f : ZMod (2 * f)) = (i + f) - i := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  let u1 := sigma.u (periodicIndex hf (a + 1))
  have hsumNu :
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf
          (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J =
        niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J +
          2 * niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a -
          2 * (u1 : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1) := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J hJ,
      ← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf sigma J hJ]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (((sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid).periodicU
              hf i : Nat) : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦ if i = a then (1 : Int) else 0) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          if i = a + 1 then (p : Int) - 2 * (u1 : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf a
      · rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i a).mp hi with rfl | rfl
        · simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.nu,
            Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, ha,
            Ne.symm hsuccDouble]
        · have hne1 : a + f ≠ a + 1 := by
            intro h
            apply hsucc
            calc
              periodicIndex hf a + 1 = periodicIndex hf (a + 1) :=
                hperiodicSucc.symm
              _ = periodicIndex hf (a + f) := by rw [h]
              _ = periodicIndex hf a := periodicIndex_add_half hf a
          simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, haHalf,
            hhalfSelf, hne1]
      · by_cases hi1 : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf (a + 1)
        · rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i (a + 1)).mp hi1 with
            rfl | rfl
          · have hu1le : u1 ≤ p := sigma.u_le _
            simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.nu,
              hperiodicSucc, hsucc, if_false, if_pos, Pi.add_apply]
            rw [← hperiodicSucc]
            rw [Nat.cast_sub hu1le]
            simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, ha1,
              hsuccDouble, u1]
            ring
          · have hne0 : a + 1 + f ≠ a := by
              intro h
              apply hsucc
              calc
                periodicIndex hf a + 1 = periodicIndex hf (a + 1) :=
                  hperiodicSucc.symm
                _ = periodicIndex hf (a + 1 + f) :=
                  (periodicIndex_add_half hf (a + 1)).symm
                _ = periodicIndex hf a := by rw [h]
            have hne1 : a + 1 + f ≠ a + 1 := hhalfSelf (a + 1)
            simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.nu,
              hi1, hperiodicSucc, hsucc, Profile.indicator,
              Profile.Contains, Profile.set, ha1Half, hne0, hne1]
        · have hia : i ≠ a := fun h ↦ hi (h ▸ rfl)
          have hia1 : i ≠ a + 1 := fun h ↦ hi1 (h ▸ rfl)
          have hi1' : periodicIndex hf i ≠ periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
            rw [← hperiodicSucc]
            exact hi1
          simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.nu, hi,
            hi1', hia, hia1]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, translationExponent_add,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_one, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
    rw [sub_mul, inversePower_succ p (2 * f) (by omega) (by omega) a]
    simp only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent]
    ring
  let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := {a + 1, a + 1 + f}
  have htwice (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i + f + f = i := by
    calc
      i + f + f = i + (2 * f : Nat) := by push_cast; ring
      _ = i := by simp
  have hTperiodic (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i ∈ T ↔ i + f ∈ T := by
    simp only [T, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact Or.inr rfl
      · left
        exact htwice (a + 1)
    · rintro (h | h)
      · right
        calc
          i = i + f + f := (htwice i).symm
          _ = a + 1 + f := by rw [h]
      · left
        exact add_right_cancel h
  have hJToggle : ∀ i, i ∈ symmDiff J T ↔ i + f ∉ symmDiff J T := by
    intro i
    simp only [Set.mem_symmDiff]
    have hJi := hJ i
    have hTi := hTperiodic i
    tauto
  have hsumToggle :
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff J T) =
        niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J -
          (u1 : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1) +
          (u1 : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1 + f) := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf sigma (symmDiff J T)
        hJToggle,
      ← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf sigma J hJ]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo (symmDiff J T) hJToggle).indicator i : Int) *
              (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦ if i = a + 1 then -(u1 : Int) else 0) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          if i = a + 1 + f then (u1 : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = a + 1
      · subst i
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
          Set.mem_symmDiff, T, ha1,
          Ne.symm (hhalfSelf (a + 1)), u1,
          PhantomWeight.periodicU]
      · by_cases hif : i = a + 1 + f
        · subst i
          simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
            Set.mem_symmDiff, T, ha1Half, hi, u1,
            PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_add_half]
        · have hiT : i ∉ T := by simp [T, hi, hif]
          have hiff : i ∈ symmDiff J T ↔ i ∈ J := by
            simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT]
          simp only [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set]
          by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J
          · have hiSymm := hiff.mpr hiJ
            simp [hiJ, hiSymm, hi, hif]
          · have hiSymm : i ∉ symmDiff J T := fun h ↦ hiJ (hiff.mp h)
            simp [hiJ, hiSymm, hi, hif]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, translationExponent_add,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_neg]
    simp only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent]
    ring
  rw [show
    (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid).t =
      sigma.t - inversePower p f hf (periodicIndex hf a) +
        (sigma.u (periodicIndex hf a + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (periodicIndex hf a + 1) by rfl]
  dsimp [T] at hsumToggle
  rw [hsumNu, hsumToggle, liftQPlusOne_add hp hf,
    liftQPlusOne_sub hp hf, ← hperiodicSucc,
    liftQPlusOne_natCast_mul hp hf,
    ← niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_half_eq_lift hp hf a,
    ← niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_half_eq_lift hp hf (a + 1)]
  simp only [u1]
  ring

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naTerminalNegOnePinnedProfileExponentWitness
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naTerminalNegOnePinnedProfileExponentWitness
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod f) (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid (start + (length + 1 : Nat)))
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJPrev : start + (length + 1 : Nat) ∈ J)
    (hJEndpoint : start + (length + 2 : Nat) ∈ J)
    (hJMinus : Profile.niveauOne
        (symmDiff J {start + (length + 2 : Nat)}) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.u (start + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hStart : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry
      (symmDiff J {start + (length + 2 : Nat)}) hJMinus start = 0)
    (hEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry
      (symmDiff J {start + (length + 2 : Nat)}) hJMinus
        (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = -1) :
    ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
      profileLeftExponent hf
          (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) valid)
          (.niveauOne J) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauOne K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  let prev : ZMod f := start + (length + 1 : Nat)
  let endpoint : ZMod f := start + (length + 2 : Nat)
  let JMinus : Set (ZMod f) := symmDiff J {endpoint}
  let K : Set (ZMod f) := pin.niveauOneTarget JMinus hJMinus
  let T : Set (ZMod f) := ↑(paCyclicInterval start length)
  have hPair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne JMinus) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne K) := by
    rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec JMinus hJMinus]
    exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus
  have hCongr := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' JMinus K hPair
  have hSigned :=
    pin.niveauOne_naTerminalNegOneSignedIntervalWeightedSum JMinus hJMinus
      start hLength hSourceZero hStart hEnd
  have hToggle := niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_eq_add_signed hf sigma' K T
  have hfun :
      (fun i : ZMod f ↦
        ((Profile.niveauOne T).indicator i : Int) *
          (Profile.niveauOne K).sign i * (sigma'.u i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ T.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
          ((Profile.niveauOne K).sign i * (sigma'.u i : Int))) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ T <;>
      simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, Set.indicator,
        hi]
  rw [hfun, hSigned] at hToggle
  have hSucc : prev + 1 = endpoint := by
    simp only [prev, endpoint]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hBridge := niveauOne_naExponentBridge (by omega : 1 ≤ p) hf sigma
    prev valid J (by simpa only [prev] using hJPrev)
      (by rw [hSucc]; simpa only [endpoint] using hJEndpoint)
  rw [hSucc] at hBridge
  refine ⟨symmDiff K T, ?_⟩
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
  change (sigma.nu (by omega) hf prev valid).t +
      niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf prev valid) J =
    sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' (symmDiff K T)
  rw [hBridge, hToggle]
  linear_combination hCongr

statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naTerminalNegOnePinnedProfileExponentWitness
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]

  have hTPeriodic (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i ∈ T ↔ i + f ∈ T := by
    simp [T, periodicIndexSet, periodicIndex_add_half]
  have hL : ∀ i, i ∈ L ↔ i + f ∉ L := by
    intro i
    simp only [L, Set.mem_symmDiff]
    have hKi := hK i
    have hTi := hTPeriodic i
    tauto
  have hPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma
          (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK) := by
    rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus]
    exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus
  have hCongr := niveauTwoProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' JMinus K hMinusComplementary hK hPair
  have hSigned :=
    pin.niveauTwo_naTerminalNegOneSignedPeriodicIntervalWeightedSum JMinus
      hMinusComplementary hJMinus start hLength hSourceZero hStart hEnd
  have hToggle := niveauTwoProfileSum_symmDiff_eq_add_signed hf sigma' K T hK
  rw [hSigned] at hToggle
  change niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' L = _ at hToggle
  have hSucc : prev + 1 = endpoint := by
    simp only [prev, endpoint]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hBridge := niveauTwo_naExponentBridge (by omega : 2 ≤ p) hf sigma
    prev valid J hComplementary (by simpa only [prev] using hJPrev)
      (by rw [hSucc]; simpa only [endpoint] using hJEndpoint)
  rw [hSucc] at hBridge
  refine ⟨L, hL, ?_⟩
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
  change liftQPlusOne p f
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf prev) valid).t +
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf prev) valid) J =
    liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' L
  rw [hBridge, hToggle]
  linear_combination hCongr
