name: KLSposet.Pinning.naDifferenceEndpointBranch_impossible
statement:
theorem naDifferenceEndpointBranch_impossible {p : Nat} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    {u uTarget xNext epsilon : Int}
    (huUpper : u < p)
    (huTargetLower : 0 ≤ uTarget) (huTargetUpper : uTarget ≤ p)
    (hxNext : |xNext| ≤ 2) (hEpsilon : epsilon = 1 ∨ epsilon = -1)
    (hEndpoint : epsilon * uTarget = -2 * (p : Int) + (u - xNext))
    (hNotEndpoint : u - xNext ≠ p)
    {xAuxPrev xAuxNext epsilonAux : Int}
    (hxAuxPrev : xAuxPrev = 2 ∨ xAuxPrev = -2)
    (hxAuxNext : |xAuxNext| ≤ 2)
    (hEpsilonAux : epsilonAux = 1 ∨ epsilonAux = -1)
    (hAuxiliary : (epsilonAux - 1) * ((p : Int) - 1) =
      (p : Int) * xAuxPrev - xAuxNext)
    {uNext uSourceNext xAfter epsilonNext : Int}
    (huNextLower : 0 ≤ uNext) (huNextUpper : uNext ≤ p)
    (huSourceNextLower : 0 ≤ uSourceNext)
    (hxAfter : |xAfter| ≤ 2)
    (hEpsilonNext : epsilonNext = 1 ∨ epsilonNext = -1)
    (hNext : epsilonNext * uNext + uSourceNext =
      (p : Int) * xAuxNext - xAfter) : False
proof:
:= by
  rcases abs_le.mp hxNext with ⟨hxNextLower, hxNextUpper⟩
  have hEndpointValues :
      u = (p : Int) - 1 ∧ uTarget = (p : Int) - 1 ∧
        xNext = -2 ∧ epsilon = -1 := by
    rcases hEpsilon with hEpsilon | hEpsilon <;> subst epsilon <;>
      norm_num at hEndpoint <;> omega
  rcases hEndpointValues with ⟨hu, huTarget, hxNextValue, hEpsilonValue⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hxAuxNext with ⟨hxAuxNextLower, hxAuxNextUpper⟩
  have hAuxiliaryValues :
      xAuxPrev = -2 ∧ xAuxNext = -2 ∧ epsilonAux = -1 := by
    rcases hxAuxPrev with hxAuxPrev | hxAuxPrev <;> subst xAuxPrev <;>
      rcases hEpsilonAux with hEpsilonAux | hEpsilonAux <;>
      subst epsilonAux <;> norm_num at hAuxiliary <;> omega
  rcases hAuxiliaryValues with
    ⟨hxAuxPrevValue, hxAuxNextValue, hEpsilonAuxValue⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hxAfter with ⟨hxAfterLower, hxAfterUpper⟩
  rw [hxAuxNextValue] at hNext
  rcases hEpsilonNext with hEpsilonNext | hEpsilonNext <;>
    subst epsilonNext <;> norm_num at hNext <;> omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naDifferenceEndpointBranch_impossible_of_pinnedCarries
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naDifferenceEndpointBranch_impossible_of_pinnedCarries
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod f)
    (hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (start + (k : ZMod f)) ≠ 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ i, i ≤ length →
      sigma.u (start + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = -2)
    (JMinus : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJMinus : Profile.niveauOne JMinus ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hJMinusEndpoint : start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f) ∉ JMinus)
    (hDifference :
      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus
          (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0 ∧
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus
          (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0)
    (huEndpointPositive : 0 < sigma.u
      (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)))
    (huEndpointStrict : sigma.u
      (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) < p)
    (hNotEndpoint :
      (sigma.u (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) : Int) -
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus
            (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) ≠ p) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let endpoint : ZMod f := start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)
  let prev : ZMod f := start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)
  have hPred : endpoint - 1 = prev := by
    simp only [endpoint, prev]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hBoundMinus : ∀ i,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus i| ≤ 2 :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 JMinus hJMinus).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hProfilePrev :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus prev = -2 := by
    have hTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
      (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus prev
    have hDifferencePrev :
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus prev = 0 := by
      simpa only [prev] using hDifference.1
    have hBasePrev' : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty prev = -2 := by
      simpa only [prev] using hBasePrev
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hDifferencePrev, hBasePrev'] at hTwice
    omega
  let epsilon :=
    (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget JMinus hJMinus)).sign endpoint
  have hEpsilon : epsilon = 1 ∨ epsilon = -1 := by
    by_cases hmem : endpoint ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget JMinus hJMinus
    · right
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
    · left
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
  have hSourceSign : (Profile.niveauOne JMinus).sign endpoint = 1 := by
    have hEndpointNotMem : endpoint ∉ JMinus := by
      simpa only [endpoint] using hJMinusEndpoint
    simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
      hEndpointNotMem]
  have hEndpointRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec JMinus hJMinus endpoint
  simp only [niveauOneCarryInput] at hEndpointRaw
  rw [hSourceSign, hPred, hProfilePrev] at hEndpointRaw
  norm_num at hEndpointRaw
  have hEndpoint :
      epsilon * (sigma'.u endpoint : Int) =
        -2 * (p : Int) +
          ((sigma.u endpoint : Int) -
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus endpoint) := by
    dsimp only [epsilon]
    linear_combination hEndpointRaw
  have hEndpointValues :
      (sigma.u endpoint : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 ∧
        (sigma'.u endpoint : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 ∧
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus endpoint = -2 ∧
        epsilon = -1 := by
    rcases abs_le.mp (hBoundMinus endpoint) with ⟨hLower, hUpper⟩
    have huPositive : (0 : Int) < sigma.u endpoint := by
      simpa only [endpoint] using (show
        (0 : Int) < sigma.u (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) by
          exact_mod_cast huEndpointPositive)
    have huUpper : (sigma.u endpoint : Int) < p := by
      simpa only [endpoint] using (show
        (sigma.u (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) : Int) < p by
          exact_mod_cast huEndpointStrict)
    have huTargetLower : (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.u endpoint := by positivity
    have huTargetUpper : (sigma'.u endpoint : Int) ≤ p := by
      exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le endpoint
    have hNotEndpoint' :
        (sigma.u endpoint : Int) -
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus endpoint ≠ p := by
      simpa only [endpoint] using hNotEndpoint
    rcases hEpsilon with hEpsilon | hEpsilon
    · rw [hEpsilon] at hEndpoint
      norm_num at hEndpoint
      exfalso
      omega
    · rw [hEpsilon] at hEndpoint
      norm_num at hEndpoint
      exact ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, hEpsilon⟩
  let JAux : Set (ZMod f) := {endpoint + 1}
  have hSuccNe : endpoint + 1 ≠ endpoint := by
    intro hEq
    have hOne : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hOne
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (endpoint + 1) - endpoint := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hEq]; simp
  have hAuxEndpoint : endpoint ∉ JAux := by
    simp only [JAux, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    exact hSuccNe.symm
  have hAuxAfter : endpoint + 1 ∈ JAux := by simp [JAux]
  let hJAux : Profile.niveauOne JAux ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset JAux
  have hAuxDichotomy :=
    pin.niveauOne_naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString hp3
      hNotExceptional hEmpty JAux hJAux start hBaseNonzero hSourceZero
  have hAuxPrev :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JAux hJAux prev = 2 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JAux hJAux prev = -2 := by
    rcases hAuxDichotomy with hSame | hNegative
    · right
      calc
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JAux hJAux prev =
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty prev := by
          simpa only [prev] using hSame (length + 1) (by omega)
        _ = -2 := by simpa only [prev] using hBasePrev
    · left
      calc
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JAux hJAux prev =
            -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty prev := by
          simpa only [prev] using hNegative (length + 1) (by omega)
        _ = 2 := by rw [show pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty prev = -2 by
          simpa only [prev] using hBasePrev]; norm_num
  have hBoundAux : ∀ i, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JAux hJAux i| ≤ 2 :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 JAux hJAux).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  let epsilonAux :=
    (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget JAux hJAux)).sign endpoint
  have hEpsilonAux : epsilonAux = 1 ∨ epsilonAux = -1 := by
    by_cases hmem : endpoint ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget JAux hJAux
    · right
      simp [epsilonAux, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
    · left
      simp [epsilonAux, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
  have hAuxSourceSign : (Profile.niveauOne JAux).sign endpoint = 1 := by
    simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
      hAuxEndpoint]
  have hAuxRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec JAux hJAux endpoint
  simp only [niveauOneCarryInput] at hAuxRaw
  rw [hAuxSourceSign, hPred, hEndpointValues.1, hEndpointValues.2.1] at hAuxRaw
  have hAuxiliary :
      (epsilonAux - 1) * ((p : Int) - 1) =
        (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JAux hJAux prev -
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JAux hJAux endpoint := by
    dsimp only [epsilonAux]
    linear_combination hAuxRaw
  let epsilonNext :=
    (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget JAux hJAux)).sign (endpoint + 1)
  have hEpsilonNext : epsilonNext = 1 ∨ epsilonNext = -1 := by
    by_cases hmem : endpoint + 1 ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget JAux hJAux
    · right
      simp [epsilonNext, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
    · left
      simp [epsilonNext, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
  have hAuxSourceSignNext :
      (Profile.niveauOne JAux).sign (endpoint + 1) = -1 :=
    (Profile.sign_eq_neg_one_iff _ _).2 hAuxAfter
  have hAfterPred : endpoint + 1 - 1 = endpoint := by ring
  have hNextRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec JAux hJAux (endpoint + 1)
  simp only [niveauOneCarryInput] at hNextRaw
  rw [hAuxSourceSignNext, hAfterPred] at hNextRaw
  norm_num at hNextRaw
  have hNext :
      epsilonNext * (sigma'.u (endpoint + 1) : Int) +
          (sigma.u (endpoint + 1) : Int) =
        (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JAux hJAux endpoint -
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JAux hJAux (endpoint + 1) := by
    dsimp only [epsilonNext]
    linear_combination hNextRaw
  apply naDifferenceEndpointBranch_impossible hp3
    (show (sigma.u endpoint : Int) < p by exact_mod_cast huEndpointStrict)
    (show (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.u endpoint by positivity)
    (show (sigma'.u endpoint : Int) ≤ p by
      exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le endpoint)
    (hBoundMinus endpoint) hEpsilon hEndpoint
    (by simpa only [endpoint] using hNotEndpoint)
    hAuxPrev (hBoundAux endpoint) hEpsilonAux hAuxiliary
    (show (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.u (endpoint + 1) by positivity)
    (show (sigma'.u (endpoint + 1) : Int) ≤ p by
      exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le (endpoint + 1))
    (show (0 : Int) ≤ sigma.u (endpoint + 1) by positivity)
    (hBoundAux (endpoint + 1)) hEpsilonNext hNext

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_naDifferenceEndpointBranch_impossible_of_pinnedCarries
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naDifferenceEndpointBranch_impossible_of_pinnedCarries
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hNoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (start + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))) ≠ 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ i, i ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf
        (start + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf
        (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))) = -2)
    (JMinus : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hMinusComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ JMinus ↔ i + f ∉ JMinus)
    (hJMinus : Profile.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hJMinusEndpoint :
      start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) ∉ JMinus)
    (hDifference :
      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
          (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus
          (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0 ∧
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
          (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus
          (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0)
    (huEndpointPositive : 0 < sigma.periodicU hf
      (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))))
    (huEndpointStrict : sigma.periodicU hf
      (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) < p)
    (hNotEndpoint :
      (sigma.periodicU hf
          (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) : Int) -
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
          (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) ≠ p) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : Fact (1 < 2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  let endpoint : ZMod (2 * f) :=
    start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))
  let prev : ZMod (2 * f) :=
    start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))
  have hPred : endpoint - 1 = prev := by
    simp only [endpoint, prev]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hBoundMinus : ∀ i,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus i| ≤ 2 :=
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
  have hProfilePrev :
      pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus prev = -2 := by
    have hTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus prev
    have hDifferencePrev :
        pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
            (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus prev = 0 := by
      simpa only [prev] using hDifference.1
    have hBasePrev' : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf prev) = -2 := by
      simpa only [prev] using hBasePrev
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hDifferencePrev, hBasePrev'] at hTwice
    omega
  let epsilon :=
    (Profile.niveauTwo
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus)
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary JMinus hMinusComplementary
        hJMinus)).sign endpoint
  have hEpsilon : epsilon = 1 ∨ epsilon = -1 := by
    by_cases hmem : endpoint ∈
        pin.niveauTwoTarget JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
    · right
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
    · left
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
  have hSourceSign :
      (Profile.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary).sign endpoint = 1 := by
    have hEndpointNotMem : endpoint ∉ JMinus := by
      simpa only [endpoint] using hJMinusEndpoint
    simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
      hEndpointNotMem]
  have hEndpointRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec JMinus
    hMinusComplementary hJMinus endpoint
  simp only [niveauTwoCarryInput] at hEndpointRaw
  rw [hSourceSign, hPred, hProfilePrev] at hEndpointRaw
  norm_num at hEndpointRaw
  have hEndpoint :
      epsilon * (sigma'.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) =
        -2 * (p : Int) +
          ((sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) -
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
              endpoint) := by
    dsimp only [epsilon]
    linear_combination hEndpointRaw
  have hEndpointValues :
      (sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 ∧
        (sigma'.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) = (p : Int) - 1 ∧
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus endpoint =
          -2 ∧ epsilon = -1 := by
    rcases abs_le.mp (hBoundMinus endpoint) with ⟨hLower, hUpper⟩
    have huPositive : (0 : Int) < sigma.periodicU hf endpoint := by
      simpa only [endpoint] using (show
        (0 : Int) < sigma.periodicU hf
            (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) by
          exact_mod_cast huEndpointPositive)
    have huUpper : (sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) < p := by
      simpa only [endpoint] using (show
        (sigma.periodicU hf
            (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) : Int) < p by
          exact_mod_cast huEndpointStrict)
    have huTargetLower :
        (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.periodicU hf endpoint := by positivity
    have huTargetUpper :
        (sigma'.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) ≤ p := by
      simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU]
      exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le (periodicIndex hf endpoint)
    have hNotEndpoint' :
        (sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) -
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
              endpoint ≠ p := by
      simpa only [endpoint] using hNotEndpoint
    rcases hEpsilon with hEpsilon | hEpsilon
    · rw [hEpsilon] at hEndpoint
      norm_num at hEndpoint
      exfalso
      omega
    · rw [hEpsilon] at hEndpoint
      norm_num at hEndpoint
      exact ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, hEpsilon⟩
  have hPeriodicSucc :
      periodicIndex hf (endpoint + 1) = periodicIndex hf endpoint + 1 := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_one]
  have hPeriodicSuccNe :
      periodicIndex hf (endpoint + 1) ≠ periodicIndex hf endpoint := by
    rw [hPeriodicSucc]
    intro hEq
    have hOne : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hOne
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (periodicIndex hf endpoint + 1) -
          periodicIndex hf endpoint := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hEq]; simp
  let JAuxBase : Set (ZMod f) := {periodicIndex hf (endpoint + 1)}
  let JAux : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf JAuxBase endpoint
  let hAuxComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ JAux ↔ i + f ∉ JAux :=
    shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf JAuxBase endpoint
  have hAuxEndpoint : endpoint ∉ JAux := by
    have hHalf : (endpoint - endpoint).val < f := by simp; omega
    rw [show JAux = shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf JAuxBase endpoint from rfl,
      mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet, if_pos hHalf]
    simp only [JAuxBase, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    exact hPeriodicSuccNe.symm
  have hAuxAfter : endpoint + 1 ∈ JAux := by
    have hDiff : endpoint + 1 - endpoint = (1 : ZMod (2 * f)) := by ring
    have hHalf : (endpoint + 1 - endpoint).val < f := by
      rw [hDiff, ZMod.val_one]
      omega
    rw [show JAux = shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf JAuxBase endpoint from rfl,
      mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet, if_pos hHalf]
    simp only [JAuxBase, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  let hJAux : Profile.niveauTwo JAux hAuxComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset_of_ne_critical hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset hNoncritical (.niveauTwo JAux hAuxComplementary)
  have hAuxDichotomy :=
    pin.niveauTwo_naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString hp3
      hNotExceptional hEmpty JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux start
      hBaseNonzero hSourceZero
  have hAuxPrev :
      pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux prev = 2 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux prev = -2 := by
    rcases hAuxDichotomy with hSame | hNegative
    · right
      calc
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux prev =
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf prev) := by
          simpa only [prev] using hSame (length + 1) (by omega)
        _ = -2 := by simpa only [prev] using hBasePrev
    · left
      calc
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux prev =
            -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf prev) := by
          simpa only [prev] using hNegative (length + 1) (by omega)
        _ = 2 := by
          rw [show pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf prev) =
            -2 by simpa only [prev] using hBasePrev]
          norm_num
  have hBoundAux : ∀ i,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux i| ≤ 2 :=
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux
  let epsilonAux :=
    (Profile.niveauTwo
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux)
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux)).sign
        endpoint
  have hEpsilonAux : epsilonAux = 1 ∨ epsilonAux = -1 := by
    by_cases hmem : endpoint ∈
        pin.niveauTwoTarget JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux
    · right
      simp [epsilonAux, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
    · left
      simp [epsilonAux, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
  have hAuxSourceSign :
      (Profile.niveauTwo JAux hAuxComplementary).sign endpoint = 1 := by
    simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
      hAuxEndpoint]
  have hAuxRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux
    endpoint
  simp only [niveauTwoCarryInput] at hAuxRaw
  rw [hAuxSourceSign, hPred, hEndpointValues.1, hEndpointValues.2.1] at hAuxRaw
  have hAuxiliary :
      (epsilonAux - 1) * ((p : Int) - 1) =
        (p : Int) *
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux prev -
          pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux endpoint := by
    dsimp only [epsilonAux]
    linear_combination hAuxRaw
  let epsilonNext :=
    (Profile.niveauTwo
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux)
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux)).sign
        (endpoint + 1)
  have hEpsilonNext : epsilonNext = 1 ∨ epsilonNext = -1 := by
    by_cases hmem : endpoint + 1 ∈
        pin.niveauTwoTarget JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux
    · right
      simp [epsilonNext, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
    · left
      simp [epsilonNext, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
  have hAuxSourceSignNext :
      (Profile.niveauTwo JAux hAuxComplementary).sign (endpoint + 1) = -1 :=
    (Profile.sign_eq_neg_one_iff _ _).2 hAuxAfter
  have hAfterPred : endpoint + 1 - 1 = endpoint := by ring
  have hNextRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux
    (endpoint + 1)
  simp only [niveauTwoCarryInput] at hNextRaw
  rw [hAuxSourceSignNext, hAfterPred] at hNextRaw
  norm_num at hNextRaw
  have hNext :
      epsilonNext * (sigma'.periodicU hf (endpoint + 1) : Int) +
          (sigma.periodicU hf (endpoint + 1) : Int) =
        (p : Int) *
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux endpoint -
          pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JAux hAuxComplementary hJAux
            (endpoint + 1) := by
    dsimp only [epsilonNext]
    linear_combination hNextRaw
  apply naDifferenceEndpointBranch_impossible hp3
    (show (sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) < p by
      simpa only [endpoint] using (show
        (sigma.periodicU hf
          (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) : Int) < p by
            exact_mod_cast huEndpointStrict))
    (show (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.periodicU hf endpoint by positivity)
    (show (sigma'.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) ≤ p by
      simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU]
      exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le (periodicIndex hf endpoint))
    (hBoundMinus endpoint) hEpsilon hEndpoint
    (by simpa only [endpoint] using hNotEndpoint)
    hAuxPrev (hBoundAux endpoint) hEpsilonAux hAuxiliary
    (show (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.periodicU hf (endpoint + 1) by positivity)
    (show (sigma'.periodicU hf (endpoint + 1) : Int) ≤ p by
      simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU]
      exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le (periodicIndex hf (endpoint + 1)))
    (show (0 : Int) ≤ sigma.periodicU hf (endpoint + 1) by positivity)
    (hBoundAux (endpoint + 1)) hEpsilonNext hNext

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naSumEndpointBranch_values
statement:
theorem naSumEndpointBranch_values {p : Nat} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    {u uTarget xBasePrev xProfilePrev xBaseNext xProfileNext
      sPrev sNext dPrev dNext epsilonTarget : Int}
    (huLower : 0 < u) (huUpper : u < p)
    (huTargetLower : 0 ≤ uTarget) (huTargetUpper : uTarget ≤ p)
    (hxBasePrev : xBasePrev = -1 ∨ xBasePrev = -2)
    (hxBaseNextUpper : xBaseNext ≤ 0)
    (hxBaseNextBound : |xBaseNext| ≤ 2)
    (hxProfileNextBound : |xProfileNext| ≤ 2)
    (hxProfileSign : xProfilePrev = xBasePrev ∨
      xProfilePrev = -xBasePrev)
    (hxProfilePrevNotNegOne : xProfilePrev ≠ -1)
    (hBasePrevDecomp : xBasePrev = sPrev - dPrev)
    (hProfilePrevDecomp : xProfilePrev = sPrev + dPrev)
    (hBaseNextDecomp : xBaseNext = sNext - dNext)
    (hProfileNextDecomp : xProfileNext = sNext + dNext)
    (hSumAlternative : -u = (p : Int) * sPrev - sNext)
    (hNotEndpoint : u - xProfileNext ≠ p)
    (hEpsilonTarget : epsilonTarget = 1 ∨ epsilonTarget = -1)
    (hTargetEquation : epsilonTarget * uTarget - u =
      (p : Int) * xProfilePrev - xProfileNext) :
    sPrev = 0 ∧ u = 1 ∧ sNext = 1 ∧ xBaseNext = 0 ∧
      xProfileNext = 2 ∧ xProfilePrev = 1 ∧ xBasePrev = -1 ∧
      uTarget = (p : Int) - 1 ∧ epsilonTarget = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases abs_le.mp hxBaseNextBound with
    ⟨hxBaseNextLower, hxBaseNextUpper⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hxProfileNextBound with
    ⟨hxProfileNextLower, hxProfileNextUpper⟩
  have hPrevCases :
      (sPrev = 0 ∧ dPrev = 1 ∧ xBasePrev = -1 ∧ xProfilePrev = 1) ∨
      (sPrev = 0 ∧ dPrev = 2 ∧ xBasePrev = -2 ∧ xProfilePrev = 2) ∨
      (sPrev = -2 ∧ dPrev = 0 ∧ xBasePrev = -2 ∧ xProfilePrev = -2) := by
    rcases hxBasePrev with hxBasePrev | hxBasePrev <;>
      rcases hxProfileSign with hxProfileSign | hxProfileSign <;> omega
  rcases hPrevCases with hPrev | hPrev | hPrev
  · rcases hPrev with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    rcases hEpsilonTarget with hEpsilonTarget | hEpsilonTarget <;>
      subst epsilonTarget <;> norm_num at hTargetEquation ⊢ <;> omega
  · rcases hPrev with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    rcases hEpsilonTarget with hEpsilonTarget | hEpsilonTarget <;>
      subst epsilonTarget <;> norm_num at hTargetEquation ⊢ <;> omega
  · rcases hPrev with ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    rcases hEpsilonTarget with hEpsilonTarget | hEpsilonTarget <;>
      subst epsilonTarget <;> norm_num at hTargetEquation ⊢ <;> omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naSumEndpointBranch_values_of_pinnedCarries
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naSumEndpointBranch_values_of_pinnedCarries
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod f)
    (hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (start + (k : ZMod f)) ≠ 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ i, i ≤ length →
      sigma.u (start + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0)
    (hBasePrev :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = -1 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = -2)
    (hBaseNextNonpositive :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) ≤ 0)
    (JMinus : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJMinus : Profile.niveauOne JMinus ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hJMinusEndpoint :
      start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f) ∉ JMinus)
    (hProfilePrevNotNegOne :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus
        (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) ≠ -1)
    (huEndpointPositive : 0 < sigma.u
      (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)))
    (huEndpointStrict : sigma.u
      (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) < p)
    (hNotEndpoint :
      (sigma.u (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) : Int) -
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus
            (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) ≠ p) :
    sigma.u (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 1 ∧
      sigma'.u (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = p - 1 ∧
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = -1 ∧
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 0 ∧
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus
          (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 1 ∧
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus
          (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) = 2 ∧
      start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f) ∉
        pin.niveauOneTarget JMinus hJMinus
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let prev : ZMod f := start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)
  let endpoint : ZMod f := start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)
  have hPred : endpoint - 1 = prev := by
    simp only [endpoint, prev]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hBaseBound : ∀ i,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i| ≤ 2 :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hMinusBound : ∀ i,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus i| ≤ 2 :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 JMinus
      hJMinus).resolve_right hNotExceptional
  have hDichotomy :=
    pin.niveauOne_naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString hp3
      hNotExceptional hEmpty JMinus hJMinus start hBaseNonzero hSourceZero
  have hProfilePrevSign :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus prev =
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty prev ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus prev =
          -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty prev := by
    rcases hDichotomy with hSame | hNegative
    · left
      simpa only [prev] using hSame (length + 1) (by omega)
    · right
      simpa only [prev] using hNegative (length + 1) (by omega)
  have hAlternative :=
    pin.niveauOne_naEndpointAlternative_of_pinnedCarries hp3
      hNotExceptional hEmpty JMinus hJMinus endpoint
      (by simpa only [endpoint] using hJMinusEndpoint)
  rw [hPred] at hAlternative
  rcases hAlternative with hSum | hDifference
  · have hBasePrevDecomp :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty prev =
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus prev -
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus
              prev := by
      have hSumTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus prev
      have hDifferenceTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus prev
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSumTwice hDifferenceTwice
      omega
    have hProfilePrevDecomp :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus prev =
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus prev +
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus
              prev := by
      have hSumTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus prev
      have hDifferenceTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus prev
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSumTwice hDifferenceTwice
      omega
    have hBaseNextDecomp :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty endpoint =
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus endpoint -
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus
              endpoint := by
      have hSumTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus endpoint
      have hDifferenceTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus endpoint
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSumTwice hDifferenceTwice
      omega
    have hProfileNextDecomp :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus endpoint =
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus endpoint +
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus
              endpoint := by
      have hSumTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus endpoint
      have hDifferenceTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus endpoint
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSumTwice hDifferenceTwice
      omega
    let epsilonTarget :=
      (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget JMinus hJMinus)).sign endpoint
    have hEpsilonTarget : epsilonTarget = 1 ∨ epsilonTarget = -1 := by
      by_cases hmem : endpoint ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget JMinus hJMinus
      · right
        simp [epsilonTarget, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
          Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hmem]
      · left
        simp [epsilonTarget, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
          Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hmem]
    have hSourceSign : (Profile.niveauOne JMinus).sign endpoint = 1 := by
      have hEndpointNotMem : endpoint ∉ JMinus := by
        simpa only [endpoint] using hJMinusEndpoint
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        hEndpointNotMem]
    have hEndpointRaw :=
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec JMinus hJMinus endpoint
    simp only [niveauOneCarryInput] at hEndpointRaw
    rw [hSourceSign, hPred] at hEndpointRaw
    have hTargetEquation :
        epsilonTarget * (sigma'.u endpoint : Int) -
            (sigma.u endpoint : Int) =
          (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus prev -
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus endpoint := by
      dsimp only [epsilonTarget]
      linear_combination hEndpointRaw
    have hValues := naSumEndpointBranch_values hp3
      (show (0 : Int) < sigma.u endpoint by
        simpa only [endpoint] using (show
          (0 : Int) < sigma.u
              (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) by
            exact_mod_cast huEndpointPositive))
      (show (sigma.u endpoint : Int) < p by
        simpa only [endpoint] using (show
          (sigma.u (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f)) : Int) < p by
            exact_mod_cast huEndpointStrict))
      (show (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.u endpoint by positivity)
      (show (sigma'.u endpoint : Int) ≤ p by
        exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le endpoint)
      (by simpa only [prev] using hBasePrev)
      (by simpa only [endpoint] using hBaseNextNonpositive)
      (hBaseBound endpoint) (hMinusBound endpoint)
      hProfilePrevSign
      (by simpa only [prev] using hProfilePrevNotNegOne)
      hBasePrevDecomp hProfilePrevDecomp hBaseNextDecomp
      hProfileNextDecomp hSum
      (by simpa only [endpoint] using hNotEndpoint)
      hEpsilonTarget hTargetEquation
    have huSource : sigma.u endpoint = 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast hValues.2.1
    have huTargetCast :
        (sigma'.u endpoint : Int) = ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)]
      exact hValues.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    have huTarget : sigma'.u endpoint = p - 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast huTargetCast
    have hTargetOmit : endpoint ∉ pin.niveauOneTarget JMinus hJMinus := by
      intro hmem
      have hSign : epsilonTarget = -1 := by
        exact (Profile.sign_eq_neg_one_iff _ _).2 hmem
      rw [hValues.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2] at hSign
      norm_num at hSign
    simpa only [prev, endpoint] using
      And.intro huSource (And.intro huTarget
        (And.intro hValues.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
          (And.intro hValues.2.2.2.1
            (And.intro hValues.2.2.2.2.2.1
              (And.intro hValues.2.2.2.2.1 hTargetOmit)))))
  · have hProfilePrevEq :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus prev =
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty prev := by
      have hTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauOne JMinus) hJMinus prev
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hDifference.1] at hTwice
      omega
    have hBasePrevNegTwo :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty prev = -2 := by
      rcases hBasePrev with hBasePrev | hBasePrev
      · exfalso
        apply hProfilePrevNotNegOne
        simpa only [prev, hProfilePrevEq] using hBasePrev
      · simpa only [prev] using hBasePrev
    exfalso
    apply pin.niveauOne_naDifferenceEndpointBranch_impossible_of_pinnedCarries
      hp3 hsubset hNotExceptional hEmpty start hBaseNonzero hSourceZero
      (by simpa only [prev] using hBasePrevNegTwo) JMinus hJMinus
      hJMinusEndpoint
      (by simpa only [prev, endpoint] using hDifference)
      huEndpointPositive huEndpointStrict hNotEndpoint

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_naSumEndpointBranch_values_of_pinnedCarries
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naSumEndpointBranch_values_of_pinnedCarries
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hNoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (start + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))) ≠ 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ i, i ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf
        (start + ((i + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0)
    (hBasePrev :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (periodicIndex hf
            (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))) = -1 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (periodicIndex hf
            (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))) = -2)
    (hBaseNextNonpositive :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf
          (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))) ≤ 0)
    (JMinus : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hMinusComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ JMinus ↔ i + f ∉ JMinus)
    (hJMinus : Profile.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hJMinusEndpoint :
      start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) ∉ JMinus)
    (hProfilePrevNotNegOne :
      pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
        (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) ≠ -1)
    (huEndpointPositive : 0 < sigma.periodicU hf
      (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))))
    (huEndpointStrict : sigma.periodicU hf
      (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) < p)
    (hNotEndpoint :
      (sigma.periodicU hf
          (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) : Int) -
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
          (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) ≠ p) :
    sigma.periodicU hf
        (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 1 ∧
      sigma'.periodicU hf
        (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = p - 1 ∧
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (periodicIndex hf
            (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))) = -1 ∧
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (periodicIndex hf
            (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))) = 0 ∧
      pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
          (start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 1 ∧
      pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
          (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 2 ∧
      start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) ∉
        pin.niveauTwoTarget JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : Fact (1 < 2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  let prev : ZMod (2 * f) :=
    start + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))
  let endpoint : ZMod (2 * f) :=
    start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))
  have hPred : endpoint - 1 = prev := by
    simp only [endpoint, prev]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hBaseBound : ∀ i,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i| ≤ 2 :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hMinusBound : ∀ i,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus i| ≤ 2 :=
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
  have hDichotomy :=
    pin.niveauTwo_naPairedCarry_eq_or_eq_neg_on_zeroString hp3
      hNotExceptional hEmpty JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus start
      hBaseNonzero hSourceZero
  have hProfilePrevSign :
      pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus prev =
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf prev) ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus prev =
          -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf prev) := by
    rcases hDichotomy with hSame | hNegative
    · left
      simpa only [prev] using hSame (length + 1) (by omega)
    · right
      simpa only [prev] using hNegative (length + 1) (by omega)
  have hAlternative :=
    pin.niveauTwo_naEndpointAlternative_of_pinnedCarries hp3
      hNotExceptional hEmpty JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus endpoint
      (by simpa only [endpoint] using hJMinusEndpoint)
  rw [hPred] at hAlternative
  rcases hAlternative with hSum | hDifference
  · have hBasePrevDecomp :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf prev) =
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus prev -
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus prev := by
      have hSumTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus prev
      have hDifferenceTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus prev
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSumTwice hDifferenceTwice
      omega
    have hProfilePrevDecomp :
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus prev =
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus prev +
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus prev := by
      have hSumTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus prev
      have hDifferenceTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus prev
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSumTwice hDifferenceTwice
      omega
    have hBaseNextDecomp :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf endpoint) =
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus endpoint -
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus endpoint := by
      have hSumTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus endpoint
      have hDifferenceTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus endpoint
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSumTwice hDifferenceTwice
      omega
    have hProfileNextDecomp :
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus endpoint =
          pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus endpoint +
            pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
              (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus endpoint := by
      have hSumTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus endpoint
      have hDifferenceTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus endpoint
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt] at hSumTwice hDifferenceTwice
      omega
    let epsilonTarget :=
      (Profile.niveauTwo
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus)
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary JMinus hMinusComplementary
          hJMinus)).sign endpoint
    have hEpsilonTarget : epsilonTarget = 1 ∨ epsilonTarget = -1 := by
      by_cases hmem : endpoint ∈
          pin.niveauTwoTarget JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
      · right
        simp [epsilonTarget, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
          Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hmem]
      · left
        simp [epsilonTarget, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
          Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hmem]
    have hSourceSign :
        (Profile.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary).sign endpoint = 1 := by
      have hEndpointNotMem : endpoint ∉ JMinus := by
        simpa only [endpoint] using hJMinusEndpoint
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        hEndpointNotMem]
    have hEndpointRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec JMinus
      hMinusComplementary hJMinus endpoint
    simp only [niveauTwoCarryInput] at hEndpointRaw
    rw [hSourceSign, hPred] at hEndpointRaw
    have hTargetEquation :
        epsilonTarget * (sigma'.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) -
            (sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) =
          (p : Int) *
              pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
                prev -
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
              endpoint := by
      dsimp only [epsilonTarget]
      linear_combination hEndpointRaw
    have hValues := naSumEndpointBranch_values hp3
      (show (0 : Int) < sigma.periodicU hf endpoint by
        simpa only [endpoint] using (show
          (0 : Int) < sigma.periodicU hf
              (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) by
            exact_mod_cast huEndpointPositive))
      (show (sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) < p by
        simpa only [endpoint] using (show
          (sigma.periodicU hf
              (start + ((length + 2 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) : Int) < p by
            exact_mod_cast huEndpointStrict))
      (show (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.periodicU hf endpoint by positivity)
      (show (sigma'.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) ≤ p by
        simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU]
        exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le (periodicIndex hf endpoint))
      (by simpa only [prev] using hBasePrev)
      (by simpa only [endpoint] using hBaseNextNonpositive)
      (hBaseBound (periodicIndex hf endpoint)) (hMinusBound endpoint)
      hProfilePrevSign
      (by simpa only [prev] using hProfilePrevNotNegOne)
      hBasePrevDecomp hProfilePrevDecomp hBaseNextDecomp
      hProfileNextDecomp hSum
      (by simpa only [endpoint] using hNotEndpoint)
      hEpsilonTarget hTargetEquation
    have huSource : sigma.periodicU hf endpoint = 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast hValues.2.1
    have huTargetCast :
        (sigma'.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) = ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)]
      exact hValues.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    have huTarget : sigma'.periodicU hf endpoint = p - 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast huTargetCast
    have hTargetOmit : endpoint ∉
        pin.niveauTwoTarget JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus := by
      intro hmem
      have hSign : epsilonTarget = -1 := by
        exact (Profile.sign_eq_neg_one_iff _ _).2 hmem
      rw [hValues.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2] at hSign
      norm_num at hSign
    simpa only [prev, endpoint] using
      And.intro huSource (And.intro huTarget
        (And.intro hValues.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
          (And.intro hValues.2.2.2.1
            (And.intro hValues.2.2.2.2.2.1
              (And.intro hValues.2.2.2.2.1 hTargetOmit)))))
  · have hProfilePrevEq :
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus prev =
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf prev) := by
      have hTwice := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty
        (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary) hJMinus prev
      simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hDifference.1] at hTwice
      omega
    have hBasePrevNegTwo :
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (periodicIndex hf prev) = -2 := by
      rcases hBasePrev with hBasePrev | hBasePrev
      · exfalso
        apply hProfilePrevNotNegOne
        simpa only [prev, hProfilePrevEq] using hBasePrev
      · simpa only [prev] using hBasePrev
    exfalso
    apply pin.niveauTwo_naDifferenceEndpointBranch_impossible_of_pinnedCarries
      hp3 hsubset hNoncritical hNotExceptional hEmpty start hBaseNonzero
      hSourceZero (by simpa only [prev] using hBasePrevNegTwo)
      JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus hJMinusEndpoint
      (by simpa only [prev, endpoint] using hDifference)
      huEndpointPositive huEndpointStrict hNotEndpoint

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naNextCoordinate_not_omitted
statement:
theorem naNextCoordinate_not_omitted {p : Nat} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    {uTarget uSource x epsilon : Int}
    (huTargetLower : 0 ≤ uTarget) (huTargetUpper : uTarget ≤ p)
    (huSourceLower : 0 ≤ uSource)
    (hxUpper : x ≤ 2) (hEpsilon : epsilon = 1 ∨ epsilon = -1)
    (hEquation : epsilon * uTarget - uSource + x = 2 * (p : Int)) : False
proof:
:= by
  rcases hEpsilon with hEpsilon | hEpsilon <;> subst epsilon <;>
    norm_num at hEquation <;> omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naFinalProfileCarry_values
statement:
theorem naFinalProfileCarry_values {p : Nat} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    {uTarget uSource xAfter epsilonNext xNext : Int}
    (huTargetLower : 0 ≤ uTarget) (huTargetUpper : uTarget ≤ p)
    (huSourceLower : 0 ≤ uSource)
    (hxAfter : |xAfter| ≤ 2)
    (hEpsilonNext : epsilonNext = 1 ∨ epsilonNext = -1)
    (hxNext : xNext = -2 ∨ xNext = 0 ∨ xNext = 2)
    (hNext : epsilonNext * uTarget + uSource + xAfter =
      (p : Int) * xNext)
    (hAtMostTwo : (0 : Int) = 2 ∨ 0 = -xNext ∨ 2 = -xNext)
    {epsilonFinal xPrev : Int}
    (hEpsilonFinal : epsilonFinal = 1 ∨ epsilonFinal = -1)
    (hxPrev : |xPrev| ≤ 2)
    (hFinal : epsilonFinal * ((p : Int) - 1) + 1 =
      (p : Int) * xPrev) :
    xNext = 0 ∧ epsilonFinal = 1 ∧ xPrev = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases abs_le.mp hxAfter with ⟨hxAfterLower, hxAfterUpper⟩
  have hxNextNotNegTwo : xNext ≠ -2 := by
    intro hx
    subst xNext
    rcases hEpsilonNext with hEpsilonNext | hEpsilonNext <;>
      subst epsilonNext <;> norm_num at hNext <;> omega
  have hxNextZero : xNext = 0 := by
    rcases hxNext with hxNext | hxNext | hxNext
    · exact False.elim (hxNextNotNegTwo hxNext)
    · exact hxNext
    · subst xNext
      norm_num at hAtMostTwo
  refine ⟨hxNextZero, ?_⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hxPrev with ⟨hxPrevLower, hxPrevUpper⟩
  rcases hEpsilonFinal with hEpsilonFinal | hEpsilonFinal <;>
    subst epsilonFinal <;> norm_num at hFinal
  · constructor
    · rfl
    · interval_cases xPrev <;> norm_num at hFinal ⊢ <;> omega
  · interval_cases xPrev <;> norm_num at hFinal <;> omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.naFinalProfileCarry_values_with_terminal
statement:
theorem naFinalProfileCarry_values_with_terminal {p : Nat} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    {uTarget uSource xAfter epsilonNext xNext : Int}
    (huTargetLower : 0 ≤ uTarget) (huTargetUpper : uTarget ≤ p)
    (huSourceLower : 0 ≤ uSource)
    (hxAfter : |xAfter| ≤ 2)
    (hEpsilonNext : epsilonNext = 1 ∨ epsilonNext = -1)
    (hxNext : xNext = -2 ∨ xNext = 0 ∨ xNext = 2)
    (hNext : epsilonNext * uTarget + uSource + xAfter =
      (p : Int) * xNext)
    (hAtMostTwo : (0 : Int) = 2 ∨ 0 = -xNext ∨ 2 = -xNext)
    {epsilonFinal xPrev : Int}
    (hEpsilonFinal : epsilonFinal = 1 ∨ epsilonFinal = -1)
    (hxPrev : |xPrev| ≤ 2)
    (hFinal : epsilonFinal * ((p : Int) - 1) + 1 =
      (p : Int) * xPrev - xNext) :
    xNext = 0 ∧ epsilonFinal = 1 ∧ xPrev = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hxNextNotNegTwo : xNext ≠ -2 := by
    intro hx
    subst xNext
    rcases abs_le.mp hxAfter with ⟨hxAfterLower, hxAfterUpper⟩
    rcases hEpsilonNext with hEpsilonNext | hEpsilonNext <;>
      subst epsilonNext <;> norm_num at hNext <;> omega
  have hxNextZero : xNext = 0 := by
    rcases hxNext with hxNext | hxNext | hxNext
    · exact False.elim (hxNextNotNegTwo hxNext)
    · exact hxNext
    · subst xNext
      norm_num at hAtMostTwo
  rw [hxNextZero] at hFinal
  have hFinal' : epsilonFinal * ((p : Int) - 1) + 1 =
      (p : Int) * xPrev := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using hFinal
  exact naFinalProfileCarry_values hp3 huTargetLower huTargetUpper
    huSourceLower hxAfter hEpsilonNext hxNext hNext hAtMostTwo
    hEpsilonFinal hxPrev hFinal'

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naFinalTargetOmission_of_pinnedCarries
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naFinalTargetOmission_of_pinnedCarries
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J JMinus : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hJMinus : Profile.niveauOne JMinus ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f)
    (hJ1 : j + 1 ∈ J) (hJ2 : j + 2 ∈ J)
    (hJMinus1 : j + 1 ∉ JMinus)
    (hBaseNext : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1) = 0)
    (hMinusNext : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus (j + 1) = 2)
    (huSource : sigma.u (j + 1) = 1)
    (huTarget : sigma'.u (j + 1) = p - 1) :
    j + 1 ∉ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
proof:
:= by
  have hBound : ∀ i, |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ i| ≤ 2 :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 J hJ).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
    (j + 1)
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBaseNext, sub_zero] at hParity
  have hxNext :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + 1) = -2 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + 1) = 0 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + 1) = 2 := by
    rcases hParity with ⟨k, hk⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp (hBound (j + 1)) with ⟨hLower, hUpper⟩
    interval_cases hValue : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + 1) <;>
      omega
  let a : ZMod (2 * f) := shiftedFirstLift hf 0 (j + 1)
  have hPeriodic : periodicIndex hf a = j + 1 := by
    simpa only [a] using periodicIndex_shiftedFirstLift hf 0 (j + 1)
  have hTwo := pin.signedPinnedCarries_atMostTwo hp3 hpOdd
    (.niveauOne ∅) (.niveauOne JMinus) (.niveauOne J)
    hEmpty hJMinus hJ a
  have hAtMostTwo :
      (0 : Int) = 2 ∨
        0 = -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + 1) ∨
        2 = -pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + 1) := by
    simpa [signedPinnedCarryAt, hPeriodic, hBaseNext, hMinusNext,
      Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
      hJ1, hJMinus1] using hTwo
  let epsilonNext :=
    (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign (j + 2)
  have hEpsilonNext : epsilonNext = 1 ∨ epsilonNext = -1 := by
    by_cases hmem : j + 2 ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
    · right
      simp [epsilonNext, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
    · left
      simp [epsilonNext, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
  have hNextRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec J hJ (j + 2)
  have hSourceSignNext : (Profile.niveauOne J).sign (j + 2) = -1 :=
    (Profile.sign_eq_neg_one_iff _ _).2 hJ2
  simp only [niveauOneCarryInput] at hNextRaw
  rw [hSourceSignNext, show j + 2 - 1 = j + 1 by ring] at hNextRaw
  norm_num at hNextRaw
  have hNext :
      epsilonNext * (sigma'.u (j + 2) : Int) +
          (sigma.u (j + 2) : Int) +
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + 2) =
        (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + 1) := by
    dsimp only [epsilonNext]
    linear_combination hNextRaw
  let epsilonFinal :=
    (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign (j + 1)
  have hEpsilonFinal : epsilonFinal = 1 ∨ epsilonFinal = -1 := by
    by_cases hmem : j + 1 ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
    · right
      simp [epsilonFinal, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
    · left
      simp [epsilonFinal, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
  have hFinalRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec J hJ (j + 1)
  have hSourceSignFinal : (Profile.niveauOne J).sign (j + 1) = -1 :=
    (Profile.sign_eq_neg_one_iff _ _).2 hJ1
  simp only [niveauOneCarryInput] at hFinalRaw
  rw [hSourceSignFinal, show j + 1 - 1 = j by ring, huSource, huTarget]
    at hFinalRaw
  norm_num [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)] at hFinalRaw
  have hFinal : epsilonFinal * ((p : Int) - 1) + 1 =
      (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ j -
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j + 1) := by
    simpa only [epsilonFinal] using hFinalRaw
  have hValues := naFinalProfileCarry_values_with_terminal hp3
    (show 0 ≤ (sigma'.u (j + 2) : Int) by positivity)
    (show (sigma'.u (j + 2) : Int) ≤ p by
      exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le (j + 2))
    (show 0 ≤ (sigma.u (j + 2) : Int) by positivity)
    (hBound (j + 2)) hEpsilonNext hxNext hNext hAtMostTwo
    hEpsilonFinal (hBound j) hFinal
  intro hTargetMem
  have hTargetSign : epsilonFinal = -1 := by
    exact (Profile.sign_eq_neg_one_iff _ _).2 hTargetMem
  rw [hValues.2.1] at hTargetSign
  norm_num at hTargetSign

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_naFinalTargetOmission_of_pinnedCarries
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naFinalTargetOmission_of_pinnedCarries
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J JMinus : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hMinusComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ JMinus ↔ i + f ∉ JMinus)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hJMinus : Profile.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hJ1 : a + 1 ∈ J) (hJ2 : a + 2 ∈ J)
    (hJMinus1 : a + 1 ∉ JMinus)
    (hBaseNext : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (a + 1)) = 0)
    (hMinusNext : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary
      hJMinus (a + 1) = 2)
    (huSource : sigma.periodicU hf (a + 1) = 1)
    (huTarget : sigma'.periodicU hf (a + 1) = p - 1) :
    a + 1 ∉ pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
proof:
:= by
  have hBound : ∀ i,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ i| ≤ 2 :=
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ
  have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty
    (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (a + 1)
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBaseNext, sub_zero] at hParity
  have hxNext :
      pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a + 1) = -2 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a + 1) = 0 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a + 1) = 2 := by
    rcases hParity with ⟨k, hk⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp (hBound (a + 1)) with ⟨hLower, hUpper⟩
    interval_cases hValue :
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a + 1) <;>
      omega
  have hTwo := pin.signedPinnedCarries_atMostTwo hp3 hpOdd
    (.niveauOne ∅) (.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary)
    (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hEmpty hJMinus hJ (a + 1)
  have hAtMostTwo :
      (0 : Int) = 2 ∨
        0 = -pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a + 1) ∨
        2 = -pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a + 1) := by
    simpa [signedPinnedCarryAt, hBaseNext, hMinusNext,
      Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
      hJ1, hJMinus1] using hTwo
  let epsilonNext :=
    (Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign (a + 2)
  have hEpsilonNext : epsilonNext = 1 ∨ epsilonNext = -1 := by
    by_cases hmem : a + 2 ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
    · right
      simp [epsilonNext, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
    · left
      simp [epsilonNext, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
  have hNextRaw :=
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ (a + 2)
  have hSourceSignNext :
      (Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary).sign (a + 2) = -1 :=
    (Profile.sign_eq_neg_one_iff _ _).2 hJ2
  simp only [niveauTwoCarryInput] at hNextRaw
  rw [hSourceSignNext, show a + 2 - 1 = a + 1 by ring] at hNextRaw
  norm_num at hNextRaw
  have hNext :
      epsilonNext * (sigma'.periodicU hf (a + 2) : Int) +
          (sigma.periodicU hf (a + 2) : Int) +
          pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a + 2) =
        (p : Int) *
          pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a + 1) := by
    dsimp only [epsilonNext]
    linear_combination hNextRaw
  let epsilonFinal :=
    (Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign (a + 1)
  have hEpsilonFinal : epsilonFinal = 1 ∨ epsilonFinal = -1 := by
    by_cases hmem : a + 1 ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
    · right
      simp [epsilonFinal, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
    · left
      simp [epsilonFinal, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
  have hFinalRaw :=
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ (a + 1)
  have hSourceSignFinal :
      (Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary).sign (a + 1) = -1 :=
    (Profile.sign_eq_neg_one_iff _ _).2 hJ1
  simp only [niveauTwoCarryInput] at hFinalRaw
  rw [hSourceSignFinal, show a + 1 - 1 = a by ring, huSource, huTarget]
    at hFinalRaw
  norm_num [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)] at hFinalRaw
  have hFinal : epsilonFinal * ((p : Int) - 1) + 1 =
      (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a -
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a + 1) := by
    simpa only [epsilonFinal] using hFinalRaw
  have hValues := naFinalProfileCarry_values_with_terminal hp3
    (show 0 ≤ (sigma'.periodicU hf (a + 2) : Int) by positivity)
    (show (sigma'.periodicU hf (a + 2) : Int) ≤ p by
      exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le (periodicIndex hf (a + 2)))
    (show 0 ≤ (sigma.periodicU hf (a + 2) : Int) by positivity)
    (hBound (a + 2)) hEpsilonNext hxNext hNext hAtMostTwo
    hEpsilonFinal (hBound a) hFinal
  intro hTargetMem
  have hTargetSign : epsilonFinal = -1 := by
    exact (Profile.sign_eq_neg_one_iff _ _).2 hTargetMem
  rw [hValues.2.1] at hTargetSign
  norm_num at hTargetSign

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naTargetSingletonToggle
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naTargetSingletonToggle {p f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (K : Set (ZMod f))
    (i : ZMod f) (hi : i ∉ K) (hu : sigma'.u i = p - 1) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' (symmDiff K {i}) =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' K +
        ((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf i
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_eq_add_signed]
  have hfun :
      (fun k : ZMod f ↦
        ((Profile.niveauOne ({i} : Set (ZMod f))).indicator k : Int) *
          (Profile.niveauOne K).sign k * (sigma'.u k : Int)) =
        (fun k : ZMod f ↦ if k = i then ((p - 1 : Nat) : Int) else 0) := by
    funext k
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · subst k
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
        hi, hu]
    · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hki]
  rw [hfun, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
  norm_num

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naFinalProfileExponentWitness
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naFinalProfileExponentWitness {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid j) (J K : Set (ZMod f))
    (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J) (hK1 : j + 1 ∉ K)
    (huSource : sigma.u (j + 1) = 1)
    (huTarget : sigma'.u (j + 1) = p - 1)
    (hPinned : profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauOne K)) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.nu hp hf j valid) (.niveauOne J) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauOne (symmDiff K {j + 1}))
proof:
:= by
  have hSourceToggle :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff J {j + 1}) =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J - inversePower p f hf (j + 1) := by
    rw [niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_eq_add_signed]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne ({j + 1} : Set (ZMod f))).indicator i : Int) *
            (Profile.niveauOne J).sign i * (sigma.u i : Int)) =
          (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j + 1 then (-1 : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
          hj1, huSource]
      · simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
    rw [hfun, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num
    ring
  have hTargetToggle := niveauOne_naTargetSingletonToggle hf sigma' K
    (j + 1) hK1 huTarget
  have hBridge := niveauOne_naExponentBridge hp hf sigma j valid J hj hj1
  have hRecurrence := inversePower_succ p f hp hf j
  have hpCast : ((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) =
      (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hp]
    norm_num
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq] at hPinned
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
  rw [hBridge, hSourceToggle, hTargetToggle, hpCast, ← hRecurrence]
  linear_combination hPinned

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_naTargetPeriodicSingletonToggle
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naTargetPeriodicSingletonToggle
    {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K)
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (ha : a ∉ K)
    (hu : sigma'.periodicU hf a = p - 1) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma'
        (symmDiff K (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a})) =
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K +
        ((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a -
        ((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + f)
proof:
:= by
  have hDouble : a + f + f = a := by
    calc
      a + f + f = a + (2 * f : Nat) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      _ = a := by simp
  have haHalf : a + f ∈ K := by
    apply (hK (a + f)).2
    simpa only [hDouble] using ha
  have huHalf : sigma'.periodicU hf (a + f) = p - 1 := by
    rw [PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_add_half]
    simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU] using hu
  have hToggle := niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSingletonToggle_of_mem hf sigma'
    K hK (a + f) haHalf
  rw [periodicIndex_add_half, huHalf, hDouble] at hToggle
  linear_combination hToggle

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_naFinalProfileExponentWitness
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naFinalProfileExponentWitness {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (valid : sigma.NuValid (periodicIndex hf a))
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K)
    (ha : a ∈ J) (ha1 : a + 1 ∈ J) (hK1 : a + 1 ∉ K)
    (huSource : sigma.periodicU hf (a + 1) = 1)
    (huTarget : sigma'.periodicU hf (a + 1) = p - 1)
    (hPinned : profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)) :
    ∃ hL : ∀ i,
        i ∈ symmDiff K
              (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}) ↔
          i + f ∉ symmDiff K
              (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}),
      profileLeftExponent hf
          (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid)
          (.niveauTwo J hJ) =
        profileLeftExponent hf sigma'
          (.niveauTwo
            (symmDiff K (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}))
            hL)
proof:
:= by
  let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}
  let L : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := symmDiff K T
  have hTPeriodic (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i ∈ T ↔ i + f ∈ T := by
    simp [T, periodicIndexSet, periodicIndex_add_half]
  have hL : ∀ i, i ∈ L ↔ i + f ∉ L := by
    intro i
    simp only [L, Set.mem_symmDiff]
    have hKi := hK i
    have hTi := hTPeriodic i
    tauto
  refine ⟨hL, ?_⟩
  have hSourceToggle :=
    niveauTwoProfileSum_periodicSingletonToggle_of_mem hf sigma J hJ
      (a + 1) ha1
  rw [periodicIndexSet_singleton hf (a + 1), huSource] at hSourceToggle
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul] at hSourceToggle
  have hTargetToggle := niveauTwo_naTargetPeriodicSingletonToggle hf sigma'
    K hK (a + 1) hK1 huTarget
  have hBridge := niveauTwo_naExponentBridge hp hf sigma a valid J hJ ha ha1
  have hRecurrence := niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_succ p f (by omega) hf a
  have hHalfRecurrence :=
    niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_succ p f (by omega) hf (a + f)
  rw [show a + f + 1 = a + 1 + f by ring] at hHalfRecurrence
  have hpCast : ((p - 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) =
      (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)]
    norm_num
  rw [hpCast] at hTargetToggle
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq] at hPinned
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
  change liftQPlusOne p f
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid).t +
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J =
    liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' L
  change niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' L = _ at hTargetToggle
  rw [hBridge, hSourceToggle, hTargetToggle]
  linear_combination hPinned - hRecurrence + hHalfRecurrence

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naFinalPinnedProfileExponentWitness
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naFinalPinnedProfileExponentWitness
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.NuValid j)
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J)
    (hTargetOmit : j + 1 ∉ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)
    (huSource : sigma.u (j + 1) = 1)
    (huTarget : sigma'.u (j + 1) = p - 1) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid)
        (.niveauOne J) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma'
        (.niveauOne (symmDiff (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ) {j + 1}))
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set (ZMod f) := pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
  have hPair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne K) := by
    rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec J hJ]
    exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne J) hJ
  have hCongr := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' J K hPair
  have hPinned : profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauOne K) := by
    simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
    linear_combination hCongr
  exact niveauOne_naFinalProfileExponentWitness (by omega) hf sigma sigma' j
    valid J K hj hj1 hTargetOmit huSource huTarget hPinned

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naFinalPinnedProfileExponentWitness_of_pinnedCarries

    (J JMinus : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')

    (hJMinus1 : j + 1 ∉ JMinus)

    (hMinusNext : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus (j + 1) = 2)
    (huSource : sigma.u (j + 1) = 1)

        (.niveauOne J) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma'

statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naFinalPinnedProfileExponentWitness
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}

    (ha : a ∈ J) (ha1 : a + 1 ∈ J)
    (hTargetOmit : a + 1 ∉
      pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
    (huSource : sigma.periodicU hf (a + 1) = 1)
    (huTarget : sigma'.periodicU hf (a + 1) = p - 1) :
    ∃ hL : ∀ i,
        i ∈ symmDiff (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
              (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}) ↔
          i + f ∉ symmDiff (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
              (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}),
      profileLeftExponent hf
          (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid)
          (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =

            (symmDiff (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)

proof:
:= by
  let K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
  let hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K :=
    pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ
  have hPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =

    rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec J hComplementary hJ]

    sigma sigma' J K hComplementary hK hPair

      profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
        profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK) := by
    simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]

  exact niveauTwo_naFinalProfileExponentWitness (by omega) hf sigma sigma' a
    valid J hComplementary K hK ha ha1 hTargetOmit huSource huTarget hPinned

statement:

    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈

    (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (valid : sigma.NuValid (periodicIndex hf a))
    (J JMinus : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)

    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈

    (hJMinus : Profile.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (ha : a ∈ J) (hJ1 : a + 1 ∈ J) (hJ2 : a + 2 ∈ J)
    (hJMinus1 : a + 1 ∉ JMinus)
    (hBaseNext : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (a + 1)) = 0)
    (hMinusNext : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary

  have hTargetOmit := pin.niveauTwo_naFinalTargetOmission_of_pinnedCarries
    hp3 hpOdd hEmpty J JMinus hComplementary hMinusComplementary hJ hJMinus

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_naPinnedProfileExponentWitness
statement:
theorem niveauOne_naPinnedProfileExponentWitness
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hNoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod f) (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hBaseStart : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty start = 0)
    (hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (start + (k : ZMod f)) ≠ 0)
    (hBaseTerminal :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = -1 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = -2)
    (hBaseNextNonpositive : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) ≤ 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ i, i ≤ length →
      sigma.u (start + (i + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (huEndpointPositive : 0 < sigma.u (start + (length + 2 : Nat)))
    (huEndpointStrict : sigma.u (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) < p)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid (start + (length + 1 : Nat)))
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hJPrev : start + (length + 1 : Nat) ∈ J)
    (hJEndpoint : start + (length + 2 : Nat) ∈ J) :
    ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
      profileLeftExponent hf
          (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) valid)
          (.niveauOne J) =
        profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauOne K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let prev : ZMod f := start + (length + 1 : Nat)
  let endpoint : ZMod f := start + (length + 2 : Nat)
  let JMinus : Set (ZMod f) := symmDiff J {endpoint}
  obtain ⟨hJMinus, hJMinusEndpoint, hCarryDichotomy, hTerminalClass⟩ :=
    pin.niveauOne_naToggledProfileCarryDichotomy hp3 hsubset hNoncritical
      hNotExceptional hEmpty start J hJEndpoint hBaseNonzero hSourceZero
      hBaseTerminal
  have hMinusStart : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus start = 0 := by
    rcases hCarryDichotomy with hSame | hNegative
    · simpa only [JMinus, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, hBaseStart] using
        hSame 0 (by omega)
    · simpa only [JMinus, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, hBaseStart, neg_zero] using
        hNegative 0 (by omega)
  by_cases hTerminal :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus prev = -1
  · exact pin.niveauOne_naTerminalNegOnePinnedProfileExponentWitness start
      hLength valid J hJPrev hJEndpoint hJMinus hSourceZero hMinusStart
      (by simpa only [prev] using hTerminal)
  · have _hTerminalClass := hTerminalClass (by
      simpa only [JMinus, prev] using hTerminal)
    by_cases hEndpoint :
        (sigma.u endpoint : Int) -
            pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus endpoint = p
    · exact pin.niveauOne_naEndpointPPinnedProfileExponentWitness start
        hLength valid J hJPrev hJEndpoint hJMinus hJMinusEndpoint
        huEndpointStrict hSourceZero hMinusStart
        (by simpa only [JMinus, endpoint] using hEndpoint)
    · have hValues :=
        pin.niveauOne_naSumEndpointBranch_values_of_pinnedCarries hp3
          hsubset hNotExceptional hEmpty start hBaseNonzero hSourceZero
          hBaseTerminal hBaseNextNonpositive JMinus hJMinus
