          hJMinusEndpoint hTerminal huEndpointPositive huEndpointStrict
          hEndpoint
      rcases hValues with
        ⟨huSource, huTarget, _hBasePrev, hBaseNext, _hMinusPrev,
          hMinusNext, _hTargetOmit⟩
      have hJNext : prev + 2 ∈ J := by
        by_contra hNextNotMem
        have hEndpointEq : prev + 1 = endpoint := by
          simp only [prev, endpoint]
          push_cast
          ring
        have hNextNeEndpoint : prev + 2 ≠ endpoint := by
          intro hEq
          have hOne : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
            rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
            omega
          apply hOne
          calc
            1 = (prev + 2) - endpoint := by rw [← hEndpointEq]; ring
            _ = 0 := by rw [hEq]; ring
        have hNextNotMinus : prev + 2 ∉ JMinus := by
          simp [JMinus, Set.mem_symmDiff, hNextNotMem, hNextNeEndpoint]
        have hMinusBound :
            |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus (prev + 2)| ≤ 2 :=
          (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 JMinus
            hJMinus).resolve_right hNotExceptional (prev + 2)
        let epsilonTarget :=
          (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget JMinus hJMinus)).sign
            (prev + 2)
        have hEpsilonTarget : epsilonTarget = 1 ∨ epsilonTarget = -1 := by
          by_cases hmem : prev + 2 ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget JMinus hJMinus
          · right
            simp [epsilonTarget, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
              Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hmem]
          · left
            simp [epsilonTarget, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
              Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hmem]
        have hSourceSign : (Profile.niveauOne JMinus).sign (prev + 2) = 1 := by
          simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
            Profile.set, hNextNotMinus]
        have hRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec JMinus hJMinus (prev + 2)
        simp only [niveauOneCarryInput] at hRaw
        rw [hSourceSign, show prev + 2 - 1 = prev + 1 by ring,
          hEndpointEq, hMinusNext] at hRaw
        have hEquation :
            epsilonTarget * (sigma'.u (prev + 2) : Int) -
                (sigma.u (prev + 2) : Int) +
                pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry JMinus hJMinus (prev + 2) =
              2 * (p : Int) := by
          dsimp only [epsilonTarget]
          linear_combination hRaw
        exact naNextCoordinate_not_omitted hp3
          (show 0 ≤ (sigma'.u (prev + 2) : Int) by positivity)
          (show (sigma'.u (prev + 2) : Int) ≤ p by
            exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le (prev + 2))
          (show 0 ≤ (sigma.u (prev + 2) : Int) by positivity)
          (abs_le.mp hMinusBound).2 hEpsilonTarget hEquation
      have hPrevSucc : prev + 1 = endpoint := by
        simp only [prev, endpoint]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hFinal :=
        pin.niveauOne_naFinalPinnedProfileExponentWitness_of_pinnedCarries
        hp3 hpOdd hNotExceptional hEmpty prev valid J JMinus hJ hJMinus
        (by simpa only [prev] using hJPrev)
        (by rw [hPrevSucc]; exact hJEndpoint)
        hJNext (by rw [hPrevSucc]; exact hJMinusEndpoint)
        (by rw [hPrevSucc]; exact hBaseNext)
        (by rw [hPrevSucc]; exact hMinusNext)
        (by rw [hPrevSucc]; exact huSource)
        (by rw [hPrevSucc]; exact huTarget)
      exact ⟨symmDiff (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ) {prev + 1}, by
        simpa only [prev] using hFinal⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_naPinnedProfileExponentWitness
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_naPinnedProfileExponentWitness
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hNoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t)
    (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (start : ZMod (2 * f)) (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hBaseStart : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf start) = 0)
    (hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (start + (k : ZMod (2 * f)))) ≠ 0)
    (hBaseTerminal :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat))) = -1 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat))) = -2)
    (hBaseNextNonpositive : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat))) ≤ 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ i, i ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf (start + (i + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (huEndpointPositive :
      0 < sigma.periodicU hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat)))
    (huEndpointStrict :
      sigma.periodicU hf (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) < p)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid
      (periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat))))
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hJPrev : start + (length + 1 : Nat) ∈ J)
    (hJEndpoint : start + (length + 2 : Nat) ∈ J) :
    ∃ (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K),
      profileLeftExponent hf
          (sigma.nu (by omega) hf
            (periodicIndex hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat))) valid)
          (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
        profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  let prev : ZMod (2 * f) := start + (length + 1 : Nat)
  let endpoint : ZMod (2 * f) := start + (length + 2 : Nat)
  let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
    periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf endpoint}
  let JMinus : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := symmDiff J T
  obtain ⟨hMinusComplementary, hJMinus, hJMinusEndpoint,
      hCarryDichotomy, hTerminalClass⟩ :=
    pin.niveauTwo_naToggledProfileCarryDichotomy hp3 hsubset hNoncritical
      hNotExceptional hEmpty start J hComplementary hJEndpoint hBaseNonzero
      hSourceZero hBaseTerminal
  have hMinusStart : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus
      hMinusComplementary hJMinus start = 0 := by
    rcases hCarryDichotomy with hSame | hNegative
    · simpa only [JMinus, T, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, hBaseStart] using
        hSame 0 (by omega)
    · simpa only [JMinus, T, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, hBaseStart, neg_zero]
        using hNegative 0 (by omega)
  by_cases hTerminal : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus
      hMinusComplementary hJMinus prev = -1
  · have hMinusComplementaryPair : ∀ i,
        i ∈ symmDiff J {endpoint, endpoint + f} ↔
          i + f ∉ symmDiff J {endpoint, endpoint + f} := by
      simpa only [JMinus, T, endpoint,
        periodicIndexSet_singleton hf endpoint] using
        hMinusComplementary
    have hJMinusPair : Profile.niveauTwo
        (symmDiff J {endpoint, endpoint + f}) hMinusComplementaryPair ∈
          compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' := by
      simpa only [JMinus, T, endpoint,
        periodicIndexSet_singleton hf endpoint] using
        hJMinus
    exact pin.niveauTwo_naTerminalNegOnePinnedProfileExponentWitness start
      hLength valid J hComplementary hJPrev hJEndpoint
      hMinusComplementaryPair hJMinusPair hSourceZero
      (by simpa only [JMinus, T, endpoint,
          periodicIndexSet_singleton hf endpoint]
        using hMinusStart)
      (by simpa only [JMinus, T, prev, endpoint,
          periodicIndexSet_singleton hf endpoint] using hTerminal)
  · have _hTerminalClass := hTerminalClass (by
      simpa only [JMinus, T, prev] using hTerminal)
    by_cases hEndpoint :
        (sigma.periodicU hf endpoint : Int) -
            pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
              endpoint = p
    · have hMinusComplementaryPair : ∀ i,
          i ∈ symmDiff J {endpoint, endpoint + f} ↔
            i + f ∉ symmDiff J {endpoint, endpoint + f} := by
        simpa only [JMinus, T, endpoint,
          periodicIndexSet_singleton hf endpoint] using
          hMinusComplementary
      have hJMinusPair : Profile.niveauTwo
          (symmDiff J {endpoint, endpoint + f}) hMinusComplementaryPair ∈
            compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' := by
        simpa only [JMinus, T, endpoint,
          periodicIndexSet_singleton hf endpoint] using
          hJMinus
      exact pin.niveauTwo_naEndpointPPinnedProfileExponentWitness start
        hLength valid J hComplementary hJPrev hJEndpoint
        hMinusComplementaryPair hJMinusPair
        (by simpa only [JMinus, T, endpoint,
            periodicIndexSet_singleton hf endpoint] using hJMinusEndpoint)
        huEndpointStrict hSourceZero
        (by simpa only [JMinus, T, endpoint,
            periodicIndexSet_singleton hf endpoint] using hMinusStart)
        (by simpa only [JMinus, T, endpoint,
            periodicIndexSet_singleton hf endpoint] using hEndpoint)
    · have hValues :=
        pin.niveauTwo_naSumEndpointBranch_values_of_pinnedCarries hp3
          hsubset hNoncritical hNotExceptional hEmpty start hBaseNonzero
          hSourceZero hBaseTerminal hBaseNextNonpositive JMinus
          hMinusComplementary hJMinus hJMinusEndpoint hTerminal
          huEndpointPositive huEndpointStrict hEndpoint
      rcases hValues with
        ⟨huSource, huTarget, _hBasePrev, hBaseNext, _hMinusPrev,
          hMinusNext, _hTargetOmit⟩
      have hJNext : prev + 2 ∈ J := by
        by_contra hNextNotMem
        have hEndpointEq : prev + 1 = endpoint := by
          simp only [prev, endpoint]
          push_cast
          ring
        have hIndexNext : periodicIndex hf (prev + 2) =
            periodicIndex hf endpoint + 1 := by
          rw [show prev + 2 = endpoint + 1 by rw [← hEndpointEq]; ring,
            periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf (endpoint + 1), map_add, map_one,
            ← periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf endpoint]
        have hIndexNextNe : periodicIndex hf (prev + 2) ≠
            periodicIndex hf endpoint := by
          intro hEq
          have hOne : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
            rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
            omega
          apply hOne
          calc
            1 = periodicIndex hf (prev + 2) -
                periodicIndex hf endpoint := by rw [hIndexNext]; ring
            _ = 0 := by rw [hEq]; ring
        have hNextNotT : prev + 2 ∉ T := by
          simp [T, periodicIndexSet, hIndexNextNe]
        have hNextNotMinus : prev + 2 ∉ JMinus := by
          simp [JMinus, Set.mem_symmDiff, hNextNotMem, hNextNotT]
        have hMinusBound : |pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus
            hMinusComplementary hJMinus (prev + 2)| ≤ 2 :=
          pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 JMinus
            hMinusComplementary hJMinus (prev + 2)
        let epsilonTarget :=
          (Profile.niveauTwo
            (pin.niveauTwoTarget JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus)
            (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary JMinus hMinusComplementary
              hJMinus)).sign (prev + 2)
        have hEpsilonTarget : epsilonTarget = 1 ∨ epsilonTarget = -1 := by
          by_cases hmem : prev + 2 ∈
              pin.niveauTwoTarget JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
          · right
            simp [epsilonTarget, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
              Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hmem]
          · left
            simp [epsilonTarget, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
              Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hmem]
        have hSourceSign :
            (Profile.niveauTwo JMinus hMinusComplementary).sign
              (prev + 2) = 1 := by
          simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
            Profile.set, hNextNotMinus]
        have hRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec JMinus
          hMinusComplementary hJMinus (prev + 2)
        simp only [niveauTwoCarryInput] at hRaw
        rw [hSourceSign, show prev + 2 - 1 = prev + 1 by ring,
          hEndpointEq, hMinusNext] at hRaw
        have hEquation :
            epsilonTarget * (sigma'.periodicU hf (prev + 2) : Int) -
                (sigma.periodicU hf (prev + 2) : Int) +
                pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry JMinus hMinusComplementary hJMinus
                  (prev + 2) = 2 * (p : Int) := by
          dsimp only [epsilonTarget]
          linear_combination hRaw
        exact naNextCoordinate_not_omitted hp3
          (show 0 ≤ (sigma'.periodicU hf (prev + 2) : Int) by positivity)
          (show (sigma'.periodicU hf (prev + 2) : Int) ≤ p by
            simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU]
            exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le (periodicIndex hf (prev + 2)))
          (show 0 ≤ (sigma.periodicU hf (prev + 2) : Int) by positivity)
          (abs_le.mp hMinusBound).2 hEpsilonTarget hEquation
      have hPrevSucc : prev + 1 = endpoint := by
        simp only [prev, endpoint]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hFinal :=
        pin.niveauTwo_naFinalPinnedProfileExponentWitness_of_pinnedCarries
          hp3 hpOdd hEmpty prev valid J JMinus hComplementary
          hMinusComplementary hJ hJMinus
          (by simpa only [prev] using hJPrev)
          (by rw [hPrevSucc]; exact hJEndpoint)
          hJNext (by rw [hPrevSucc]; exact hJMinusEndpoint)
          (by rw [hPrevSucc]; exact hBaseNext)
          (by rw [hPrevSucc]; exact hMinusNext)
          (by rw [hPrevSucc]; exact huSource)
          (by rw [hPrevSucc]; exact huTarget)
      exact ⟨symmDiff (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
          (periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf (prev + 1)}), hFinal.1,
        by simpa only [prev] using hFinal.2⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.na_nu_support_subset_of_profileExponentWitnesses
statement:
theorem na_nu_support_subset_of_profileExponentWitnesses
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hNoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t)
    (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.NuValid j)
    (hNiveauOne : ∀ (J : Set (ZMod f))
      (_hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
        compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma'),
      j ∈ J → j + 1 ∈ J →
        ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
          profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid)
              (.niveauOne J) =
            profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauOne K))
    (hNiveauTwo : ∀ (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
      (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
      (_hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
        compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
      (a : ZMod (2 * f)), periodicIndex hf a = j →
      a ∈ J → a + 1 ∈ J →
        ∃ (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K),
          profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid)
              (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
            profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid) ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hOriginalLeft : leftExponentSet hf sigma ⊆
      leftExponentSet hf sigma' :=
    leftExponentSet_subset_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_ne_critical
      hp3 hf chars sigma sigma' hsubset hNoncritical
  have hDetOriginal : determinantExponent hf sigma =
      determinantExponent hf sigma' :=
    determinantExponent_eq_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset hp hf chars
      sigma sigma' hsubset
  have hDetNu : determinantExponent hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid) =
      determinantExponent hf sigma' :=
    (determinantExponent_nu (by omega) hf sigma j valid).trans hDetOriginal
  apply semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_determinant_eq_of_left_subset hp hf
    chars (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid) sigma' hDetNu
  apply (leftExponentSet_subset_iff_complementary_choice_of_determinant_eq
    hp hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid) sigma' hDetNu).2
  intro profile
  cases profile with
  | niveauOne J =>
      by_cases hj : j ∈ J
      · by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J
        · let hJ := niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars
            sigma sigma' hsubset J
          obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hNiveauOne J hJ hj hj1
          exact Or.inl ⟨.niveauOne K, hK.symm⟩
        · left
          rw [profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne (by omega) hf sigma j valid
            J hj hj1]
          exact hOriginalLeft ⟨
            (Profile.niveauOne J).periodicSymmDiff hf {j + 1}, rfl⟩
      · by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J
        · right
          have hjCompl : j ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          have hj1Compl : j + 1 ∉ Jᶜ := by simpa
          rw [show (Profile.niveauOne J).compl = .niveauOne Jᶜ by rfl,
            profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne (by omega) hf sigma j valid Jᶜ
              hjCompl hj1Compl]
          exact hOriginalLeft ⟨
            (Profile.niveauOne Jᶜ).periodicSymmDiff hf {j + 1}, rfl⟩
        · right
          have hjCompl : j ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          have hj1Compl : j + 1 ∈ Jᶜ := by simpa
          let hJCompl := niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf
            chars sigma sigma' hsubset Jᶜ
          obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hNiveauOne Jᶜ hJCompl hjCompl hj1Compl
          exact ⟨.niveauOne K, by
            simpa only [Profile.compl] using hK.symm⟩
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      let a0 : ZMod (2 * f) := shiftedFirstLift hf 0 j
      have ha0Index : periodicIndex hf a0 = j :=
        periodicIndex_shiftedFirstLift hf 0 j
      let a : ZMod (2 * f) := if a0 ∈ J then a0 else a0 + f
      have haIndex : periodicIndex hf a = j := by
        dsimp only [a]
        split_ifs with ha0
        · exact ha0Index
        · rw [periodicIndex_add_half, ha0Index]
      have ha : a ∈ J := by
        dsimp only [a]
        split_ifs with ha0
        · exact ha0
        · by_contra ha0f
          exact ha0 ((hJ a0).mpr ha0f)
      have hCompatible : Profile.niveauTwo J hJ ∈
          compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
        mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset_of_ne_critical hp3 hf chars sigma
          sigma' hsubset hNoncritical (.niveauTwo J hJ)
      by_cases ha1 : a + 1 ∈ J
      · obtain ⟨K, hK, hEq⟩ := hNiveauTwo J hJ hCompatible a haIndex ha ha1
        exact Or.inl ⟨.niveauTwo K hK, hEq.symm⟩
      · left
        have hEq := profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauTwo hp hf sigma a
          (by simpa only [haIndex] using valid) J hJ ha ha1
        have hEq' : profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid)
              (.niveauTwo J hJ) =
            profileLeftExponent hf sigma
              ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).periodicSymmDiff hf
                {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}) := by
          simpa only [haIndex] using hEq
        rw [hEq']
        exact hOriginalLeft ⟨
          (Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).periodicSymmDiff hf
            {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)}, rfl⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.na_nu_support_subset
statement:
theorem na_nu_support_subset
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (start : ZMod f)
    (hBaseStart : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
      (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hsubset ∅) start = 0)
    (hBaseNegative : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
        (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
          hsubset ∅) (start + (k : ZMod f)) < 0)
    (hBaseNextNonpositive : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅
      (niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hsubset ∅) (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) ≤ 0)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ i, i ≤ length →
      sigma.u (start + (i + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (huEndpointPositive : 0 < sigma.u (start + (length + 2 : Nat)))
    (huEndpointStrict : sigma.u (start + (length + 2 : Nat)) < p) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) (by
          exact hSourceZero length (by omega))) ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hsubset ∅
  let prev : ZMod f := start + (length + 1 : Nat)
  let endpoint : ZMod f := start + (length + 2 : Nat)
  let valid : sigma.NuValid prev := by
    simpa only [prev] using hSourceZero length (by omega)
  change semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
      (sigma.nu (by omega) hf prev valid) ⊆
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
  have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
    intro hExceptional
    rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, huAll, huAll', ht⟩
    exact (exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars sigma
      sigma' huAll huAll' ht).1 hsubset
  have hBaseBound : ∀ i,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i| ≤ 2 :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (start + (k : ZMod f)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro k hkLower hkUpper
    have hNegative := hBaseNegative k hkLower hkUpper
    simpa only [hEmpty] using ne_of_lt hNegative
  have hBaseTerminal :
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = -1 ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) = -2 := by
    have hNegative : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (start + (length + 1 : Nat)) < 0 := by
      simpa only [hEmpty] using
        hBaseNegative (length + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    have hBound := abs_le.mp (hBaseBound (start + (length + 1 : Nat)))
    omega
  have hLength : length + 1 < f :=
    naNegativeString_length_lt_period hf start
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty)
      (by simpa only [hEmpty] using hBaseStart) hBaseNonzero
  have hNoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t :=
    pin.zero_source_and_zero_emptyCarry_target_not_critical hp3 hsubset
      hEmpty (start + 1) start
      (by simpa using hSourceZero 0 (by omega))
      (by simpa only [hEmpty] using hBaseStart) sigma'.t
  apply na_nu_support_subset_of_profileExponentWitnesses hp3 hsubset
    hNoncritical prev valid
  · intro J hJ hJPrev hJEndpoint
    apply pin.niveauOne_naPinnedProfileExponentWitness hp3 hpOdd hsubset
      hNoncritical hNotExceptional hEmpty start hLength
      (by simpa only [hEmpty] using hBaseStart) hBaseNonzero hBaseTerminal
      (by simpa only [hEmpty, endpoint] using hBaseNextNonpositive)
      hSourceZero huEndpointPositive huEndpointStrict valid J hJ
      (by simpa only [prev] using hJPrev)
    have hPrevSucc : prev + 1 = endpoint := by
      simp only [prev, endpoint]
      push_cast
      ring
    change endpoint ∈ J
    rw [← hPrevSucc]
    exact hJEndpoint
  · intro J hComplementary hJ a haIndex ha hJEndpoint
    let startLift : ZMod (2 * f) := a - (length + 1 : Nat)
    have hPeriodic (k : Nat) :
        periodicIndex hf (startLift + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) =
          start + (k : ZMod f) := by
      rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf
        (startLift + (k : ZMod (2 * f))), map_add, map_natCast]
      dsimp only [startLift]
      rw [map_sub, map_natCast, ← periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf a, haIndex]
      simp only [prev]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hLiftPrev : startLift + (length + 1 : Nat) = a := by
      dsimp only [startLift]
      ring
    have hLiftEndpoint : startLift + (length + 2 : Nat) = a + 1 := by
      dsimp only [startLift]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hWitness := pin.niveauTwo_naPinnedProfileExponentWitness hp3 hpOdd
      hsubset hNoncritical hNotExceptional hEmpty startLift hLength
      (by
        have hIndexStart : periodicIndex hf startLift = start := by
          simpa using hPeriodic 0
        rw [hIndexStart]
        simpa only [hEmpty] using hBaseStart)
      (by
        intro k hkLower hkUpper
        rw [hPeriodic]
        exact hBaseNonzero k hkLower hkUpper)
      (by simpa only [hPeriodic] using hBaseTerminal)
      (by rw [hPeriodic]; simpa only [hEmpty] using hBaseNextNonpositive)
      (by
        intro i hi
        simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodic]
        exact hSourceZero i hi)
      (by
        simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodic]
        exact huEndpointPositive)
      (by
        simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodic]
        exact huEndpointStrict)
      (by simpa only [hPeriodic] using valid) J hComplementary hJ
      (by rw [hLiftPrev]; exact ha)
      (by rw [hLiftEndpoint]; exact hJEndpoint)
    simpa only [hPeriodic] using hWitness

name: KLSposet.Pinning.na_nu_support_subset_of_minimalNegativeBoundaryReachesPositive
statement:
theorem na_nu_support_subset_of_minimalNegativeBoundaryReachesPositive
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty)
    (_hCase : CarrySixCase (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty) sigma.u)
    (hAllNonpositive : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i ≤ 0)
    (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
    (hString : NegativeStringToPositive
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty) sigma.u j) :
    ∃ (length : Nat) (hZero : sigma.u (j + (length : ZMod f)) = 0),
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
          (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + (length : ZMod f)) hZero) ⊆
        semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
proof:
:= by
  rcases hString with ⟨length, hInterval, hEndpointPositive⟩
  let start : ZMod f := j - 1
  have hIndex (k : Nat) : start + (k + 1 : Nat) = j + (k : ZMod f) := by
    dsimp only [start]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hOperationIndex : start + (length + 1 : Nat) =
      j + (length : ZMod f) := hIndex length
  have hEndpointIndex : start + (length + 2 : Nat) =
      j + (length + 1 : Nat) := by
    simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using hIndex (length + 1)
  have hZeroLength : sigma.u (j + (length : ZMod f)) = 0 :=
    (hInterval length (by omega)).2
  have hEndpointCoord : j + (length : ZMod f) + 1 =
      j + (length + 1 : Nat) := by
    push_cast
    ring
  have hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (start + (k : ZMod f)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro k hkLower hkUpper
    by_cases hkOne : k = 1
    · subst k
      simpa [start] using ne_of_lt hCurrent
    let n := k - 1
    have hkEq : k = n + 1 := by
      dsimp only [n]
      omega
    have hnUpper : n ≤ length := by
      dsimp only [n]
      omega
    rw [hkEq]
    have hNegative := (hInterval n hnUpper).1
    rw [show start + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) =
        j + (n : ZMod f) by simpa using hIndex n]
    exact ne_of_lt hNegative
  have hEndpointStrict : sigma.u (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) < p := by
    have hUpper := sigma.u_le (j + (length + 1 : Nat))
    have hNotP : sigma.u (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) ≠ p := by
      intro hP
      have hNoInvertibleNu :=
        (pin.emptyCarry_minimal_reductions hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal).2.2.2.2
      have hTerminalNegative := (hInterval length (by omega)).1
      exact (hNoInvertibleNu (j + (length : ZMod f)) hZeroLength
        (by rw [hEndpointCoord]; exact hP)) hTerminalNegative
    omega
  have hSupport := pin.na_nu_support_subset hp3 hpOdd hsubset start
    (by simpa only [start] using hPrev)
    (by
      intro k hkLower hkUpper
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hAllNonpositive (start + (k : ZMod f)))
        (hBaseNonzero k hkLower hkUpper))
    (by rw [hEndpointIndex]; exact hAllNonpositive _)
    (by
      intro i hi
      rw [hIndex]
      exact (hInterval i hi).2)
    (by
      rw [hEndpointIndex]
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hEndpointPositive)
    (by rw [hEndpointIndex]; exact hEndpointStrict)
  exact ⟨length, hZeroLength, by
    simpa only [hOperationIndex] using hSupport⟩

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_nbZeroString_of_separatingProfile
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_nbZeroString_of_separatingProfile
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hBaseAt : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) a = -1)
    (hProfileAt :
      pin.sameNiveauCarry (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ a = 1)
    (hBaseNegative : ∀ k, k < length →
      pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary)
        (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) < 0)
    (hBaseEnd : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty (.niveauTwo J hComplementary)
      (a + (length : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0)
    (hLaterNotMem : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      a + (k : ZMod (2 * f)) ∉ J) :
    ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let P : Profile f := .niveauTwo J hComplementary
  have hBounds :=
    (pin.pairedCarry_bounds_or_exception hp3 hEmpty P hJ).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hProfileBound :=
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ
  have hBaseAtP : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty P a = -1 := by
    simpa only [P] using hBaseAt
  have hProfileAtP : pin.sameNiveauCarry P hJ a = 1 := by
    simpa only [P] using hProfileAt
  have hSumAt : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty P hJ a = 0 := by
    have hDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty P hJ a
    rw [hProfileAtP, hBaseAtP] at hDouble
    omega
  have hDifferenceAt : pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty P hJ a = 1 := by
    have hDouble := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty P hJ a
    rw [hProfileAtP, hBaseAtP] at hDouble
    omega
  have hPred (k : Nat) :
      a + ((k + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1 =
        a + (k : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
    push_cast
    ring
  have hPropagation : ∀ k, k ≤ length → 1 ≤ k →
      sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0 ∧
        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty P hJ
          (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
        intro hkUpper hkPositive
        obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : k ≠ 0)
        have hnUpper : n < length := by omega
        have hPrevSum : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty P hJ
            (a + (n : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0 := by
          by_cases hnZero : n = 0
          · subst n
            simpa only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] using hSumAt
          · exact (ih n (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)).2
        have hPrevNegative : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty P
            (a + (n : ZMod (2 * f))) < 0 := by
          simpa only [P] using hBaseNegative n hnUpper
        have hPrevDifferencePositive :
            0 < pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty P hJ
              (a + (n : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
          have hDoubleSum := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty P hJ
            (a + (n : ZMod (2 * f)))
          have hDoubleDifference := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty P hJ
            (a + (n : ZMod (2 * f)))
          omega
        have hNotMem := hLaterNotMem (n + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        rcases (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J
            hComplementary hJ
            (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))).2 hNotMem with
          hSum | hDifference
        · rw [hPred n, hPrevSum] at hSum
          have hSourceEq :
              (sigma.periodicU hf
                  (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) : Int) =
                pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty P hJ
                  (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
            simpa only [P, mul_zero, zero_sub, neg_inj] using hSum
          by_cases hTerminal : n + 1 = length
          · have hBaseZero : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty P
                (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0 := by
              simpa only [P, hTerminal] using hBaseEnd
            subst length
            have hSourceZero : sigma.periodicU hf
                (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0 := by
              by_contra hSourceNe
              have hSourcePositive :
                  0 < sigma.periodicU hf
                    (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) :=
                Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hSourceNe
              have hDoubleSum := pin.two_mul_pairedCarrySum hEmpty P hJ
                (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))
              have hDoubleDifference := pin.two_mul_pairedCarryDifference hEmpty P hJ
                (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))
              have hProfileCarryBound :
                  |pin.sameNiveauCarry P hJ
                      (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))| ≤ 2 := by
                simpa only [P, sameNiveauCarry] using
                  hProfileBound (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))
              rcases abs_le.mp hProfileCarryBound with
                ⟨hProfileCarryLower, hProfileCarryUpper⟩
              have hSourcePositiveInt : (0 : Int) <
                  sigma.periodicU hf
                    (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
                exact_mod_cast hSourcePositive
              have hSumPositive : 0 < pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty P hJ
                  (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
                omega
              have hSumEq : pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty P hJ
                  (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 1 := by
                omega
              have hDifferenceEq : pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty P hJ
                  (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 1 := by
                omega
              have hNextNotMem := hLaterNotMem (n + 1 + 1)
                (by omega) (by omega)
              rcases (pin.niveauTwoPairedCarryAlternative_normalized hEmpty J
                  hComplementary hJ
                  (a + ((n + 1 + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))).2
                  hNextNotMem with hNextSum | hNextDifference
              · have hNextSum' :
                    -(sigma.periodicU hf
                        (a + ((n + 1 + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) : Int) =
                      (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty P hJ
                          (a + ((n + 1 + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1) -
                        pin.pairedCarrySum hEmpty P hJ
                          (a + ((n + 1 + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
                    simpa only [P] using hNextSum
                rw [hPred (n + 1), hSumEq] at hNextSum'
                have hNextSumBound :=
                  hBounds.1 (a + ((n + 1 + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))
                rcases abs_le.mp hNextSumBound with
                  ⟨hNextSumLower, hNextSumUpper⟩
                have hNextSourceNonnegative : (0 : Int) ≤
                    sigma.periodicU hf
                      (a + ((n + 1 + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
                  positivity
                omega
              · have hNextDifference' :
                    (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty P hJ
                        (a + ((n + 1 + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1) =
                      pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty P hJ
                        (a + ((n + 1 + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
                    simpa only [P] using hNextDifference
                rw [hPred (n + 1), hDifferenceEq] at hNextDifference'
                have hNextDifferenceBound :=
                  hBounds.2 (a + ((n + 1 + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))
                rcases abs_le.mp hNextDifferenceBound with
                  ⟨hNextDifferenceLower, hNextDifferenceUpper⟩
                omega
            have hSourceZeroInt :
                (sigma.periodicU hf
                  (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) : Int) = 0 := by
              exact_mod_cast hSourceZero
            rw [hSourceZeroInt] at hSourceEq
            exact ⟨hSourceZero, hSourceEq.symm⟩
          · have hCurrentNegative : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty P
                (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) < 0 := by
              simpa only [P] using hBaseNegative (n + 1) (by omega)
            have hSigns := pin.pairedCarry_sign_of_base_negative_of_not_exception
              hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty P hJ
              (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) hCurrentNegative
            have hSourceZero : sigma.periodicU hf
                (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0 := by
              have hSourceNonnegative : (0 : Int) ≤
                  sigma.periodicU hf
                    (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
                positivity
              have hSourceZeroInt :
                  (sigma.periodicU hf
                    (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) : Int) = 0 := by
                omega
              exact_mod_cast hSourceZeroInt
            have hSourceZeroInt :
                (sigma.periodicU hf
                  (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) : Int) = 0 := by
              exact_mod_cast hSourceZero
            rw [hSourceZeroInt] at hSourceEq
            exact ⟨hSourceZero, hSourceEq.symm⟩
        · have hDifference' :
              (p : Int) * pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty P hJ
                  (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1) =
                pin.pairedCarryDifference hEmpty P hJ
                  (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
            simpa only [P] using hDifference
          rw [hPred n] at hDifference'
          have hCurrentDifferenceBound :=
            hBounds.2 (a + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)))
          rcases abs_le.mp hCurrentDifferenceBound with
            ⟨hCurrentDifferenceLower, hCurrentDifferenceUpper⟩
          nlinarith
  intro k hkPositive hkUpper
  exact (hPropagation k hkUpper hkPositive).1

name: KLSposet.Pinning.nb_zero_string
statement:
theorem nb_zero_string
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
    (hAllNonpositive : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i ≤ 0)
    (huCurrent : 0 < sigma.u j) (huNext : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hBaseNegative : ∀ k, k < length →
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + (k : ZMod f)) < 0)
    (hBaseEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (j + (length : ZMod f)) = 0) :
    ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length →
      sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
    intro hExceptional
    rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, hu, hu', ht⟩
    exact (exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars sigma
      sigma' hu hu' ht).1 hsubset
  have hBaseBound : ∀ i,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i| ≤ 2 :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hCurrentEq : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = -1 := by
    let xCurrent := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j
    let xNext := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1)
    let y := niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' ∅
      (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty) (j + 1)
    change xCurrent = -1
    change xCurrent < 0 at hCurrent
    have hEquation : y = (p : Int) * xCurrent - xNext := by
      have hSpec := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty (j + 1)
      rw [show j + 1 - 1 = j by ring] at hSpec
      simpa only [y, xCurrent, xNext] using hSpec
    have hInputBound : |y| ≤ (p : Int) := by
      have huTargetUpper : (sigma'.u (j + 1) : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le (j + 1)
      have huTargetNonnegative : (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.u (j + 1) := by
        positivity
      dsimp only [y, niveauOneCarryInput]
      rw [huNext]
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, abs_mul,
        Profile.abs_sign, one_mul, abs_of_nonneg huTargetNonnegative]
      exact huTargetUpper
    rw [hEquation] at hInputBound
    have hCurrentBound : |xCurrent| ≤ 2 := by
      simpa only [xCurrent] using hBaseBound j
    have hNextBound : |xNext| ≤ 2 := by
      simpa only [xNext] using hBaseBound (j + 1)
    rcases abs_le.mp hCurrentBound with ⟨hCurrentLower, hCurrentUpper⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hNextBound with ⟨hNextLower, hNextUpper⟩
    rw [abs_le] at hInputBound
    rcases hInputBound with ⟨hInputLower, hInputUpper⟩
    interval_cases xCurrent <;> interval_cases xNext <;> omega
  have huCurrentStrict : sigma.u j < p := by
    have hUpper :=
      (pin.negativeBoundary_emptyCarry_coordinate hEmpty j hPrev hCurrent).2.2
    rw [hCurrentEq] at hUpper
    exact_mod_cast (show (sigma.u j : Int) < p by omega)
  have hTargetCurrent : (sigma'.u j : Int) = (sigma.u j : Int) + 1 := by
    have hCoordinate :=
      (pin.negativeBoundary_emptyCarry_coordinate hEmpty j hPrev hCurrent).2.1
    rw [hCurrentEq] at hCoordinate
    omega
  have hLength : length < f := by
    by_contra hLengthNot
    have hfLe : f ≤ length := Nat.le_of_not_gt hLengthNot
    let k := length - f
    have hk : k < length := by
      dsimp only [k]
      omega
    have hSplit : length = k + f := by
      dsimp only [k]
      omega
    have hIndex : j + (k : ZMod f) = j + (length : ZMod f) := by
      conv_rhs => rw [hSplit]
      push_cast
      simp
    have hNegative := hBaseNegative k hk
    rw [hIndex, hBaseEnd] at hNegative
    omega
  let a : ZMod (2 * f) := shiftedFirstLift hf 0 j
  have hPeriodicAt : periodicIndex hf a = j := by
    simpa only [a] using periodicIndex_shiftedFirstLift hf 0 j
  have hPeriodic (k : Nat) :
      periodicIndex hf (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) =
        j + (k : ZMod f) := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf
      (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))), map_add, map_natCast,
      ← periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf a, hPeriodicAt]
  let J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf {j} a
  let hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J :=
    shiftedNiveauTwoSet_complementary hf {j} a
  have ha : a ∈ J := by
    rw [show J = shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf {j} a by rfl,
      mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet]
    have hfPositive : 0 < f := by omega
    simp [hPeriodicAt, hfPositive]
  have hLaterNotMem : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
      a + (k : ZMod (2 * f)) ∉ J := by
    intro k hkPositive hkUpper
    have hkUpperF : k ≤ f := by omega
    have hkTwoF : k < 2 * f := by omega
    rw [show J = shiftedNiveauTwoSet hf {j} a by rfl,
      mem_shiftedNiveauTwoSet]
    have hSub : a + (k : ZMod (2 * f)) - a =
        (k : ZMod (2 * f)) := by ring
    rw [hSub, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hkTwoF]
    by_cases hkF : k < f
    · rw [if_pos hkF]
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, hPeriodic]
      intro hEq
      have hEq' : j + (k : ZMod f) = j + 0 := by simpa using hEq
      have hCast : (k : ZMod f) = 0 := add_left_cancel hEq'
      have hVal := congrArg ZMod.val hCast
      simp only [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hkF, ZMod.val_zero] at hVal
      omega
    · have hkEq : k = f := by omega
      subst k
      rw [if_neg (by omega : ¬ f < f)]
      simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, hPeriodic]
      simp
  have hNoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t :=
    pin.zero_source_and_zero_emptyCarry_target_not_critical hp3 hsubset
      hEmpty (j + 1) (j - 1) huNext hPrev sigma'.t
  have hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset_of_ne_critical hp3 hf chars sigma
      sigma' hsubset hNoncritical (.niveauTwo J hComplementary)
  have hBaseAt : pin.baseCarryAt hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) a = -1 := by
    simp only [baseCarryAt, hPeriodicAt, hCurrentEq]
  have hProfileAt : pin.sameNiveauCarry
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ a = 1 := by
    let P : Profile f := .niveauTwo J hComplementary
    let xPrev := pin.sameNiveauCarry P hJ (a - 1)
    let xAt := pin.sameNiveauCarry P hJ a
    let epsilon := (Profile.niveauTwo
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
      (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign a
    change xAt = 1
    have hPrevBound : |xPrev| ≤ 2 := by
      simpa only [P, sameNiveauCarry, xPrev] using
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ (a - 1)
    have hAtBound : |xAt| ≤ 2 := by
      simpa only [P, sameNiveauCarry, xAt] using
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ a
    have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty P hJ a
    have hParity' : ∃ z, xAt - (-1) = z + z := by
      simpa only [P, xAt, hBaseAt] using hParity
    have hSourceSign : P.sign a = -1 := by
      exact (Profile.sign_eq_neg_one_iff P a).2 ha
    have hEquationRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ a
    have hEquation : epsilon * ((sigma.u j : Int) + 1) +
          (sigma.u j : Int) = (p : Int) * xPrev - xAt := by
      simp only [niveauTwoCarryInput] at hEquationRaw
      rw [hSourceSign] at hEquationRaw
      simp only [P, xPrev, xAt, epsilon]
      rw [show a - 1 = a - 1 by rfl]
      rw [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodicAt,
        PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodicAt] at hEquationRaw
      rw [hTargetCurrent] at hEquationRaw
      norm_num at hEquationRaw
      exact hEquationRaw
    have hEpsilon : epsilon = 1 ∨ epsilon = -1 := by
      by_cases hmem : a ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
      · right
        simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hmem]
      · left
        simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hmem]
    rcases hpOdd with ⟨n, hn⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hPrevBound with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hAtBound with ⟨hAtLower, hAtUpper⟩
    rcases hParity' with ⟨z, hz⟩
    rcases hEpsilon with hEpsilon | hEpsilon
    · rw [hEpsilon] at hEquation
      interval_cases xPrev <;> interval_cases xAt <;>
        norm_num at hEquation <;> omega
    · rw [hEpsilon] at hEquation
      interval_cases xPrev <;> interval_cases xAt <;>
        norm_num at hEquation <;> omega
  have hLifted := pin.niveauTwo_nbZeroString_of_separatingProfile hp3
    hNotExceptional hEmpty J hComplementary hJ a hBaseAt hProfileAt
    (by
      intro k hk
      simp only [baseCarryAt, hPeriodic]
      exact hBaseNegative k hk)
    (by simp only [baseCarryAt, hPeriodic, hBaseEnd]) hLaterNotMem
  intro k hkPositive hkUpper
  have hZero := hLifted k hkPositive hkUpper
  simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodic] using hZero

name: KLSposet.Pinning.nbFirstZeroAfterNegativeBoundary
statement:
theorem nbFirstZeroAfterNegativeBoundary
    {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (x : ZMod f → Int) (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : x (j - 1) = 0) (hCurrent : x j < 0)
    (hAllNonpositive : ∀ i, x i ≤ 0) :
    ∃ length : Nat,
      1 ≤ length ∧ length < f ∧
        (∀ k : Nat, k < length → x (j + (k : ZMod f)) < 0) ∧
        x (j + (length : ZMod f)) = 0 ∧
        ∀ k : Nat, x (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0 → length ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hLastCast : ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) = -1 := by
    have hfSplit : f = (f - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hCast := congrArg (fun n : Nat => (n : ZMod f)) hfSplit
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hCast
    calc
      ((f - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) = (f : ZMod f) - 1 := by
        rw [hCast]
        ring
      _ = 0 - 1 := by rw [ZMod.natCast_self]
      _ = -1 := by ring
  let ZeroAt : Nat → Prop := fun k => x (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0
  have hExists : ∃ k : Nat, ZeroAt k := by
    refine ⟨f - 1, ?_⟩
    simpa only [ZeroAt, hLastCast, sub_eq_add_neg] using hPrev
  let length := Nat.find hExists
  have hEnd : x (j + (length : ZMod f)) = 0 := by
    simpa only [length, ZeroAt] using Nat.find_spec hExists
  have hPositive : 1 ≤ length := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hLengthZero : length = 0 := by omega
    rw [hLengthZero] at hEnd
    have hCurrentZero : x j = 0 := by simpa using hEnd
    omega
  have hLength : length < f := by
    have hFindLe : length ≤ f - 1 := by
      simpa only [length] using
        (Nat.find_min' hExists (show ZeroAt (f - 1) by
          simpa only [ZeroAt, hLastCast, sub_eq_add_neg] using hPrev))
    omega
  have hNegative : ∀ k : Nat, k < length →
      x (j + (k : ZMod f)) < 0 := by
    intro k hk
    have hNonpositive := hAllNonpositive (j + (k : ZMod f))
    have hNonzero : x (j + (k : ZMod f)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hZero
      have hFindLe : length ≤ k := by
        simpa only [length] using
          (Nat.find_min' hExists (show ZeroAt k by
            simpa only [ZeroAt] using hZero))
      omega
    omega
  refine ⟨length, hPositive, hLength, hNegative, hEnd, ?_⟩
  intro k hZero
  simpa only [length] using
    (Nat.find_min' hExists (show ZeroAt k by
      simpa only [ZeroAt] using hZero))

name: KLSposet.Pinning.nb_zero_interval
statement:
theorem nb_zero_interval
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
    (hAllNonpositive : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i ≤ 0)
    (huNext : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hCases :
      0 < sigma.u j ∨
        (∀ i, sigma.u i = 0) ∨
          (sigma.u j = 0 ∧
            ∃ (endpoint stop : Nat), endpoint < f ∧ stop ≤ endpoint ∧
              (∀ k : Nat, k ≤ endpoint →
                sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0) ∧
              0 < sigma.u (j + ((endpoint + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) ∧
              pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
                (j + (stop : ZMod f)) = 0)) :
    ∃ length : Nat,
      1 ≤ length ∧ length < f ∧
        (∀ k : Nat, k < length →
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
            (j + (k : ZMod f)) < 0) ∧
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (j + (length : ZMod f)) = 0 ∧
        ∀ k : Nat, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length →
          sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases nbFirstZeroAfterNegativeBoundary hf
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty) j hPrev hCurrent
      hAllNonpositive with
    ⟨length, hLengthPositive, hLength, hNegative, hEnd, hLeast⟩
  refine ⟨length, hLengthPositive, hLength, hNegative, hEnd, ?_⟩
  rcases hCases with huCurrent | hCases
  · exact pin.nb_zero_string hp3 hpOdd hsubset hEmpty j hPrev hCurrent
      hAllNonpositive huCurrent huNext hNegative hEnd
  rcases hCases with hAllSourceZero | hLaterPositive
  · intro k _hkPositive _hkUpper
    exact hAllSourceZero _
  · rcases hLaterPositive with
      ⟨_huCurrentZero, endpoint, stop, _hEndpointLength, hStopUpper,
        hSourceZero, _hEndpointPositive, hStopZero⟩
    have hLengthStop : length ≤ stop := hLeast stop hStopZero
    intro k _hkPositive hkUpper
    exact hSourceZero k (le_trans hkUpper (le_trans hLengthStop hStopUpper))

name: KLSposet.Pinning.nbBaseStartCoordinates
statement:
theorem nbBaseStartCoordinates
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
    (huNext : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0) :
    pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = -1 ∧
      sigma'.u j = sigma.u j + 1 ∧ sigma.u j < p
proof:
:= by
  have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
    intro hExceptional
    rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, hu, hu', ht⟩
    exact (exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars sigma
      sigma' hu hu' ht).1 hsubset
  have hBaseBound : ∀ i,
      |pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i| ≤ 2 :=
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 ∅ hEmpty).resolve_right
      hNotExceptional
  have hCurrentEq : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = -1 := by
    let xCurrent := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j
    let xNext := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j + 1)
    let y := niveauOneCarryInput sigma sigma' ∅
      (pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty) (j + 1)
    change xCurrent = -1
    change xCurrent < 0 at hCurrent
    have hEquation : y = (p : Int) * xCurrent - xNext := by
      have hSpec := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty (j + 1)
      rw [show j + 1 - 1 = j by ring] at hSpec
      simpa only [y, xCurrent, xNext] using hSpec
    have hInputBound : |y| ≤ (p : Int) := by
      have huTargetUpper : (sigma'.u (j + 1) : Int) ≤ (p : Int) := by
        exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le (j + 1)
      have huTargetNonnegative : (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.u (j + 1) := by
        positivity
      dsimp only [y, niveauOneCarryInput]
      rw [huNext]
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, abs_mul,
        Profile.abs_sign, one_mul, abs_of_nonneg huTargetNonnegative]
      exact huTargetUpper
    rw [hEquation] at hInputBound
    have hCurrentBound : |xCurrent| ≤ 2 := by
      simpa only [xCurrent] using hBaseBound j
    have hNextBound : |xNext| ≤ 2 := by
      simpa only [xNext] using hBaseBound (j + 1)
    rcases abs_le.mp hCurrentBound with ⟨hCurrentLower, hCurrentUpper⟩
    rcases abs_le.mp hNextBound with ⟨hNextLower, hNextUpper⟩
    rw [abs_le] at hInputBound
    rcases hInputBound with ⟨hInputLower, hInputUpper⟩
    interval_cases xCurrent <;> interval_cases xNext <;> omega
  have hCoordinate :=
    (pin.negativeBoundary_emptyCarry_coordinate hEmpty j hPrev hCurrent).2.1
  have hUpper :=
    (pin.negativeBoundary_emptyCarry_coordinate hEmpty j hPrev hCurrent).2.2
  rw [hCurrentEq] at hCoordinate hUpper
  refine ⟨hCurrentEq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact_mod_cast (show (sigma'.u j : Int) = (sigma.u j : Int) + 1 by omega)
  · exact_mod_cast (show (sigma.u j : Int) < p by omega)

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_nbBaseEndpointTargetCoordinate
statement:
theorem niveauOne_nbBaseEndpointTargetCoordinate
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hu : sigma.u i = 0)
    (hPrevNegative : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) < 0)
    (hAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = 0) :
    pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) = -1 ∧ sigma'.u i = p
proof:
:= by
  have hEquation := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec ∅ hEmpty i
  have huUpper : (sigma'.u i : Int) ≤ p := by
    exact_mod_cast sigma'.u_le i
  have huNonnegative : (0 : Int) ≤ sigma'.u i := by positivity
  by_cases hi : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget ∅ hEmpty
  · simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hu, hAt, hi] at hEquation
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  · simp [niveauOneCarryInput, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator,
      Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hu, hAt, hi] at hEquation
    nlinarith

name: KLSposet.Pinning.nbStartCarryStep
statement:
theorem nbStartCarryStep {p u target : Nat} (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    {epsilon xPrev xAt : Int}
    (huStrict : u < p) (hTarget : target = u + 1)
    (hEpsilon : epsilon = 1 ∨ epsilon = -1)
    (hPrevBound : |xPrev| ≤ 2) (hAtBound : |xAt| ≤ 2)
    (hPrevEven : Even xPrev) (hAtParity : Even (xAt - (-1)))
    (hEquation : epsilon * (target : Int) + (u : Int) =
      (p : Int) * xPrev - xAt) :
    (u = 0 ∧ target = 1 ∧ xPrev = 0 ∧ xAt = -1) ∨ xAt = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases abs_le.mp hPrevBound with ⟨hPrevLower, hPrevUpper⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hAtBound with ⟨hAtLower, hAtUpper⟩
  rcases hPrevEven with ⟨zPrev, hzPrev⟩
  rcases hAtParity with ⟨zAt, hzAt⟩
  rw [hTarget] at hEquation ⊢
  rcases hEpsilon with hEpsilon | hEpsilon <;> rw [hEpsilon] at hEquation
  all_goals interval_cases xPrev <;> interval_cases xAt <;> omega

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_nbStartCarryAlternative
statement:
theorem niveauOne_nbStartCarryAlternative
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f) (hj : j ∈ J)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = -1)
    (huTarget : sigma'.u j = sigma.u j + 1)
    (huStrict : sigma.u j < p) :
    (sigma.u j = 0 ∧ sigma'.u j = 1 ∧
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j - 1) = 0 ∧
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ j = -1) ∨
      pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ j = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hBounds := (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 J hJ)
    |>.resolve_right hNotExceptional
  have hPrevParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
    (j - 1)
  have hAtParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ j
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBasePrev, sub_zero] at hPrevParity
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBaseAt] at hAtParity
  have hSourceSign : (Profile.niveauOne J).sign j = -1 :=
    (Profile.sign_eq_neg_one_iff (.niveauOne J) j).2 hj
  let epsilon := (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign j
  have hEpsilon : epsilon = 1 ∨ epsilon = -1 := by
    by_cases hmem : j ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
    · right
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
    · left
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
  have hEquationRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_spec J hJ j
  have hEquation : epsilon * (sigma'.u j : Int) + (sigma.u j : Int) =
      (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j - 1) -
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ j := by
    simp only [niveauOneCarryInput, hSourceSign] at hEquationRaw
    norm_num at hEquationRaw
    exact hEquationRaw
  exact nbStartCarryStep hp3 huStrict huTarget hEpsilon
    (hBounds (j - 1)) (hBounds j) hPrevParity hAtParity hEquation

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_nbStartCarryAlternative
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_nbStartCarryAlternative
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (a : ZMod (2 * f)) (ha : a ∈ J)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (a - 1)) = 0)
    (hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf a) = -1)
    (huTarget : sigma'.periodicU hf a = sigma.periodicU hf a + 1)
    (huStrict : sigma.periodicU hf a < p) :
    (sigma.periodicU hf a = 0 ∧ sigma'.periodicU hf a = 1 ∧
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a - 1) = 0 ∧
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a = -1) ∨
      pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hBounds := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ
  have hPrevParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty
    (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (a - 1)
  have hAtParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty
    (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ a
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBasePrev, sub_zero] at hPrevParity
  simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBaseAt] at hAtParity
  have hSourceSign : (Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary).sign a = -1 :=
    (Profile.sign_eq_neg_one_iff (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) a).2 ha
  let epsilon := (Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
    (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign a
  have hEpsilon : epsilon = 1 ∨ epsilon = -1 := by
    by_cases hmem : a ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
    · right
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
    · left
      simp [epsilon, Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
        Profile.set, hmem]
  have hEquationRaw := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_spec J hComplementary hJ a
  have hEquation : epsilon * (sigma'.periodicU hf a : Int) +
        (sigma.periodicU hf a : Int) =
      (p : Int) * pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a - 1) -
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a := by
    simp only [niveauTwoCarryInput, hSourceSign] at hEquationRaw
    norm_num at hEquationRaw
    exact hEquationRaw
  exact nbStartCarryStep hp3 huStrict huTarget hEpsilon
    (hBounds (a - 1)) (hBounds a) hPrevParity hAtParity hEquation

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_nbEndpointCarryZero
statement:
theorem niveauOne_nbEndpointCarryZero
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈ compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod f) (hu : sigma.u i = 0) (hu' : sigma'.u i = p)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (i - 1) = -1)
    (hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i = 0) :
    pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hBound := (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry_bound_or_exception hp3 J hJ)
    |>.resolve_right hNotExceptional
  have hEpsilon :
      (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i = 1 ∨
        (Profile.niveauOne (pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ)).sign i = -1 := by
    by_cases hi : i ∈ pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
    · right
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
    · left
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
  have hPrevOdd : Odd (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (i - 1)) := by
    have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ
      (i - 1)
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBasePrev] at hParity
    rcases hParity with ⟨z, hz⟩
    exact ⟨z - 1, by omega⟩
  have hAtEven : Even (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ i) := by
    have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty (.niveauOne J) hJ i
    simpa only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBaseAt, sub_zero] using hParity
  have hEquation := pin.niveauOne_paCarryEquation J hJ i hu
  rw [hu'] at hEquation
  rcases paEndpointCarryStep hp3 hEpsilon (hBound (i - 1)) (hBound i)
      hPrevOdd hAtEven hEquation with hPositive | hNegative
  · exact hPositive.2.1
  · exact hNegative.2.1

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_nbEndpointCarryZero
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_nbEndpointCarryZero
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ k, k ∈ J ↔ k + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (i : ZMod (2 * f))
    (hu : sigma.periodicU hf i = 0) (hu' : sigma'.periodicU hf i = p)
    (hBasePrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf (i - 1)) = -1)
    (hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (periodicIndex hf i) = 0) :
    pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hBound := pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry_abs_le_two hp3 J hComplementary hJ
  have hEpsilon :
      (Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign i = 1 ∨
      (Profile.niveauTwo (pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ)
        (pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ)).sign i = -1 := by
    by_cases hi : i ∈ pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
    · right
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
    · left
      simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hi]
  have hPrevOdd :
      Odd (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (i - 1)) := by
    have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ (i - 1)
    simp only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBasePrev] at hParity
    rcases hParity with ⟨z, hz⟩
    exact ⟨z - 1, by omega⟩
  have hAtEven : Even (pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ i) := by
    have hParity := pin.pairedCarry_difference_even hEmpty
      (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ i
    simpa only [sameNiveauCarry, baseCarryAt, hBaseAt, sub_zero] using hParity
  have hEquation := pin.niveauTwo_paCarryEquation J hComplementary hJ i hu
  rw [hu'] at hEquation
  rcases paEndpointCarryStep hp3 hEpsilon (hBound (i - 1)) (hBound i)
      hPrevOdd hAtEven hEquation with hPositive | hNegative
  · exact hPositive.2.1
  · exact hNegative.2.1

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauOne_nbProfileExponentWitness_of_carries
statement:
theorem niveauOne_nbProfileExponentWitness_of_carries
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hJ : Profile.niveauOne J ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J)
    (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.u (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hStart :
      (sigma.u j = 0 ∧ sigma'.u j = 1 ∧
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ (j - 1) = 0 ∧
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ j = -1) ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ j = 1)
    (hEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry J hJ
      (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0) :
    ∃ K : Set (ZMod f),
      profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) (.niveauOne J) =
        profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauOne K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K : Set (ZMod f) := pin.niveauOneTarget J hJ
  have hPair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne K) := by
    rw [← pin.niveauOneTarget_spec J hJ]
    exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauOne J) hJ
  have hCongr := niveauOneProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' J K hPair
  have hTheta := profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauOne_of_mem_mem
    (by omega : 1 ≤ p) hf sigma j valid J hj hj1
  rcases hStart with hNegative | hPositive
  · have hEquation := pin.niveauOne_paCarryEquation J hJ j hNegative.1
    have hjTarget : j ∉ K := by
      intro hjK
      have hSign : (Profile.niveauOne K).sign j = -1 := by
        simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
          hjK]
      rw [hSign, hNegative.2.1, hNegative.2.2.1, hNegative.2.2.2] at hEquation
      norm_num at hEquation
    have hToggle := niveauOne_pbSingletonToggle hf sigma' K j hjTarget
      hNegative.2.1
    refine ⟨symmDiff K {j}, ?_⟩
    rw [hTheta]
    simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
    rw [hToggle]
    linear_combination hCongr
  · let T : Set (ZMod f) := ↑(paCyclicInterval j length)
    have hSigned := pin.niveauOne_pbSignedIntervalWeightedSum J hJ j hLength
      hSourceZero hPositive hEnd
    have hToggle := niveauOneProfileSum_symmDiff_eq_add_signed hf sigma' K T
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne T).indicator i : Int) *
            (Profile.niveauOne K).sign i * (sigma'.u i : Int)) =
          (fun i : ZMod f ↦ T.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : Int)) i *
            ((Profile.niveauOne K).sign i * (sigma'.u i : Int))) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i ∈ T <;>
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, Set.indicator,
          hi]
    rw [hfun, hSigned] at hToggle
    refine ⟨symmDiff K T, ?_⟩
    rw [hTheta]
    simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
    rw [hToggle]
    linear_combination hCongr

name: KLSposet.Pinning.niveauTwo_nbProfileExponentWitness_of_carries
statement:
theorem niveauTwo_nbProfileExponentWitness_of_carries
    {p f length : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f} (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hComplementary : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (hJ : Profile.niveauTwo J hComplementary ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid (periodicIndex hf a))
    (ha : a ∈ J) (ha1 : a + 1 ∈ J)
    (hLength : length + 1 < f)
    (hSourceZero : ∀ k, k ≤ length →
      sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0)
    (hStart :
      (sigma.periodicU hf a = 0 ∧ sigma'.periodicU hf a = 1 ∧
          pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ (a - 1) = 0 ∧
          pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a = -1) ∨
        pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ a = 1)
    (hEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauTwoCarry J hComplementary hJ
      (a + (length + 1 : Nat)) = 0) :
    ∃ (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K),
      profileLeftExponent hf
          (sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid)
          (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
        profileLeftExponent hf sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := pin.niveauTwoTarget J hComplementary hJ
  let hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K :=
    pin.niveauTwoTarget_complementary J hComplementary hJ
  have hPair :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) =
        profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK) := by
    rw [← pin.niveauTwoTarget_spec J hComplementary hJ]
    exact pin.target_pair_eq (.niveauTwo J hComplementary) hJ
  have hCongr := niveauTwoProfileSum_congr_left_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' J K hComplementary hK hPair
  have hTheta := profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauTwo_of_mem_mem hp hf sigma a
    valid J hComplementary ha ha1
  rcases hStart with hNegative | hPositive
  · have hEquation := pin.niveauTwo_paCarryEquation J hComplementary hJ a
      hNegative.1
    have haTarget : a ∉ K := by
      intro haK
      have hSign : (Profile.niveauTwo K hK).sign a = -1 := by
        simp [Profile.sign, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
          haK]
      rw [hSign, hNegative.2.1, hNegative.2.2.1, hNegative.2.2.2] at hEquation
      norm_num at hEquation
    let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) :=
      periodicIndexSet hf {periodicIndex hf a}
    let L : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := symmDiff K T
    have hL : ∀ i, i ∈ L ↔ i + f ∉ L := by
      intro i
      simp only [L, T, Set.mem_symmDiff, periodicIndexSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
        Set.mem_singleton_iff, periodicIndex_add_half]
      have hKi := hK i
      tauto
    have hToggle := niveauTwo_pbPeriodicSingletonToggle hf sigma' K hK a
      haTarget hNegative.2.1
    change niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' L = _ at hToggle
    refine ⟨L, hL, ?_⟩
    rw [hTheta]
    simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
    rw [hToggle]
    linear_combination hCongr
  · let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := periodicIndexSet hf
        (↑(paCyclicInterval (periodicIndex hf a) length) : Set (ZMod f))
    let L : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := symmDiff K T
    have hL : ∀ i, i ∈ L ↔ i + f ∉ L := by
      intro i
      simp only [L, T, Set.mem_symmDiff, periodicIndexSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
        periodicIndex_add_half]
      have hKi := hK i
      tauto
    have hSigned := pin.niveauTwo_pbSignedPeriodicIntervalWeightedSum J
      hComplementary hJ a hLength hSourceZero hPositive hEnd
    have hToggle := niveauTwoProfileSum_symmDiff_eq_add_signed hf sigma' K T hK
    rw [hSigned] at hToggle
    change niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' L = _ at hToggle
    refine ⟨L, hL, ?_⟩
    rw [hTheta]
    simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
    rw [hToggle]
    linear_combination hCongr

name: KLSposet.Pinning.nb_theta_support_subset
statement:
theorem nb_theta_support_subset
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
    (hAllNonpositive : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i ≤ 0)
    (huNext : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hCases :
      0 < sigma.u j ∨
        (∀ i, sigma.u i = 0) ∨
          (sigma.u j = 0 ∧
            ∃ (endpoint stop : Nat), endpoint < f ∧ stop ≤ endpoint ∧
              (∀ k : Nat, k ≤ endpoint →
                sigma.u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0) ∧
              0 < sigma.u (j + ((endpoint + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) ∧
              pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
                (j + (stop : ZMod f)) = 0)) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
        (sigma.theta hf j ⟨
          (pin.nbBaseStartCoordinates hp3 hsubset hEmpty j hPrev hCurrent
            huNext).2.2,
          huNext⟩) ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hBaseStart := pin.nbBaseStartCoordinates hp3 hsubset hEmpty j hPrev
    hCurrent huNext
  have hBaseAt : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j = -1 := hBaseStart.1
  have huTargetStart : sigma'.u j = sigma.u j + 1 := hBaseStart.2.1
  have huStrict : sigma.u j < p := hBaseStart.2.2
  let valid : sigma.ThetaValid j := ⟨huStrict, huNext⟩
  change semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars (sigma.theta hf j valid) ⊆
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
  obtain ⟨length, hLengthPositive, hLength, hBaseNegative, hBaseEnd,
      hSourceZero⟩ := pin.nb_zero_interval hp3 hpOdd hsubset hEmpty j hPrev
        hCurrent hAllNonpositive huNext hCases
  let tailLength := length - 1
  have hTailSucc : tailLength + 1 = length := by
    dsimp only [tailLength]
    omega
  have hTailLength : tailLength + 1 < f := by omega
  have hSourceZeroTail : ∀ k, k ≤ tailLength →
      sigma.u (j + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    exact hSourceZero (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hEndIndex : j + (tailLength + 1 : Nat) =
      j + (length : Nat) := by rw [hTailSucc]
  have hBaseEndTail : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (j + (tailLength + 1 : Nat)) = 0 := by
    rw [hEndIndex]
    exact hBaseEnd
  have hEndPredIndex : j + (length : ZMod f) - 1 =
      j + ((length - 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
    have hLengthSplit : length = length - 1 + 1 := by omega
    conv_lhs => rw [hLengthSplit]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hBaseEndPrevNegative : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (j + (length : ZMod f) - 1) < 0 := by
    rw [hEndPredIndex]
    exact hBaseNegative (length - 1) (by omega)
  have huEnd : sigma.u (j + (length : ZMod f)) = 0 :=
    hSourceZero length hLengthPositive le_rfl
  have hBaseEndpoint := pin.niveauOne_nbBaseEndpointTargetCoordinate hEmpty
    (j + (length : ZMod f)) huEnd hBaseEndPrevNegative hBaseEnd
  have hBaseEndPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
      (j + (length : ZMod f) - 1) = -1 := hBaseEndpoint.1
  have huTargetEnd : sigma'.u (j + (length : ZMod f)) = p :=
    hBaseEndpoint.2
  have hNotExceptional : ¬ ExceptionalCarryPair sigma sigma' := by
    intro hExceptional
    rcases hExceptional with ⟨rfl, hu, hu', ht⟩
    exact (exceptionalSemisimpleCharacterSets_incomparable hf chars sigma
      sigma' hu hu' ht).1 hsubset
  have hNoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t :=
    pin.zero_source_and_zero_emptyCarry_target_not_critical hp3 hsubset hEmpty
      (j + 1) (j - 1) huNext hPrev sigma'.t
  apply pb_theta_support_subset_of_profileExponentWitnesses hp3 hsubset
    hNoncritical j valid
  · intro J hJ hj hj1
    have hStart := pin.niveauOne_nbStartCarryAlternative hp3 hNotExceptional
      hEmpty J hJ j hj hPrev hBaseAt huTargetStart huStrict
    have hEnd := pin.niveauOne_nbEndpointCarryZero hp3 hNotExceptional hEmpty
      J hJ (j + (length : ZMod f)) huEnd huTargetEnd hBaseEndPrev hBaseEnd
    exact pin.niveauOne_nbProfileExponentWitness_of_carries J hJ j valid hj hj1
      hTailLength hSourceZeroTail hStart (by simpa only [hEndIndex] using hEnd)
  · intro J hComplementary hJ a haIndex ha ha1
    have hPeriodic (k : Nat) :
        periodicIndex hf (a + (k : ZMod (2 * f))) =
          j + (k : ZMod f) := by
      rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_natCast,
        ← periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf a, haIndex]
    have hBasePrevA : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (a - 1)) = 0 := by
      rw [periodicIndex_sub_one, haIndex]
      exact hPrev
    have hBaseAtA : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf a) = -1 := by rw [haIndex]; exact hBaseAt
    have huTargetStartA : sigma'.periodicU hf a =
        sigma.periodicU hf a + 1 := by
