      simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, haIndex] using huTargetStart
    have huStrictA : sigma.periodicU hf a < p := by
      simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, haIndex] using huStrict
    have hSourceZeroA : ∀ k, k ≤ tailLength →
        sigma.periodicU hf (a + (k + 1 : Nat)) = 0 := by
      intro k hk
      simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodic]
      exact hSourceZeroTail k hk
    have hStart := pin.niveauTwo_nbStartCarryAlternative hp3 hEmpty J
      hComplementary hJ a ha hBasePrevA hBaseAtA huTargetStartA huStrictA
    have hBaseEndPrevIndex : periodicIndex hf
        (a + (length : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1) =
          j + (length : ZMod f) - 1 := by
      rw [periodicIndex_sub_one, hPeriodic]
    have hBaseEndPrevA : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (a + (length : ZMod (2 * f)) - 1)) = -1 := by
      rw [hBaseEndPrevIndex]
      exact hBaseEndPrev
    have hBaseEndA : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
        (periodicIndex hf (a + (length : ZMod (2 * f)))) = 0 := by
      rw [hPeriodic]
      exact hBaseEnd
    have huEndA : sigma.periodicU hf
        (a + (length : ZMod (2 * f))) = 0 := by
      simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodic] using huEnd
    have huTargetEndA : sigma'.periodicU hf
        (a + (length : ZMod (2 * f))) = p := by
      simpa only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, hPeriodic] using huTargetEnd
    have hEnd := pin.niveauTwo_nbEndpointCarryZero hp3 hEmpty J
      hComplementary hJ (a + (length : ZMod (2 * f))) huEndA huTargetEndA
      hBaseEndPrevA hBaseEndA
    have hWitness := pin.niveauTwo_nbProfileExponentWitness_of_carries J
      hComplementary hJ a (by simpa only [haIndex] using valid) ha ha1
      hTailLength hSourceZeroA hStart (by
        simpa only [hTailSucc] using hEnd)
    simpa only [haIndex] using hWitness

name: KLSposet.Pinning.nbCases_of_noNegativeString
statement:
theorem nbCases_of_noNegativeString
    {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (x : ZMod f → Int) (u : ZMod f → Nat)
    (j : ZMod f) (hAllNonpositive : ∀ i, x i ≤ 0)
    (hNoString : ¬ NegativeStringToPositive x u j) :
    0 < u j ∨
      (∀ i, u i = 0) ∨
        (u j = 0 ∧
          ∃ (endpoint stop : Nat), endpoint < f ∧ stop ≤ endpoint ∧
            (∀ k : Nat, k ≤ endpoint →
              u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0) ∧
            0 < u (j + ((endpoint + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) ∧
            x (j + (stop : ZMod f)) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  by_cases huCurrentPositive : 0 < u j
  · exact Or.inl huCurrentPositive
  by_cases hAllZero : ∀ i, u i = 0
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hAllZero)
  right
  right
  have huCurrentZero : u j = 0 := by omega
  have hSomePositive : ∃ i, 0 < u i := by
    push_neg at hAllZero
    rcases hAllZero with ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨i, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hi⟩
  have hExistsBounded : ∃ k : Nat, k < f ∧
      0 < u (j + (k : ZMod f)) := by
    rcases hSomePositive with ⟨i, hi⟩
    let k : Nat := (i - j).val
    have hk : k < f := by
      simpa only [k] using ZMod.val_lt (i - j)
    have hkCast : (k : ZMod f) = i - j := by
      simpa only [k] using ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (i - j)
    refine ⟨k, hk, ?_⟩
    rw [hkCast]
    have hIndex : j + (i - j) = i := by abel
    rw [hIndex]
    exact hi
  let PositiveAt : Nat → Prop := fun k => 0 < u (j + (k : ZMod f))
  have hExists : ∃ k : Nat, PositiveAt k := by
    rcases hExistsBounded with ⟨k, _hk, hPositive⟩
    exact ⟨k, hPositive⟩
  let first := Nat.find hExists
  have hFirstPositive : PositiveAt first := by
    simpa only [first] using Nat.find_spec hExists
  have hFirstNonzero : 1 ≤ first := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hFirstZero : first = 0 := by omega
    rw [hFirstZero] at hFirstPositive
    simp only [PositiveAt, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, huCurrentZero,
      lt_self_iff_false] at hFirstPositive
  have hFirstLt : first < f := by
    rcases hExistsBounded with ⟨k, hk, hPositive⟩
    have hFirstLe : first ≤ k := by
      simpa only [first] using Nat.find_min' hExists hPositive
    omega
  let endpoint := first - 1
  have hEndpointSucc : endpoint + 1 = first := by
    dsimp only [endpoint]
    omega
  have hEndpointLt : endpoint < f := by omega
  have hSourceZero : ∀ k : Nat, k ≤ endpoint →
      u (j + (k : ZMod f)) = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    by_contra hNonzero
    have hPositive : PositiveAt k := by
      exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hNonzero
    have hFirstLe : first ≤ k := by
      simpa only [first] using Nat.find_min' hExists hPositive
    omega
  have hStop : ∃ stop : Nat, stop ≤ endpoint ∧
      x (j + (stop : ZMod f)) = 0 := by
    by_contra hNoStop
    push_neg at hNoStop
    apply hNoString
    refine ⟨endpoint, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k hk
      refine ⟨?_, hSourceZero k hk⟩
      have hNonpositive := hAllNonpositive (j + (k : ZMod f))
      have hNonzero := hNoStop k hk
      omega
    · have hPositive : 0 < u
          (j + ((endpoint + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) := by
        rw [hEndpointSucc]
        exact hFirstPositive
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hPositive
  rcases hStop with ⟨stop, hStopUpper, hStopZero⟩
  refine ⟨huCurrentZero, endpoint, stop, hEndpointLt, hStopUpper,
    hSourceZero, ?_, hStopZero⟩
  have hPositive : 0 < u
      (j + ((endpoint + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) := by
    rw [hEndpointSucc]
    exact hFirstPositive
  exact hPositive

name: KLSposet.Pinning.nbMinimalThetaValid
statement:
theorem nbMinimalThetaValid
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty) (hNe : sigma ≠ sigma')
    (hAllNonpositive : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i ≤ 0)
    (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
    (hNoString : ¬ NegativeStringToPositive
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty) sigma.u j) :
    sigma.ThetaValid j
proof:
:= by
  have huNext := (pin.preliminaries hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe).2.2.1
    j hAllNonpositive hPrev hCurrent hNoString
  exact (pin.negativeBoundary_theta_validNoninvertible hEmpty j hPrev
    hCurrent huNext).1

name: KLSposet.Pinning.nb_theta_support_subset_of_minimalNegativeBoundaryNoPositive
statement:
theorem nb_theta_support_subset_of_minimalNegativeBoundaryNoPositive
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty) (hNe : sigma ≠ sigma')
    (_hCase : CarrySixCase (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty) sigma.u)
    (hAllNonpositive : ∀ i, pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty i ≤ 0)
    (j : ZMod f)
    (hPrev : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty (j - 1) = 0)
    (hCurrent : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty j < 0)
    (hNoString : ¬ NegativeStringToPositive
      (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty) sigma.u j) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
        (sigma.theta hf j (pin.nbMinimalThetaValid hp3 hsubset hEmpty
          hMinimal hNe hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent hNoString)) ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
proof:
:= by
  let valid := pin.nbMinimalThetaValid hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe
    hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent hNoString
  have huNext : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 := valid.2
  have hCases := nbCases_of_noNegativeString hf
    (pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty) sigma.u j hAllNonpositive hNoString
  change semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars (sigma.theta hf j valid) ⊆
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
  exact pin.nb_theta_support_subset hp3 hpOdd hsubset hEmpty j hPrev hCurrent
    hAllNonpositive huNext hCases

name: KLSposet.inversePower_succ
statement:
theorem inversePower_succ (p f : Nat) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (j : ZMod f) :
    (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf (j + 1) =
      inversePower p f hf j
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hpow : (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) ^ f = 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_pow]
    have hone : 1 ≤ p ^ f := one_le_pow₀ hp
    have hnat : p ^ f = (p ^ f - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hone).symm
    calc
      ((p ^ f : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) = ((p ^ f - 1) + 1 : Nat) :=
        congrArg (fun n : Nat ↦ (n : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))) hnat
      _ = 1 := by rw [Nat.cast_add, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_add, Nat.cast_one]
  letI : Fact (1 < f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have honeval : (1 : ZMod f).val = 1 := by
    rw [ZMod.val_one]
  by_cases hnowrap : j.val + 1 < f
  · have hval : (j + 1).val = j.val + 1 := by
      have hlt : j.val + (1 : ZMod f).val < f := by
        simpa only [honeval] using hnowrap
      simpa only [honeval] using ZMod.val_add_of_lt (a := j) (b := 1) hlt
    rw [inversePower, inversePower, hval, ← pow_succ']
    congr 1
    omega
  · have hj : j.val + 1 = f := by
      have hjlt := j.val_lt
      omega
    have hval : (j + 1).val = 0 := by
      rw [ZMod.val_add, honeval, hj, Nat.mod_self]
    have hsub : f - j.val = 1 := by omega
    rw [inversePower, inversePower, hval, hsub]
    simp only [Nat.sub_zero, pow_one, hpow, mul_one]

name: KLSposet.inversePower_zero
statement:
theorem inversePower_zero (p f : Nat) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) :
    inversePower p f hf 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hpow : (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) ^ f = 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_pow]
    have hone : 1 ≤ p ^ f := one_le_pow₀ hp
    have hnat : p ^ f = (p ^ f - 1) + 1 := (Nat.sub_add_cancel hone).symm
    calc
      ((p ^ f : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) = ((p ^ f - 1) + 1 : Nat) :=
        congrArg (fun n : Nat ↦ (n : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))) hnat
      _ = 1 := by rw [Nat.cast_add, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_add, Nat.cast_one]
  simpa [inversePower] using hpow

name: KLSposet.translationExponent_add
statement:
theorem translationExponent_add (p f : Nat) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (a b : ZMod f → Int) :
    translationExponent p f hf (a + b) =
      translationExponent p f hf a + translationExponent p f hf b
proof:
:= by
  simp [translationExponent, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: KLSposet.translationExponent_neg
statement:
theorem translationExponent_neg (p f : Nat) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (a : ZMod f → Int) :
    translationExponent p f hf (-a) = -translationExponent p f hf a
proof:
:= by
  simp [translationExponent]

name: KLSposet.HodgeType.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {f : Nat} {r s : HodgeType f} (hupper : r.upper = s.upper)
    (hlower : r.lower = s.lower) : r = s
proof:
:= by
  cases r
  cases s
  simp_all

name: KLSposet.PBoundedHodgeType.translate_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem translate_zero {p f : Nat} (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f) :
    r.translate 0 = r
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply HodgeType.ext <;> funext i <;> simp [translate, HodgeType.translate]

name: KLSposet.PBoundedHodgeType.translate_add
statement:
theorem translate_add {p f : Nat} (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f) (a b : ZMod f → Int) :
    (r.translate a).translate b = r.translate (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply HodgeType.ext <;> funext i <;>
    simp [translate, HodgeType.translate, add_assoc]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {p f : Nat} {sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f} (hu : sigma.u = tau.u)
    (ht : sigma.t = tau.t) : sigma = tau
proof:
:= by
  cases sigma
  cases tau
  simp_all

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge
statement:
theorem ofHodge_toHodge {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) : ofHodge hf sigma.toHodge = sigma
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : 1 < p ^ f := one_lt_pow₀ (by omega) (by omega)
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero (p ^ f - 1) := ⟨by omega⟩
  apply PhantomWeight.ext
  · funext i
    simp [ofHodge, toHodge, HodgeType.gap]
  · change translationExponent p f hf
        (fun i ↦ if i = 0 then (sigma.t.val : Int) else 0) = sigma.t
    simp [translationExponent, inversePower_zero p f (by omega) hf]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.ofHodge_translate
statement:
theorem ofHodge_translate {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f)
    (shift : ZMod f → Int) (hshift : shift ∈ TranslationLattice p f hf) :
    ofHodge hf (r.translate shift) = ofHodge hf r
proof:
:= by
  apply PhantomWeight.ext
  · funext i
    simp [ofHodge, PBoundedHodgeType.translate, HodgeType.gap, HodgeType.translate]
  · change translationExponent p f hf (r.1.lower + shift) =
      translationExponent p f hf r.1.lower
    rw [translationExponent_add]
    change translationExponent p f hf shift = 0 at hshift
    rw [hshift, add_zero]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.translationEquivalent_iff_ofHodge_eq
statement:
theorem translationEquivalent_iff_ofHodge_eq {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (r s : PBoundedHodgeType p f) :
    TranslationEquivalent hf r s ↔ ofHodge hf r = ofHodge hf s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨shift, hshift, rfl⟩
    exact (ofHodge_translate hf r shift hshift).symm
  · intro h
    let shift : ZMod f → Int := fun i ↦ s.1.lower i - r.1.lower i
    have hgap : ∀ i, r.1.gap i = s.1.gap i := by
      intro i
      have hu := congrFun (congrArg PhantomWeight.u h) i
      change (r.1.gap i).toNat = (s.1.gap i).toNat at hu
      have hrnonneg : 0 ≤ r.1.gap i := sub_nonneg.mpr (r.1.ordered i)
      have hsnonneg : 0 ≤ s.1.gap i := sub_nonneg.mpr (s.1.ordered i)
      have hcast := congrArg (fun n : Nat ↦ (n : Int)) hu
      simpa only [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hrnonneg, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hsnonneg] using hcast
    have hshift : shift ∈ TranslationLattice p f hf := by
      change translationExponent p f hf shift = 0
      have hfun : shift = s.1.lower + (-r.1.lower) := by
        funext i
        simp [shift, sub_eq_add_neg]
      rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, translationExponent_neg]
      have ht := congrArg PhantomWeight.t h
      change translationExponent p f hf r.1.lower =
        translationExponent p f hf s.1.lower at ht
      rw [← ht, add_neg_cancel]
    refine ⟨shift, hshift, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply HodgeType.ext
    · funext i
      change s.1.upper i = r.1.upper i + shift i
      have hi := hgap i
      change r.1.upper i - r.1.lower i = s.1.upper i - s.1.lower i at hi
      simp only [shift]
      omega
    · funext i
      change s.1.lower i = r.1.lower i + shift i
      simp [shift]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.ofHodge_u_intCast
statement:
theorem ofHodge_u_intCast {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f)
    (i : ZMod f) : ((ofHodge hf r).u i : Int) = r.1.gap i
proof:
:= by
  change ((r.1.gap i).toNat : Int) = r.1.gap i
  exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (r.1.ordered i))

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.muValid_iff_ofHodge
statement:
theorem muValid_iff_ofHodge {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f)
    (j : ZMod f) : r.MuValid j ↔ (ofHodge hf r).MuValid j
proof:
:= by
  have hj := ofHodge_u_intCast hf r j
  have hj1 := ofHodge_u_intCast hf r (j + 1)
  change (r.1.IsIrregular (j + 1) ∧ 0 < r.1.gap j) ↔
    (0 < (ofHodge hf r).u j ∧ (ofHodge hf r).u (j + 1) = 0)
  change (r.1.upper (j + 1) = r.1.lower (j + 1) ∧ 0 < r.1.gap j) ↔ _
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> constructor
  · have hcast : (0 : Int) < ((ofHodge hf r).u j : Int) := by simpa only [hj] using h2
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  · have hgapzero : r.1.gap (j + 1) = 0 := by
      change r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1) = 0
      omega
    have hcast : ((ofHodge hf r).u (j + 1) : Int) = 0 := by
      rw [hj1, hgapzero]
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  · have hcast : ((ofHodge hf r).u (j + 1) : Int) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h2
    have hgapzero : r.1.gap (j + 1) = 0 := by rw [← hj1]; exact hcast
    change r.1.upper (j + 1) = r.1.lower (j + 1)
    change r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1) = 0 at hgapzero
    omega
  · have hcast : (0 : Int) < ((ofHodge hf r).u j : Int) := by exact_mod_cast h1
    rwa [hj] at hcast

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.thetaValid_iff_ofHodge
statement:
theorem thetaValid_iff_ofHodge {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f) (j : ZMod f) :
    r.ThetaValid j ↔ (ofHodge hf r).ThetaValid j
proof:
:= by
  have hj := ofHodge_u_intCast hf r j
  have hj1 := ofHodge_u_intCast hf r (j + 1)
  change (r.1.IsIrregular (j + 1) ∧ r.1.gap j < (p : Int)) ↔
    ((ofHodge hf r).u j < p ∧ (ofHodge hf r).u (j + 1) = 0)
  change (r.1.upper (j + 1) = r.1.lower (j + 1) ∧ r.1.gap j < (p : Int)) ↔ _
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ <;> constructor
  · have hcast : ((ofHodge hf r).u j : Int) < (p : Int) := by simpa only [hj] using h2
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  · have hgapzero : r.1.gap (j + 1) = 0 := by
      change r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1) = 0
      omega
    have hcast : ((ofHodge hf r).u (j + 1) : Int) = 0 := by
      rw [hj1, hgapzero]
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  · have hcast : ((ofHodge hf r).u (j + 1) : Int) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h2
    have hgapzero : r.1.gap (j + 1) = 0 := by rw [← hj1]; exact hcast
    change r.1.upper (j + 1) = r.1.lower (j + 1)
    change r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1) = 0 at hgapzero
    omega
  · have hcast : ((ofHodge hf r).u j : Int) < (p : Int) := by exact_mod_cast h1
    rwa [hj] at hcast

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.nuValid_iff_ofHodge
statement:
theorem nuValid_iff_ofHodge {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f)
    (j : ZMod f) : r.NuValid j ↔ (ofHodge hf r).NuValid j
proof:
:= by
  have hj := ofHodge_u_intCast hf r j
  change r.1.IsIrregular j ↔ (ofHodge hf r).u j = 0
  change r.1.upper j = r.1.lower j ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hgapzero : r.1.gap j = 0 := by
      change r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j = 0
      omega
    have hcast : ((ofHodge hf r).u j : Int) = 0 := by rw [hj, hgapzero]
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  · intro h
    have hcast : ((ofHodge hf r).u j : Int) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h
    have hgapzero : r.1.gap j = 0 := by rw [← hj]; exact hcast
    change r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j = 0 at hgapzero
    omega

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single
statement:
theorem translationExponent_single {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (j : ZMod f) (a : Int) :
    translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦ if i = j then a else 0) =
      (a : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf j
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  simp [translationExponent]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.translationExponent_adjacent
statement:
theorem translationExponent_adjacent {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (j : ZMod f) (a b : Int) :
    translationExponent p f hf
        (fun i ↦ if i = j then a else if i = j + 1 then b else 0) =
      (a : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf j +
        (b : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  classical
  have hfun : (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then a else if i = j + 1 then b else 0) =
      (fun i ↦ if i = j then a else 0) +
        (fun i ↦ if i = j + 1 then b else 0) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp [hsucc.symm]
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp [hsucc]
      · simp [hij, hij1]
  rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, translationExponent_single,
    translationExponent_single]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.ofHodge_mu
statement:
theorem ofHodge_mu {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : r.MuValid j) :
    ofHodge hf (r.mu hf j valid) =
      (ofHodge hf r).mu hf j ((muValid_iff_ofHodge hf r j).mp valid)
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  apply ext
  · funext i
    change (ofHodge hf (r.mu hf j valid)).u i =
      if i = j then (ofHodge hf r).u i - 1
      else if i = j + 1 then (ofHodge hf r).u i + p
      else (ofHodge hf r).u i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp only [if_pos, ofHodge, PBoundedHodgeType.mu, HodgeType.gap]
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j := sub_nonneg.mpr (r.1.ordered j)
      have hcast : (((r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j).toNat : Nat) : Int) =
          r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnonneg
      calc
        (r.1.upper j - 1 - r.1.lower j).toNat =
            ((r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j) - 1).toNat := by
          congr 1
          ring
        _ = ((((r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j).toNat : Nat) : Int) - 1).toNat := by
          rw [hcast]
        _ = (r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j).toNat - 1 := by
          simpa using (Int.toNat_sub (r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j).toNat 1)
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        have hirreg := valid.1
        change r.1.upper (j + 1) = r.1.lower (j + 1) at hirreg
        simp [ofHodge, PBoundedHodgeType.mu, HodgeType.gap, hsucc, hirreg]
      · simp [ofHodge, PBoundedHodgeType.mu, HodgeType.gap, hij, hij1]
  · rfl

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.ofHodge_theta
statement:
theorem ofHodge_theta {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : r.ThetaValid j) :
    ofHodge hf (r.theta hf j valid) =
      (ofHodge hf r).theta hf j ((thetaValid_iff_ofHodge hf r j).mp valid)
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  apply ext
  · funext i
    change (ofHodge hf (r.theta hf j valid)).u i =
      if i = j then (ofHodge hf r).u i + 1
      else if i = j + 1 then (ofHodge hf r).u i + p
      else (ofHodge hf r).u i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp only [if_pos, ofHodge, PBoundedHodgeType.theta, HodgeType.gap]
      simp only [hsucc.symm, if_false]
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j := sub_nonneg.mpr (r.1.ordered j)
      have hcast : (((r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j).toNat : Nat) : Int) =
          r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnonneg
      rw [show r.1.upper j - (r.1.lower j - 1) =
        (r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j) + 1 by ring, ← hcast]
      omega
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        have hirreg := valid.1
        change r.1.upper (j + 1) = r.1.lower (j + 1) at hirreg
        simp [ofHodge, PBoundedHodgeType.theta, HodgeType.gap, hsucc, hirreg]
      · simp [ofHodge, PBoundedHodgeType.theta, HodgeType.gap, hij, hij1]
  · change translationExponent p f hf (r.theta hf j valid).1.lower =
      translationExponent p f hf r.1.lower - inversePower p f hf j
    have hlower : (r.theta hf j valid).1.lower =
        r.1.lower + fun i ↦ if i = j then (-1 : Int) else 0 := by
      funext i
      change (if i = j then r.1.lower i - 1 else r.1.lower i) =
        r.1.lower i + if i = j then (-1 : Int) else 0
      by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [hlower, translationExponent_add, translationExponent_single]
    simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.ofHodge_nu
statement:
theorem ofHodge_nu {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : r.NuValid j) :
    ofHodge hf (r.nu hp hf j valid) =
      (ofHodge hf r).nu hp hf j ((nuValid_iff_ofHodge hf r j).mp valid)
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  apply ext
  · funext i
    change (ofHodge hf (r.nu hp hf j valid)).u i =
      if i = j then (ofHodge hf r).u i + 1
      else if i = j + 1 then p - (ofHodge hf r).u i
      else (ofHodge hf r).u i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      have hirreg := valid
      change r.1.upper j = r.1.lower j at hirreg
      simp [ofHodge, PBoundedHodgeType.nu, HodgeType.gap, hirreg]
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp only [hsucc, if_false, if_pos, ofHodge, PBoundedHodgeType.nu,
          HodgeType.gap]
        have hnonneg : 0 ≤ r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1) :=
          sub_nonneg.mpr (r.1.ordered (j + 1))
        have hcast : (((r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1)).toNat : Nat) : Int) =
            r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1) := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnonneg
        rw [show r.1.lower (j + 1) + (p : Int) - r.1.upper (j + 1) =
          (p : Int) - (r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1)) by ring]
        calc
          ((p : Int) - (r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1))).toNat =
              ((p : Int) -
                (((r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1)).toNat : Nat) : Int)).toNat := by
            congr 2
            exact hcast.symm
          _ = p - (r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1)).toNat :=
            Int.toNat_sub p (r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1)).toNat
      · simp [ofHodge, PBoundedHodgeType.nu, HodgeType.gap, hij, hij1]
  · change translationExponent p f hf (r.nu hp hf j valid).1.lower =
      translationExponent p f hf r.1.lower - inversePower p f hf j +
        ((ofHodge hf r).u (j + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (j + 1)
    have hlower : (r.nu hp hf j valid).1.lower =
        r.1.lower + fun i ↦
          if i = j then (-1 : Int)
          else if i = j + 1 then ((ofHodge hf r).u (j + 1) : Int)
          else 0 := by
      funext i
      change (if i = j then r.1.lower i - 1
        else if i = j + 1 then r.1.upper i else r.1.lower i) =
        r.1.lower i + if i = j then (-1 : Int)
          else if i = j + 1 then ((ofHodge hf r).u (j + 1) : Int) else 0
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
      · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
        · subst i
          simp only [hsucc, if_false, if_pos]
          rw [ofHodge_u_intCast hf r (j + 1)]
          simp [HodgeType.gap]
        · simp [hij, hij1]
    rw [hlower, translationExponent_add, translationExponent_adjacent]
    simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.nu_mu_inverse
statement:
theorem nu_mu_inverse {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 1) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0) :
    ∃ hmu : sigma.MuValid j, ∃ hnu : (sigma.mu hf j hmu).NuValid j,
      (sigma.mu hf j hmu).nu hp hf j hnu = sigma
proof:
:= by
  have hmu : sigma.MuValid j := ⟨by omega, huj1⟩
  refine ⟨hmu, ?_⟩
  have hnu : (sigma.mu hf j hmu).NuValid j := by
    simp [NuValid, mu, huj]
  refine ⟨hnu, ?_⟩
  have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
    omega
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  apply ext
  · funext i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp [nu, mu, huj]
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp [nu, mu, hsucc, huj1]
      · simp [nu, mu, hij, hij1]
  · simp [nu, mu, huj1, hone, inversePower_succ p f hp hf j]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.mu_nu_inverse
statement:
theorem mu_nu_inverse {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = p) :
    ∃ hnu : sigma.NuValid j, ∃ hmu : (sigma.nu hp hf j hnu).MuValid j,
      (sigma.nu hp hf j hnu).mu hf j hmu = sigma
proof:
:= by
  have hnu : sigma.NuValid j := huj
  refine ⟨hnu, ?_⟩
  have hmu : (sigma.nu hp hf j hnu).MuValid j := by
    constructor
    · simp [nu, huj]
    · have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
        intro h
        have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
          omega
        apply hone
        calc
          (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
          _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
      simp [nu, hsucc, huj1]
  refine ⟨hmu, ?_⟩
  have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
    omega
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  apply ext
  · funext i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp [mu, nu, huj]
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp [mu, nu, hsucc, huj1]
      · simp [mu, nu, hij, hij1]
  · simp [mu, nu, huj1, inversePower_succ p f hp hf j]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.hodge_nu_mu_translationEquivalent
statement:
theorem hodge_nu_mu_translationEquivalent {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (huj : r.1.gap j = 1) (huj1 : r.1.gap (j + 1) = 0) :
    ∃ hmu : r.MuValid j, ∃ hnu : (r.mu hf j hmu).NuValid j,
      TranslationEquivalent hf r ((r.mu hf j hmu).nu hp hf j hnu)
proof:
:= by
  have hirreg : r.1.IsIrregular (j + 1) := by
    change r.1.upper (j + 1) = r.1.lower (j + 1)
    change r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1) = 0 at huj1
    omega
  have hmu : r.MuValid j := ⟨hirreg, by omega⟩
  refine ⟨hmu, ?_⟩
  have hnu : (r.mu hf j hmu).NuValid j := by
    change (r.mu hf j hmu).1.upper j = (r.mu hf j hmu).1.lower j
    simp only [PBoundedHodgeType.mu, if_pos]
    change r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j = 1 at huj
    omega
  refine ⟨hnu, ?_⟩
  have huj' : (ofHodge hf r).u j = 1 := by
    have hcast := ofHodge_u_intCast hf r j
    rw [huj] at hcast
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  have huj1' : (ofHodge hf r).u (j + 1) = 0 := by
    have hcast := ofHodge_u_intCast hf r (j + 1)
    rw [huj1] at hcast
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  rcases nu_mu_inverse hp hf (ofHodge hf r) j huj' huj1' with
    ⟨hmu', hnu', hinverse⟩
  apply (translationEquivalent_iff_ofHodge_eq hf _ _).mpr
  simpa only [ofHodge_nu, ofHodge_mu] using hinverse.symm

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.hodge_mu_nu_translationEquivalent
statement:
theorem hodge_mu_nu_translationEquivalent {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (huj : r.1.gap j = 0) (huj1 : r.1.gap (j + 1) = p) :
    ∃ hnu : r.NuValid j, ∃ hmu : (r.nu hp hf j hnu).MuValid j,
      TranslationEquivalent hf r ((r.nu hp hf j hnu).mu hf j hmu)
proof:
:= by
  have hnu : r.NuValid j := by
    change r.1.upper j = r.1.lower j
    change r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j = 0 at huj
    omega
  refine ⟨hnu, ?_⟩
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hmu : (r.nu hp hf j hnu).MuValid j := by
    constructor
    · change (r.nu hp hf j hnu).1.upper (j + 1) =
        (r.nu hp hf j hnu).1.lower (j + 1)
      simp only [PBoundedHodgeType.nu, hsucc, if_false, if_pos]
      change r.1.upper (j + 1) - r.1.lower (j + 1) = p at huj1
      omega
    · change 0 < (r.nu hp hf j hnu).1.gap j
      simp only [HodgeType.gap, PBoundedHodgeType.nu, if_pos]
      change r.1.upper j - r.1.lower j = 0 at huj
      omega
  refine ⟨hmu, ?_⟩
  have huj' : (ofHodge hf r).u j = 0 := by
    have hcast := ofHodge_u_intCast hf r j
    rw [huj] at hcast
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  have huj1' : (ofHodge hf r).u (j + 1) = p := by
    have hcast := ofHodge_u_intCast hf r (j + 1)
    rw [huj1] at hcast
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  rcases mu_nu_inverse hp hf (ofHodge hf r) j huj' huj1' with
    ⟨hnu', hmu', hinverse⟩
  apply (translationEquivalent_iff_ofHodge_eq hf _ _).mpr
  simpa only [ofHodge_mu, ofHodge_nu] using hinverse.symm

statement:

    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) :

      translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦ (sigma.u i : Int))
proof:

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileSum_univ_mu
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_univ_mu {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.MuValid j) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) Set.univ =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_translationExponent,
    niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_translationExponent]
  have hfun : (fun i ↦ (((sigma.mu hf j valid).u i : Nat) : Int)) =
      (fun i ↦ (sigma.u i : Int)) +
        (fun i ↦ if i = j then -1 else if i = j + 1 then (p : Int) else 0) := by
    funext i
    have hpos : 1 ≤ sigma.u j := by
      have := valid.1
      omega
    have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
        omega
      apply hone
      calc
        (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp only [PhantomWeight.mu, if_pos, Pi.add_apply]
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hpos, Nat.cast_one]
      ring
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp [PhantomWeight.mu, hsucc, valid.2]
      · simp [PhantomWeight.mu, hij, hij1]
  rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_adjacent]
  norm_num only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_natCast]
  rw [inversePower_succ p f hp hf j]
  ring

name: KLSposet.determinantExponent_mu
statement:
theorem determinantExponent_mu {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.MuValid j) :
    determinantExponent hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) = determinantExponent hf sigma
proof:
:= by
  change sigma.t + sigma.t +
      niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) Set.univ =
    sigma.t + sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum_univ_mu hp hf sigma j valid]

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileSum_univ_theta
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_univ_theta {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) Set.univ =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ +
        2 * inversePower p f hf j
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_translationExponent,
    niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_translationExponent]
  have hfun : (fun i ↦ (((sigma.theta hf j valid).u i : Nat) : Int)) =
      (fun i ↦ (sigma.u i : Int)) +
        (fun i ↦ if i = j then 1 else if i = j + 1 then (p : Int) else 0) := by
    funext i
    have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
        omega
      apply hone
      calc
        (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp [PhantomWeight.theta]
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp [PhantomWeight.theta, hsucc, valid.2]
      · simp [PhantomWeight.theta, hij, hij1]
  rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_adjacent]
  norm_num only [Int.cast_one, Int.cast_natCast]
  rw [inversePower_succ p f hp hf j]
  ring

name: KLSposet.determinantExponent_theta
statement:
theorem determinantExponent_theta {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j) :
    determinantExponent hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) = determinantExponent hf sigma
proof:
:= by
  change (sigma.t - inversePower p f hf j) +
        (sigma.t - inversePower p f hf j) +
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) Set.univ =
    sigma.t + sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum_univ_theta hp hf sigma j valid]
  ring

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileSum_univ_nu
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_univ_nu {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid j) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.nu hp hf j valid) Set.univ =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ +
        2 * inversePower p f hf j -
          2 * (sigma.u (j + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
            inversePower p f hf (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_translationExponent,
    niveauOneProfileSum_univ_eq_translationExponent]
  have hfun : (fun i ↦ (((sigma.nu hp hf j valid).u i : Nat) : Int)) =
      (fun i ↦ (sigma.u i : Int)) +
        (fun i ↦ if i = j then 1 else if i = j + 1 then
          (p : Int) - 2 * (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) else 0) := by
    funext i
    have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
        omega
      apply hone
      calc
        (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      simp [PhantomWeight.nu]
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp only [PhantomWeight.nu, hsucc, if_false, if_pos, Pi.add_apply]
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (sigma.u_le (j + 1))]
        ring
      · simp [PhantomWeight.nu, hij, hij1]
  rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_adjacent]
  norm_num only [Int.cast_one, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_ofNat,
    Int.cast_natCast]
  rw [show ((p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) -
        2 * (sigma.u (j + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))) *
          inversePower p f hf (j + 1) =
      (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf (j + 1) -
        2 * (sigma.u (j + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (j + 1) by ring]
  rw [inversePower_succ p f hp hf j]
  ring

name: KLSposet.determinantExponent_nu
statement:
theorem determinantExponent_nu {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.NuValid j) :
    determinantExponent hf (sigma.nu hp hf j valid) = determinantExponent hf sigma
proof:
:= by
  change (sigma.t - inversePower p f hf j +
          (sigma.u (j + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
            inversePower p f hf (j + 1)) +
        (sigma.t - inversePower p f hf j +
          (sigma.u (j + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
            inversePower p f hf (j + 1)) +
        niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.nu hp hf j valid) Set.univ =
    sigma.t + sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum_univ_nu hp hf sigma j valid]
  ring

name: KLSposet.periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half
statement:
theorem periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (i a : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf a ↔ i = a ∨ i = a + f
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  constructor
  · intro hperiodic
    have hzero : periodicIndex hf (i - a) = 0 := by
      rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf (i - a), map_sub,
        ← periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf i, ← periodicIndex_eq_castHom hf a,
        hperiodic]
      simp
    change (((i - a).val : Nat) : ZMod f) = 0 at hzero
    have hdiv : f ∣ (i - a).val :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff (i - a).val f).mp hzero
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdiv
    have hklt : k < 2 := by
      apply Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left (a := f)
      rw [← hk]
      simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using ZMod.val_lt (i - a)
    have hkcases : k = 0 ∨ k = 1 := by omega
    rcases hkcases with rfl | rfl
    · left
      have hval : (i - a).val = 0 := by simpa using hk
      have hsub : i - a = 0 := (ZMod.val_eq_zero (i - a)).mp hval
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hsub
    · right
      have hval : (i - a).val = f := by simpa using hk
      have hsub : i - a = (f : ZMod (2 * f)) := by
        rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (i - a), hval]
      calc
        i = a + (i - a) := by ring
        _ = a + f := by rw [hsub]
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · rfl
    · exact periodicIndex_add_half hf a

name: KLSposet.periodicIndexSet_singleton
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [periodicIndexSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_singleton_iff,

  exact periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i a

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_half_eq_lift
statement:
theorem niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_half_eq_lift {p f : Nat}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (a : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a +
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + f) =
      liftQPlusOne p f (inversePower p f hf (periodicIndex hf a))
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : (f : ZMod (2 * f)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hdiv : 2 * f ∣ f :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff f (2 * f)).mp hzero
    have hle : 2 * f ≤ f := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdiv
    omega
  have hne : a + f ≠ a := by
    intro h
    apply hhalf
    calc
      (f : ZMod (2 * f)) = (a + f) - a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hfun :
      periodicExtend hf
          (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = periodicIndex hf a then (1 : Int) else 0) =
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦ if i = a then (1 : Int) else 0) +
          (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦ if i = a + f then (1 : Int) else 0) := by
    funext i
    simp only [periodicExtend, Pi.add_apply]
    by_cases hi : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf a
    · rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i a).mp hi with rfl | rfl
      · rw [if_pos rfl]
        simp [Ne.symm hne]
      · rw [if_pos hi]
        simp [hne]
    · have hia : i ≠ a := fun h ↦ hi (h ▸ rfl)
      have hiaf : i ≠ a + f := by
        intro h
        apply hi
        rw [h, periodicIndex_add_half]
      simp [hi, hia, hiaf]
  have hperiodic := translationExponent_periodicExtend hp hf
    (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = periodicIndex hf a then (1 : Int) else 0)
  rw [hfun, translationExponent_add,
    PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single,
    PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single,
    PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single] at hperiodic
  simpa [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent] using hperiodic

name: KLSposet.liftQPlusOne_natCast_mul
statement:
theorem liftQPlusOne_natCast_mul {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (n : Nat) (x : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
    liftQPlusOne p f ((n : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * x) =
      (n : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) * liftQPlusOne p f x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [liftQPlusOne]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.cast_succ, add_mul, liftQPlusOne_add hp hf, ih,
        Nat.cast_succ, add_mul]
      simp [add_comm]

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauOne
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauOne {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.MuValid j) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) (.niveauOne J) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauOne J)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) J =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
      ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
        omega
      apply hone
      calc
        (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    have hpos : 1 ≤ sigma.u j := by
      have := valid.1
      omega
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
          (((sigma.mu hf j valid).u i : Nat) : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.u i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          if i = j then -1 else if i = j + 1 then (p : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp only [PhantomWeight.mu, if_pos, Pi.add_apply]
        rw [Nat.cast_sub hpos, Nat.cast_one]
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hj]
        ring
      · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
        · subst i
          simp [PhantomWeight.mu, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,

    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_adjacent]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_natCast]
    rw [inversePower_succ p f hp hf j]
    ring
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
  change sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.mu hf j valid) J =
    sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J
  rw [hsum]

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauOne
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauOne {p f : Nat}
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∉ J) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) (.niveauOne J) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauOne J)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) J =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J + inversePower p f hf j := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
      ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
        omega
      apply hone
      calc
        (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
          (((sigma.theta hf j valid).u i : Nat) : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.u i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then 1 else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp [PhantomWeight.theta, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hj]
      · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
        · subst i
          simp [PhantomWeight.theta, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
            Profile.set, hsucc, hj1, valid.2]
        · simp [PhantomWeight.theta, hij, hij1]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
  change (sigma.theta hf j valid).t +
      niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) J =
    sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J
  rw [hsum]
  change (sigma.t - inversePower p f hf j) +
      (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J + inversePower p f hf j) =
    sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J
  ring

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauOne_of_mem_mem

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauOne {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.NuValid j) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (hj : j ∈ J) (hj1 : j + 1 ∉ J) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.nu hp hf j valid) (.niveauOne J) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma
        ((Profile.niveauOne J).periodicSymmDiff hf {j + 1})
proof:
:= by
  have hsumNu : niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.nu hp hf j valid) J =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J + inversePower p f hf j := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
      ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
        omega
      apply hone
      calc
        (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
          (((sigma.nu hp hf j valid).u i : Nat) : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.u i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ if i = j then 1 else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        simp [PhantomWeight.nu, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
          Profile.set, hj]
      · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
        · subst i
          simp [PhantomWeight.nu, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
            Profile.set, hsucc, hj1]
        · simp [PhantomWeight.nu, hij, hij1]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num
  have hsumToggle :
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff J {j + 1}) =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J +
          (sigma.u (j + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
            inversePower p f hf (j + 1) := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
      ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          ((Profile.niveauOne (symmDiff J {j + 1})).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.u i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.u i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          if i = j + 1 then (sigma.u (j + 1) : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
          Set.mem_symmDiff, hj1]
      · have hiff : i ∈ symmDiff J {j + 1} ↔ i ∈ J := by
          simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hi]
        have hind :
            (Profile.niveauOne (symmDiff J {j + 1})).indicator i =
              (Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i := by
          simp only [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set]
          by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J
          · have hiSymm : i ∈ symmDiff J {j + 1} := hiff.mpr hiJ
            simp [hiJ, hiSymm]
          · have hiSymm : i ∉ symmDiff J {j + 1} :=
              fun h ↦ hiJ (hiff.mp h)
            simp [hiJ, hiSymm]
        rw [hind]
        simp [hi]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_natCast]
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, Profile.periodicSymmDiff,
    CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
  change (sigma.nu hp hf j valid).t +
      niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.nu hp hf j valid) J =
    sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff J {j + 1})
  rw [hsumNu, hsumToggle]
  change (sigma.t - inversePower p f hf j +
        (sigma.u (j + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (j + 1)) +
      (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J + inversePower p f hf j) =
    sigma.t + (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J +
      (sigma.u (j + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
        inversePower p f hf (j + 1))
  ring

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauTwo
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_mu_niveauTwo {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (valid : sigma.MuValid (periodicIndex hf a))
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (ha : a ∈ J) (ha1 : a + 1 ∈ J) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid)
        (.niveauTwo J hJ) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ)
proof:
:= by
  have hperiodicSucc :
      periodicIndex hf (a + 1) = periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_one]
  have hsucc : periodicIndex hf a + 1 ≠ periodicIndex hf a := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (periodicIndex hf a + 1) - periodicIndex hf a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have honeDouble : (1 : ZMod (2 * f)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
    omega
  have hsuccDouble : a + 1 ≠ a := by
    intro h
    apply honeDouble
    calc
      (1 : ZMod (2 * f)) = (a + 1) - a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have haHalf : a + f ∉ J := (hJ a).mp ha
  have ha1Half : a + 1 + f ∉ J := (hJ (a + 1)).mp ha1
  have hhalf : (f : ZMod (2 * f)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hdiv : 2 * f ∣ f :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff f (2 * f)).mp hzero
    have hle : 2 * f ≤ f := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdiv
    omega
  have hhalfSelf (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i + f ≠ i := by
    intro h
    apply hhalf
    calc
      (f : ZMod (2 * f)) = (i + f) - i := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hsum :
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf
          (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J =
        niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf
        (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J hJ,
      ← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf sigma J hJ]
    have hpos : 1 ≤ sigma.u (periodicIndex hf a) := by
      have := valid.1
      omega
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (((sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid).periodicU hf i : Nat) : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          if i = a then -1 else if i = a + 1 then (p : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf a
      · rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i a).mp hi with rfl | rfl
        · simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.mu, if_pos,
            Pi.add_apply]
          rw [Nat.cast_sub hpos, Nat.cast_one]
          simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, ha]
          ring
        · have hne1 : a + f ≠ a + 1 := by
            intro h
            apply hsucc
            calc
              periodicIndex hf a + 1 = periodicIndex hf (a + 1) :=
                hperiodicSucc.symm
              _ = periodicIndex hf (a + f) := by rw [h]
              _ = periodicIndex hf a := periodicIndex_add_half hf a
          simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, haHalf,
            hhalfSelf, hne1]
      · by_cases hi1 : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf (a + 1)
        · rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i (a + 1)).mp hi1 with
            rfl | rfl
          · simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.mu,
              hperiodicSucc, hsucc, if_false, if_pos, Pi.add_apply]
            simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, ha1,
              valid.2, hsuccDouble]
          · have hne0 : a + 1 + f ≠ a := by
              intro h
              apply hsucc
              calc
                periodicIndex hf a + 1 = periodicIndex hf (a + 1) :=
                  hperiodicSucc.symm
                _ = periodicIndex hf (a + 1 + f) :=
                  (periodicIndex_add_half hf (a + 1)).symm
                _ = periodicIndex hf a := by rw [h]
            simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, ha1Half,
              hhalfSelf, hne0]
        · have hia : i ≠ a := fun h ↦ hi (h ▸ rfl)
          have hia1 : i ≠ a + 1 := fun h ↦ hi1 (h ▸ rfl)
          have hi1' : periodicIndex hf i ≠ periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
            rw [← hperiodicSucc]
            exact hi1
          simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.mu, hi,
            hi1', hia, hia1]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_adjacent]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_natCast]
    rw [inversePower_succ p (2 * f) hp (by omega) a]
    ring
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
  change liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf
        (sigma.mu hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J =
    liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J
  rw [hsum]

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauTwo
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_theta_niveauTwo {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid (periodicIndex hf a))
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (ha : a ∈ J) (ha1 : a + 1 ∉ J) :
    profileLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid)
        (.niveauTwo J hJ) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ)
proof:
:= by
  have hperiodicSucc :
      periodicIndex hf (a + 1) = periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_one]
  have hsucc : periodicIndex hf a + 1 ≠ periodicIndex hf a := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (periodicIndex hf a + 1) - periodicIndex hf a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have honeDouble : (1 : ZMod (2 * f)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
    omega
  have hsuccDouble : a + 1 ≠ a := by
    intro h
    apply honeDouble
    calc
      (1 : ZMod (2 * f)) = (a + 1) - a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have haHalf : a + f ∉ J := (hJ a).mp ha
  have ha1Half : a + 1 + f ∈ J := by
    by_contra h
    exact ha1 ((hJ (a + 1)).mpr h)
  have hhalf : (f : ZMod (2 * f)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hdiv : 2 * f ∣ f :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff f (2 * f)).mp hzero
    have hle : 2 * f ≤ f := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdiv
    omega
  have hhalfSelf (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i + f ≠ i := by
    intro h
    apply hhalf
    calc
      (f : ZMod (2 * f)) = (i + f) - i := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have haNeSuccHalf : a ≠ a + 1 + f := by
    intro h
    apply hsucc
    calc
      periodicIndex hf a + 1 = periodicIndex hf (a + 1) :=
        hperiodicSucc.symm
      _ = periodicIndex hf (a + 1 + f) :=
        (periodicIndex_add_half hf (a + 1)).symm
      _ = periodicIndex hf a := by rw [← h]
  have hsum :
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf
          (sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J =
        niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J +
          liftQPlusOne p f (inversePower p f hf (periodicIndex hf a)) := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf
        (sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J hJ,
      ← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf sigma J hJ]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (((sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid).periodicU hf i : Nat) : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦ if i = a then (1 : Int) else 0) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          if i = a + 1 + f then (p : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf a
      · rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i a).mp hi with rfl | rfl
        · simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.theta,
            Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, ha,
            haNeSuccHalf]
        · have hne1 : a + f ≠ a + 1 + f := by
            intro h
            apply hsuccDouble
            calc
              a + 1 = (a + 1 + f) - f := by ring
              _ = (a + f) - f := by rw [h]
              _ = a := by ring
          simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, haHalf,
            hhalfSelf, hne1]
      · by_cases hi1 : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf (a + 1)
        · rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i (a + 1)).mp hi1 with
            rfl | rfl
          · simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.theta,
              hperiodicSucc, hsucc, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
              Profile.set, ha1, valid.2, hsuccDouble,
              Ne.symm (hhalfSelf (a + 1))]
          · have hne0 : a + 1 + f ≠ a := by
              intro h
              apply hsucc
              calc
                periodicIndex hf a + 1 = periodicIndex hf (a + 1) :=
                  hperiodicSucc.symm
                _ = periodicIndex hf (a + 1 + f) :=
                  (periodicIndex_add_half hf (a + 1)).symm
                _ = periodicIndex hf a := by rw [h]
            simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.theta,
              hi1, hperiodicSucc, hsucc, Profile.indicator,
              Profile.Contains, Profile.set, ha1Half, valid.2, hne0]
        · have hia : i ≠ a := fun h ↦ hi (h ▸ rfl)
          have hia1f : i ≠ a + 1 + f := by
            intro h
            apply hi1
            rw [h, periodicIndex_add_half]
          have hi1' : periodicIndex hf i ≠ periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
            rw [← hperiodicSucc]
            exact hi1
          simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.theta, hi,
            hi1', hia, hia1f]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, translationExponent_add,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_one, Int.cast_natCast]
    have hrec := inversePower_succ p (2 * f) (by omega : 1 ≤ p)
      (by omega) (a + f)
    rw [show a + f + 1 = a + 1 + f by ring] at hrec
    rw [hrec, ← niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_half_eq_lift hp hf a]
    simp only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent]
    ring
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
  change liftQPlusOne p f
        (sigma.t - inversePower p f hf (periodicIndex hf a)) +
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf
        (sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J =
    liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J
  rw [hsum, liftQPlusOne_sub hp hf]
  ring
