  have hhalfSelf (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i + f ≠ i := by
    intro h
    apply hhalf
    calc
      (f : ZMod (2 * f)) = (i + f) - i := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hsum :
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf
          (sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J =
        niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J +
          2 * niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf
        (sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J hJ,
      ← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf sigma J hJ]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (((sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid).periodicU hf i : Nat) : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          if i = a then (1 : Int) else if i = a + 1 then (p : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf a
      · rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i a).mp hi with rfl | rfl
        · simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.theta,
            Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, ha]
        · have hne1 : a + f ≠ a + 1 := by
            intro h
            apply hsucc
            calc
              periodicIndex hf a + 1 = periodicIndex hf (a + 1) :=
                hperiodicSucc.symm
              _ = periodicIndex hf (a + f) := by rw [h]
              _ = periodicIndex hf a := periodicIndex_add_half hf a
          simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, haHalf,
            hhalfSelf, hne1]
      · by_cases hi1 : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf (a + 1)
        · rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i (a + 1)).mp hi1 with
            rfl | rfl
          · simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.theta,
              hperiodicSucc, hsucc, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
              Profile.set, ha1, valid.2, hsuccDouble]
          · have hne0 : a + 1 + f ≠ a := by
              intro h
              apply hsucc
              calc
                periodicIndex hf a + 1 = periodicIndex hf (a + 1) :=
                  hperiodicSucc.symm
                _ = periodicIndex hf (a + 1 + f) :=
                  (periodicIndex_add_half hf (a + 1)).symm
                _ = periodicIndex hf a := by rw [h]
            have hne1 : a + 1 + f ≠ a + 1 := hhalfSelf (a + 1)
            simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.theta,
              hi1, hperiodicSucc, hsucc, Profile.indicator,
              Profile.Contains, Profile.set, ha1Half, valid.2, hne0, hne1]
        · have hia : i ≠ a := fun h ↦ hi (h ▸ rfl)
          have hia1 : i ≠ a + 1 := fun h ↦ hi1 (h ▸ rfl)
          have hi1' : periodicIndex hf i ≠ periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
            rw [← hperiodicSucc]
            exact hi1
          simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.theta, hi,
            hi1', hia, hia1]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_adjacent]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_one, Int.cast_natCast]
    rw [inversePower_succ p (2 * f) (by omega) (by omega) a]
    simp only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent]
    ring
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
  change liftQPlusOne p f
        (sigma.t - inversePower p f hf (periodicIndex hf a)) +
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf
        (sigma.theta hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J =
    liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J +
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf a -
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + f)
  rw [hsum, liftQPlusOne_sub hp hf,
    ← niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_half_eq_lift hp hf a]
  ring

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauTwo
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_nu_niveauTwo {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (a : ZMod (2 * f))
    (valid : sigma.NuValid (periodicIndex hf a))
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J)
    (ha : a ∈ J) (ha1 : a + 1 ∉ J) :
    profileLeftExponent hf
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid)
        (.niveauTwo J hJ) =
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma
        ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).periodicSymmDiff hf
          {periodicIndex hf (a + 1)})
proof:
:= by
  have hperiodicSucc :
      periodicIndex hf (a + 1) = periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
    rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom, map_add, map_one]
  have hsucc : periodicIndex hf a + 1 ≠ periodicIndex hf a := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (periodicIndex hf a + 1) - periodicIndex hf a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have honeDouble : (1 : ZMod (2 * f)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
    omega
  have hsuccDouble : a + 1 ≠ a := by
    intro h
    apply honeDouble
    calc
      (1 : ZMod (2 * f)) = (a + 1) - a := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have haHalf : a + f ∉ J := (hJ a).mp ha
  have ha1Half : a + 1 + f ∈ J := by
    by_contra h
    exact ha1 ((hJ (a + 1)).mpr h)
  have hhalf : (f : ZMod (2 * f)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hdiv : 2 * f ∣ f :=
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff f (2 * f)).mp hzero
    have hle : 2 * f ≤ f := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdiv
    omega
  have hhalfSelf (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i + f ≠ i := by
    intro h
    apply hhalf
    calc
      (f : ZMod (2 * f)) = (i + f) - i := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have haNeSuccHalf : a ≠ a + 1 + f := by
    intro h
    apply hsucc
    calc
      periodicIndex hf a + 1 = periodicIndex hf (a + 1) :=
        hperiodicSucc.symm
      _ = periodicIndex hf (a + 1 + f) :=
        (periodicIndex_add_half hf (a + 1)).symm
      _ = periodicIndex hf a := by rw [← h]
  let u1 := sigma.u (periodicIndex hf (a + 1))
  have hsumNu :
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf
          (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J =
        niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J +
          liftQPlusOne p f (inversePower p f hf (periodicIndex hf a)) -
          2 * (u1 : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1 + f) := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J hJ,
      ← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf sigma J hJ]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (((sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid).periodicU
              hf i : Nat) : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦ if i = a then (1 : Int) else 0) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          if i = a + 1 + f then (p : Int) - 2 * (u1 : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf a
      · rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i a).mp hi with rfl | rfl
        · simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.nu,
            Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, ha,
            haNeSuccHalf]
        · have hne1 : a + f ≠ a + 1 + f := by
            intro h
            apply hsuccDouble
            calc
              a + 1 = (a + 1 + f) - f := by ring
              _ = (a + f) - f := by rw [h]
              _ = a := by ring
          simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, haHalf,
            hhalfSelf, hne1]
      · by_cases hi1 : periodicIndex hf i = periodicIndex hf (a + 1)
        · rcases (periodicIndex_eq_iff_eq_or_eq_add_half hf i (a + 1)).mp hi1 with
            rfl | rfl
          · simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.nu,
              hperiodicSucc, hsucc, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains,
              Profile.set, ha1, hsuccDouble, Ne.symm (hhalfSelf (a + 1))]
          · have hne0 : a + 1 + f ≠ a := by
              intro h
              exact haNeSuccHalf h.symm
            have hu1le : u1 ≤ p := sigma.u_le _
            simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.nu, hi1,
              hperiodicSucc, hsucc, if_false, if_pos, Pi.add_apply]
            rw [← hperiodicSucc]
            rw [Nat.cast_sub hu1le]
            simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
              ha1Half, hne0, u1]
            ring
        · have hia : i ≠ a := fun h ↦ hi (h ▸ rfl)
          have hia1f : i ≠ a + 1 + f := by
            intro h
            apply hi1
            rw [h, periodicIndex_add_half]
          have hi1' : periodicIndex hf i ≠ periodicIndex hf a + 1 := by
            rw [← hperiodicSucc]
            exact hi1
          simp [PhantomWeight.periodicU, PhantomWeight.nu, hi,
            hi1', hia, hia1f]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, translationExponent_add,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_one, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul]
    have hrec := inversePower_succ p (2 * f) (by omega : 1 ≤ p)
      (by omega) (a + f)
    rw [show a + f + 1 = a + 1 + f by ring] at hrec
    let B := translationExponent p (2 * f) (by omega)
      (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
        ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int))
    change B + 1 * inversePower p (2 * f) (by omega) a +
        ((p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) - 2 * u1) *
          inversePower p (2 * f) (by omega) (a + 1 + f) =
      B + liftQPlusOne p f (inversePower p f hf (periodicIndex hf a)) -
        2 * u1 * niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1 + f)
    calc
      _ = B + (inversePower p (2 * f) (by omega) a +
            (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
              inversePower p (2 * f) (by omega) (a + 1 + f)) -
            2 * u1 * inversePower p (2 * f) (by omega) (a + 1 + f) := by ring
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hrec, ← niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_half_eq_lift hp hf a]
        rfl
  let T : Set (ZMod (2 * f)) := {a + 1, a + 1 + f}
  have htwice (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i + f + f = i := by
    calc
      i + f + f = i + (2 * f : Nat) := by push_cast; ring
      _ = i := by simp
  have hTperiodic (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : i ∈ T ↔ i + f ∈ T := by
    simp only [T, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact Or.inr rfl
      · left
        exact htwice (a + 1)
    · rintro (h | h)
      · right
        calc
          i = i + f + f := (htwice i).symm
          _ = a + 1 + f := by rw [h]
      · left
        exact add_right_cancel h
  have hJToggle : ∀ i, i ∈ symmDiff J T ↔ i + f ∉ symmDiff J T := by
    intro i
    simp only [Set.mem_symmDiff]
    have hJi := hJ i
    have hTi := hTperiodic i
    tauto
  have hsumToggle :
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff J T) =
        niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J +
          (u1 : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1) -
          (u1 : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (a + 1 + f) := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf sigma
        (symmDiff J T) hJToggle,
      ← translationExponent_niveauTwo_indicator hf sigma J hJ]
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo (symmDiff J T) hJToggle).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          ((Profile.niveauTwo J hJ).indicator i : Int) *
            (sigma.periodicU hf i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦ if i = a + 1 then (u1 : Int) else 0) +
        (fun i : ZMod (2 * f) ↦
          if i = a + 1 + f then -(u1 : Int) else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i = a + 1
      · subst i
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
          Set.mem_symmDiff, T, ha1,
          Ne.symm (hhalfSelf (a + 1)), u1,
          PhantomWeight.periodicU]
      · by_cases hif : i = a + 1 + f
        · subst i
          simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
            Set.mem_symmDiff, T, ha1Half, hi, u1,
            PhantomWeight.periodicU, periodicIndex_add_half]
        · have hiT : i ∉ T := by simp [T, hi, hif]
          have hiff : i ∈ symmDiff J T ↔ i ∈ J := by
            simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hiT]
          simp only [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set]
          by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J
          · have hiSymm := hiff.mpr hiJ
            simp [hiJ, hiSymm, hi, hif]
          · have hiSymm : i ∉ symmDiff J T := fun h ↦ hiJ (hiff.mp h)
            simp [hiJ, hiSymm, hi, hif]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, translationExponent_add,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single,
      PhantomWeight.translationExponent_single]
    norm_num only [Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_neg]
    simp only [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent]
    ring
  simp only [profileLeftExponent, Profile.periodicSymmDiff,
    CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
  rw [periodicIndexSet_singleton hf (a + 1)]
  rw [show
    (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid).t =
      sigma.t - inversePower p f hf (periodicIndex hf a) +
        (sigma.u (periodicIndex hf a + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
          inversePower p f hf (periodicIndex hf a + 1) by rfl]
  dsimp [T] at hsumToggle
  change liftQPlusOne p f
        (sigma.t - inversePower p f hf (periodicIndex hf a) +
          (sigma.u (periodicIndex hf a + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
            inversePower p f hf (periodicIndex hf a + 1)) +
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (periodicIndex hf a) valid) J =
    liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma (symmDiff J {a + 1, a + 1 + f})
  rw [hsumNu, hsumToggle, liftQPlusOne_add hp hf,
    liftQPlusOne_sub hp hf, ← hperiodicSucc,
    liftQPlusOne_natCast_mul hp hf,
    ← niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_half_eq_lift hp hf (a + 1)]
  simp only [u1]
  ring

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoProfileSum_add_compl
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_add_compl {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ =
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  simp only [niveauTwoProfileSum]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
  simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_univ, if_true]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : i ∈ J <;> simp [hi]

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoProfileSum_univ_eq_lift
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_univ_eq_lift {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) :
    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ =
      liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ)
proof:
:= by
  have hOne :
      translationExponent p f hf (fun i ↦ (sigma.u i : Int)) =
        niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ := by
    simpa [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set] using
      translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator hf sigma Set.univ
  rw [← hOne, ← translationExponent_periodicExtend hp hf]
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  simp only [niveauTwoProfileSum, translationExponent, periodicExtend,
    PhantomWeight.periodicU, niveauTwoFundamentalExponent,
    Finset.sum_filter, Set.mem_univ, if_true]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  norm_cast

name: KLSposet.profileExponents_add_eq_determinant
statement:
theorem profileExponents_add_eq_determinant {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Profile f) :
    match J with
    | .niveauOne K =>
        sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma K +
            (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Kᶜ) =
          determinantExponent hf sigma
    | .niveauTwo K _ =>
        liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma K +
            (liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Kᶜ) =
          liftQPlusOne p f (determinantExponent hf sigma)
proof:
:= by
  cases J with
  | niveauOne K =>
      simp only
      calc
        sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma K +
              (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Kᶜ) =
            sigma.t + sigma.t +
              (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma K +
                niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Kᶜ) := by ring
        _ = sigma.t + sigma.t +
              niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ := by
            rw [niveauOneProfileSum_add_compl]
        _ = determinantExponent hf sigma := rfl
  | niveauTwo K hK =>
      simp only
      calc
        liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma K +
              (liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Kᶜ) =
            liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
              (niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma K +
                niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Kᶜ) := by ring
        _ = liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
              niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ := by
            rw [niveauTwoProfileSum_add_compl]
        _ = liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
              liftQPlusOne p f (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Set.univ) := by
            rw [niveauTwoProfileSum_univ_eq_lift hp hf]
        _ = liftQPlusOne p f (determinantExponent hf sigma) := by
            simp only [determinantExponent]
            rw [liftQPlusOne_add hp hf, liftQPlusOne_add hp hf]

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_eq_iff_profileRightExponent_eq_of_determinant_eq
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_eq_iff_profileRightExponent_eq_of_determinant_eq
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hdet : determinantExponent hf sigma = determinantExponent hf sigma')
    (J K : Profile f) :
    profileLeftExponent hf sigma J = profileLeftExponent hf sigma' K ↔
      profileRightExponent hf sigma J = profileRightExponent hf sigma' K
proof:
:= by
  cases J with
  | niveauOne J =>
      cases K with
      | niveauOne K =>
          simp only [profileLeftExponent, profileRightExponent,
            CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
          have hs := profileExponents_add_eq_determinant hp hf sigma
            (.niveauOne J)
          have ht := profileExponents_add_eq_determinant hp hf sigma'
            (.niveauOne K)
          constructor
          · intro hleft
            calc
              sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ =
                  determinantExponent hf sigma -
                    (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) := by
                rw [← hs]
                ring
              _ = determinantExponent hf sigma' -
                    (sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' K) := by
                rw [hdet, hleft]
              _ = sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ := by
                rw [← ht]
                ring
          · intro hright
            calc
              sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J =
                  determinantExponent hf sigma -
                    (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) := by
                rw [← hs]
                ring
              _ = determinantExponent hf sigma' -
                    (sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ) := by
                rw [hdet, hright]
              _ = sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' K := by
                rw [← ht]
                ring
      | niveauTwo K hK => simp [profileLeftExponent, profileRightExponent]
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      cases K with
      | niveauOne K => simp [profileLeftExponent, profileRightExponent]
      | niveauTwo K hK =>
          simp only [profileLeftExponent, profileRightExponent,
            CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
          have hs := profileExponents_add_eq_determinant hp hf sigma
            (.niveauTwo J hJ)
          have ht := profileExponents_add_eq_determinant hp hf sigma'
            (.niveauTwo K hK)
          have hdetLift := congrArg (liftQPlusOne p f) hdet
          constructor
          · intro hleft
            calc
              liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ =
                  liftQPlusOne p f (determinantExponent hf sigma) -
                    (liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
                      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J) := by
                rw [← hs]
                ring
              _ = liftQPlusOne p f (determinantExponent hf sigma') -
                    (liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t +
                      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K) := by
                rw [hdetLift, hleft]
              _ = liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t +
                    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ := by
                rw [← ht]
                ring
          · intro hright
            calc
              liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J =
                  liftQPlusOne p f (determinantExponent hf sigma) -
                    (liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
                      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) := by
                rw [← hs]
                ring
              _ = liftQPlusOne p f (determinantExponent hf sigma') -
                    (liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t +
                      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ) := by
                rw [hdetLift, hright]
              _ = liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t +
                    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K := by
                rw [← ht]
                ring

name: KLSposet.profileLeftExponent_mem_iff_compl_mem_of_determinant_eq
statement:
theorem profileLeftExponent_mem_iff_compl_mem_of_determinant_eq
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hdet : determinantExponent hf sigma = determinantExponent hf sigma')
    (J : Profile f) :
    profileLeftExponent hf sigma J ∈ leftExponentSet hf sigma' ↔
      profileLeftExponent hf sigma J.compl ∈ leftExponentSet hf sigma'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨K, hK⟩
    refine ⟨K.compl, ?_⟩
    have hright :=
      (profileLeftExponent_eq_iff_profileRightExponent_eq_of_determinant_eq
        hp hf sigma' sigma hdet.symm K J).mp hK
    simpa only [profileLeftExponent_compl] using hright
  · rintro ⟨K, hK⟩
    refine ⟨K.compl, ?_⟩
    have hright :=
      (profileLeftExponent_eq_iff_profileRightExponent_eq_of_determinant_eq
        hp hf sigma' sigma hdet.symm K J.compl).mp hK
    simpa only [profileLeftExponent_compl, profileRightExponent_compl]
      using hright

name: KLSposet.leftExponentSet_subset_iff_complementary_choice_of_determinant_eq
statement:
theorem leftExponentSet_subset_iff_complementary_choice_of_determinant_eq
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hdet : determinantExponent hf sigma = determinantExponent hf sigma') :
    leftExponentSet hf sigma ⊆ leftExponentSet hf sigma' ↔
      ∀ J : Profile f,
        profileLeftExponent hf sigma J ∈ leftExponentSet hf sigma' ∨
          profileLeftExponent hf sigma J.compl ∈ leftExponentSet hf sigma'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsub J
    exact Or.inl (hsub ⟨J, rfl⟩)
  · intro hchoice _
    rintro ⟨J, rfl⟩
    rcases hchoice J with hJ | hJcompl
    · exact hJ
    · exact (profileLeftExponent_mem_iff_compl_mem_of_determinant_eq
        hp hf sigma sigma' hdet J).mpr hJcompl

name: KLSposet.profileCharacterPair_mul_eq_determinantCharacter
statement:
theorem profileCharacterPair_mul_eq_determinantCharacter
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Profile f) :
    (profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma J).left *
        (profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma J).right =
      niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars (determinantExponent hf sigma)
proof:
:= by
  rw [profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents]
  cases J with
  | niveauOne K =>
      simp only [profileCharacterExponents, realizeOrderedCharacterExponents]
      rw [← AddChar.map_add_eq_mul,
        profileExponents_add_eq_determinant hp hf sigma (.niveauOne K)]
  | niveauTwo K hK =>
      simp only [profileCharacterExponents, realizeOrderedCharacterExponents]
      rw [← AddChar.map_add_eq_mul,
        profileExponents_add_eq_determinant hp hf sigma (.niveauTwo K hK),
        ← niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne]

name: KLSposet.determinantExponent_eq_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset
statement:
theorem determinantExponent_eq_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hsub : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma') :
    determinantExponent hf sigma = determinantExponent hf sigma'
proof:
:= by
  let J : Profile f := .niveauOne ∅
  have hsource :
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma J ∈
        semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma := ⟨J, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hsub hsource
  apply chars.niveauOneExactOrder
  change niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars (determinantExponent hf sigma) =
    niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars (determinantExponent hf sigma')
  calc
    niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars (determinantExponent hf sigma) =
        (profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma J).left *
          (profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma J).right :=
      (profileCharacterPair_mul_eq_determinantCharacter hp hf chars sigma J).symm
    _ = (profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' K).left *
          (profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' K).right := by rw [hK]
    _ = niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars (determinantExponent hf sigma') :=
      profileCharacterPair_mul_eq_determinantCharacter hp hf chars sigma' K

name: KLSposet.semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_determinant_eq_of_left_subset
statement:
theorem semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_determinant_eq_of_left_subset
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hdet : determinantExponent hf sigma = determinantExponent hf sigma')
    (hleft : leftExponentSet hf sigma ⊆ leftExponentSet hf sigma') :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma'
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨J, rfl⟩
  have hleftMem : profileLeftExponent hf sigma J ∈ leftExponentSet hf sigma :=
    ⟨J, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K, hLK⟩ := hleft hleftMem
  refine ⟨K, ?_⟩
  rw [profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents,
    profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents]
  apply congrArg (realizeOrderedCharacterExponents hp hf chars)
  cases J with
  | niveauOne J =>
      cases K with
      | niveauOne K =>
          simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq] at hLK
          have ht := profileExponents_add_eq_determinant hp hf sigma' (.niveauOne K)
          have hs := profileExponents_add_eq_determinant hp hf sigma (.niveauOne J)
          apply congrArg₂ OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne hLK
          calc
            sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ =
                determinantExponent hf sigma' -
                  (sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' K) := by
              rw [← ht]
              ring
            _ = determinantExponent hf sigma -
                  (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) := by
              rw [← hdet, hLK]
            _ = sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ := by
              rw [← hs]
              ring
      | niveauTwo K hK => simp [profileLeftExponent] at hLK
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      cases K with
      | niveauOne K => simp [profileLeftExponent] at hLK
      | niveauTwo K hK =>
          simp only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq] at hLK
          have ht := profileExponents_add_eq_determinant hp hf sigma'
            (.niveauTwo K hK)
          have hs := profileExponents_add_eq_determinant hp hf sigma
            (.niveauTwo J hJ)
          have hdetLift := congrArg (liftQPlusOne p f) hdet
          apply congrArg₂ OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauTwo hLK
          calc
            liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ =
                liftQPlusOne p f (determinantExponent hf sigma') -
                  (liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t +
                    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K) := by
              rw [← ht]
              ring
            _ = liftQPlusOne p f (determinantExponent hf sigma) -
                  (liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
                    niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J) := by
              rw [← hdetLift, hLK]
            _ = liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t +
                  niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ := by
              rw [← hs]
              ring

name: KLSposet.leftExponentSet_subset_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_ne_critical
statement:
theorem leftExponentSet_subset_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_ne_critical
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hsub : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma')
    (hnoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t) :
    leftExponentSet hf sigma ⊆ leftExponentSet hf sigma'
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨J, rfl⟩
  have hcompat := mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset_of_ne_critical hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' hsub hnoncritical J
  obtain ⟨K, hNiveau, hPair⟩ :=
    (mem_compatibleProfiles_iff (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma' J).mp hcompat
  refine ⟨K, ?_⟩
  cases J with
  | niveauOne J =>
      cases K with
      | niveauOne K =>
          have hExp := niveauOneProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq
            (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma' J K hPair
          have hLeft :
              sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J =
                sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' K := by
            have hBoth :
                sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J =
                    sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' K ∧
                  sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ =
                    sigma'.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ := by
              simpa only [profileCharacterExponents,
                OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne.injEq] using hExp
            exact hBoth.1
          simpa only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauOne.injEq]
            using hLeft.symm
      | niveauTwo K hK => simp [Profile.niveau] at hNiveau
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      cases K with
      | niveauOne K => simp [Profile.niveau] at hNiveau
      | niveauTwo K hK =>
          have hExp := niveauTwoProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq
            (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma' J K hJ hK hPair
          have hLeft :
              liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J =
                liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K := by
            have hBoth :
                liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J =
                    liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K ∧
                  liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ =
                    liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t +
                      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ := by
              simpa only [profileCharacterExponents,
                OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauTwo.injEq] using hExp
            exact hBoth.1
          simpa only [profileLeftExponent, CharacterExponent.niveauTwo.injEq]
            using hLeft.symm

name: KLSposet.semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_iff_determinant_eq_and_left_subset_of_ne_critical
statement:
theorem semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_iff_determinant_eq_and_left_subset_of_ne_critical
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hnoncritical : sigma' ≠ PhantomWeight.critical p f sigma'.t) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma' ↔
      determinantExponent hf sigma = determinantExponent hf sigma' ∧
        leftExponentSet hf sigma ⊆ leftExponentSet hf sigma'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsub
    exact ⟨determinantExponent_eq_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset
        (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma' hsub,
      leftExponentSet_subset_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_ne_critical
        hp hf chars sigma sigma' hsub hnoncritical⟩
  · rintro ⟨hdet, hleft⟩
    exact semisimpleCharacterSet_subset_of_determinant_eq_of_left_subset
      (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma' hdet hleft

name: KLSposet.mem_semisimpleCharacterSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_semisimpleCharacterSet_iff {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*}
    [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (rho : OrderedCharacterPair I A) :
    rho ∈ semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ↔
      ∃ J : Profile f, profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma J = rho
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.liftNuChain
statement:
theorem liftNuChain {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (start : ZMod f) (n : Nat) (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f)
    (tau : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hchain : NuChain hp hf start n (ofHodge hf r) tau) :
    ∃ s, PBoundedHodgeType.NuChain hp hf start n r s ∧ ofHodge hf s = tau
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing tau with
  | zero =>
      change tau = ofHodge hf r at hchain
      exact ⟨r, rfl, hchain.symm⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      rcases hchain with ⟨mid, hprev, valid, htau⟩
      rcases ih mid hprev with ⟨s, hs, hsEncoding⟩
      have hvalid : s.NuValid (start + (n : ZMod f)) :=
        (nuValid_iff_ofHodge hf s _).mpr (by simpa only [hsEncoding] using valid)
      let out := s.nu hp hf (start + (n : ZMod f)) hvalid
      refine ⟨out, ⟨s, hs, hvalid, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      calc
        ofHodge hf out =
            (ofHodge hf s).nu hp hf (start + (n : ZMod f))
              ((nuValid_iff_ofHodge hf s _).mp hvalid) :=
          ofHodge_nu hp hf s _ hvalid
        _ = mid.nu hp hf (start + (n : ZMod f)) valid := by
          simp only [hsEncoding]
        _ = tau := htau.symm

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.sourceCoordinates_of_theta_eq_steinberg
statement:
theorem sourceCoordinates_of_theta_eq_steinberg {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (hTheta : sigma.theta hf j valid = steinberg p f 0) :
    sigma.u j = p - 1 ∧ sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 ∧
      (∀ i, i ≠ j → i ≠ j + 1 → sigma.u i = p) ∧
      sigma.t = inversePower p f hf j
proof:
:= by
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hj := congrFun (congrArg PhantomWeight.u hTheta) j
  have hj1 := congrFun (congrArg PhantomWeight.u hTheta) (j + 1)
  have ht := congrArg PhantomWeight.t hTheta
  have huj : sigma.u j = p - 1 := by
    simp only [theta, if_pos, steinberg, constantWeight] at hj
    omega
  refine ⟨huj, valid.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hij hij1
    have hi := congrFun (congrArg PhantomWeight.u hTheta) i
    simpa only [theta, hij, hij1, if_false, steinberg, constantWeight] using hi
  · simp only [theta, steinberg, constantWeight] at ht
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ht

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.steinbergToBarsottiTateState_zero
statement:
theorem steinbergToBarsottiTateState_zero {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (huj : sigma.u j = p - 1) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    (hother : ∀ i, i ≠ j → i ≠ j + 1 → sigma.u i = p)
    (ht : sigma.t = inversePower p f hf j) :
    steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j 0 (by omega) = sigma
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : Fact (1 < f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hfsub : 0 ≠ f - 1 := by omega
  apply ext
  · funext i
    have hzero : (i - j).val = 0 ↔ i = j := by
      rw [ZMod.val_eq_zero]
      constructor
      · intro h
        apply sub_eq_zero.mp h
      · exact sub_eq_zero.mpr
    have hone : (i - j).val = 1 ↔ i = j + 1 := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        have hcast : i - j = (1 : ZMod f) := by
          rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_val (i - j), h]
          norm_num
        linear_combination hcast
      · intro h
        subst i
        have hdiff : j + 1 - j = (1 : ZMod f) := by ring
        rw [hdiff, ZMod.val_one]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      change (if 0 = f - 1 then 1 else if (j - j).val = 0 then p - 1
        else if (j - j).val ≤ 0 then 1
        else if (j - j).val = 1 then 0 else p) = sigma.u j
      rw [if_neg hfsub]
      simp [huj]
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        change (if 0 = f - 1 then 1 else if (j + 1 - j).val = 0 then p - 1
          else if (j + 1 - j).val ≤ 0 then 1
          else if (j + 1 - j).val = 1 then 0 else p) = sigma.u (j + 1)
        rw [show j + 1 - j = (1 : ZMod f) by ring, ZMod.val_one,
          if_neg hfsub]
        simp [huj1]
      · have hvalPos : 0 < (i - j).val := by
          have := (hzero.not.mpr hij)
          omega
        have hvalNeOne : (i - j).val ≠ 1 := hone.not.mpr hij1
        change (if 0 = f - 1 then 1 else if (i - j).val = 0 then p - 1
          else if (i - j).val ≤ 0 then 1
          else if (i - j).val = 1 then 0 else p) = sigma.u i
        rw [if_neg hfsub, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega),
          if_neg hvalNeOne]
        exact (hother i hij hij1).symm
  · change (if 0 = f - 1 then 0 else inversePower p f hf j) = sigma.t
    rw [if_neg hfsub, ht]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.steinbergToBarsottiTateState_last
statement:
theorem steinbergToBarsottiTateState_last {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (j : ZMod f) :
    steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j (f - 1) le_rfl =
      barsottiTate p f (by omega) 0
proof:
:= by
  apply ext
  · funext i
    simp [steinbergToBarsottiTateState, barsottiTate, constantWeight]
  · simp [steinbergToBarsottiTateState, barsottiTate, constantWeight]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.steinbergToBarsottiTateState_succ
statement:
theorem steinbergToBarsottiTateState_succ {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (j : ZMod f) (n : Nat) (hn : n + 1 ≤ f - 1) :
    ∃ valid : (steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j n (by omega)).NuValid
        (j + (n + 1 : Nat)),
      (steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j n (by omega)).nu (by omega) hf
          (j + (n + 1 : Nat)) valid =
        steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j (n + 1) hn
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : Fact (1 < f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero (p ^ f - 1) := ⟨by
    have : 1 < p ^ f := one_lt_pow₀ (by omega) (by omega)
    omega⟩
  let old := steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j n (by omega)
  let k : ZMod f := j + (n + 1 : Nat)
  have hnlt : n < f - 1 := by omega
  have hn1lt : n + 1 < f := by omega
  have hkdiff : k - j = ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
    dsimp only [k]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hkval : (k - j).val = n + 1 := by
    rw [hkdiff, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hn1lt]
  have hvalid : old.NuValid k := by
    change old.u k = 0
    change (if n = f - 1 then 1 else if (k - j).val = 0 then p - 1
      else if (k - j).val ≤ n then 1
      else if (k - j).val = n + 1 then 0 else p) = 0
    rw [if_neg (by omega), hkval]
    simp
  refine ⟨hvalid, ?_⟩
  apply ext
  · funext i
    by_cases hik : i = k
    · subst i
      change (old.nu (by omega) hf k hvalid).u k =
        (steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j (n + 1) hn).u k
      rw [show (old.nu (by omega) hf k hvalid).u k = old.u k + 1 by
        simp [nu]]
      rw [show old.u k = 0 by exact hvalid]
      change 1 = (if n + 1 = f - 1 then 1
        else if (k - j).val = 0 then p - 1
        else if (k - j).val ≤ n + 1 then 1
        else if (k - j).val = n + 1 + 1 then 0 else p)
      rw [hkval]
      split <;> simp
    · by_cases hik1 : i = k + 1
      · subst i
        change (old.nu (by omega) hf k hvalid).u (k + 1) =
          (steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j (n + 1) hn).u (k + 1)
        rw [show (old.nu (by omega) hf k hvalid).u (k + 1) = p - old.u (k + 1) by
          simp [nu, hik]]
        by_cases hlast : n + 1 = f - 1
        · have hk1 : k + 1 = j := by
            have hnf : n + 2 = f := by omega
            calc
              k + 1 = j + ((n + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
                dsimp only [k]
                push_cast
                ring
              _ = j + (f : ZMod f) := by rw [hnf]
              _ = j := by rw [ZMod.natCast_self]; ring
          have hold : old.u (k + 1) = p - 1 := by
            rw [hk1]
            dsimp only [old, steinbergToBarsottiTateState]
            rw [if_neg (by omega)]
            simp
          have hnew :
              (steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j (n + 1) hn).u (k + 1) = 1 := by
            dsimp only [steinbergToBarsottiTateState]
            rw [if_pos hlast]
          rw [hold, hnew]
          omega
        · have hn2lt : n + 2 < f := by omega
          have hk1diff : k + 1 - j = ((n + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
            dsimp only [k]
            push_cast
            ring
          have hk1val : (k + 1 - j).val = n + 2 := by
            rw [hk1diff, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hn2lt]
          change p - (if n = f - 1 then 1
            else if (k + 1 - j).val = 0 then p - 1
            else if (k + 1 - j).val ≤ n then 1
            else if (k + 1 - j).val = n + 1 then 0 else p) =
            (if n + 1 = f - 1 then 1
            else if (k + 1 - j).val = 0 then p - 1
            else if (k + 1 - j).val ≤ n + 1 then 1
            else if (k + 1 - j).val = n + 1 + 1 then 0 else p)
          rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg hlast, hk1val]
          simp
      · have hrepr : i = j + (((i - j).val : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
          rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
          ring
        have hneFront : (i - j).val ≠ n + 1 := by
          intro h
          apply hik
          rw [hrepr, h]
        have hneNext : (i - j).val ≠ n + 2 := by
          intro h
          apply hik1
          rw [hrepr, h]
          dsimp only [k]
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [show (old.nu (by omega) hf k hvalid).u i = old.u i by
          simp [nu, hik, hik1]]
        change (if n = f - 1 then 1 else if (i - j).val = 0 then p - 1
          else if (i - j).val ≤ n then 1
          else if (i - j).val = n + 1 then 0 else p) =
          (if n + 1 = f - 1 then 1 else if (i - j).val = 0 then p - 1
          else if (i - j).val ≤ n + 1 then 1
          else if (i - j).val = n + 2 then 0 else p)
        rw [if_neg (by omega)]
        by_cases hlast : n + 1 = f - 1
        · rw [if_pos hlast]
          have hk1 : k + 1 = j := by
            have hnf : n + 2 = f := by omega
            calc
              k + 1 = j + ((n + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
                dsimp only [k]
                push_cast
                ring
              _ = j + (f : ZMod f) := by rw [hnf]
              _ = j := by rw [ZMod.natCast_self]; ring
          have hneZero : (i - j).val ≠ 0 := by
            intro hzero
            have hsub : i - j = 0 := (ZMod.val_eq_zero (i - j)).mp hzero
            have hij : i = j := sub_eq_zero.mp hsub
            apply hik1
            rw [hij, hk1]
          have hvalLt := ZMod.val_lt (i - j)
          rw [if_neg hneZero, if_pos (by omega)]
        · rw [if_neg hlast]
          by_cases hzero : (i - j).val = 0
          · rw [if_pos hzero, if_pos hzero]
          · rw [if_neg hzero, if_neg hzero]
            by_cases hle : (i - j).val ≤ n
            · rw [if_pos hle, if_pos (by omega)]
            · rw [if_neg hle, if_neg hneFront]
              have hnotleNext : ¬(i - j).val ≤ n + 1 := by omega
              rw [if_neg hnotleNext, if_neg hneNext]
  · by_cases hlast : n + 1 = f - 1
    · have hk1 : k + 1 = j := by
        have hnf : n + 2 = f := by omega
        calc
          k + 1 = j + ((n + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
            dsimp only [k]
            push_cast
            ring
          _ = j + (f : ZMod f) := by rw [hnf]
          _ = j := by rw [ZMod.natCast_self]; ring
      have hrec := inversePower_succ p f (by omega) hf k
      rw [hk1] at hrec
      have holdt : old.t = inversePower p f hf j := by
        dsimp only [old, steinbergToBarsottiTateState]
        rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      have holdsucc : old.u (k + 1) = p - 1 := by
        rw [hk1]
        dsimp only [old, steinbergToBarsottiTateState]
        rw [if_neg (by omega)]
        simp
      have hnewt : (steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j (n + 1) hn).t = 0 := by
        dsimp only [steinbergToBarsottiTateState]
        rw [if_pos hlast]
      change old.t - inversePower p f hf k +
          (old.u (k + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf (k + 1) =
        (steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j (n + 1) hn).t
      rw [holdt, holdsucc, hk1, hnewt]
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ p)]
      push_cast
      linear_combination hrec
    · have hrec := inversePower_succ p f (by omega) hf k
      have hn2lt : n + 2 < f := by omega
      have hk1diff : k + 1 - j = ((n + 2 : Nat) : ZMod f) := by
        dsimp only [k]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hk1val : (k + 1 - j).val = n + 2 := by
        rw [hk1diff, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hn2lt]
      have holdt : old.t = inversePower p f hf j := by
        dsimp only [old, steinbergToBarsottiTateState]
        rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      have holdsucc : old.u (k + 1) = p := by
        dsimp only [old, steinbergToBarsottiTateState]
        rw [if_neg (by omega), hk1val]
        simp
      have hnewt : (steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j (n + 1) hn).t =
          inversePower p f hf j := by
        dsimp only [steinbergToBarsottiTateState]
        rw [if_neg hlast]
      change old.t - inversePower p f hf k +
          (old.u (k + 1) : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * inversePower p f hf (k + 1) =
        (steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j (n + 1) hn).t
      rw [holdt, holdsucc, hnewt]
      linear_combination hrec

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.thetaPreimage_nuChain_barsottiTate
statement:
theorem thetaPreimage_nuChain_barsottiTate {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (hTheta : sigma.theta hf j valid = steinberg p f 0) :
    NuChain (by omega) hf (j + 1) (f - 1) sigma
      (barsottiTate p f (by omega) 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases sourceCoordinates_of_theta_eq_steinberg hp hf sigma j valid hTheta with
    ⟨huj, huj1, hother, ht⟩
  have hstates : ∀ n (hn : n ≤ f - 1),
      NuChain (by omega) hf (j + 1) n sigma
        (steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j n hn) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        intro hn
        change steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j 0 hn = sigma
        exact steinbergToBarsottiTateState_zero hp hf sigma j huj huj1 hother ht
    | succ n ih =>
        intro hn
        change ∃ mid,
          NuChain (by omega) hf (j + 1) n sigma mid ∧
            ∃ stepValid : mid.NuValid (j + 1 + (n : ZMod f)),
              steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j (n + 1) hn =
                mid.nu (by omega) hf (j + 1 + (n : ZMod f)) stepValid
        have hprev := ih (by omega : n ≤ f - 1)
        rcases steinbergToBarsottiTateState_succ hp hf j n hn with
          ⟨stepValid, hstep⟩
        have hindex : j + 1 + (n : ZMod f) = j + (n + 1 : Nat) := by
          push_cast
          ring
        refine ⟨steinbergToBarsottiTateState hp hf j n (by omega), hprev, ?_⟩
        rw [hindex]
        exact ⟨stepValid, hstep.symm⟩
  have hlast := hstates (f - 1) le_rfl
  rw [steinbergToBarsottiTateState_last hp hf j] at hlast
  exact hlast

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.ofHodge_barsottiTate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHodge_barsottiTate {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) :
    ofHodge hf (PBoundedHodgeType.barsottiTate hp) =
      barsottiTate p f (by omega) 0
proof:
:=
  ofHodge_toHodge hp hf _

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.ofHodge_steinberg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHodge_steinberg {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) :
    ofHodge hf (PBoundedHodgeType.steinberg (p := p) (f := f)) =
      steinberg p f 0
proof:
:=
  ofHodge_toHodge hp hf _

name: KLSposet.PBoundedHodgeType.steinbergToBarsottiTate_nuChain
statement:
theorem steinbergToBarsottiTate_nuChain {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : r.ThetaValid j)
    (hTheta : r.theta hf j valid = steinberg (p := p) (f := f)) :
    ∃ s, NuChain (by omega) hf (j + 1) (f - 1) r s ∧
      TranslationEquivalent hf (barsottiTate hp) s
proof:
:= by
  have hThetaEncoding :
      (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r).theta hf j
          ((PhantomWeight.thetaValid_iff_ofHodge hf r j).mp valid) =
        PhantomWeight.steinberg p f 0 := by
    calc
      _ = PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf (r.theta hf j valid) :=
        (PhantomWeight.ofHodge_theta hf r j valid).symm
      _ = PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf (steinberg (p := p) (f := f)) := by
        rw [hTheta]
      _ = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f 0 :=
        PhantomWeight.ofHodge_steinberg hp hf
  have hPhantomChain := PhantomWeight.thetaPreimage_nuChain_barsottiTate
    hp hf (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r) j
      ((PhantomWeight.thetaValid_iff_ofHodge hf r j).mp valid) hThetaEncoding
  rcases PhantomWeight.liftNuChain (by omega) hf (j + 1) (f - 1) r
      (PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) 0) hPhantomChain with
    ⟨s, hChain, hs⟩
  refine ⟨s, hChain, ?_⟩
  apply (PhantomWeight.translationEquivalent_iff_ofHodge_eq hf _ _).mpr
  rw [PhantomWeight.ofHodge_barsottiTate hp hf, hs]

name: KLSposet.FundamentalCharacterSystem.niveauOneExactOrder
statement:
theorem FundamentalCharacterSystem.niveauOneExactOrder
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun e : ZMod (p ^ f - 1) ↦ chars.niveauOneBase ^ e.val)
proof:
:=
  FundamentalCharacterSystem.niveauOne_exactOrder chars

name: KLSposet.powerIndex_injective_of_orderOf_eq
statement:
private theorem powerIndex_injective_of_orderOf_eq
    {G : Type*} [Monoid G] {n : Nat} [NeZero n] (a : G)
    (ha : orderOf a = n) : Function.Injective (fun e : ZMod n ↦ a ^ e.val)
proof:
:= by
  intro e e' heq
  apply ZMod.val_injective
  exact pow_injOn_Iio_orderOf (by simpa [ha] using e.val_lt)
    (by simpa [ha] using e'.val_lt) heq

name: KLSposet.fundamentalCharacterOrderFactorization
statement:
theorem fundamentalCharacterOrderFactorization (p f : Nat) :
    p ^ (2 * f) - 1 = (p ^ f - 1) * (p ^ f + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : p ^ (2 * f) = (p ^ f) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_comm, pow_mul]
  calc
    p ^ (2 * f) - 1 = (p ^ f) ^ 2 - 1 ^ 2 := by simp [hpow]
    _ = (p ^ f + 1) * (p ^ f - 1) := sq_tsub_sq _ _
    _ = (p ^ f - 1) * (p ^ f + 1) := mul_comm _ _

name: KLSposet.cyclicNiveauOneGeneratorOrder
statement:
theorem cyclicNiveauOneGeneratorOrder (p f : Nat) (hp : 1 < p) (hf : 0 < f) :
    orderOf (Multiplicative.ofAdd
      ((p ^ f + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1))) = p ^ f - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 1 < p ^ f := Nat.one_lt_pow hf.ne' hp
  have hfactor := fundamentalCharacterOrderFactorization p f
  have hN : p ^ (2 * f) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hfactor]
    exact Nat.mul_ne_zero (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [orderOf_ofAdd_eq_addOrderOf, ZMod.addOrderOf_coe _ hN, hfactor]
  have hgcd : Nat.gcd ((p ^ f - 1) * (p ^ f + 1)) (p ^ f + 1) = p ^ f + 1 := by
    simp
  rw [hgcd]
  calc
    (p ^ f - 1) * (p ^ f + 1) / (p ^ f + 1) =
        (p ^ f + 1) * (p ^ f - 1) / (p ^ f + 1) := by rw [mul_comm]
    _ = p ^ f - 1 :=
      Nat.mul_div_right (m := p ^ f + 1) (p ^ f - 1) (Nat.zero_lt_succ _)

name: KLSposet.cyclicNiveauTwoGeneratorOrder
statement:
theorem cyclicNiveauTwoGeneratorOrder (p f : Nat) :
    orderOf (Multiplicative.ofAdd
      (1 : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1))) = p ^ (2 * f) - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderOf_ofAdd_eq_addOrderOf, ZMod.addOrderOf_one]

name: KLSposet.cyclicNiveauOne_period
statement:
theorem cyclicNiveauOne_period (p f : Nat)
    (g : Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1))) :
    (cyclicNiveauOneBase p f g) ^ (p ^ f - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change Multiplicative.ofAdd
      ((p ^ f - 1) • (((p ^ f + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) * g.toAdd)) =
    Multiplicative.ofAdd 0
  congr 1
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← Nat.cast_mul]
  rw [← fundamentalCharacterOrderFactorization p f]
  rw [ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]

name: KLSposet.cyclicNiveauTwo_period
statement:
theorem cyclicNiveauTwo_period (p f : Nat)
    (g : Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1))) :
    (cyclicNiveauTwoBase p f g) ^ (p ^ (2 * f) - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change Multiplicative.ofAdd ((p ^ (2 * f) - 1) • g.toAdd) = Multiplicative.ofAdd 0
  congr 1
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul]

name: KLSposet.cyclicNiveauOne_exactOrder
statement:
theorem cyclicNiveauOne_exactOrder (p f : Nat) (hp : 1 < p) (hf : 0 < f) :
    Function.Injective (fun e : ZMod (p ^ f - 1) ↦ cyclicNiveauOneBase p f ^ e.val)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 1 < p ^ f := Nat.one_lt_pow hf.ne' hp
  letI : NeZero (p ^ f - 1) := ⟨by omega⟩
  intro e e' heq
  apply powerIndex_injective_of_orderOf_eq
      (Multiplicative.ofAdd
        ((p ^ f + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)))
      (cyclicNiveauOneGeneratorOrder p f hp hf)
  simpa [cyclicNiveauOneBase] using
    DFunLike.congr_fun heq
      (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)))

name: KLSposet.cyclicNiveauTwo_exactOrder
statement:
theorem cyclicNiveauTwo_exactOrder (p f : Nat) (hp : 1 < p) (hf : 0 < f) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun e : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1) ↦ cyclicNiveauTwoBase p f ^ e.val)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 1 < p ^ f := Nat.one_lt_pow hf.ne' hp
  have hfactor := fundamentalCharacterOrderFactorization p f
  letI : NeZero (p ^ (2 * f) - 1) :=
    ⟨by rw [hfactor]; exact Nat.mul_ne_zero (by omega) (by omega)⟩
  intro e e' heq
  apply powerIndex_injective_of_orderOf_eq
      (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)))
      (cyclicNiveauTwoGeneratorOrder p f)
  simpa [cyclicNiveauTwoBase] using
    DFunLike.congr_fun heq
      (Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)))

name: KLSposet.cyclicNiveauTwo_norm
statement:
theorem cyclicNiveauTwo_norm (p f : Nat)
    (g : Multiplicative (ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1))) :
    (cyclicNiveauTwoBase p f g) ^ (p ^ f + 1) = cyclicNiveauOneBase p f g
proof:
:= by
  change Multiplicative.ofAdd ((p ^ f + 1) • g.toAdd) =
    Multiplicative.ofAdd
      (((p ^ f + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) * g.toAdd)
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul]

name: KLSposet.niveauOneFundamentalExponent_succ
statement:
theorem niveauOneFundamentalExponent_succ (p f : Nat) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (i : ZMod f) :
    (p : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) * niveauOneFundamentalExponent p f hf (i + 1) =
      niveauOneFundamentalExponent p f hf i
proof:
:= by
  exact inversePower_succ p f hp hf i

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_succ
statement:
theorem niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_succ (p f : Nat) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) * niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (i + 1) =
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf i
proof:
:= by
  exact inversePower_succ p (2 * f) hp (by omega) i

name: KLSposet.FundamentalCharacterSystem.niveauOne_frobenius
statement:
theorem FundamentalCharacterSystem.niveauOne_frobenius {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (i : ZMod f) :
    (chars.niveauOne hp hf (i + 1)) ^ p = chars.niveauOne hp hf i
proof:
:= by
  change (niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
      (niveauOneFundamentalExponent p f hf (i + 1))) ^ p =
    niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
      (niveauOneFundamentalExponent p f hf i)
  rw [← AddChar.map_nsmul_eq_pow]
  congr 1
  simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using niveauOneFundamentalExponent_succ p f (by omega) hf i

name: KLSposet.FundamentalCharacterSystem.niveauTwo_frobenius
statement:
theorem FundamentalCharacterSystem.niveauTwo_frobenius {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    (chars.niveauTwo hp hf (i + 1)) ^ p = chars.niveauTwo hp hf i
proof:
:= by
  change (niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars
      (niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (i + 1))) ^ p =
    niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars
      (niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf i)
  rw [← AddChar.map_nsmul_eq_pow]
  congr 1
  simpa [nsmul_eq_mul] using niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_succ p f (by omega) hf i

name: KLSposet.periodicIndex_natCast
statement:
theorem periodicIndex_natCast {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (j : Nat) (hj : j < f) :
    periodicIndex hf (j : ZMod (2 * f)) = (j : ZMod f)
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  simp [periodicIndex, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (by omega : j < 2 * f)]

name: KLSposet.periodicIndex_add_natCast
statement:
theorem periodicIndex_add_natCast {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (j : Nat) :
    periodicIndex hf ((f + j : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) = (j : ZMod f)
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  simp [periodicIndex]

name: KLSposet.periodicIndex_eq_castHom
statement:
theorem periodicIndex_eq_castHom {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    periodicIndex hf i =
      ZMod.castHom (show f ∣ 2 * f by exact ⟨2, by omega⟩) (ZMod f) i
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  rw [← ZMod.natCast_zmod_val i]
  simp [periodicIndex]

name: KLSposet.periodicIndex_sub_one
statement:
theorem periodicIndex_sub_one {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (i : ZMod (2 * f)) :
    periodicIndex hf (i - 1) = periodicIndex hf i - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
  simp

name: KLSposet.niveauOneCharacterProduct_eq_exponentCharacter
statement:
theorem niveauOneCharacterProduct_eq_exponentCharacter {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) :
    niveauOneCharacterProduct hp hf chars sigma J =
      niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J)
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun i ↦ i ∈ J)
  change s.prod (fun i ↦
      (niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
        (niveauOneFundamentalExponent p f hf i)) ^ sigma.u i) =
    niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
      (s.sum fun i ↦ (sigma.u i : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) *
        niveauOneFundamentalExponent p f hf i)
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi,
        AddChar.map_add_eq_mul, ih]
      rw [← AddChar.map_nsmul_eq_pow]
      congr 1
      simp [nsmul_eq_mul]

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoCharacterProduct_eq_exponentCharacter
statement:
theorem niveauTwoCharacterProduct_eq_exponentCharacter {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) :
    niveauTwoCharacterProduct hp hf chars sigma J =
      niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars (niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J)
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun i ↦ i ∈ J)
  change s.prod (fun i ↦
      (niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars
        (niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf i)) ^ sigma.periodicU hf i) =
    niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars
      (s.sum fun i ↦ (sigma.periodicU hf i : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf i)
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi,
        AddChar.map_add_eq_mul, ih]
      rw [← AddChar.map_nsmul_eq_pow]
      congr 1
      simp [nsmul_eq_mul]

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoExponentCharacter_liftQPlusOne
statement:
theorem niveauTwoExponentCharacter_liftQPlusOne {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A) (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
    niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars (liftQPlusOne p f t) =
      chars.niveauTwoBase ^ ((p ^ f + 1) * t.val)
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (p ^ (2 * f) - 1) := ⟨by
    have : 1 < p ^ (2 * f) := one_lt_pow₀ (by omega) (by omega)
    omega⟩
  ext g
  change (chars.niveauTwoBase g) ^ (liftQPlusOne p f t).val =
    (chars.niveauTwoBase g) ^ ((p ^ f + 1) * t.val)
  rw [liftQPlusOne, ZMod.val_natCast]
  exact (pow_eq_pow_mod ((p ^ f + 1) * t.val) (chars.niveauTwo_period g)).symm

name: KLSposet.niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne
statement:
theorem niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A) (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
    niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars t =
      niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars (liftQPlusOne p f t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauTwoExponentCharacter_liftQPlusOne]
  ext g
  change (chars.niveauOneBase g) ^ t.val =
    (chars.niveauTwoBase g) ^ ((p ^ f + 1) * t.val)
  rw [pow_mul, chars.niveauTwo_norm]

name: KLSposet.profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents
statement:
theorem profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J : Profile f) :
    profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma J =
      realizeOrderedCharacterExponents hp hf chars
        (profileCharacterExponents hf sigma J)
proof:
:= by
  cases J with
  | niveauOne J =>
      simp only [profileCharacterPair, profileCharacterExponents,
        realizeOrderedCharacterExponents]
      congr 1
      · change chars.niveauOneBase ^ sigma.t.val *
            niveauOneCharacterProduct hp hf chars sigma J =
          niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
            (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J)
        rw [niveauOneCharacterProduct_eq_exponentCharacter,
          AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
        rfl
      · change chars.niveauOneBase ^ sigma.t.val *
            niveauOneCharacterProduct hp hf chars sigma Jᶜ =
          niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
            (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ)
        rw [niveauOneCharacterProduct_eq_exponentCharacter,
          AddChar.map_add_eq_mul]
        rfl
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      simp only [profileCharacterPair, profileCharacterExponents,
        realizeOrderedCharacterExponents]
      congr 1
      · change chars.niveauTwoBase ^ ((p ^ f + 1) * sigma.t.val) *
            niveauTwoCharacterProduct hp hf chars sigma J =
          niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars
            (liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma J)
        rw [niveauTwoCharacterProduct_eq_exponentCharacter,
          AddChar.map_add_eq_mul, niveauTwoExponentCharacter_liftQPlusOne]
      · change chars.niveauTwoBase ^ ((p ^ f + 1) * sigma.t.val) *
            niveauTwoCharacterProduct hp hf chars sigma Jᶜ =
          niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars
            (liftQPlusOne p f sigma.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ)
        rw [niveauTwoCharacterProduct_eq_exponentCharacter,
          AddChar.map_add_eq_mul, niveauTwoExponentCharacter_liftQPlusOne]

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J J' : Set (ZMod f))
    (h : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne J')) :
    profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauOne J')
proof:
:= by
  have hreal :
      realizeOrderedCharacterExponents hp hf chars
          (profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne J)) =
        realizeOrderedCharacterExponents hp hf chars
          (profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauOne J')) := by
    rw [← profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J),
      ← profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauOne J')]
    exact h
  apply congrArg₂ OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauOne
  · apply chars.niveauOneExactOrder
    exact congrArg OrderedCharacterPair.left hreal
  · apply chars.niveauOneExactOrder
    exact congrArg OrderedCharacterPair.right hreal

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f)
    (J J' : Set (ZMod (2 * f)))
    (hJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ i + f ∉ J) (hJ' : ∀ i, i ∈ J' ↔ i + f ∉ J')
    (h : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo J' hJ')) :
    profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ) =
      profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauTwo J' hJ')
proof:
:= by
  have hreal :
      realizeOrderedCharacterExponents hp hf chars
          (profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ)) =
        realizeOrderedCharacterExponents hp hf chars
          (profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauTwo J' hJ')) := by
    rw [← profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents hp hf chars sigma (.niveauTwo J hJ),
      ← profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo J' hJ')]
    exact h
  apply congrArg₂ OrderedCharacterExponents.niveauTwo
  · apply chars.niveauTwo_exactOrder
    exact congrArg OrderedCharacterPair.left hreal
  · apply chars.niveauTwo_exactOrder
    exact congrArg OrderedCharacterPair.right hreal

name: KLSposet.crossNiveauProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq
statement:
theorem crossNiveauProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A] (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K)
    (h : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)) :
    liftQPlusOne p f (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) =
        liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K ∧
      liftQPlusOne p f (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) =
        liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ
proof:
:= by
  have hreal :
      realizeOrderedCharacterExponents hp hf chars
          (profileCharacterExponents hf sigma (.niveauOne J)) =
        realizeOrderedCharacterExponents hp hf chars
          (profileCharacterExponents hf sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)) := by
    rw [← profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J),
      ← profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)]
    exact h
  constructor
  · apply chars.niveauTwo_exactOrder
    have hleft := congrArg OrderedCharacterPair.left hreal
    change niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) =
      niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars
        (liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K) at hleft
    rw [niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne] at hleft
    exact hleft
  · apply chars.niveauTwo_exactOrder
    have hright := congrArg OrderedCharacterPair.right hreal
    change niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
        (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) =
      niveauTwoExponentCharacter hp hf chars
        (liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ) at hright
    rw [niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne] at hright
    exact hright

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_nat
statement:
theorem niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_nat (p f : Nat) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hf : 2 ≤ f) (i : ZMod (2 * f)) (n : Nat) :
    (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ n *
        niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (i + (n : ZMod (2 * f))) =
      niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf i
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      have hindex :
          i + ((n + 1 : Nat) : ZMod (2 * f)) =
            (i + (n : ZMod (2 * f))) + 1 := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [hindex, pow_succ]
      calc
        (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ n * p *
              niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf
                (i + (n : ZMod (2 * f)) + 1) =
            (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ n *
              ((p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
                niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf
                  (i + (n : ZMod (2 * f)) + 1)) := by ring
        _ = (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ n *
              niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf
                (i + (n : ZMod (2 * f))) := by
              rw [niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_succ p f hp hf]
        _ = niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf i := ih

name: KLSposet.periodicIndex_add_half
statement:
theorem periodicIndex_add_half {f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (i : ZMod (2 * f)) : periodicIndex hf (i + f) = periodicIndex hf i
proof:
:= by
  rw [periodicIndex_eq_castHom, periodicIndex_eq_castHom]
  simp

name: KLSposet.niveauTwoProfileSum_mul_power_eq_compl
statement:
theorem niveauTwoProfileSum_mul_power_eq_compl {p f : Nat}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K) :
    (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f *
        niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma Kᶜ =
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma K
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (2 * f) := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  let e : Equiv.Perm (ZMod (2 * f)) := Equiv.addRight (f : ZMod (2 * f))
  rw [niveauTwoProfileSum, niveauTwoProfileSum, Finset.mul_sum]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_equiv e
  · intro i
    simpa [e] using hK i
  · intro i hi
    change
      (sigma.periodicU hf i : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
          niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf i =
        (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f *
          ((sigma.periodicU hf (i + f) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (i + f))
    have hperiodic : sigma.periodicU hf (i + f) = sigma.periodicU hf i := by
      simp only [PhantomWeight.periodicU]
      rw [periodicIndex_add_half hf]
    rw [hperiodic]
    have hexp := niveauTwoFundamentalExponent_add_nat p f hp hf i f
    calc
      (sigma.periodicU hf i : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf i =
          (sigma.periodicU hf i : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
            ((p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f *
              niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (i + f)) := by rw [hexp]
      _ = (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f *
          ((sigma.periodicU hf i : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) *
            niveauTwoFundamentalExponent p f hf (i + f)) := by ring

name: KLSposet.power_mul_liftQPlusOne
statement:
theorem power_mul_liftQPlusOne {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (_hf : 1 ≤ f)
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
    (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f * liftQPlusOne p f t =
      liftQPlusOne p f t
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero (p ^ (2 * f) - 1) := ⟨by
    have : 1 < p ^ (2 * f) := one_lt_pow₀ (by omega) (by omega)
    omega⟩
  have hpower : (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ (2 * f) = 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_pow]
    have hone : 1 ≤ p ^ (2 * f) := one_le_pow₀ (by omega)
    have hnat : p ^ (2 * f) = (p ^ (2 * f) - 1) + 1 :=
      (Nat.sub_add_cancel hone).symm
    calc
      ((p ^ (2 * f) : Nat) : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) =
          ((p ^ (2 * f) - 1) + 1 : Nat) :=
        congrArg (fun n : Nat ↦ (n : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1))) hnat
      _ = 1 := by rw [Nat.cast_add, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_add, Nat.cast_one]
  have hsquare :
      (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f *
          (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_add, show f + f = 2 * f by omega, hpower]
  simp only [liftQPlusOne, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
    Nat.cast_pow]
  calc
    (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f *
          (((p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f + 1) * t.val) =
        (((p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f *
            (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f) +
          (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f) * t.val := by ring
    _ = (1 + (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f) * t.val := by rw [hsquare]
    _ = ((p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f + 1) * t.val := by ring

name: KLSposet.crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_isScalar
statement:
theorem crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_isScalar {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K)
    (hpair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)) :
    (profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J)).IsScalar
proof:
:= by
  rcases crossNiveauProfileCharacterExponents_eq_of_pair_eq hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' J K hK hpair with ⟨hleft, hright⟩
  let q : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1) := (p : ZMod (p ^ (2 * f) - 1)) ^ f
  have ht : q * liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t = liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t :=
    power_mul_liftQPlusOne (by omega) (by omega) sigma'.t
  have hsourceRight :
      q * liftQPlusOne p f (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) =
        liftQPlusOne p f (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) :=
    power_mul_liftQPlusOne (by omega) (by omega) _
  have hsum : q * niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ =
      niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K :=
    niveauTwoProfileSum_mul_power_eq_compl (by omega) hf sigma' K hK
  have hrel :
      q * (liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ) =
        liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K := by
    rw [mul_add, ht, hsum]
  have hexp :
      liftQPlusOne p f (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) =
        liftQPlusOne p f (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) := by
    calc
      liftQPlusOne p f (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) =
          liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' K := hleft
      _ = q * (liftQPlusOne p f sigma'.t + niveauTwoProfileSum hf sigma' Kᶜ) :=
        hrel.symm
      _ = q * liftQPlusOne p f
          (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) := by rw [hright]
      _ = liftQPlusOne p f
          (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) := hsourceRight
  have hbase :
      sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J =
        sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ := by
    have hchar : niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
          (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) =
        niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
          (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ) := by
      rw [niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne,
        niveauOneExponentCharacter_eq_niveauTwo_liftQPlusOne, hexp]
    apply chars.niveauOneExactOrder
    exact hchar
  rw [profileCharacterPair_eq_realize_exponents]
  change niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
      (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J) =
    niveauOneExponentCharacter hp hf chars
      (sigma.t + niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma Jᶜ)
  rw [hbase]

name: KLSposet.crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_eq_implies_scalar
statement:
theorem crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_eq_implies_scalar {p f : Nat}
    {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) (J : Set (ZMod f))
    (K : Set (ZMod (2 * f))) (hK : ∀ i, i ∈ K ↔ i + f ∉ K)
    (hpair : profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J) =
      profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)) :
    (profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma (.niveauOne J)).IsScalar ∧
      (profileCharacterPair hp hf chars sigma' (.niveauTwo K hK)).IsScalar
proof:
:= by
  have hscalar := crossNiveauProfileCharacterPair_isScalar hp hf chars
    sigma sigma' J K hK hpair
  exact ⟨hscalar, by simpa only [hpair] using hscalar⟩

name: KLSposet.semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_invertibleStep
statement:
theorem semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_invertibleStep
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    {sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f}
    (hStep : PhantomWeight.InvertibleStep (by omega) hf sigma tau) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma =
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars tau
proof:
:= by
  rcases hStep with ⟨j, valid, huj, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, valid, huj1, rfl⟩
  · apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact mu_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset hp hf chars sigma j valid
    · rcases sigma.nu_mu_inverse (by omega) hf j huj valid.2 with
        ⟨_validMu, validNu, hInverse⟩
      have hSubset := nu_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset hp hf chars
        (sigma.mu hf j valid) j validNu
      simpa only [hInverse] using hSubset
  · apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact nu_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset hp hf chars sigma j valid
    · rcases sigma.mu_nu_inverse (by omega) hf j valid huj1 with
        ⟨_validNu, validMu, hInverse⟩
      have hSubset := mu_semisimpleCharacterSet_subset hp hf chars
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid) j validMu
      simpa only [hInverse] using hSubset

name: KLSposet.semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_equivalent
statement:
theorem semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_equivalent
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    {sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f}
    (hEquivalent : PhantomWeight.Equivalent (by omega) hf sigma tau) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma =
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars tau
proof:
:= by
  induction hEquivalent with
  | rel sigma tau hStep =>
      exact semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_invertibleStep hp hf chars hStep
  | refl sigma => rfl
  | symm sigma tau _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans sigma tau upsilon _ _ ihSigmaTau ihTauUpsilon =>
      exact ihSigmaTau.trans ihTauUpsilon

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileSum_steinberg_eq_barsottiTate_predecessorShift
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_steinberg_eq_barsottiTate_predecessorShift
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) :
    niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t) J =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf (PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t)
        {i | i + 1 ∈ J}
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  rw [niveauOneProfileSum, niveauOneProfileSum]
  symm
  let e : Equiv.Perm (ZMod f) := Equiv.addRight (1 : ZMod f)
  apply Finset.sum_equiv e
  · intro i
    simp [e]
  · intro i hi
    simp only [PhantomWeight.barsottiTate, PhantomWeight.steinberg,
      PhantomWeight.constantWeight, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]
    exact (niveauOneFundamentalExponent_succ p f (by omega) hf i).symm

statement:

name: KLSposet.niveauOneProfileSum_barsottiTate_eq_steinberg_successorShift
statement:
theorem niveauOneProfileSum_barsottiTate_eq_steinberg_successorShift
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
    (J : Set (ZMod f)) :
