name: KLSposet.profileCharacterExponents_steinberg_eq_barsottiTate_predecessorShift
statement:
theorem profileCharacterExponents_steinberg_eq_barsottiTate_predecessorShift
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1))
    (J : Profile f) :
    profileCharacterExponents hf (PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t) J =
      profileCharacterExponents hf
        (PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t) J.predecessorShift
proof:
:= by
  cases J with
  | niveauOne J =>
      simp only [profileCharacterExponents, Profile.predecessorShift,
        PhantomWeight.steinberg, PhantomWeight.barsottiTate, PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
      congr 2
      · exact niveauOneProfileSum_steinberg_eq_barsottiTate_predecessorShift hp hf t J
      · simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq] using
          niveauOneProfileSum_steinberg_eq_barsottiTate_predecessorShift hp hf t Jᶜ
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      simp only [profileCharacterExponents, Profile.predecessorShift,
        PhantomWeight.steinberg, PhantomWeight.barsottiTate, PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
      congr 2
      · exact niveauTwoProfileSum_steinberg_eq_barsottiTate_predecessorShift hp hf t J
      · simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq] using
          niveauTwoProfileSum_steinberg_eq_barsottiTate_predecessorShift hp hf t Jᶜ

statement:

      · exact niveauOneProfileSum_barsottiTate_eq_steinberg_successorShift hp hf t J
      · simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq] using
          niveauOneProfileSum_barsottiTate_eq_steinberg_successorShift hp hf t Jᶜ
  | niveauTwo J hJ =>
      simp only [profileCharacterExponents, Profile.successorShift,
        PhantomWeight.steinberg, PhantomWeight.barsottiTate, PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
      congr 2
      · exact niveauTwoProfileSum_barsottiTate_eq_steinberg_successorShift hp hf t J

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.eq_of_equivalent_of_all_coordinates_positive
statement:
theorem eq_of_equivalent_of_all_coordinates_positive
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    {sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f}
    (hEquivalent : Equivalent hp hf sigma tau)
    (hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < sigma.u i) : sigma = tau
proof:
:= by
  let AllPositive : PhantomWeight p f → Prop := fun rho => ∀ i, 0 < rho.u i
  have hIsolated : ∀ {rho rho' : PhantomWeight p f},
      Equivalent hp hf rho rho' →
        (AllPositive rho → rho = rho') ∧ (AllPositive rho' → rho = rho') := by
    intro rho rho' h
    induction h with
    | rel rho rho' hStep =>
        constructor
        · intro hPos
          dsimp only [AllPositive] at hPos
          rcases hStep with
            ⟨j, valid, huj, hTarget⟩ | ⟨j, valid, huj1, hTarget⟩
          · rcases valid with ⟨huPositive, huNext⟩
            have := hPos (j + 1)
            omega
          · have := hPos j
            change rho.u j = 0 at valid
            omega
        · intro hPos
          dsimp only [AllPositive] at hPos
          rcases hStep with ⟨j, valid, huj, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, valid, huj1, rfl⟩
          · have hZero : (rho.mu hf j valid).u j = 0 := by
              simp [mu, huj]
            have := hPos j
            omega
          · have hZero : (rho.nu hp hf j valid).u (j + 1) = 0 := by
              have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
                intro h
                have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
                  rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
                  omega
                apply hone
                calc
                  (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
                  _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
              simp [nu, hsucc, huj1]
            have := hPos (j + 1)
            omega
    | refl rho => exact ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
    | symm rho rho' h ih =>
        exact ⟨fun hPos => (ih.2 hPos).symm, fun hPos => (ih.1 hPos).symm⟩
    | trans rho rho' rho'' h1 h2 ih1 ih2 =>
        constructor
        · intro hPos
          have hEq1 := ih1.1 hPos
          subst rho'
          exact ih2.1 hPos
        · intro hPos
          have hEq2 := ih2.2 hPos
          subst rho''
          exact ih1.2 hPos
  exact (hIsolated hEquivalent).1 hPositive

name: KLSposet.Pinning.key
statement:
theorem key
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty) (hNe : sigma ≠ sigma')
    (hNotSpecial : ∀ t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1),
      ¬ ((sigma = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t) ∨
          (sigma = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t))) :
    KeyOutcome pin hEmpty
proof:
:= by
  have hPrelim := pin.preliminaries hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe
  have hCase := pin.pinnedEmptyCarry_sixCases hEmpty hNe
  cases hCase with
  | positive hCarry =>
      rcases hPrelim.1 hCarry with ⟨t, hPair | hSpecial⟩
      · exact .positive hCarry t hPair.1 hPair.2
      · exact False.elim (hNotSpecial t (Or.inl hSpecial))
  | positiveBoundaryPositive j hPrev hCurrent huPositive =>
      rcases hPrelim.2.1 j hPrev hCurrent with
        ⟨length, _hPositive, _hEnd, hZero⟩
      have huNext : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 := by
        simpa using hZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)
      let valid : sigma.MuValid j := ⟨huPositive, huNext⟩
      have hSupport := pin.pa_mu_support_subset_of_minimalPositiveBoundary
        hp3 hpOdd hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe j hPrev hCurrent huPositive
      exact .positiveBoundaryPositive j hPrev hCurrent huPositive valid (by
        simpa only [valid] using hSupport)
  | positiveBoundaryZero j hPrev hCurrent huZero =>
      rcases hPrelim.2.1 j hPrev hCurrent with
        ⟨length, _hPositive, _hEnd, hZero⟩
      have huNext : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 := by
        simpa using hZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)
      let valid : sigma.ThetaValid j := ⟨by omega, huNext⟩
      have hSupport := pin.pb_theta_support_subset_of_minimalPositiveBoundary
        hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe j hPrev hCurrent huZero
      exact .positiveBoundaryZero j hPrev hCurrent huZero valid (by
        simpa only [valid] using hSupport)
  | negativeBoundaryReachesPositive hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent hString =>
      rcases hString with ⟨length, hInterval, hEndpointPositive⟩
      let start : ZMod f := j - 1
      have hIndex (k : Nat) :
          start + (k + 1 : Nat) = j + (k : ZMod f) := by
        dsimp only [start]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hOperationIndex : start + (length + 1 : Nat) =
          j + (length : ZMod f) := hIndex length
      have hEndpointIndex : start + (length + 2 : Nat) =
          j + (length + 1 : Nat) := by
        simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using hIndex (length + 1)
      have hZero : sigma.u (j + (length : ZMod f)) = 0 :=
        (hInterval length (by omega)).2
      let valid : sigma.NuValid (j + (length : ZMod f)) := hZero
      have hEndpointCoord : j + (length : ZMod f) + 1 =
          j + (length + 1 : Nat) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      have hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
          pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
            (start + (k : ZMod f)) ≠ 0 := by
        intro k hkLower hkUpper
        let n := k - 1
        have hkEq : k = n + 1 := by
          dsimp only [n]
          omega
        have hnUpper : n ≤ length := by
          dsimp only [n]
          omega
        rw [hkEq, hIndex]
        exact ne_of_lt (hInterval n hnUpper).1
      have hValidNoninvertible :
          PhantomOperation.ValidNoninvertible .nu sigma
            (j + (length : ZMod f)) :=
        pin.negativeStringEnd_nu_validNoninvertible hEmpty hMinimal
          (j + (length : ZMod f)) hZero (hInterval length (by omega)).1
      have hEndpointStrict : sigma.u (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) < p := by
        have hUpper := sigma.u_le (j + (length + 1 : Nat))
        have hNotP : sigma.u (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) ≠ p := by
          intro hP
          apply hValidNoninvertible.2
          exact ⟨hZero, by simpa only [hEndpointCoord] using hP⟩
        omega
      have hEndpointPositive' :
          0 < sigma.u (j + ((length + 1 : Nat) : ZMod f)) := by
        simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hEndpointPositive
      have hSupport := pin.na_nu_support_subset hp3 hpOdd hsubset start
        (by simpa only [start] using hPrev)
        (by
          intro k hkLower hkUpper
          exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hAllNonpositive (start + (k : ZMod f)))
            (hBaseNonzero k hkLower hkUpper))
        (by rw [hEndpointIndex]; exact hAllNonpositive _)
        (by
          intro i hi
          rw [hIndex]
          exact (hInterval i hi).2)
        (by
          rw [hEndpointIndex]
          simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hEndpointPositive)
        (by rw [hEndpointIndex]; exact hEndpointStrict)
      exact .negativeBoundaryReachesPositive hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent
        length hInterval hEndpointPositive' valid (by
          simpa only [valid, hOperationIndex] using hSupport)
  | negativeBoundaryNoPositive hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent hNoString =>
      let valid : sigma.ThetaValid j :=
        pin.nbMinimalThetaValid hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe
          hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent hNoString
      have hSupport :=
        pin.nb_theta_support_subset_of_minimalNegativeBoundaryNoPositive
          hp3 hpOdd hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe
          (.negativeBoundaryNoPositive hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent
            hNoString) hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent hNoString
      exact .negativeBoundaryNoPositive hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent
        hNoString valid (by simpa only [valid] using hSupport)
  | negative hCarry =>
      rcases hPrelim.2.2.2 hCarry with ⟨t, hPair | hSpecial⟩
      · exact .negative hCarry t hPair.1 hPair.2
      · exact False.elim (hNotSpecial t (Or.inr hSpecial))

name: KLSposet.Pinning.key_all_cases
statement:
theorem key_all_cases
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hsubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty) (hNe : sigma ≠ sigma')
    (hNotSpecial : ∀ t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1),
      ¬ ((sigma = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t) ∨
          (sigma = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t))) :
    KeyConclusions pin hEmpty
proof:
:= by
  have hPrelim := pin.preliminaries hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe
  refine
    { positive := ?_
      positiveBoundaryPositive := ?_
      positiveBoundaryZero := ?_
      negativeBoundaryReachesPositive := ?_
      negativeBoundaryNoPositive := ?_
      negative := ?_
      exhaustive := pin.pinnedEmptyCarry_sixCases hEmpty hNe }
  · intro hCarry
    rcases hPrelim.1 hCarry with ⟨t, hPair | hSpecial⟩
    · exact ⟨t, hPair⟩
    · exact False.elim (hNotSpecial t (Or.inl hSpecial))
  · intro j hPrev hCurrent huPositive
    rcases hPrelim.2.1 j hPrev hCurrent with
      ⟨length, _hPositive, _hEnd, hZero⟩
    have huNext : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 := by
      simpa using hZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)
    let valid : sigma.MuValid j := ⟨huPositive, huNext⟩
    refine ⟨valid, ?_⟩
    have hSupport := pin.pa_mu_support_subset_of_minimalPositiveBoundary
      hp3 hpOdd hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe j hPrev hCurrent huPositive
    simpa only [valid] using hSupport
  · intro j hPrev hCurrent huZero
    rcases hPrelim.2.1 j hPrev hCurrent with
      ⟨length, _hPositive, _hEnd, hZero⟩
    have huNext : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 := by
      simpa using hZero 1 (by omega) (by omega)
    let valid : sigma.ThetaValid j := ⟨by omega, huNext⟩
    refine ⟨valid, ?_⟩
    have hSupport := pin.pb_theta_support_subset_of_minimalPositiveBoundary
      hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe j hPrev hCurrent huZero
    simpa only [valid] using hSupport
  · intro hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent length hInterval
      hEndpointPositive
    let start : ZMod f := j - 1
    have hIndex (k : Nat) :
        start + (k + 1 : Nat) = j + (k : ZMod f) := by
      dsimp only [start]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hOperationIndex : start + (length + 1 : Nat) =
        j + (length : ZMod f) := hIndex length
    have hEndpointIndex : start + (length + 2 : Nat) =
        j + (length + 1 : Nat) := by
      simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using hIndex (length + 1)
    have hZero : sigma.u (j + (length : ZMod f)) = 0 :=
      (hInterval length (by omega)).2
    let valid : sigma.NuValid (j + (length : ZMod f)) := hZero
    have hEndpointCoord : j + (length : ZMod f) + 1 =
        j + (length + 1 : Nat) := by
      push_cast
      ring
    have hBaseNonzero : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ length + 1 →
        pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (start + (k : ZMod f)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro k hkLower hkUpper
      let n := k - 1
      have hkEq : k = n + 1 := by
        dsimp only [n]
        omega
      have hnUpper : n ≤ length := by
        dsimp only [n]
        omega
      rw [hkEq, hIndex]
      exact ne_of_lt (hInterval n hnUpper).1
    have hValidNoninvertible :
        PhantomOperation.ValidNoninvertible .nu sigma
          (j + (length : ZMod f)) :=
      pin.negativeStringEnd_nu_validNoninvertible hEmpty hMinimal
        (j + (length : ZMod f)) hZero (hInterval length (by omega)).1
    have hEndpointStrict : sigma.u (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) < p := by
      have hUpper := sigma.u_le (j + (length + 1 : Nat))
      have hNotP : sigma.u (j + (length + 1 : Nat)) ≠ p := by
        intro hP
        apply hValidNoninvertible.2
        exact ⟨hZero, by simpa only [hEndpointCoord] using hP⟩
      omega
    have hSupport := pin.na_nu_support_subset hp3 hpOdd hsubset start
      (by simpa only [start] using hPrev)
      (by
        intro k hkLower hkUpper
        exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hAllNonpositive (start + (k : ZMod f)))
          (hBaseNonzero k hkLower hkUpper))
      (by rw [hEndpointIndex]; exact hAllNonpositive _)
      (by
        intro i hi
        rw [hIndex]
        exact (hInterval i hi).2)
      (by
        rw [hEndpointIndex]
        simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hEndpointPositive)
      (by rw [hEndpointIndex]; exact hEndpointStrict)
    refine ⟨valid, ?_⟩
    simpa only [valid, hOperationIndex] using hSupport
  · intro hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent hNoString
    let valid : sigma.ThetaValid j :=
      pin.nbMinimalThetaValid hp3 hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe
        hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent hNoString
    refine ⟨valid, ?_⟩
    have hSupport :=
      pin.nb_theta_support_subset_of_minimalNegativeBoundaryNoPositive
        hp3 hpOdd hsubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe
        (.negativeBoundaryNoPositive hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent
          hNoString) hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent hNoString
    simpa only [valid] using hSupport
  · intro hCarry
    rcases hPrelim.2.2.2 hCarry with ⟨t, hPair | hSpecial⟩
    · exact ⟨t, hPair⟩
    · exact False.elim (hNotSpecial t (Or.inr hSpecial))

name: KLSposet.Pinning.eq_or_barsottiTate_steinberg_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq
statement:
theorem eq_or_barsottiTate_steinberg_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f} {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    {sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f}
    (pin : Pinning hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p)
    (hEq : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma =
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma')
    (hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles hp hf chars sigma sigma')
    (hMinimal : pin.IsMinimal hEmpty) :
    sigma = sigma' ∨
      ∃ t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1),
        (sigma = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t) ∨
          (sigma = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hNe : sigma = sigma'
  · exact Or.inl hNe
  right
  by_cases hSpecial : ∃ t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1),
      (sigma = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t ∧
          sigma' = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t) ∨
        (sigma = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t ∧
          sigma' = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t)
  · exact hSpecial
  have hSubset : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma' := by
    rw [hEq]
  have hNotSpecial (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
      ¬ ((sigma = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t) ∨
          (sigma = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t)) := by
    intro ht
    exact hSpecial ⟨t, ht⟩
  have hOutcome := pin.key hp3 hpOdd hSubset hEmpty hMinimal hNe hNotSpecial
  cases hOutcome with
  | positive hCarry t hSource hTarget =>
      exfalso
      have hStrict := unramified_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset_critical
        hp3 hf chars t
      have hBack : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
          (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) ⊆
        semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
          (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t) := by
        rw [← hTarget, ← hSource, hEq]
      exact (Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp hStrict).2
        (Set.Subset.antisymm hStrict.1 hBack)
  | positiveBoundaryPositive j hPrev hCurrent huPositive valid hSupport =>
      exfalso
      have hValidNoninvertible :=
        pin.positiveBoundaryPositive_mu_validNoninvertible hEmpty hMinimal j
          huPositive valid.2 hCurrent
      have hNoninvertible : sigma.u j ≠ 1 := by
        intro hOne
        exact hValidNoninvertible.2 ⟨hOne, valid.2⟩
      have hStrict := mu_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars sigma j
        valid hNoninvertible
      have hBack : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars (sigma.mu hf j valid) ⊆
          semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma := by
        simpa only [hEq] using hSupport
      exact (Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp hStrict).2
        (Set.Subset.antisymm hStrict.1 hBack)
  | positiveBoundaryZero j hPrev hCurrent huZero valid hSupport =>
      exfalso
      have hStrict := theta_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars sigma j
        valid
      have hBack : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars (sigma.theta hf j valid) ⊆
          semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma := by
        simpa only [hEq] using hSupport
      exact (Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp hStrict).2
        (Set.Subset.antisymm hStrict.1 hBack)
  | negativeBoundaryReachesPositive hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent length
      hInterval hEndpointPositive valid hSupport =>
      exfalso
      have hCurrentAtEnd : pin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hEmpty
          (j + (length : ZMod f)) < 0 := (hInterval length (by omega)).1
      have hValidNoninvertible := pin.negativeStringEnd_nu_validNoninvertible
        hEmpty hMinimal (j + (length : ZMod f)) valid hCurrentAtEnd
      have hNoninvertible : sigma.u (j + (length : ZMod f) + 1) ≠ p := by
        intro hP
        exact hValidNoninvertible.2 ⟨valid, hP⟩
      have hStrict := nu_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars sigma
        (j + (length : ZMod f)) valid hNoninvertible
      have hBack : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
          (sigma.nu (by omega) hf (j + (length : ZMod f)) valid) ⊆
          semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma := by
        simpa only [hEq] using hSupport
      exact (Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp hStrict).2
        (Set.Subset.antisymm hStrict.1 hBack)
  | negativeBoundaryNoPositive hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent hNoString valid
      hSupport =>
      exfalso
      have hStrict := theta_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars sigma j
        valid
      have hBack : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars (sigma.theta hf j valid) ⊆
          semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma := by
        simpa only [hEq] using hSupport
      exact (Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp hStrict).2
        (Set.Subset.antisymm hStrict.1 hBack)
  | negative hCarry t hSource hTarget =>
      exfalso
      have hStrict := unramified_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset_critical
        hp3 hf chars t
      have hBack : semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
          (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) ⊆
        semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars
          (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t) := by
        rw [← hTarget, ← hSource, hEq]
      exact (Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mp hStrict).2
        (Set.Subset.antisymm hStrict.1 hBack)

name: KLSposet.semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_iff_equivalent_or_barsottiTate_steinberg
statement:
theorem semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_iff_equivalent_or_barsottiTate_steinberg
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma sigma' : PhantomWeight p f) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma =
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma' ↔
      PhantomWeight.Equivalent (by omega) hf sigma sigma' ∨
        ∃ t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1),
          (sigma = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t ∧
              sigma' = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t) ∨
            (sigma = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t ∧
              sigma' = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hEq
    have hSubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma' := by
      rw [hEq]
    let pin : Pinning (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma' :=
      canonicalPinning (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma'
    have hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
        compatibleProfiles (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma' :=
      niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
        hSubset ∅
    rcases pin.exists_isMinimal_after_equivalent hEmpty with
      ⟨tau, hTauSigma, minimalPin, hMinimalEmpty, hMinimal⟩
    have hTauSupport : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars tau =
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma :=
      semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_equivalent (by omega) hf chars hTauSigma
    have hTauTarget : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars tau =
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma' :=
      hTauSupport.trans hEq
    rcases minimalPin.eq_or_barsottiTate_steinberg_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq
        hp3 hpOdd hTauTarget hMinimalEmpty hMinimal with
      hLiteral | ⟨t, hForward | hReverse⟩
    · left
      have hSigmaTau :=
        (PhantomWeight.equivalent_isEquivalence (by omega) hf).symm hTauSigma
      simpa only [hLiteral] using hSigmaTau
    · right
      have hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < tau.u i := by
        intro i
        rw [hForward.1]
        simp [PhantomWeight.barsottiTate, PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
      have hTauEqSigma :=
        PhantomWeight.eq_of_equivalent_of_all_coordinates_positive
          (by omega) hf hTauSigma hPositive
      exact ⟨t, Or.inl ⟨hTauEqSigma.symm.trans hForward.1, hForward.2⟩⟩
    · right
      have hPositive : ∀ i, 0 < tau.u i := by
        intro i
        rw [hReverse.1]
        simp [PhantomWeight.steinberg, PhantomWeight.constantWeight]
        omega
      have hTauEqSigma :=
        PhantomWeight.eq_of_equivalent_of_all_coordinates_positive
          (by omega) hf hTauSigma hPositive
      exact ⟨t, Or.inr ⟨hTauEqSigma.symm.trans hReverse.1, hReverse.2⟩⟩
  · exact semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_equivalent_or_barsottiTate_steinberg
      (by omega) hf chars

name: KLSposet.simpleSupportInclusion_classification
statement:
theorem simpleSupportInclusion_classification
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (X Y : Set (OrderedCharacterPair I A))
    (hX : X ∈ semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
    (hY : Y ∈ semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
    (hSimple : SimpleInclusionIn
      (semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars) X Y) :
    SimpleSupportInclusionClassification (by omega) hf chars X Y
proof:
:= by
  rcases hX with ⟨sigma, rfl⟩
  rcases hY with ⟨sigma', rfl⟩
  have hSubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma' := hSimple.1.1
  have hSetsNe : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ≠
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma' := hSimple.1.ne
  let pin : Pinning (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    canonicalPinning (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma'
  have hEmpty : Profile.niveauOne (∅ : Set (ZMod f)) ∈
      compatibleProfiles (by omega) hf chars sigma sigma' :=
    niveauOne_mem_compatibleProfiles_of_subset hp3 hf chars sigma sigma'
      hSubset ∅
  rcases pin.exists_isMinimal_after_equivalent hEmpty with
    ⟨tau, hTauSigma, minimalPin, hMinimalEmpty, hMinimal⟩
  have hTauSupport : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars tau =
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma :=
    semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_equivalent (by omega) hf chars hTauSigma
  have hTauSubset : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars tau ⊆
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma' := by
    rw [hTauSupport]
    exact hSubset
  have hTauNe : tau ≠ sigma' := by
    intro hEq
    subst tau
    exact hSetsNe hTauSupport.symm
  have hNotSpecial (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
      ¬ ((tau = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t) ∨
          (tau = PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t ∧
            sigma' = PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t)) := by
    intro hSpecial
    have hTauTarget : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars tau =
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma' := by
      rcases hSpecial with hForward | hReverse
      · rw [hForward.1, hForward.2]
        exact barsottiTate_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_steinberg
          (by omega) hf chars t
      · rw [hReverse.1, hReverse.2]
        exact (barsottiTate_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_steinberg
          (by omega) hf chars t).symm
    exact hSetsNe (hTauSupport.symm.trans hTauTarget)
  have hIntermediate_eq_target
      (rho : PhantomWeight p f)
      (hLower : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars tau ⊂
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars rho)
      (hUpper : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars rho ⊆
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma') :
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars rho =
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma' := by
    by_contra hNe
    have hLower' : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊂
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars rho := by
      simpa only [hTauSupport] using hLower
    have hUpper' : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars rho ⊂
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma' :=
      (Set.ssubset_iff_subset_ne).2 ⟨hUpper, hNe⟩
    exact hSimple.2 (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars rho)
      ⟨rho, rfl⟩ ⟨hLower', hUpper'⟩
  have hOutcome := minimalPin.key hp3 hpOdd hTauSubset hMinimalEmpty hMinimal
    hTauNe hNotSpecial
  cases hOutcome with
  | positive hCarry t hSource hTarget =>
      exact .unramifiedCritical t
        (hTauSupport.symm.trans (congrArg
          (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars) hSource))
        (congrArg (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars) hTarget)
  | positiveBoundaryPositive j hPrev hCurrent huPositive valid hSupport =>
      have hValidNoninvertible :=
        minimalPin.positiveBoundaryPositive_mu_validNoninvertible
          hMinimalEmpty hMinimal j huPositive valid.2 hCurrent
      have hStrict := mu_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars tau j
        valid (by
          intro hOne
          exact hValidNoninvertible.2 ⟨hOne, valid.2⟩)
      exact .mu tau j valid hTauSupport.symm
        (hIntermediate_eq_target (tau.mu hf j valid) hStrict hSupport).symm
  | positiveBoundaryZero j hPrev hCurrent huZero valid hSupport =>
      have hStrict := theta_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars tau j
        valid
      exact .theta tau j valid hTauSupport.symm
        (hIntermediate_eq_target (tau.theta hf j valid) hStrict hSupport).symm
  | negativeBoundaryReachesPositive hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent length
      hInterval hEndpointPositive valid hSupport =>
      have hCurrentAtEnd : minimalPin.pinnedNiveauOneCarry ∅ hMinimalEmpty
          (j + (length : ZMod f)) < 0 := (hInterval length (by omega)).1
      have hValidNoninvertible :=
        minimalPin.negativeStringEnd_nu_validNoninvertible hMinimalEmpty hMinimal
          (j + (length : ZMod f)) valid hCurrentAtEnd
      have hStrict := nu_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars tau
        (j + (length : ZMod f)) valid (by
          intro hP
          exact hValidNoninvertible.2 ⟨valid, hP⟩)
      exact .nu tau (j + (length : ZMod f)) valid hTauSupport.symm
        (hIntermediate_eq_target
          (tau.nu (by omega) hf (j + (length : ZMod f)) valid)
          hStrict hSupport).symm
  | negativeBoundaryNoPositive hAllNonpositive j hPrev hCurrent hNoString valid
      hSupport =>
      have hStrict := theta_semisimpleCharacterSet_ssubset hp3 hf chars tau j
        valid
      exact .theta tau j valid hTauSupport.symm
        (hIntermediate_eq_target (tau.theta hf j valid) hStrict hSupport).symm
  | negative hCarry t hSource hTarget =>
      exact .unramifiedCritical t
        (hTauSupport.symm.trans (congrArg
          (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars) hSource))
        (congrArg (semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars) hTarget)

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.zeroCount_mu
statement:
theorem zeroCount_mu {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.MuValid j) :
    sigma.zeroCount hf + (if sigma.u j = 1 then 1 else 0) =
      (sigma.mu hf j valid).zeroCount hf + 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hpoint : ∀ i : ZMod f,
      (if sigma.u i = 0 then 1 else 0) +
          (if i = j then if sigma.u j = 1 then 1 else 0 else 0) =
        (if (sigma.mu hf j valid).u i = 0 then 1 else 0) +
          (if i = j + 1 then 1 else 0) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      have huZero : sigma.u j ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt valid.1
      by_cases huOne : sigma.u j = 1
      · simp [mu, hsucc.symm, huOne]
      · have huSub : sigma.u j - 1 ≠ 0 := by omega
        simp [mu, hsucc.symm, huZero, huOne, huSub]
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        have hpZero : p ≠ 0 := by omega
        simp [mu, hsucc, valid.2, hpZero]
      · simp [mu, hij, hij1]
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : ZMod f,
        ((if sigma.u i = 0 then 1 else 0) +
          (if i = j then if sigma.u j = 1 then 1 else 0 else 0))) =
        ∑ i : ZMod f, (
          (if (sigma.mu hf j valid).u i = 0 then 1 else 0) +
            (if i = j + 1 then 1 else 0)) :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _hi ↦ hpoint i)
  change ((∑ i : ZMod f, if sigma.u i = 0 then 1 else 0) +
      (if sigma.u j = 1 then 1 else 0)) =
    (∑ i : ZMod f, if (sigma.mu hf j valid).u i = 0 then 1 else 0) + 1
  simpa only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
    Finset.mem_univ, if_true] using hsum

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.zeroCount_mu_of_noninvertible
statement:
theorem zeroCount_mu_of_noninvertible {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.MuValid j)
    (hNoninvertible : sigma.u j ≠ 1) :
    sigma.zeroCount hf = (sigma.mu hf j valid).zeroCount hf + 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [if_neg hNoninvertible, add_zero] using
    sigma.zeroCount_mu hp hf j valid

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.zeroCount_mu_of_invertible
statement:
theorem zeroCount_mu_of_invertible {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.MuValid j)
    (hInvertible : sigma.u j = 1) :
    sigma.zeroCount hf = (sigma.mu hf j valid).zeroCount hf
proof:
:= by
  have hCount := sigma.zeroCount_mu hp hf j valid
  rw [if_pos hInvertible] at hCount
  omega

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.zeroCount_theta
statement:
theorem zeroCount_theta {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j) :
    sigma.zeroCount hf = (sigma.theta hf j valid).zeroCount hf + 1 +
      (if sigma.u j = 0 then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have hpoint : ∀ i : ZMod f,
      (if sigma.u i = 0 then 1 else 0) =
        (if (sigma.theta hf j valid).u i = 0 then 1 else 0) +
          (if i = j + 1 then 1 else 0) +
            (if i = j then if sigma.u j = 0 then 1 else 0 else 0) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      by_cases huZero : sigma.u j = 0
      · simp [theta, hsucc.symm, huZero]
      · simp [theta, hsucc.symm, huZero]
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        have hpZero : p ≠ 0 := by omega
        simp [theta, hsucc, valid.2, hpZero]
      · simp [theta, hij, hij1]
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : ZMod f, if sigma.u i = 0 then 1 else 0) =
        ∑ i : ZMod f, (
          (if (sigma.theta hf j valid).u i = 0 then 1 else 0) +
            (if i = j + 1 then 1 else 0) +
              (if i = j then if sigma.u j = 0 then 1 else 0 else 0)) :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _hi ↦ hpoint i)
  change (∑ i : ZMod f, if sigma.u i = 0 then 1 else 0) =
    (∑ i : ZMod f, if (sigma.theta hf j valid).u i = 0 then 1 else 0) +
      1 + (if sigma.u j = 0 then 1 else 0)
  simpa only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
    Finset.mem_univ, if_true] using hsum

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.zeroCount_nu_of_noninvertible
statement:
theorem zeroCount_nu_of_noninvertible {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.NuValid j)
    (hNoninvertible : sigma.u (j + 1) ≠ p) :
    sigma.zeroCount hf =
      (sigma.nu hp hf j valid).zeroCount hf + 1 +
        (if sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  classical
  have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
      omega
    apply hone
    calc
      (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
  have huSuccLt : sigma.u (j + 1) < p := by
    have huSuccLe := sigma.u_le (j + 1)
    omega
  have hpoint : ∀ i : ZMod f,
      (if sigma.u i = 0 then 1 else 0) =
        (if (sigma.nu hp hf j valid).u i = 0 then 1 else 0) +
          (if i = j then 1 else 0) +
            (if i = j + 1 then
              if sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 then 1 else 0 else 0) := by
    intro i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      have huZero : sigma.u j = 0 := valid
      simp [nu, huZero, hsucc.symm]
    · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        have hTargetPositive : p - sigma.u (j + 1) ≠ 0 := by omega
        have hpZero : p ≠ 0 := by omega
        by_cases huZero : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0
        · simp [nu, hsucc, huZero, hpZero]
        · simp [nu, hsucc, huZero, hTargetPositive]
      · simp [nu, hij, hij1]
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : ZMod f, if sigma.u i = 0 then 1 else 0) =
        ∑ i : ZMod f, (
          (if (sigma.nu hp hf j valid).u i = 0 then 1 else 0) +
            (if i = j then 1 else 0) +
              (if i = j + 1 then
                if sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 then 1 else 0 else 0)) :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _hi ↦ hpoint i)
  change (∑ i : ZMod f, if sigma.u i = 0 then 1 else 0) =
    (∑ i : ZMod f, if (sigma.nu hp hf j valid).u i = 0 then 1 else 0) +
      1 + (if sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 then 1 else 0)
  simpa only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
    Finset.mem_univ, if_true] using hsum

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.zeroCount_nu_of_invertible
statement:
theorem zeroCount_nu_of_invertible {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.NuValid j)
    (hInvertible : sigma.u (j + 1) = p) :
    sigma.zeroCount hf = (sigma.nu hp hf j valid).zeroCount hf
proof:
:= by
  rcases sigma.mu_nu_inverse hp hf j valid hInvertible with
    ⟨validNu, validMu, hInverse⟩
  have hValidEq : validNu = valid := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  cases hValidEq
  have huZero : sigma.u j = 0 := valid
  have hTargetOne : (sigma.nu hp hf j valid).u j = 1 := by
    simp [nu, huZero]
  have hCount := (sigma.nu hp hf j valid).zeroCount_mu_of_invertible
    hp hf j validMu hTargetOne
  rw [hInverse] at hCount
  exact hCount.symm

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.zeroCount_eq_of_equivalent
statement:
theorem zeroCount_eq_of_equivalent {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    {sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f} (hEquivalent : Equivalent hp hf sigma tau) :
    sigma.zeroCount hf = tau.zeroCount hf
proof:
:= by
  induction hEquivalent with
  | rel sigma tau hStep =>
      rcases hStep with ⟨j, valid, huj, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, valid, huj1, rfl⟩
      · exact sigma.zeroCount_mu_of_invertible hp hf j valid huj
      · exact sigma.zeroCount_nu_of_invertible hp hf j valid huj1
  | refl sigma => rfl
  | symm sigma tau _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans sigma tau upsilon _ _ ihSigmaTau ihTauUpsilon =>
      exact ihSigmaTau.trans ihTauUpsilon

name: KLSposet.zeroCount_eq_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq
statement:
theorem zeroCount_eq_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hEq : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma =
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars tau) :
    sigma.zeroCount hf = tau.zeroCount hf
proof:
:= by
  rcases (semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_iff_equivalent_or_barsottiTate_steinberg
      hp3 hpOdd hf chars sigma tau).mp hEq with
    hEquivalent | ⟨t, hForward | hReverse⟩
  · exact PhantomWeight.zeroCount_eq_of_equivalent (by omega) hf hEquivalent
  · rw [hForward.1, hForward.2]
    have hpZero : p ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp [PhantomWeight.zeroCount, PhantomWeight.barsottiTate,
      PhantomWeight.steinberg, PhantomWeight.constantWeight, hpZero]
  · rw [hReverse.1, hReverse.2]
    have hpZero : p ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp [PhantomWeight.zeroCount, PhantomWeight.barsottiTate,
      PhantomWeight.steinberg, PhantomWeight.constantWeight, hpZero]

name: KLSposet.semisimpleSupportRepresentative_spec
statement:
theorem semisimpleSupportRepresentative_spec
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    {hp : 2 ≤ p} {hf : 2 ≤ f}
    {chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A}
    (Y : SemisimpleSupportSet hp hf chars) :
    semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars (semisimpleSupportRepresentative Y) =
      Y.1
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec Y.property

name: KLSposet.semisimpleSupportZeroCount_eq
statement:
theorem semisimpleSupportZeroCount_eq
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (Y : SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f)
    (hSigma : Y.1 = semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma) :
    semisimpleSupportZeroCount Y = sigma.zeroCount hf
proof:
:= by
  apply zeroCount_eq_of_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars
  exact (semisimpleSupportRepresentative_spec Y).trans hSigma

name: KLSposet.semisimpleSupportZeroCount_lt_of_simpleInclusion
statement:
theorem semisimpleSupportZeroCount_lt_of_simpleInclusion
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (X Y : SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars)
    (hSimple : SimpleInclusionIn
      (semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars) X.1 Y.1) :
    semisimpleSupportZeroCount Y < semisimpleSupportZeroCount X
proof:
:= by
  have hClassification := simpleSupportInclusion_classification hp3 hpOdd hf
    chars X.1 Y.1 X.2 Y.2 hSimple
  cases hClassification with
  | mu sigma j valid hSource hTarget =>
      have hStepStrict : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊂
          semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars (sigma.mu hf j valid) := by
        simpa only [hSource, hTarget] using hSimple.1
      have hNoninvertible : sigma.u j ≠ 1 := by
        intro huOne
        have hEq := semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_invertibleStep (by omega) hf
          chars (Or.inl ⟨j, valid, huOne, rfl⟩)
        exact hStepStrict.ne hEq
      have hXCount := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars X sigma
        hSource
      have hYCount := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars Y
        (sigma.mu hf j valid) hTarget
      rw [hXCount, hYCount]
      have hCount := sigma.zeroCount_mu_of_noninvertible (by omega) hf j valid
        hNoninvertible
      omega
  | theta sigma j valid hSource hTarget =>
      have hXCount := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars X sigma
        hSource
      have hYCount := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars Y
        (sigma.theta hf j valid) hTarget
      rw [hXCount, hYCount]
      have hCount := sigma.zeroCount_theta (by omega) hf j valid
      omega
  | nu sigma j valid hSource hTarget =>
      have hStepStrict : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊂
          semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
            (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid) := by
        simpa only [hSource, hTarget] using hSimple.1
      have hNoninvertible : sigma.u (j + 1) ≠ p := by
        intro huSucc
        have hEq := semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_invertibleStep (by omega) hf
          chars (Or.inr ⟨j, valid, huSucc, rfl⟩)
        exact hStepStrict.ne hEq
      have hXCount := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars X sigma
        hSource
      have hYCount := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars Y
        (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid) hTarget
      rw [hXCount, hYCount]
      have hCount := sigma.zeroCount_nu_of_noninvertible (by omega) hf j valid
        hNoninvertible
      omega
  | unramifiedCritical t hSource hTarget =>
      have hXCount := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars X
        (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t) hSource
      have hYCount := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars Y
        (PhantomWeight.critical p f t) hTarget
      rw [hXCount, hYCount]
      have hpSubPositive : 0 < p - 1 := by omega
      simp [PhantomWeight.zeroCount, PhantomWeight.unramified,
        PhantomWeight.critical, PhantomWeight.constantWeight,
        Nat.ne_of_gt hpSubPositive]
      omega

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.finite
statement:
theorem PhantomWeight.finite {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f) :
    Finite (PhantomWeight p f)
proof:
:= by
  letI : NeZero f := ⟨by omega⟩
  letI : NeZero (p ^ f - 1) := ⟨by
    have : 1 < p ^ f := one_lt_pow₀ hp (by omega)
    omega⟩
  let encode : PhantomWeight p f →
      ((ZMod f → Fin (p + 1)) × ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) := fun sigma ↦
    (fun i ↦ ⟨sigma.u i, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (sigma.u_le i)⟩, sigma.t)
  apply Finite.of_injective encode
  intro sigma tau h
  apply PhantomWeight.ext
  · funext i
    exact Fin.ext_iff.mp (congrFun (congrArg Prod.fst h) i)
  · exact congrArg Prod.snd h

name: KLSposet.semisimpleSupportSet_finite
statement:
theorem semisimpleSupportSet_finite
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A) :
    Finite (SemisimpleSupportSet hp hf chars)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (PhantomWeight p f) := PhantomWeight.finite hp hf
  apply Finite.of_surjective
    (fun sigma : PhantomWeight p f ↦
      (⟨semisimpleCharacterSet hp hf chars sigma, ⟨sigma, rfl⟩⟩ :
        SemisimpleSupportSet hp hf chars))
  rintro ⟨Y, sigma, hSigma⟩
  refine ⟨sigma, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hSigma

name: KLSposet.simpleInclusionIn_of_covBy
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hCov.lt, ?_⟩
  intro Z hZ hBetween
  have hXZ : X < (⟨Z, hZ⟩ : SemisimpleSupportSet hp hf chars) := hBetween.1
  have hZY : (⟨Z, hZ⟩ : SemisimpleSupportSet hp hf chars) < Y := hBetween.2
  exact hCov.2 hXZ hZY

name: KLSposet.semisimpleSupportZeroCount_lt_of_properInclusion
statement:
theorem semisimpleSupportZeroCount_lt_of_properInclusion
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (X Y : SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars)
    (hProper : X.1 ⊂ Y.1) :
    semisimpleSupportZeroCount Y < semisimpleSupportZeroCount X
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars) :=
    semisimpleSupportSet_finite (by omega) hf chars
  letI : Fintype (SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI : DecidableLE (SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars) :=
    Classical.decRel _
  letI : DecidableLT (SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars) :=
    Classical.decRel _
  letI : LocallyFiniteOrder (SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars) :=
    Fintype.toLocallyFiniteOrder
  have hChain : Relation.TransGen (· ⋖ ·) X Y :=
    lt_iff_transGen_covBy.mp hProper
  induction hChain with
  | single hCov =>
      exact semisimpleSupportZeroCount_lt_of_simpleInclusion hp3 hpOdd hf chars
        _ _ (simpleInclusionIn_of_covBy hCov)
  | tail hChain hCov ih =>
      have hXB : X < _ :=
        (lt_iff_transGen_covBy (x := X) (y := _)).mpr hChain
      exact (semisimpleSupportZeroCount_lt_of_simpleInclusion hp3 hpOdd hf chars
        _ _ (simpleInclusionIn_of_covBy hCov)).trans
          (ih hXB)

name: KLSposet.zeroCount_add_two_le_of_intermediate
statement:
theorem zeroCount_add_two_le_of_intermediate
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f)
    (Z : Set (OrderedCharacterPair I A))
    (hZ : Z ∈ semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
    (hLeft : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊂ Z)
    (hRight : Z ⊂ semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars tau) :
    tau.zeroCount hf + 2 ≤ sigma.zeroCount hf
proof:
:= by
  let X : SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars :=
    ⟨semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma, ⟨sigma, rfl⟩⟩
  let W : SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars := ⟨Z, hZ⟩
  let Y : SemisimpleSupportSet (by omega) hf chars :=
    ⟨semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars tau, ⟨tau, rfl⟩⟩
  have hWX := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_lt_of_properInclusion hp3 hpOdd hf
    chars X W hLeft
  have hYW := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_lt_of_properInclusion hp3 hpOdd hf
    chars W Y hRight
  have hXCount := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars X sigma rfl
  have hYCount := semisimpleSupportZeroCount_eq hp3 hpOdd hf chars Y tau rfl
  rw [hXCount] at hWX
  rw [hYCount] at hYW
  omega

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.mu_no_intermediate
statement:
theorem PhantomWeight.mu_no_intermediate
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.MuValid j) :
    ¬ ∃ Z : Set (OrderedCharacterPair I A),
      Z ∈ semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars ∧
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊂ Z ∧
      Z ⊂ semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars (sigma.mu hf j valid)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨Z, hZ, hLeft, hRight⟩
  have hGap := zeroCount_add_two_le_of_intermediate hp3 hpOdd hf chars sigma
    (sigma.mu hf j valid) Z hZ hLeft hRight
  have hCount := sigma.zeroCount_mu (by omega) hf j valid
  split at hCount <;> omega

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.theta_adjacent_zero_of_intermediate
statement:
theorem PhantomWeight.theta_adjacent_zero_of_intermediate
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (Z : Set (OrderedCharacterPair I A))
    (hZ : Z ∈ semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
    (hLeft : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊂ Z)
    (hRight : Z ⊂
      semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars (sigma.theta hf j valid)) :
    sigma.u j = 0 ∧ sigma.u (j + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hGap := zeroCount_add_two_le_of_intermediate hp3 hpOdd hf chars sigma
    (sigma.theta hf j valid) Z hZ hLeft hRight
  have hCount := sigma.zeroCount_theta (by omega) hf j valid
  have huZero : sigma.u j = 0 := by
    by_contra hu
    rw [if_neg hu] at hCount
    omega
  exact ⟨huZero, valid.2⟩

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.nu_adjacent_zero_of_intermediate
statement:
theorem PhantomWeight.nu_adjacent_zero_of_intermediate
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : sigma.NuValid j)
    (Z : Set (OrderedCharacterPair I A))
    (hZ : Z ∈ semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
    (hLeft : semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars sigma ⊂ Z)
    (hRight : Z ⊂ semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
      (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid)) :
    sigma.u j = 0 ∧ sigma.u (j + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hGap := zeroCount_add_two_le_of_intermediate hp3 hpOdd hf chars sigma
    (sigma.nu (by omega) hf j valid) Z hZ hLeft hRight
  have hNoninvertible : sigma.u (j + 1) ≠ p := by
    intro huSucc
    have hCount := sigma.zeroCount_nu_of_invertible (by omega) hf j valid huSucc
    omega
  have hCount := sigma.zeroCount_nu_of_noninvertible (by omega) hf j valid
    hNoninvertible
  have huSuccZero : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0 := by
    by_contra hu
    rw [if_neg hu] at hCount
    omega
  exact ⟨valid, huSuccZero⟩

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.theta_eq_nu_of_successor_zero
statement:
theorem PhantomWeight.theta_eq_nu_of_successor_zero
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (thetaValid : sigma.ThetaValid j) (nuValid : sigma.NuValid j)
    (huSucc : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0) :
    sigma.theta hf j thetaValid = sigma.nu hp hf j nuValid
proof:
:= by
  apply PhantomWeight.ext
  · funext i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · simp [PhantomWeight.theta, PhantomWeight.nu, hij]
    · by_cases hijSucc : i = j + 1
      · subst i
        simp [PhantomWeight.theta, PhantomWeight.nu, hij, huSucc]
      · simp [PhantomWeight.theta, PhantomWeight.nu, hij, hijSucc]
  · simp [PhantomWeight.theta, PhantomWeight.nu, huSucc]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.invertibleStep_reverse
statement:
theorem invertibleStep_reverse {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    {sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f}
    (hStep : InvertibleStep hp hf sigma tau) :
    InvertibleStep hp hf tau sigma
proof:
:= by
  rcases hStep with ⟨k, valid, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, valid, hu, rfl⟩
  · rcases sigma.nu_mu_inverse hp hf k hu valid.2 with
      ⟨validMu, validNu, hInverse⟩
    right
    refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only using validNu
    have hsucc : k + 1 ≠ k := by
      intro h
      have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
        omega
      apply hone
      calc
        (1 : ZMod f) = (k + 1) - k := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    · simp [mu, hsucc, valid.2]
    · simpa only using hInverse.symm
  · rcases sigma.mu_nu_inverse hp hf k valid hu with
      ⟨validNu, validMu, hInverse⟩
    left
    refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only using validMu
    · have hv : sigma.u k = 0 := valid
      simp [nu, hv]
    · simpa only using hInverse.symm

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.thetaLocalConditions_of_invertibleStep
statement:
theorem thetaLocalConditions_of_invertibleStep
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    {sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f} {j : ZMod f}
    (hStep : InvertibleStep (by omega) hf sigma tau)
    (hLocal : ThetaLocalConditions sigma j) : ThetaLocalConditions tau j
proof:
:= by
  rcases hLocal with ⟨huj, huj1, hujm1, huj2⟩
  rcases hStep with ⟨k, valid, huk, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, valid, huk1, rfl⟩
  · have hkj : k ≠ j := by
      intro h
      subst k
      omega
    have hkj1 : k ≠ j + 1 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, huj1] at huk
      omega
    have hk1j : k + 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hk : k = j - 1 := by linear_combination h
      rw [hk] at huk
      exact hujm1 huk
    have hk1j1 : k + 1 ≠ j + 1 := by
      intro h
      apply hkj
      linear_combination h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [mu, hkj.symm, hk1j.symm, huj]
    · simp [mu, hkj1.symm, hk1j1.symm, huj1]
    · intro hOne
      by_cases hkm1 : j - 1 = k
      · apply hujm1
        rw [hkm1]
        exact huk
      · by_cases hkm1s : j - 1 = k + 1
        · change (if j - 1 = k then sigma.u (j - 1) - 1
              else if j - 1 = k + 1 then sigma.u (j - 1) + p
              else sigma.u (j - 1)) = 1 at hOne
          rw [if_neg hkm1, if_pos hkm1s] at hOne
          omega
        · have : sigma.u (j - 1) = 1 := by
            simpa [mu, hkm1, hkm1s] using hOne
          exact hujm1 this
    · intro hP
      by_cases hk2 : j + 2 = k
      · subst k
        simp [mu, huk] at hP
        omega
      · by_cases hk2s : j + 2 = k + 1
        · have : k = j + 1 := by
            calc
              k = (k + 1) - 1 := by ring
              _ = (j + 2) - 1 := by rw [← hk2s]
              _ = j + 1 := by ring
          exact hkj1 this
        · have : sigma.u (j + 2) = p := by
            simpa [mu, hk2, hk2s] using hP
          exact huj2 this
  · have hkj : k ≠ j := by
      intro h
      subst k
      rw [huj1] at huk1
      omega
    have hkj1 : k ≠ j + 1 := by
      intro h
      have hk1 : k + 1 = j + 2 := by rw [h]; ring
      rw [hk1] at huk1
      exact huj2 huk1
    have hk1j : k + 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      rw [h, huj] at huk1
      omega
    have hk1j1 : k + 1 ≠ j + 1 := by
      intro h
      apply hkj
      linear_combination h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [nu, hkj.symm, hk1j.symm, huj]
    · simp [nu, hkj1.symm, hk1j1.symm, huj1]
    · intro hOne
      by_cases hkm1 : j - 1 = k
      · apply hk1j
        calc
          k + 1 = (j - 1) + 1 := by rw [hkm1]
          _ = j := by ring
      · by_cases hkm1s : j - 1 = k + 1
        · change (if j - 1 = k then sigma.u (j - 1) + 1
              else if j - 1 = k + 1 then p - sigma.u (j - 1)
              else sigma.u (j - 1)) = 1 at hOne
          rw [if_neg hkm1, if_pos hkm1s] at hOne
          have huAt : sigma.u (j - 1) = p := by rw [hkm1s]; exact huk1
          rw [huAt, Nat.sub_self] at hOne
          omega
        · have : sigma.u (j - 1) = 1 := by
            simpa [nu, hkm1, hkm1s] using hOne
          exact hujm1 this
    · intro hP
      by_cases hk2 : j + 2 = k
      · change (if j + 2 = k then sigma.u (j + 2) + 1
              else if j + 2 = k + 1 then p - sigma.u (j + 2)
              else sigma.u (j + 2)) = p at hP
        rw [if_pos hk2] at hP
        have huAt : sigma.u (j + 2) = 0 := by rw [hk2]; exact valid
        rw [huAt] at hP
        omega
      · by_cases hk2s : j + 2 = k + 1
        · change (if j + 2 = k then sigma.u (j + 2) + 1
              else if j + 2 = k + 1 then p - sigma.u (j + 2)
              else sigma.u (j + 2)) = p at hP
          rw [if_neg hk2, if_pos hk2s] at hP
          have huAt : sigma.u (j + 2) = p := by rw [hk2s]; exact huk1
          rw [huAt, Nat.sub_self] at hP
          omega
        · have : sigma.u (j + 2) = p := by
            simpa [nu, hk2, hk2s] using hP
          exact huj2 this

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.theta_invertibleStep
statement:
theorem theta_invertibleStep
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    {sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f} {j : ZMod f}
    (hStep : InvertibleStep (by omega) hf sigma tau)
    (hLocal : ThetaLocalConditions sigma j)
    (validSigma : sigma.ThetaValid j) (validTau : tau.ThetaValid j) :
    InvertibleStep (by omega) hf (sigma.theta hf j validSigma)
      (tau.theta hf j validTau)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hLocal with ⟨huj, huj1, hujm1, huj2⟩
  rcases hStep with ⟨k, valid, huk, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, valid, huk1, rfl⟩
  · have hkj : k ≠ j := by
      intro h
      subst k
      omega
    have hkj1 : k ≠ j + 1 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, huj1] at huk
      omega
    have hk1j : k + 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hk : k = j - 1 := by linear_combination h
      rw [hk] at huk
      exact hujm1 huk
    have hk1j1 : k + 1 ≠ j + 1 := by
      intro h
      apply hkj
      linear_combination h
    have validMu : (sigma.theta hf j validSigma).MuValid k := by
      constructor
      · simp [theta, hkj, hkj1, huk]
      · simp [theta, hk1j, hk1j1, valid.2]
    left
    refine ⟨k, validMu, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [theta, hkj, hkj1, huk]
    · apply PhantomWeight.ext
      · funext i
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst i
          simp [theta, mu, hkj.symm, hk1j.symm]
        · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
          · subst i
            simp [theta, mu, hij, hkj1.symm, hk1j1.symm]
          · by_cases hik : i = k
            · subst i
              simp [theta, mu, hkj, hkj1]
            · by_cases hik1 : i = k + 1
              · subst i
                simp [theta, mu, hk1j, hk1j1]
              · simp [theta, mu, hij, hij1, hik, hik1]
      · simp [theta, mu]
  · have hkj : k ≠ j := by
      intro h
      subst k
      rw [huj1] at huk1
      omega
    have hkj1 : k ≠ j + 1 := by
      intro h
      have hk1 : k + 1 = j + 2 := by rw [h]; ring
      rw [hk1] at huk1
      exact huj2 huk1
    have hk1j : k + 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      rw [h, huj] at huk1
      omega
    have hk1j1 : k + 1 ≠ j + 1 := by
      intro h
      apply hkj
      linear_combination h
    have validNu : (sigma.theta hf j validSigma).NuValid k := by
      change sigma.u k = 0 at valid
      change (sigma.theta hf j validSigma).u k = 0
      simpa [theta, hkj, hkj1] using valid
    right
    refine ⟨k, validNu, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [theta, hk1j, hk1j1, huk1]
    · apply PhantomWeight.ext
      · funext i
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst i
          simp [theta, nu, hkj.symm, hk1j.symm]
        · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
          · subst i
            simp [theta, nu, hij, hkj1.symm, hk1j1.symm]
          · by_cases hik : i = k
            · subst i
              simp [theta, nu, hkj, hkj1]
            · by_cases hik1 : i = k + 1
              · subst i
                simp [theta, nu, hk1j, hk1j1]
              · simp [theta, nu, hij, hij1, hik, hik1]
      · simp [theta, nu, hk1j, hk1j1]
        ring

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.thetaLocalConditions_iff_of_invertibleStep
statement:
theorem thetaLocalConditions_iff_of_invertibleStep
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    {sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f} {j : ZMod f}
    (hStep : InvertibleStep (by omega) hf sigma tau) :
    ThetaLocalConditions sigma j ↔ ThetaLocalConditions tau j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact thetaLocalConditions_of_invertibleStep hp hf hStep
  · exact thetaLocalConditions_of_invertibleStep hp hf
      (invertibleStep_reverse (by omega) hf hStep)

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.theta_equivalent_transport
statement:
theorem theta_equivalent_transport
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    {sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f} {j : ZMod f}
    (hEquivalent : Equivalent (by omega) hf sigma tau) :
    (ThetaLocalConditions sigma j ↔ ThetaLocalConditions tau j) ∧
      ∀ (validSigma : sigma.ThetaValid j) (validTau : tau.ThetaValid j),
        ThetaLocalConditions sigma j → ThetaLocalConditions tau j →
        Equivalent (by omega) hf (sigma.theta hf j validSigma)
          (tau.theta hf j validTau)
proof:
:= by
  induction hEquivalent with
  | rel sigma tau hStep =>
      refine ⟨thetaLocalConditions_iff_of_invertibleStep hp hf hStep, ?_⟩
      intro validSigma validTau hSigma _hTau
      exact Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _
        (theta_invertibleStep hp hf hStep hSigma validSigma validTau)
  | refl sigma =>
      refine ⟨Iff.rfl, ?_⟩
      intro validSigma validTau _hSigma _hTau
      have hTheta : sigma.theta hf j validSigma = sigma.theta hf j validTau := rfl
      rw [hTheta]
      exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  | symm sigma tau hEquivalent ih =>
      refine ⟨ih.1.symm, ?_⟩
      intro validTau validSigma hTau hSigma
      exact Relation.EqvGen.symm _ _ (ih.2 validSigma validTau hSigma hTau)
  | trans sigma tau upsilon hSigmaTau hTauUpsilon ihSigmaTau ihTauUpsilon =>
      refine ⟨ihSigmaTau.1.trans ihTauUpsilon.1, ?_⟩
      intro validSigma validUpsilon hSigma hUpsilon
      have hTau : ThetaLocalConditions tau j := ihSigmaTau.1.mp hSigma
      have validTau : tau.ThetaValid j := ⟨by
        have hu := hTau.1
        omega, hTau.2.1⟩
      exact Relation.EqvGen.trans _ _ _
        (ihSigmaTau.2 validSigma validTau hSigma hTau)
        (ihTauUpsilon.2 validTau validUpsilon hTau hUpsilon)

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.theta_equivalent_of_equivalent_at_local_zero_pair
statement:
theorem theta_equivalent_of_equivalent_at_local_zero_pair
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    {sigma tau : PhantomWeight p f} (j : ZMod f)
    (hEquivalent : Equivalent (by omega) hf sigma tau)
    (hLocal : ThetaLocalConditions sigma j) :
    ThetaLocalConditions tau j ∧
      ∀ (validSigma : sigma.ThetaValid j) (validTau : tau.ThetaValid j),
        Equivalent (by omega) hf (tau.theta hf j validTau)
          (sigma.theta hf j validSigma)
proof:
:= by
  have hTransport := theta_equivalent_transport hp hf (j := j) hEquivalent
  have hTau := hTransport.1.mp hLocal
  refine ⟨hTau, ?_⟩
  intro validSigma validTau
  exact Relation.EqvGen.symm _ _
    (hTransport.2 validSigma validTau hLocal hTau)

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.niveauOneLeftExponent_theta
statement:
theorem niveauOneLeftExponent_theta {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j) (J : Set (ZMod f)) :
    niveauOneLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) J =
      niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma J + thetaNiveauOneShift hf j J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum : niveauOneProfileSum hf (sigma.theta hf j valid) J =
      niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J +
        (if j ∈ J then 1 else 0) * inversePower p f hf j +
        (if j + 1 ∈ J then 1 else 0) * inversePower p f hf j := by
    rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
      ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
    have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
        omega
      apply hone
      calc
        (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    have hfun :
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
          (((sigma.theta hf j valid).u i : Nat) : Int)) =
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦ ((Profile.niveauOne J).indicator i : Int) *
          (sigma.u i : Int)) +
        (fun i : ZMod f ↦
          if i = j then (if j ∈ J then 1 else 0)
          else if i = j + 1 then (if j + 1 ∈ J then (p : Int) else 0)
          else 0) := by
      funext i
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst i
        by_cases hj : j ∈ J <;>
          simp [theta, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hj]
      · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
        · subst i
          by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J <;>
            simp [theta, Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set,
              hsucc, hj1, valid.2]
        · simp [theta, hij, hij1]
    rw [hfun, translationExponent_add, translationExponent_adjacent]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
    all_goals rw [inversePower_succ p f hp hf j]
    all_goals ring
  rw [niveauOneLeftExponent, niveauOneLeftExponent, thetaNiveauOneShift, hsum]
  change (sigma.t - inversePower p f hf j) +
      (niveauOneProfileSum hf sigma J +
        (if j ∈ J then 1 else 0) * inversePower p f hf j +
        (if j + 1 ∈ J then 1 else 0) * inversePower p f hf j) = _
  ring

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.niveauOneLeftExponent_eq_of_adjacent_zero
statement:
theorem niveauOneLeftExponent_eq_of_adjacent_zero
    {p f : Nat} (hf : 2 ≤ f) (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0)
    {J K : Set (ZMod f)}
    (hAway : ∀ i, i ≠ j → i ≠ j + 1 → (i ∈ J ↔ i ∈ K)) :
    niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma J = niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma K
proof:
:= by
  rw [niveauOneLeftExponent, niveauOneLeftExponent]
  congr 1
  rw [← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator,
    ← translationExponent_niveauOne_indicator]
  congr 1
  funext i
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst i
    simp [huj]
  · by_cases hij1 : i = j + 1
    · subst i
      simp [huj1]
    · have hi := hAway i hij hij1
      by_cases hiJ : i ∈ J
      · have hiK := hi.mp hiJ
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hiK]
      · have hiK : i ∉ K := by simpa [hiJ] using hi
        simp [Profile.indicator, Profile.Contains, Profile.set, hiJ, hiK]

name: KLSposet.PhantomWeight.theta_niveauOneLeftExponent_range
statement:
theorem theta_niveauOneLeftExponent_range
    {p f : Nat} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (sigma : PhantomWeight p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : sigma.ThetaValid j)
    (huj : sigma.u j = 0) (huj1 : sigma.u (j + 1) = 0) :
    Set.range (niveauOneLeftExponent hf (sigma.theta hf j valid)) =
      Set.image2 (fun x y : ZMod (p ^ f - 1) ↦ x + y)
        (Set.range (niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma))
        ({-inversePower p f hf j, 0, inversePower p f hf j} :
          Set (ZMod (p ^ f - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨J, rfl⟩
    rw [niveauOneLeftExponent_theta hp hf]
    refine Set.mem_image2_of_mem
      (f := fun x y : ZMod (p ^ f - 1) ↦ x + y) ⟨J, rfl⟩ ?_
    by_cases hj : j ∈ J <;> by_cases hj1 : j + 1 ∈ J <;>
      simp [thetaNiveauOneShift, hj, hj1]
  · intro hx
    rcases hx with ⟨a, ⟨J, rfl⟩, gamma, hGamma, rfl⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hGamma
    rcases hGamma with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · let K : Set (ZMod f) := J \ {j, j + 1}
      refine ⟨K, ?_⟩
      rw [niveauOneLeftExponent_theta hp hf]
      have hBase : niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma K =
          niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma J := by
        apply niveauOneLeftExponent_eq_of_adjacent_zero hf sigma j huj huj1
        intro i hij hij1
        simp [K, hij, hij1]
      have hjK : j ∉ K := by simp [K]
      have hj1K : j + 1 ∉ K := by simp [K]
      rw [hBase]
      simp [thetaNiveauOneShift, hjK, hj1K]
    · let K : Set (ZMod f) := insert j (J \ {j, j + 1})
      refine ⟨K, ?_⟩
      rw [niveauOneLeftExponent_theta hp hf]
      have hBase : niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma K =
          niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma J := by
        apply niveauOneLeftExponent_eq_of_adjacent_zero hf sigma j huj huj1
        intro i hij hij1
        simp [K, hij, hij1]
      have hjK : j ∈ K := by simp [K]
      have hj1K : j + 1 ∉ K := by
        have hsucc : j + 1 ≠ j := by
          intro h
          have hone : (1 : ZMod f) ≠ 0 := by
            rw [Ne, ZMod.one_eq_zero_iff]
            omega
          apply hone
          calc
            (1 : ZMod f) = (j + 1) - j := by ring
            _ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
        simp [K, hsucc]
      rw [hBase]
      simp [thetaNiveauOneShift, hjK, hj1K]
    · let K : Set (ZMod f) := insert j (insert (j + 1) J)
      refine ⟨K, ?_⟩
      rw [niveauOneLeftExponent_theta hp hf]
      have hBase : niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma K =
          niveauOneLeftExponent hf sigma J := by
        apply niveauOneLeftExponent_eq_of_adjacent_zero hf sigma j huj huj1
        intro i hij hij1
        simp [K, hij, hij1]
      have hjK : j ∈ K := by simp [K]
      have hj1K : j + 1 ∈ K := by simp [K]
      rw [hBase]
      simp [thetaNiveauOneShift, hjK, hj1K]

name: KLSposet.hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily_eq
statement:
theorem hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily_eq
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A) :
    hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily hp hf chars =
      semisimpleCharacterSetFamily hp hf chars
proof:
:= by
  ext X
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨sigma, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨sigma.toHodge, ?_⟩
    simp [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet,
      PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge hp hf]

name: KLSposet.hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet_eq_iff_equivalent_or_barsottiTate_steinberg
statement:
theorem hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet_eq_iff_equivalent_or_barsottiTate_steinberg
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (r s : PBoundedHodgeType p f) :
    hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars r =
        hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars s ↔
      r.Equivalent (by omega) hf s ∨
        ∃ t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1),
          (r.Equivalent (by omega) hf
                (PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t).toHodge ∧
              s.Equivalent (by omega) hf
                (PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t).toHodge) ∨
            (r.Equivalent (by omega) hf
                (PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t).toHodge ∧
              s.Equivalent (by omega) hf
                (PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t).toHodge)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet, hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet]
  constructor
  · intro hEq
    rcases (semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_iff_equivalent_or_barsottiTate_steinberg
        hp3 hpOdd hf chars (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r)
          (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf s)).mp hEq with
      hEquivalent | ⟨t, hForward | hReverse⟩
    · exact Or.inl hEquivalent
    · right
      refine ⟨t, Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · unfold PBoundedHodgeType.Equivalent
        rw [PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf, hForward.1]
        exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
      · unfold PBoundedHodgeType.Equivalent
        rw [PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf, hForward.2]
        exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
    · right
      refine ⟨t, Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · unfold PBoundedHodgeType.Equivalent
        rw [PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf, hReverse.1]
        exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
      · unfold PBoundedHodgeType.Equivalent
        rw [PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf, hReverse.2]
        exact Relation.EqvGen.refl _
  · rintro (hEquivalent | ⟨t, hForward | hReverse⟩)
    · exact semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_equivalent (by omega) hf chars
        hEquivalent
    · calc
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
            (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r) =
            semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf
                (PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t).toHodge) :=
          semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_equivalent (by omega) hf chars
            hForward.1
        _ = semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t) := by
          rw [PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf]
        _ = semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t) :=
          barsottiTate_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_steinberg
            (by omega) hf chars t
        _ = semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf
                (PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t).toHodge) := by
          rw [PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf]
        _ = semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf s) :=
          (semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_equivalent (by omega) hf chars
            hForward.2).symm
    · calc
        semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
            (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r) =
            semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf
                (PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t).toHodge) :=
          semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_equivalent (by omega) hf chars
            hReverse.1
        _ = semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (PhantomWeight.steinberg p f t) := by
          rw [PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf]
        _ = semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t) :=
          (barsottiTate_semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_steinberg
            (by omega) hf chars t).symm
        _ = semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf
                (PhantomWeight.barsottiTate p f (by omega) t).toHodge) := by
          rw [PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf]
        _ = semisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
              (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf s) :=
          (semisimpleCharacterSet_eq_of_equivalent (by omega) hf chars
            hReverse.2).symm

name: KLSposet.hodgeSimpleSupportInclusion_classification
statement:
theorem hodgeSimpleSupportInclusion_classification
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (X Y : Set (OrderedCharacterPair I A))
    (hX : X ∈ hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
    (hY : Y ∈ hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
    (hSimple : SimpleInclusionIn
      (hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars) X Y) :
    HodgeSimpleSupportInclusionClassification (by omega) hf chars X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hFamily := hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily_eq (by omega) hf chars
  have hX' : X ∈ semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars := by
    rw [← hFamily]
    exact hX
  have hY' : Y ∈ semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars := by
    rw [← hFamily]
    exact hY
  have hSimple' : SimpleInclusionIn
      (semisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars) X Y := by
    rw [← hFamily]
    exact hSimple
  have hClassification := simpleSupportInclusion_classification hp3 hpOdd hf
    chars X Y hX' hY' hSimple'
  cases hClassification with
  | mu sigma j valid hSource hTarget =>
      let r : PBoundedHodgeType p f := sigma.toHodge
      have hEncode : PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r = sigma :=
        PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf sigma
      have validR : r.MuValid j :=
        (PhantomWeight.muValid_iff_ofHodge hf r j).mpr (by
          simpa only [hEncode] using valid)
      exact .mu r j validR
        (by simpa only [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet, hEncode] using hSource)
        (by simpa only [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet,
          PhantomWeight.ofHodge_mu, hEncode] using hTarget)
  | theta sigma j valid hSource hTarget =>
      let r : PBoundedHodgeType p f := sigma.toHodge
      have hEncode : PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r = sigma :=
        PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf sigma
      have validR : r.ThetaValid j :=
        (PhantomWeight.thetaValid_iff_ofHodge hf r j).mpr (by
          simpa only [hEncode] using valid)
      exact .theta r j validR
        (by simpa only [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet, hEncode] using hSource)
        (by simpa only [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet,
          PhantomWeight.ofHodge_theta, hEncode] using hTarget)
  | nu sigma j valid hSource hTarget =>
      let r : PBoundedHodgeType p f := sigma.toHodge
      have hEncode : PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r = sigma :=
        PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf sigma
      have validR : r.NuValid j :=
        (PhantomWeight.nuValid_iff_ofHodge hf r j).mpr (by
          simpa only [hEncode] using valid)
      exact .nu r j validR
        (by simpa only [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet, hEncode] using hSource)
        (by simpa only [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet,
          PhantomWeight.ofHodge_nu, hEncode] using hTarget)
  | unramifiedCritical t hSource hTarget =>
      exact .unramifiedCritical t
        (by
          rw [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet,
            PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf]
          exact hSource)
        (by
          rw [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet,
            PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf]
          exact hTarget)

name: KLSposet.hodgeUnramifiedCritical_simpleInclusion
statement:
theorem hodgeUnramifiedCritical_simpleInclusion
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (t : ZMod (p ^ f - 1)) :
    SimpleInclusionIn
      (hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
      (hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.unramified p f t).toHodge)
      (hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
        (PhantomWeight.critical p f t).toHodge)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily_eq (by omega) hf chars]
  rw [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet, hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet,
    PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf,
    PhantomWeight.ofHodge_toHodge (by omega) hf]
  exact unramified_critical_semisimpleCharacterSet_simple hp3 hf chars t

name: KLSposet.PBoundedHodgeType.mu_simpleInclusion_iff
statement:
theorem mu_simpleInclusion_iff
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : r.MuValid j) :
    SimpleInclusionIn
        (hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
        (hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars r)
        (hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
          (r.mu hf j valid)) ↔
      (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r).u j ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily_eq (by omega) hf chars]
  rw [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet, hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet,
    PhantomWeight.ofHodge_mu]
  exact PhantomWeight.mu_simpleInclusion_iff hp3 hpOdd hf chars
    (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r) j
      ((PhantomWeight.muValid_iff_ofHodge hf r j).mp valid)

name: KLSposet.PBoundedHodgeType.theta_simpleInclusion_iff
statement:
theorem theta_simpleInclusion_iff
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f) (j : ZMod f)
    (valid : r.ThetaValid j) :
    SimpleInclusionIn
        (hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
        (hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars r)
        (hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
          (r.theta hf j valid)) ↔
      ¬ r.ExceptionalForSimplicity hf j
proof:
:= by
  rw [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily_eq (by omega) hf chars]
  rw [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet, hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet,
    PhantomWeight.ofHodge_theta]
  exact PhantomWeight.theta_simpleInclusion_iff hp3 hpOdd hf chars
    (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r) j
      ((PhantomWeight.thetaValid_iff_ofHodge hf r j).mp valid)

name: KLSposet.PBoundedHodgeType.nu_simpleInclusion_iff
statement:
theorem nu_simpleInclusion_iff
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A)
    (r : PBoundedHodgeType p f) (j : ZMod f) (valid : r.NuValid j) :
    SimpleInclusionIn
        (hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily (by omega) hf chars)
        (hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars r)
        (hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet (by omega) hf chars
          (r.nu (by omega) hf j valid)) ↔
      (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r).u (j + 1) ≠ p ∧
        ¬ r.ExceptionalForSimplicity hf j
proof:
:= by
  rw [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSetFamily_eq (by omega) hf chars]
  rw [hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet, hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet,
    PhantomWeight.ofHodge_nu]
  exact PhantomWeight.nu_simpleInclusion_iff hp3 hpOdd hf chars
    (PhantomWeight.ofHodge hf r) j
      ((PhantomWeight.nuValid_iff_ofHodge hf r j).mp valid)

name: KLSposet.hodgeSemisimpleSupport_theorem
statement:
theorem hodgeSemisimpleSupport_theorem
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type*} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A) :
    HodgeSemisimpleSupportConclusions hp3 hpOdd hf chars where
  equalityClassification
proof:
:=
    hodgeSemisimpleCharacterSet_eq_iff_equivalent_or_barsottiTate_steinberg
      hp3 hpOdd hf chars
  simpleInclusionClassification :=
    hodgeSimpleSupportInclusion_classification hp3 hpOdd hf chars
  unramifiedCriticalSimple :=
    hodgeUnramifiedCritical_simpleInclusion hp3 hf chars
  muSimplicity := PBoundedHodgeType.mu_simpleInclusion_iff
    hp3 hpOdd hf chars
  thetaSimplicity := PBoundedHodgeType.theta_simpleInclusion_iff
    hp3 hpOdd hf chars
  nuSimplicity := PBoundedHodgeType.nu_simpleInclusion_iff
    hp3 hpOdd hf chars

name: KLSposet.hodgeSemisimpleSupport_theorem_type0
statement:
theorem hodgeSemisimpleSupport_theorem_type0
    {p f : Nat} {I A : Type 0} [Monoid I] [CommGroup A]
    (hp3 : 3 ≤ p) (hpOdd : Odd p) (hf : 2 ≤ f)
    (chars : FundamentalCharacterSystem p f I A) :
    HodgeSemisimpleSupportConclusions hp3 hpOdd hf chars
proof:
:=
  hodgeSemisimpleSupport_theorem hp3 hpOdd hf chars
